title: Systems Development Engineer II, FO Support
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon.com is seeking a Systems Development Engineer to join a Fulfillment Optimization team that helps promise, plan, and execute the delivery of millions of packages to customers worldwide — faster and cheaper each day — while providing an extraordinary customer experience from the website to doorstep delivery. Our systems handle millions of requests per second and make business recommendations that impact billions of dollars each year. With rapid expansion into new geographies, increasing complexity of the transportation network, and an expanding selection of products, the Fulfillment Optimization team builds solutions that scale and propel the business with best-in-class technology innovations.  
  
We are looking for passionate, hard-working, and talented engineers who have experience supporting innovative, mission-critical, high-volume applications — and who are excited to apply AI and agentic automation to how large-scale systems are supported and operated. You will have an enormous opportunity to work across multiple systems: researching and identifying common issues, building AI-powered tooling that diagnoses and prevents them, and driving teams toward resolution to have a positive impact on the customer experience. Your solutions will impact our customers directly. This role requires you to hit the ground running; your ability to learn quickly and work on disparate and overlapping tasks will define your success.  
  
The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, has superior verbal and written communication skills and strong organizational skills, can juggle multiple tasks at once, works independently, and maintains professionalism under pressure. You must be able to identify problems before they happen and implement solutions that detect and prevent outages. Your ability to accurately prioritize work, make sound technical trade-offs, improve the customer experience, and get the right things done will have a direct impact on Amazon's Supply Chain Optimization and fulfillment-network efficiency.  
  
As a SysDE II on this team, you will work autonomously on difficult, team- and component-level problems, build resilient and well-tested solutions, and increasingly act as a force multiplier — enabling other builders through the tools, automation, and AI capabilities you deliver.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Dive deeply into technical details to diagnose, reproduce, and root-cause issues across Amazon technology products (services, tools, data solutions, etc.), and drive them to resolution or escalation.
* Design, build, and operate AI-powered and agentic support capabilities — diagnostic agents, automated root-cause analysis, anomaly detection, and self-healing/auto-remediation — that detect and prevent issues before they impact customers.
* Apply AI across the software development lifecycle (spec-driven and AI-assisted development, agentic workflows) to raise engineering velocity and quality.
* Automate repetitive operational tasks to increase efficiency and reduce manual toil, and build tooling that enables other engineers.
* Manage trouble tickets through to resolution or escalation using existing documentation, procedures, and tools, and improve those mechanisms over time.

About the team  
The Fulfillment Optimization (FO) Support team plays a crucial role in Amazon's supply chain operations. We invent and deliver software solutions that facilitate Customer Promise Speed, Order Planning, and Fulfillment.  
  
The FO Support team leverages data, process improvement, and innovative technologies — including AI and agentic automation — to provide comprehensive engineering-excellence services and solutions across FO's product portfolios. The team is responsible for FO services as front-line support and plays a central role in the organization's success.

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
* Knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals (networking, storage, operating systems)
* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience building services using AWS products
* Experience with distributed systems at scale
* Experience with Linux/Unix
* Experience leveraging AI (Artificial Intelligence) agents for security review automation, spec-driven development practices, or adversarial red teaming
* Experience building or integrating AI/GenAI-powered solutions (e.g., LLM-based tools, agentic frameworks, automated diagnostics or remediation)

title: Embedded Software Technical Lead
description:
At **Kandou**, we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to **democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)** of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption.

Our proprietary **MIMO-over-copper technology** powers a **high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric** that is both **scalable and energy-efficient**. Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution **reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly** while preserving **high bandwidth and ultra-low latency** — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale.

As **Embedded Software Technical Lead**, you will lead the implementation and delivery of assigned firmware modules and workstreams for Kandou's new ASIC products, under the technical direction of the overall Firmware Lead. You will remain hands-on in coding, debugging and bring-up, while mentoring engineers working on your scope. The overall Firmware Lead owns the firmware roadmap, team-wide priorities and release decisions; this role owns execution within the agreed architecture and project plan.

**Responsabilities**

* Lead the design, development, test and maintenance of assigned real-time firmware modules for high-speed heterogeneous SoC platforms.
* Translate agreed system requirements into module designs and hardware/software interfaces; review architecture and interface changes with the Firmware Lead and architects.
* Plan and coordinate assigned work: estimate effort, track dependencies and milestones, and escalate risks and priority conflicts to the Firmware Lead.
* Remain hands-on in C/C++ development, RTOS integration, low-level drivers, bootloaders, secure boot and reliable firmware updates.
* Drive bring-up, hardware/software integration and root-cause analysis for assigned firmware, working with silicon design and validation teams.
* Lead module-level design and code reviews, apply team coding and test standards, and provide validation evidence and documentation for firmware release reviews.
* Mentor engineers on assigned work, guide implementation decisions and share knowledge; align broader technical decisions with the Firmware Lead.

Coordinate with validation and applications teams to resolve integration and field issues; improve the software tools supporting silicon development and debug.

**Essential Experience**

* 10+ years of experience designing, coding and debugging real-time embedded applications in C and/or C++, including 2+ years providing technical leadership for firmware modules or projects.
* Demonstrated ownership of firmware module delivery from requirements and design through bring-up, validation and release integration within a wider engineering team.
* Strong embedded SoC experience with bare-metal and RTOS environments, including RTOS porting and integration with Zephyr, FreeRTOS or equivalent.
* Knowledge of RISC-V architecture and hands-on bare-metal or RTOS firmware development for RV32/RV64 cores, including trap handling, CSR access and toolchain setup.
* Board and SoC bring-up using JTAG and other debug mechanisms; ability to diagnose complex issues across firmware, drivers and hardware.
* Experience interfacing with hardware and peripherals using SPI, I2C/SMBus, I3C and JTAG, and implementing bootloaders, secure boot and firmware update flows.
* Proficiency in Python or another modern scripting language, and practical use of Git/GitLab, CI, Make/CMake and automated unit and integration testing.
* Strong design-review, documentation, organisational, presentation and mentoring skills; ability to align cross-functional teams and learn new technical areas.

**Useful Experience**

* Heterogeneous multicore systems with scalar and vector processors; embedded Linux, memory and network interfaces, and virtual memory.
* High-speed signalling technologies such as PCIe and CXL, including link training, equalization and retimer/redriver interaction with host and device PHYs.
* Firmware for Active Electrical Cable (AEC) or retimer/redriver ASICs, including cable diagnostics, eye margin monitoring, temperature/voltage telemetry and power-state management.
* Management and sideband protocols including SMBus, I3C, MCTP and CMIS; SerDes technology and PHY register-level tuning.
* Simulation, co-simulation and FPGA platforms for pre-silicon firmware development; HyperBus and HyperRAM technologies.

Cryptographic algorithms and secure firmware lifecycle practices, including authenticated updates, recovery and rollback protection.

If this is the role you have been looking for and you want to be part of a growing Company, with an exciting future then we would love to hear from you. Together We Kandou It!!

* Perform fiber optic and copper cable laying as per approved routes and project requirements.
* Conduct route surveys, cable length calculations and pathway/tray inspections.
* Perform fiber splicing, including stripping, cleaning, cleaving, alignment, fusion splicing and splice-tray dressing.
* Perform fiber core mapping, labeling and termination.
* Work with LIU, ODF, fiber cassettes, patch panels and patch cords.
* Perform fiber testing using VFL, optical power meter and OTDR.
* Identify and troubleshoot fiber faults, high-loss issues, connectivity problems and link failures.
* Perform CAT5e/CAT6/CAT6A copper cable laying and termination.
* Perform I/O and patch-panel termination using T568A/T568B standards.
* Ensure proper cable dressing, bend-radius control, labeling and cable management.
* Conduct copper cable testing and support certification activities.
* Troubleshoot failed copper certification results, including wire-map, termination, pair-untwist, bend/crushing and patch-cord issues.
* Support data-center cabling and rack patching activities.
* Maintain accurate Port Matrix, Fiber Core Matrix, Copper Connectivity Sheets and cable documentation.
* Prepare and maintain testing reports, as-built documentation and project handover documents.
* Coordinate with project engineers, customers, vendors and internal teams during implementation.
* Follow all required quality, safety and site procedures.

* Basic understanding of Single Mode and Multi Mode Fiber.
* Knowledge of OS1/OS2 and OM1/OM2/OM3/OM4/OM5.
* 12-core fiber color-code knowledge.
* Fiber laying and cable dressing.
* Fusion splicing and core mapping.
* VFL, OTDR and optical power testing.
* Fiber fault identification and troubleshooting.

Copper Cabling
  
  

* CAT5e, CAT6 and CAT6A cabling.
* T568A/T568B color codes.
* I/O and patch-panel termination.
* Cable dressing and labeling.
* Wire-map and certification testing.
* Understanding of NEXT, FEXT, Return Loss and other basic certification parameters.

Data Center / Infrastructure
  
  

* Rack and patch-panel connectivity.
* LIU, ODF and fiber cassette handling.
* Cable routing and management.
* Port mapping and source/destination identification.
* Basic understanding of structured cabling practices.

**Practical Skills Preferred**

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
**Job Description: Product Marketing Manager**

**Experience:**
3–5 years

**Location:**
Mulund , Mumbai (In office 5 days a week)

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About mple.ai**

mple.ai is building an AI-powered platform that helps organisations improve employee capability, training effectiveness, and business performance. We are evolving beyond training and enablement into a business intelligence platform that connects employee behaviour, departmental performance, and organisational goals to actionable insights.

We are looking for a
**Product Marketing Manager who can bridge the gap between product, customers, sales, and growth**
. This person will own how we communicate our product internally and externally, translate features into compelling value propositions, and drive efficient customer acquisition through data led growth marketing.

This is an opportunity for someone who thrives in a startup environment, enjoys building from scratch, and has experience scaling products in a
**1 to 100 growth journey**
.

**What You Will Own1. Customer & Product Communication**

* Translate product features and capabilities into clear, compelling customer benefits and business outcomes.
* Own customer facing product communication, including product launches, feature announcements, release notes, product updates, email communication, and adoption campaigns.
* Build product messaging for different stakeholders, including business leaders, department heads, administrators, and end users.
* Develop customer education and enablement assets such as product guides, FAQs, one-pagers, presentations, demos, and use-case documents.
* Understand customer pain points, feedback, and usage behaviour to identify communication gaps and opportunities to improve adoption.
* Ensure customers understand not just what the product does, but why it matters to their business.

**2. Sales Enablement**

* Act as the communication bridge between Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing.
* Ensure internal teams understand new features, product changes, use cases, limitations, and positioning before communicating them to customers.
* Create sales enablement material, including pitch decks, battlecards, objection handling guides, competitor comparisons, and product walkthroughs.
* Convert customer feedback and frontline insights into actionable inputs for the Product team.

**3. Growth Marketing & CPA Optimisation**

* Plan and execute growth marketing initiatives across relevant paid and organic channels.
* Own customer acquisition performance, with a strong focus on
  **Cost Per Acquisition (CPA)**
  and improving acquisition efficiency.
* Track campaign performance across the funnel, from lead generation and conversion to qualified opportunities and customer acquisition.
* Experiment with messaging, creatives, landing pages, audiences, offers, and channels to improve conversion rates.
* Work with sales and growth teams to understand lead quality and optimise campaigns for meaningful business outcomes, not just clicks or leads.
* Monitor acquisition metrics, identify inefficiencies, and continuously reallocate effort and budgets towards better-performing channels.
* Build a culture of experimentation through structured hypotheses, rapid testing, and data-backed decisions.

**4. Building in a Startup Environment**

* Take ownership of projects end-to-end, from identifying a problem to executing, measuring, and improving the solution.
* Work comfortably in an environment where processes are still evolving and priorities can change quickly..

**What We Are Looking For**

* **3–5 years of experience**
  in product marketing, growth marketing, B2B marketing.
* Prior experience working in a startup, preferably in a fast growing SaaS, AI, B2B technology.
* Demonstrated experience contributing to a
  **1 to 100 scaling journey**
  building processes, launching initiatives, and improving outcomes as the business grows.
* **Excellent written and verbal communication skills**
  , with the ability to simplify complex product concepts.
* Strong
  **customer empathy**
  and the ability to understand business problems from the customer's perspective.
* Hands on experience with
  **growth campaigns**
  and a clear understanding of CPA, CAC, conversion rates, funnel performance, and acquisition efficiency.
* A
  **data driven mindset,**
  with the ability to interpret campaign performance and turn insights into action.
* A
  **bias for action**
  , comfort with ambiguity, and willingness to get into the details.

**What Will Make You Stand Out**

* Experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, AI products, HR tech, sales enablement, or learning and development.
* Experience marketing a product with multiple user personas or complex use cases.
* Experience building product communication processes from scratch.
* Experience running A/B tests and optimising landing pages and acquisition funnels.
* A portfolio of product launches, campaigns, sales enablement assets, or growth experiments with measurable results.

**Success Metrics for This Role**

Your performance will be evaluated on the impact of your work, not just the number of campaigns or assets delivered.

* **Feature Adoption: % of users using the feature launched**
  .
* **Internal alignment:**
  % Improvement in NPS for the feature released
* **Acquisition efficiency:**
  Reduction in CPA and improvement in conversion rates across relevant funnel stages.
* **Growth contribution:**
  Improvement in qualified lead generation and contribution to customer acquisition targets.

📍

Mumbai, India (Work from Office)

Monday to Friday (Saturday only when required)

**🌐 About Helo.ai**
Helo.ai by VivaConnect is an AI-first cloud communication platform (CPaaS), built on 25 years of enterprise communication expertise. We help businesses—from startups to large enterprises—personalise conversations for billions with AI across SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, Voicebots, Chatbots, and Email, all from a single platform.
  
  

* 25+ years of enterprise communication expertise
* Trusted by leading brands including Aditya Birla Capital, Bajaj Finance, and Kotak Mahindra Bank
* Google and Meta Partner

**🌟 Why Build Your Career With Us**

* Own and shape Helo.ai’s brand positioning and go-to-market presence
* Drive integrated marketing across brand, content, demand generation, events, and partnerships
* Work closely with leadership, sales, product, design, PR, and growth teams
* Lead high-impact campaigns in a fast-growing AI and CPaaS environment
* Build a scalable marketing engine that influences brand visibility and business growth
* Play a strategic role in defining how Helo.ai is perceived in the market

**🌍 Discover More About Helo.ai**

* Website: https://helo.ai/
* LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/sayheloai/
* Instagram: @sayheloai | @lifeathelo.ai

**💼 The Role You'll Play**
As our
**Senior Manager - Marketing & GTM**
, you will lead Helo.ai’s marketing strategy across brand, content, campaigns, events, partnerships, and demand generation.
  
  
You will be responsible for building a strong and differentiated market presence for Helo.ai while driving high-quality engagement, pipeline impact, and category visibility. This role requires someone who can combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution and work cross-functionally to turn marketing into a strong growth lever for the business.
  
  
In addition to the responsibilities listed below, you should be open to taking up related initiatives that strengthen Helo.ai’s market positioning, revenue influence, and brand impact.
  
  
**🧩 What You'll Be Driving**
**🔹 Brand Positioning & Strategic Marketing**

* Own and strengthen Helo.ai’s brand positioning across key business segments
* Shape messaging and narrative for products, solutions, and company-level communication
* Ensure consistency of brand voice across external and internal marketing touchpoints
* Drive brand visibility and differentiation in the AI, CPaaS, and enterprise communication space

**🔹 Go-to-Market Strategy**

* Lead GTM planning and execution for products, solutions, campaigns, and key business initiatives
* Translate business priorities into clear and actionable marketing programs
* Build marketing strategies aligned to customer segments, ICPs, and business goals
* Partner with sales and leadership teams to support revenue-focused campaigns and launches

**🔹 Content & Communication Leadership**

* Oversee high-impact content across LinkedIn, social media, website, email, decks, case studies, and sales enablement material
* Guide the creation of thought leadership, brand campaigns, product messaging, and customer-facing narratives
* Ensure quality, clarity, and consistency across all content assets
* Build a strong content engine that supports awareness, engagement, and conversion

**🔹 Demand Generation & Pipeline Support**

* Design and execute integrated campaigns that contribute to lead generation and pipeline growth
* Support inbound and outbound efforts through targeted content, lead magnets, and campaign programs
* Work closely with sales teams to improve lead quality, engagement, and conversion
* Measure campaign performance and optimize for reach, engagement, and business outcomes

**🔹 Events, Field Marketing & Partnerships**

* Lead the planning and execution of trade shows, industry events, webinars, and flagship brand activations
* Build strategic partnerships and co-marketing opportunities that enhance brand reach and credibility
* Represent marketing in cross-functional planning for industry presence and ecosystem engagement
* Ensure strong pre-event, on-ground, and post-event marketing execution

**🔹 Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Build, mentor, and manage a high-performing marketing team
* Collaborate with product, sales, design, SEO, PR, and leadership teams on strategic initiatives
* Manage agencies, freelancers, and external partners where required
* Bring structure, ownership, and performance discipline into the marketing function

**🔹 Performance, Analytics & Optimization**

* Track KPIs across brand growth, campaign performance, engagement, and revenue contribution
* Use data and market insights to refine strategy and improve execution quality
* Monitor content, events, and GTM performance and identify areas for optimization
* Build marketing systems and processes that can scale with business growth

**🧠 Knowledge & Expertise We Value**
**Functional Capability**

* 7–10 years of experience in B2B marketing, GTM, brand, demand generation, content, or partnerships
* Strong experience in SaaS, CPaaS, telecom, conversational AI, martech, or technology-led businesses
* Proven ability to lead integrated marketing strategies across digital, content, events, and field marketing
* Experience in building brand positioning and executing GTM programs for growth-stage businesses
* Strong understanding of enterprise buyer journeys and ICP-led marketing
* Experience working closely with revenue, leadership, and product teams
* Exposure to fintech, BFSI, enterprise tech, or regulated-industry marketing is an added advantage
* Experience in scaling teams, functions, or new marketing initiatives is preferred

**Professional Strengths**

* Strong strategic thinking with hands-on execution ability
* Excellent storytelling, communication, and messaging skills
* Commercial mindset with a clear understanding of business impact
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities
* Ability to manage multiple high-priority initiatives simultaneously
* High ownership, problem-solving ability, and attention to detail
* Passion for brand-building, growth, and continuous innovation

**🛠 Platforms & Tools**

* Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Gmail & Drive)
* CRM and marketing automation platforms
* LinkedIn and other digital/social media platforms
* Analytics and campaign reporting tools
* AI tools for productivity, research, and content support
* Project and content planning tools

**🎓 Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Mass Communication, Journalism, English, or a related field (Preferred)
* MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is a plus
* 7–10 years of relevant experience in Marketing, Brand, GTM, Demand Generation, Content, or Partnerships
* Strong track record of driving business-aligned marketing programs in fast-paced environments
* Experience in high-growth startups, B2B SaaS, technology, or enterprise-focused businesses preferred

**📊 Indicators of Success**

* Stronger brand visibility and market positioning for Helo.ai
* High-quality marketing campaigns delivered across channels and business priorities
* Meaningful contribution to lead generation, pipeline growth, and revenue influence
* Successful execution of product launches, GTM programs, and brand initiatives
* Strong event marketing and partnership outcomes
* Scalable team structure, stronger execution quality, and improved marketing efficiency
* Consistent growth in engagement, content quality, and strategic brand impact

**📈 Performance & Growth**
The role follows defined KPIs and KRAs to ensure clarity in responsibilities, support performance tracking, and recognize contributions toward brand growth, GTM excellence, audience engagement, and business impact.
  
  
**🌍 Equal Opportunity Employer**
At Helo.ai, we celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive, collaborative environment for all.

description:

title: Manager – Partnerships, Communications & Marketing (FinTech/BFSI)
description:
Company Description

The Fintech Association for Consumer Empowerment (FACE) is a non-profit industry association and RBI-recognised Self-Regulatory Organisation in the FinTech sector (SRO-FT). FinTech companies come together at FACE to advance consumer-centric digital financial services that are safe, suitable and transparent and deliver positive outcomes for society and the economy. FACE works across member engagement, policy and knowledge initiatives, partnerships, responsible industry development and stakeholder engagement to support a trusted and sustainable FinTech ecosystem.

Role Description

The Manager – Partnerships, Communications & Marketing is a Mumbai-based role supporting FACE’s partnership and stakeholder engagement as well as its external-facing communications, marketing and event engagement. The position will serve as a key interface with FACE members and coordinate engagement with founders, chief executives, business leaders and functional heads. Responsibilities include building institutional and ecosystem partnerships, developing partnership concepts and engagement plans, maintaining stakeholder pipelines and coordinating member and partner initiatives. The role will also support communication planning, content development, campaigns, branding and engagement for events, webinars, roundtables, workshops, conferences and member meetings. The position involves regular interaction with members, institutional and knowledge partners, speakers, agencies, designers, vendors and other stakeholders.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in communications, marketing, media, journalism, public relations, business administration, public policy or a related discipline.
* Four to six years of relevant experience, including demonstrated hands-on experience in communications and marketing.
* Experience in partnerships, stakeholder engagement, member engagement or institutional relations is strongly preferred.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills and the confidence to work effectively with founders, chief executives, senior leaders, partners and internal teams.
* Excellent writing, editing, documentation and presentation skills, with experience planning campaigns and managing digital channels, content calendars and external-facing communication workflows.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Word, PowerPoint and Excel, and comfort with digital communication and marketing tools.
* Experience coordinating webinars, roundtables, conferences or other professional events would be an advantage.
* Working knowledge of design tools such as Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, Figma or similar platforms would be an advantage.
* Experience in FinTech, financial services, BFSI, an industry association, a policy-facing organisation or another knowledge-led institution would be an advantage.
* Highly organised, self-driven, collaborative and adaptable, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

title: Product Management Sr Analyst, SAS and SQL - Assistant Vice President
description:
The Product Management Senior Analyst is an intermediate level position responsible for the development of product plans, strategies and tactics in coordination with the Product Management team. The overall objective of this role is to coordinate the promotion of products to develop new markets, increase share of market and obtain competitive position. You will apply analytical thinking and leverage data analysis tools and methodologies to drive data-driven analysis and control-related business projects.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Assist in development and analysis of strategic product roadmaps, product enhancement and development, product launches, and product marketing to gain maximum benefit from each product, as well as review surveys and analyze competitive industry landscapes to identify relative trends, threats, and opportunities for product managers
* Participate in day-to-day product management for core products such as product delivery, client experience, and client communication strategies as well as help the team prioritize, negotiate, and remove obstacles to achieve business results
* Serve as a representative for the Controls Automation development team on control-related business projects, focusing on the development and execution of data-driven analysis.
* Develop and automate control reports utilizing a range of tools including SAS, SQL, Enterprise Data Warehouse, BigData, EAP, and shell scripting.
* Support the design, development, delivery, and maintenance of best-in-class Control programs, policies, and practices for USCC Controls Automation.
* Execute client value propositions, positioning, segmentation, pricing, targeting, channel strategies, and competitive differentiation to achieve preferred status as a partner to Citi clients
* Provide informal guidance or on-the-job training to new team members
* Oversee client and competitor market research, develop product innovation roadmap, and assist product managers in addressing fundamental trials of product commoditization to create an advanced set of solutions
* Contribute to achievement of acquisition targets, product financial performance, revenue performance, and expense management goals as well as oversee identification and execution of opportunities and gaps business plans
* Implement team procedures, client problem resolution, and client management
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

**Qualifications & Skills:**

* 8-10 years of experience
* Knowledge of marketing, credit, acquisitions, product development, and/or analytics
* Ability to work unsupervised and adjust priorities quickly as circumstances dictate
* Ability to work under pressure and manage deadlines or unexpected changes in expectations or requirements
* Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication
* Demonstrated analytical skills
* Demonstrated problem-solving and decision-making skills

**Technical Proficiency (Must-Have):**

* Strong and advanced proficiency in SAS: Demonstrated expertise in SAS programming for data manipulation, statistical analysis, and report generation.
* Strong and advanced proficiency in SQL: Expert-level SQL skills for complex querying, data extraction, and database management across various platforms.

**Technical Proficiency (Add-on/Desired):**

* Proficiency in UNIX shell scripting, NDM for automation and job scheduling.
* Familiarity with Enterprise Data Warehouses, BigData, and EAP platforms.

**Education:**

* Bachelor's/University degree or equivalent experience

title: Commercial Marketing Manager
description:
Commercial Marketing Manager – India
  
  
Culture & Values: Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart
  
  
Location: Mumbai (Hybrid)
  
  
Reports To: Director of Field Marketing, India
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
As the Nutanix Commercial Field Marketing Manager, you will be the primary marketing engine driving scalable demand generation, pipeline acceleration, and market penetration across Nutanix’s India commercial segment.
  
  
Reporting directly to the Director of Field Marketing, India, you will sit at the intersection of commercial sales, demand generation, partner marketing, and sales engagement. In this high-impact role, you will take ownership of designing and executing full-funnel marketing programs that reach commercial audiences at scale and convert engagement into measurable business outcomes.
  
  
You will work closely with Commercial Sales leaders, Account Executives, Inside Sales, channel partners, the APJ marketing team, and the Global Demand Center to build repeatable programs that position Nutanix as the platform of choice for hybrid multicloud, cloud-native applications, and Enterprise AI.
  
  
**About The Team**
You will be part of the vibrant India Field Marketing organisation, working in lockstep with local commercial sales leadership, the channel ecosystem, the APJ team, and Global Demand Center.
  
  
We operate in a fast-paced, data-informed environment where bold ideas, experimentation, and collaborative execution are central to how we build impactful marketing programs. The team combines strategic planning with hands-on execution to create demand, accelerate pipeline, and strengthen Nutanix’s position in the Indian market.
  
  
Your Role (What You’ll Do)
  
  

* Build & Execute the Commercial Demand Engine: Develop and lead integrated marketing plans for India’s commercial segment across digital campaigns, email, webinars, third-party demand generation, seminars, workshops, and partner programs.
* Pipeline Generation & Velocity: Own the commercial marketing target and partner closely with Commercial Sales leaders, Account Executives, and Inside Sales to build quarterly pipeline generation and acceleration plans.
* Scale Digital & Lifecycle Programs: Create repeatable programs that acquire, engage, nurture, and re-engage prospects and customers, with a focus on whitespace, net-new logo acquisition, and measurable funnel progression.
* Drive Ecosystem Co-Marketing: Work with resellers, distributors, system integrators, service providers, and technology partners to develop joint go-to-market programs that extend reach and generate partner-sourced pipeline.
* Curate High-Impact Commercial Experiences: Plan and deliver regional events, partner-led activities, customer and prospect workshops, user groups, webinars, and other experiences that create meaningful sales engagement—not just attendance.
* Localize & Contextualize Narratives: Translate global campaigns into relevant India-focused messaging that addresses commercial customer priorities, including cloud modernization, infrastructure simplification, hybrid multicloud, cloud-native applications, competitive displacement, and Enterprise AI adoption.
* Analytics & Optimization: Monitor campaign performance, funnel progression, pipeline contribution, and program ROI using Salesforce, marketing automation, and analytics platforms. Test and optimize programs to improve quality, conversion, and efficiency.
* Advocate Customer Success: Identify and cultivate referenceable customers, testimonials, speakers, and local success stories that strengthen Nutanix’s value proposition across India.
* Manage Execution Excellence: Own program planning, budgets, agencies, vendors, timelines, follow-up processes, and stakeholder communications across multiple concurrent initiatives.

What You Will Bring
  
  

* 6–9 years of B2B technology marketing experience, with specific experience in field marketing, demand generation, integrated campaigns, or commercial marketing.
* A proven track record of developing and executing high-impact marketing programs that deliver measurable leads, meetings, opportunities, and pipeline.
* Strong understanding of commercial or mid-market audiences and the ability to build programs that work across direct, digital, and partner-led routes to market.
* Practical knowledge of the B2B sales funnel, lead management, campaign attribution, nurture, and sales follow-up processes.
* Experience planning and executing digital programs, webinars, third-party demand generation, seminars, workshops, regional events, and partner activities.
* Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships with Sales leaders, Account Executives, Inside Sales, channel teams, partners, APJ stakeholders, and global marketing teams.
* Hands-on experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms such as Salesforce and Marketo; familiarity with campaign reporting and analytics is essential.
* Strong project management, budget management, prioritization, agency, and vendor-management skills.
* Familiarity with enterprise software, SaaS, cloud, data center, infrastructure, or cybersecurity technologies, with the curiosity to learn complex technical solutions quickly.
* A data-driven, results-oriented mindset with the ability to analyze performance, communicate insights, and make clear recommendations.
* A creative thinker, team player, detail-oriented, self-motivated, and effective communicator who can thrive in a fast-paced, changing environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field. An MBA is a plus.

Work Arrangement
  
  
Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration.
  
  
In India offices (Mumbai, Bangalore, Pune), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster team alignment, collaboration, and access to in-office resources.
  
  
The scope of responsibilities for this role is territory-based across India, meaning that travel will be required for sales alignment, partner engagement, customer programs, and regional events.
  
  
Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.
  
  
Nutanix is a global leader in cloud software and a pioneer in hyperconverged infrastructure solutions, making computing invisible anywhere.
  
  
Companies around the world use Nutanix software to leverage a single platform to manage any app, at any location, at any scale for their private, hybrid, and multicloud environments.
  
  
Marketing at Nutanix
  
  
--

title: Field Marketing Manager
description:
**Description**
At Gigamon, our purpose is to protect the hybrid networks and data of the largest, most complex organizations on the planet. Certified as a Great Place to Work, we offer a deep observability pipeline that efficiently delivers network-derived intelligence to cloud, security, and observability tools. This helps our customers to eliminate security blind spots, optimize network traffic, and dramatically reduce tool cost and complexity, enabling them to better secure and manage their hybrid cloud infrastructure. Gigamon has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of governments and educational organizations.
  
  
The Field & Channel Marketing Manager will join Gigamon’s Sales and Marketing team in India, supporting revenue growth, qualified pipeline generation, and partner engagement across the country. Based in Mumbai, this role will develop and execute integrated field and channel marketing programs in collaboration with India sales and channel leaders, regional marketing teams, partners, distributors, agencies, and cross-functional stakeholders. The manager will oversee programs from planning through execution, follow-up, and performance reporting, while managing budgets and ensuring alignment with APAC and global marketing priorities. This role reports to the VP, Global Field & Channel Marketing and requires occasional travel within India.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Translate India sales and channel priorities into integrated field and channel marketing strategies and annual or quarterly plans.
* Own the end-to-end execution of approved marketing programs, including stakeholder alignment, planning, delivery, follow-up, and performance reporting.
* Partner with India sales and channel leaders to design programs that generate qualified pipeline and contribute to revenue through direct and partner-led activities.
* Collaborate with channel account managers, distributors, resellers, and technology partners to develop and execute demand-generation and channel-enablement programs.
* Plan and manage B2B industry events, executive engagements, campaigns, webinars, and other customer- and partner-facing activities.
* Coordinate agencies, timelines, logistics, communications, and success measures for marketing programs.
* Develop and execute integrated campaigns across digital, events, partner marketing, communications, and enablement channels.
* Manage allocated marketing investments and program budgets, including forecasting, spend management, budget reconciliation, compliance, purchase orders, invoices, expenses, and program documentation.
* Track program performance using agreed metrics, marketing automation platforms, and CRM systems; provide timely insights and recommendations to India and APAC sales and marketing leadership.
* Use performance data and stakeholder feedback to optimize future programs, improve pipeline contribution, and strengthen partner engagement.
* Support APAC-wide programs and campaigns in India as required.

**What You’ve Done**

* Earned a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* Built 6–10 years of experience in field marketing, channel marketing, or integrated B2B technology marketing.
* Planned and executed B2B industry events and partner-led demand-generation programs from the ground up, delivering against defined goals and budgets.
* Developed strong relationships with distributors, resellers, value-added distributors, and technology partners within the India market.
* Managed agencies, vendors, timelines, logistics, communications, and other executional requirements for marketing programs.
* Executed digital marketing programs directly or through partners to increase awareness, engagement, lead generation, and pipeline across India.
* Translated sales and marketing objectives into clear strategies, actionable tactics, measurable success criteria, and execution plans.
* Monitored and evaluated marketing programs, events, and campaigns using marketing automation and CRM systems.
* Demonstrated proficiency with marketing automation and CRM platforms such as Marketo and Salesforce.
* Familiarity with Folloze, Workfront, Monday.com, and 6sense is an advantage, along with the ability to learn new systems quickly.
* Gained experience marketing network security, cybersecurity, observability, or related technology solutions.
* Developed knowledge of the India technology partner and channel ecosystem.
* Worked effectively in a global organization and collaborated with regional and worldwide marketing teams.

**Who You Are**

* A results-oriented marketer who connects field and channel programs to measurable pipeline, revenue, and partner outcomes.
* A strategic and practical thinker who can translate business priorities into focused, executable marketing plans.
* An organized project manager who can manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, agencies, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* An analytical professional who uses performance data and stakeholder feedback to improve program effectiveness.
* A clear communicator and collaborative partner who can influence cross-functional stakeholders and work effectively with sales, channel, marketing, and external teams.
* A self-directed contributor who leverages internal and external resources to deliver high-quality work on time and within budget.
* Detail-oriented, particularly in budget management, marketing operations, and program administration.
* Willing and able to travel within India as required.

As an equal opportunity employer, all applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, age, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, and/or local law. Gigamon is on a continued mission to grow and scale an innovative organization. We believe this is best achieved by hiring, celebrating, and respecting people with diverse backgrounds, skills, perspectives, and experiences.

Our Gigamon Applicant Privacy Policy, will inform you about how Gigamon Inc. and its direct and indirect subsidiaries collect, use, store, or otherwise process personal information about job applicants and candidates, including through your access and/or use of our careers website and third-party job websites (e.g. LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, Naukri, etc.).

title: Vetting Manager
description:
To support the Vetting lead in the effective execution of Vetting Desk functions, ensuring timely coordination of RightShip inspection readiness, closure management, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement of fleet vetting outcomes.

The role focuses on operational execution, process ownership, and performance tracking, enabling the Vetting Desk to maintain consistency, reduce risk exposure, and support fleet inspection validity and acceptance.

**ROLES ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

* Oversee the booking, scheduling, and administrative management of approximately 180–200 RightShip inspections annually, ensuring compliance with regulatory timelines and internal requirements.
* Lead inspection coordination activities, including documentation review, root cause analysis (RCA), and monitoring of corrective and preventive action (CAPA) implementation until closure.
* Manage the preparation and submission of PSC closeouts, including identification of root causes and development of effective preventive actions to minimize recurrence.
* Ensure consistency and adherence to quality standards across the vetting process, driving fleet-wide performance improvements, particularly in critical risk areas such as ISM compliance, machinery readiness, and mooring safety.
* Liaise effectively with ship Masters, Chief Engineers, Business Units, and external stakeholders (including RightShip and port authorities) to facilitate smooth communication, timely resolution of issues, and inspection readiness.
* Analyze inspection data, trends, and recurring findings to identify systemic gaps and recommend targeted preventive measures to enhance fleet safety and inspection outcomes.
* Support the development and continuous improvement of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), guidance documents, and training programs related to vetting and RightShip compliance.
* Assist in preparing periodic reports and performance dashboards for senior management, covering inspection status, findings trends, safety score performance, and risk mitigation initiatives.Analyze inspection data and trends to identify recurring issues and recommend preventive actions.

  
**Requirements**

**KEY SKILLS AND CAPABILITIES:**

**Technical skills**

1. Knowledge of international shipping regulations, vetting procedures, and safety management systems (ISM).

2. Prior experience with data trend analysis, RCA, and CAP processes is recommended.

**Professional skills**

1. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to effectively interact with shipboard and shore teams, as well as external stakeholders.

2. Proven leadership skills with experience managing small teams.

3. Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities; detail-oriented with high accountability.

4. Proactive problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.

5. Good computer skills including MS Office - 365, RMS, RightShip portal, and data analysis tools.

**PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION:**

* Hold a valid Master (FG) Certificate of Competency (Master / Chief Mate) in accordance with the STCW Code.
* Alternatively, hold a valid MEO Class I Certificate of Competency or (Chief Engineer) in accordance with the STCW Code.
* Possess a minimum of one (1) years’ experience in ship management, vetting, or maritime operations, with demonstrated exposure to RightShip or equivalent vetting and inspection processes (applicable to Chief Mate / Second Engineer backgrounds). **Fresh Candidates from Sea Chief Engineers and Masters - will be considered basis aptitude and skills.**
* Demonstrated ability to prepare investigation reports, inspection responses, and safety bulletins in a clear, structured, and professional manner.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure, manage competing priorities, and consistently meet tight operational deadlines.

  
  
**Benefits**

About Anglo-Eastern

Anglo-Eastern is a global leader in independent ship management services. The Group manages over 700 vessels under full technical management, supports around 500 additional ships under crew management, and has overseen more than 1,000 newbuildings and conversions through its newbuilding supervision and project management divisions.

Headquartered in Hong Kong, Anglo-Eastern operates through a network of 30 offices across Asia, Europe, and the Americas, including wholly owned maritime training facilities. Our strength lies in our people: over 39,000 seafarers and 2,350 shore-based employees who work together to support clients across ship types while building trust, driving performance, and shaping a better maritime future.

Why join Anglo-Eastern?

* Join a globally respected company with a strong maritime heritage of over 50 years
* Work in an environment anchored in integrity, trust, and long-term relationships
* Access continuous learning and structured career development across a truly global network
* Be part of a team committed to delivering excellence and shaping a better maritime future

Join us today!

title: Application Support Senior Analyst - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Role Overview**

The **L2 Application Support Engineer** (Technical Support Analyst) is a critical role within the Production Support and Operations team. This individual is responsible for providing high-quality technical support, troubleshooting, and incident resolution for complex enterprise applications and platforms. Acting as the bridge between L1 Helpdesk/Monitoring teams and L3 Development/Engineering groups, the L2 Engineer ensures system availability, stability, and adherence to strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs) in a fast-paced, enterprise technology environment.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Incident & Problem Management**

* **Escalation Handling:** Acknowledge and own incidents escalated by the L1 support team or monitoring alerts.
* **Troubleshooting & Diagnosis:** Perform in-depth technical analysis and root cause investigation of application, database, middleware, and infrastructure failures.
* **Workaround Implementation:** Apply approved temporary workarounds or permanent hotfixes to restore services quickly and minimize business impact.
* **Collaboration:** Partner with L3 developers, database administrators (DBAs), network engineers, and system administrators to resolve complex, multi-tiered issues.
* **Incident Lifecycle Management:** Track and document all incident progression within the ITSM platform (e.g., ServiceNow) from creation through to resolution.
  

  

**2. Monitoring, Observability & Preventive Maintenance**

* **System Monitoring:** Actively monitor application health, batch jobs, integration feeds, and system performance using enterprise observability suites.
* **Proactive Interventions:** Identify recurring patterns, error trends, or capacity bottlenecks and initiate preventative actions.
* **Health Checks:** Perform daily health checks, start-of-day (SOD) and end-of-day (EOD) verifications, and batch processing runs.

**3. Release, Deployment & Configuration Management**

* **Deployment Validation:** Support the verification of application deployments, system patches, and infrastructure upgrades during maintenance windows.
* **Configuration Controls:** Maintain and update application configuration files, environment variables, and parameter settings under strict change management processes.
* **Environment Management:** Assist in maintaining non-production (UAT/Staging) and production environments to ensure consistency.

**4. Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* **Status Updates:** Provide clear, timely, and precise communications to business stakeholders, product owners, and technology leadership during critical (Sev-1/Sev-2) incidents.
* **Bridges & War Rooms:** Participate in or lead technical incident bridges to coordinate restoration efforts.
* **Post-Incident Reviews:** Contribute technical inputs to Post-Incident Reviews (PIRs) and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documentation.

**5. Documentation & Knowledge Management**

* **Runbooks & SOPs:** Document and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), application architecture maps, and troubleshooting runbooks.
* **Knowledge Sharing:** Train L1 teams on common issue resolution paths to shift-left workloads and improve first-contact resolution rates.

**Qualifications & Experience**

  
  

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* **Experience:** 8+ years of experience in an application support, technical support, or systems engineering role (preferably in an enterprise or financial services environment).
* **Certifications (Desirable):**
  + ITIL v3 or v4 Foundation certification.
  + Professional certifications in AWS/Azure, Kubernetes (CKAD), Linux Administration, or Oracle/SQL.

**Required Technical Skills**

**Domain**

**Technology / Tooling**

**Operating Systems**

Strong hands-on experience with **Linux/Unix** environments (navigating file systems, checking logs, monitoring CPU/memory, cron jobs) and **Windows Server**.

**Scripting & Automation**

Proficiency in writing and debugging **Shell scripting** (Bash), **PowerShell**, or **Python** to automate daily tasks and analyze log files.

**Databases & Querying**

Strong **SQL** skills (Oracle, MS SQL, Sybase, or PostgreSQL). Ability to write complex select queries, joins, analyze execution plans, and run database scripts.

**Middleware & Web Servers**

Working knowledge of **Apache**, **Tomcat**, **Nginx**, **WebSphere,** and messaging queues like **IBM MQ**, **RabbitMQ**, or **Apache Kafka**.

**Cloud & Containerization**

Familiarity with **Docker**, **Kubernetes**, **OpenShift**, or cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure) concepts and container deployments.

**Monitoring & Logging**

Hands-on experience with tools such as **Splunk**, **ELK Stack**, **AppDynamics**, **Dynatrace**, **Grafana**, or **ITRS Geneos**.

**ITSM & Collaboration**

Experience with ticketing tools like **ServiceNow** or **Jira**, and version control systems like **Git** or Bitbucket.

  
  

**Required Professional & Soft Skills**

* **Analytical Mindset:** Excellent logical reasoning and problem-solving skills; ability to systematically break down a complex issue.
* **Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate technical details into plain language for business teams.
* **Pressure Tolerance:** Calm demeanor under pressure, especially during high-severity system outages.
* **Team Collaboration:** Ability to work cohesively in a global, distributed cross-functional environment.

title: Talent Acquisition Executive
description:
**Location:** Ghatkopar West, Mumbai

**Work Model:** Hybrid (4 Days Work From Office + 2 Days Work From Home)

**Work Schedule:** Monday to Saturday

**Shift Timings:** 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM IST

**Salary Range:** INR 25,000 - 30,000 per month

**About Datastraw**

Datastraw Technologies is an AI operating company that helps modern businesses scale through a combination of people, technology, data, automation and AI. We currently specialise in customer experience (CX), helping brands manage and improve their customer interactions across channels while building the systems and AI-powered solutions that make their operations faster, more efficient and scalable.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for someone to join our **Talent & People team, with Talent Acquisition as the primary responsibility.**

This role goes beyond filling open positions. You’ll own end-to-end hiring across technical and non-technical roles, build talent pipelines for current and future requirements, and develop a strong network of potential candidates.

You’ll also work with our Tech team to improve recruitment through AI, automation and better systems, while supporting onboarding, employee experience and other People & Culture initiatives.

**What You’ll Do**

**1) Talent Acquisition**

* Own end-to-end recruitment, from sourcing and screening to interviews, selection and joining.
* Build and maintain talent pools and pipelines for recurring and future hiring requirements.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand role requirements and improve candidate evaluation.
* Maintain recruitment trackers, talent databases and hiring MIS, using data to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Manage candidate communication and support a smooth transition from selection to onboarding.

**2) Talent Systems & Process Improvement**

* Identify repetitive tasks and opportunities to simplify or automate recruitment processes.
* Explore AI tools, ATS, HRMS and other technologies to improve sourcing, screening and pipeline management.
* Work with the Tech team to build more efficient and scalable talent systems.

**3) People & Culture**

* Support onboarding, joining formalities and employee experience.
* Contribute to employee engagement, culture-building and the documentation and improvement of People processes.

**Who We’re Looking For**

* Hands-on experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment or HR, including end-to-end hiring.
* Experience hiring for both technical and non-technical roles.
* Familiarity with onboarding and joining formalities.
* Experience using an HRMS; ATS experience is an advantage.
* Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets, MS tools, Slack and other workplace productivity tools.
* Highly organised, proactive and accountable, with strong follow-through across multiple priorities.
* Curious about AI, automation and technology, and interested in improving how recruitment works. Coding experience is not required.
* Start-up, high-volume hiring, BPO, outsourcing or recruitment consultancy experience is an advantage.
* Based in Mumbai and comfortable with the hybrid work model, with a personal laptop and reliable high-speed Wi-Fi.

**What This Role Can Become**

This role offers the opportunity to grow beyond recruitment execution into broader Talent, People & Culture, and talent systems ownership. As Datastraw scales, you’ll have the opportunity to help shape how we discover, evaluate, engage and hire talent.

We value people who think independently, take ownership, solve problems and keep pushing improvements forward without waiting for every step to be defined.

**If you want to do more than fill vacancies and are excited about building a smarter, more effective talent engine, we’d love to hear from you.**

title: Network Delivery Engineer 1
description:
PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:
  
  
At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
  
  
**Job Description**
As a Network Delivery Engineer, you will be responsible for the execution of network provisioning tasks and 24/7 continuous monitoring, initial troubleshooting, and escalation of network infrastructure and service incidents. This role requires strong problem-solving skills, a foundational understanding of networking concepts, and the ability to work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment to ensure maximum network uptime and performance.
  
  
**Experience bucket: 1-3 years**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Handling BAU tasks:
* Conduct network provisioning deployments.
* Perform Firewall configuration which includes ACL management, Periodic Firewall reviews and IPSec/NAT.
* Perform periodic Patch Management for Network switches/firewalls and servers.
* Upgrade OS for network devices to maintain a stable environment.
* Undertake network maintenance activities during business off-peak hours.
* Performance Optimization:
* Conduct performance analysis and implement optimizations to ensure the network operates at peak efficiency.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to fine-tune network parameters and troubleshoot performance bottlenecks.
* Network Automation:
* Develop and implement automation scripts to streamline routine network tasks and enhance operational efficiency.
* Integrate automation tools and frameworks to support network provisioning, monitoring, and management.
* Incident Response and Resolution:
* Act as a primary on-call engineer in resolving complex network incidents and outages and file RCAs wherever applicable.
* Function as L1 point of escalation for Network Operations.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor Engineering in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 1-3 years of experience in network operations, network engineering or a related role.
* Familiarity with Data Center topologies and network routing and switching concepts like BGP, OSPF, VLAN, VRRP, etc. Knowledge of VxLAN will be an added advantage
* Basic scripting and automation skills, with entry-level proficiency in languages like Python, Go, Shell and orchestration tools like Ansible, Salt or similar.
* Basic fundamental knowledge of Linux esp. Distributions like Ubuntu and RHEL and web-servers like Nginx and Apache2.
* Experience in a 24x7 on-call rotation environment and in handling critical incidents.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent leadership and communication skills.
* Certifications/Course Completion for Cisco CCNA/Juniper JNCIA or equivalent would be an added advantage.

Network Delivery Engineer (NDE) - 1 position represents a significant opportunity for an entry level professional to make a substantial impact on our organization's network infrastructure. Join our team and be a key contributor to the success and innovation of our data center network infrastructure.

title: Staff Consulting Architect
description:
**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**
**The Opportunity**
Are you a seasoned professional with strong hands-on expertise in virtualization, SDN, and network security, complemented by excellent consulting and communication skills? If so, you’ll thrive in our collaborative environment where you’ll lead the design and implementation of cutting-edge data center and hybrid cloud solutions, make a significant impact on our clients' success, and advance your career as part of a dynamic team at Nutanix.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Staff Consulting Architect will be a vital member of Nutanix's Professional Services team, which is dedicated to delivering innovative virtualization, software-defined networking (SDN), and network security solutions to our clients. This team operates from Bangalore or Pune and fosters a collaborative and inclusive culture that values creativity and knowledge sharing. The mission of the team is to empower organizations with next-generation data center and hybrid cloud environments that enhance performance, security, and scalability.
  
  
You will report to the Director of Professional Services, who promotes a supportive and mentoring leadership style, focusing on empowering team members to achieve their full potential and encouraging a strong sense of collaboration. The role is hybrid, requiring the employee to come into the office three days a week, fostering teamwork and facilitating knowledge exchange while allowing flexibility for remote work.
  
  
Nutanix is seeking a
**Staff Consulting Architect**
specializing in
**virtualization, software-defined networking (SDN), and network security**
to design, implement, and optimize next-generation data centre and hybrid cloud environments.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess
**strong hands-on expertise in hypervisors (VMware / AHV)**
and a
**deep understanding of network virtualization and microsegmentation concepts.**
While certain specialized or automation-related areas can be developed through internal enablement programs, strong fundamentals in virtualization and SDN are mandatory.
  
  
**Your Role**

* Architecture & Design
* Lead the design and deployment of SDN solutions including:

+ Virtual networks, overlays (Geneve / VXLAN), logical switches and routers.
+ Network Controllers / Managers for centralized control and automation.
+ VPCs or logical segments for tenant isolation and scalability.
+ Gateways, VPNs, and BGP configurations for hybrid connectivity.

* Architect multi-tier microsegmentation strategies and enforce Zero Trust principles.
* Collaborate with enterprise network and security teams for seamless integration between virtual and physical infrastructures.
* Implementation & Delivery
* Configure SDN controllers, edge gateways, and security policies in production environments.

* Administer orchestration and lifecycle management using Prism Central, vCenter, or similar tools.
* Support hybrid cloud network architectures spanning on-premises and public cloud environments.
* Collaborate with compute and storage teams to ensure end-to-end performance.

* Diagnose and resolve issues related to network overlays, routing, and policy enforcement.
* Utilize CLI tools, REST APIs, or automation scripts for diagnostics and configuration management.
* Perform performance tuning and maintain high availability of network services.

* 10+ years of experience in data centre virtualization and SDN solutions.
* Strong understanding of networking concepts — VLANs, routing, NAT, VPNs, BGP, firewalls, overlays (VXLAN/Geneve).
* Hands-on experience with at least one SDN platform:

+ VMware NSX / Nutanix Flow / Cisco ACI (or equivalent).

* Proven expertise in microsegmentation and Zero Trust architecture design.
* Working knowledge of any one hypervisor (VMware ESXi, Nutanix AHV, or Hyper-V).
* Experience integrating virtual and physical network infrastructures.
* Strong troubleshooting skills using CLI / API / network analysis tools.
* Excellent consulting, customer engagement, and communication skills.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical architectures.

*(These can be built on-the-job or via internal learning programs)*

* Automation and scripting using REST APIs, PowerShell, or Python.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform or Ansible.
* Exposure to hybrid or multi-cloud networking (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Integration of flow analytics and visibility tools for monitoring and compliance.
* Performance tuning and advanced SDN optimization techniques.
* Mentoring, workshop facilitation, and leadership in technical communities.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong consulting and stakeholder management abilities.
* Excellent documentation and presentation skills.
* Team mentorship and ability to guide junior consultants.
* Structured approach to problem-solving and decision-making.

**Education & Certifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline.
* Preferred Certifications (VCP-NV, VCAP-NV, CCNP Data Centre, Nutanix NCP).

**Location**

* Pune/Bangalore (Work from Office).
* Travel as required for customer assignments.

title: Senior Software Solutions Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Software Solutions Engineer to support NVIDIA AI Enterprise customers and deployments across cloud and datacenter environments. This is a dual role: (1) Support, triage and resolve complex customer software issues end-to-end, and (2) build software features, automation, diagnostics, reproducible test cases, and deployment tooling—to improve product readiness and scale support across enterprise environments.
  
  
You will work across compute and cloud-native technologies in CSP environments, including container platforms/orchestrators, enterprise system software, and GPU-accelerated AI frameworks and inference services used to run production AI workloads at scale. In this customer-facing role, you will work closely with customers and internal engineering teams to understand issues, explain root causes, drive resolution, and collaborate on fixes and improvements. Success in this role requires strong debugging skills, crisp communication, and ownership of technically deep escalations from inception to closure.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Develop and maintain product-facing features and deployment assets for AI Enterprise supportability (e.g., scripts, configuration guidance, Kubernetes manifests/Helm charts, and reproducible test cases)
* Develop and maintain Python-based tooling/automation (validators, log collectors, repro harnesses) to improve NVIDIA AI Enterprise deployment reliability across NGC and container orchestrators (e.g., Kubernetes)
* Contribute code-level fixes, patches, or pull requests (as appropriate) in collaboration with engineering to address customer-impacting issues and improve product readiness
* Support enterprise customers deploying NVIDIA AI Enterprise in datacenter and CSP environments, including Kubernetes-based and containerized production AI platforms
* Take ownership of customer issues from inception to resolution: reproduce in lab/cloud, collect diagnostics, provide mitigations, and partner with engineering on fixes
* Create high-quality bug reports and RFEs with clear repro steps, environment details (CSP/Kubernetes/GPU), impact analysis, and supporting artifacts
* Develop customer-facing and internal documentation (KBs, runbooks, deployment guidance) to improve time-to-value and reduce recurring issues
* Be on call one weekend per month in the event a customer has a Sev1 outage and requires engineering assistance

**What We Need To See**

* BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* 5+ years system software development and troubleshooting experience, ideally with some customer facing
* Strong computer science fundamentals and programming/scripting skills (Python required; Bash; Go/C++ a plus) to automate investigations and build diagnostics/repro tools
* Strong troubleshooting fundamentals (networking, concurrency, OS concepts) and a structured approach to isolating issues across application, platform, and infrastructure layers
* Deep understanding of at least two of the following: data centers/servers, distributed systems, virtualization, deep learning frameworks, containers (Docker/Kubernetes), hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and CI/CD for reliable deployments
* Familiarity with GPU-accelerated AI/ML stacks and production model deployment/serving (e.g., NGC containers, CUDA/tooling concepts, inference serving such as Triton or similar)
* Deep Linux knowledge and comfort troubleshooting in production Linux environments; working knowledge of Windows is a plus
* Professional-level communication skills, interpersonal skills with a passion to solve problems

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Hands-on experience deploying and operating NVIDIA AI Enterprise components in production across on-prem or CSP environments
* Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants/tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar) to accelerate debugging, automation, and test creation
* Experience operating Kubernetes-based platforms in production (cluster operations, upgrades, control-plane/data-plane failure modes)
* Strong performance debugging skills for GPU and cloud workloads (profiling, latency/throughput tuning) and familiarity with observability/tracing tools

title: Senior Enterprise Operations Engineer-1
description:
