We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Enterprise Operations Engineer-1
  
  
**Job Description**
L2 Cloud Operations Engineer – Role Description
  
  
Two shifts - Sun to Wed 06:30 am to 06:30 pm with Sun alternate
  
  
Thurs to Sun 06:30 am to 06:30 pm with Sun alternate
  
  
We are seeking a highly skilled L2 Cloud Operations Engineer to operate, scale, and continuously improve enterprise-grade multi-cloud platforms. This role combines expertise in cloud engineering, DevOps, SRE, automation, CI/CD troubleshooting, observability, security operations, and AIOps-driven incident management.
  
  
You will be responsible for ensuring complex incident resolution, platform reliability, DevOps enablement, Kubernetes operations, automation, and operational excellence across AWS, Azure, and hybrid environments.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Cloud Operations & Platform Reliability (SRE Focus)
* Take ownership of production cloud platform stability, availability, performance, and reliability.
* Lead complex incident triage, deep troubleshooting, and resolution across cloud and container platforms.
* Implement SRE best practices such as SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, error budgets, and resilience engineering.
* Drive root cause analysis (RCA) and eliminate recurring failures through engineering solutions.
* CI/CD Pipeline Support & DevOps Enablement
* Provide advanced troubleshooting for CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, AWS CodePipeline).
* Diagnose and resolve pipeline failures related to infrastructure, container builds, artifact storage, security scanning, and deployment orchestration.
* Enable self-service pipelines, progressive delivery, canary deployments, and rollback automation.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to improve deployment velocity, quality, and reliability.
* Multi-Cloud Engineering & Kubernetes Operations
* Operate and support large-scale AWS, Azure, and hybrid cloud platforms.
* Perform advanced Kubernetes operations including:
* Cluster management
* Node scaling
* Networking troubleshooting
* Pod failures
* Storage & ingress debugging
* Manage cloud networking, compute, storage, IAM, load balancing, and security services.
* Observability, AIOps & Intelligent Operations
* Operate and enhance enterprise observability platforms across metrics, logs, traces, and events.
* Implement AIOps-driven alert correlation, noise reduction, anomaly detection, and predictive analytics.
* Build automated remediation workflows and self-healing systems.
* Drive MTTR reduction through automation-first operations.
* Security Operations & DevSecOps
* Provide cloud security incident triage and remediation.
* Implement DevSecOps automation for vulnerability scanning, compliance checks, and policy enforcement.
* Support cloud security posture management (CSPM), IAM governance, secrets management, and certificate lifecycle management.
* Automation, Infrastructure as Code & Engineering Excellence
* Build and maintain infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM, and Bicep.
* Develop automation scripts and tools using Python, Bash, PowerShell, and Go.
* Implement event-driven automation and auto-healing frameworks.
* ITSM, Incident, Change & Problem Management
* Serve as the technical escalation point for L1 teams.
* Lead incident management, problem management, and change governance using ITIL best practices.
* Maintain high-quality SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge articles.

**Mandatory Qualifications & Certifications (Strict Requirement)**
Candidates must hold at least two of the following certifications:
  
  

* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate
* AWS DevOps Engineer – Professional / SysOps Administrator – Associate
* Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert
* Azure DevOps Engineer Expert

Candidates without minimum two active certifications will not be considered.
  
  
**Required Technical Skills**
Cloud & Platform
  
  

* AWS: EC2, EKS, VPC, IAM, ALB/NLB, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, Lambda
* Azure: AKS, VNET, IAM (Entra), Load Balancer, App Services, Monitor
* Multi-cloud architecture & operations

Kubernetes & Containers
  
  

* Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, OpenShift)
* Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, Flux
* Docker, container build pipelines
* Service mesh (Istio / Linkerd – good to have)

CI/CD & DevOps Toolchain
  
  

* Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps
* Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep
* Artifact management: Nexus, Artifactory
* GitOps workflows

Observability & AIOps
  
  

* Dynatrace, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, ELK
* Event correlation, anomaly detection, predictive analytics
* AIOps platforms & auto-remediation frameworks

Security & Compliance
  
  

* IAM, secrets management, PKI & certificates
* CSPM: Prisma Cloud, Wiz, Defender
* Security incident response
* Vulnerability scanning & remediation

Scripting & Automation
  
  

* Python, Bash, PowerShell, Go (any two)
* REST APIs, event-driven automation
* Serverless automation workflows

SRE & Operational Excellence Skills
  
  

* SLIs, SLOs, SLAs
* Error budgets
* Chaos engineering
* Capacity planning & forecasting
* Performance engineering

Behavioral & Leadership Skills
  
  

* Strong problem-solving mindset
* Excellent troubleshooting skills
* High ownership & accountability
* Stakeholder communication
* Ability to work in 24x7 global operations model

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: AWS DevOps Architect
description:
**Job Title:**
AWS DevOps Architect

**Job Type:**
Full-Time

**Duration:**
Long Term

**Work Preference:**
Onsite

**Experience:**
10+ Years

**Work Location:**
Gondia, MH/ Pune, MH

**Immediate joiner preferred**

We are seeking an experienced AWS DevOps Architect to design and implement scalable, secure, highly automated DevOps solutions on AWS. This role will define cloud infrastructure architecture, CI/CD standards, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), container platforms, security controls, observability, and operational best practices.

The ideal candidate combines strong AWS architecture expertise with hands-on DevOps engineering experience and can provide technical leadership across application, integration, data, and cloud modernization initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define enterprise AWS DevOps architecture, standards, reusable patterns, and reference architectures.
* Design and implement highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient AWS environments.
* Architect CI/CD pipelines for applications, APIs, integrations, data workloads, and infrastructure.
* Establish Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, AWS CDK/CDKTF, and CloudFormation.
* Design containerized platforms using Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, and Amazon ECR.
* Define deployment strategies including Blue/Green, Canary, Rolling, and automated rollback.
* Automate provisioning and configuration of AWS infrastructure across development, test, staging, and production environments.
* Implement DevSecOps practices including SAST/DAST, vulnerability scanning, secrets management, IAM controls, and policy enforcement.
* Design AWS networking patterns involving VPCs, subnets, security groups, Route 53, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink/VPC endpoints, load balancers, and hybrid connectivity.
* Establish centralized logging, monitoring, tracing, alerting, and operational dashboards.
* Implement observability using Amazon CloudWatch, CloudTrail, AWS X-Ray, OpenSearch, Prometheus, and Grafana.
* Design IAM and security models following least-privilege and Zero Trust principles.
* Implement secrets and encryption management using AWS Secrets Manager, Systems Manager Parameter Store, and AWS KMS.
* Design solutions for high availability, disaster recovery, backup, auto-scaling, and business continuity.
* Build reusable Terraform/CDK modules, pipeline templates, and automation accelerators.
* Support migration and modernization of legacy applications and integration workloads onto AWS.
* Establish governance across multiple AWS accounts using AWS Organizations, Control Tower, IAM, SCPs, tagging standards, and centralized logging.
* Work closely with Enterprise Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, Development, Integration, Data Engineering, and Operations teams.
* Mentor DevOps engineers and provide architectural guidance and technical leadership.

**Required Experience**

* 10+ years of overall IT experience with 5+ years of AWS/DevOps experience.
* 3+ years in a DevOps Architect, Cloud Architect, Platform Architect, or Lead DevOps Engineer role.
* Strong hands-on experience with AWS services including:
* EC2, S3, IAM, VPC
* Lambda
* ECS/EKS
* ECR
* API Gateway
* Route 53
* ALB/NLB
* CloudWatch and CloudTrail
* Secrets Manager and KMS
* EventBridge, SNS and SQS
* Step Functions
* Strong expertise in Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
* Experience with AWS CDK/CDKTF and CloudFormation.
* Strong experience with Docker and Kubernetes/EKS.
* Experience building CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, AWS CodePipeline and CodeBuild.
* Strong scripting skills using Python, Bash, and/or PowerShell.
* Strong understanding of AWS networking, security, IAM, encryption, certificates, and private connectivity.
* Experience implementing enterprise DevSecOps and security automation.
* Experience designing monitoring and observability solutions.
* Strong understanding of Git workflows, artifact management, release management, and environment promotion.
* Integration Modernization Experience – Preferred

**Experience supporting AWS-based enterprise integration platforms involving:**

* Amazon API Gateway for API management and exposure.
* AWS Lambda for serverless processing and integration.
* Amazon EventBridge, SNS and SQS for event-driven integration.
* AWS Step Functions for workflow orchestration.
* AWS Transfer Family for SFTP/AS2-based file and B2B integration.
* AWS B2B Data Interchange for EDI transformation and processing.
* Amazon S3 for enterprise file and message storage.
* AWS Batch for large-scale batch processing.
* Amazon MWAA / Apache Airflow for workflow orchestration.
* Private endpoints and secure connectivity between AWS and enterprise/on-premise systems.
* DevSecOps Responsibilities

**The architect should establish automated controls for:**

* SAST/DAST and dependency scanning
* Container image scanning
* Infrastructure vulnerability scanning
* Terraform/IaC security validation
* Secrets detection
* IAM and policy validation
* Automated compliance checks
* Artifact and container security
* Audit logging and traceability

* Experience leading large-scale technical programs involving multiple engineering teams and business stakeholders.
* Strong experience managing complex cross-functional initiatives within software engineering, infrastructure, cloud, platform engineering, data, or technology organizations.
* Demonstrated ability to build and manage integrated plans, coordinate dependencies, mitigate risks, and drive successful delivery outcomes.

* Experience supporting platform adoption, developer enablement, operational excellence, and organizational transformation initiatives.
* Experience establishing delivery governance, operational reviews, portfolio management, or enterprise planning practices.
* Experience working within regulated environments requiring strong security, governance, compliance, and risk management controls.
* PMP, PgMP, Scrum, SAFe, or comparable program management certifications.

All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:

title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**Job Overview**

We are looking for a **Senior** **SDET** to test the resilience and correctness of distributed backend systems supporting a high-stakes account provisioning and onboarding workflow. This role is focused on the execution of pre-approved, benign tracer/replay scenarios against staging endpoints, analysis of request/response behaviour, and documentation of observable account/CID lifecycle and downstream state behaviour.

The ideal candidate has strong distributed-systems and API-testing experience and maintains disciplined technical evidence capture and traceability.

This role is not intended to perform unrestricted adversarial testing. Testing activities will be limited to approved staging environments and pre-approved benign scenarios.

**Project Details**  
  
**Title:** Senior SDET  
**Rate:** $13.5/hr
  
**Start Date:** 19th October  
**Duration:** 5 Weeks  
**Commitment**: 33 Hours per Week  
**Location:** India (Remote)  
**Job Type:** Freelance

### **Responsibilities**

* Analyze distributed system APIs to validate correctness, consistency, and failure handling across services involved in account creation, data persistence, and related record-linking
* Execute pre-approved request variations and boundary-validation scenarios using sanitized tracer payloads against designated staging endpoints.
* Investigate system behavior under malformed, malicious, or unexpected inputs and document findings clearly
* Capture complete request/response evidence, including HTTP status codes, latency, headers, and payload bodies, subject to approved data-handling requirements.
* Validate behavior of near-real-time inline checks (evaluated within milliseconds at the gateway) as distinct from longer-running background verification/risk pipelines (evaluated over minutes to hours), confirming each layer of defense behaves as expected
* Verify data persistence, referential integrity, and correct linkage of related records/relationships written by backend services during processing
* Execute controlled replay suites and compare expected versus observed API behavior.
* Correlate replay results with the API schemas and network evidence produced by the Middleware SDET.
* Document observable account/CID lifecycle behavior and downstream state changes for handoff
* Capture and archive test logs and evidence in a structured, retrievable format to support audits and post-incident reviews
* Collaborate with backend engineering teams to reproduce, isolate, and validate fixes for distributed-system defects
* Contribute to test strategy for backend/middleware reliability, including failure-mode and chaos-style testing
* Maintain traceability between test evidence, defects, and system requirements
* Reconcile backend observations with the frontend FSM and middleware/API evidence produced by earlier workstreams.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Strong experience of **5-8+ years** in testing distributed systems and analyzing inter-service API behavior
* Hands-on experience with request payload tampering, fuzzing, or adversarial API testing techniques
* Understanding of layered defense architectures, including the distinction between synchronous/inline validation and asynchronous/background verification processes
* Familiarity with testing data persistence and relational/hierarchical integrity in backend data stores
* Demonstrated discipline in test log archival, evidence capture, and structured documentation practices
* Solid understanding of backend/middleware architecture, failure modes, and system boundaries
* Familiarity with API testing tools and scripting for building custom fuzzing/tampering test cases
* Strong analytical and investigative skills for root-causing complex, systemic defects
* Experience executing controlled API replay or staging validation is strongly preferred.
* Experience correlating API responses with observable application/account lifecycle states is preferred.
* Experience supporting audit, compliance, or evidence-based reporting requirements is a plus

title: Lead Software Development Engineer in Test

title: Senior System & Network Administrator (IT Hardware & Network)
description:
**Company :**
Dayal Fertilizers Private Limited
  
  
**Job Title :**
Senior System & Network Administrator (IT Hardware & Network)
  
  
**Qualification :**
Graduation in Computer Science / IT or a related field
  
  
**Experience :**
7 - 10 Yrs.
  
  
**Location :**
Meerut, Partapur, Delhi Road ( Uttar Pradesh)
  
  
**Work Timing :**
10:00 AM - 06:00 PM
  
  
**Certifications :**
Cisco CCNA
  
  
**Reporting To**
: General Manager - Platform Engineering
  
  
**Job Purpose**
We are seeking a highly experienced and capable Senior System & Network Administrator with 7+ years of hands-on experience in managing enterprise IT infrastructure, network security, server administration, and IT facility management. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring the availability, security, performance, and reliability of the organization's IT infrastructure while minimizing operational downtime.
  
  
As a key member of the IT Infrastructure & Facility Management function, the candidate will oversee enterprise networks, Windows and Linux servers, security systems, virtualization, backup and disaster recovery, IT procurement, asset management, and end-user support. The role also involves managing vendor relationships, software licenses, Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), and infrastructure performance reporting.
  
  
Experience in a manufacturing environment will be an added advantage, particularly in supporting plant operations, business-critical systems, and uninterrupted IT services.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, configure, maintain, and optimize enterprise networks, including Cisco routers, switches, VLANs, and network segmentation.
* Manage firewalls, UTM security features, NAT/PAT configurations, and secure VPN connectivity for site-to-site and remote access.
* Administer endpoint security solutions, including Sequrite Endpoint Protection, and maintain awareness of EDR, XDR, and MDR security technologies.
* Manage Windows Server, Linux systems, Active Directory, Group Policy Objects (GPO), DNS, DHCP, proxy servers, and virtualization infrastructure.
* Plan and execute server upgrades, firmware updates, BIOS updates, operating system patching, and end-of-life hardware replacements.
* Maintain reliable backup and recovery processes, periodically verify backup integrity, and support infrastructure continuity and disaster recovery planning.
* Manage Office 365 / Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace environments, including user accounts, access controls, and identity management.
* Monitor network and server performance using enterprise monitoring tools such as Zabbix or Nagios, proactively identifying and resolving infrastructure issues.
* Analyze system logs, network traffic, and security events to identify faults, investigate incidents, and implement corrective actions.
* Support the installation, configuration, and maintenance of MSSQL and MySQL databases, including basic queries, database maintenance, and user access management.
* Manage IT assets, endpoint compliance, hardware and software inventory, device security policies, and asset lifecycle tracking.
* Oversee IT facility infrastructure, including IP CCTV surveillance, biometric attendance systems, and associated physical security technologies.
* Plan IT budgets, evaluate hardware and software requirements, assess vendors, negotiate commercial terms, and manage procurement activities.
* Take ownership of annual renewals for AMCs, software licenses, application subscriptions, and infrastructure support contracts.
* Manage the IT helpdesk and ticketing workflows, ensuring timely resolution of user issues in accordance with defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Maintain updated network diagrams, infrastructure documentation, technical inventories, troubleshooting guides, and standard operating procedures.
* Prepare and present monthly MIS reports covering network performance, server downtime, helpdesk tickets, user complaints, security incidents, and hardware ageing.
* Coordinate with internal teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure reliable IT services and continuous infrastructure improvement.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of enterprise networking, including TCP/IP, LAN, WAN, VLANs, routing, switching, and network troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience with Cisco routers and switches, firewall administration, UTM, NAT/PAT, and VPN configurations.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and Linux administration.
* Experience with virtualization technologies, server hardware, storage, system patching, and infrastructure lifecycle management.
* Knowledge of endpoint protection solutions, security policies, vulnerability management, and infrastructure hardening.
* Experience in implementing and monitoring backup, recovery, and disaster recovery processes.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 / Office 365 or Google Workspace administration and identity management.
* Working knowledge of network and infrastructure monitoring tools such as Zabbix or Nagios.
* Basic administration of MSSQL and MySQL databases, including queries, maintenance, and access controls.
* Experience in IT asset management, hardware/software procurement, vendor coordination, AMC management, and license renewals.
* Knowledge of helpdesk ticketing systems, SLA management, IT documentation, and MIS reporting.
* Familiarity with IP CCTV, biometric access or attendance systems, and related IT facility infrastructure.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent ownership and accountability for infrastructure availability and service continuity.
* Ability to prioritize incidents and resolve issues under time-sensitive conditions.
* Good communication and coordination skills with users, vendors, and management.
* Strong planning, documentation, reporting, and IT asset management capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple infrastructure activities independently and lead technical service delivery.
* Cost-conscious approach to procurement, vendor management, and infrastructure optimization.

**Must have**

* Experience in IT infrastructure management within a manufacturing or plant-based environment.
* Exposure to production-critical applications, ERP systems, and business operations.
* Experience with remote deployment and automation of firmware, BIOS, and operating system updates.
* Experience in IT budget planning, commercial negotiations, vendor evaluation, and annual contract management.

**Good To have**

* Experience with high-availability infrastructure, production clustering, and server modernization.
* Familiarity with EDR, XDR, MDR, and advanced threat detection and response practices.
* Knowledge of IT service management (ITSM) practices, incident management, change management, and SLA governance.
* Exposure to infrastructure security audits, business continuity planning, and disaster recovery drills

**Proximity To Delhi NCR Distance**
~70 km from Delhi, ~40 km from Ghaziabad, 55 km from Noida
  
  
**Connectivity**

* NH 58, Delhi Meerut Expressway ( 45-50 Min),
* Railways ( 50-60 Min), and
* Metro/Rapid connectivity ( 30-40 Min) from Delhi and Noida.

**Cost Advantage:**
Lower cost of living than Delhi /Noida, making it attractive for professionals

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
In this role at EY GDS Consulting, you will play a key role in shaping innovative solutions for telecom clients, acting as their trusted advisor in transformation leveraging Nokia FlowOne driven solutions. You will apply leading industry standards along with Nokia FlowOne expertise to solve complex telecommunication challenges and leverage cutting-edge technologies to drive Telco transformations. You will support the Partners and the Markets team in any opportunities that are initiated by clients.
  
  
You will be responsible to create a market for EY offerings across the telecommunications value chain and generate new leads and opportunities based on the client relationships you already have. Additionally, you will be responsible for delivery of key client outcomes on engagements by managing the teams on ground and client expectations of delivery, helping project teams mitigate delivery risk and identifying key issues that hinder outcomes for the client.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Provide solution architecture and thought leadership on Zero Touch Fulfilment and Autonomous Networks leveraging Nokia FlowOne and other Nokia suite of OSS products
* Lead the implementation of related solutions, ensuring adherence to project timelines and quality standards.
* Driving presales response for OSS transformation RFIs/RFPs.
* Develop comprehensive documentation for network architectures, designs, and processes.
* Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in Autonomous networks, AI, and Machine learning with hands on experience in leveraging leading AI tools for deliveries.
* Develop and apply solution architecture standards, processes, and principles.
* Evaluate and recommend technologies, tools, and platforms that support autonomous networking initiatives.
* You will be the day-to-day point of contact for clients and managers on projects. You structure and engage teams to deliver high-quality outputs.

* Commissioning of the EMS, DMS systems.

* Engineering and code development for the EMS, DMS systems that meets the high standards.
* Parameterization, optimization, testing of EMS, DMS systems.
* Databases management.
* Develop and provide trainings for specific computer systems.
* Performs commissioning activities.

* Exposure in Modelling of SCADA and Power System Analyst Applications

* Basic Knowledge in software testing;
* English (written and spoken) - advanced level;

title: Tech S and T-Resilience and Reliability Engineer-Senior-GDSF02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Senior level)**
**Description**
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) is a modern way of delivering IT Solutions by imbibing Software engineering principles in Service Delivery to reduce IT Risk to business, improve business resilience, attain predictability & reliability, optimize cost of IT Infra and Ops
  
  
A Site Reliability Engineer typically has deep software engineering experience encompassing design, build, deploy and manage / maintain an IT solution ensuring resilience, reliability, and performance.
  
  
An SRE is a bridge between development and operations by applying a software engineering mindset to the development, deployment, and maintenance of applications to maximize system reliability & automation, while improving efficiencies by optimizing resources
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Defining SLA/SLO/SLI for a product / service
* Engineering in resilient design and implementation practices into solutions as they go through the product life cycle
* Engineering out manual effort (Toil) through the development of automated processes and services (e.g., Automated Management of Systems, CI/CD improvements)
* Developing Observability Solutions to track, report, and measure SLA adherence
* Help Optimize Cost of IT Infra & Operations - FinOps
* Critical Situation management
* SOP / Runbook automation, Toil reduction
* Data Analytics & System trend analysis

**Typical Skills And Background**

* 7+ years of experience in software product engineering principles, processes and systems
* Hands-on experience in Java / J2EE, one of web server (Apache Tomcat or IBM HTTP Server), one of the application servers (Tomcat/WebSphere), and any major RDBMS like Oracle
* Hands-on experience in at least one CI-CD (Azure DevOps, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins) and IaC tools (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Ansible etc.)
* Experience in at least one cloud technology (AWS/Azure/GCP etc. and Docker, Pivotal, Kubernetes, OpenShift etc.) and its reliability tools (Azure AppInsight, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor etc.)
* Experience in Linux (RHEL) operating system performance monitoring parameters and their interpretation, commands used for monitoring
* Experience in Observability - APM tools (Dynatrace, AppDynamics etc.), metrics / log consolidation (Splunk) and ELK Stack
* Defining NFRs and SLA/SLO/SLI agreement for a product / platform / services
* Knowledge on queuing models used, thread pools, request servicing processes etc.
* Knowledge in Web Services, SOA, ESB (DataPower), RESTFul
* Knowledge of application design patterns, J2EE application architectures, Microservices, Spring boot & Cloud native architectures
* Proficiency in Java runtimes, Core Java, Garbage collection, JVM parameters tuning
* Experience in performance tuning on Application Servers (Tomcat/WAS)
* Experience in trouble shooting Performance / Scalability / Availability issues
* Experience in Thread dump, heap dump generation & analysis
* Knowledge on Query tuning and database designs & models
* Knowledge at least one automation scripting language like Python
* Mastery in collaborative software development using Git, Jira, Confluence etc.
* AI/ML & Data Analytics knowledge and experience is a desirable

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: Automated Operations Engineer
description:
**Join our Team**
**About The Opportunity**
The Automated Operations Engineer CS Core & RAN is responsible for 24×7 monitoring, fault detection, incident management and service assurance of PS Core network infrastructure. The role focuses on maintaining high network availability, ensuring service stability, meeting defined SLAs and supporting efficient network operations through proactive monitoring, troubleshooting and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Network Monitoring: Monitor network elements, servers, applications and services using NMS, EMS and other monitoring tools.
* Alarm Management: Identify, analyze, correlate and troubleshoot network alarms to minimize service disruptions and ensure timely resolution.
* Incident Management: Perform Level 1 and 2 troubleshooting for PS Core network, transmission and service-related issues.
* Trouble Ticket Management: Create, update, track, and manage TTs in the ITSM tool ensuring accurate documentation and timely closure.
* Escalation Management: Escalate critical incidents and unresolved issues to the relevant technical teams, OEMs and stakeholders as per the defined escalation matrix.
* Stakeholder Coordination: Coordinate with field teams, OEMs, service providers and internal operations teams for incident resolution and service restoration.
* SLA and KPI Compliance: Track operational SLAs and KPIs, identify deviations and ensure incidents are addressed within the agreed timelines.
* Preventive Maintenance: Perform routine network health checks and monitoring activities to identify potential issues and prevent service degradation.
* Reporting and Documentation: Prepare incident reports, shift handover notes, operational dashboards and RCA inputs.
* Change and Maintenance Support: Support planned change activities, software upgrades and maintenance windows ensuring compliance with approved procedures.
* Operational Process Compliance: Follow defined SOPs, MOPs, escalation procedures and operational guidelines to ensure consistent service delivery.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve monitoring effectiveness, incident handling and operational efficiency through process optimization and automation.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Knowledge of telecommunications networks, particularly PS Core.
* Experience in network monitoring, alarm management, incident handling and trouble ticket management.
* Understanding of NMS/EMS tools and ITSM-based incident management processes.
* Basic troubleshooting knowledge of IP networking, transmission, and telecom services.
* Understanding of SLA/KPI monitoring, escalation procedures and operational reporting.
* Ability to work in a 24×7 shift-based operational environment.
* Strong focus on service assurance, incident resolution and operational compliance.

**Key Performance Expectations**

* Timely identification, acknowledgment and resolution/escalation of critical alarms and incidents.
* Achievement of defined SLA and KPI targets.
* Accurate TT creation, assignment, tracking and closure.
* Effective shift handovers and adherence to operational procedures.
* Minimization of missed incidents and avoidable service-impacting delays.
* Continuous improvement in monitoring, troubleshooting and operational efficiency.

**Work Environment**
The role requires working in a 24×7 Network Operations Centre (NOC) environment, including rotational shifts, weekends, and holidays as per operational requirements.

title: Incident Manager
description:
Join our Team

**About this Opportunity:**

We are seeking an experienced Incident Manager to join our Global Network Operations Center (GNOC) team. In this critical role, you will be responsible for managing incidents across all customers, particularly handling high-severity (Severity 1) outages. You will ensure the timely and efficient restoration of services within agreed service-level agreements (SLAs) and collaborate with cross-functional teams to minimize network disruptions.

**What You Will Do:**

• Incident Management (24x7): Lead and manage high-severity incidents, ensuring minimal disruption and rapid recovery.

• Technical & Management Coordination: Set up and drive Technical & Management Bridges for effective communication during emergency events.

• Resource Mobilization: Ensure necessary resources (staff, systems, facilities) are engaged and focused on restoring service.

• Escalation Handling: Lead escalation discussions and ensure the timely execution of escalation decisions during critical incidents.

• Reporting & RCA: Contribute to writing Event Reports and Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) for incidents.

• Customer Communication: Maintain clear communication with customers and management about incident status and progress.

• Crisis Management: Guide the team through high-pressure situations while balancing service restoration and data collection for investigation purposes.

• Collaboration with Global Teams: Work with local support staff, third-party vendors, and other teams to ensure the effective resolution of incidents.

• Continuous Improvement: Assist in identifying and implementing process improvements to reduce incident occurrence and impact.

**The Skills You Bring:**

• 5+ years experience in Incident Management Expertise: Proven experience managing incidents in a telecom or network operations environment (8-15 years).

• Technical Leadership: Strong ability to lead and manage technical teams under pressure.

• Problem Solving: Capable of troubleshooting complex technical issues while ensuring service recovery.

• Telecom Knowledge: In-depth understanding of telecom systems and network infrastructure (Ericsson experience is a plus).

• Calm Under Pressure: Ability to stay calm and focused in high-stress situations, with a solution-oriented approach.

• Customer Service Skills: Demonstrated ability to handle aggressive or disruptive customer reactions with professionalism.

• Communication Skills: Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication abilities.

• Escalation & Crisis Management: Skilled in handling escalations and managing political dynamics in high-stakes scenarios.

• Engineering Background: An engineering degree or equivalent technical qualification.

The Security Presales team works closely with customers, OEMs, partners, and internal sales teams to design and position cybersecurity solutions that address evolving business and security challenges. The team plays a critical role in solution design, technical consulting, bid management, and customer engagement across enterprise security opportunities.
  
  
**Key Purpose of the Role**
The Security Presales Consultant will be responsible for understanding customer requirements, architecting cybersecurity solutions, supporting technical sales engagements, and driving successful solution adoption. The role requires strong expertise in Cisco Security technologies and multi-vendor security platforms, along with the ability to translate business needs into scalable and secure architectures.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Engage with customers, OEMs, channel partners, and sales teams to understand business, technical, and solution requirements.
* Conduct technical discovery sessions and recommend appropriate cybersecurity and network security solutions.
* Design and prepare HLDs, LLDs, architecture diagrams, BOM/BOQ, technical proposals, and Statements of Work (SOW).
* Support RFPs, RFQs, tenders, compliance documents, and technical solution submissions.
* Architect and position Cisco security solutions, including:

+ Cisco Firepower Threat Defense (FTD)
+ Cisco Firepower Management Center (FMC)
+ Cisco ASA
+ IPS / IDS Solutions

* Provide solutioning support for multi-vendor security environments, including Check Point and Fortinet FortiGate.
* Analyze customer infrastructure and recommend security modernization, firewall optimization, and network transformation solutions.
* Develop migration strategies for firewall consolidation and migration projects, including FortiGate/ASA to Cisco or Check Point platforms.
* Work closely with sales teams to qualify opportunities, define scope, and prepare optimized BOM/BOQ.
* Deliver customer presentations, workshops, solution demonstrations, and Proof of Concepts (POCs).
* Prepare competitive solution comparisons and articulate technical and business differentiators.
* Ensure seamless handover to delivery teams with complete solution documentation, assumptions, implementation approach, and scope definition.

**Who We're Looking For**

* 5-10 years of experience in Security Presales, Network Security, Security Consulting, or Solution Architecture.
* Strong expertise in Cisco Security technologies, including FTD, FMC, ASA, IPS, and IDS.
* Hands-on experience with Check Point and/or Fortinet security solutions.
* Strong understanding of enterprise network and security architecture.
* Experience in preparing HLDs, LLDs, BOM/BOQ, RFP responses, and technical proposals.
* Exposure to firewall migration, security transformation, and security modernization projects.
* Excellent customer-facing, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work with sales, OEMs, partners, and delivery teams in a fast-paced environment.

**Core Competencies**

* Security Presales & Solution Consulting
* Cisco Security (FTD, FMC, ASA)
* Check Point Security Solutions
* Fortinet FortiGate
* Network & Cybersecurity Architecture
* HLD / LLD Design
* BOM / BOQ Preparation
* RFP & Tender Management
* Security Assessments & Migration Planning
* Customer Presentations & POCs
* Technical Proposal Development
* Stakeholder Management & Business Communication

**Preferred Certifications**

* Cisco CCNP Security / CCIE Security
* Cisco Firepower Certifications
* Check Point CCSA / CCSE
* Fortinet NSE Certifications
* CISSP, CISM, or equivalent security certifications (preferred)

title: IT & Systems Executive
description:
**About Athena**

Athena Education is India’s leading college admissions consultancy, guiding around 1,000 students each year toward the world’s most selective universities. With offices in Gurgaon, Bengaluru, and Mumbai, a rapidly growing international client base, and a team of approximately 180 people across counselling, academics, product, and operations, Athena is continuing to scale its footprint and capabilities.

**About the Role**

This will be Athena’s
**first dedicated IT hire**
, with end-to-end ownership of the organization’s technology environment.

Our students and families trust us with highly sensitive information, including academic transcripts, financial information, personal essays, and university portal access. Your role will be to ensure that Athena’s technology ecosystem is
**secure, reliable, well-managed, and cost-efficient**
as the organization grows.

This is a high-ownership role with a clear mandate, significant autonomy, and direct access to leadership. You will have the opportunity to build and strengthen Athena’s IT infrastructure, systems, security practices, and processes from the ground up.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Device & Endpoint Security:**
  Own the complete laptop fleet across Athena’s three offices, including asset management, mobile device management (MDM), disk encryption, patching, antivirus, and the secure issuance and recovery of devices.
* **Identity & Access Management:**
  Implement and manage single sign-on (SSO), multi-factor authentication (MFA), role-based access controls, and same-day access provisioning and revocation as team members join, transition roles, or exit the organization.
* **Data Protection & Compliance:**
  Ensure Athena remains aligned with India’s DPDP Act and relevant client-side data requirements. Establish and maintain data classification and retention policies, vendor agreements, and a tested incident-response framework.
* **Credential & Records Security:**
  Move shared credentials and sensitive student records into secure, centralized, and auditable systems while establishing strong access and records-management practices.
* **Network & Workplace Infrastructure:**
  Manage internet connectivity and redundancy, Wi-Fi, VPNs, meeting-room AV, printing, and other workplace technology across the Gurgaon, Bengaluru, and Mumbai offices.
* **Software & Cost Optimization:**
  Build and maintain a centralized register of all software and technology tools used across Athena, including ownership, renewal dates, license counts, and costs. Identify opportunities to renegotiate contracts, consolidate tools, optimize licenses, and eliminate unnecessary expenditure.
* **IT Support & Enablement:**
  Build and manage an efficient internal helpdesk with clear service levels, ensure every new joiner is fully set up from Day 1, and create straightforward documentation that enables teams to resolve common issues independently.

**Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of experience managing IT environments for organizations with
  **100+ users**
* Hands-on experience with
  **Google Workspace administration**
  and device management platforms such as Intune, Jamf, Scalefusion, or similar tools
* Practical experience implementing and managing
  **SSO, MFA, identity management, and access controls**
* Strong experience managing technology vendors, contracts, licenses, and renewals
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical risks and solutions clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* Exposure to compliance and information-security frameworks such as
  **DPDP, GDPR, SOC 2, or ISO 27001**
* Experience supporting technology infrastructure across
  **multiple office locations**
* Experience using
  **scripting or automation**
  to streamline routine IT and administrative tasks
* Previous experience in an organization handling
  **sensitive personal or client data**
* Relevant certifications in
  **IT, information security, cloud, or cybersecurity**

title: Technical Account Manager, ES - INDIA
description:
**Description**
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
Amazon has built a global reputation for being the most customer-centric company, a company that customers from all over the world recognize, value, and trust for both our products and services. Amazon has a fast-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun and Make History.”
  
  
As an increasing number of enterprises move their critical systems to the cloud, AWS India is in need of highly efficient technical consulting talent to help our largest and strategically important customers navigate the operational challenges and complexities of AWS Cloud. We are looking for Technical Consultants to support our customers creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Data Analytics, Application services, Networking, Server-less and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor for organizations ranging from start-ups to large enterprises.
  
  
As a Technical Account Manager, you will be the primary technical point of contact for one or more customers helping to plan, debug, and oversee ongoing operations of business-critical applications. You will get your hands dirty, troubleshooting application, network, database, and architectural challenges using a suite of internal AWS Cloud tools as well as your existing knowledge and toolkits. We are seeking individuals with strong backgrounds in I.T. Consulting and in any of these related areas such as Solution Designing, Application and System Development, Database Management, Big Data and Analytics, DevOps Consulting, and Media technologies. Knowledge of programming and scripting is beneficial to the role.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:
  
  

* Learn and use Cloud technologies.
* Interact with leading technologists around the world.
* Work on critical, highly complex customer problems that may span multiple AWS Cloud services.
* Apply advanced troubleshooting techniques to provide unique solutions to our customers' individual needs.
* Work directly with AWS Cloud subject matter experts to help reproduce and resolve customer issues.
* Write tutorials, how-to videos, and other technical articles for the customer community.
* Leverage your extensive customer support experience and provide feedback to internal AISPL teams on how to improve our services.
* Drive projects that improve support-related processes and our customers’ technical support experience.
* Assist in Design/Architecture of AWS and Hybrid cloud solutions.
* Help Enterprises define IT and business processes that work well with cloud deployments.
* Be available outside of business hours to help coordinate the handling of urgent issues as needed.

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* 7+ years of hands-on infrastructure, troubleshooting, systems administration, networking, DevOps or applications development experience
* Experience in external enterprise customer-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
* Be mobile and travel to client locations as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- AWS India - Haryana

title: Cloud Solution Engineer
description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------

**About this opportunity**

The Cloud Solution Engineer is responsible for building, deploying, and maintaining cloud-native platforms across OpenShift, OpenStack, CEE, and CNIS environments. The role requires strong Linux, OpenShift, OpenStack, networking, security, automation, and infrastructure knowledge, with an AI-first mindset to improve platform reliability, operational efficiency, and delivery speed. The engineer works closely with development, operations, and security teams to deliver secure and scalable cloud solutions.

**What you will do:**

* Deploy, configure, upgrade, and support cloud platforms across development, test, and production environments.
* Build and manage OpenShift and OpenStack infrastructure, including compute, storage, networking, and cluster lifecycle activities.
* Automate provisioning, configuration, validation, and operational tasks using Infrastructure as Code, scripting, and AI-assisted solutions.
* Troubleshoot Linux, Kubernetes/OpenShift, network, storage, security, and platform integration issues through structured root cause analysis.
* Implement platform security controls, vulnerability remediation, access management, and compliance requirements.
* Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, operational procedures, and reusable deployment templates.
* Collaborate with architects, developers, security teams, and support teams to ensure reliable platform delivery and continuous improvement.

**The skills you bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering/IT or equivalent experience with 6+ years in Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, DevOps, System Administration, or related domains.
* Strong Linux administration skills, including system services, networking, performance analysis, troubleshooting, and shell scripting.
* Experience with cloud platforms, Kubernetes/OpenShift, containers, and OpenStack technologies.
* Good understanding of networking concepts such as DNS, routing, load balancing, firewalls, IP addressing, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of infrastructure security, RBAC, vulnerability management, secrets management, and secure-by-design practices.
* Experience with automation tools and scripting (Python, Ansible, Terraform, GitOps, CI/CD pipelines).
* Basic hardware and datacentre infrastructure knowledge, including servers, storage, compute resources, and platform dependencies.
* Familiarity with AI tools and AI-assisted engineering practices for automation, troubleshooting, documentation, and operational efficiency.

description:

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI

The Teradata Global Support Organization-Base (GSO BASE) Support team is a 24x7, high volume global support centre. Along with incident management, we provide technical/functional knowledge necessary to resolve customer’s problems, both internal and external. The support is provided in multiple languages across the globe.

**What You’ll Do**

The **Customer** **Technical Support Specialist** works in a fast-paced, demanding technical customer support center environment that requires timely solutions to complex technical problems, often of a critical nature to the customer. As a technical support specialist for Teradata’s Base Support team, you will perform troubleshooting activities, escalate problems to the appropriate party(s), and assist in communicating the solution to the customer. You will develop and maintain a working knowledge of current hardware, software, firmware, processes, and tools. You are required to have both strong technical and interpersonal skills. The work environment requires 24x7 coverage which is achieved via follow the sub-Model, on-call rotations, and extended hours, as needed, to accommodate customer needs. This position will also be supporting international customers in Japan for after hours and the ability to be proficient in English is a plus.

  

**Who You’ll Work With**

As the Technical Support Specialist French for GSO BASE typically works in a collaborative environment and interacts with various teams and individuals within Teradata. Some of the key stakeholders and colleagues that a Technical Support Specialist may work with Customers, Product Support Engineers, Platform support engineers, Service Experience Managers, Critical Support Managers, Infrastructure and Operations Teams, Training and Onboarding Teams, Third-party Vendors and other Engineering teams.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* Effective oral and written communications skills in English & French language.

* 3-5 years of Technical Support related experience.
* Good Database and Operating System knowledge
* Experience in Help Desk/Customer service position is a plus
* Knowledge of Support Center procedures and troubleshooting protocols.
* Knowledge of UNIX, Linux, Windows and other current operating systems.
* Knowledge of Teradata support tools including the installation of remote tools is a plus.
* Knowledge of ServiceNow & Power BI reporting.

**What You’ll Bring**

As a Technical Support Specialist for GSO BASE, you will need to bring a combination of technical expertise, customer service skills, and problem-solving abilities to effectively assist customers with their cloud-related issues. You will serve as a bridge between customers and the technical aspects of Teradata services. Your ability to solve problems, provide excellent customer service, and stay current with cloud & Onprem technologies will be essential in ensuring customer satisfaction and success in this role. . Here's what you should bring to excel in this role:

* You should accept and respond to incoming calls and emails from English & French Speaking customers.
* You should be able to collaborate effectively with other support analysts, developers, engineers, and various teams to resolve complex issues.
* Provide Initial problem triage and clarify problem definition.
* Search knowledge bases for known solutions to known problems.
* Identification and management of duplicate incidents
* Extract logs, dumps, error files from customer systems and analyze.
* Prepare and transmit source upgrade files.
* Provide remote support to on-site resources.
* Log problem resolution and support knowledge creation
* Coordinates activities associated with product/service resolution issues.
* Apply search tools to identify previously developed solutions and recognize patterns and symptoms.

* Attend Alert governance calls and isolate noise and redundant issues.

title: Service Desk Analyst
description:
### **Description**

**About the Role:**  
  
The Service Desk Analyst is the first point of contact for all global IT and service requests, resolving issues by phone, email, ticket and in person, and escalating what can't be fixed at first line. You should deliver excellent, timely support to users across multiple business areas, so that issues are resolved with minimal business impact and within SLA.  
  
The Global Service Desk Team has 5 analysts. It supports 1500+ users worldwide, 24 hours a day, 5 days a week (moving to 24x7), on a follow-the-sun shift pattern.

  

### **Responsibilities**

**Ticket and incident management**

* Act as first-level contact for users and resolve issues, or convey resolutions, by phone, email, service desk tickets and face to face.

* Maintain control of the Global Service Desk queue: log, prioritise, resolve and reassign tickets as soon as possible after they are raised.

* Take ownership of tickets and see them through to prompt, satisfactory resolution, collaborating with the team as needed.

* Prioritise business-affecting issues and escalate unresolved queries to the right level of support so problems are fixed within SLA.

* Track, route and redirect problems to the correct resources.

* Follow the Global Incident Management guidelines and ensure proper recording, documentation and closure of every ticket.

**User support and onboarding/off boarding**

* Walk users through the problem-solving process, follow up and provide feedback until the issue is resolved.

* Manage user on- and off-boarding in line with the agreed process flow and timescales, including updating user data.

* Set up new equipment globally, handing over to regional support where required.

* Install and configure software on user machines.

* Support multiple business areas, including IT, Application Support, Facilities and Travel.

**Service quality and relationships**

* Deliver efficient customer service that meets and exceeds user expectations.

* Build strong relationships across all business areas and represent the Service Desk positively to internal customers, clients and suppliers.

* Take part in the 24x5 global shift Rota (moving to 24x7) so users in every region are supported during their working hours.

* Produce activity reports and attend regular 1:1s with the department head to cascade priorities.

* Recommend procedure changes and improvements, and keep growing your knowledge of help desk procedures, products and services.

### **Skills and Experience**

**Technical**

* Working knowledge of help desk / ticketing software and remote-control tools

* Windows 10/11 and macOS (OS X) support

* Microsoft 365, including strong core Office skills (Excel in particular)

* Basic SharePoint and OneDrive management

* Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS)

* Advanced troubleshooting and diagnostic skills

**Professional**

* Proficiency in English, with strong written and verbal communication

* Strong client-facing and customer service orientation

* Ability to priorities, multi-task and complete tasks to the end

* Good organizational and relationship-building skills

* Flexibility to work 24-hour shift patterns

As a next-generation brand activation agency, adm Indicia's purpose is to simplify our clients’ below-the-line marketing, build sustainable ROI and engage their customers across the path to purchase. description:
**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

You will lead the electrical engineering and delivery of high rating static generator excitation systems, ensuring compliance, quality, safety, manufacturability, and successful project execution.

Project Engineering:

* Lead electrical engineering for 5,000 A to 10,000 A static excitation systems from specification review to FAT, commissioning, and handover.
* Review customer specifications, generator data, field forcing requirements, protection philosophy, grid code expectations, and project scope to define a compliant solution.

title: Senior Service Engineer - IT Infra and Cyber Security
description:

Engineers, Quality Engineers, User Interaction Design Engineers, Infrastructure/Platform team, and
  
the Product Owners to help lead the technical insight and industry perspective in the creation,
  
delivery, and integration of complex and comprehensive security solutions. You will be a security

title: DevOps Engineering Manager
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

**Role Summary**

The Manager, DevOps Engineering is the lead hands-on engineer responsible for the India-based DevOps capability supporting enterprise applications, integrations, data platforms, and cloud infrastructure. The role combines technical leadership with direct engineering accountability across Azure infrastructure, networking, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, security, environment management, observability, and production readiness.

This is not a process-focused or administrative management role. The manager is expected to personally design, build, review, and troubleshoot infrastructure, deployment pipelines, network configurations, access controls, monitoring, and automation. The role will also establish engineering standards, mentor DevOps engineers, review technical work, and serve as the escalation point for complex infrastructure and deployment issues.

The manager will work closely with enterprise architects, application teams, integration engineers, data engineers, networking, security, and delivery leadership to ensure environments and deployment processes are secure, repeatable, scalable, and operationally supportable. The role is accountable for improving delivery discipline, reducing manual processes, resolving environment bottlenecks, and ensuring infrastructure and releases are ready for production.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and mentor DevOps engineers while remaining hands-on in delivery.
* Design and support Azure infrastructure, networking, identity, monitoring, and platform services.
* Manage virtual networks, subnets, private endpoints, DNS, routing, firewalls, and IP capacity.
* Build and maintain reusable Infrastructure as Code using Bicep or Terraform.
* Design and support Azure DevOps YAML pipelines and reusable deployment templates.
* Automate environment provisioning, configuration, testing, release, rollback, and recovery.
* Implement Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, service principals, RBAC, Key Vault, and least-privilege controls.
* Establish monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, and operational runbooks.
* Review infrastructure code, pipeline code, scripts, and security changes.
* Lead troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, incident response, and production-readiness reviews.
* Enforce DevOps, security, release, and operational engineering standards.
* Partner with architecture, application, integration, data, networking, and security teams.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of DevOps, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or related experience.
* 4+ years of hands-on Microsoft Azure engineering experience.
* 2+ years in a lead engineer or technical management role.
* Strong Azure networking and IP-address planning experience.
* Strong Infrastructure as Code experience using Bicep, Terraform, or both.
* Strong Azure DevOps and YAML pipeline experience.
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities, service principals, and Key Vault.
* Experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
* Strong scripting skills using PowerShell, Azure CLI, Bash, or Python.
* Demonstrated ability to lead engineers while remaining technically hands-on.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting Azure Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid, Event Hubs, and microservices.
* Experience with D365 Finance and Operations, Power Platform, or Dataverse.
* Experience with Azure Policy, security scanning, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
* Experience with containers, AKS, or site reliability engineering practices.

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
