title: PHE Expert
description:
**Company Description**

Egis is a leading global architectural, consulting, construction engineering, operations and mobility services firm. We create and operate intelligent infrastructure and buildings that both respond to the climate emergency and contribute to balanced, sustainable and resilient development. Our 20,500 employees operate across over 100 countries, deploying their expertise to develop and deliver cutting-edge innovations and solutions for clients. Through the wide range of our activities, we are central to the collective organisation of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world.

 **Job Description**

Position: PHE Expert

**Experience:** 13–15 Years

**Education:** M.Tech in Environmental Engineering / Infrastructure Engineering

Main Duties and Responsibilities

The PHE Design / Sewerage / Drainage Design Engineer will be responsible for leading and managing the planning, design, review, and technical delivery of medium to large-scale urban infrastructure projects. The role requires strong technical expertise, multidisciplinary coordination, and the ability to independently manage design assignments from concept through detailed design and tender stages.

Key responsibilities shall include, but not be limited to:

* Lead site visits, field investigations, data collection, and consultations with clients, government authorities, and stakeholder agencies to establish project requirements, design criteria, and project briefs.
* Lead and undertake the planning and design of complex, medium-, and large-scale sewerage and drainage projects, including gravity, pressure, loop, and combined systems.
* Develop and review sewerage and drainage network designs, including hydraulic analysis, pipe sizing, alignment, profiles, pumping systems, and associated infrastructure.
* Lead the design of sewerage infrastructure, including gravity and pressure pipelines, distribution networks, manholes, wells, pumping stations, pumping mains, and other associated hydraulic/hydrotechnical structures.
* Prepare, review, and approve design calculations, technical reports, drawings, specifications, BOQs, and cost estimates in accordance with applicable codes, standards, and project requirements.
* Lead the design and detailing of water reservoirs and RCC tanks, including overhead, surface, and underground tanks, as well as associated pumping stations and pumping mains.
* Develop and review technical specifications for pipes, fittings, valves, construction materials, equipment, and construction methodologies.
* Prepare and review detailed engineering drawings, layouts, longitudinal profiles, typical details, and construction drawings for sewerage and drainage infrastructure.
* Ensure the technical quality, accuracy, and constructability of designs and deliverables before submission to the client.
* Review designs and deliverables prepared by junior engineers and provide technical guidance, mentoring, and support to the design team.
* Coordinate closely with multidisciplinary teams, including urban planners, urban designers, architects, structural engineers, electrical/mechanical engineers, estimators, CAD, and GIS teams.
* Coordinate with procurement specialists, Quantity Surveyors, Infrastructure Experts, and Project Managers to provide timely technical inputs for tendering, procurement, and project implementation.
* Participate in client and stakeholder meetings, technical presentations, design reviews, and progress discussions, and provide appropriate technical recommendations.
* Respond to and resolve technical queries raised by clients, government departments, contractors, and other stakeholders during design, tendering, and construction stages.
* Review contractor submissions, technical proposals, shop drawings, material submissions, and method statements, where required, and provide technical recommendations.
* Support tendering and bidding activities by preparing technical inputs, specifications, BOQs, estimates, and responses to technical queries and clarifications.
* Identify design risks, interface issues, and potential constructability challenges and recommend appropriate technical solutions.
* Ensure compliance of designs with applicable national/international standards, statutory requirements, client specifications, and project-specific design criteria.
* Maintain overall responsibility for timely delivery of assigned design packages while ensuring quality, cost-effectiveness, and adherence to project schedules.
* Provide technical leadership and support to the Project Manager and senior management on PHE, sewerage, and drainage-related matters.
* Contribute to business development activities, including preparation of technical proposals, methodologies, scope of work, and technical presentations, as required.

  
**Qualifications**

**Qualification:** M.Tech in Environmental Engineering / Infrastructure Engineering

**Experience:** 13–15 Years

title: Sr Engineer II - SecOps Insider threat
description:
At Aristocrat, we are at the forefront of entertainment and technology, pushing boundaries to build world-leading gaming content. Our mission is to bring happiness to life through the power of play, and our culture is built on innovation, creativity, and integrity. As a Sr Security Analyst, you will play a crucial role in our Security Operations Center (SOC), ensuring the safety and integrity of our systems. This is an outstanding opportunity to join a dynamic team, collaborate globally, and drive impactful security initiatives. Your expertise will be instrumental in protecting our assets and supporting our mission to deliver world-class gaming experiences. Join us and be part of an ambitious team that values connection and strives for excellence!

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Serve as the incident lead for handling and investigating high-severity and complex security incidents from beginning to end. Focus on defining the incident scope, containment, eradication, and recovery phases. Work closely with technical and business partners. Assume responsibility for the root-cause analysis.
* Lead complex, multi-stage investigations across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, and SaaS telemetry, including advanced malware analysis, credential-compromise, and lateral-movement investigations.
* Define detection strategy aligned to MITRE ATT&CK and the organization’s threat model; identify and recommend new detection logic across SIEM, XDR, EDR, and SOAR.
* Conduct threat hunts guided by threat intelligence, emerging TTPs, and gaps in detection coverage; convert findings into new detections, playbooks, and control recommendations.
* Lead Tier 2 SOC operations, ensuring shift priorities, case load, and blocking issue flow meet SLAs and quality standards.
* Build and maintain SOC playbook, runbook, and knowledge-based library; ensure content stays current with tooling and threat changes.
* Identify, build, and recommend process improvements across the SOC, measuring and reporting their impact.
* Chip in to and help implement the multi-year security operations strategy, including detection coverage roadmap, telemetry strategy, automation targets, and capability maturity.
* Interpret security findings as risk-centered advice for security engineering, IT, and business collaborators.
* Mentor and develop Tier 1 and Tier 2 analysts through structured mentoring, investigation walkthroughs, and technical training.
* Participate in cross-functional forums and collaborate with global security teams to ensure a cohesive, consistent approach to security operations.
* Provide senior on-call coverage for major incidents involving blocking issues.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 8+ years in security operations, incident response, detection engineering, or an equivalent blue-team role.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Advanced certifications such as GCIA, GCIH, GCFA, GCDA, GNFA, GREM, OSCP, Microsoft SC-200 or equivalent are highly regarded.
* Expert knowledge of Windows, Linux, Active Directory, and Entra ID charge techniques; able to reconstruct an intrusion from raw logs without a playbook.
* Strong experience in cloud security monitoring and response across at least one major provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Proficiency in Python or PowerShell for automation, data analysis, and tooling integration.
* Deep solid understanding of MITRE ATT&CK, the incident response lifecycle, malware analysis, and phishing investigation.
* Track record of defining standards, processes, and playbooks, and of improving them based on evidence.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor analysts and raise the technical bar of a team.
* Clear, structured technical writing, including incident reports, RCAs, and briefings for senior technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong influencing and teamwork skills; able to work with engineering, IT, and business groups locally and globally to promote change without direct authority.

*This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.*

**Compensation Philosophy**
===========================

We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.

Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

title: Design Engineer - Cable
description:
**THE COMPANY**

Established in 1998, JSM Group is a leading specialist infrastructure engineering company. We design and install the complex power networks, digital infrastructure and specialist systems a future-focused worldwide marketplace needs.

From High-Power grid connections to Critical Utilities. Data Centres to Renewable Energy, our full turnkey solution teams manage the full scope to help advise and deliver complex infrastructure projects at speed, on time and with reduced legislation, technical and commercial risks.

**THE TEAM**

Join the Power Operations team at JSM Group Services Ltd., a leading provider of integrated utility infrastructure solutions. Our combination of end-to-end technical expertise, decades of industry experience, and unlimited fresh thinking makes us a trusted partner in delivering next-generation connectivity in energy and communications across the UK, Europe, and beyond.

Our Power team delivers high-value electrical infrastructure projects for some of the most demanding clients in the sector – from hyperscale data centre operators to major industrial and grid clients. We are building a team of exceptional project management professionals who can drive complex programmes from award through to energisation, and we want people who take real ownership of their projects

**SCOPE OF ROLE**  
  
As a **Cable Systems Engineer**, you will support the development and delivery of cable system engineering activities for substation and renewable energy projects. You will be responsible for the design and engineering of **HVAC and HVDC cable systems from 11kV up to 132kV**, ensuring compliance with applicable standards, DNO requirements, project specifications, budget and schedule.

You will work closely with primary engineering, project teams, clients, DNOs and suppliers to deliver technically compliant and optimised cable system designs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Carry out **HVAC cable calculations and cable sizing** in accordance with DNO requirements and ENA/IEC/BS standards.
* Develop cable route layouts, feasibility drawings, trench sections and cable management systems.
* Prepare detailed cable design calculations, reports and technical documentation.
* Perform **cable pulling, cable thrust and cable sizing calculations** and support cable/accessory procurement.
* Design and coordinate **HV/EHV cable systems, sealing end structures and interfaces** with primary engineering.
* Review and optimise cable routing, JB locations and overall cable system design.
* Raise and manage RFIs/TQs and coordinate technical information required at project start-up.
* Review supplier drawings, datasheets and technical submissions.
* Produce and review **AutoCAD drawings** as required.
* Liaise with internal disciplines, subcontractors, suppliers, clients and DNOs to identify and mitigate technical risks.
* Provide technical input to **tender proposals** and participate in client/DNO meetings.
* Deliver engineering activities independently in line with agreed project budgets, schedules, standards and regulations.

**Position Summary**

**What You’ll Do**
Our Legal Business Services Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) practice is expanding its Application Managed Services team. As a CLM AMS Senior Project Support, you will take a leadership role in supporting, enhancing, and optimizing clients’ CLM technology solutions. You will be instrumental in providing exceptional support and driving ongoing enhancements for our clients’ mission-critical applications, proactively contributing to the success of their transformation initiatives.
  
  
You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve incidents, address service requests, and proactively identify opportunities for process optimization. Your responsibilities will include troubleshooting technical issues, managing client communications, and ensuring service level agreements (SLAs) are met or exceeded. * Effectively coordinate weekly governance calls with clients and provide timely status reports/dashboards.
* Develop and execute comprehensive test plans for system changes, enhancements, and new releases; ensure quality assurance and risk mitigation.

title: SOC Analyst
description:
**Bravura’s Commitment and Mission**
At Bravura Solutions, collaboration, diversity and excellence matter. We value your ideas, giving you room to be curious and innovate in an exciting, fast-paced, and flexible environment. We look for many different skills and abilities, as well as how you can add value to Bravura and our culture.
  
  
As a Global FinTech market leader and ASX listed company, Bravura is a trusted partner to over 350 leading financial services clients, delivering wealth management technology and products. We invest significantly in our technology hubs and innovation labs, which inspire and drive our creative, future-focused mindset. We take pride in developing cutting-edge, digital first technology solutions that support our clients to achieve financial security and prosperity for their customers.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Security Operations Analyst will support build out of our internal capability and partner closely with our outsourced SOC provider. This role focuses on incident response coordination, security monitoring, vulnerability management and remediation oversight, helping to strengthen our overall security posture through effective operational processes and active stakeholder collaboration.
  
  
You’ll play a vital role in ensuring we meet both our internal security obligations and the high expectations of our financial services clients.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Act as the in-house lead for escalations from our third-party MDR/SOC, supporting triage, investigation of alerts from the SIEM, EDR and cloud security tooling (Rapid7 InsightIDR, AWS GuardDuty/CloudTrail), and coordination of incident response
* Investigate security alerts across endpoint, identity, network and cloud environments, correlating available evidence to determine severity, business impact and appropriate response actions.
* Analyse Windows and identity-related security events, including Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Kerberos and NTLM authentication activity, and coordinate investigation and remediation with relevant technical teams.
* Review network security events involving TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, proxies, VPNs and common enterprise protocols, identifying suspicious behaviour and recommending appropriate follow-up actions.
* Escalate confirmed or complex incidents to the Senior SOC Analyst and the Rapid7 SOC. Support containment and recovery activities
* Document incidents from detection to closure in the ticketing system (Jira/ServiceNow)
* Follow established SOC runbooks and playbooks while contributing to the development, maintenance and continuous improvement of incident response runbooks, playbooks and standard operating procedures (SOPs)
* Support the vulnerability management programme such as scan scheduling, triage, risk prioritisation, and remediation tracking
* Monitor the threat landscape to inform detection and response activities
* Support audits and client due diligence processes where required

**Unleash your potential**
To be successful in this role, your background and experience will include:
  
  
  

* 3–5 years’ experience in a security operation, incident response, or SOC analyst role (in-house or MSSP/MDR)
* Hands-on experience with an enterprise SIEM. Rapid7 InsightIDR / InsightVM preferred; Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar or equivalent accepted)
* Working knowledge of network security fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, proxies, VPNs and common protocols.
* Practical experience investigating security events in Microsoft Windows environments, with working knowledge of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Kerberos, NTLM and common authentication flows.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear incident summaries, document evidence, and coordinate actions with infrastructure, application, engineering, and third-party SOC teams.
* Solid understanding of vulnerability management tools and risk-based remediation.
* Familiarity with regulatory and client security expectations in financial services or highly regulated environments
* Knowledge of attack techniques and incident response frameworks (e.g. MITRE ATT&CK)
* Beneficial:

+ scripting/automation, cloud security experience (AWS/Azure).
+ experience using approved AI-assisted security tools for alert triage, investigation, SIEM query development and reporting, with the ability to validate AI-generated outputs and handle sensitive security data appropriately.
+ Industry security certifications are a bonus.

**Working at Bravura**
Our people are the heart of our business. We work hard to provide a rich employee with experience and a robust framework for ongoing career development.
  
  
  

* Competitive salary and employee benefits scheme.
* Flexible working hours, we value work-life balance.
* Maternity/ Parental (including secondary) leave policy.
* A cab facility is available in Delhi/NCR.
* Meal facility available
* Free Medical Insurance

**Corporate Responsibilities Environmental & Health & Safety**

* Ensure Annual Training is competed as required.
* Review Annually & Comply with all Company policies related to H&S and Environmental Management Systems
* Report all/any breaches or accidents/near misses immediately when discovered.

**So, what’s next?**
We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion so even if you don’t match every listed skill or tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you.
  
  
Please note that interviews are primarily conducted virtually and if you require any reasonable adjustments or would like to note which pronouns you use, please let us know.
  
  
All final applicants for this position will be asked to consent to a criminal record and background check. Please note that people with criminal records are not automatically barred from applying for this position. Each application will be considered on its merits.

title: Technical Account Manager, ES - INDIA
description:
**Description**
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
Amazon has built a global reputation for being the most customer-centric company, a company that customers from all over the world recognize, value, and trust for both our products and services. Amazon has a fast-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun and Make History.”
  
  
As an increasing number of enterprises move their critical systems to the cloud, AWS India is in need of highly efficient technical consulting talent to help our largest and strategically important customers navigate the operational challenges and complexities of AWS Cloud. We are looking for Technical Consultants to support our customers creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Data Analytics, Application services, Networking, Server-less and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor for organizations ranging from start-ups to large enterprises.
  
  
As a Technical Account Manager, you will be the primary technical point of contact for one or more customers helping to plan, debug, and oversee ongoing operations of business-critical applications. You will get your hands dirty, troubleshooting application, network, database, and architectural challenges using a suite of internal AWS Cloud tools as well as your existing knowledge and toolkits. We are seeking individuals with strong backgrounds in I.T. Consulting and in any of these related areas such as Solution Designing, Application and System Development, Database Management, Big Data and Analytics, DevOps Consulting, and Media technologies. Knowledge of programming and scripting is beneficial to the role.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:
  
  

* Learn and use Cloud technologies.
* Interact with leading technologists around the world.
* Work on critical, highly complex customer problems that may span multiple AWS Cloud services.
* Apply advanced troubleshooting techniques to provide unique solutions to our customers' individual needs.
* Work directly with AWS Cloud subject matter experts to help reproduce and resolve customer issues.
* Write tutorials, how-to videos, and other technical articles for the customer community.
* Leverage your extensive customer support experience and provide feedback to internal AISPL teams on how to improve our services.
* Drive projects that improve support-related processes and our customers’ technical support experience.
* Assist in Design/Architecture of AWS and Hybrid cloud solutions.
* Help Enterprises define IT and business processes that work well with cloud deployments.
* Be available outside of business hours to help coordinate the handling of urgent issues as needed.

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* 7+ years of hands-on infrastructure, troubleshooting, systems administration, networking, DevOps or applications development experience
* Experience in external enterprise customer-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
* Be mobile and travel to client locations as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Senior Manager Project Pursuits
description:
**Job Description**
**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

* Build and sustain strategic relationships with Global Engineering Centers and EPC stakeholders to position Emerson as a preferred partner.
* Drive early engagement in project lifecycles to embed Measurement Solutions products into specifications, standards, and material requisitions.
* Develop and execute structured account plans, including stakeholder mapping, project pipeline tracking, and qualification strategies.
* Collaborate across global teams, including sales, marketing, product, and strategic account teams, to align pursuit strategies and deliver customer value.
* Lead technical discussions, workshops, and training sessions to build customer capability and strengthen product adoption.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date project and account information in CRM tools to support data-driven decision-making and forecasting.
* Provide insights on market trends, competitive positioning, and customer needs to inform strategy and innovation.
* Monitor and improve key performance indicators, including specification success rate, pipeline growth, and customer engagement outcomes.
* Develop and execute training plans for assigned Global Engineering Center, delivering awareness, application, and advanced technical training tailored to client seniority and discipline mix. Leverage Emerson’s training organization, Application Specialists, and Product Marketing. Position training as a strategic specification and preference tool. Track execution and measure outcomes including specification activity, stakeholder coverage, and client feedback.
* Partner with Global Strategic Account teams to align pursuit strategies, commercial positioning, and stakeholder messaging for shared accounts. Regularly share account and project pipeline updates and support the execution of global approved vendor list qualification, Global Frame Agreement utilization, and licensor engagement activities at the local Global Engineering Center level.

**Who You Are:**
You consistently deliver on commitments by following through on plans with accuracy and attention to detail while maintaining a strong focus on measurable outcomes. You build partnerships and work collaboratively across teams and functions, sharing knowledge and aligning efforts to achieve shared goals. You develop a deep understanding of customer needs and use that insight to create meaningful solutions that drive long-term value. You adapt your approach to identify new opportunities, think creatively, and respond effectively to evolving business and customer requirements.
  
  
**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* A bachelor’s degree in engineering or a relevant technical field (such as instrumentation, electrical, mechanical, or chemical engineering).
* A minimum of 8 years of related experience required; 10+ years preferred.
* Experience in industrial automation, process measurement, or related industries, with exposure to EPC or owner-operator environments.
* Understanding of the project lifecycle, including engineering design, specification development, and procurement processes.
* Experience engaging with engineering teams on technical specifications, vendor qualification, or project pursuit activities.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and deliver engaging presentations or training sessions.
* Familiarity with CRM systems and a data-driven approach to managing pipelines and customer interactions.
* Willingness and ability to travel as part of the role.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and deliver technical training or product capability sessions to engineering audiences, including drafting structured, multi-level training plans.
* Experience engaging or coordinating with strategic or major account management teams on shared accounts including aligning pursuit strategies and sharing structured account intelligence.

**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:**

* Experience working with or within EPC organizations or Global Engineering Centers.
* Knowledge of Measurement Solutions technologies (flow, pressure, temperature, level, analytical, or systems) or similar product portfolios.
* Exposure to industries such as oil and gas, petrochemicals, power generation, or industrial manufacturing.
* Experience with engineering tools or platforms used for specification and design (e.g., SmartPlant, AVEVA).
* Demonstrated ability to work across global teams and influence without direct authority.
* Experience supporting global approved vendor list qualification efforts, Global Frame Agreement utilization, or licensor engagement programs at a local or regional level.

**Our Culture and Commitment To You:**
At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

title: Associate (CE) - Customer CoE
description:
**About Us**

In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.
  
  
**Who You’ll Work With**
BCN Customer COE, as part of Bain’s expert client delivery network, has the vision to lend expertise, speed and competitiveness to Bain’s Pricing, Commercial Excellence, Marketing & Customer Experience projects by co-developing and delivering Pricing products, designing Go-to-Market strategy solutions and improving customer experience effectively through client-specific analysis and solutions. We develop products and deliver solutions that help clients identify and fulfill their full potential across the entire sales value chain and customer journey. We also capture value across all stages—from problem identification and solution design to implementation and capability transfer.
  
  
The CoE has fast-paced, dynamic environment with continuous innovation and learning. We offer multitude of professional development opportunities for those who like to problem-solve in an analytical environment. The COE provides a truly global experience with opportunity to work with Bain teams, experts and clients across the world in an inclusive, collaborative and fun-loving team culture along with global transfer opportunities.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
We are hyper-focused on developing and deploying solutions that help clients accelerate growth sustainably through their go-to-market engine and help them reach full potential growth – from market opportunity identification to coverage planning, pricing, account cadence to optimization of sales and marketing functions, among other levers.
  
  
This is an opportunity to drive the development and deployment of our suite of cutting-edge solutions that help clients realize untapped value in their existing go-to-market engine within days and weeks, supported by analysis of client data and benchmarks and define the roadmap for the next ~12-18 months of work for the client and the Bain case teams.
  
  
Associate (Commercial Excellence) is an expert on
**developing and deploying solutions on projects**
and
**leads a work-stream with support from analysts**
(as needed) end-to-end – from ideation to delivery and presentation, leading discussions with key internal and client stakeholders including Bain Partners, Directors, and Case teams. Usually an associate is staffed 100% on a project and works
**under the guidance of the COE Project Leader/ Manager,**
playing a key role in output delivery and client communication
  
  

* Leads and executes key client delivery and analyses across identified GTM levers, from solution ideation, development and development, as needed and ensure timely, high quality, error-free analysis and output

* Demonstrate logical thinking and apply sound business judgment to drive the overall output across every stage (from data gathering to final presentation)
* Brainstorm with the BCN Project Leader/ Manager and Bain consulting/ specialist team on various aspects of a client project or new IP development
* Drive conversations through data analysis to help drive insights through data analysis and story-lining the deliverable to prove/disprove hypotheses in the best interest of the client/project
* Provide actionable feedback, coaching and mentoring to analysts (as needed) to address their professional development needs

**About You**

* Work experience range in case highest qualification is undergraduate studies – 2-5 years and in case of postgraduate studies 0-3 years with relevant experience in industry or consulting firms with exposure to go-to-market strategy, sales strategy and execution
* Hands on executional expertise on advanced MS-Excel and MS-PowerPoint is a must, prior experience in Tableau and Alteryx is preferred (good to have)
* Possess excellent analytic and communication skills, and should have experience working in a team environment with ability to handle multiple tasks and tight timelines
* Ability to combine business context and technical implementation
* Possess excellent time management and prioritization skills
* Able to drive thought leadership with guidance and brainstorm with project leader, partner and clients to come up with creative new solutions to complex problems

**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the #1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents..

description:

description:
**Job Description – Security Presales ConsultantAbout The Team**
The Security Presales team works closely with customers, OEMs, partners, and internal sales teams to design and position cybersecurity solutions that address evolving business and security challenges. The team plays a critical role in solution design, technical consulting, bid management, and customer engagement across enterprise security opportunities.
  
  
**Key Purpose of the Role**
The Security Presales Consultant will be responsible for understanding customer requirements, architecting cybersecurity solutions, supporting technical sales engagements, and driving successful solution adoption. The role requires strong expertise in Cisco Security technologies and multi-vendor security platforms, along with the ability to translate business needs into scalable and secure architectures.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Engage with customers, OEMs, channel partners, and sales teams to understand business, technical, and solution requirements.
* Conduct technical discovery sessions and recommend appropriate cybersecurity and network security solutions.
* Design and prepare HLDs, LLDs, architecture diagrams, BOM/BOQ, technical proposals, and Statements of Work (SOW).
* Support RFPs, RFQs, tenders, compliance documents, and technical solution submissions.
* Architect and position Cisco security solutions, including:

+ Cisco Firepower Threat Defense (FTD)
+ Cisco Firepower Management Center (FMC)
+ Cisco ASA
+ IPS / IDS Solutions

* Provide solutioning support for multi-vendor security environments, including Check Point and Fortinet FortiGate.
* Analyze customer infrastructure and recommend security modernization, firewall optimization, and network transformation solutions.
* Develop migration strategies for firewall consolidation and migration projects, including FortiGate/ASA to Cisco or Check Point platforms.
* Work closely with sales teams to qualify opportunities, define scope, and prepare optimized BOM/BOQ.
* Deliver customer presentations, workshops, solution demonstrations, and Proof of Concepts (POCs).
* Prepare competitive solution comparisons and articulate technical and business differentiators.
* Ensure seamless handover to delivery teams with complete solution documentation, assumptions, implementation approach, and scope definition.

**Who We're Looking For**

* 5-10 years of experience in Security Presales, Network Security, Security Consulting, or Solution Architecture.
* Strong expertise in Cisco Security technologies, including FTD, FMC, ASA, IPS, and IDS.
* Hands-on experience with Check Point and/or Fortinet security solutions.
* Strong understanding of enterprise network and security architecture.
* Experience in preparing HLDs, LLDs, BOM/BOQ, RFP responses, and technical proposals.
* Exposure to firewall migration, security transformation, and security modernization projects.
* Excellent customer-facing, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work with sales, OEMs, partners, and delivery teams in a fast-paced environment.

**Core Competencies**

* Security Presales & Solution Consulting
* Cisco Security (FTD, FMC, ASA)
* Check Point Security Solutions
* Fortinet FortiGate
* Network & Cybersecurity Architecture
* HLD / LLD Design
* BOM / BOQ Preparation
* RFP & Tender Management
* Security Assessments & Migration Planning
* Customer Presentations & POCs
* Technical Proposal Development
* Stakeholder Management & Business Communication

**Preferred Certifications**

* Cisco CCNP Security / CCIE Security
* Cisco Firepower Certifications
* Check Point CCSA / CCSE
* Fortinet NSE Certifications
* CISSP, CISM, or equivalent security certifications (preferred)

title: Growth Marketing Specialist
description:
About UniVisory

UniVisory is a premium global education advisory working with ambitious students and families aspiring to Ivy League, Stanford, MIT, Oxbridge and other leading universities worldwide.

We are looking for a hands-on Growth Marketing Specialist with one primary mandate:

Help UniVisory consistently reach the right students and parents — through Meta Ads and organic social media — and convert that attention into high-quality leads and conversations.

This is not a social-media posting role. We are looking for someone who understands audiences, messaging, creatives, targeting and performance — and can execute.

What You'll Own

1. Meta Ads & Audience Targeting

Own and execute Meta campaigns across Instagram and Facebook

Identify and continuously refine the right target audiences for different UniVisory programs

Build and test audience segments across geography, demographics, interests, behaviours and intent

Develop campaign hypotheses and systematically test audience × message × creative combinations

Optimize campaigns for lead quality, not simply low CPL

Build retargeting and lookalike strategies from high-quality lead and customer data

Identify why campaigns are attracting the wrong audience and fix them quickly

2. Organic Audience Building

Build UniVisory's organic presence across Instagram and LinkedIn

Identify the questions, concerns and aspirations that matter most to ambitious students and parents

Create content themes designed to reach and engage those audiences

Turn UniVisory's student outcomes, insights, testimonials, research and admissions expertise into high-value content

Experiment with formats, hooks, topics and distribution strategies to increase relevant reach

Build organic authority rather than simply increasing posting frequency

3. Messaging & Creative Testing

Understand different student and parent segments and what matters to each

Translate those insights into strong campaign angles, hooks and creative briefs

Work with designers/content teams to develop high-performing creatives

Continuously test messaging, offers, formats and calls-to-action

Use campaign and engagement data to determine what resonates with the right audience

4. Lead Quality & Growth Analytics

Track the complete journey from campaign → lead → qualified lead → strategy session/demo/application → enrolment

Work closely with the sales team to understand which campaigns are producing genuinely strong prospects

Identify patterns in high-quality versus low-quality leads

Recommend what to scale, change or stop

Maintain simple dashboards around audience, campaign, creative and lead-quality performance

Who We're Looking For

3–5 years of hands-on digital/growth marketing experience

Strong practical experience running Meta Ads

Experience with audience targeting, lead-generation campaigns and campaign optimization

Strong understanding of Instagram and organic social media growth

Ability to think about who we are trying to reach before deciding what to post or advertise

Strong creative and content judgment

Comfortable working with campaign and funnel data

Able to move quickly from hypothesis → campaign → data → learning → next experiment

Comfortable working directly with the Founder

High ownership and strong execution orientation

Willing to work from our Gurugram office

Experience in education, study abroad, premium services or another high-consideration B2C category is preferred but not mandatory.

What Success Looks Like

We will not judge this role primarily by followers, impressions or cheap leads.

Success means:

Are we consistently reaching the right students and parents?

Are the right people engaging with our content?

Are Meta campaigns producing increasingly high-quality leads?

Are those leads progressing to meaningful conversations, strategy sessions, demos or applications?

Are we learning every week which audiences, messages and creatives work best?

The goal is to build a repeatable engine:

Right Audience → Right Message → Relevant Content/Creative → Qualified Lead → Conversion

Why UniVisory

You'll work directly with the Founder and have significant ownership over how UniVisory reaches and engages its next generation of students and families.

title: Associate Manager Social Media
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

**Role: Social Media & Content Marketing**

About TBO

TBO is a global platform that aims to simplify all buying and selling travel needs of travel partners across the world. The proprietary technology platform aims to simplify the demands of the complex world of global travel by seamlessly connecting the highly distributed travel buyers and travel suppliers at scale.

The TBO journey began in 2006 with a simple goal – to address the evolving needs of travel buyers and suppliers, and what started off as a single product air ticketing company, has today become the leading B2A (Business to Agents) travel portal across the Americas, UK & Europe, Africa, Middle East, India, and Asia Pacific.

Today, TBO’s product range from air, hotels, rail, holiday packages, car rentals, transfers, sightseeing, cruise, and cargo. Apart from these products, our proprietary platform relies heavily on AI/ML to offer unique listings and products, meeting specific requirements put forth by customers, thus increasing conversions.

TBO’s approach has always been technology-first, and we continue to invest on new innovations and new offerings to make travel easy and simple. TBO’s travel APIs are serving large travel ecosystems across the world while the modular architecture of the platform enables new travel products while expanding across new geographies.

**Why TBO:**

• You will influence & contribute to “Building World Largest Technology Led Travel Distribution Network” for a $ 9 Trillion global travel business market.

• We are the emerging leaders in technology led end-to-end travel management, in the B2B space.

• Physical Presence in 47 countries with business in 110 countries.

• We are reputed for our-long lasting trusted relationships. We stand by our eco system of suppliers and buyers to service the end customer.

• An open & informal start-up environment which cares.

**What TBO offers to a Life Traveler in You:**

• Enhance Your Leadership Acumen. Join the journey to create global scale and ‘World Best’.

• Challenge Yourself to do something path breaking. Be Empowered. The only thing to stop you will be your imagination.

• Post pandemic: travel space is likely to see significant growth. Witness and shape this space. It will be one exciting journey.

• As a fastest growing B2B platform our priority is purpose-building scalable systems.

• Adopting industry leading technologies to support best-in-class business capabilities for high performing and scalable solutions.

• Fast response to the evolving regulatory environment and helping to meet the firm's regulatory commitments by addressing internal and external commitments.

Key Expectations

**1. Strategic Planning**

* Design short- and long-term content strategies across LinkedIn (Global) and Meta platforms, primarily Facebook and Instagram (Regional), aligned with enterprise-level and regional business goals, brand voice, and target audiences.
* Develop content around major travel and cultural moments in key markets, marketing campaigns, industry events, PR, trends, partnerships, and other relevant initiatives.
* Manage people- and values-focused content for the
  *Life at TBO*
  LinkedIn page to strengthen the employer brand and attract top talent globally.

**2. Content Creation & Curation**

* Develop compelling copy, prepare creative briefs, and manage content approvals in close collaboration with the Graphic Design team and relevant stakeholders.
* Oversee the creation of short-form videos, carousels, and other platform-specific formats in multiple languages.

**3. Community Management**

* Respond to comments, direct messages, and customer service inquiries across social media platforms.
* Escalate genuine customer issues to the appropriate teams and identify and report potential business leads to the relevant stakeholders.

**4. Scheduling & Publishing**

* Build and maintain content calendars, ensuring consistent and timely publishing across TBO and Jumbonline.
* Reshare relevant TBO Academy content with appropriate captions, tags, and mentions of relevant people and businesses.

**5. Paid Advertising & Campaign Management**

* Plan, budget, execute, and optimize targeted social media advertising campaigns, primarily on Meta, based on regional business objectives such as top-of-funnel awareness and new customer acquisition.
* Monitor campaign performance and optimize activities to reduce Cost per Acquisition (CPA) and Cost per Result (CPR).
* Leverage relevant travel trade publications on a case-by-case basis to support regional marketing objectives.

**6. Analytics & Reporting**

* Track organic social media KPIs, including reach, engagement rates, and community growth, across relevant platforms.
* Benchmark performance against key competitors and prepare comprehensive organic social media performance reports twice a year.
* Measure paid campaign performance and report outcomes against defined objectives.

**7. Brand Custodianship**

* Take ownership of brand consistency by ensuring adherence to TBO’s brand guidelines, tone of voice, and creative standards.
* Regularly monitor social media activities and content to maintain quality, consistency, and alignment with brand positioning.

Qualifications & Experience

* **Education:**
  Postgraduate degree in Marketing & Communications from an English-medium educational institution, with excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* **Certifications:**
  Industry-recognized certifications are preferred, such as the Meta Blueprint Social Media Marketing Professional Certificate and Google-certified courses.
* **Professional Experience:**
  3–5+ years of experience managing organic and paid social media campaigns, collaborating with stakeholders, analyzing ROI, and managing advertising budgets. Prior experience in corporate organizations or social media agencies is preferred.

Key Skills Required

**1. Copywriting & Tone Adaptation**

* Ability to craft platform-specific messaging, adapting tone and style to different audiences—for example, casual and visual content for Instagram versus professional communication for LinkedIn.
* Ability to combine human creativity with AI capabilities to improve content development and execution.

**2. Content Creation & Creative Management**

* Minimum 3 years of experience managing in-house and outsourced creative teams.
* Working knowledge of the latest AI tools for content development and creative asset management.

**3. Platform Expertise**

* Strong understanding of platform algorithms, audience behaviour, content formats, and engagement strategies across Meta, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and X.

**4. Analytics & Performance Reporting**

* Ability to track and interpret KPIs, including reach, engagement rates, click-through rates, and conversions.
* Familiarity with paid analytics tools and the scheduling and reporting capabilities available through LinkedIn and Meta Business Suite.

Personal Attributes

* Passionate, self-driven, and hardworking, with a balance of strategic thinking and hands-on execution.
* High-energy, enthusiastic, proactive, and comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
* Strong ownership mindset, creative problem-solving ability, and a focus on continuous improvement.

title: Senior Manager Project Pursuits
description:
**Job Description**
**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

* Build and sustain strategic relationships with Global Engineering Centers and EPC stakeholders to position Emerson as a preferred partner.
* Drive early engagement in project lifecycles to embed Measurement Solutions products into specifications, standards, and material requisitions.
* Develop and execute structured account plans, including stakeholder mapping, project pipeline tracking, and qualification strategies.
* Collaborate across global teams, including sales, marketing, product, and strategic account teams, to align pursuit strategies and deliver customer value.
* Lead technical discussions, workshops, and training sessions to build customer capability and strengthen product adoption.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date project and account information in CRM tools to support data-driven decision-making and forecasting.
* Provide insights on market trends, competitive positioning, and customer needs to inform strategy and innovation.
* Monitor and improve key performance indicators, including specification success rate, pipeline growth, and customer engagement outcomes.
* Develop and execute training plans for assigned Global Engineering Center, delivering awareness, application, and advanced technical training tailored to client seniority and discipline mix. Leverage Emerson’s training organization, Application Specialists, and Product Marketing. Position training as a strategic specification and preference tool. Track execution and measure outcomes including specification activity, stakeholder coverage, and client feedback.
* Partner with Global Strategic Account teams to align pursuit strategies, commercial positioning, and stakeholder messaging for shared accounts. Regularly share account and project pipeline updates and support the execution of global approved vendor list qualification, Global Frame Agreement utilization, and licensor engagement activities at the local Global Engineering Center level.

**Who You Are:**
You consistently deliver on commitments by following through on plans with accuracy and attention to detail while maintaining a strong focus on measurable outcomes. You build partnerships and work collaboratively across teams and functions, sharing knowledge and aligning efforts to achieve shared goals. You develop a deep understanding of customer needs and use that insight to create meaningful solutions that drive long-term value. You adapt your approach to identify new opportunities, think creatively, and respond effectively to evolving business and customer requirements.
  
  
**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* A bachelor’s degree in engineering or a relevant technical field (such as instrumentation, electrical, mechanical, or chemical engineering).
* A minimum of 8 years of related experience required; 10+ years preferred.
* Experience in industrial automation, process measurement, or related industries, with exposure to EPC or owner-operator environments.
* Understanding of the project lifecycle, including engineering design, specification development, and procurement processes.
* Experience engaging with engineering teams on technical specifications, vendor qualification, or project pursuit activities.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and deliver engaging presentations or training sessions.
* Familiarity with CRM systems and a data-driven approach to managing pipelines and customer interactions.
* Willingness and ability to travel as part of the role.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and deliver technical training or product capability sessions to engineering audiences, including drafting structured, multi-level training plans.
* Experience engaging or coordinating with strategic or major account management teams on shared accounts including aligning pursuit strategies and sharing structured account intelligence.

**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:**

* Experience working with or within EPC organizations or Global Engineering Centers.
* Knowledge of Measurement Solutions technologies (flow, pressure, temperature, level, analytical, or systems) or similar product portfolios.
* Exposure to industries such as oil and gas, petrochemicals, power generation, or industrial manufacturing.
* Experience with engineering tools or platforms used for specification and design (e.g., SmartPlant, AVEVA).
* Demonstrated ability to work across global teams and influence without direct authority.
* Experience supporting global approved vendor list qualification efforts, Global Frame Agreement utilization, or licensor engagement programs at a local or regional level.

**Our Culture and Commitment To You:**
At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Grest is one of India's leading full-stack recommerce brands, making premium renewed Apple devices more accessible through quality, technology and trust. With a growing D2C business and expanding offline retail presence, we're building a strong omnichannel brand in India's recommerce market.

We're looking for a Marketing Manager to lead Grest's marketing function, drive brand growth and build a strong connection with consumers. This role requires someone who understands premium consumer brands, consumer psychology and the business of scaling a D2C brand.

***Roles and Responsibilities:***

**1. Marketing Strategy & Business Growth**

* Own the overall marketing strategy, aligned with business objectives and revenue targets.
* Develop marketing plans, budgets, campaign calendars and growth roadmaps.
* Identify growth opportunities across customer segments, geographies and channels.
* Align marketing priorities with business performance, profitability and expansion goals.

**2. Brand Strategy & Positioning**

* Own Grest's brand positioning, value proposition, messaging and overall consumer perception.
* Build brand aspiration, trust and consideration in the premium renewed electronics category.
* Develop integrated campaigns that strengthen brand recall and differentiate Grest in the market.
* Ensure consistency in brand communication across digital platforms, the website and retail stores.

**3. Consumer Psychology & Insights**

* Develop a deep understanding of consumer behaviour, purchase motivations, aspirations and barriers.
* Translate consumer insights into effective positioning, messaging and campaign strategies.
* Understand what drives trust and purchase decisions when consumers consider premium, high-value products.
* Use customer feedback, market research and behavioural data to identify opportunities for growth.

**4. Growth & Revenue Management**

* Own marketing's contribution to revenue, customer acquisition and overall business growth.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer acquisition efficiency, conversion rates, average order value and retention.
* Work with performance, e-commerce and CRM teams to develop and execute growth strategies.
* Evaluate channel performance and allocate budgets based on business impact and profitability.

**5. Integrated Campaigns & Creative Direction**

* Lead the development of brand campaigns, product campaigns, seasonal promotions and major marketing initiatives.
* Set campaign objectives, briefs, target audiences, messaging and success metrics.
* Provide strategic direction to creative, content, performance and social media teams.
* Ensure campaigns balance brand building, consumer engagement and sales outcomes.

**6. Omnichannel & Offline Marketing**

* Develop marketing strategies that connect Grest's D2C website with its growing offline retail presence.
* Plan store launch campaigns, hyperlocal marketing, activations, events and strategic partnerships.
* Drive brand awareness, store footfall and sales through integrated online and offline initiatives.
* Measure the impact of offline marketing and identify opportunities to scale successful initiatives.

**7. Team Leadership & Cross-functional Management**

* Lead and coordinate specialist teams across performance marketing, SEO, content, creative, social media, CRM and other marketing functions.
* Set clear objectives, KPIs, priorities and accountability for each team.
* Translate business goals into actionable plans and ensure teams work towards common outcomes.
* Review performance, provide strategic direction and remove execution bottlenecks.
* Manage agencies, external partners and marketing budgets where required.
* Build a culture of ownership, experimentation, collaboration and performance.

**8. Marketing Analytics & Reporting**

* Own the overall marketing dashboard and performance review process.
* Track revenue contribution, marketing spend, CAC, ROAS, conversion rates, customer retention and brand performance.
* Evaluate campaign effectiveness and identify opportunities for optimisation.
* Use data and consumer insights to make informed decisions on budgets, channels and marketing priorities.
* Present marketing performance, key learnings and growth opportunities to the leadership team.

***What we're looking for :***

* **Experience scaling a D2C brand:**
   A strong understanding of how consumer businesses grow, acquire customers and build sustainable revenue.
* **Understanding of premium brands:**
   The ability to build aspiration, communicate value and establish trust beyond discount-led marketing.
* **Strong grasp of consumer psychology:**
   An understanding of what motivates consumers, shapes perceptions and influences purchase decisions.
* **Strategic marketing mindset:**
   The ability to connect brand positioning, customer acquisition and retention with larger business goals.
* **Team leadership experience:**
   The ability to lead specialist teams, set direction and drive accountability without being involved in every executional detail.
* **Commercial acumen:**
   Comfort with marketing budgets, revenue targets, acquisition costs, conversion metrics and profitability.
* **Creative and analytical thinking:**
   The ability to combine compelling brand narratives with data-backed decision-making.
* **Strong ownership:**
   The ability to independently lead the marketing function, prioritise effectively and work closely with business leadership.

***What success looks like :***

* Stronger brand positioning, aspiration and consumer trust.
* Consistent, profitable D2C growth and improved marketing efficiency.
* Clear strategic direction and alignment across all marketing teams.
* Effective integration of digital marketing and offline retail growth.
* A high-performing marketing function with measurable goals and accountability.



**To apply:**
 Share your resume along with a brief note on a D2C brand you have helped scale, your contribution and the business impact you created at 
**[hr@grest.in]**
.

 Marketing Manager – Grest

title: L2 IT Infrastructure Management Engineer – Remote Data Center Operations
description:
We are looking for an experienced
**Level 2 IT Infrastructure Management Professional**
to support and manage multiple infrastructure towers in a remote data center environment. The role will be responsible for day-to-day operational support, incident resolution, service requests, monitoring, troubleshooting, coordination with tower specialists and vendors, and ensuring agreed SLA/KPI compliance.

The engineer should have broad hands-on knowledge across
**Windows/Linux servers, virtualization, storage, backup, network, Active Directory, cloud connectivity, monitoring, security, and ITSM processes**
, with the ability to remotely diagnose infrastructure issues and coordinate resolution across different technical teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide
  **L2 operational support**
  for remote data center infrastructure across multiple technology towers.
* Monitor server, network, storage, backup, virtualization, and infrastructure health using enterprise monitoring tools.
* Handle incidents, service requests, alerts, and operational tasks within agreed SLA timelines.
* Perform troubleshooting for:
* Windows and Linux server issues
* CPU, memory, disk and service-related problems
* VM availability and virtualization issues
* Network connectivity and DNS/DHCP issues
* Storage capacity and access issues
* Backup failures and restore requests
* Active Directory and access-related incidents
* Support remote administration of physical and virtual servers.
* Coordinate with L3 teams, OEM vendors, application teams, cloud teams, SOC/NOC teams, and data center teams for complex issues.
* Perform routine health checks and operational checks across all infrastructure towers.
* Review monitoring alerts, identify recurring issues, and initiate problem management where required.
* Support server provisioning, decommissioning, patching, reboot coordination, and configuration changes.
* Monitor backup jobs and coordinate restore validation.
* Support Active Directory administration, including:
* User and group management
* Server/computer account management
* Group Policy troubleshooting
* DNS and DHCP support
* Support virtualization platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V.
* Perform basic troubleshooting for SAN/NAS/storage environments.
* Support LAN/WAN/VPN and network connectivity troubleshooting in coordination with network teams.
* Assist with firewall rule validation and connectivity testing where required.
* Support remote access tools, jump servers, privileged access, and bastion environments.
* Maintain configuration, asset, and infrastructure inventory records.
* Execute approved standard changes and operational procedures.
* Maintain incident notes, troubleshooting evidence, resolution details, and knowledge articles.
* Participate in shift handover and operational governance calls.
* Identify risks, dependencies, capacity constraints, and recurring operational issues.
* Support DR readiness, backup validation, and disaster recovery exercises.
* Follow change, incident, problem, service request, and access management processes.
* Ensure adherence to security policies, access controls, and operational procedures.

**Infrastructure Towers in Scope**

The L2 engineer is expected to coordinate and support the following towers:

**Tower**

**Expected L2 Coverage**

Windows Server

OS health, services, patching, event logs, performance troubleshooting

Linux Server

Basic OS health, services, disk, CPU/memory, connectivity

Virtualization

VMware/Hyper-V VM health, console access, resource checks

Storage

Capacity, connectivity, mounts, SAN/NAS basic troubleshooting

Backup

Job monitoring, failure troubleshooting, restore coordination

Network

LAN/WAN, VLAN, DNS, DHCP, VPN, connectivity validation

Active Directory

Users, groups, computer accounts, GPO, authentication issues

Monitoring

Alert monitoring, ticket creation, event correlation and escalation

Security

AV/EDR alerts, access issues, coordination with SOC

Cloud

Basic AWS/Azure infrastructure monitoring and connectivity support

Data Center Operations

Remote coordination for physical server/network/storage activities

**Required Technical Skills**

* Windows Server 2016/2019/2022 administration
* Basic Linux administration
* Active Directory, DNS, DHCP and Group Policy
* VMware vSphere/ESXi or Hyper-V
* Server hardware and infrastructure troubleshooting
* SAN/NAS/storage fundamentals
* Enterprise backup tools such as Veeam, Commvault, NetBackup or equivalent
* TCP/IP, routing, VLAN, VPN and network troubleshooting
* Monitoring tools such as SolarWinds, PRTG, Nagios, Zabbix, SCOM or equivalent
* ServiceNow, Halo, Jira, ManageEngine or equivalent ITSM tools
* Remote access technologies including RDP, SSH, VPN and jump hosts
* Basic PowerShell and/or shell scripting knowledge
* Microsoft 365 / Entra ID exposure preferred
* AWS/Azure infrastructure exposure preferred
* Endpoint security / EDR knowledge preferred

**ITSM and Process Knowledge**

Candidate should have practical knowledge of:

* Incident Management
* Service Request Management
* Problem Management
* Change Management
* Major Incident Management
* SLA/KPI monitoring
* Escalation management
* Knowledge management
* Shift handover
* RCA support
* Configuration and asset management

**Experience**

* **4–7 years of overall IT infrastructure support experience**
* Minimum
  **2–3 years in L2 infrastructure operations**
* Experience supporting
  **remote data center operations or managed infrastructure services**
* Experience working in a
  **24x7 or shift-based support environment**
  preferred
* Experience handling multiple infrastructure towers is highly desirable

**Educational Qualification**

* B.E./B.Tech/BCA/B.Sc./MCA or equivalent qualification in IT/Computer Science
* Relevant infrastructure certifications are desirable

Preferred certifications may include:

* ITIL Foundation
* Microsoft Windows Server / Azure certification
* VMware certification
* Red Hat/Linux certification
* AWS/Azure fundamentals
* Network+ / CCNA

**Key Competencies**

* Strong troubleshooting and analytical ability
* Ability to work across multiple infrastructure towers
* Good incident ownership and follow-through
* Strong coordination and escalation skills
* Ability to work independently in remote operations
* Good written and verbal communication
* Strong documentation discipline
* Ability to work under SLA-driven environments
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts if required

**Sample Performance Expectations**

The role may be measured against:

* SLA compliance
* Incident resolution rate
* Ticket backlog
* Repeat incident reduction
* Monitoring alert closure
* Backup success rate
* Patch compliance
* Documentation quality
* Escalation effectiveness
* Customer satisfaction
* Shift handover quality

title: ST - Telco-Nokia Flow One-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Technology Consulting - Manager – Nokia FlowOne Solution Architect**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
In this role at EY GDS Consulting, you will play a key role in shaping innovative solutions for telecom clients, acting as their trusted advisor in transformation leveraging Nokia FlowOne driven solutions. You will apply leading industry standards along with Nokia FlowOne expertise to solve complex telecommunication challenges and leverage cutting-edge technologies to drive Telco transformations. You will support the Partners and the Markets team in any opportunities that are initiated by clients.
  
  
You will be responsible to create a market for EY offerings across the telecommunications value chain and generate new leads and opportunities based on the client relationships you already have. Additionally, you will be responsible for delivery of key client outcomes on engagements by managing the teams on ground and client expectations of delivery, helping project teams mitigate delivery risk and identifying key issues that hinder outcomes for the client.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Provide solution architecture and thought leadership on Zero Touch Fulfilment and Autonomous Networks leveraging Nokia FlowOne and other Nokia suite of OSS products
* Lead the implementation of related solutions, ensuring adherence to project timelines and quality standards.
* Driving presales response for OSS transformation RFIs/RFPs.
* Develop comprehensive documentation for network architectures, designs, and processes.
* Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in Autonomous networks, AI, and Machine learning with hands on experience in leveraging leading AI tools for deliveries.
* Develop and apply solution architecture standards, processes, and principles.
* Evaluate and recommend technologies, tools, and platforms that support autonomous networking initiatives.
* You will be the day-to-day point of contact for clients and managers on projects. You structure and engage teams to deliver high-quality outputs.
* Take the lead in identifying client issues and proposing the most appropriate approach for challenges that the telecommunication industry players face.
* You help develop the business and acquire new clients and engagements, including the identification and pursuit of business opportunities by forging strong client relationships.
* You build and maintain long-term relationships with senior clients.
* You drive strategic discussions regarding business objectives and strategy KPIs.
* Delivering qualified solutions to meet business objectives, providing focus to ensure scope and objectives are maintained throughout the project and program life cycles ensuring benefits realization.
