title: Deputy Manager - MES Rudrapur
description:
**Responsibilities & Key Deliverables**
---------------------------------------

1. MES team at Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd, you will spearhead the ideation and implementation of shop floor automation technologies. This involves conducting thorough studies of machines and processes to identify optimized solutions that enhance operational efficiency and data accuracy. You will be responsible for understanding and leveraging data inputs from IoT sensors, actuators, and embedded controls, ensuring seamless data collection and integrity at the source.

2.Your role will include developing scenarios for fault prediction and performance enhancement through edge analytics and data normalization techniques. You will drive manufacturing analytics initiatives by designing and consolidating visualization tools and interfaces to facilitate comprehensive machine and process digitization. This requires standardising data collection methods for manufacturing execution systems (MES), enabling efficient integration of supplier process data, and evaluating appropriate technology standards for digital interfaces across hardware, software, and embedded modules.

3.In addition, you will manage multiple projects concurrently from planning to deployment and sustenance phases, utilising tools such as MS Project for effective scheduling and resource allocation. This entails close coordination with project execution teams, vendors, plant heads, IT infrastructure teams, and digital champions to ensure successful MES and digitisation project rollouts. Budget oversight, milestone tracking, and risk mitigation will be key responsibilities while ensuring the alignment of digital initiatives with overall plant KPIs.

4. Key deliverables include continuous engagement in project reviews with stakeholders, managing assets in collaboration with Asset Management, and fostering collaboration with IT teams to support compute, storage, and network requirements. You will also be accountable for developing dashboards and reports that monitor benefit realization, highlight deviations, and propose improvements to enhance analytics capabilities and business insights effectively.

**Experience**
--------------

We are seeking candidates with 2-5 years of progressive experience in industrial automation and manufacturing digital transformation projects, particularly involving MES and IoT ecosystems. Ideal experience includes hands-on exposure to PLC programming, industrial communication protocols such as Modbus TCP/IP, Profinet, and Profibus, and working with major PLC brands like Siemens, Schneider, Rockwell, and Mitsubishi.

The role requires practical knowledge of sensor technologies, industrial device configuration including RFID and wireless systems, and signal conditioning in both linear and non-linear systems. Experience in data analytics using tools such as Python, Pandas, and Matplotlib to analyze manufacturing data and develop predictive scenarios is highly valuable.

Proven capability in managing automation projects end-to-end—right from technology ideation, data acquisition strategy, through deployment and sustained operations—is sought. Strong documentation skills using software such as MS Visio, Word, and PowerPoint to translate technical insights into clear, actionable materials for diverse stakeholders are essential.

Applicants should demonstrate autonomy in problem solving, debugging manufacturing web and distributed Windows applications, and working collaboratively within cross-functional teams. Prior involvement in digital manufacturing environments and manufacturing analytics projects will be advantageous.

**Industry Preferred**
----------------------

Preferred candidates will have experience in the automotive manufacturing sector or original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), where precision, automation, and data-driven decision-making are pivotal. Exposure to shop floor digital transformation within automotive plants or equivalent high-volume industrial settings will enable a strong understanding of the complexities and expectations within this industry.

Experience within industries that emphasize stringent quality management, real-time system monitoring, and predictive maintenance will also be beneficial. Familiarity with automotive production systems and MES integration tailored to large-scale manufacturing will be a significant asset in delivering maximum impact through this role.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Essential Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical, Electronics, or Instrumentation Engineering (B.E. / B.Tech.) with a minimum of 60% aggregate marks or equivalent CGPA from a recognised university.

**Desirable Attributes:**

* Additional certifications or training in Industrial Automation, IoT, Data Analytics, or related fields would be advantageous.
* Continuing education relating to programming languages, automation frameworks, and digital manufacturing applications is encouraged to keep pace with evolving technology.

**General Requirements**
------------------------

Successful candidates should have robust technical expertise in industrial control systems and MES-IoT environments, complemented by practical capabilities in PLC programming and industrial communication networks such as Modbus TCP/IP, Profinet, and Profibus.

Hands-on experience with devices from major vendors like Siemens, Schneider, Rockwell, and Mitsubishi, as well as familiarity with sensor technologies and industrial measurement techniques, is necessary. Functional understanding of data sampling, signal conditioning, and the analysis of both linear and non-linear systems will form the foundation of your daily responsibilities.

Proficiency with data analytics tools, especially in Python including libraries such as Pandas and Matplotlib, is highly desirable to assist in the extraction of actionable insights from manufacturing data. Comfortable documentation skills using MS Visio, Word, and PowerPoint to produce detailed technical schematics and presentations are expected.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate initiative, excellent problem-solving aptitude, and strong collaborative abilities. The capacity to quickly interpret user requirements and transform these into technical use cases will contribute significantly to project success. Embracing a continuous learning mindset and enthusiasm for emerging technologies aimed at operational efficiency is essential.

------------------------------------------------------

At Mahindra & Mahindra Limited, we are deeply committed to fostering diversity, equity, and inclusion within our workplace. We celebrate the rich diversity of our team members and believe that it inspires creativity, drives innovation, and enriches our organisation.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants without regard to any legally protected characteristics including but not limited to age, caste, race, religion, colour, ethnic origin, gender identity, nationality, disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, educational background, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, citizenship, ancestry, or financial status.

title: Data Test Analyst
description:
**Job Title: Data Test Analyst**
**Job Description**
This role offers an excellent opportunity for a Junior Test Analyst to build a career in a leading global financial services environment. You will support the full testing lifecycle for regulatory, control, and functional changes, ensuring systems and reports are accurate, reliable, and audit-ready. Working closely with technology and business stakeholders, you will help design and execute test cases, manage defects, and support user acceptance testing to enable highquality delivery across complex financial products and platforms.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Review business and functional requirements to understand the scope of change, regulatory and control impacts, and downstream dependencies.
* Support test preparation by helping to design, document, and maintain comprehensive test cases and scripts that provide full coverage and clear traceability to requirements and controls.
* Assist in building structured test plans, including defining execution schedules, identifying required environments, and setting clear entry and exit criteria.
* Execute system, functional, and regression test cases accurately and consistently, ensuring results are recorded in a clear and standardized manner.
* Log defects with detailed, reproducible steps, data conditions, and expected versus actual results, enabling efficient investigation and resolution.
* Maintain uptodate defect logs, track defect status through the full lifecycle, and participate in defect triage sessions to help prioritize and clarify issues.
* Liaise with technology teams to clarify defects, validate fixes, and retest once remediation is deployed, ensuring issues are fully resolved before release.
* Capture, organize, and file test evidence in line with governance standards so that all testing activities are auditready and fully versioncontrolled.
* Support user acceptance testing (UAT) cycles by coordinating execution with business users, responding to testing queries, and consolidating UAT results and signoffs.
* Contribute to validating control outputs, exception reports, and regulatory reporting changes from a testing perspective to ensure compliance and control effectiveness.
* Work methodically and proactively, escalating risks or issues in a timely manner, particularly where they may impact tight regulatory or release timelines.
* Collaborate with crossfunctional teams, including change delivery, technology, and business stakeholders, to ensure alignment on testing scope, coverage, and outcomes.

**Essential Skills**

* Experience in testing, quality assurance, or change delivery within financial services, ideally 2 to 5 years, or equivalent internship exposure.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and change lifecycle, including user acceptance testing (UAT) support and release processes.
* Handson experience executing structured system, functional, and regression test cases in a controlled environment.
* Proficient use of test management and defect tracking tools such as JIRA, ALM, Zephyr, or similar platforms.
* Disciplined defect lifecycle management, including clear logging, classification, tracking, and retesting of issues.
* Ability to interpret business and functional requirements and translate them into test conditions, test cases, and expected results.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation discipline, with a focus on traceability and maintaining auditready evidence.
* Comfort working with data sets, including validating calculations and checking report outputs for accuracy and completeness.
* Awareness of regulatory and control requirements and how they influence test coverage, test design, and evidencing.
* Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear, concise test documentation and defect descriptions.
* Organized and methodical working style, with the ability to manage multiple testing activities and meet tight deadlines.

**Additional Skills & Qualifications**

* Exposure to global markets or trading environments and associated fronttoback workflows, such as trade capture, risk, and reporting processes (preferred but not essential).
* Experience supporting testing in complex financial products or regulatory reporting initiatives.
* Familiarity with structured quality assurance practices and governance frameworks in large organizations.
* Masters degree or equivalent postgraduate qualification.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with crossfunctional teams across technology, operations, and business functions.
* Proactive mindset with a focus on continuous improvement of test processes, tools, and documentation.

**Work Environment**
You will work in a large, global financial services organization that operates across multiple countries and markets. The environment emphasizes strong governance, regulatory compliance, and robust control frameworks, requiring thorough documentation, traceability, and auditready testing evidence. You will use industrystandard test management and defect tracking tools such as JIRA, ALM, or Zephyr, and work closely with technology and business stakeholders across the full change lifecycle. The culture promotes continuous professional development, flexible working arrangements where possible, and opportunities for career growth within an inclusive and diverse environment. The organization values collaboration, respect, and the contribution of every team member, fostering a workplace where different perspectives are encouraged and performance is recognized.

Job Title: Senior Security Engineer

Shift Timings: General Shift Role

  

Summary:

The Senior Security Engineer will lead application security engineering across the software development lifecycle. Strong hands-on SAST and DAST scanning experience is required, with primary ownership of DAST operations, SAST engineering, penetration testing, vulnerability remediation and DevSecOps enablement. The role will embed security into design and development, integrate security testing into Secure by Design (SBD), GitHub, Azure and CI/CD workflows, and work closely with development, QA, DevOps, cloud, and product teams to ensure security controls are implemented before production release.

  

Key Responsibilities:

Application Security & Secure by Design

* Embed security requirements, threat considerations, secure coding practices, and control validation across design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance phases.
* Work directly with development teams to identify security gaps early and provide practical remediation guidance while applications are being built.
* Define and maintain security gates, minimum control requirements, exception handling, and evidence expectations for application releases. SAST, DAST & Penetration Testing - Technical Responsibilities
* Own the implementation, configuration, administration, tuning and continuous improvement of enterprise SAST and DAST capabilities.
* Configure, operate and optimize Invicti for authenticated and unauthenticated DAST scans, including scan profiles, authentication, scheduling, coverage, validation, reporting, retesting and troubleshooting.
* Perform SAST scan onboarding and configuration, validate code-level findings, analyze data flows and sources/sinks, tune rules, suppress verified false positives with evidence and provide developer-ready remediation guidance.
* Plan and execute web application, API and network-focused penetration tests using approved methodologies and tools; document reproducible evidence, risk ratings, business impact and corrective actions.
* Triage and correlate SAST, DAST and penetration-testing findings; validate exploitability, remove duplicate or false-positive results, prioritize risk and confirm closure through rescans and retesting.
* Monitor technical scan performance, including scan completion, coverage, authentication success, scan failures, false-positive rates, recurring findings, test effectiveness and remediation trends. DevSecOps, CI/CD, Azure & GitHub Security
* Integrate approved SAST and DAST controls into Secure by Design processes, GitHub repositories, pull requests, build workflows, CI/CD pipelines and release gates.
* Partner with DevOps and engineering teams to implement automated security scans, quality gates, severity thresholds, break-build criteria, and risk-based exception workflows.
* Administer and monitor security controls across GitHub and Azure development environments, including code scanning, secret scanning, dependency alerts, repository security settings, pipeline findings and cloud security configurations.
* Enforce branch protection, mandatory reviews, least-privilege access, environment separation, secure secrets handling and controlled promotion to production.
* Investigate scan and integration failures and retain security evidence for release governance and audit requirements. Vulnerability Management & Remediation
* Manage the end-to-end application vulnerability lifecycle: identification, validation, prioritization, assignment, remediation tracking, retesting, closure and reporting.
* Drive SLA-based remediation with development owners, escalate overdue risks, support documented risk acceptance where justified and verify fixes through rescans or retesting.
* Maintain dashboards and metrics covering vulnerability aging, severity, closure performance, recurrence, scan coverage and application risk posture. Collaboration, Governance & Continuous Improvement
* Act as the application security partner for developers, architects, QA engineers, DevOps teams, product owners, cloud teams and infrastructure teams.
* Deliver secure coding guidance, developer awareness sessions, tool onboarding and knowledge-sharing based on observed vulnerability patterns.
* Contribute to application security standards, procedures, checklists, playbooks, audit evidence and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Evaluate emerging AppSec and DevSecOps capabilities and recommend improvements that increase coverage, automation, accuracy and remediation speed.

  

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering or a related discipline or equivalent relevant experience.
* Minimum 5–8 years of hands-on cyber security experience, with strong focus on application security, DevSecOps, vulnerability management or penetration testing.

  

Required:

Strong hands-on experience implementing, configuring, operating, tuning and troubleshooting both SAST and DAST solutions in enterprise software development environments.

Hands-on experience with Invicti or a comparable enterprise DAST platform, including authenticated scanning, scan configuration, validation, tuning, reporting, troubleshooting and retesting.

* Hands-on experience integrating security scanning into GitHub pull-request workflows, Azure or equivalent cloud development environments, build systems, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Working knowledge of Azure security concepts, GitHub security capabilities, source control governance, secrets management, and secure deployment practices.
* Strong understanding of OWASP Top 10, secure SDLC, common web and API vulnerabilities, risk methodologies. rating, remediation techniques and penetration-testing
* Ability to interpret code-level findings and collaborate with developers on remediation across at least one common language or framework.
* Experience managing remediation SLAs, exceptions, evidence, dashboards, metrics, and stakeholder reporting.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and corrective actions to both engineering and non-technical stakeholders. Preferred Skills and Certifications
* Experience with additional SAST, SCA, container, API or cloud-native security tools.
* Exposure to tools and platforms such as GitHub Advanced Security, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions or equivalent technologies.
* Familiarity with threat modeling, security architecture reviews, software supply-chain security, SBOM practices, and compliance frameworks.
* Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, GWAPT, CSSLP, , CEH, Microsoft Azure Security Engineer Associate or equivalent AppSec / penetration-testing credentials.

Following receipt of a conditional offer of employment, candidates will be required to complete additional job-related screening processes as permitted or required by applicable law.

title: Software Tester
description:
**Role Summary:**

We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented ETL Senior Tester to join our growing data team. The successful candidate will be responsible for validating the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of data as it flows through our enterprise-grade Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) and Extract, Load, Transform (ELT) processes and data pipelines. This role is crucial for ensuring the reliability of our data for analytics, reporting, and critical business operations.

The ETL Tester will play a key role in designing and executing comprehensive test plans, scenarios, and cases for complex data transformations, data migrations, and data warehousing solutions. They will collaborate closely with data engineers, developers, business analysts, and other stakeholders to ensure that our data solutions meet business requirements

**Essential Responsibilities**

· Test Strategy & Planning: Analyze business, functional, and technical requirements to identify testable scenarios and clarify ambiguities in user stories and specifications. Design comprehensive test plans, test scenarios, and test cases for ETL workflows, data platforms, and reporting solutions.

· ETL Testing Execution: Execute manual and automated testing for ETL processes, data transformations, data validation, and data pipelines.

· Data Validation & Integrity: Perform thorough data validation, data comparison, and backend testing to ensure the accuracy of data transformations and mappings. Validate data mapping, transformations, aggregations, and business rules across source systems, staging layers, data warehouses, and reporting layers. Conduct data integrity checks, reconciliations, and consistency validations using advanced SQL and other data validation techniques.

· SQL Proficiency: Write and execute complex SQL queries for data validation, reconciliation, integrity checks, and to verify data transformations and business rules.

· Defect Management: Identify, log, track, and manage defects using tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps, and collaborate with developers and data engineers to resolve issues and verify fixes.

· Performance Testing: Support ETL performance testing and validate load performance against benchmarks. Analyze pipeline runtime, throughput, latency, and resource utilization.

· Documentation & Reporting: Document test execution results, defect reports, test evidence, and sign-off artifacts to support quality assurance, audits, and compliance. Communicate test results, risks, quality metrics, and recommendations clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.

· Agile Collaboration: Actively participate in Agile delivery processes, including Program Increment planning, stand-ups, sprint planning, grooming, and retrospectives, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

· Continuous Improvement: Incorporate learnings and best practices to improve the ETL testing process over time and contribute to continuous QA process improvements

**Required Experience**

· Bachelor’s degree or higher from a reputed university

· 6 to 10 years of experience in manual and automated testing, with a strong focus on ETL, data transformation, and data validation.

· Strong understanding of ETL processes, data warehousing concepts (facts, dimensions, star/snowflake schema), relational databases and PySpark scripting.

· Advanced SQL skills, including writing complex queries for data validation, reconciliation, and integrity checks (joins, aggregations, subqueries, window functions).

· Hands-on experience creating test cases, test scenarios, and executing test plans

· Experience with cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform or Azure, AWS, Dataproc or Databricks

· Experience with defect tracking tools such as Jira or Agility etc.

· Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

· Ability to work independently and collaboratively in an Agile environment

· Experience with scripting languages like Python for test automation

**Good to have**

· Healthcare industry experience

· Familiarity with healthcare data models (claims, clinical, eligibility, provider data, etc.)

· Understanding of data governance and data quality standard

title: Quality Automation Specialist
description:
Join us as a Quality Automation Specialist
  
  

* In this key role, you’ll be undertaking and enabling automated testing activities in all delivery models
* We’ll look to you to support teams to develop quality solutions and enable continuous integration and assurance of defect free deployment of customer value
* You’ll be working closely with feature teams and a variety of stakeholders, giving you great exposure to professional development opportunities
* We're offering this role at associate level

What you'll do
  
  
Joining us in a highly collaborative role, you’ll be contributing to the transformation of testing using quality processes, tools, and methodologies, significantly improving control, accuracy and integrity. You’ll make sure repeatable, constant and consistent quality is built into all phases of the idea to value lifecycle at reduced cost or reduced time to market. It’s a chance to work with colleagues at multiple levels, and with cross-domain, domain, platform and feature teams, to build in quality as an integral part of all activities.
  
  
**Additionally, You’ll Be**

* Supporting the design of automation test strategies, aligned to business or programme goals
* Actioning and evolving more predictive and intelligent testing approaches, based on automation and innovative testing products and solutions
* Collaborating to refine the scope of manual and automated testing required, the creation of automated test scripts, user documentation and artefacts
* Designing and creating a low maintenance suite of stable, re-usable automated tests, which are usable both within the product or domain and across domains and systems in an end-to-end capacity
* Applying testing and delivery standards by understanding the product development lifecycle along with mandatory, regulatory and compliance requirements

The skills you'll need
  
  
We’re looking for someone with experience of automated testing, particularly from an Agile development or CI/CD environment. You’ll be an innovative thinker who can identify opportunities and design solutions, coupled with the ability to develop complex automation code.
  
  
You’ll have a good understanding of Agile methodologies with experience of working in an Agile team, with the ability to relate everyday work to the strategic vision of the feature.
  
  
**We’ll Also Look For You To Have**

* Experience in end-to-end and automation testing using the latest tools as recommended by the enterprise tooling framework
* A background of designing, developing and implementing automation frameworks in new environments
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to management level colleagues
* Good collaboration and stakeholder management skills

title: Quality Automation Specialist
description:

* In this key role, you’ll be undertaking and enabling automated testing activities in all delivery models

What you'll do
  
  
Joining us in a highly collaborative role, you’ll be contributing to the transformation of testing using quality processes, tools, and methodologies, significantly improving control, accuracy and integrity. You’ll make sure repeatable, constant and consistent quality is built into all phases of the idea to value lifecycle at reduced cost or reduced time to market. title: Product Owner/Business Analyst (Hybrid)
description:
**About Team**
RX Global aims to create unforgettable experiences for attendees and exhibitors through organizing events. Innovation, creativity, and collaboration drive the company to offer exceptional services to clients.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Product Owner/Business Analyst is a hands on, outcome focused product role within RX’s At Show Products group within the Digital Products portfolio.
  
  
Working in close partnership with Senior Product Managers based in the UK, the Product Manager II operates within defined problem and solution spaces, contributing strong problem understanding, creative challenge, prioritisation support, and delivery phase judgement. The role focuses on execution quality, customer outcomes, implementation expertise, and facilitating learning.
  
  
Success in this role comes from caring deeply about whether products actually work for customers in live environments — and acting decisively when they don’t.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Customer & Problem Understanding**

* Build a deep, first‑hand understanding of customer needs, behaviours, and constraints in trade show usage contexts.
* Represent customer and business context within the delivery team.
* Frame problems clearly and test assumptions using both qualitative insight and quantitative data.

**Product Delivery & Execution**

* Partner with engineering, design, delivery management and data analytics to enable effective delivery within agreed scope and constraints.
* Provide sufficient context, clarity, and specification to unblock teams and sustain momentum.
* Make pragmatic trade‑offs and decisions during delivery, balancing value, feasibility, reliability, and time.

**Partnership with Senior Product Managers**

* Work closely with UK‑based Senior Product Managers as an execution partner and an SME who can constructively challenge solutions.
* Carry delivery realities, technology options, customer insight, and learning into roadmap and prioritisation discussions.
* Support the successful execution and monitoring of agreed product and technology work.

**Validation, Learning & Reliability**

* Validate product hypotheses through appropriate data, experimentation, and real‑world feedback.
* Monitor product behaviour in live show conditions, identifying reliability or adoption issues early.
* Feed learning back into iterative improvement and prioritisation cycles.

**Cross‑Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate effectively with commercial, product success, marketing, and sales teams to support adoption and operability.
* Contribute to coordinated releases and dependency management where user journeys span multiple teams.
* Lead product demos or reviews at key milestones, clearly articulating outcomes, trade‑offs, and learning.

**This Role Is**
**What This Role Is — and Is Not**

* Strongly delivery‑ and outcome‑oriented — get stuff done
* Focused on idea validation, execution quality, local leadership, and reliable value creation
* A critical, high-trust partnering role to senior product leadership
* Part of the core product team and integral to the RX India team creating impact
* Important to negotiating cross-team dependencies at the delivery level

**This Role Is NOT**

* Responsible for “what and why” at the level of commissioning new products and features
* Responsible for product vision or product strategy
* Required to invest much time beyond in backlog administration

**Requirements**
**Requirements and Backlog**

* Define and prioritise a value-based product backlog, including functional features and (with the Tech Lead) technical and compliance items
* Elicit and document business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Ensure stories are well-defined, appropriately sized, and sprint-ready
* Drive the solution within boundaries shaped by the PM — making active trade-offs on what gets built
* Elicit and define specifications for implementation with enough detail for the team to move forward

**Business Analysis**

* Identify assumptions, dependencies, edge cases, and operational impacts
* Distinguish documented fact from assumption and inference
* Create process maps and requirements documentation that are testable and traceable
* Provide clarification and handle requirements changes during sprint execution

**Communication and Stakeholder Engagement**

* Act as the primary product point of contact for the delivery team
* Facilitate the team's understanding of business context — the what and why
* Engage stakeholders to understand needs and goals, and accurately relay that input
* Keep management updated on implementation progress via sprint demos and reports
* Tailor communication to different audiences (team, PM, business stakeholders)

**Agile Delivery**

* Participate actively in planning, refinement, reviews, and retrospectives
* Support the Delivery Manager in ensuring value delivery against requirements
* Support release readiness activities (pre-release support for Product Partners)
* Support the PM in discovery activities where needed

**Analytics and Data Literacy**

* Using dashboards (Mixpanel, PowerBI) to generate simple insights and inform trade-offs
* Assessing basic data quality; connecting product work to OKRs and outcomes

**Product and Domain Knowledge**

* Become the subject matter expert (SME) - how the product works end-to-end, system connections, and business value
* Respond appropriately to live event issues with suitable urgency

**Technical Awareness**

* Broad awareness of the technical architecture and platform constraints
* Ability to speak credibly with engineers about implementation boundaries

**Nice-to-Have**
**Discovery and Research Support**

* Applying common discovery tools (interviews, jobs-to-be-done, journey mapping) to directly support the PM's discovery responsibilities
* Understanding when to seek specialist data analytics support

**Go-to-Market Awareness**

* Understanding how product features contribute to revenue, retention, and commercial value
* Awareness of how products are rolled out to business units and show teams

**Experienced Using These Tools Or Equivalent**

* Jira
* Confluence
* Mixpanel
* Miro
* Sigma

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.
  
  
**Working for you**

Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company.

**JOB PURPOSE:**

The Quality Engineer is responsible for leading the quality assurance and control functions for the wire payments and commercial payments hub platform. This role ensures robust, secure, and compliant payment processing solutions by overseeing test planning, execution, automation, and compliance with regulatory and security standards. The incumbent collaborates with product, development, and operations teams to deliver high-quality solutions supporting business objectives.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

**Testing Coordination & Execution:**

* Develop, publish, and execute test plans, test cases, traceability matrices, automation scripts, virtualization, status reports, defect and exit reports.

* Develop, publish, and execute testing estimates and manage financials related to testing activities.
* Track and report QA/QE metrics and KPIs such as velocity and defect slippage.

**Defect & Compliance Management:**

* Manage defects throughout their lifecycle, ensuring timely resolution and documentation.
* Identify, manage, and implement remediation for any noncompliance items and deviations.
* Ensure adherence to QA/QE standards and support the implementation of new standards.
* Recognize and identify areas for process, policy, or tool improvement.

**Technical Leadership:**

* Provide input, feedback, and challenge to technical designs and assess impacts to testing.
* Identify and implement automation, AI, or other emerging solutions to expedite testing and improve quality.
* Lead the adoption of automation frameworks and tools.

**CROSS-FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS:**

* Collaborates with project managers, business analysts, developers, and other stakeholders to coordinate testing activities and ensure alignment with project objectives.
* Works closely with development teams to provide feedback on technical designs and assess testing impacts.
* Interacts with external vendors and tool providers to evaluate and integrate testing solutions.
* Partners with other QA/QE professionals across the organization to share best practices and drive continuous improvement.

**COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* As an employee of CIBC, the incumbent must comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines, and controls.



**AUTHORITIES/DECISION RIGHTS:**

* As a key contributor to the business unit, this job has the authority to recommend changes to business processes in order to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness.

**JOB DIMENSIONS:**

* Responsible for the delivery of testing services for assigned projects/initiatives, supporting retail banking, mobile, web-based, UX, API, and accessibility testing.
* Provides technical and process leadership to ensure quality standards are met.
* Supports achievement of business unit goals through effective quality engineering and testing practices.

**KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:**

**Education:**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or related field.

**Experience:**

* 3+ years QA/QE experience, 1–3 years development/automation
* Banking applications, API/web services, databases, integrations

**Must have skills:**

* API testing (REST, SOAP, gRPC)
* Automation tools (Postman, Parasoft SOAtest, REST Assured, Karate)
* Programming in Python, Java, or JavaScript
* Database testing (SQL/NoSQL), ETL testing
* Service virtualization
* Version control (Git), CI/CD integration
* Test management tools (JIRA, ALM)
* QA Fundamentals is must to have skill

**Nice to have:**

* MQ, Solace, batch testing, UNIX
* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP)
* Performance testing tools (JMeter, NeoLoad)
* Security testing (OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite)
* Familiarity with microservices, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)

**The Opportunity**
Join a global biopharma company with a 130-year legacy and mission to achieve new milestones in healthcare. Be part of a technology-driven, data-led organization supporting a diversified portfolio of medicines, vaccines, and animal health products. Work alongside passionate teams that use data, analytics, and insights to drive decisions and tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats.

We are looking for Senior Specialist with strong Functional analysis, data analysis, functional testing, UAT coordination, stakeholder communication, and Scrum Master responsibilities for one or two squads. Understand business data needs and perform descriptive and investigative analysis across relevant solution-delivery phases. * Data validation, reconciliation, and data-quality assessment

title: Data Quality Engineer
description:
**Company:**
Finarb Analytics Consulting Pvt. Ltd.

**Job Title:**
Data Quality Engineer – SQL / ETL / Microsoft Fabric

**Location:**
Hyderabad or Kolkata, India

**Experience:**
3–6 Years (Suggested)

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Application Link:**
https://zurl.to/KmZM?source=CareerSite

About Finarb

Finarb Analytics Consulting is a data, analytics, and technology consulting firm helping organizations transform complex data into actionable business insights through advanced analytics, business intelligence, artificial intelligence, and modern data platforms.

**Website:**
https://www.finarb.ai

About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented, technically strong
**Data Quality Engineer**
to ensure the accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability of enterprise data across multiple platforms.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with
**SQL, data validation, ETL testing, data reconciliation, and data quality automation**
, along with a good understanding of data warehousing and modern cloud data platforms.

This role will focus on validating data flowing through SQL Server, Azure Data Factory, and Microsoft Fabric environments, with particular emphasis on ensuring data integrity during platform migration and ongoing production operations.

The successful candidate will collaborate closely with data engineers, BI developers, senior data quality professionals, and data architects to identify data discrepancies, investigate root causes, automate validation processes, and establish reliable data quality controls.

We are looking for engineers who can independently analyze complex datasets, understand transformation logic, and develop scalable, repeatable data quality testing solutions.

Key Responsibilities1. Data Quality Validation and Testing

* Develop and execute comprehensive data quality checks across enterprise data platforms.
* Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, uniqueness, and integrity.
* Perform source-to-target validation across ingestion, staging, transformation, and reporting layers.
* Identify missing records, duplicates, null values, invalid mappings, and inconsistent business calculations.
* Validate data against defined business rules and transformation specifications.
* Investigate discrepancies and collaborate with engineering teams to resolve issues.
* Develop reusable test cases and maintain data quality documentation.

2. SQL-Based Data Testing and Reconciliation

* Develop complex SQL queries to validate data across source and target systems.
* Perform record-count reconciliation, aggregate reconciliation, and detailed field-level comparisons.
* Validate joins, transformations, aggregations, and business calculations.
* Test stored procedures, SQL transformations, views, and data warehouse tables.
* Analyze large datasets to identify inconsistencies and anomalies.
* Investigate root causes of data mismatches and document findings.
* Optimize validation queries for performance and scalability.

3. ETL / ELT Pipeline Testing

* Test data ingestion and transformation pipelines built using Azure Data Factory and Microsoft Fabric.
* Validate pipeline execution results, data transformations, and target data structures.
* Verify incremental loads, full loads, upserts, and change data capture processes.
* Test data handling for missing values, duplicate records, invalid formats, and unexpected source changes.
* Validate pipeline error handling, retry mechanisms, and exception processing.
* Perform regression testing following ETL enhancements and production releases.
* Collaborate with data engineers to investigate and resolve pipeline-related data issues.

4. Microsoft Fabric Migration Validation

* Support data quality assurance during migration from SQL Server and Azure Data Factory to Microsoft Fabric.
* Develop source-to-target reconciliation processes for migrated datasets.
* Validate data transformations across Fabric Lakehouse, Warehouse, and data pipelines.
* Perform row-count, checksum, aggregate, and field-level reconciliation where appropriate.
* Verify historical data completeness and incremental data consistency.
* Identify discrepancies between legacy and Fabric-based processing.
* Support parallel-run validation and post-migration stabilization.
* Maintain migration validation reports and evidence of data quality checks.

5. Data Quality Automation

* Develop reusable SQL-based validation scripts and automated reconciliation processes.
* Build automated data quality checks using Python, SQL, or other appropriate tools.
* Integrate validation processes into ETL/ELT workflows where applicable.
* Automate recurring checks for data completeness, uniqueness, referential integrity, and business rule compliance.
* Implement exception reporting and automated identification of data quality failures.
* Support continuous improvement of testing efficiency and coverage.
* Reduce manual validation effort through repeatable and maintainable testing frameworks.

6. Production Data Quality Monitoring

* Monitor data quality across production data pipelines and reporting datasets.
* Investigate data-related incidents reported by business users or BI teams.
* Perform root cause analysis for recurring data quality defects.
* Track data quality issues and coordinate resolution with engineering teams.
* Validate corrective fixes and perform regression testing.
* Support production release validation and ongoing operational checks.
* Maintain traceability of data quality defects and their resolutions.

7. Collaboration and Documentation

* Work closely with data engineers, Power BI developers, and data architects.
* Understand business rules, data transformations, and reporting requirements.
* Translate data specifications into comprehensive validation scenarios.
* Document test cases, reconciliation logic, test results, and identified defects.
* Participate in requirement reviews, technical discussions, and defect triage.
* Contribute to establishing standardized data quality processes and best practices.

Required Technical Skills

Technology / SkillExpected ProficiencySQL / T-SQLAdvanced querying and validationData Quality TestingAccuracy, completeness, consistency, uniquenessETL / ELT TestingSource-to-target and transformation validationData ReconciliationRecord-level, aggregate, and field-level comparisonsSQL ServerStrong hands-on experienceData WarehousingFact/dimension tables and transformation logicAzure Data FactoryUnderstanding of pipelines and data flowsData Quality AutomationSQL scripts and automated validationDefect InvestigationRoot cause analysis and issue trackingMicrosoft FabricBasic knowledge or practical exposure

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 3–6 years of experience in data quality engineering, ETL testing, data validation, or data warehouse testing.
* Strong hands-on SQL skills, including complex joins, CTEs, aggregations, window functions, and subqueries.
* Proven experience performing source-to-target data validation and reconciliation.
* Experience testing ETL/ELT pipelines and complex data transformations.
* Good understanding of relational databases and data warehousing concepts.
* Experience identifying data discrepancies and independently investigating root causes.
* Familiarity with SQL Server and Azure-based data environments.
* Experience developing and maintaining test cases, validation scripts, and defect reports.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills

* Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, and Fabric Data Factory.
* Knowledge of Python or PySpark for automated data validation.
* Familiarity with data quality frameworks such as Great Expectations, Soda, or equivalent tools.
* Experience with Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2.
* Understanding of Delta Lake and medallion architecture.
* Experience validating large-scale cloud data migration projects.
* Familiarity with Power BI reports and semantic model validation.
* Knowledge of Git, Azure DevOps, and CI/CD processes.
* Exposure to data profiling, data observability, and data governance concepts.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Purview or equivalent metadata management tools.

Key Competencies

* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Ability to independently investigate complex data discrepancies.
* Strong understanding of business rules and transformation logic.
* Ability to communicate technical defects clearly and effectively.
* Collaborative approach to working with engineering and BI teams.
* Ownership of testing deliverables and data quality outcomes.
* Ability to manage multiple testing priorities in a dynamic environment.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will be expected to:

1. Ensure high levels of data accuracy, completeness, and consistency across enterprise datasets.
2. Identify and resolve data quality issues before they impact downstream reporting.
3. Develop reusable SQL-based reconciliation and validation processes.
4. Automate recurring data quality checks to improve testing efficiency.
5. Validate data integrity throughout Microsoft Fabric migration activities.
6. Reduce production data discrepancies and recurring data quality defects.
7. Maintain clear documentation and traceability of data quality testing.
8. Contribute to establishing reliable, scalable data quality practices across the organization.

Why Join Finarb?

* Work on enterprise-scale data engineering and analytics initiatives.
* Gain exposure to Microsoft Fabric and modern cloud data platforms.
* Participate in complex data migration and modernization programs.
* Collaborate with experienced data engineers, architects, and BI professionals.
* Develop expertise in data quality automation and advanced data validation.
* Contribute to delivering reliable and trusted enterprise data solutions.

**Roche India - Roche Services & Solutions**
**Hyderabad**

Roche is a stable and innovative biotechnological company offering exceptional career paths and great benefits for fresh graduates and outstanding professionals. We are continuously expanding, looking for new talents to join our transforming Roche Services & Solutions Center. We offer a flexible working framework (2 office days/week on average).
  
  
The Global Digital Hub growing business line within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Content Creation, and Creative Design.
  
  
**Position Summary**
As a
**Medical Copy Quality Assurance Specialist**
in the growing medical copy and content team within Roche Services & Solutions, you will play a crucial role in reviewing and editing various forms of content, such as articles, blog posts, social media posts, website content, and promotional materials related to medical and healthcare topics. This specialized team focuses on generating commercial content intended for various digital formats (emails, videos, banners, infographics, websites, etc.). Their work plays a crucial role in supporting the communication strategies developed by Roche's global and local business teams.
  
  
**Your Opportunity:**
We are seeking a meticulous and detail-oriented Medical Copy Quality Assurance (QA) Specialist to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and compliance of digital medical / scientific materials designed for the US market. The primary responsibility of this role is to conduct comprehensive quality checks (QC) for various digital materials such as emails, banners, and advertisements, with a focus on medical and scientific accuracy. This position demands a keen eye for detail and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to maintain the highest standard of quality.
  
  
Day-to-Day Role Description:
  
  

* Review and QC of Medical/Scientific Digital Materials:

+ Examine emails, banners, ads, and other digital assets, checking:

- Foundational quality and fit to brief
- Language use, style, spelling, grammar, formatting, etc
- Scientific and medical accuracy
- Consistency with brand guidelines and technical specifications

* Collaborate with Teams:

+ Work closely with writers, designers, and project managers to address feedback and implement revisions
+ Provide constructive feedback to enhance the accuracy and quality of deliverables

* Maintain Documentation:

+ Keep thorough records of QC findings and suggestions
+ Track revisions and document outcomes for continuous improvement

Step-by-Step Checklist for Medical/Scientific QC of Digital Materials:
  
  

* Check the Accuracy of Content:

+ Verify that all scientific and medical claims are evidence-based and supported by reliable sources
+ Confirm that the content aligns with current medical guidelines and applicable regulatory standards

* Conduct a Thorough Language Check:

+ Review for grammar, punctuation, and spelling errors
+ Ensure clarity, conciseness, and readability, tailoring the language to the target audience

* Verify Consistency:

+ Confirm that terminology, branding, and tone are consistent throughout the material
+ Ensure completeness of all text elements, e.g., footnotes, references, abbreviations, special formatting, etc
+ Cross-check for any conflicting information
+ Check for copy formatting/layout issues

* Validate Visual Elements:

+ Review images, charts, or graphics for scientific accuracy and appropriate usage
+ Ensure visual elements enhance the overall message without introducing errors

* Check Compliance:

+ Ensure compliance with US regulations, industry standards, and client-specific guidelines
+ Flag any material that requires further legal or medical review

* Perform Final Review:

+ Reassess the material after all changes have been implemented
+ Give final approval, ensuring it is error-free and ready for distribution

**Who You Are**
We are looking for knowledgeable individuals who are highly involved and passionate about writing and language!
  
  

* 2-3 years of experience in similar position
* Strong medical or science background
* A higher degree in life sciences is highly preferred, but candidates with other relevant experience will also be considered
* Minimum C2 level proficiency in English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Proven experience in quality control processes, particularly in reviewing medical or scientific content
* Collaborative attitude - working effectively across our diverse resources and business stakeholders
* Ability to work within a team and in different time zones
* Excellent attention to detail, consistency, clarity, and scientific rigor
* Customer-service mentality & can-do attitude
* Experience with the standard IT applications, preferably including Google suite
* Continuous improvement and growth mindset
* Ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment, ability to prioritize tasks

Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
  
  
**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

title: JD-SDET-Test-Automation
description: Role Overview We are looking for a hands-on Software Development Engineer in Test who is technically strong in Selenium with Java, REST Assured, and Postman, and very strong across UI testing, API testing, and database testing. These skills are the foundation of this role and you will use them every day to build automation frameworks, validate services and data end to end, and keep our regression suites stable and trustworthy. Depth in these areas is essential. This is not a role where they can be picked up on the job. You are a strong software engineer first and a tester second. You will design and own Selenium WebDriver frameworks in Java, automate REST and SOAP APIs with REST Assured and Postman, and validate data directly in relational databases using SQL. You will work closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, and client teams, so clear communication and genuine collaboration matter as much as technical depth. You will own work across the full quality lifecycle: test strategy, framework design, functional and regression automation, API and database testing, CI/CD integration, test data management, defect triage, and production quality monitoring. This is a coding role, not a manual testing or test management-only role.Key Responsibilities UI Testing Design, build, and maintain scalable UI automation frameworks using Selenium WebDriver with Java, applying the Page Object Model, TestNG or JUnit, data-driven design, and reusable utilities. Build and maintain Playwright test suites for web, cross-browser, and end-to-end regression coverage, using fixtures, auto-waiting, and parallel execution, and support teams whose products are automated in Playwright. Write stable UI tests in both Selenium and Playwright with resilient locator strategies, proper waits and synchronization, parallel execution on Selenium Grid and Playwright workers, and clear failure evidence such as screenshots, logs, and traces. API Testing Build and maintain API automation for REST services using REST Assured with Java, covering positive, negative, and boundary scenarios, authentication and authorization, request chaining, and JSON schema validation. Use Postman for exploratory API testing, collection design, environment and variable management, and automated collection runs with Newman in CI, and test SOAP services where required. Validate status codes, headers, payloads, and error handling, and confirm that API responses match the data stored in the database. Database Testing Write and run SQL to validate data integrity, constraints, referential integrity, stored procedures, triggers, and views across relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, or PostgreSQL. Validate data migrations, ETL jobs, and batch processes by reconciling source and target data, and build automated backend data checks into the regression suites. Create and manage test data through SQL scripts and APIs, including setup, teardown, and masking of sensitive data. Engineering and Quality Ownership Integrate UI, API, and database test suites into CI/CD pipelines with parallel execution and consolidated reporting. Define the test strategy for new features, covering risk analysis, coverage targets, test data strategy, and entry and exit criteria. Perform code reviews for both application code and test code, and advocate for testability in design and architecture discussions. Investigate failures, trace each defect to the layer where it originates (UI, API, or database), and drive it to closure with clear, reproducible reporting and evidence. Track and publish quality metrics such as automation coverage, flakiness, escaped defects, and mean time to detection, and act on the trends. Collaboration and Communication Work closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, and client stakeholders in Agile ceremonies to clarify requirements, raise risks early, and agree on acceptance criteria. Communicate test progress, quality risks, and release readiness clearly to both technical and business audiences. Share automation practices and coding standards with the wider QA team and mentor less experienced engineers. Required Qualifications These are essential. Candidates must be strong in all of the following to succeed in this role. 5+ years of professional experience in software testing, with at least 2 years in a hands-on SDET or test automation engineering role. Very strong Java programming skills, including object-oriented design, collections, and exception handling, with a track record of writing clean, maintainable, production-quality test code. Very strong hands-on experience with Selenium WebDriver and Java, including building frameworks from scratch with the Page Object Model, TestNG or JUnit, and Maven or Gradle, and handling waits, iframes, multiple windows, and dynamic elements. Very strong hands-on experience with REST Assured, including request and response specifications, authentication (OAuth, JWT, API keys), serialization and deserialization of payloads, and JSON schema validation. Very strong hands-on experience with Postman, including collections, environments and variables, pre-request and test scripts, and running collections with Newman. Deep understanding of API testing concepts: HTTP methods, status codes, headers, REST principles, contract validation, and testing of SOAP services. Very strong SQL and database testing skills, including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and window functions, and validating data integrity, stored procedures, and data migrations across Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, or PostgreSQL. Proven ability to validate end-to-end business flows across the UI, API, and database layers.Experience with CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps. Proficiency with Git, branching strategies, and code review practices, plus strong software engineering fundamentals. Strong collaboration skills, with experience working closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, and client teams in an Agile environment. Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain quality risk clearly to both engineers and business stakeholders. Nice to Have Experience with Playwright for UI or API automation, and comfort supporting teams that use it. Exposure to Mabl or other low-code UI automation tools. Experience testing Pega applications (Pega Platform 8.x or Pega Infinity), including automating dynamic Pega UI. Performance testing experience with JMeter, NeoLoad, or LoadRunner. BDD framework experience with Cucumber. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP). Test management and reporting tooling: Jira, Zephyr, Xray, Allure, or ReportPortal. Contract testing with Pact, accessibility testing (WCAG 2.1 AA), and security testing fundamentals with OWASP awareness. Background in a regulated domain such as banking, financial services, insurance, or healthcare. Familiarity with AI-assisted testing tools, such as AI-driven test case generation or self-healing locators. Ideal Candidate Profile You are a hands-on automation engineer who writes clean Java code, thinks in terms of risk rather than test counts, and is equally comfortable debugging a flaky Selenium locator, a failing REST Assured test, and a data mismatch in a SQL query. You troubleshoot independently, communicate clearly, and build strong working relationships with developers, architects, product owners, and client teams.

title: SDET – AI Tools & Test Automation
description: Anthrobyte wins by putting AI agents into the real operations of enterprise clients — and making them work, in production, where it matters. Production is only trusted when it has been proven. We need an engineer who can prove it: someone who tests AI systems the way they actually behave, not the way a demo suggests, and who builds the tooling that lets the whole team do the same. This is a build-from-the-front role. You test inside the problem, against the client’s real data and constraints, not from a checklist. What you’ll own Quality for AI in production. You decide what “good enough to ship” means for systems that don’t behave the same way twice. Evaluation sets, regression suites, hallucination and guardrail checks — you design them, run them, and defend the results. Performance and benchmarking. You build repeatable benchmarks for latency, throughput, and retrieval quality across pipelines, vector search, and agent workflows — and you explain why the numbers moved. Quality gates in the pipeline. You embed automated tests into CI/CD so nothing reaches a client’s live operations without passing them. The gate is yours, and so is the call when it should stay shut. The product loop. You turn what you learn in the field into reusable test frameworks, benchmarks, and standards inside AATLAS — so every engagement makes the next one faster and safer, and we compound into a product, not a services treadmill. Raising the standard. This is the multiplier. You mentor engineers in test automation and performance practice, and codify how we test into a playbook others can run without you. Success is a team that tests the way you do, not you testing everything. Client trust. You present benchmark and quality findings to engineering leads, client security, and business stakeholders — in architecture reviews, security reviews, and the room where decisions get made — and you hold your position when the answer is “not ready yet.” RequirementsWhat we’re looking for Production track record. 7–10 years in software testing, at least 5 of them as an SDET or automation engineer. You’ve built test frameworks from scratch and lived with what you shipped. Core automation, with depth. Expert in Python and Pytest — framework design, fixtures, parametrization, reporting — and in Postman, with API suites automated in CI. Production experience in at least one UI framework: Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium. Performance engineering. Hands-on with Locust, Gatling, k6, or JMeter, and able to interpret results rather than just generate them. Delivery plumbing. CI/CD in GitLab, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps. Docker. At least one cloud platform (AWS or Azure). Backend and database testing. Range. You’re equally comfortable writing code, designing a test strategy, and explaining a failure to a non-technical stakeholder. Systems mindset. You think in reliability, not test counts. Enterprise AI is won on auditability and things that keep working.Bonus points Experience testing ML and LLM systems, RAG pipelines, vector databases, embeddings, or MCP-based agent workflows. Familiarity with LLM evaluation approaches and tooling. A second UI framework, Jest, or BDD tooling (SpecFlow, pytest-bdd, behave). Accessibility and security testing (axe, OWASP ZAP). Experience in regulated or enterprise environments such as finance, healthcare, or telecom. A track record of growing junior engineers into independent operators. What this role is not A manual tester working from scripts. A pure automation engineer who runs suites someone else designed. A researcher who benchmarks in isolation and never sees a client’s reality. If you want to test from a distance rather than from inside the problem, this isn’t it. How we work Small, high-trust, founder-close team. Governance-first, because our work runs inside clients’ live operations. You’ll have real authority over what “ready” means, and the mandate to build the testing capability we’ll become known for. How to apply Tell us two stories. First: a system you tested or benchmarked where the numbers surprised you, what you built to find out, and what you did when the answer was uncomfortable.Second: a release you heldback, or a standard you set, that others pushed against, and how it played out. Those two stories tell us more than any CV.

* Experience in project business sector preferred
* Knowledge of ERP systems and MES preferred

title: E Trading Quality Assurance Lead - Assistant Vice President
description:
Citi is looking for an experienced e-Trading Technology Quality Assurance (QA) Senior Analyst to play a pivotal role in safeguarding the integrity of electronic trading platforms within a high-velocity, globally connected Capital Markets technology environment. In this role, you will own quality assurance across the full testing lifecycle — from UAT strategy through to production rollout — directly influencing the reliability and regulatory compliance of trading systems used at scale. You will operate as a senior quality leader, mentoring colleagues, shaping testing standards, and coordinating across global technology and business teams to drive consistent, measurable quality outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end quality assurance across UAT and production rollout cycles for electronic trading platforms, including validation of Futures and Options products, algorithmic Trading and Execution Platform, and electronic order management workflows.
* Design, execute, and maintain automated test suites using Java and Cucumber within a Behavior-Driven Development framework, ensuring test coverage aligns with system and regulatory requirements.
* Define and enforce quality standards and testing procedures across the software development lifecycle, conducting annual reviews and recommending improvements to keep practices current and effective.
* Monitor products and processes for conformance to established standards, identify quality risks, perform root cause analysis, and deliver clearly documented remediation recommendations.
* Validate system behavior against FIX protocol specifications and electronic trading regulatory obligations, ensuring trading platform outputs meet both technical and compliance benchmarks.
* Act as a quality advisor and mentor to junior team members, providing guidance on testing approaches, standards adherence, and professional development within IT Quality.
* Assess quality-related risks in business and technology decisions, escalating control issues transparently and ensuring all corrective actions are assigned, tracked, and resolved to completion.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* 9-13 years experience in an IT Quality or software quality assurance role, with demonstrated ownership across the full testing lifecycle from test strategy through to production validation.
* Must - Hands-on experience testing electronic trading platforms, including a solid working knowledge of Futures and Options products, Capital Markets and Derivatives domains, order types, and electronic trading processes.
* Must - Demonstrated experience testing e-Trading lifecycles and workflows as well experience of trading algorithms such as TWAP, VWAP, Iceberg etc. with the ability to validate algorithmic behavior against defined specifications.
* Proficiency in test automation using Java and Cucumber within a BDD Behavior-Driven Development framework, including the ability to write, modify, and execute complex automated test scripts independently.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, container environments such as ECS, and version control using GitHub, enabling effective integration of quality practices into modern delivery workflows.
* Good understanding of the FIX protocol and regulatory obligations for electronic trading, with the ability to validate system behavior against these standards in a structured and auditable way.
* Strong stakeholder communication and coordination skills, with the ability to align project teams, vendors, and global counterparts on quality outcomes across complex, multi-geography programs.

**Beneficial Skills & Qualifications**

* Project management experience in a fast-paced, time-to-market driven technology environment, with the ability to manage quality workstreams across concurrent deliverables.
* Experience contributing to the development of new testing standards and procedures in collaboration with cross-functional technology teams.
* Familiarity with process audit methodologies and the ability to conduct structured product evaluation and conformance assessments.

description:
At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!
  
  
Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.
  
  
**Job Description**
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
**Requirements Engineering**

* Elicit, document and maintain URS and FRS for each platform module, using structured workshops, process walkthroughs, system demonstrations and review of current SOPs, work instructions and conventions.
* Produce the supporting artefacts: as-is and to-be process maps, data-flow diagrams, user stories with acceptance criteria, business rules, data dictionaries, interface specifications and non-functional requirements (performance, availability, security, auditability, data retention).
* Build and maintain the Requirements Traceability Matrix from URS to FRS to design, test cases and validation evidence, so every requirement can be implemented and tested.
* Run requirement reviews with PV operations, Quality, IT Security, Data Privacy and Engineering; manage change control on approved requirements.
* Prioritize with the Product Owner, write release-level scope statements and support sprint planning and backlog refinement.

**Domain coverage**
You will specify requirements across the following modules, working with the respective PV subject-matter experts:
  
  

* Global and local literature search strategy management, database connectors (MEDLINE/PubMed, Embase and others), de-duplication, AI-assisted relevance screening and ICSR identification, full-text handling, reviewer workflow, hit-level audit trail, reconciliation and KPIs; alignment with GVP Module VI and local literature requirements.
* Multi-channel intake (email, portal, call centre, partner feeds, literature, social media), duplicate detection, AI-assisted data extraction from unstructured sources, MedDRA and WHODrug coding support, seriousness and expectedness assessment, narrative generation with human review, E2B(R3) submission, follow-up management, and integration with safety databases (e.g. Argus, LifeSphere, Veeva Vault Safety).
* Data sources (safety database, EudraVigilance, FAERS, literature), disproportionality and signal detection methods, signal validation, prioritisation, assessment and tracking workflows, signal-to-risk linkage, and documentation aligned to GVP Module IX.
* Data retrieval and reconciliation, line listings and summary tabulations, AI-assisted section drafting with locked source-to-text traceability, author and reviewer workflow, version control, schedule and submission tracking, aligned to 21 CFR 314.80 and ICH E2C(R2).
* Source and channel configuration, listening rules, AI classification of posts for potential adverse events, identifiability and validity criteria, PII handling, reviewer workflow and conversion to case intake, aligned to GVP Module VI and FDA guidance on internet and social media.
* PSMF support, audit-trail reporting and query, compliance dashboards (timeliness, quality, backlog), deviation and CAPA linkage, document and training evidence retrieval, and the ability to reproduce any AI-assisted decision on request.

**Agentic AI specifics**

* Define, for every agent in the platform, its role, inputs, tools, permitted actions and decision authority, and the human-in-the-loop checkpoints where a qualified person must review, approve or override.
* Specify AI output acceptance criteria with the SMEs: target precision and recall for screening and classification tasks, confidence thresholds for auto-routing versus human review, and how performance is measured and monitored in production.
* Write requirements for explainability and auditability of AI decisions: rationale capture, source citation, prompt and model version logging, reproducibility, and retention of the evidence an inspector would ask for.
* Specify guardrails: what agents must never do without human approval (e.g. submit an ICSR, close a signal, finalise a report), handling of low-confidence or out-of-distribution inputs, and fallback behaviour when a model or tool is unavailable.
* Define requirements for model lifecycle governance: evaluation datasets, change control for prompts and models, regression testing, periodic review, and restrictions on use of client data for model training.

**Regulatory, quality and privacy compliance**

* Translate the following into explicit, testable requirements and work with Quality on validation strategy:

+ 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11: electronic records, electronic signatures, audit trails, access control, data integrity (ALCOA+), system security, record retention and retrieval.
+ GDPR and other applicable data-protection laws: lawful basis, data minimisation, pseudonymisation, data-subject rights, cross-border transfer, retention and deletion, privacy by design; support Data Protection Impact Assessments.
+ GVP Modules (notably I, II, IV, VI, VII, IX) and ICH E2B(R3), E2C(R2), E2D, E2E as they apply to each module.
+ Computerised system validation: GAMP 5 (second edition), risk-based and Computer Software Assurance approaches; author or contribute to validation plans, functional risk assessments, test strategies and traceability.

description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

Citi is looking for an experienced e-Trading Technology Quality Assurance (QA) Senior Analyst to play a pivotal role in safeguarding the integrity of electronic trading platforms within a high-velocity, globally connected Capital Markets technology environment. In this role, you will own quality assurance across the full testing lifecycle — from UAT strategy through to production rollout — directly influencing the reliability and regulatory compliance of trading systems used at scale. You will operate as a senior quality leader, mentoring colleagues, shaping testing standards, and coordinating across global technology and business teams to drive consistent, measurable quality outcomes.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end quality assurance across UAT and production rollout cycles for electronic trading platforms, including validation of Futures and Options products, algorithmic Trading and Execution Platform, and electronic order management workflows.
