title: Test Manager
description:
**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for an Individual Functional Test Manager to lead functional test delivery across assigned projects, workstreams, or client implementations. This is a hands-on functional test leadership role focused on test strategy, planning, execution oversight, quality governance, risk management, and release readiness.

You will define and execute the functional test approach for your allocated scope, ensuring test coverage, traceability, defect management, evidence, reporting, and sign-off are delivered in line with FNZ SDLC and project delivery expectations. You will work closely with Project Managers, Delivery Managers, Solution Consultants, Analyst Testers, IAbout the Rolenfrastructure, Release Management, and client stakeholders to ensure high-quality outcomes.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

As an Individual Functional Test Manager, you will take ownership of functional test delivery for your assigned project or workstream, ensuring testing is planned, executed, evidenced, governed, and reported to the required quality standards.

* Define and own the functional test strategy and test approach for assigned projects, workstreams, or client implementations.
* Lead functional test planning, estimation, scope definition, prioritization, and execution oversight in line with the SDLC.
* Ensure testing artefacts such as test plans, scenarios, cases, execution evidence, defect updates, traceability, and closure reports are produced to agreed standards.
* Manage functional testing risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, blockers, and residual quality risks for your allocated scope.
* Provide clear, timely, and metrics-driven reporting on test progress, execution status, defect trends, coverage, quality gates, and release readiness.
* Engage with project, delivery, client, and internal stakeholders to agree the QA engagement model, test scope, entry and exit criteria, dependencies, and execution approach.
* Support defect triage and issue resolution through evidence-based analysis, impact assessment, and recommended actions.
* Coordinate functional testing sign-off readiness by validating scope coverage, execution results, defect position, residual risks, and exit criteria.
* Ensure required test environments, test data, and access needs are identified, requested, and available in line with execution timelines.
* Assess testing impact of change requests and ensure functional test plans, estimates, scope, and evidence are updated through change management.
* Maintain strong test governance through quality gates, functional test metrics, progress reporting, and stakeholder visibility.
* Drive continuous improvement within your functional test scope to improve test coverage, execution discipline, defect prevention, and delivery predictability.
* Provide day-to-day functional test directions to Analyst Testers and project contributors without direct line-management responsibility.
* Coach and support project team members on test design, coverage, traceability, evidence quality, defect management, and risk-based prioritization.
* Capture and share functional testing knowledge, key decisions, assumptions, lessons learned, and recommendations with relevant stakeholders.

What You’ll Bring

We are looking for a career testing professional with strong functional test delivery experience, excellent stakeholder management skills, and the ability to operate effectively in fast-paced client-facing delivery environments.

* Strong hands-on functional testing experience across test planning, scenario design, execution, defect management, evidence review, and test closure.
* Experience working in client-facing test delivery or engagement roles, preferably within Financial Services.
* Ability to manage functional test activities under pressure and deliver to strict deadlines.
* Experience working in fast-paced Agile delivery environments.
* Experience working with distributed teams across onshore, nearshore, and offshore locations.
* Deep understanding of functional test metrics, coverage, defect trends, KPIs, SLAs, quality gates, and release readiness reporting.
* Strong experience using Jira and Xray for test management, defect tracking, reporting, and traceability.
* Ability to articulate complex information in a clear, concise, and stakeholder-friendly way.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint for reporting, analysis, and stakeholder communication.
* Ability to prioritize your own workload and coordinate functional test activities across contributors without direct line-management responsibility.
* Strong ownership of personal deliverables, functional test outcomes, and project quality commitments.
* Collaborative working style with the ability to build trusted relationships and influence delivery teams.
* Proactive mindset with the ability to identify improvements to current processes and testing practices.
* Adaptability to move between projects and become productive quickly.
* Commitment to continuous improvement and measurable quality outcomes.

Preferred certification: ISTQB Advanced Test Manager Certification or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Industry Knowledge

* Experience with investment, wealth, life, and/or pensions products and the markets in which FNZ and its customers operate.
* Strong understanding of the regulatory environment relevant to FNZ and its clients.
* Knowledge of the FNZ platform across key functional areas is highly desirable.

**About FNZ**
-------------

FNZ is a global FinTech firm transforming the way financial institutions serve their wealth management customers. We partner with banks, insurers, and asset managers to help people achieve their financial goals through our unique combination of technology leadership, innovation, and asset servicing.

Our services enable clients to provide best-in-class wealth management solutions to financial advisers, end-investors, and the workplace. We create solutions that are flexible, transparent, and scalable, reflecting the latest market demographic, and regulatory trends worldwide.

FNZ has experienced exceptional growth over the past decade, both in assets under administration and through the substantial expansion of our international footprint.

Today, FNZ is responsible for over £1.5 trillion in assets under administration, held by around 20 million customers of some of the world’s largest financial institutions, including Aviva, Barclays, BNZ, Generali, HSBC, Lloyds Banking Group, National Australia Bank, Quilter, Santander, UOB, Vanguard, and Zurich.

*About FNZ*

*FNZ is committed to opening up wealth so that everyone, everywhere can invest in their future on their terms. We know the foundation to do that already exists in the wealth management industry, but complexity holds firms back.*

*We created wealth’s growth platform to help. We provide a global, end-to-end wealth management platform that integrates modern technology with business and investment operations. All in a regulated financial institution.*

*We partner with the world’s leading financial institutions, with over US$2.5 trillion in assets on platform (AoP).*  
  
*Together with our clients, we empower nearly 30 million people across all wealth segments to invest in their future.*

We are looking for an R&D Technical Lead to lead software development and R&D activities for ETAP Real-Time products. You will work closely with global R&D, Product Management, QA/Testing, and Project Engineering teams to develop innovative solutions, improve product quality, and address evolving market and customer requirements. * Lead and coordinate R&D and product development activities, providing technical guidance, reviewing solutions, mentoring developers, and resolving technical challenges.

* Evaluate new technologies, communication protocols, and market requirements; develop proofs of concept (PoCs) and contribute to product performance, reliability, scalability, and usability improvements.
* Collaborate with global R&D, Product Management, QA/Testing, and Project Engineering teams on technical reviews, release planning, product demonstrations, troubleshooting, and technical documentation.

**Essential Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Instrumentation, or a related technical field.
* Typically 3–6 years of relevant experience in software development, R&D, or engineering software, preferably involving SCADA, real-time systems, industrial automation, or power-system applications.
* Strong programming knowledge in C#, .NET, or .NET Framework; experience with software design, debugging, performance analysis, and system integration.
* Working knowledge of databases and development tools, including SQL, PostgreSQL or SQL Server, REST APIs, Git, and Visual Studio.
* Experience coordinating technical activities or guiding development teams, with good problem-solving, planning, communication, and team coordination skills.

**Desired Skills And Competencies**

* Knowledge of SCADA, EMS, DMS, OMS, ADMS, FEP, FLISR, real-time monitoring, HMI, alarms, events, trends, and historical data.
* Familiarity with industrial communication protocols such as OPC UA/DA, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3, Modbus, and IEC 61850, along with power-system operation and protection fundamentals.
* Experience with V&V, product testing, Jira and Incident Report management, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and release coordination; knowledge of C++, Java, Python, Node.js, MongoDB, or AI/ML concepts is an advantage.
* Demonstrates technical leadership, curiosity, and a continuous-improvement mindset, with a strong focus on innovation, customer impact, accountability, and collaboration across local and global teams.

**ETAP requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.**
**ETAP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business.**
**Come and join ETAP to create the transformative technology that enables our customers to engineer a better world.**

title: Quality Control (QC) – Culling Expert
description:
At Aftershoot, we’re building a global community of photographers who spend less time behind their screens and more time behind the lens. Every feature we create, every update we ship, is designed to make post-processing easier, faster, and smarter for photographers around the world.
  
  
From culling to editing to retouching. Our AI tools do all the heavy lifting, so photographers can focus on what they do best: capturing moments, telling stories, and creating magic.
  
  
We’re a fast-growing, passionate team backed over 100K+ active users globally. Double-digit ARR in less than 4 years, amazing investors and team who truly believe in our mission.

If you care deeply about building meaningful products, working with curious and driven teammates, and being part of a team that genuinely loves what they do, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
Let’s create the future of AI in photography, together.
  
  
**About The Role**
This role focuses on
**quality, critique, and real-world photography workflows**
.
  
  
As a QC, you will review labelled data and AI outputs inside the Aftershoot app, evaluating them from a photographer’s perspective. You’ll help identify gaps between what photographers expect and what the product currently delivers.
  
  
If you’ve used multiple photography tools and enjoy giving thoughtful, structured feedback on image selections and product behaviour, this role is for you.
  
  
**💼 What you’ll do:**

* Perform quality checks on labelled datasets and flag errors or inconsistencies
* Review AI culling outputs within the Aftershoot app
* Critique selections from a photographer’s point of view
* Identify edge cases, failure patterns, and quality gaps
* Provide clear, actionable feedback to improve labelling standards
* Share suggestions to improve product behaviour and culling logic
* Collaborate with ML and Product teams to align outputs with real photographer workflows

* Professional photography experience or deep hands-on usage of photography tools
* Strong understanding of real-world photography workflows
* Experience using other culling or editing tools (Lightroom, Photo Mechanic, etc.)
* Ability to critique image selections and explain why something works or doesn’t
* Strong attention to detail and structured thinking
* Comfort working from the Delhi office on a full time basis

**What happens after you apply?**

* Step 1: If your profile aligns with our vibe and requirements for the role, our people team will reach out to you for a brief phone call.
* Step 2: If everything aligns, your next chat will be with one of your future team members to better understand the role and your experience.
* Step 3: You will then be given a task - this helps us evaluate your thought process and help you showcase your expertise.
* Step 4: If everything goes well, you will meet the leadership for a quick bar-raiser round.
* Step 5: If you do manage to clear all rounds, this is the point we make an offer, shake hands, and welcome you to the team.

title: Product Analyst Intern
description:
**About the Role**

We are rebuilding a large enterprise operations platform. The Product Analyst Intern will work closely with the Product Manager across documentation, requirement analysis and internal research through the specification and validation phase.

The work is mostly about understanding how a complex process works, writing it down clearly, and spotting where the existing documentation is incomplete or contradicts itself. Good fit for someone who reads carefully, writes cleanly and likes getting to the bottom of how something actually works.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Documentation**

• Draft and maintain product documentation — process flows, requirement breakdowns, configuration guides, release and change notes

• Convert workshop discussions and stakeholder inputs into structured written requirements

• Keep the document set current and version-controlled as decisions change

**Requirement analysis**

• Review business requirement documents for gaps, contradictions and outdated references; maintain an open-items register with proposed resolutions

• Map existing process rules and workflows and identify where they diverge from the documented standard

• Prepare test scenarios and validation checklists from existing specifications

**Internal research**

• Work with operations and client-facing teams to understand how the current process actually runs, and write up the findings

• Trace how specific cases and exceptions are handled today to surface undocumented behaviour
**Analysis**

• Work with operational datasets and configuration workbooks to reconcile inconsistencies and support requirement decisions with evidence

**Support to the Product Manager**

• Day-to-day BAU — meeting notes and action tracking, stakeholder follow-ups, status updates, query logs and quick turnaround asks

**Required skills**

• Strong written communication — able to explain a complex process simply and precisely

• Strong reading comprehension for long business documents

• Structured thinking and high attention to detail

• Working knowledge of Excel and comfort with documentation tools (Word, Confluence or similar) • Pursuing or recently completed a degree in engineering, business, economics, statistics or a related field

**Good to Have**

• Python (pandas) or SQL for basic data work

• Exposure to business process documentation, workflow tools or rule-based systems

• Familiarity with a high-volume operations or compliance environment

**What you will get**

• Direct exposure to how a large enterprise product is specified, validated and built

• Ownership of independent deliverables alongside hands-on support work

• Regular feedback and a portfolio of documentation and research work at the end

title: Lead Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**Overview**

We are seeking a Lead SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test ) to provide end-to-end technical governance across all QA layers — frontend, middleware, and backend — for a complex, multi-layered onboarding platform. This role owns the architecture of API contract testing and the data modeling of complex entity relationships (e.g., hierarchical/parent-child style structures), while ensuring that quality assumptions made at one layer (such as client-side validation) are independently verified at every downstream layer rather than trusted at face value. The ideal candidate combines strong technical leadership with the ability to set and enforce delivery governance across cross-functional teams.

**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Provide technical governance across frontend, middleware, and backend testing layers.
* Establish and enforce QA delivery standards, evidence requirements, review processes, and quality gates.
* Review frontend constraint dictionaries and FSM/state-model outputs for completeness and consistency.
* Review API schema reconstructions, network evidence, and tracer replay outputs for technical quality and traceability.
* Coordinate with QA Analysts, SDETs, and Test Operations Associates to align technical execution with delivery timelines.
* Review test architecture decisions, validation approaches, and coverage strategies.
* Coordinate dependency resolution, evidence rework, and cross-layer reconciliation throughout the engagement.
* Act as the escalation point for cross-layer technical discrepancies and evidence-quality issues.
* Compile and quality-check the raw technical evidence dossiers produced by the workstreams.
* Identify evidence gaps, inconsistencies, or areas requiring rework before handoff to client stakeholders.
* Report on delivery health, technical risks, evidence quality, dependencies, and unresolved gaps.
* Prepare the technical evidence package for handoff to the client team responsible for final modelling and logic-gap assessment.
* Support technical readout preparation by ensuring that findings are traceable to empirical evidence.

**Project Details**

**Title**: Lead SDET **Rate:** $17/hr  
**Start Date:** 19th October  
**Duration:** 4 Months  
**Commitment:** 22 Hours per Week  
**Location:** India (Remote)  
**Job Type:** Contractual (with the possibility of a Full-time employment extension based on performance and project needs)

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Proven experience of 8+ years in a QA leadership role spanning multiple testing layers (frontend, middleware, backend)
* Demonstrated expertise in API contract testing architecture and governance
* Practical experience with knowledge graph or entity-relationship data modeling and its application to test/data traceability
* Strong understanding of layered system architectures and the importance of independently verifying quality at each layer rather than relying on upstream assumptions
* Strong track record of technical delivery governance, including setting standards and quality gates
* Excellent cross-functional leadership and stakeholder communication skills
* Deep technical grounding across QA disciplines (manual, automation, systems-level testing) to credibly guide teams at every layer
* Experience mentoring or managing SDETs and QA Analysts
* Experience leading complex multi-week technical QA, API validation, or security-assessment engagements is strongly preferred.
* Experience establishing evidence/traceability models across complex technical workflows is preferred.
* Familiarity with knowledge graphs, entity-relationship models, or structured technical dependency/evidence modeling is preferred; deep knowledge-graph engineering expertise is not required.
* Ability to synthesize technical evidence into concise stakeholder-ready findings and handoff materials.

* Technical Expertise: Ability to read and understand C# code, and leverage prior experience with API development, SQL Server, and Postman or Bruno, to drive technical platform initiatives.

* Strong written communication skills using Office 365 tools such as Outlook and Teams.
* Experience in creating technical and end-user documentation with Jira.
* Proven ability to work effectively with diverse development teams, including onshore, near-shore, and off-shore resources.

title: Senior Associate - Implementation Specialist
description:
**About Us**
At apexanalytix, we’re lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we’ve been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure-to-pay solutions to the world. We’re the perfect balance of established company and start-up. You will find a unique home here.
  
  
And you’ll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you’ll be helping build that reputation.
  
  
Read more about apexanalytix - https://www.apexanalytix.com/about/
  
  
WORK LOCATION – Noida, Sector -135, Candor Tech space
  
  
WORK TIMINGS - 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM (IST)
  
  
**Position Summary**
****Transportation will be given by company****
The Sr. Associate – Implementation Specialist provides technical leadership and hands-on expertise across client implementations of apex portal™ and smartVM™. The role owns the technical success of an implementation end to end — from requirement discovery and solution design through ERP integration, data mapping, testing and go-live.
  
  
The successful candidate combines strong technical depth in SaaS platforms, APIs, ETL and databases with the consulting presence to build trusted client relationships. Practical, hands-on experience applying AI tools within a delivery or implementation environment is mandatory for this role. This is also a mentoring role: you will guide junior team members and act as an escalation point for complex technical issues.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
****Client Implementation & Delivery****
▪ Identify critical implementation requirements and build an implementation plan that delivers project milestones on time and to scope.
  
  
▪ Present technical overviews of apexportal and associated technical requirements to clients during implementation and upgrade planning.
  
  
▪ Manage the setup and configuration of the technical environment for hosted clients.
  
  
▪ Take end-to-end ownership of release and delivery activities, including cutover and post go-live stabilization.
  
  
****Solution Design & Integration****
▪ Design and develop workflows for apexportal functionality and present them to key stakeholders for sign-off.
  
  
▪ Assist clients in designing and building interfaces between their ERP systems and apexportal, and lead the testing of those integrations, including data reconciliation between the client ERP and apexportal.
  
  
▪ Develop and unit test baseline modules of the apexportal Solutions product.
  
  
▪ Apply AI tools and automation to accelerate delivery tasks such as data mapping, configuration, testing, documentation and issue diagnosis.
  
  
****Technical Leadership & Support****
▪ Serve as Subject Matter Expert and technical lead for client configurations and installations of apexportal and smartVM.
  
  
▪ Act as the escalation point for internal and external deployments, troubleshooting and diagnosing the root cause of software issues.
  
  
▪ Provide guidance, training and knowledge transfer to junior team members across both products.
  
  
▪ Partner with the Client Value and Audit teams to resolve client issues and support ongoing accounts.
  
  
****Process Improvement & Reporting****
▪ Design, implement and enhance high-impact business process improvement initiatives for client software implementations.
  
  
▪ Create and maintain mockups, BRDs, FRDs and wireframes using tools such as Visio, Excel, Microsoft Project, Adobe and Snagit.
  
  
▪ Provide recommendations to leadership on a regular and ad-hoc basis and prepare periodic status reporting for management.
  
  
**Required Skills & Experience**
**Candidates must demonstrate all of the following:**
▪
****AI experience —****
hands-on experience applying AI tools and technologies (for example AI-assisted development, automation, document or data extraction, or AI-supported analysis) to real delivery work. Candidates should be able to describe specific use cases and the outcome achieved.
  
  
▪
****Implementation / ERP background —****
4+ years in an implementation, technical consulting or professional services role, including exposure to ERP systems and their data structures.
  
  
▪
****SaaS product understanding —****
solid understanding of SaaS architecture, multi-tenant delivery models, configuration-led implementations and the release cycles they operate on.
  
  
▪
****APIs, ETL & data warehousing —****
working knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs, ETL mapping and table design, and core data warehouse concepts.
  
  
▪
****Database skills —****
hands-on experience with SQL Server, PostgreSQL or an equivalent relational database, including the ability to write and troubleshoot complex queries, stored procedures, views, indexes and jobs (2+ years).
  
  
▪
****Communication —****
excellent written and verbal communication, with the confidence to present technical concepts to non-technical client stakeholders and executives.
  
  
▪
****Delivery methodology —****
4+ years delivering within Agile / Scrum SDLC environments.
  
  
**Additional Technical Skills**
▪ Experience with Supply Chain or Procure-to-Pay technology implementations.
  
  
▪ Working knowledge of integration technologies including SSO, SAML, SSL, web services, REST and SOAP; ServiceNow integration experience is an advantage.
  
  
▪ Experience with version control tools such as Git, SVN, CVS or TFS.
  
  
▪ Familiarity with business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, QlikView or SSRS.
  
  
▪ Comfortable working with the command line and standard system commands.
  
  
**Preferred / Good To Have**
▪ Hands-on experience with Workday or Oracle.
  
  
▪ Consulting experience across multiple ERPs — specifically MDM, Vendor Master and P2P (SAP, Oracle, PeopleSoft and similar).
  
  
▪ Exposure to Accounts Payable modules within ERP systems such as Workday, SAP, Oracle or J.D. Edwards.
  
  
▪ Knowledge of report migration, subscriptions and data extraction from ERP systems.
  
  
▪ Experience defining application and system configuration standards with cross-functional teams and business units.
  
  
****CORE COMPETENCIES****
▪ Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with a track record of diagnosing root causes rather than symptoms.
  
  
▪ Client-service mindset, with the ability to translate client requirements into automated, scalable solutions.
  
  
▪ Highly organized and detail-oriented; able to multi-task with limited supervision and meet changing deadlines under pressure.
  
  
▪ Takes initiative and accepts accountability for outcomes.
  
  
▪ Collaborative and willing to share knowledge across the team.
  
  
**About Apexanalytix**
apexanalytix is a cloud-based software and services company that works with over 200 of the Global Fortune 1000 to recover lost profits, protect against procurement fraud, and manage supplier onboarding, compliance and payment profit optimization. Each year we receive approximately 9 million supplier records and $4.6 trillion in invoices and payments from our clients. We work with organizations including the world's largest retailer, electronics company, entertainment company, financial institutions, pharmaceutical and automotive manufacturers, and services companies, with shared services locations in the US, UK and Hong Kong.
  
  
Delivering our solutions to the world’s largest companies has enabled us to build what a leading IT industry analyst describes as possibly the only trusted source for accurate, high-value supplier information. We are making this data available to solution developers, enterprises and other organizations through an on-demand API business model. Our API service to the validated and enhanced smartVM data source is supplemented by over 400 real-time data sources through direct integration, subscription and robotics — giving clients the trusted data they need to ensure compliance, manage risk, improve B2B transaction processing, enable strategic initiatives, predict outcomes and prescribe action.
  
  
**apexanalytix is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or any other protected status.**

Job Description: Analog Validation/Characterization Engineer/Lead
  
  
**Primary And Secondary Responsibilities**

* Develop bench characterization methodologies for Analog/Mixed-Signal IPs across PVT combinations.

* B.Tech/M.Tech. in Electronics/Communication Engineering

ADC, DAC, PLL, PMC, PMU, OSC, PVT, Labview, VALIDATION, Post-Silicon, HARDWARE, DESIGN, ANALOG VALIDATION, CHARACTERIZATION, Test & Measurements.

title: Lead Software Development Engineer
description:
**Senior Software Engineer- Python Automation for Barco Control Rooms @ Barco NOIDA.**
**BCR (Barco Control Rooms)**
The Barco Control Rooms business unit is making workflow and visualization solutions for the Control Room market since 1994 to help operators collect, visualize and share critical information for optimal mission-critical decision making. Today, we are still the number one choice for control room professionals who want to stay on top of their situational awareness with 12000+ installations for critical infrastructure and critical operations.
  
  
**Barco CTRL**
is our latest flagship software product. It is a simple, scalable and secure platform, that gives an operator full control over the information flow in an easy and intuitive way for faster and efficient decision making.
  
  
**Senior Software Engineer - Python Automation @ Barco NOIDA**
We are seeking highly accomplished test automation expert to join our dynamic product development team who can be part of the Barco CTRL product group. The ideal candidate should have worked as Automation developer in product-based organization and has experience in developing and delivering software products in agile methodology. The candidate should be self-driven and should have a great combination of Test strategy, automation, software design, deeper product understanding, technical and communication skills. The right candidate should be passionate about software and technology, product development, excellent communicator, comfortable with ambiguity, and can move fast and is a good collaborator.
  
  
**About The Role**
As Senior Software Engineer in test automation, you will:
  
  

* Collaborate with product owners, architects, and scrum team members to define the system automation strategy
* Design and develop a robust automation framework, increasing and improving system automation.
* Gain a deep understanding of the Barco control room product, becoming proficient in all its features
* Regularly monitor automation tests, improve their stability, and keep the system updated with the latest dependencies.
* Mentor team members and promote best practices in system automation.
* Actively participate in component and system-level validation activities with the QA team.
* Work with cross-functional teams across multiple groups, geography, and time zones.
* Ensure the delivery of high-quality, timely product releases.

**Qualification and Experience:**

* B.E/B.Tech/ME/M.Tech in Computer Science or a related field.
* 7-10 years of experience in automation testing of enterprise software products using Python and various frameworks.
* Strong proficiency in Python programming.
* Expertise in designing automation framework architecture.
* Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, PyTest, JMeter, or similar.
* Solid experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins, version control systems like Git, container-based application deployment, Docker, and DevOps practices.
* Deep understanding of release processes and the creation of automation test strategies.
* Self-motivated, team player, result-oriented, critical thinker, and problem solver.
* Excellent analytical, communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
* Experience with Agile software development using SCRUM.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of performance and security testing
* Good experience in networking domain.

title: Automotive Systems and Applications Engineer
description:
Business Unit Description
  
  
NXP’s Automotive Processing business line provides the processing power and system enablement needed to accelerate the
**next generation of automotive innovation**
, including vehicle networking, wireless connectivity, body and chassis, powertrain, safety, gateway, zone control, advanced driver assistance systems and central-compute applications. The business line includes flagship automotive processor platforms such as S32G, S32Z/E, S32N, and other next-generation real-time and applications processing devices that enable scalable vehicle architectures for
**software-defined vehicles (SDVs)**
and connected automotive platforms.
  
  
**Vehicle architectures**
are rapidly evolving from distributed ECU-based systems to zonal, domain and central-compute architectures, where
**software**
,
**high-speed networking**
,
**real-time processing**
,
**security**
,
**safety**
and
**AI-driven workloads**
are becoming key differentiators.
**Edge AI**
is bringing a major revolution to automotive innovation by enabling intelligent and safe decision-making closer to the vehicle.
  
  
**Job Summary**

* This position will be a part of AP Business Line working on above mentioned products directly associating with this transformation by combining heterogeneous compute, real-time processing, networking, accelerator integration and software enablement for next-generation automotive platforms.
* Solve customer system design issues throughout all stages of the customer product development cycle (conception through production). Provide responsive and thorough hardware and software technical support to enable successful launch and production of customer systems.
* Create and own the development of evaluation and demonstration HW and SW solutions that showcase NXP automotive devices capabilities and value proposition.
* Create and own solution development and proof-of-concept activities for automotive processor platforms, including reference boards, diagnostics software, software package enablement, and silicon bring-up.
* Contribute to NPI development, create technical documentation and training material to enable customers
* Support marketing efforts to position NXP as a thought leader in automotive applications.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Promote NXP design-win activities by enabling customer transition from reference designs to production applications.
* Create evaluation and demonstration hardware and software solutions to showcase the value, performance and innovation of NXP automotive processors.
* Support customer system design, debug and integration activities across the complete customer development cycle, including concept, evaluation, bring-up, validation, production readiness and post-launch support.
* Develop and demonstrate innovative embedded automotive solutions across vehicle networking, gateway, vehicle dynamics, safety, real-time processing, central-compute, zonal architecture(s) and AI-enabled edge workloads.
* Contribute to NPI activities through application readiness, reference board support, diagnostics software, software package validation, customer enablement, collateral creation and training material.
* Provide technical guidance to field applications engineers, sales engineers, marketing teams and customers on processor features, system architecture, software enablement, debug methodology and platform integration.
* Work closely with marketing, product management, product definition, test engineering, hardware development and software development teams to enable successful launch and adoption of new automotive processors.
* Provide customer input, competitive intelligence and technical feedback to internal teams to optimize processor platforms, software enablement, collateral, tools and customer experience.
* Create technical documentation, application notes, training material, demos, quick-start guidance, debug notes and customer-facing enablement collateral.

Cross-Functional Aspects
  
  

* Collaborate with customers, FAEs, sales, marketing, systems engineering, software engineering, hardware design, product definition, validation and test teams to drive customer success and product adoption.
* Act as the technical voice of the customer inside NXP, helping internal teams understand customer requirements, issue trends, product gaps, competitive positioning and solution opportunities.
* Support technical queries from field applications engineers, sales engineers and marketing teams with clear, accurate and timely responses.
* Contribute to solution roadmap discussions by aligning device capabilities, customer use cases, software readiness, demo priorities, collateral needs and market trends.

**Job Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree(s) in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related discipline.
* 8-12 years of relevant experience in embedded systems, software development, automotive processors and system applications, systems engineering, HW/SW development
* Strong hands-on development experience with MCU/MPU architecture(s), Arm-based is an advantage.
* Strong hands-on experience with compilers, emulators, RTOS, bare-metal software, system initialization and embedded debug techniques.
* Strong hands-on with Operating System(s), porting BSPs, boot flows, drivers and system-level debugging. Development experience with Linux, QNX, FreeRTOS, and Hypervisors is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of HW and SW (system) debugging using debug tools like T32, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, digital voltmeters, LabVIEW or equivalent tools.
* Working knowledge of automotive communication interfaces such as CAN, Ethernet, PCIe protocols and associated software is an advantage.
* Experience interacting directly with customers and solving complex technical issues throughout all stages of customer development cycles.
* Knowledge of AI principles, machine learning fundamentals, model optimization concepts and edge AI deployment workflows is desirable. Prior experience with edge AI accelerators, AI/ML runtime environments, model deployment on embedded targets, and performance or memory optimization for AI workloads will be an advantage.
* Must have very strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Ability and desire to travel domestically and internationally as required.

title: Manager – Travel, T&E Compliance, Audit & Reporting
description:
**Job Description**
Alimentation Couche-Tard Inc., (ACT) is a global Fortune 200 company (https://corpo.couche-tard.com/en/). A leader in convenience store and fuel space, it has a footprint across 31 countries and territories. ACT's India entity i.e. Circle K Business Centre India (CKBCI) is a wholly owned subsidiary and an integrated center, collaborating with our international teams supporting the delivery of ACT's global business operations.
  
  
**About The Role**
This role will be based in Cyber Hub Gurugram. Manager – Travel, T&E Compliance, Audit & Reporting will be responsible for the day-to-day governance, compliance, controls, reporting and continuous improvement of Circle K's Travel & Expense (T&E) programme and day to day governance of Travel Management Company (TMC).
  
  
The role will act as a central point of expertise for travel operations, TMC governance, T&E policy compliance, audit and controls, travel policy standardization, management reporting, training and process automation. The position will work closely with Finance, Procurement, Internal Audit, HR, Technology, business stakeholders, Navan/ Travel Management Company (TMC) to ensure that T&E processes are controlled, efficient, data-led and aligned with Circle K policies and internal-control and audit requirements.
  
  
The role will also lead opportunities to leverage automation and analytics to strengthen preventive controls, reduce manual effort, improve compliance and identify savings and leakage across the T&E ecosystem.
  
  
***Roles & Responsibilities
  
  
Travel & T&E Operations***

* Manage and oversee the day-to-day execution of the global T&E operating processes, with particular focus on travel booked through Navan and related travel expenses.
* Work closely with Director CKBCI to be the operational subject-matter expert for Navan, including policy configuration, traveller profiles, approval workflows, reporting, exceptions, and issue resolution.
* Monitor the end-to-end travel process from travel request and approval through booking, travel, expense submission, reimbursement and reconciliation.
* Establish and maintain clear procedures for handling travel and T&E exceptions, escalations, cancellations, refunds, and credits.
* Partner with the TMC, and other suppliers to monitor service levels and resolve recurring operational issues.

***T&E Compliance & Policy Governance***

* Monitor compliance with the Global T&E Policies and identify areas of non-compliance, control gaps and emerging risks.
* Develop and maintain a structured T&E compliance framework, including preventive and corrective controls.
* Monitor advance-booking compliance, pre-trip approval, preferred supplier usage, policy exceptions, out-of-channel bookings and other defined policy requirements.
* Ensure policies and policy changes are accurately translated into system rules, workflows and automated controls.
* Establish appropriate compliance mechanisms for different traveller groups, including executives, while maintaining appropriate visibility and governance.
* Coordinate policy communication, training and periodic awareness initiatives with HR and business stakeholders

**Audit, Controls & Risk Management**

* Own the operational response to T&E audit requirements and support Internal Audit, Finance and other control functions with evidence and analysis.
* Ensure T&E processes and automated reviews comply with internal policies, regulatory requirements, fraud-prevention controls and SOX/internal-control expectations, where applicable.
* Validate the effectiveness and accuracy of automated and AI-enabled T&E controls before and after implementation.
* Maintain audit trails, control documentation, standard operating procedures and evidence of exception resolution.
* Identify control weaknesses and recommend remediation actions with clear owners and timelines.
* Monitor recurring exceptions and investigate potential misuse, fraud, duplicate transactions or unusual spending patterns.

***Reporting, Analytics & Insights***

* Develop and maintain a T&E management reporting and dashboard framework covering spend, compliance, adoption, leakage, suppliers, exceptions and savings.
* Provide regular reporting to Finance, Procurement, leadership and other relevant stakeholders.
* Analyse travel spend across business units, traveller groups, suppliers, routes, categories and booking channels to identify trends and opportunities.
* Establish meaningful KPIs and dashboards to measure the effectiveness of the T&E programme.
* Develop reporting that provides visibility of Navan adoption versus off-platform spend, including root-cause analysis of leakage.
* Translate T&E data into actionable recommendations for policy, sourcing, supplier management and process improvement.

***Process Improvement, Standardization & Automation***

* Lead continuous improvement initiatives across the T&E process, with a focus on reducing manual intervention and strengthening controls.
* Identify opportunities to use RPA, workflow automation and analytics to improve T&E compliance and operational efficiency.
* Develop automated controls for areas such as:
* advance-booking compliance.
* pre-trip approval.
* policy exception monitoring.
* duplicate and high-risk expense detection.
* unused travel credit tracking.
* refund monitoring.
* off-platform booking/leakage detection; and
* automated compliance reporting.
* Work with Technology and business teams to define requirements, test solutions, validate outputs and transition automation into business-as-usual operations.
* Continuously assess whether existing controls can be simplified, automated or moved from detective to preventive controls.

***Travel Spend & Supplier Governance***

* Partner with Procurement to identify travel savings and supplier optimisation opportunities.
* Monitor utilisation of negotiated airline, hotel, car rental and other travel rates.
* Analyse supplier and channel performance and identify opportunities for consolidation or improved commercial terms.
* Support supplier reviews, RFPs and contract renewals with data, performance analysis and business requirements.
* Monitor the financial impact of unused credits, refunds, cancellations and other recoverable travel value Support strategies to improve Navan adoption and reduce unmanaged/off-platform travel spend

***Stakeholder & Change Management***

* Build strong relationships with Finance, Procurement, Internal Audit, HR, Technology, business leaders and travel stakeholders globally.
* Provide subject-matter expertise and guidance to employees, managers and delegates on T&E processes and policy.
* Support implementation of new T&E technology, policies, controls and operating-model changes.
* Develop communication and training materials and support adoption of new processes.
* Act as a change champion for the ongoing transformation of the T&E programme.

***What Success Looks Like***
***Within the first 12 months, the successful candidate will have:***

* Established a clear T&E governance and compliance framework.
* Created a reliable management dashboard providing visibility of travel spend, compliance, leakage and exceptions.
* Improved control and visibility over travel booked outside approved channels.
* Strengthened pre-trip approval and travel-policy compliance.
* Established a structured process for unused credits, refunds and travel exceptions.
* Identified and implemented high-value automation opportunities that reduce manual controls.
* Established effective governance with TMC and key travel suppliers.
* Built a sustainable T&E operating model with clear ownership, procedures, and reporting.
* Train
* Standardize global policies.
* Hotel booking

***Key Performance Indicators***
***Success in the role will be measured through outcomes including:***

* Reduction in off-platform/unmanaged travel spend.
* Improvement in travel-policy compliance and reduction in repeat exceptions.
* Increased percentage of travel subject to appropriate pre-trip approval and automated controls.
* Reduction in manual T&E compliance and audit activities through automation.
* Timely and accurate management reporting with clear actionable insights.
* Recovery and utilisation of unused travel credits and refunds.
* Reduction in duplicate, high-risk and potentially fraudulent transactions.
* Successful implementation of agreed T&E process-improvement and automation initiatives.
* Strong supplier/TMC performance against agreed SLAs.
* Positive stakeholder and traveller experience.

***Job Requirements
  
  
Education***

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Travel Management, Operations, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree or professional certification in Travel Management, Finance, Compliance, Audit, Process Improvement, or related field is preferred.

**Experience**

* 15+ years of relevant experience across Travel Management, T&E Operations, Finance Operations, Compliance, Audit, Shared Services, or Process Transformation.
* Experience managing or governing a corporate travel programme and/or T&E operations.
* Hands-on experience with Navan or a comparable corporate travel management platform is highly desirable.
* Experience working with Finance, Procurement, Internal Audit, HR, Technology, and business stakeholders within a global organization.
* Experience implementing and improving automated controls, workflows, reporting, analytics, or digital solutions.
* Experience supporting large-scale and/or multi-country travel and expense programmes are preferred.

***Behavioral Skills***

* Strong ownership and accountability with the ability to operate independently.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical capability.
* Comfortable challenging existing processes and identifying better ways of working.
* Strong stakeholder-management and influencing skills across global teams.
* Ability to balance compliance, cost, control and traveler experience.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* High attention to detail without losing sight of the broader business objective.
* Demonstrates Circle K values: Take Ownership, One Team, Play to Win and Do the Right Thing.

***Knowledge***

* Strong understanding of corporate travel and T&E processes.
* Strong knowledge of travel policy, compliance, internal controls, audit and risk management.
* Strong analytical and data interpretation skills.
* Experience with Power BI, Power Automate, Excel and/or comparable analytics and automation tools.
* Understanding of APIs, RPA, AI-enabled controls and workflow automation.
* Ability to translate business policy into system rules and automated controls.
* Strong understanding of data quality, reporting and reconciliation.
* Knowledge of SOX/internal-control environments and fraud-prevention controls is an advantage.

**Other Requirements**
**Work Model:**
Mandatory 5-day work-from-office.
  
  
**Working Hours:**
Flexible hours.
  
  
**Notice Period:**
Immediate joiners are preferred or maximum 30 days .
  
  
**Candidate Location:**
Candidates based within a commuting distance from the office are preferred.

**Essentials**
**Contract Drafting, Review & Negotiation**

* Draft, review, redline and negotiate a broad range of contracts for RSM US LLP and its affiliates across jurisdictions, ensuring clear documentation of rights, obligations, risk allocation and business intent

Amazon is searching for a smart and motivated individual to serve as a specialist on its Law Enforcement Response (LER) team for India. The LER team consists of a dedicated group of specialists who are responsible for responding to law enforcement requests (e.g., subpoenas, search warrants) received from government agencies. Amazon is seeking a talented individual who can contribute to this critical function as the company continues to grow around the world.
  
  
Each LER specialist's principal duty is to make sure that requests are processed professionally and expeditiously, all while ensuring the privacy and security of business and customer information in accordance with the law and with Amazon's policies and procedures. This requires great judgment and experience dealing with challenging and ambiguous situations.
  
  
Candidates must be self-motivated, have a strong work ethic, and be able to work independently and at times with little supervision.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Evaluate and respond to law enforcement requests in a manner consistent with the privacy and security of business and customer information, in accordance with the law and with Amazon's policies and procedures
* Ability to periodically (on a set rotation) receive and process emergency law enforcement requests both during and outside of normal business hours, and sometimes overnight
* Utilize a combination of web-based applications and data extraction tools to compile information potentially responsive to a particular law enforcement request
* Communicate verbally and in writing with law enforcement personnel, Amazon employees, outside counsel, and others
* Assist in the identification of patterns and trends that might be evident from the processing of certain law enforcement requests
* Handle the most complex and challenging law enforcement requests, as well as special projects
* Help lead the training and development of other LER specialists
* Travel periodically, including on short notice, to represent Amazon in courts and law enforcement offices, as required.
* Sign and issue certificates/letters to authenticate digital evidence in response to law enforcement requests

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience
* Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
* Experience working in fast paced environments, and managing workload even during times of stress, or escalated activity
* Experience in business development and building strong client relationship
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and judgment
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with colleagues
* Excellent organizational skills, and ability to work independently and manage multiple projects at once
* Ability to demonstrate sound judgment even in ambiguous situations

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience responding to requests from law enforcement agencies
* Experience in making and/or responding to law enforcement requests
* Experience with computer skills, including proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Written and/or verbal proficiency in one or more of the following languages: Hindi

title: Company Secretary
description:
**Position: Company Secretary**

**Company Description**
ATS Services Pvt Ltd is a diversified services organization with over a decade of experience in designing and executing customer engagement programs for a wide range of clients. ATS delivers solutions in customer retention, collections for retail and B2B customers, and business analytics including MIS dashboards. The company also offers consulting in credit and risk, covering portfolio valuation, assessment and repair, credit procedures and policies, and business process design.

**Role Description**
The Company Secretary will manage corporate secretarial functions and ensure compliance with applicable company law and regulatory requirements in India. Responsibilities include organizing and documenting board and general meetings, preparing agendas and minutes, maintaining statutory registers and records, and coordinating filings with regulatory authorities. The role involves advising management and the board on corporate governance, compliance obligations, and changes in relevant legislation, as well as drafting and reviewing policies, resolutions, and corporate documents. The Company Secretary will collaborate closely with finance, legal, and senior leadership to support audits, due diligence activities, and stakeholder communication. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Faridabad.

**Qualifications**

* Professional qualification as Company Secretary (CS) from the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI); additional degrees in law, commerce, or finance are an advantage.
* Strong knowledge of Companies Act, corporate governance standards, and other relevant statutory and regulatory frameworks.
* Demonstrated experience in conducting board and general meetings, drafting minutes and resolutions, and maintaining statutory registers and records.
* Skills in regulatory filings, compliance monitoring, and coordination with auditors, legal advisors, and regulatory authorities.
* Handle applicable legal compliances, including POSH-related matters.
* Support banking operations involving legal and secretarial documentation.
* Provide legal support to business units handling Domestic Collections and B2B International Collections.
* Coordinate Information Security Audits, client audits, and related compliance requirements.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proficiency in drafting policies, notices, reports, and formal correspondence.
* High level of integrity, attention to detail, and ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and work effectively with cross-functional teams on-site.

**Experience:**
Minimum 2 years

**Working Days:**
5 days a week (Monday to Friday)

If you have experience in corporate secretarial compliance, legal documentation, and regulatory requirements, we would love to hear from you.

**Email cv to hiring@servicesats.com**

title: National Security Officer
description:
**Overview**
Microsoft's National Security charter for India strengthens national cyber resilience, elevates customer readiness, ensures regulatory compliance and positions Microsoft as the trusted security partner to governments and critical industries. The charter runs on four pillars: Keeping the Nation Safe (cyber agencies, Project ATLAS, Sovereign Cloud); Keeping Customers Safe (incident readiness and compliance); Keeping Citizens Safe (CrimeOS, law enforcement and anti-fraud); and Keeping Microsoft Safe (MeitY empanelment, DPDPA and CERT-In compliance).
  
  
The Deputy National Security Officer owns the day-to-day operations of this charter, so that the National Security Officer can focus on executive and regulator engagement and on Solution Engineering leadership. The role sits at the intersection of national cyber agencies, regulators, Public Sector customers and Microsoft's global security organizations.
  
  
A recent example of the work: Microsoft's One-Microsoft response with the Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C, Ministry of Home Affairs) on the transnational "Boss Scam" CEO-impersonation malware campaign, coordinating Defender Security Research, the Digital Crimes Unit (DCU), the Microsoft Security Response Center (MSRC) and CELA.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Agency and regulator cadence. Run the monthly engagement cadence with 8+ national cyber agencies and regulators (CERT-In, NCSC, NCIIPC, I4C, RBI, MeitY, SEBI, IRDAI); prepare briefings, track commitments and coordinate MSTIC quarterly threat briefings to top agencies.
* Threat-intelligence and incident coordination. Serve as the operational point of contact for government-origin threat intelligence and malware submissions; route and track cases across Defender Security Research, MSRC, DCU, CDOC and CELA; run the intake/case register and standardized status reporting to agencies; coordinate CERT-In regulatory incident notifications with CELA.
* Government Security Program (GSP). Drive onboarding of Cybersecurity agencies.
* Cybersecurity Boardroom programme. Deliver 12 executive Cybersecurity Boardrooms per year for PS-critical customers with CDOC, MSTIC and advisory partners (EY, PwC); drive WARA/WASA and Unified Security coverage of PS-critical customers with CSU.
* Compliance and regulatory point of view. Support MeitY Advanced Services Empanelment, the DPDPA readiness assessment and the India Regulatory PoV (CERT-In, RBI, DPDPA, SEBI); map Microsoft cloud capabilities to Indian regulatory requirements with CELA.
* Skilling at scale. Run the Government CISO programme and national awareness programmes (targets: 100K Level-1 awareness, 1,000 professionals, 500 Government CISOs via NEILIT/NeGD MoUs; 50+ agency deep-dives).
* Citizen safety. Support CrimeOS deployment at I4C and state law-enforcement agencies, law-enforcement request handling with CELA/LENS/DCU, and containment of consumer-platform abuse (for example, Digital Arrest scams).
* Sovereign and national programmes. Support Project ATLAS, the Secure Windows for Government baseline with CERT-In, and Microsoft Cloud for Sovereignty / Azure Local positioning with agencies.
* Thought leadership. Contribute to 24+ articles and talks per year; represent Microsoft Security at agency forums and CISO communities; brief agency leadership and CISOs independently.
* Field support. Support account and security specialist teams on regulation-driven customer requirements in Public Sector and regulated industries.

Success measures (first 12 months)
  
  

* 8+ agencies and regulators on a formal monthly engagement cadence.
* Oboarded agencies to the Government Security Program.
* Standardized intake and status-reporting process live for government threat submissions.
* 12 Cybersecurity Boardrooms delivered for PS-critical customers.
* MeitY Advanced Empanelment complete and the India Regulatory PoV published.
* Government CISO programme launched and skilling targets on track.

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years in cybersecurity with depth in threat intelligence, incident response or security operations.
* Hands-on fluency with the Microsoft Security stack: Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender (XDR, Endpoint, Office 365), Security Copilot and Purview.
* Experience working with or inside government, law-enforcement, CERT or regulatory bodies in India.
* Proven ability to brief senior government officials and CISOs without support.
* Strong programme-management and cross-functional coordination skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English; Hindi is an advantage.
* Indian citizen or eligible to work in India [To be confirmed with HR / CELA for any clearance considerations].

**Preferred**

* Prior NSO/NTO, CISO, CERT or national-agency experience.
* Malware analysis or threat-hunting background.
* Knowledge of the Indian regulatory landscape: CERT-In directions, MeitY cloud empanelment, DPDPA, and RBI/SEBI/IRDAI cyber frameworks.
* Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GIAC, SC-200 or SC-100.
* Experience with sovereign cloud or air-gapped deployments.
* Public speaking and published thought leadership.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

The role of a
**Product Manager**
is a highly coveted and dynamic position within the realm of business and technology. A Product Manager is a skilled professional responsible for overseeing the entire lifecycle of a product, from its inception and development to its launch and ongoing success in the market. This multifaceted career requires a unique blend of strategic thinking, technical expertise, and exceptional communication skills.

At the heart of their responsibilities, Product Managers act as the
**bridge between various stakeholders, including customers, engineering teams, designers, and business executives.**
They possess a keen understanding of market trends, consumer needs, and competitive landscapes. With their visionary approach, they identify potential product opportunities, conceptualize innovative ideas, and translate them into actionable plans.

To successfully execute their vision, Product Managers
**collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, guiding and coordinating the efforts of designers, engineers, marketers, and other professionals.**
They serve as the driving force behind product development, ensuring that the end result aligns with the company's strategic goals and satisfies customer demands. This requires an astute ability to prioritize tasks, make informed decisions, and manage competing interests.

Throughout the product development process, Product Managers
**employ their analytical prowess to gather and analyze data, seeking valuable insights that inform critical decisions.**
They conduct thorough market research, user testing, and competitive analysis to fine-tune the product's features, design, and overall user experience. By deeply understanding customer needs and pain points, they drive the creation of products that deliver exceptional value and differentiate themselves in the marketplace.

Additionally, Product Managers are responsible for
**creating and maintaining a roadmap that outlines the product's strategic direction and milestones.**
They meticulously plan releases, define product requirements, and collaborate with engineering teams to ensure timely and efficient development cycles. Their role extends beyond the initial launch, as they continuously monitor product performance, gather feedback, and iterate on features to enhance user satisfaction and drive business growth.

**Exceptional communication skills are a hallmark of a successful Product Manager. They serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, articulating the product vision, goals, and progress to executives, team members, and customers. Moreover, they adeptly navigate challenging conversations, manage expectations, and negotiate trade-offs to ensure the successful delivery of the product.**

***We are proud to be a Great Place to Work certified!***

The company is committed to environmental sustainability and supports green chemistry by prioritising the use of bio inputs in manufacturing. Jubilant is one of the world’s largest producers of Acetaldehyde from the bio route.

* Experience supporting client-facing projects and transformation initiatives
* Willingness to travel internationally on short- and medium-term assignments, as required

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

title: SCO-Manufacturing-Scrum Master
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Service line - Position Title: Scrum Master and Business Analyst Job Description (6+ Years Experience)**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As a Scrum Master and Business Analyst with over 6 years of experience, you will play a dual role in facilitating Agile Scrum processes while analysing and documenting business requirements to ensure high-quality project delivery. You are responsible for promoting Agile best practices, coaching teams, and collaborating with stakeholders to align on project goals.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Facilitate all Agile ceremonies including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Coach and mentor Scrum teams on Agile/Scrum principles, promoting continuous improvement and removing impediments.
* Collaborate closely with Product Owners and stakeholders to maintain a clear and prioritized product backlog.
* Gather, analyse, and document business requirements, translating them into actionable user stories and functional specifications.
* Work with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment between business needs and technical solutions.
* Track project progress through metrics such as velocity, burndown charts, and sprint reports.
* Facilitate communication and coordination among distributed teams including developers, QA, and DevOps.
* Support scaling Agile processes and adapting methodologies to fit organizational needs.
* Identify risks and issues, proactively driving resolution to keep projects on track.
* Use Agile tools like Jira, Confluence, and other project management software effectively.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Business, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP), or equivalent Agile certification.
* 6+ years of experience in Agile environments as a Scrum Master and Business Analyst.
* Strong understanding of Scrum framework, Agile methodologies, and business analysis principles.
* Proven ability to facilitate Agile ceremonies and manage stakeholder relationships.
* Experience in writing user stories, use cases, and functional requirements.
* Proficient with Agile project management tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and analytical skills.
* Experience working in software development or IT projects involving SaaS, microservices, or enterprise systems is a plus.

**Skills**

* Agile and Scrum expertise
* Business process analysis and requirement gathering
* Facilitation and conflict resolution
* Stakeholder management and communication
* Project tracking and metrics reporting
* Risk management and issue resolution
* Coaching and servant leadership
* Tools: Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Office, collaboration platforms

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**Quick Facts About the Role**

* **Role:**
  Project Manager
* **Location:**
  Coimbatore/Hyderabad
* **YOE:**
  3 - 7 years
* **Skills:**
  Expertise in project management methodologies, Agile methodologies, Scrum techniques, stakeholder management, and client interaction.
* **Benefits:**
  Learn more about our perks below.

  Competitive compensation as per industry standards.

**Who we are**

We are Foxsense Innovations - a bunch of passionate developers that love solving complex business problems through products and tools we build from scratch. Weʼve been at it for over 7 years now, and weʼve serviced over 50 happy customers around the world, while also building several in-house micro-SaaS tools for the market (all of this while being bootstrapped and profitable). Our team is rapidly growing, and weʼre in an exciting phase of our 1-10 journey. This is an opportunity for anyone who wants to experience this journey with us.

**About the role**

We seek a project manager to handle our company’s ongoing projects. You will work closely with your team members to ensure that all project requirements, deadlines, and schedules are on track. Responsibilities include submitting project deliverables, preparing status reports, establishing effective project communication plans, and properly executing said plans.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinating with cross-discipline team members to ensure all parties are on track with project requirements, deadlines, and schedules.
* Meeting with project team members to identify and resolve issues.
* Submitting project deliverables and ensuring that they adhere to quality standards.
* Preparing status reports by gathering, analyzing, and summarizing relevant information.
* Establish effective project communication plans and ensure their execution.
* Facilitating change requests to ensure that all parties are informed of the impacts on schedule and budget.
* Identifying and developing new opportunities with clients.
* Obtaining customer acceptance of project deliverables.
* Managing customer satisfaction within the project transition period.
* Conducting post-project evaluation and identifying successful and unsuccessful project elements.
* Prepare requirement documents, user flows and validate test cases.

**Requirements**

* A bachelor’s degree or master’s degree in a related field.
* 3+ years experience in project management in the Technology industry
* Ability to lead project teams of various sizes and see them through to completion.
* Ability to manage clients and expectations.
* Strong understanding of formal project management, agile methodologies and stakeholder management.
* Able to complete projects in a timely manner.
* Strong communication and literary skills.

**Bonus Skills**

* Basic understanding of coding, APIs, or cloud infrastructure to facilitate seamless communication with technical teams.
* Mastery of Agile methodologies to quickly adapt to changing priorities and drive project execution efficiently in a dynamic environment.

**Why work with us**

When you work with Foxsense Innovations, you donʼt just work a boring job. Our goal is to create a work environment that makes you want to brag about your work to your friends!

***Hereʼs why youʼll love working with us:***

* Unlimited sick leave policy, and a generous paid leave plan to ensure you get time off work whenever you need it
* A competitive and rewarding start-up culture that motivates you from day one, along with regular team-building activities
* Delicious lunch along with snacks and refreshments at office, so that hunger pangs never affect your A-game
* We have a yearly annual retreat for the team to unwind and enjoy - we went to Vagamon last year, who knows where we go this year!

**If that's not enough, there's always more!**

* Need a breather? Game with Foxes at the TT. There's a scoreboard!
* Our wholesome health care plans care for you - whenever, wherever.
* Embrace growth! Learn & grow from peers - You'll find budding freshers, seasoned veterans - you name it.
* We take unwinding as seriously as we do hustling - game nights are our way of downtime.
* Collaboration is vital for us - your value isn’t limited to your responsibilities! Feel free to lurk in other departments and share your thoughts!

**Weʼre glad youʼve made it this far! If you’re passionate about delivering successful projects, fostering collaboration, and driving growth in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, we’d love to hear from you.**
