Job Description: QA Engineer – Networking (Switches & Routers)
  
  
Required exp - ( 4 - 8 years )
  
  
Location: Gurgaon (preferred), Bangalore
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a skilled QA Engineer with strong expertise in Python, Linux, and IP Networking to validate networking products, including switches and routers.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for functional, system, integration, regression, and automation testing of networking features and services in Linux-based networking platforms.
  
  
The role requires a strong understanding of Layer 2/Layer 3 networking, packet forwarding, routing, bridging, VLANs, firewalling, NAT, and IP networking protocols.
  
  
The candidate will develop and maintain Python-based test automation, troubleshoot complex networking issues, analyze packet captures and system logs, and collaborate with development teams to ensure product quality and reliability.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, execute, and maintain Python-based test automation frameworks and test scripts for networking products.
* Perform validation and verification of switches, routers, and Linux-based networking platforms.
* Validate Layer 2 and Layer 3 functionality, including packet forwarding, bridging, VLANs, IP addressing, routing tables, static routing, policy routing, and NAT.
* Test and troubleshoot networking protocols, firewall rules, connection tracking, tunneling, access control, and network services.
* Validate device configuration, provisioning, service initialization, firmware upgrades, reboot recovery, configuration persistence, and system stability.
* Perform packet-level troubleshooting using Wireshark, tcpdump, and other network diagnostic tools.
* Analyze Linux system logs, application logs, kernel messages, and protocol traces to isolate defects and identify root causes.
* Maintain test plans, test cases, automation scripts, defect reports, and technical documentation.

Mandatory Skills
  
  

* Python Programming and Test Automation
* Strong Python programming skills for test automation and application-level validation.
* Ability to automate configuration, traffic generation, result verification, log collection, and failure analysis.
* Familiarity with test automation frameworks such as pytest or unittest.
* Linux
* Strong hands-on experience with Linux operating systems, command-line tools, shell scripting, processes, services, filesystems, permissions, and system logs.
* Experience troubleshooting Linux networking, interface configuration, routes, sockets, and service failures.
* Good knowledge of Networking Services including exposure to dnsmasq for DNS and DHCP services, chrony for NTP synchronization etc
* Understanding of Linux networking architecture, including kernel networking, packet processing, and user-space networking services.
* Familiarity with tools such as `ip`, `ss`, `tcpdump`, `ping`, `traceroute`, `journalctl`, and `dmesg`.
* IP Networking Fundamentals
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, IPv4, IPv6, subnetting, CIDR, ARP, ICMP, TCP, and UDP.
* Good understanding of routing software & protocols including FRRouting (FRR) and routing protocols such as BGP and OSPF.
* In-depth understanding of Layer 2 and Layer 3 forwarding, Ethernet bridging, VLANs, tagging, and inter-VLAN routing.
* Understanding of routing tables, static routing, default routes, policy-based routing, and next-hop selection.
* Knowledge of NAT, firewall behavior, packet processing, DPI, packet filtering, connection tracking, and end-to-end packet flow, including iptables, ebtables, arptables, ipset, and conntrack-tools.
* Familiarity with VPN technologies and tunneling protocols, including IPsec, GRE, and OpenVPN.
* Familiarity with IEEE 802.1X, RADIUS, RadSecProxy, and MAC Authentication Bypass (MAB).
* Experience with packet analysis and network troubleshooting tools such as Wireshark and tcpdump.

Good-to-Have Skills
  
  

* Embedded Linux and Cross-Compilation
* Understanding of Embedded Linux architecture, boot processes, root filesystems, and service initialization.
* Familiarity with cross-compilation toolchains, target architectures, sysroots, shared libraries, and embedded firmware builds.
* Basic knowledge of embedded system debugging and resource constraints.

title: Frontline Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**We are Omnissa!**
  
  
Omnissa is the first AI-driven digital work platform, built to support flexible, secure, work-from-anywhere experiences. We integrate industry-leading solutions—including Unified Endpoint Management, Virtual Apps and Desktops, Digital Employee Experience, and Security & Compliance into a seamless, autonomous workspace that adapts to how people work. Our platform boosts employee engagement while optimizing IT operations, security, and cost.
  
  
Guided by our Core Values
**Act in Alignment, Build Trust, Foster Inclusiveness, Drive Efficiency, and Maximize Customer Value,**
we’re growing rapidly and committed to delivering meaningful impact. If you're passionate about shaping the future of work, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**What is the opportunity?**
We are seeking a
**Frontline Engineer (MDM and Quality Systems Side of Experience is Mandate)**
to own product quality end-to-end from test strategy and automation to the full lifecycle of field-reported issues that reach engineering. This is a core engineering role, not a support function. It sits at the intersection of proactive quality ownership and reactive field intelligence, treating every real-world issue as a signal that strengthens the system.
  
  
Quality Systems Engineers design and build the test gates that keeps the product reliable. They also serve as the engineering first responder when complex, high-priority issues arrive from the field — investigating, reproducing, and distilling them into precise, engineering-ready work items. Critically, the patterns they uncover flow back into test coverage, observability improvements, and product design, closing the loop between what customers experience and what engineering builds next.
  
  
This role owns metrics across two dimensions: the health of the product as measured through traditional quality indicators, and the health of the field feedback pipeline as measured through incoming service request volume, field issue triage velocity, and the rate at which systemic issues are eliminated. Both dimensions matter equally.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Test Strategy & Quality Engineering

+ Design, develop, and maintain test plans, test cases, and automated test suites covering functional, regression, integration, and system-level scenarios
+ Own test automation strategy and contribute to frameworks that improve coverage, speed, and reliability across release cycles
+ Evaluate the product through the lens of usability and supportability — not just correctness — and proactively surface gaps before they reach customers
+ Participate in design and code reviews to embed quality thinking upstream in the development lifecycle
+ Track and report on quality health metrics including defect escape rates, test coverage, automation pass rates, and release readiness signals
+ Contribute to improvements in logging, diagnostics, and system observability that make the product easier to validate and debug

* Field Issue Investigation & Engineering Triage

+ Act as the engineering first responder for complex, high-priority issues arriving from the field, owning investigation and triage end-to-end
+ Perform rapid technical analysis using logs, monitoring systems (e.g., Logz.io: Modern Observability Powered by AI ), and production data to assess severity, impact scope, and failure patterns
+ Conduct deep technical debugging across distributed systems, APIs, services, and code paths to isolate and narrow suspected root causes
+ Reproduce complex field issues in local or shared environments, ensuring reliable alignment with production behavior
+ Enrich issue tickets with complete technical context — logs, configurations, network traces, reproduction steps, and system behavior details — so engineering teams can act without additional clarification
+ Identify duplicate issues and link them to existing defects or known issues to maintain clean, accurate JIRA hygiene
+ Collaborate with Core Engineering to validate hypotheses and confirm failure points through structured analysis
+ Validate fixes in patches or releases and ensure proper issue closure including regression verification

* Systemic Quality Improvement & Feedback Loop

+ Analyze patterns across field issues and incoming customer service requests to identify systemic gaps in test coverage, observability, or product behavior
+ Translate field intelligence into concrete engineering improvements: new test cases, observability instrumentation, documentation, or product design changes
+ Participate in retrospectives for significant incidents and ensure findings produce durable improvements — not just one-time fixes
+ Partner with TPMs and Engineering leadership to track field issue SLAs and resolution progress across priority tiers
+ Build and contribute to automation, scripts, and AI-assisted workflows that reduce repetitive triage work and improve engineering throughput
+ Set up and maintain development and test environments required for issue reproduction and validation workflows
+ Recommend and implement improvements to system observability, UX signals, and diagnostics that reduce future field issue volume

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong software engineering foundation with the ability to read, debug, and reason across distributed systems and microservices
* Hands-on experience in software quality engineering, including test design, test automation, and defect lifecycle management
* Experience investigating production systems using logs, monitoring tools, and observability platforms
* Solid understanding of APIs, client-server architectures, and modern distributed systems
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving ability for ambiguous, high-priority issues
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for cross-functional work with Engineering, TPMs, and product stakeholders

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in enterprise device management (UEM) domains such as Apple, Android, Windows, or similar platforms
* Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tools (Cursor, Claude, Rovo, or equivalent)
* Background in sustaining engineering, field engineering, or production systems engineering
* Experience building or owning test automation frameworks or developer productivity tooling
* Familiarity with observability platforms and structured log analysis

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Field Health & Issue Pipeline

+ Volume and trend of incoming customer service requests over time
+ Volume and trend of field issues routed to engineering for investigation
+ Time to first technical assessment of field issues
+ SLA compliance for high-priority field issues
+ Successful reproduction rate of customer-reported issues
+ Time to identify root cause or failure domain
+ Percentage of issues fully enriched and ready for engineering action without follow-up
+ Number of recurring issue patterns eliminated through systemic improvements

* Product Quality

+ Defect escape rate and regression rate across releases
+ Test automation coverage and pass rate
+ Reduction in duplicate defects and improved JIRA hygiene
+ Contributions to logging, observability, or test coverage that measurably reduce field issue volume
+ Release readiness signal accuracy — how well pre-release quality metrics predict post-release stability

**Why This Role Matters**
Most engineering organizations treat product quality and field issue response as separate concerns, handled by separate teams. Quality Systems Engineers reject that separation. They own both and in owning both, they create something neither function can create alone, a continuous, closed-loop system where real-world customer experience directly shapes what gets tested, what gets instrumented, and what gets built next.
  
  
The result is compounding: field issues get resolved faster, the same issues stop recurring, and the product becomes measurably more stable with every release cycle. This is quality engineering operating at its highest level of impact.
  
  
**Location:**
India (Bangalore)
  
  
**Location Type:**
HYBRID
  
  
**Travel Expectations:**
Yes
  
  
**Education:**
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

description:

**Technology Product Management Lead Analyst (C13)**
to support the evolution of Citi's
**Operating Model AI (OMAI)**
platform. This role will serve as a key liaison between Business, Operations, Risk, Controls, Data, AI/Analytics, and Technology teams to deliver scalable solutions that enhance operational transparency, governance, reporting, workflow management, and data-driven decision making across the organization.
  
  
The successful candidate will partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering teams, Business Stakeholders, and End Users to translate strategic objectives into actionable requirements, manage a prioritized backlog, and drive the successful delivery of platform capabilities. * Support implementation of AI-enabled capabilities, analytics, reporting enhancements, and workflow automation.
* Validate delivered functionality against business requirements and expected outcomes.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect triage, and release readiness activities.
* Monitor delivery metrics, user feedback, and platform adoption to drive continuous improvement.
* Drive process improvements related to requirements management, Agile execution, prioritization, and delivery governance.
* Act as the voice of the customer while balancing competing business and technology priorities.
* Communicate roadmap updates, risks, dependencies, and delivery progress to stakeholders and leadership.
* Assess and manage risks appropriately, ensuring adherence to applicable policies, controls, and governance standards.

**Recommended Qualifications:**

* 6-10 years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or related Technology roles.
* 5+ years of experience defining and documenting business, managing product backlogs, Epics, Features, User Stories, and Acceptance Criteria.
* Strong experience working in Agile environments utilizing Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or similar methodologies.
* Experience with AI-assisted tools, automation technologies, workflow platforms, and digital transformation initiatives is preferred.
* Experience partnering with Technology, Data, QA, Operations, and Business stakeholders throughout the product lifecycle.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize competing initiatives, manage multiple workstreams, and successfully deliver complex programs.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence outcomes and drive consensus across multiple teams and organizations.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence or similar product management and collaboration tools.
* Ability to create process flows, business requirements documents, functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and user journey maps.
* Working knowledge of SQL, reporting tools, analytics platforms, and data management concepts.
* Exceptional communication, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking abilities with keen attention to detail.
* Ability to influence without direct authority and effectively communicate complex business and technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong organizational skills, execution focus, and the ability to adapt and perform in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
* Proactive self-starter with a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and commitment to delivering business value.
* Experience within Financial Services, Banking, Risk, Controls, Compliance, Operational Excellence, or Data Management organizations is preferred.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s/University degree preferred

description:
**What's the role?**
As a Sr R&D Test Engineer II, you will contribute to the validation and quality assurance of HERE's HD Map and related geospatial solutions. You'll work closely with experienced engineers and cross-functional teams to execute test strategies, analyze geospatial datasets, and support both manual and automated testing initiatives. This role offers an excellent opportunity to deepen your expertise in software testing, location technologies, and data validation while making a measurable impact on products used worldwide.
  
  
**You Will Have The Opportunity To**

* Execute functional, regression, and product-level validation activities for HERE's HD Map and Base Map solutions.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and QA teams to understand requirements, define test scenarios, and validate product quality.
* Develop, maintain, and execute test plans, test cases, and test datasets that support comprehensive product validation.
* Support manual testing activities and contribute to the continuous adoption of test automation capabilities.
* Investigate, document, and track defects using quality management and issue-tracking tools.
* Validate geospatial data pipelines and datasets, including data ingestion, transformation, and output verification activities.
* Analyze test results, identify inconsistencies, recommend improvements, and help strengthen testing processes and quality practices.

**Who are you?**
You are a detail-oriented problem solver who enjoys learning new technologies and collaborating with others to deliver high-quality results. You are passionate about software quality and excited by the opportunity to work with large-scale geospatial and HD Map systems.
  
  
To be successful in this role, it would be ideal if you bring:
  
  

* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Approximately 3 to 6 years of experience in software testing, quality assurance, or a related discipline.
* Working knowledge of Python for scripting, coding logic , test development, or automation support.
* Experience with manual testing methodologies and exposure to test automation concepts.
* Experience with SQL, query writing and data validation techniques.
* Understanding of SDLC, Agile development practices, and quality engineering principles.
* Experience working with defect tracking and test management tools such as Jira.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and attention to detail.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills within global and cross-functional teams.
* Interest in geospatial technologies, HD Maps, GIS concepts, or related location-based systems.

Exposure to tools such as GitLab, ArcGIS,QGIS, HERE mapping tools, or industry-recognized software testing certifications may help accelerate your success in the role.
  
  
**What Do We Offer?**

* The opportunity to solve meaningful, large-scale problems with real-world impact.
* A collaborative, inclusive, and learning-focused work environment.
* Access to continuous learning opportunities, mentorship, and career development.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**Job Overview**

We are looking for a **Senior** **SDET** to test the resilience and correctness of distributed backend systems supporting a high-stakes account provisioning and onboarding workflow. This role is focused on the execution of pre-approved, benign tracer/replay scenarios against staging endpoints, analysis of request/response behaviour, and documentation of observable account/CID lifecycle and downstream state behaviour.

The ideal candidate has strong distributed-systems and API-testing experience and maintains disciplined technical evidence capture and traceability.

This role is not intended to perform unrestricted adversarial testing. Testing activities will be limited to approved staging environments and pre-approved benign scenarios.

**Project Details**  
  
**Title:** Senior SDET  
**Rate:** $13.5/hr
  
**Start Date:** 19th October  
**Duration:** 5 Weeks  
**Commitment**: 33 Hours per Week  
**Location:** India (Remote)  
**Job Type:** Freelance

### **Responsibilities**

* Analyze distributed system APIs to validate correctness, consistency, and failure handling across services involved in account creation, data persistence, and related record-linking
* Execute pre-approved request variations and boundary-validation scenarios using sanitized tracer payloads against designated staging endpoints.
* Investigate system behavior under malformed, malicious, or unexpected inputs and document findings clearly
* Capture complete request/response evidence, including HTTP status codes, latency, headers, and payload bodies, subject to approved data-handling requirements.
* Validate behavior of near-real-time inline checks (evaluated within milliseconds at the gateway) as distinct from longer-running background verification/risk pipelines (evaluated over minutes to hours), confirming each layer of defense behaves as expected
* Verify data persistence, referential integrity, and correct linkage of related records/relationships written by backend services during processing
* Execute controlled replay suites and compare expected versus observed API behavior.
* Correlate replay results with the API schemas and network evidence produced by the Middleware SDET.
* Document observable account/CID lifecycle behavior and downstream state changes for handoff
* Capture and archive test logs and evidence in a structured, retrievable format to support audits and post-incident reviews
* Collaborate with backend engineering teams to reproduce, isolate, and validate fixes for distributed-system defects
* Contribute to test strategy for backend/middleware reliability, including failure-mode and chaos-style testing
* Maintain traceability between test evidence, defects, and system requirements
* Reconcile backend observations with the frontend FSM and middleware/API evidence produced by earlier workstreams.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Strong experience of **5-8+ years** in testing distributed systems and analyzing inter-service API behavior
* Hands-on experience with request payload tampering, fuzzing, or adversarial API testing techniques
* Understanding of layered defense architectures, including the distinction between synchronous/inline validation and asynchronous/background verification processes
* Familiarity with testing data persistence and relational/hierarchical integrity in backend data stores
* Demonstrated discipline in test log archival, evidence capture, and structured documentation practices
* Solid understanding of backend/middleware architecture, failure modes, and system boundaries
* Familiarity with API testing tools and scripting for building custom fuzzing/tampering test cases
* Strong analytical and investigative skills for root-causing complex, systemic defects
* Experience executing controlled API replay or staging validation is strongly preferred.
* Experience correlating API responses with observable application/account lifecycle states is preferred.
* Experience supporting audit, compliance, or evidence-based reporting requirements is a plus

title: Lead Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**Overview**

We are seeking a Lead SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test ) to provide end-to-end technical governance across all QA layers — frontend, middleware, and backend — for a complex, multi-layered onboarding platform. This role owns the architecture of API contract testing and the data modeling of complex entity relationships (e.g., hierarchical/parent-child style structures), while ensuring that quality assumptions made at one layer (such as client-side validation) are independently verified at every downstream layer rather than trusted at face value. The ideal candidate combines strong technical leadership with the ability to set and enforce delivery governance across cross-functional teams.

**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Provide technical governance across frontend, middleware, and backend testing layers.
* Establish and enforce QA delivery standards, evidence requirements, review processes, and quality gates.
* Review frontend constraint dictionaries and FSM/state-model outputs for completeness and consistency.
* Review API schema reconstructions, network evidence, and tracer replay outputs for technical quality and traceability.
* Coordinate with QA Analysts, SDETs, and Test Operations Associates to align technical execution with delivery timelines.
* Review test architecture decisions, validation approaches, and coverage strategies.
* Coordinate dependency resolution, evidence rework, and cross-layer reconciliation throughout the engagement.
* Act as the escalation point for cross-layer technical discrepancies and evidence-quality issues.
* Compile and quality-check the raw technical evidence dossiers produced by the workstreams.
* Identify evidence gaps, inconsistencies, or areas requiring rework before handoff to client stakeholders.
* Report on delivery health, technical risks, evidence quality, dependencies, and unresolved gaps.
* Prepare the technical evidence package for handoff to the client team responsible for final modelling and logic-gap assessment.
* Support technical readout preparation by ensuring that findings are traceable to empirical evidence.

**Project Details**

**Title**: Lead SDET **Rate:** $17/hr  
**Start Date:** 19th October  
**Duration:** 4 Months  
**Commitment:** 22 Hours per Week  
**Location:** India (Remote)  
**Job Type:** Contractual (with the possibility of a Full-time employment extension based on performance and project needs)

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Proven experience of 8+ years in a QA leadership role spanning multiple testing layers (frontend, middleware, backend)
* Demonstrated expertise in API contract testing architecture and governance
* Practical experience with knowledge graph or entity-relationship data modeling and its application to test/data traceability
* Strong understanding of layered system architectures and the importance of independently verifying quality at each layer rather than relying on upstream assumptions
* Strong track record of technical delivery governance, including setting standards and quality gates
* Excellent cross-functional leadership and stakeholder communication skills
* Deep technical grounding across QA disciplines (manual, automation, systems-level testing) to credibly guide teams at every layer
* Experience mentoring or managing SDETs and QA Analysts
* Experience leading complex multi-week technical QA, API validation, or security-assessment engagements is strongly preferred.
* Experience establishing evidence/traceability models across complex technical workflows is preferred.
* Familiarity with knowledge graphs, entity-relationship models, or structured technical dependency/evidence modeling is preferred; deep knowledge-graph engineering expertise is not required.
* Ability to synthesize technical evidence into concise stakeholder-ready findings and handoff materials.

title: QA Engineer
description:
Actowiz Solutions
  
  
QA Engineer
  
  
0-2 years
  
  
Ahmedabad
  
  
Full-Time
  
  
****About The Role****
We are looking for a detail-oriented QA Engineer to join our R&D Department. The candidate will be responsible for validating web-scraped data, reviewing sample files, testing API responses, verifying client-specific requirements, and ensuring that all deliverables meet defined quality standards before submission.
  
  
The candidate will work closely with developers, Team Leads (TLs), and Assistant Team Leads (ATLs) to identify defects, maintain quality benchmarks, and prevent recurring data extraction issues.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Data Quality Assurance


+ Validate scraped data against the source website and client requirements.
+ Verify field-level accuracy, completeness, consistency, and data types.
+ Identify missing fields, incorrect values, duplicate records, and formatting issues.
+ Validate product details, pricing, availability, URLs, identifiers, and other relevant attributes.

* Sample and Deliverable Validation


+ Review sample files before they are marked as QA-passed or submitted to clients.
+ Ensure that the output structure, column names, file naming conventions, and data formats match the specified requirements.
+ Validate samples against the approved requirements and reference examples.
+ Maintain evidence of validation and document any defects identified.

* API Testing


+ Validate API requests and responses, including HTTP status codes, response structures, required fields, and error handling.
+ Verify JSON, CSV, Excel, and other required output formats.
+ Test pagination, filtering, and relevant request parameters wherever applicable.
+ Use Postman or similar tools for API validation.

* Defect Management and RCA


+ Report defects with clear descriptions, sample records, screenshots, and reproduction steps.
+ Coordinate with developers and TLs/ATLs for defect resolution and retesting.
+ Identify recurring quality issues and contribute to Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
+ Maintain defect logs and track issues until closure.

* Quality Process Improvement


+ Develop and maintain QA checklists for different projects and platforms.
+ Identify opportunities to automate repetitive validation tasks using Python.
+ Track quality metrics, including defect rates, first-pass acceptance, rework, and sample rejection trends.
+ Recommend improvements to reduce recurring errors and improve delivery reliability.

****Required Skills****




+ Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
+ Experience in manual testing, data validation, or software QA.
+ Basic to intermediate Python knowledge for data validation and automation.
+ Experience working with JSON, CSV, Excel, and structured datasets.
+ Understanding of REST APIs, HTTP methods, status codes, and response validation.
+ Familiarity with Postman, Excel, and basic SQL/MongoDB queries.
+ Excellent attention to detail and documentation skills.

****Preferred Qualifications****




+ Experience in web scraping, crawling, e-commerce data, or data extraction projects.
+ Knowledge of HTML, CSS selectors, XPath, and browser developer tools.
+ Experience with automated testing frameworks or data comparison scripts.
+ Familiarity with Git and issue-tracking systems.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**




+ Accuracy and completeness of QA validation.
+ Number of defects identified before client submission.
+ Reduction in recurring defects and sample rejections.
+ Compliance with project-specific QA checklists.
+ Timely completion of QA reviews.
+ Quality and completeness of defect reports and RCAs.
+ Effectiveness of retesting and defect closure.

**Expected Outcome**
The QA Engineer will establish an independent quality checkpoint within the R&D workflow, ensuring that samples and deliverables are validated against client requirements before final approval and reducing avoidable rework and quality escalations.

title: Sr Product Manager
description:
**The Company**
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
  
  
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
  
  
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
  
  
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
  
  
**Job Summary:**
This job focuses to define and own the product strategy and roadmap for Payments and Payouts Platform including, card acquiring, bank payment processing, and payouts, balancing customer needs, business value, and technical dependencies. Gathering customer experience insights to inform product requirements and analyzing research, market data, and usability studies for data-driven decision-making. Own payment lifecycle requirements, including processing, settlement, reconciliation, payouts, and exception handling. Collaborate with business teams, engineering, architects, operations, risk, and compliance to build scalable capabilities and ensure launch readiness.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Uses data to build insights on product or platform requirements consistent with the shared vision for the product.
* Gathers insights from the customer experience and customer needs to input to product requirements
* Analyzes research, market analysis and usability studies, research and market analysis to support data-driven decision making
* Monitors product profitability measures, including budget.
* Lead sprint planning, daily standups and retrospectives to drive execution. Interfaces with product and technology leadership as needed.
* Partners with content developers, data scientists, product designers and user experience researchers to identify new opportunities.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:**
**Must-Have:**

* Must have atleast 3+years of relevant Product Management experience into Payments/Card Acquiring
* Define and own the product strategy and roadmap for Payments and Payouts Platform including, card acquiring, bank payment processing, and payouts, balancing customer needs, business value, and technical dependencies.
* Gather customer and stakeholder requirements and translate them into actionable product requirements, workflows, and acceptance criteria.
* Lead end-to-end product development, from discovery and solution design through delivery, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with business teams, engineering, architects, operations, risk, and compliance to build scalable capabilities and ensure launch readiness.
* Own payment lifecycle requirements, including processing, settlement, reconciliation, payouts, and exception handling.
* Resolve customer issues, processing challenges, and delivery blockers through hands-on problem solving and root-cause analysis.
* Maintain stakeholder alignment, define success metrics, and remain accountable for product delivery and outcomes.

**Subsidiary:**
PayPal
  
  
**Travel Percent:**
0
  
  
PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact-us.
  
  
For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations.
  
  
**Our Benefits:**
At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health.
  
  
**Who We Are:**
Click Here to learn more about our culture and community.
  
  
**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com.
  
  
**Belonging at PayPal:**
Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal.

title: Justdial - Product Manager - Smart Assist
description:
**Job Description**
Build the AI that runs a business's front desk | PM - Smart Assist, JustDial
  
  
Every day, lakhs of Indian businesses miss calls, lose customers and leave money on the table. We're building Smart Assist: an AI receptionist that doesn't just pick up the phone, it runs the conversation.
  
  
It answers every call, understands what the customer wants, handles objections, negotiates and closes. Next, it picks up the phone itself, making outbound calls to follow up, re-engage and sell on the vendor's behalf.
  
  
We want a PM to take this from a smart bot to a bot that grows businesses.
  
  
**What You'll Build**

* The brain of the bot: how it handles calls, reads intent and responds the way a great receptionist would
* Outbound calling: follow-ups, reminders, re-engagement and selling
* Intelligence on top: call insights, lead quality and smart next actions for the vendor
* Advanced features that make vendors say "I can't run my business without this"
* GTM: taking what you build to market and making it land

Along the way you'll talk to vendors and users constantly, own the roadmap, keep a sharp eye on competitors, and rally tech, design, sales and leadership around your plan.
  
  
**You're Our Person If You**

* Are from IIT / IIM / FMS / IIFT or an equivalent tier-1 institute
* Have 2 - 3 years of experience owning a product, not just shipping tickets
* Are self-driven: you spot the problem, own it and push it through without waiting to be told
* Get energy from talking to users and turning messy feedback into sharp product
* Can manage stakeholders and drive a launch end to end
* Bonus: You've built or worked closely on voice bots or conversational AI

This is not a maintain-the-roadmap role. It's a take-it-to-the-next-level role.

* Experience working in a Startup, Small, or Mid-sized organization with a fast-paced, high-ownership culture will be highly preferred.

title: Associate Product Manager - Onboarding
description:
Overview:

***Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity***

With 4,300 employees and over 400,000 retail and institutional clients from more than 80 offices spread across five continents, we’re a Fortune-100, Nasdaq-listed provider, connecting clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.

At StoneX, we offer you the opportunity to be part of an institutional-grade financial services network that connects companies, organizations, and investors to the global markets ecosystem. As a team member, you'll benefit from our unique blend of digital platforms, comprehensive clearing and execution services, personalized high-touch support, and deep industry expertise. Elevate your career with us and make a significant impact in the world of global finance.

Immerse yourself in the best-in-class institutional-grade technology, working alongside industry experts and gaining exposure to various asset classes, such as equities, options, fixed income securities, and advanced trading, research, and management technology.

Responsibilities:

**Position Purpose:**

StoneX is modernising client onboarding and setup across the firm. This multi-year programme will replace fragmented and duplicated processes with a controlled, scalable capability spanning due diligence and KYC/AML through account creation, entitlements, credit and risk setup, reference data and trading readiness.

The Onboarding Product Management team bridges the technical and business worlds, working closely with Engineering, Business Analysis, Compliance/AML and other business functions to deliver this capability. As an Associate Product Manager, you will lead analysis within defined onboarding workstreams, work with stakeholders to identify improvement opportunities, and help translate agreed changes into product and delivery outcomes. This may include exploring how automation and AI could streamline onboarding processes.

This is a hands-on opportunity to learn product management, work with stakeholders across regions and business lines, and influence how the onboarding experience is delivered.

**Primary duties will include:**

* Leading the analysis of current-state onboarding processes within assigned workstreams, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, control and client experience.
* Engaging stakeholders across regions and business lines to gather input, validate findings and support recommendations.
* Collecting and analysing feedback, product analytics and market insights to identify opportunities for improvement and innovation.
* Working with large data sets to identify volumes, bottlenecks and trends across onboarding processes.
* Translating product ideas into clear requirements and deliverables.
* Partnering with senior Product Managers to shape onboarding product strategy and roadmap.
* Supporting the design of the end-to-end client experience across applicable systems.
* Acting as an onboarding solutions and KYC processes subject-matter expert, representing the onboarding team internally and externally.

Qualifications:

**To land this role you will need:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in a field related to business, technology, or client solutions.
* Experience in business analysis, process analysis or product management, ideally within financial services (experience in KYC/AML, compliance, or onboarding is a plus).
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to assess processes, identify inefficiencies and propose practical improvements.
* Comfort working with large data sets to identify trends and support evidence-based recommendations.
* Experience using, or willingness to use, AI tools to support analysis and assessment work.
* Familiarity with agile methodologies, backlog management, and product delivery practices.

**What makes you stand out:**

* A relevant accreditation in Business Analysis.
* Knowledge of client onboarding and setup, including KYC/AML, client due diligence, account and entity creation, entitlements, credit and risk.
* Exposure or experience working on onboarding transformation projects across multiple regions and legal entities.
* Strong collaboration and influencing skills, with the ability to drive decisions without direct authority.

**Working environment:**

* In-office – 4 days a week.
* Some travel may be required to support stakeholder engagement across regions.

title: Brand Manager
description:
**Brand Manager**

**Experience:** 4+ Years  
**Industry:** Home Décor / Retail / Consumer / E-commerce  
**Company:** Material Depot

**About the Role**

We are looking for a creative, strategic, and hands-on Brand Manager to build and strengthen Material Depot’s brand presence across digital and offline channels. The ideal candidate will combine strong brand thinking with excellent creative sensibility, consumer understanding, and execution capabilities.

You will own brand communication, social media growth, influencer collaborations, and integrated marketing campaigns, ensuring a consistent and compelling brand identity across every customer touchpoint.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Brand Strategy & Positioning**

* Develop and execute the brand strategy in alignment with business goals and growth priorities.
* Strengthen brand positioning, identity, and messaging across online and offline channels.
* Ensure consistency in brand voice, visual identity, and customer communication.

**2. Social Media & Digital Growth**

* Own and grow the brand’s presence across Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
* Develop monthly content calendars and drive timely execution of engaging, high-quality content.
* Track content performance, audience engagement, and channel growth to continuously improve results.

**3. Influencer Marketing & Partnerships**

* Identify, onboard, and manage relevant influencers and content creators.
* Develop influencer campaigns that drive brand awareness, engagement, and consideration.
* Measure campaign performance and optimize collaborations based on outcomes.

**4. Creative Campaigns & Brand Communication**

* Conceptualize and execute integrated campaigns for product launches, store openings, festivals, and key brand moments.
* Lead creative briefs and coordinate with internal teams, agencies, designers, and content creators to take ideas from concept to execution.
* Oversee creative outputs across social media, paid advertising, website, in-store communication, and offline events.
* Maintain high standards of visual storytelling, design, and brand consistency.

**5. Brand Awareness & Marketing Initiatives**

* Plan and execute ATL, BTL, and digital initiatives to improve brand visibility and recall.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen brand presence through events, partnerships, activations, and customer engagement initiatives.
* Align brand campaigns with business objectives and customer acquisition priorities.

**6. Brand Intelligence & Performance**

* Track brand health, consumer sentiment, social media performance, campaign effectiveness, and competitor activity.
* Translate consumer insights and performance data into actionable brand strategies.
* Monitor relevant KPIs, including reach, engagement, brand awareness, campaign performance, and audience growth.

**Requirements**

* 4+ years of experience in brand management, brand marketing, or integrated marketing, preferably in consumer brands, home décor, retail, lifestyle, or e-commerce.
* Strong understanding of brand strategy, positioning, consumer behaviour, and visual identity.
* Excellent creative sensibility and an eye for design, storytelling, and detail.
* Experience managing social media channels, influencer collaborations, and integrated marketing campaigns.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work with data, interpret campaign performance, and translate insights into action.
* Excellent project management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* High ownership, accountability, and a hands-on approach to execution in a fast-paced environment.

**What We’re Looking For**

Someone who can think strategically, execute independently, and build a distinctive brand. You should be comfortable working in a fast-moving environment, managing multiple initiatives, collaborating across teams, and balancing creative excellence with measurable business impact.

Pay: ₹1,800,000.00 - ₹2,000,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Sr Product Manager
description:
**The Company**

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

**Job Summary:**

This job focuses to define and own the product strategy and roadmap for Payments and Payouts Platform including, card acquiring, bank payment processing, and payouts, balancing customer needs, business value, and technical dependencies. Gathering customer experience insights to inform product requirements and analyzing research, market data, and usability studies for data-driven decision-making. Own payment lifecycle requirements, including processing, settlement, reconciliation, payouts, and exception handling. Collaborate with business teams, engineering, architects, operations, risk, and compliance to build scalable capabilities and ensure launch readiness.

* Gathers insights from the customer experience and customer needs to input to product requirements
* Analyzes research, market analysis and usability studies, research and market analysis to support data-driven decision making
* Monitors product profitability measures, including budget.
* Lead sprint planning, daily standups and retrospectives to drive execution. Interfaces with product and technology leadership as needed.
* Partners with content developers, data scientists, product designers and user experience researchers to identify new opportunities.

**Must-Have:**

* **Must have atleast 3+years of relevant Product Management experience into Payments/Card Acquiring**
* Define and own the product strategy and roadmap for Payments and Payouts Platform including, card acquiring, bank payment processing, and payouts, balancing customer needs, business value, and technical dependencies.
* Gather customer and stakeholder requirements and translate them into actionable product requirements, workflows, and acceptance criteria.

0

title: Principal Product Manager
description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world's most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what's next.  
  
Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills.  
  
People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.

#### **About the role**

HackerRank Interviews is a live technical interviewing platform designed to evaluate how candidates solve realistic engineering problems, not just whether they can pass an algorithm test. Candidates and interviewers collaborate in a shared workspace using coding tools, production-style repositories, and Plan-Build-Review tasks. The platform also supports observable AI-assisted development, letting teams assess how candidates prompt, review, and apply AI-generated work, with observation tools and post-interview reports giving hiring teams clearer, structured evidence for decisions.  
In this role, you'll help lead the Interviews product - an AI-native, pair-programming interview experience that gives interviewers the ability to collaborate with candidates on real-world problems and code repos. You'll shape how the platform evolves across richer ADE experiences (harnesses like Claude Code and Codex CLI), Chakra Assist for evaluation, richer session observation (screen sharing, A/V), and reporting across in-product, exports, APIs and MCP. You'll work closely with engineers as collaborators and as the product's core customer and user base including senior engineering leadership as stakeholders who care deeply about this space.

#### **What you will do**

* Own the roadmap for how HackerRank Interviews evaluates AI-assisted development including richer ADE harnesses, Chakra Assist, and session observation capabilities.
* Define how the platform captures and surfaces signals on how candidates prompt, review and apply AI-generated work, so interviewers get clearer, structured evidence.
* Drive the reporting and integration strategy across in-product reporting, exports, APIs and MCP.
* Engage directly with engineering customers and users including senior engineering leadership as the primary audience for this product, translating their needs into roadmap decisions.
* Represent the product in high-visibility, customer-facing moments with composure, including when executives engage directly and unexpectedly.
* Partner closely with Engineering and Design to ship production-quality, AI-native interview experiences.
* Embrace AI - in how we operate, as well as in the product.

#### **Who you are**

* Overall 7+ years of total professional experience including at least 1 year of hands-on Software Engineering.
* 5+ years of Product Management experience, preferably building B2B SaaS, enterprise products and/or tech services and/or platforms, and you are currently working as a PM today.
* Comfortable being the technical/product voice in a room full of engineers, including stakeholders like senior engineering leadership
* Able to stay composed and sound under sudden high-visibility pressure for example, a CTO persona dropping into a live customer channel.
* A strategic thinker who can evaluate complex challenges, prioritise effectively, and balance short-term progress with long-term success.
* Deeply passionate about AI using it as a reflex across your own workflows, not just in the product you build.
* Ability to deep dive into ambitious problem statements and create customer value.
* Proven track record of successfully launching and growing new products and/or significant features.
* Ability to work in a fast paced cross team, cross geo environment and to deliver on a common vision.
* Ability to work with engineers, designers and analysts and be comfortable presenting to non-technical/business stakeholders and customers.

#### **Even better if you have**

* Hands-on fluency with agentic coding harnesses (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Copilot Workspace, or similar) deep enough to reason about what a good AI-assisted engineering actually looks like.
* Experience designing or owning a GTM motion where the buyer and user were engineers or engineering leadership, rather than a traditional non-technical economic buyer.
* Experience operating in a lean, founder-style team with no dedicated marketing support i.e., you've personally built your own sales decks, messaging and customer-facing materials before, not just briefed a marketing team.
* Background in HR tech, talent assessment, or technical hiring.
* Experience building reporting/analytics or API-level integrations (e.g. MCP, data exports) for a technical audience.

#### **You will thrive in this role if you**

* **You are a builder at heart.** You enjoy creating something from scratch, transforming ideas into tangible, high-impact products.
* **Ambiguity excites you**. You're comfortable working in undefined spaces, carving out clarity where little exists, and defining a clear vision and strategy.
* **You take a customer-first approach.** You excel at identifying unmet customer needs and turning those insights into innovative product solutions.
* **You are a strategic thinker.** You can evaluate complex challenges, prioritise effectively, and make decisions that balance short-term progress with long-term success.
* **You thrive in fast-paced environments.** You're energised by working on high-impact initiatives where priorities can shift as you gain new insights.
* **You have a bias for action.** You're not afraid to experiment, iterate, and learn quickly in pursuit of delivering exceptional outcomes.
* **You are deeply passionate about AI.** You're in the weeds and trying out AI tools constantly and are at a point where you are using AI as a reflex to try and automate several workflows in your life and 10x yourself.

**Want to learn more about HackerRank?** Check out HackerRank.com to explore our products, solutions and resources, and dive into our story and mission here.

title: Product Director- MXDR
description:
**Director, MXDR Product**

**Level**

Director

  

**Function**

Product Engineering & Development — MXDR (Managed Extended Detection & Response)

  

**Experience**

15–20 years, including 5+ years leading a security or infrastructure product at scale

**Role Summary**
================

The Director, MXDR Product owns the MXDR product line end-to-end — strategy, roadmap, delivery, and outcomes. This person sits at the intersection of engineering, architecture, security operations, sales, and customer success, converting technical capability into a coherent product that customers trust and buy. They will partner closely with the Senior Architect (who continues to own technical architecture) while taking full ownership of product direction, delivery commitments, cross-functional alignment, and executive/customer communication.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Product Ownership & Strategy**
--------------------------------

* Own the MXDR product roadmap end-to-end — define priorities, sequence releases, and make explicit trade-off calls between customer asks, competitive pressure, and technical debt.
* Translate market and customer signal (win/loss reviews, analyst reports, competitive intelligence, compliance requirements like FedRAMP/SOC 2) into a defensible product strategy.
* Own the business case for major initiatives — cost, timeline, staffing, and expected outcome — before they go to engineering, closing the gap between "good architecture" and "fundable roadmap."

**Delivery Ownership**
----------------------

* Own delivery predictability: turn architecture and design work into resourced, sequenced, trackable delivery plans with realistic timelines.
* Run the cadence that keeps delivery visible — regular progress reviews, clear status reporting (RAG/roadmap-vs-actual), and early escalation of risk rather than late surprises.
* Partner with the Senior Architect and engineering leads to convert technical designs into shippable phases with clear acceptance criteria and success metrics.

**Stakeholder Management & Communication**
------------------------------------------

* Be the primary product point of contact for CTO, executive leadership, and key customers — comfortable presenting roadmap, risk, and trade-offs to non-technical and executive audiences.
* Manage the inevitable tension between sales commitments, customer requests, and engineering capacity — and be the one who says no, with a clear rationale, when needed.
* Build and maintain trust with cross-functional stakeholders (engineering, SOC/security operations, sales, marketing, customer success, compliance) so the product roadmap reflects real constraints from every side, not just engineering's.

**Ownership & Accountability**
------------------------------

* Take end-to-end accountability for product outcomes — not just what was designed or built, but what shipped, what customers adopted, and what moved the business forward.
* Proactively surface risk (technical, delivery, market, compliance) rather than waiting to be asked — and bring a recommended path forward, not just a problem.
* Own post-release outcomes: adoption, customer feedback, support burden, and whether the product delivered the value it was built for.

**Domain & Technical Fluency**
------------------------------

* Be fluent enough in MXDR/SOC concepts (detection engineering, threat hunting, SIEM/UEBA/ITDR, incident response workflows, MITRE ATT&CK) to have a credible technical conversation with architects, customers, and analysts — without needing to be the one designing the models.
* Understand the compliance and certification landscape relevant to security products (SOC 2, FedRAMP, ISO 27001, GDPR) well enough to factor it into roadmap decisions early, not as an afterthought.
* Expertise in building AI based SDLC using AI tools.

**AI/ML, LLM, and Innovation Strategy**

* **GenAI & LLM Integration:** Design the architectural blueprint for embedding Generative AI and LLMs (via commercial APIs like OpenAI/Anthropic or open-source models like Llama/Mistral) into our existing products to deliver next-generation customer value.
* **Machine Learning Pipelines:** Leverage the **Python** ecosystem to oversee the creation of scalable ML data pipelines, MLOps frameworks, and predictive modeling features that enhance our application's intelligent capabilities.
* **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG):** Architect advanced RAG systems combining **Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch as a vector database)** and SQL to enable high-performance, context-aware semantic search and enterprise knowledge retrieval.
* **AI Security & Governance:** Establish enterprise-wide compliance, data privacy (preventing PII leakage into LLMs), and ethical guardrails for AI usage, ensuring alignment with emerging global AI regulations.
* **Internal AI Automation:** Lead initiatives to leverage AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot) and automated testing tools to improve overall engineering team velocity and code quality.

**Executive Technology Strategy & Enterprise Architecture**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* **Long-Term Technical Vision**: Define and execute a 3-to-5-year technology roadmap that scales with the company’s business growth, shifting engineering from a reactive delivery unit to a proactive business driver.
* **Polyglot Stack Governance:** Establish modern architectural guardrails and engineering standards for our composite ecosystem—ensuring seamless, secure integration between enterprise Angular frontends, distributed Python services, and high-performance .NET Web APIs.
* **Enterprise Data & Search Strategy:** Architect the future state of our data layer; guide principal engineers in optimizing high-transaction SQL databases (replication, partitioning) alongside massive Elastic Stack (ELK) clusters utilized for real-time search, analytics, and observability.
* **R&D and Innovation Leadership**: Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and AI/ML capabilities to determine their business viability, running targeted Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs) to maintain market competitiveness.
* **Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity:** Own the design and regular testing of global Disaster Recovery (DR) and High Availability (HA) strategies to guarantee maximum business continuity and strict uptime SLA compliance.

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

**Required**
------------

* 15–20 years total experience, with a meaningful portion in product development or product leadership roles for security, infrastructure, or SaaS platforms.
* 5+ years operating at Director level or equivalent scope — owning a product line's roadmap, delivery, and business outcomes, not just a feature area.
* Demonstrated track record of taking a product from architecture/vision to shipped, adopted reality — able to speak to specific products they've owned end-to-end.
* **Technical Breadth:** Previous hands-on architecture experience in enterprise Microsoft environments (.NET/C#) blended with open-source ecosystems (Python, Angular).
* Strong delivery discipline: experience running structured delivery cadences (roadmaps, sprint/release tracking, RAG reporting) and holding cross-functional teams to commitments.
* Excellent communicator — comfortable presenting to CTO/executive leadership and to customers, and able to translate deep technical detail into business language and back.
* Experience working alongside (not replacing) a strong technical architect — clear sense of where product ownership ends and architecture ownership begins, and how to partner rather than compete.
* Working knowledge of security operations concepts: detection & response, threat intelligence, SIEM/XDR/UEBA, identity security, or adjacent domains.
* Compliance & Governance Alignment: Ensure all engineering processes, data handling pipelines, and architectural patterns adhere strictly to industry certifications relevant to a scaling mid-size company (**SOC2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA**, etc.).

**Preferred**
-------------

* Prior experience specifically in MXDR, MDR, SIEM, XDR, or broader security operations product lines.
* Experience navigating compliance-driven sales cycles (FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001) and their impact on roadmap and architecture decisions.
* Experience building or scaling a product function — hiring and mentoring product managers, delivery leads, or program managers.
* Familiarity with modern detection engineering concepts (behavioral analytics, ML-based detection, identity threat detection) sufficient to evaluate technical proposals critically.

title: Senior Java Engineer
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  
  
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
  
  
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

### **Company Description**

Okta is the leading independent provider of enterprise identity. The Okta Identity Cloud enables organizations to securely connect the right people to the right technologies at the right time. With over 6,500 pre-built integrations to applications and infrastructure providers, Okta customers can easily and securely use the best technologies for their business. Over 7,950 organizations, including 20th Century Fox, JetBlue, Nordstrom, Slack, Teach for America, and Twilio, trust Okta to help protect the identities of their workforces and customers.

### **Position Description**

We are seeking an experienced **Senior Software Engineer** to play a key role in building and scaling the **Okta Recovery Vault (ORV)**. This team is responsible for Okta's enterprise-grade soft-delete and object recovery capability, designed to protect critical identity objects (Users and Groups) from accidental or malicious deletion.

As a Senior Engineer, you will own the technical design, implementation, and operational reliability of critical components within our real-time, high-fidelity recovery system. You will solve complex engineering problems around identity preservation (UUIDs) and relationship restoration—including group memberships, app assignments, and password hashes—ensuring our customers can seamlessly recover from data loss events.

### **Job Duties and Responsibilities**

* **Feature Execution:** Drive the technical design and end-to-end implementation of complex features, such as granular and bulk recovery workflows across Free and Advanced Resilience tiers.
* **Component Design:** Design and build reliable core components for real-time recovery systems that capture deletion events and support scalable data restoration.
* **Relationship & State Management:** Solve challenging engineering problems around relationship restoration (group memberships, app assignments, device enrollments) and state consistency.
* **Security & Compliance:** Implement secure logging and tracking for all recovery operations (soft-delete, restore, permanent-delete) in Syslog to adhere to strict audit and compliance standards.
* **Product & Cross-Functional Alignment:** Partner with Product Managers and technical leads to clarify requirements, define technical scope, and break down complex projects into actionable milestones.
* **Operational Excellence:** Participate in on-call rotations, troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis (RCAs), and enhance system observability, logging, and metrics.
* **Code Quality & Technical Standards:** Champion engineering best practices through thorough code reviews, automated testing, and comprehensive technical documentation.
* **Team Growth:** Provide guidance and peer mentorship to intermediate and junior engineers on the team to foster technical growth and code quality.

### **Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* **Experience:** 5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience building and scaling highly reliable, production-grade applications.
* **Java Expertise:** Strong proficiency in object-oriented programming, with extensive experience in **Java** and the **Spring Boot** framework.
* **Distributed Systems:** Solid experience with distributed system patterns, asynchronous job processing, and event-driven architectures (essential for bulk restore operations).
* **Data Management:** Proficiency with relational databases (e.g., **MySQL**) and caching strategies (e.g., **Redis**) to manage state and high-throughput data snapshots.
* **API Design:** Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining robust **RESTful APIs** for enterprise integration.
* **Problem Solving & Ownership:** Proven track record of independently breaking down ambiguous requirements into clean, scalable software designs.

### **Nice to Haves**

* Familiarity with Identity and Access Management (IAM) standards (SCIM, SAML, OAuth, OIDC) or directory services (AD, LDAP).
* Experience with resilient systems design (e.g., retry strategies, circuit breakers, rate limiting).
* Hands-on experience with feature flagging frameworks and gradual/canary deployment strategies.
* Experience with queueing systems or message brokers (e.g., Kafka).

### **Education and Training**

* **B.S. or M.S.** in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

* Gather customer, seller, and delivery feedback and translate insights into solution improvements.
* Leverage AI, automation, and reusable intellectual property to improve customer outcomes and delivery efficiency.
* Establish success metrics and measure solution adoption, customer impact, and business outcomes.

**Working Model**
=================

The Product Manager partners closely with a Solution Owner.

The Solution Owner is responsible for commercial strategy, go-to-market execution, portfolio performance, seller adoption, and business success.

The Product Manager is responsible for customer discovery, solution strategy, roadmap management, cross-functional execution, and ensuring solutions are scalable, repeatable, and ready for successful customer adoption.

==================

**Education and/or Experience Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Solutions Management, Presales, or related roles.
* Experience building enterprise solutions that combine technology, services, partner capabilities, and delivery models.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.
* Strong customer discovery, requirements definition, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience translating customer needs into scalable, repeatable offerings.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to balance customer needs, business priorities, and technical feasibility.
* Experience working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience in one or more of the following:

* Artificial Intelligence & Automation
* Cloud Platforms
* Data & Analytics
* Cybersecurity
* Digital Workplace
* Infrastructure Modernization

Experience with:

* Design Thinking
* Jobs-to-be-Done
* Agile Product Management
* Lean Product Development

**Key Performance Indicators (Examples)**
=========================================

* Customer problem statements and solution requirements validated through discovery activities.
* Roadmap commitments delivered on time and with quality.
* Time-to-market for new solutions and enhancements.
* Solution adoption and customer satisfaction.
* Delivery readiness, including documentation, playbooks, and implementation guidance.
* Reuse of accelerators, automation, AI capabilities, and reusable assets.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and cross-functional execution effectiveness.
* Measurable customer and business outcomes delivered through solutions.

*The information in this position description is intended to convey information about the key responsibilities and requirements of the position. It is not an exhaustive list of the skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities or working conditions associated with the opportunity. Position Descriptions are subject to change.*

**Customer Focus and Quality Management Responsibilities**
==========================================================

Each CDW coworker is responsible for maintaining customer focus and conforms to the CDW quality management system. Specific responsibilities include:

* Periodic reviews of CDW Circle of Service Philosophy and the Quality Policy to understand CDW’s commitment to excellent client service and continual improvement and to conform to these policies and philosophies at all times.
