At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The SAP TM Transportation Management Senior Consultant serves as a senior-level advisor responsible for leading complex SAP Transportation Management (TM) transformation initiatives for enterprise clients. This role combines deep SAP TM expertise with strategic consulting capabilities to design, implement, and optimize end-to-end transportation solutions that drive operational excellence, cost reduction, and supply chain visibility. The consultant participates in pursuing client sales opportunities and working on bid & proposal efforts along with activities including configuration and setting up the SAP TM system, assessment of client business problems, conducting the analysis to solve the problems, administration of engagement activities while contributing to practice growth and innovation.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Responsible for the successful delivery of the SAP TM module related deliverables in SAP and S4 HANA implementation, support, and upgrade projects to meet engagement objectives and budget
* Lead design workshops with the client and responsible for requirement gathering, solution design, fit-gap analysis, writing functional specification, system configuration, testing and cutover activities for both standalone SAP TM system and embedded SAP TM in S/4 HANA
* Design SAP TM system Integrations with other modules of SAP/S4 HANA (like EWM, SD, MM etc.) and 3rd Party system
* Provide functional and business process expertise to the project team, resolve TM related client s issues and mentor junior team members
* Handle various industry specific complex TM scenarios like shipper, LSP and carriers
* Work with sales team, write proposals, define SAP TM scope and effort estimation for the new opportunities and present SAP TM capability to the potential client

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Technical and Professional Requirements:**

* 8-10 years of experience in implementation, support and upgrade projects in SAP TM
* Must have good functional and business knowledge, worked in multiple E2E implementations, integration, testing and application support in S/4HANA embedded TM and SAP TM (latest versions)
* Ability to interact with other cross functional teams from modules like OTC, EWM for integration scenario
* Excellent written and verbal interpersonal skills for co-ordinating across teams
* Should be able to lead workshop or working sessions with business
* Knowledge in ABAP and debugging would be nice to have

**Core SAP TM Competencies:**

* Comprehensive knowledge in all L3 aspects of SAP TM such as Order Management (Logistics Integration, Freight Unit, Forwarding Order, Freight Order, Freight Booking), Transportation Planning and Execution, Carrier Selection, Charge Calculation and Freight Settlement, Invoice Integration and Carrier Communication methodologies
* Proficiency in Master Data setup such as Resource Management, Locations, Business Partners etc.
* Deep understanding of SAP TM integration with SAP ERP S/4HANA logistics (SD, MM, LE) and embedded TM scenarios
* Expertise in Transportation Planning strategies: manual planning, Transportation Cockpit, optimizer-based planning (VSR), and automated freight unit building
* Proficiency in Freight Order Lifecycle Management, Freight Tendering processes, Subcontracting and Execution monitoring
* Advanced knowledge of Charge calculation, Freight Agreement Management, Rate tables and Transportation cost allocation

**Technical Skills:**

* SAP TM configuration and customizing across all functional areas (master data, organizational structures, profiles setup for Planning, business rules such as BRF+ conditions)
* Data migration methodologies using DRF, LSMW, SAP Data Services, or Migration Cockpit; system landscape design (Development, Quality, Production)
* Understanding of SAP TM on HANA optimization, performance tuning, and analytics capabilities
* Expertise in implementation planning, fit-gap analysis, SAP TM system configuration E2E, testing, rollout and post-implementation support.

**Industry Knowledge:**

* Expertise in logistics and supply chain operations across multiple transportation modes (road, rail, ocean, air, intermodal)
* Knowledge of carrier management practices, freight procurement, contract negotiations, and service level agreements
* Familiarity with industry best practices, benchmarks, and emerging trends (sustainability, real-time visibility, autonomous transportation)

**Consulting Competencies:**
**Client Management**

* Proven ability to engage with client and influence strategic decision-making
* Expertise in requirements gathering through workshops, interviews, and process analysis; translating business needs into technical specifications
* Change management and organizational adoption strategies, including training program design, communication planning, and stakeholder engagement
* Project governance frameworks, steering committee management, and escalation resolution

**Solution Design**

* End-to-end solution architecture spanning SAP TM, ERP or S/4 HANA, EWM, GTS, and third-party logistics systems (TMS, WMS, visibility platforms)
* Business process optimization using Lean Six Sigma or similar methodologies; identification of automation opportunities and efficiency gains
* Integration strategy development including point-to-point, hub-based, and API-led connectivity approaches
* Oversight of custom development (ABAP, SAPUI5, BRF+) ensuring adherence to SAP standards and maintainability

**Leadership & Delivery**

* Project and program management using methodologies such as SAP Activate, Agile, or hybrid approaches.
* Leadership of diverse teams (10-30+ members) including onshore, nearshore, and offshore resources across functional and technical disciplines
* Quality assurance practices including test strategy development, UAT coordination, cutover planning, and post-go-live support
* Risk management, issue resolution, and proactive communication to ensure on-time, on-budget delivery

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Degree in Engineering or MBA in Supply Chain Area.
* Desired to have SAP certification on SAP TM.
* Having experience of working in integration area of SAP TM and other areas.
* Minimum of 8-10 years of experience in SAP TM.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

We are seeking a collaborative, analytical, and delivery-focused **Technology Product Management Lead Analyst (C13)** to support the evolution of Citi's **Operating Model AI (OMAI)** platform. This role will serve as a key liaison between Business, Operations, Risk, Controls, Data, AI/Analytics, and Technology teams to deliver scalable solutions that enhance operational transparency, governance, reporting, workflow management, and data-driven decision making across the organization.

The successful candidate will partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering teams, Business Stakeholders, and End Users to translate strategic objectives into actionable requirements, manage a prioritized backlog, and drive the successful delivery of platform capabilities. The role requires strong product ownership, business analysis, stakeholder management, and Agile execution skills, with the ability to balance business priorities, technology constraints, and governance requirements.

The ideal candidate must be adaptable, execution-oriented, data-driven, and capable of managing risks, removing impediments, and delivering high-quality outcomes while building strong partnerships across a diverse stakeholder base.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Partner with business stakeholders, product leadership, engineering teams, and end users to define and deliver OMAI platform capabilities.
* Gather, analyze, and document business, process, system, and data requirements.
* Translate business objectives into Epics, Features, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and Process Flows.
* Create, prioritize, and maintain a well-groomed product backlog aligned with business priorities.
* Ensure requirements meet Definition of Ready and Definition of Done standards.
* Facilitate workshops, working sessions, demos, and stakeholder reviews to drive alignment and clarity.
* Partner with Agile teams throughout sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and release activities.
* Provide ongoing functional guidance and requirement clarification to development and QA teams.
* Coordinate across Product, Engineering, Data, AI, Operations, Governance, and Risk teams to drive delivery.
* Analyze current-state and future-state processes and identify opportunities for automation, efficiency gains, and workflow optimization.
* Support implementation of AI-enabled capabilities, analytics, reporting enhancements, and workflow automation.
* Validate delivered functionality against business requirements and expected outcomes.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect triage, and release readiness activities.
* Monitor delivery metrics, user feedback, and platform adoption to drive continuous improvement.
* Drive process improvements related to requirements management, Agile execution, prioritization, and delivery governance.
* Act as the voice of the customer while balancing competing business and technology priorities.
* Communicate roadmap updates, risks, dependencies, and delivery progress to stakeholders and leadership.
* Assess and manage risks appropriately, ensuring adherence to applicable policies, controls, and governance standards.
  

  

**Recommended Qualifications:**

* 6-10 years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or related Technology roles.
* 5+ years of experience defining and documenting business, managing product backlogs, Epics, Features, User Stories, and Acceptance Criteria.
* Strong experience working in Agile environments utilizing Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or similar methodologies.
* Experience with AI-assisted tools, automation technologies, workflow platforms, and digital transformation initiatives is preferred.
* Experience partnering with Technology, Data, QA, Operations, and Business stakeholders throughout the product lifecycle.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize competing initiatives, manage multiple workstreams, and successfully deliver complex programs.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence outcomes and drive consensus across multiple teams and organizations.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence or similar product management and collaboration tools.
* Ability to create process flows, business requirements documents, functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and user journey maps.
* Working knowledge of SQL, reporting tools, analytics platforms, and data management concepts.
* Exceptional communication, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking abilities with keen attention to detail.
* Ability to influence without direct authority and effectively communicate complex business and technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong organizational skills, execution focus, and the ability to adapt and perform in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
* Proactive self-starter with a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and commitment to delivering business value.
* Experience within Financial Services, Banking, Risk, Controls, Compliance, Operational Excellence, or Data Management organizations is preferred.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**Job Description Summary**

As an Associate Product Manager at Alacriti, you will drive the vision, roadmap, and development of our cloud-native money movement and payments platform. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, performant, and developer-friendly payment solutions that delight users and accelerate digital transformation for our financial clients. We are seeking candidates with 3+ years of product management experience, specifically with a track record of owning platform, API, or developer-facing products end-to-end.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

* Develop the long-term vision and strategy for the product and create and execute on a compelling roadmap
* Build deep user empathy with Alacriti’s clients and partners, understanding global payment industry trends and competitors' offerings to influence the roadmap effectively
* Collaborate with engineering, design and other teams to jointly shape product experiences that delight end-users
* Ensure we are building a reliable, performant platform, including system reliability, API extensibility, and latency
* Use metrics to inform point of view and leverage analytics to measure success
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a knack for precise and concise articulation of user problems
* Strong analytical capabilities with experience defining and tracking success metrics, running experiments (e.g., holdback tests), and using data to measure product impact on revenue, adoption and margins
* Experience working on products that require aligning multiple stakeholders, developing joint roadmaps, and navigating competing priorities between internal goals and external partner objectives
* Ability to thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment with significant autonomy and responsibility
* Strong business acumen and comfort with complex ecosystem and platform-level problems

**Who you are**

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

* You are a product builder who can move easily between a user’s hardest problem, the business opportunity behind it, and the product decisions needed to solve it.
* You have worked on technically complex products - such as APIs, developer tools, shared platform capabilities, or core product experiences - but you do not build tech/platform for its own sake. You see strong platform design as a way to help users move faster, create better products, and unlock new business models.
* You are opinionated, thoughtful, and execution-oriented. You can focus a team on the few decisions that matter most, create momentum in ambiguous situations, and ship products that raise the bar for both quality and impact.

Key Requirements

* **Product Management Experience:**
  3+ years of experience in Product Management, with end-to-end ownership of platform, API, or developer-facing products.
* **Product Strategy and Execution:**
  Demonstrated experience in roadmap development, feature prioritization, product delivery, and outcome measurement.
* **Payments and FinTech Knowledge:**
  Strong understanding of payment processing, money movement, transaction flows, payment ecosystems, or financial technology products.
* **Technical Product Understanding:**
  Ability to work with APIs, platform capabilities, technical requirements, and engineering teams to deliver scalable solutions.
* **Data-Driven Decision-Making:**
  Experience defining product success metrics, analyzing performance data, and measuring business impact.
* **Customer-Centric Mindset:**
  Strong problem-discovery skills and the ability to translate user needs into effective product solutions.
* **Stakeholder Management:**
  Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to align cross-functional teams and external partners.
* **Business Acumen:**
  Ability to understand business models, customer value, revenue opportunities, and complex platform-level challenges.
* **Go-to-Market Collaboration:**
  Experience working with Sales and Marketing teams on product launches, positioning, enablement, and adoption.
* **Execution and Ownership:**
  Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

* **Education:**
  B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred.
* **Domain Experience:**
  Prior experience in payments, FinTech, banking technology, or financial infrastructure is an advantage.
* **Platform Product Experience:**
  Experience converting customized or client-specific solutions into scalable, reusable product capabilities.
* **API and Developer Products:**
  Experience building or managing API-first products, developer-facing platforms, or technical integrations.
* **Strategic Product Thinking:**
  Ability to anticipate future customer needs and make well-judged foundational product investments.
* **Experimentation and Analytics:**
  Experience with product experiments, holdback tests, performance measurement, and data-driven optimization.

description:

· Partner with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Operations, Finance, and executive stakeholders to align priorities and drive execution.

Qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related discipline.

· MBA or advanced degree is a plus.

· 8+ years of product management experience delivering digital products from strategy through execution.

· Demonstrated experience defining long-term product strategy and delivering complex products with measurable customer and business impact.

· Experience leading products or platforms that span multiple teams or organizational boundaries.

· Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage qualitative and quantitative insights to drive strategic decisions.

· Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and align cross-functional organizations without direct authority.

· Excellent written, verbal, and executive communication skills.

· Proven ability to make high-quality decisions in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

· Experience balancing strategic planning with hands-on product execution.

Preferred Experience

· Customer-facing digital products

· Enterprise software or operational platforms

· Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning applications

· Automation and workflow optimization

· Data products and analytics

· Mobile applications

· Experimentation, A/B testing, or optimization

· Pricing, commerce, marketplace, or operational products

Success in this Role

· Exceptional customer obsession and product judgment.

· Strategic leadership with the ability to influence decisions across the organization.

· Ownership of large, ambiguous business problems from strategy through execution.

· Strong systems thinking and the ability to identify scalable solutions.

· Data-driven decision making balanced with sound product intuition.

· Executive presence and ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership.

· Ability to mentor and elevate other Product Managers.

Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. title: Edge & Physical AI HW Product Manager/Director
description:

* Partner with the i.MX, S32 SoC, i.MCU, and RT product teams to define NPU IP integration requirements, including power domains, bus interfaces, memory bandwidth allocation, software-hardware co-design constraints, SoC bring-up, and debugging.

* Manage product lifecycle from definition through ramp, sustaining, and EOL — including customer transition plans across generations

* Co-own SW development of dNPU, integrated and chiplet based designs w/ the SW product manager
* Develop end-to-end system solutions and demonstration platforms for hardware and software developers at industry events and conferences.

**Job Qualifications**

* 10+ years of product management or product strategy experience in semiconductor or silicon IP, with direct ownership of hardware product definition and roadmap
* Hands-on experience defining silicon product specifications — performance targets, memory architecture, power envelopes, packaging, and process node decisions
* Strong understanding of SoC and IP integration — experience defining IP for integration into a host processor or SoC is strongly preferred
* Familiarity with chiplet architectures and multi-chip interconnect standards (UCIe, BoW, or equivalent) is a significant plus
* Track record of driving design wins and customer adoption across multiple product generations
* Ability to build and defend business cases including BOM cost, ASP, gross margin, and market sizing
* Experience with competitive analysis and differentiation strategy in a fast-moving semiconductor segment
* Strong cross-functional leadership skills — ability to drive alignment across architecture, engineering, sales, marketing, and executive stakeholders
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to represent complex technical tradeoffs to both engineering teams and executive audiences

**Good To Have**

* Direct experience in AI/ML inference silicon — NPU, GPU, or inference accelerator product management
* Familiarity with inference workloads including CNNs, transformers, LLMs, and VLM variants deployed at the edge
* Experience working with ODMs, OEMs, and contract manufacturers on board design, system integration, and production
* Background in industrial, automotive, or embedded edge markets
* MBA or advanced degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related discipline

title: Leading Associate Vice President - Product Owner - CMDB & Asset Management [T500-25882]
description:
**About Deutsche Börse Group:**

Headquartered in Frankfurt, Germany, Deutsche Börse Group is a leading international exchange organization and market infrastructure provider. They empower investors, financial institutions, and companies by facilitating access to global capital markets.

Their India center is located in Hyderabad, serves as a key strategic hub and comprises India’s top-tier tech talent. They focus on crafting advanced IT solutions that elevate market infrastructure and services. Deutsche Börse Group in India is composed of a team of capital market engineers forming the backbone of financial markets worldwide.

**Field of activity:**

Corporate IT – together with the CTO Area - is driving together the Implementation of ServiceNow for IT Service & Asset Management. This is a multi-year program professionalizing and standardizing the handling of CMDB, Asset Management, ITSM and other processes/activities. The IT SAM Program is pursuing a.o. following goals:

* Deliver a group wide IT Service & Asset Management Platform in the cloud in line with the enterprise architecture
* Replace legacy technology (CRM7) to Cloud native technology track
* Drive cultural change form proprietary DBG specific implementation into a SaaS solution

**Your Mission:**

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Product Owner to lead the topic of CMDB, Configuration and Asset Management in our IT Service & Asset Management (IT SAM) capabilities. You will be at the heart of our digital transformation, driving the implementation and evolution of our new central platform. This is a key role in shifting our culture from a legacy, process-heavy environment to a modern, cloud-native, and service-oriented model.

If you are a practical leader who thinks in terms of products and services that deliver real value, and you are passionate about building modern IT solutions, this is the role for you. We need a doer, not just a theorist, who can cut through complexity and guide our organization towards a more efficient and user-centric future.

**Tasks / Responsibilities:**

* **Own the Product Vision & Strategy:**
  You will define and champion a clear product vision for IT Service and Asset Management. You'll translate the strategic goals of our multi-year transformation program into a prioritized, value-driven product backlog. This includes owning, developing, maintaining, prioritizing and securing completeness of the Product Backlog with, on top of business requirements, external and internal audit items, BAU activities and Enablers.
* **Lead with a Practical Mindset:**
  While familiarity with ITIL is essential, your focus will be on practical application. You will pragmatically balance business needs with governance requirements, ensuring we build effective services, not just "paper tiger" processes.
* **Drive Agile Execution**
  : As the "Voice of the Customer," you will guide our Agile development team. This includes breaking down features into clear user stories, defining objectives, goals and acceptance criteria, and ensuring the team is always working on what matters most. You will be the final authority on accepting work, using Behaviour-Driven Development (BDD) practices and practices like Definition of Ready (DoR) and the Definition of Done (DoD), ensuring the final product meets our high standards.
* **Champion Service Adoption & Value:**
  You will own the strategy for product adoption, ensuring users understand and benefit from the new platform. A key part of your role will be evaluating new features from our SaaS vendor to ensure we are maximizing the value of our investment.
* **Collaborate and Communicate:**
  You will be the central point of contact between senior stakeholders, business users, and the development team. Your ability to communicate clearly and manage relationships at all levels will be critical to aligning everyone on the product roadmap and ensuring smooth execution.
* **Manage the Basics:**
  This includes managing JIRA / Confluence / SharePoint together with the Product Team. Organizing, preparing and following up different types of program meetings. Contributing to program communication content and channels (mail, newsletter, intranet)

**Qualifications / Required skills:**

* **Proven Product Ownership Experience:**
  5+ years of experience as a Product Owner (or similar role) in a large-scale, enterprise Agile environment.
* **Deep Domain Expertise:**
  Strong, hands-on experience with IT Configuration, IT Asset Management (ITAM) and IT Service Management (ITSM) processes and a deep understanding of the underlying data (CMDB).
* **Practical SaaS Implementation Skills:**
  Demonstrated experience in implementing and managing enterprise SaaS solutions (ServiceNow experience is a significant advantage). You understand how to leverage out-of-the-box capabilities over excessive customization.
* **A Product & Service Mentality:**
  You are a strategic thinker who focuses on customer needs and delivering tangible business value. You have a track record of simplifying complex problems and communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* **Leadership & Influence:**
  Excellent communication, negotiation, and decision-making skills. You are confident engaging with stakeholders at all levels and can operate effectively in a multi-national environment.
* **Industry Context:**
  Experience working in the financial services industry or another highly regulated environment is highly desirable.
* **Language:**
  Excellent proficiency in written and spoken English is required. Basic German is a plus.

title: Product Owner
description:
**About StarRez**
StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1,400+ clients across 25+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user-friendly, all-in-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Product Owner, you will be responsible for the end-to-end delivery of product workstreams, acting as the bridge between Product Managers and the development teams. While the Product Manager focuses more on leading the relevant product vision and strategy and generating impactful roadmaps, your role will be to ensure flawless execution of that body of work in conjunction with your Product Engineering team. That includes owning requirements and Acceptance Criteria, grooming the backlog and helping deliver quality software to market.
  
  
Additionally, you will own and lead well defined projects, as agreed with the Product Manager, to deliver incremental value toward the Product and Technology department's goals. Ultimately, the Product Manager and the Product Owner collaborate to deliver world class outcomes for our business.
  
  
**What You Will Own**
**Backlog Management & Prioritization**

* Own and manage the product backlog for your assigned product or workstream.
* Collaborate with the Product Manager to understand product goals and ensure backlog prioritization aligns with strategic objectives.
* Clearly define user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical requirements in collaboration with the engineering and design teams.

**Delivery Execution**

* Maintain alignment with the product roadmap, ensuring backlog items are prioritized and executed in line with roadmap goals.
* Identify and independently own well defined initiatives, as agreed with the Product Manager, ensuring successful delivery of these workstreams.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Coordinate with Product Managers to gather business requirements and translate them into actionable tasks.
* Collaborate closely with the Product Manager to ensure all executed work aligns with the product vision and strategic outcomes for the area.
* Actively engage with cross-functional teams, including Engineering, Design, Quality, and Customer Success.

**Refinement & Continuous Improvement**

* Assist backlog refinement sessions, sprint planning, and retrospectives, continuously improving processes and team effectiveness.
* Support all relevant agile processes that the team follows, ensuring high levels of collaboration and accountability.
* Analyze and incorporate feedback from users, Quality, and internal stakeholders to refine features and improve outcomes.

**Product Quality & Value Delivery**

* Collaborate to ensure the delivered product increments meet quality standards and deliver value to users.
* Track and report on key delivery metrics, identifying areas for improvement and ensuring alignment with product goals.
* Ensure proper documentation of delivered features and support the go-to market process in collaboration with Product Managers.
* Work with the Product Manager to determine optimizations to live features and incremental work that may further enhance the delivery of outcomes.

**Required Qualification**

* 3+ years of experience as a Product Owner, or similar role in a SaaS environment.
* Strong understanding of agile product development frameworks, including Scrum or Kanban.
* Proven track record of managing complex product backlogs and delivering high impact features on time.
* Excellent collaboration skills with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, and QA.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey requirements and priorities to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Analytical mindset, with the ability to break down complex problems into actionable solutions.
* Experience working closely with Product Managers to translate strategic goals into deliverable tasks.
* Familiarity with product management and development tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Miro etc)

**Preferred Qualification**

* Experience working in B2B SaaS, particularly in Property Tech or Housing.
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar agile certification.
* Understanding of user-centered design principles and product discovery techniques.

**Reasons to Join Our Team**
StarRez is not just a workplace—it's a place to belong, build, and grow.
  
  

* A Culture That Lasts: Many of our team members have been with us for 20+ years—a testament to our people-first philosophy.
* Global Impact, Local Ownership: Join a team that spans across Australia, the USA, the UK, and Canada, working on industry-leading solutions, while building the centre up from ground up.
* Long-Term Vision: We're not here for short-term gains. We invest in our people for the long haul, creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and thrive.
* Innovation with Stability: Backed by Vista Equity Partners, we combine the agility of a scaling SaaS company with the stability of long-term industry leadership.
* Z-Factor: We take pride in our culture of passion, care, and high performance. The Z-Factor defines how we support our teams, foster growth, and ensure that everyone at StarRez thrives.

StarRez is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Development Manager- AI Product Development
description:
**Job Location: Hyderabad**

**Role Overview**

* We are looking for a Development Manager who will bring structure, rigour, and technical depth to how we build our AI products. This is a role for someone who is as comfortable deep in system design and architecture decisions as they are running a sprint, reviewing code, and shaping engineering culture. You will lead the development of AI products — solutions at the intersection of data analytics and enterprise software — working alongside a team of intelligent, high-energy engineers who set a high bar for themselves. We want a builder-leader — someone who brings structured thinking to product development, keeps the team sharp and focused, and is genuinely excited about where AI is taking enterprise software.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Structured Product Development**

* Establish and drive a structured, repeatable approach to product development across AI product portfolio — covering planning, architecture, sprint execution, and release discipline.
* Own the end-to-end development lifecycle: from requirements and system design through build, test, deployment, and continuous improvement.
* Introduce and enforce engineering best practices — code quality, documentation standards, design reviews, and testing frameworks — that scale with the team and the products.
* Bring clarity and predictability to delivery without sacrificing the team's pace and engineering ambition.

**Technical Leadership & System Design**

* Lead system design and architecture decisions for AI-powered product features — ensuring solutions are scalable, cost-efficient, and built for the long term.
* Drive cost optimisation strategies for AI features, including model selection, inference efficiency, caching strategies, and smart resource allocation.
* Conduct meaningful code and design reviews — setting a high technical bar while helping the team grow through constructive, experience-backed feedback.
* Identify technical risks early and make clear, well-reasoned calls on trade-offs across build quality, speed, and scalability.

**AI-Savvy Development Practices**

* Champion best practices for AI-based product development — including responsible LLM integration, prompt engineering governance, hallucination mitigation, evaluation frameworks, and AI observability.
* Guide the team in making pragmatic decisions around AI adoption: when to build, when to buy, and how to integrate third-party AI capabilities cleanly into product architecture.
* Stay ahead of evolving AI tooling, frameworks, and patterns — bringing relevant ideas and approaches back to the team proactively.
* Team & Delivery
* Lead a team of intelligent and highly capable engineers — your role is to amplify their output, not manage their time.
* Run effective sprint planning, retrospectives, and delivery cycles — keeping the team focused, unblocked, and aligned to product priorities.
* Work closely with the Product Leader to translate the product roadmap into well-scoped, executable development plans; provide regular progress updates and proactively surface risk factors, dependencies, and blockers before they impact delivery.
* Foster a culture of ownership, curiosity, and continuous learning — where engineers feel challenged and take pride in what they ship.

**Required Qualifications**

**Experience**

* 10–12 years of overall experience in software or product development, with a strong hands-on engineering background throughout.
* At least 3 years of experience leading a development team — with a track record of shipping well- engineered, production-grade software.
* Demonstrated experience building structured development processes in fast-paced, product-driven environments.
* Prior experience working on or alongside AI-integrated products — whether LLM-based features, ML pipelines, or intelligent automation — is an advantage.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong hands-on proficiency in Java for backend development; working knowledge of Python, particularly for AI/ML integration and data processing workflows.
* Solid understanding of system design principles — including distributed systems, API design, data modelling, and scalability patterns.
* Good hands-on experience with AI/LLM integration patterns, prompt engineering, cost optimisation in AI workloads, and responsible AI practices in product development.
* Good understanding of DevOps best practices — including CI/CD pipelines, version control workflows, containerisation, automated testing, and release management.
* Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure preferred) and modern SaaS architecture patterns.

title: (Agentic) Product Manager
description:
**About This Role**
We are building a durable execution process engine – a platform that bridges enterprise workflow automation and intelligent agent orchestration. This is a zero-to-one product launch from concept to market.
  
  
You will lead the product strategy and execution for one of three interconnected pillars in the platform (Durable Processes, Data Connectors, AI Agents). Working alongside peer PMs and reporting to the Group PM, you'll own the complete customer journey: from defining what we build, to shipping it, to ensuring it lands with users.
  
  
This role is for a PM who has shipped complex, multi-layer platform products before and who thrives in the tension between technical ambition and customer reality.
  
  
**The Product Vision**
A durable execution engine that scales from developer laptops to enterprise clouds, bringing workflow automation, intelligent agents, and real-time data integration into one coherent platform.
  
  
Modern enterprises are stuck. Legacy workflow systems are rigid and don't integrate with AI. Code-first pipelines (Airflow, Temporal) give developers freedom but leave business analysts behind. We're building the bridge.
  
  
**Our Platform Will**

* Work for multiple personas – Business analysts author visually, engineers deploy as code, operators observe in real time. No translation layer needed.
* Treat AI as native – Intelligent agents aren't bolted on; they're first-class actors in the process execution model with full auditability and compliance guardrails.
* Connect everything – Data from any source (APIs, databases, message queues, cloud services) flows naturally through your processes without custom plumbing.
* Build toward Horizon's sophistication – Our long-term ambition is to deliver agentic orchestration depth comparable to the best-in-class products in the market.

The result: enterprises can automate complex work faster, with more control, and with confidence that their processes will execute reliably at scale.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
Strategic ownership
  
  

* Define the product roadmap for Workflows & Orchestration – what customers need, what moves the needle, what builds defensible value
* Make the hard calls: what ships in MVP, what is post-launch, what never ships
* Own the competitive positioning – position durable processes as a first-class pillar of an integrated platform, not a standalone point solution
* Shape both pro-code and no-code experiences – own SDKs, CLI, and visual editor consistency; documentation and learning paths across both personas

Execution leadership
  
  

* Lead cross-functional alignment (eng, design, marketing, sales) on priorities and milestones
* Conduct customer discovery: who are we building for, what problems do they have, what's blocking adoption
* Make data-driven decisions: usage patterns, customer feedback, performance metrics all inform direction
* Unblock ambiguity: when technical direction isn't clear, you synthesize information and move forward decisively

Partnership with peer PMs
  
  

* You're not alone – work collaboratively with two peer IC PMs who own the Data Connectors and AI Agents pillars
* Establish clear integration points and contract boundaries so all three pillars (Durable Processes, Data Connectors, AI Agents) work together seamlessly
* Escalate only real conflicts up to the Group PM; resolve most decisions at your level

**We're Looking For**
**Experience Shipping One Or More Of The Following**
Complex infrastructure or platform products
  
  

* Enterprise workflow or automation systems
* Products that span multiple user personas (business analysts, developers, operators)
* Products that required deep technical integration
* Zero-to-one launches where you shaped initial product-market fit.

Core capabilities
  
  

* Technical fluency – You read code, understand architecture constraints, and can have a real conversation with engineers about feasibility and tradeoffs. You don't need to be an engineer, but you think like one.
* Customer obsession with realism – You spend time with users, but you're not a feature-request transcriber. You synthesize what they need from what they say.
* Decisiveness under ambiguity – You make calls with incomplete information. You're comfortable killing ideas you love if data suggests they won't work.
* Communication across layers – You talk to engineers about latency budgets, to customers about compliance, to executives about roadmap priorities. Different audiences, same honesty.
* Systems thinking – You see how pieces connect. Developer SDKs influence adoption patterns. Pricing models influence feature prioritization. You optimize for the system, not the local maximum.
* AI native – You’re using LLMs as part of your product workflow and can adapt to any tool easily. We currently use Claude Code and Cursor.

Nice to have
  
  

* 5+ years of relevant experience as a Product Manager, with a strong focus on platform products.
* Exposure to workflow engines, BPM systems, or process orchestration platforms (Camunda, Zeebe, Airflow, Temporal).
* Experience with enterprise compliance requirements (SOC 2, PCI-DSS, HIPAA) and how they shape product architecture.
* Understanding of multi-tenant SaaS scaling challenges and tradeoffs
* Previous zero-to-one product launch where you defined the initial MVP and shaped early-stage product-market fit.
* Experience building features using LLMs (it can be a hobby project).

PlantsShip is a growing landscaping, irrigation, nursery production and exports company, delivering landscaping development, horticulture, hardscaping, irrigation, plant supply and maintenance services.

Our vision is to build a ₹1,000 crore company by 2030 while expanding our business across India and international markets.

We are looking for a proactive, experienced HR professional who can establish a structured HR function, take complete ownership of recruitment and ensure smooth HR operations across our business.

2. Role Objective

The HR Manager will be responsible for managing the complete employee lifecycle, with primary ownership of 
**end-to-end recruitment, manpower planning, HR operations, payroll coordination, statutory compliance and performance management**
.

The candidate must be capable of working independently with management and department heads to ensure that the right people are recruited, onboarded and retained to support the company's growth.

3. Key Responsibilities

**A. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition – Primary Responsibility**

* Take complete ownership of recruitment across all departments.
* Collect manpower requirements from management and department heads.
* Prepare and maintain Job Descriptions (JDs) and candidate competency profiles.
* Develop recruitment plans, hiring timelines and sourcing strategies.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, employee referrals, recruitment agencies and other channels.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial HR interviews.
* Assess candidates for experience, skills, salary expectations, communication and suitability.
* Coordinate technical and functional interviews with department heads.
* Maintain interview evaluation forms, candidate databases and recruitment trackers.
* Manage salary discussions, notice periods and joining commitments within approved limits.
* Submit shortlisted candidates and hiring recommendations to management for approval.
* Coordinate offer letters, appointment letters, documentation and joining formalities.
* Track recruitment KPIs, including time-to-hire, hiring cost, offer acceptance and joining ratio.
* Build a talent pipeline for critical roles across Sales, Operations, Finance, Procurement, Project Management, Nursery and other departments.

**B. HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle**

* Manage employee onboarding, induction, probation, confirmation, transfers and exit formalities.
* Prepare and maintain offer letters, appointment letters, confirmation letters, relieving letters and experience letters.
* Maintain employee files, HR records, attendance, leave records and employee databases.
* Coordinate monthly payroll processing with the Accounts/Finance team.
* Address employee queries related to salary, attendance, leave, policies and documentation.
* Establish and implement HR policies, employee handbooks, rules and procedures.
* Manage employee grievances, disciplinary matters and workplace issues.
* Maintain employee headcount and department-wise manpower records.

**C. Statutory Compliance & Documentation**

* Coordinate applicable PF, ESI, Professional Tax, gratuity, labour-law and other employment-related compliance requirements.
* Maintain compliance calendars and ensure timely completion of applicable filings and payments.
* Coordinate with payroll teams, external consultants, auditors and relevant authorities.
* Monitor employment documentation and statutory records.
* Identify compliance gaps and recommend corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance requirements are reviewed according to applicable laws and establishment-specific obligations.

**D. Performance Management & Employee Development**

* Establish KRAs, KPIs and performance appraisal processes in consultation with management.
* Coordinate probation reviews and employee performance evaluations.
* Identify training and development requirements.
* Support departmental manpower planning and organization structure development.
* Monitor employee attendance, discipline, productivity and retention.
* Support employee engagement and retention initiatives.

**E. HR Systems, SOPs & Reporting**

* Develop HR SOPs, formats, checklists and approval workflows.
* Implement and maintain an HRMS or structured employee database.
* Prepare monthly HR MIS and management dashboards.
* Maintain recruitment, headcount, attendance, attrition and payroll reports.
* Establish clear HR processes, responsibilities and accountability.
* Conduct periodic internal HR reviews and recommend improvements.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The HR Manager will be evaluated on:

1. Recruitment fulfilment against approved manpower requirements.
2. Time taken to fill vacancies.
3. Quality and suitability of shortlisted candidates.
4. Offer acceptance and joining ratios.
5. Recruitment cost and sourcing effectiveness.
6. Completion of employee documentation and onboarding.
7. Payroll coordination accuracy and timeliness.
8. Timely completion of applicable statutory compliance activities.
9. Completion of probation and performance reviews.
10. Accuracy of HR MIS and employee records.
11. Employee retention and resolution of HR queries.
12. Implementation of HR policies, SOPs and systems.

5. Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration or a related discipline; an MBA/PGDM in HR is preferred.
* 5–8+ years of hands-on HR experience.
* Proven experience independently managing end-to-end recruitment.
* Strong knowledge of HR operations, employee lifecycle and payroll coordination.
* Practical understanding of Indian labour laws and applicable statutory compliance.
* Experience preparing HR policies, employment letters, SOPs and HR reports.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel and HRMS/payroll systems.
* Strong communication, negotiation, coordination and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate with multiple departments.

6. Preferred Industry Experience

Candidates with experience in any of the following sectors will be preferred:

* Landscaping and horticulture
* Construction and infrastructure
* Real estate and project execution
* Nursery, agriculture and agri-business
* Manufacturing or other multi-department operational businesses

Experience recruiting sales professionals, project managers, engineers, supervisors, finance professionals and operational staff will be an advantage.

7. Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is:

* Proactive, organised and accountable.
* Strong in execution, not limited to administrative work.
* Comfortable managing multiple vacancies simultaneously.
* Capable of building recruitment systems and maintaining a strong candidate pipeline.
* Confident in coordinating with senior management and department heads.
* Focused on measurable outcomes, process discipline and compliance.
* Interested in growing with a company that has ambitious expansion plans.

8. Reporting & Decision-Making Authority

The HR Manager will manage the recruitment process and HR operations independently within approved policies and budgets.

* Department heads will identify manpower requirements and evaluate technical suitability.
* HR will manage sourcing, screening, interview coordination and recruitment documentation.
* Management will approve final hiring decisions, salary exceptions and other key employment decisions.
* HR will coordinate offer release, onboarding and employee documentation after approval.

9. Application Process

Interested candidates should apply with their updated resume and include:

* Total HR experience.
* Years of hands-on recruitment experience.
* Industries and positions recruited for.
* Experience managing payroll and statutory compliance.
* Current CTC and expected CTC.
* Notice period and availability to join.

**Join PlantsShip and help build a strong HR function to support our growth towards our ₹1,000 crore vision for 2030.**

title: HR Risk & Compliance Manager
description:
HR Operations- Risk & Compliance Manager
  
  
This role is open in multiple locations and benefits vary based on the location of hire.
  
  
**About Flutter Entertainment**
Flutter Entertainment is the
**world’s largest sports betting and iGaming operator**
with
**15.9 million**
Average Monthly Players worldwide and an annual revenue of
**$16.4 billion**
in 2025. We have a
**portfolio of iconic brands**
, including FanDuel, Paddy Power, Betfair, PokerStars, Sisal, and Sportsbet.
  
  
Flutter Entertainment is listed on the
**New York Stock Exchange (NYSE).**
We’re proud to be recognized by
**TIME**
as one of the
**World’s Best Companies 2025**
— a reflection of the passion and commitment of our colleagues across the globe.
  
  
Working at Flutter is a chance to work with a growing
**portfolio of brands**
across a range of opportunities. We will support you every step of the way to help you grow. Just like our brands, we ensure our people have everything they need to succeed.
  
  
**Overview Of The Role**
The HR Risk & Compliance Manager is a pivotal mid-level leadership role within Flutter's Group HR Operations & Transformation department, serving as a trusted strategic partner to HR leadership and the broader executive team.
  
  
As Flutter continues to scale its global footprint, this role provides the essential oversight and subject matter expertise required to navigate an increasingly complex and evolving regulatory landscape — translating legal and compliance obligations into practical, operationally sound HR practices that protect both the organization and its employees.
  
  
At its core, the HR Risk & Compliance Manager is responsible for ongoing, recording and managing risk registers, Controls, Issues, actions on Flutter Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) tool for Group HR Operations & Transformation.
  
  
This encompasses the full lifecycle of compliance activity — from horizon-scanning for emerging regulatory changes and conduct structured risk assessments, through to designing and embedding policies, procedures, and controls that align with global employment law standards, data protection obligations, and Flutter's defined organizational risk appetite.
  
  
The role requires a practitioner who can operate with equal confidence at a strategic level — advising senior stakeholders on risk exposure and compliance posture — and at a detailed operational level, ensuring that day-to-day HR processes consistently meet their regulatory and ethical obligations.
  
  
A central pillar of this role is deep subject matter expertise across multi-jurisdictional employment law and data privacy regulation.
  
  
**Accountabilities & Responsibilities**
**Employment Law Compliance**

* Monitor and ensure ongoing adherence to employment legislation across all jurisdictions in which the organization operates.
* Proactively assess regulatory changes — including amendments to wage and hour laws, termination requirements, leave entitlements, and worker classification rules — and translate these into actionable policy updates and operational guidance within required implementation timelines.
* Provide authoritative, risk-informed guidance to HR Business Partners, People Leaders, and senior management on complex employment matters
* Serve as the primary internal subject matter expert on employment standards, maintaining a current and comprehensive register of statutory obligations across all active jurisdictions and flagging emerging regulatory risks to senior management.

GRC Record Maintenance
  
  

* Design, implement, and continuously maintain a comprehensive HR Governance, Risk, and Compliance framework that aligns with recognised standards
* Establish, document, and record internal controls including sox controls covering the full employee lifecycle — from recruitment and onboarding through to performance management, data handling, and offboarding — ensuring each control is mapped to its underlying regulatory obligation.
* Maintain a live GRC register that captures all applicable regulatory requirements, assigned control owners, control testing schedules, and remediation actions, providing leadership with a transparent and auditable view of the organisation's HR compliance status at any given time.
* Ensure that compliance requirements are clearly communicated across the organisation and that accountabilities for policy adherence are embedded within role descriptions, manager onboarding materials, and departmental operating procedures.

**Risk Assessment & Mitigation**

* Conduct structured, periodic HR process risk assessments across all HR operations & Transformation processes and geographies, utilising both qualitative and quantitative methodologies to identify compliance gaps, operational vulnerabilities, and areas of elevated legal exposure.
* Develop and execute targeted risk mitigation strategies for identified findings, assigning clear ownership, remediation timelines, and success metrics; monitor progress against agreed action plans and escalate unresolved or high-severity risks through appropriate governance channels.
* Prepare clear, concise risk reports and compliance dashboards for presentation to senior leadership, the HR Director, and board-level oversight committees, translating technical compliance findings into business-relevant risk language that supports informed decision-making.
* Maintain a dynamic HR risk register that is reviewed and updated on a defined cadence (at minimum quarterly), incorporating changes in the regulatory environment, organisational structure, workforce composition, and operational footprint.
* Conduct Risk & Control self-assessment (RCSA) for all Group HR operation & Transformation processes

Compliance Auditing & Monitoring
  
  

* Plan and execute a structured programme of internal HR compliance reviews covering key risk areas including right-to-work verification, payroll compliance etc.
* Develop audit methodologies, sampling frameworks, and test scripts appropriate to each audit area; document findings in formal audit reports that clearly articulate the nature of any non-compliance, the associated risk level, and recommended corrective actions with defined remediation timelines.
* Implement a continuous compliance monitoring programme — distinct from periodic auditing — that provides real-time or near-real-time visibility into key compliance indicators, such as training completion rates, policy acknowledgement status, and the timeliness of disciplinary process documentation.
* Track and report on the status of all corrective actions arising from internal audits, external regulatory reviews, and self-identified compliance gaps, ensuring that remediation is completed within agreed timeframes and that repeat findings are escalated appropriately.

**Regulatory Reporting & Documentation**

* Maintain a comprehensive and well-organised compliance documentation repository, ensuring that all policies, audit records, risk assessments, training logs, regulatory correspondence, and incident reports are retained in accordance with applicable data retention requirements and are readily accessible for regulatory inspection or internal review.
* Develop and maintain a regulatory reporting calendar that captures all recurring submission deadlines across jurisdictions, with sufficient lead time built in for data collection, validation, and sign-off by relevant stakeholders.

Training & Awareness Programs
  
  

* Design and deliver a comprehensive HR compliance training curriculum for three distinct audiences: HR professionals requiring in-depth knowledge of compliance obligations and processes; people managers requiring practical guidance on legally compliant decision-making; and all employees requiring foundational awareness of key compliance topics.
* Develop engaging, jurisdiction-appropriate training content covering priority compliance areas including GDPR and data protection obligations, anti-discrimination and equal opportunity requirements, anti-harassment and respectful workplace standards, whistleblowing procedures, and applicable health and safety responsibilities — leveraging a blend of e-learning modules, live workshops, and written guidance materials.
* Establish a training tracking and reporting mechanism that monitors completion rates by business unit, role level, and geography; identify and follow up on gaps in completion; and produce regular training compliance reports for HR leadership that demonstrate the organisation's investment in a culture of compliance.
* Evaluate training effectiveness through post-training assessments, employee surveys, and trend analysis of compliance incidents and policy breaches, using insights to continuously improve content, delivery methods, and targeting of awareness campaigns.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Act as the HR function's primary compliance liaison to Legal, Finance, IT, Data Privacy, Internal Audit, and operational business units, ensuring that HR compliance considerations are embedded into organisational processes, system implementations, and strategic initiatives from the outset rather than as an afterthought.
* Support merger, acquisition, and corporate restructuring activities by leading HR compliance due diligence workstreams — assessing the target organisation's employment law compliance status, workforce liabilities, policy frameworks, and data protection practices — and providing structured findings and risk assessments to the deal team and senior leadership.
* Coordinate with external legal advisors, specialist employment counsel, data protection consultants, and HR compliance specialists as required, managing these relationships effectively to ensure timely, cost-efficient, and high-quality advice that is appropriately integrated into internal compliance processes.
* Champion a cross-functional approach to compliance culture, proactively identifying opportunities to align HR compliance initiatives with broader organisational governance programmes and contributing to enterprise-wide risk and compliance forums, committees, and reporting processes.

**Skills & Capabilities**
Success in this role requires a well-rounded combination of technical expertise, analytical capability, and interpersonal effectiveness. The ideal candidate will bring both the specialist knowledge to navigate complex regulatory environments and the professional maturity to influence organizational behavior at all levels.
  
  
**Technical Expertise**

* The role requires a deep and current understanding of employment law and HR regulations across multiple jurisdictions, including familiarity with region-specific frameworks such as the EU's Working Time Directive, the UK Employment Rights Act, the US Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA), and equivalent standards in other applicable geographies.
* A strong command of data protection legislation is essential, particularly the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and its national implementations, as well as comparable privacy frameworks such as the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and other local privacy laws that intersect with HR data processing activities.
* The role further demands hands-on familiarity with GRC methodologies — including risk registers, control frameworks, and compliance lifecycle management — alongside practical experience operating HR information systems (HRIS) and dedicated compliance management platforms such as Workday.

**Risk Management & Analytical Thinking**

* The successful candidate will demonstrate a proven capability to identify, assess, and prioritize compliance risks across the full spectrum of HR operations — from recruitment and onboarding through to termination and post-employment obligations
* The Candidate should have the ability to conduct structured risk assessments, develop evidence-based mitigation strategies, and monitor the effectiveness of controls over time.
* The Candidate should have the ability to translate dense and often ambiguous regulatory requirements into clear, practical, and operationally viable solutions — bridging the gap between legal obligation and day-to-day HR practice without creating unnecessary organizational friction.
* Handle SOX & Audit sessions as a bridge between HR operations & Audit teams.

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills are a non-negotiable requirement.
* The HR Risk & Compliance Manager will regularly engage with a diverse range of audiences — from senior executives and legal counsel to frontline managers and individual employees — and must be able to calibrate the complexity and tone of compliance guidance accordingly.
* This includes the ability to produce clear policy documents, concise audit reports, and compelling training materials, as well as the confidence to present risk findings and recommendations to leadership.
* Strong relationship-building capabilities will be essential in fostering a culture of compliance across geographically dispersed teams.

**Project Management & Organizational Effectiveness**

* The breadth of this role demands exceptional organizational discipline and the ability to manage multiple concurrent compliance workstreams without compromising quality or accuracy.
* The successful candidate will be comfortable owning initiatives from scoping through to completion, setting clear milestones, managing dependencies, and proactively escalating blockers when necessary.
* A high degree of attention to detail is critical — particularly when exploring policy documentation, interpreting regulatory guidance, or preparing materials for external regulatory bodies.
* The ability to work with a significant degree of autonomy, demonstrating self-direction and initiative while maintaining appropriate visibility with senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners throughout each project lifecycle.

**TO EXCEL IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL NEED TO HAVE**
**Required Experience**
Candidates must bring a minimum of 7–8 years of progressive experience in HR compliance, employment law, governance, or a closely related risk management function.
  
  
This experience should demonstrate a consistent track record of managing compliance obligations across multiple jurisdictions simultaneously — not merely exposure to a single domestic market.
  
  
Applicants should be able to evidence hands-on involvement in developing and implementing compliance frameworks from the ground up or substantially overhaul existing structures to meet evolving regulatory demands.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
A bachelor’s degree in human resources, Law, Business Administration, or a closely related discipline is required as a foundational academic qualification.
  
  
In addition, candidates must hold either a recognised professional HR qualification — such as CIPD, SHRM CP/SHRM-SCP, or a nationally recognised equivalent — or a legal qualification,
  
  
**Preferred Experience**
Prior experience within multinational or global organisations — particularly those navigating complex, multi-layered regulatory environments — is highly desirable, as is a professional background in regulated industries such as financial services, gaming, fintech, or healthcare, where compliance culture is embedded and rigorously enforced.
  
  
Candidates with meaningful exposure to data protection and privacy compliance, including practical application of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) or equivalent frameworks such as the CCPA, will hold a distinct advantage given the intersection of HR data handling and privacy obligations in this role.
  
  
Experience conducting or supporting compliance audits, internal controls reviews, or regulatory inspections is also preferred, as is familiarity with compliance management software platforms such as Archer, Audit board technology solutions that streamline monitoring and reporting workflows.
  
  
**Measure of Success**

* Establishing of the GRC hierarchy, Risk management framework implementation across HR operations & transformation
* Number of process deep dive completion , Self-Identified issues & Control Monitoring

**Benefits We Offer**

* Access to Learnerbly, Udemy, and a Self-Development Fund for upskilling.
* Career growth through Internal Mobility Programs.
* Comprehensive Health Insurance for you and dependents.
* Coverage of OPD Consultations and Full Body health checkup every year.
* Well-Being Fund and 24/7 Assistance Program for holistic wellness.
* Hybrid Model: 2 office days/week with flexible leave policies, including maternity, paternity, and sabbaticals.
* Free Meals, Cab Allowance, and a Home Office Setup Allowance.
* Employer PF Contribution, gratuity, Personal Accident & Life Insurance.
* Sharesave Plan to purchase discounted company shares.
* Volunteering Leave and Team Events to build connections.
* Recognition through the Kudos Platform and Referral Rewards.

**WHY CHOOSE US**
Flutter is an
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
and values the unique perspectives and experiences that everyone brings. We are committed to a fair and inclusive recruitment process where every candidate has an equal opportunity to succeed, with hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential.
  
  
We have ambitious growth plans and goals for the future. Here's an opportunity for you to play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Flutter Entertainment India.
  
  
If you're passionate about this opportunity but don't meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Your skills, experiences and perspective could make you a great fit for our team.

title: Manager Marketing -  Opera & Osteozen
description:
Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because
**Good Health Can’t Wait**
.

We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.

For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).

‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose-driven, future-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency

Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ & nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

**Job Description**

**Job Summary**
  
We are looking for experienced Marketing Manger for overseeing the decision-making process for new products, including conceptualization, prioritization, and successful market launches. Ensuring the review and implementation of pre-launch strategies and brand plans, while fostering strong relationships with key customers. Leading strategic initiatives and providing guidance to subordinates for effective product planning and execution, within the constraints of regulatory frameworks and market capabilities, to achieve continuous growth in market share and product portfolio expansion annually.
  
  
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
  
• You will be responsible for identifying gaps in the product portfolio, analysing international trends, and proposing new product ideas based on unmet needs. Deliberating with the cross-functional team regarding the profitability of new products, and making final decisions on new product ideas from a marketing perspective.
  
  
• You will be responsible for conducting risk versus benefit analysis, discussing the merits and demerits of new product ideas with the medico-marketing team, and finalizing the prioritization of new products in consultation with the vertical head to ensure the implementation and launch of the most promising products.
  
  
• You will be responsible for reviewing go-to-market strategies, validating launch plans, and overseeing the successful implementation of strategies, as well as ensuring the effective launch of new products.
  
  
• You will be responsible for sales planning & budgeting of existing products by setting growth goals for subordinate marketing teams, deciding overall targets for the therapeutic area, and monitoring market potential to ensure consistent growth in market share.
  
  
• You will be responsible for Brand Strategy formulating of existing products by implementing brand strategies, monitoring their execution, identifying gaps, and suggesting corrective actions to strengthen brand positioning and market presence.
  
  
• You will be responsible for making decisions on initiatives to maintain customer relationships, reviewing non-product-based programs, and refining strategies based on customer feedback, especially from Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs).
  
  
• You will be responsible for initiating strategic activities to enhance brand presence, designing the future roadmap, and implementing initiatives through agencies after thorough evaluation and regular interaction with the strategy team.
  
  
• You will be responsible for leading and developing a team by conducting goal setting, performance appraisals, and providing mentorship, training, and development opportunities to ensure a high-performing and cohesive team environment.

**Qualifications**

**Education Qualification:**
MBA along with a graduate degree in Science stream
  
  
  
  
**Minimum work experience: 10-12**
years of experience in Indian Pharmaceutical Industry and experience in Product Management, launching at least one new product.
  
  
  
  
**Skills & attributes
  
  
Technical Skills**
  
• In-depth understanding of Indian Pharmaceutical Industry,
  
  
• Understanding of diseases, therapy and relevant therapeutic areas
  
  
• Financial management skills to develop and manage budgets, allocate resources effectively, and optimize cost control for the product portfolio.
  
  
• Functional understanding of chronic market
  
  
• Scientific Knowledge of Product
  
  
• Ability to analyse market data, clinical trial results, and sales performance to inform decision-making and product portfolio strategies

**Behavioural Skills**
  
• Proactive and visionary mind-set
  
  
• Strong networking skills
  
  
• Effective people management abilities
  
  
• Adaptability and change management skills
  
  
• Strategic orientation and decision-making capabilities
  
  
• Creative and ability to draw insights

**Additional Information**

**About the Department
  
  
Global Generics India**
  
Global Generics India business journey began in 1986. In the last three decades, we have grown as a trusted name in the healthcare industry and rank as one of the top 10 Pharma Companies in the Indian Pharma Market (IPM) as per IQVIA MAT (November 2022). Our commitment to Lead Ahead has helped us move ranks from 16th position to 10th position (IPM) in the last four years. We are a fast-growing organisation with double-digit growth and significant market share in domestic markets. Currently, we rank among the top 5 in oncology, anti-allergy and gastrointestinal diseases and the top 10 in a few other therapy areas. Our focus is on leveraging our digital capabilities, collaborations, innovations and inorganic opportunities to become the top 5 companies in the Indian Pharma Market.
  
  
  
  
**Benefits Offered**
  
At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.
  
  
The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.
  
  
  
  
**Our Work Culture**
  
Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.
  
  
For more details, please visit our career website at
**https://careers.drreddys.com/#!/**
