▪ Strong ability to influence without authority and align diverse stakeholders across commercial, medical, analytics and operations functions.
  
  
**▪ Preferred Qualifications**
▪ Pharmaceutical or healthcare commercial marketing experience with familiarity in MLR/compliance processes.
  
  
▪ Experience supporting US pharmaceutical brand marketing and omnichannel engagement strategies.
  
  
▪ Experience partnering directly with Brand Directors, Marketing Leads and cross-functional commercial teams to drive brand performance and customer engagement.

title: Marketing Consultant
description:
**Company Description:**

Gain Tailwind is a B2B marketing consulting firm providing senior marketing leadership and dedicated marketing teams to early and mid-stage technology companies. We operate as an extension of the leadership team, taking ownership of marketing strategy, planning and execution, with a clear focus on business outcomes. Our Fractional CMO and Fractional Marketing Team models bring together brand positioning, go-to-market strategy, category development, thought leadership and demand generation into one integrated marketing function. With experienced leadership and a full-stack team, we help companies build, run and scale their marketing without the complexity of building an entire function in-house.

**Role:**

We are looking for an experienced Marketing Consultant who can independently lead client engagements, translate business objectives into marketing strategies and drive execution across brand and demand generation.

The role requires someone who can think strategically while managing day-to-day delivery, working closely with client leadership teams and Tailwind's internal specialists. You will be responsible for developing marketing plans, managing client relationships, coordinating cross-functional teams and ensuring marketing programmes deliver measurable business outcomes.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Marketing strategy and consulting:**
  Understand client business objectives, markets, competitors and target audiences to develop integrated B2B marketing strategies, GTM plans and measurable marketing roadmaps.
* **Client leadership and account ownership:**
  Independently manage client engagements, build relationships with founders and senior stakeholders, lead strategic discussions and proactively identify opportunities for improvement and growth.
* **Brand and demand generation:**
  Plan and oversee initiatives across brand positioning, thought leadership, content marketing, account-based marketing (ABM), digital acquisition, events and demand generation.
* **End-to-end project management:**
  Own project plans, timelines, budgets and deliverables. Coordinate with content, design, digital and external partners to ensure high-quality, timely execution with minimal supervision.
* **Performance and optimisation:**
  Define KPIs, analyse marketing performance, develop client reports and recommend improvements based on data and business priorities.

**Qualifications:**

* **7+ years of experience**
  in B2B marketing, preferably across technology, SaaS, IT services, adtech or other technology-led businesses.
* Demonstrated ability to develop marketing strategies and independently manage integrated marketing programmes, beyond individual channels or campaigns.
* Strong understanding of brand positioning, go-to-market strategy, content marketing, demand generation and account-based marketing.
* Proven client and stakeholder management skills, including experience working directly with founders, senior executives or marketing leadership teams.
* Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple accounts, coordinate specialist teams and deliver against timelines and business objectives.
* Strong analytical skills, with experience defining marketing KPIs, evaluating campaign performance and translating data into actionable recommendations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to develop strategic presentations, articulate recommendations and simplify complex business problems.
* Working knowledge of CRM, marketing automation, analytics and AI-powered marketing tools.
* Self-driven, structured and proactive, with the ability to take ownership, anticipate challenges and operate independently in a consulting environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related discipline. Prior B2B consulting or fractional marketing experience is an advantage.

**What we are looking for:**

Someone who can operate as a strategic marketing partner to clients, not just manage marketing activities. You should be equally comfortable discussing business priorities with a CEO, building a marketing roadmap, reviewing a brand narrative and ensuring that a campaign goes live on schedule.

The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking, strong execution discipline, client ownership and commercial understanding, with the curiosity to continuously learn and adapt as marketing evolves.

title: Assistant Vice President, Operating Model, Product & Client Solutions
description:
**About Citco**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services with staff across 50 office locations worldwide. With more than $1.8 trillion in assets under administration, we deliver end-to-end solutions and exceptional service to meet our clients’ needs.
  
  
For more information about Citco, please visit www.citco.com
  
  
**About The Team & Business Line**
Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.
  
  
Strategic Operations is a dedicated function within Private Assets. It brings transformation delivery, project execution, business analysis, operational initiatives and implementation support into one team, reducing the delivery burden on BAU Operations and maintaining ownership from design through adoption.
  
  
The group will be split across three distinct focus areas, aligned under two individual leaders:
  
  
Operating Model, Product & Client Solutions: led by the Operating Model & Product leader, this area will define how services should run end to end, shape scalable products and solutions, support complex client implementations, and ensure client commitments are operationally deliverable.
  
  
Data, Reporting & Platform Enablement: led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will define Operations requirements for data, reporting and platforms, strengthen data quality and lineage, and carry solutions through testing, deployment and adoption.
  
  
Digital Workflow, Automation & AI: also led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will identify and deliver workflow, automation and AI opportunities, establish appropriate controls, and measure whether the expected benefits are realised.
  
  
The group works in close partnership with Operations, the Transformation Office, IT, Tactical Operations and Marquee Client teams. Roles may be permanent or approximately 12-month rotational assignments anchored in strategic locations. Rotational colleagues will join from the business, help shape and deliver change, and return to the line with broader project experience.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Your Role**
**You will support the redesign and delivery of operating model and product change, with hands-on ownership of analysis, testing and implementation tasks.**

* Map current state processes, gather data and evidence where the friction and cost actually sit.
* Support the design of target state processes, controls and handoffs.
* Draft business requirements and supporting documentation for review with IT and the Transformation Office.
* Build and execute test scripts, run UAT cycles and track defects through to resolution.
* Document client-specific processes and requirements, and evidence where they differ from our standard model.
* Prepare analysis and materials to support client pitches, POCs and solution design.
* Support implementation of fund structures, new client setups, onboarding and transitions on our accounting platforms.
* Maintain the reuse inventory — what was built, for whom, and who else could benefit.
* Prepare training material and support Operations teams through go-live and into adoption.
* Maintain project documentation, trackers and status reporting.

**Qualifications**
**About You**
**You have 4+ years’ experience in private assets accounting or operations, at a fund administrator, fund manager or comparable environment.**

* Solid technical knowledge of private assets processes — general ledger, capital activity, fee calculations, financial statements and investor reporting.
* Exposure to process improvement, system testing or project work, or a clear appetite to move in that direction.
* Comfortable engaging both operational teams and technology partners.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interrogate data and evidence a recommendation.
* Attention to detail and a proven ability to manage several pieces of work at once.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Advanced computer skills (Microsoft Excel); exposure to reporting, workflow or automation tooling an advantage.
* Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance or Economics; working towards a professional accounting designation an advantage.

**What We Expect Of The Strategic Operations Team**
Regardless of role or focus area, everyone in Strategic Operations is expected to demonstrate the following:
  
  

* Deep technical and operational knowledge — genuine depth in how our processes, data and platforms actually work — the detail that only comes from having run the work.
* Curiosity — the instinct to ask why a process looks the way it does, to challenge the answer, and to keep asking whether there is a better way.
* A transformational mindset — comfortable redesigning end to end rather than patching, and prepared to see change through past go-live to the point where it is genuinely adopted.
* Ownership through to adoption — accountability does not end at delivery; success is measured by whether the change sticks in the business.
* Commercial and client awareness — an understanding of what we can genuinely run, so that what we commit to a client is deliverable.
* Global mindset — working across regions, jurisdictions and time zones, and designing solutions that scale beyond a single desk, client or location.
* Ambition to shape Citco’s future — an appetite to help build the operating model we will run for years, and to be measured on whether it works.

**Our Benefits**
Your well-being is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.
  
  
We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect.
  
  
Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

title: Systems Development Engineer II, FO Support
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon.com is seeking a Systems Development Engineer to join a Fulfillment Optimization team that helps promise, plan, and execute the delivery of millions of packages to customers worldwide — faster and cheaper each day — while providing an extraordinary customer experience from the website to doorstep delivery. Our systems handle millions of requests per second and make business recommendations that impact billions of dollars each year. With rapid expansion into new geographies, increasing complexity of the transportation network, and an expanding selection of products, the Fulfillment Optimization team builds solutions that scale and propel the business with best-in-class technology innovations.  
  
We are looking for passionate, hard-working, and talented engineers who have experience supporting innovative, mission-critical, high-volume applications — and who are excited to apply AI and agentic automation to how large-scale systems are supported and operated. You will have an enormous opportunity to work across multiple systems: researching and identifying common issues, building AI-powered tooling that diagnoses and prevents them, and driving teams toward resolution to have a positive impact on the customer experience. Your solutions will impact our customers directly. This role requires you to hit the ground running; your ability to learn quickly and work on disparate and overlapping tasks will define your success.  
  
The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, has superior verbal and written communication skills and strong organizational skills, can juggle multiple tasks at once, works independently, and maintains professionalism under pressure. You must be able to identify problems before they happen and implement solutions that detect and prevent outages. Your ability to accurately prioritize work, make sound technical trade-offs, improve the customer experience, and get the right things done will have a direct impact on Amazon's Supply Chain Optimization and fulfillment-network efficiency.  
  
As a SysDE II on this team, you will work autonomously on difficult, team- and component-level problems, build resilient and well-tested solutions, and increasingly act as a force multiplier — enabling other builders through the tools, automation, and AI capabilities you deliver.  
  
Key job responsibilities

About the team  
The Fulfillment Optimization (FO) Support team plays a crucial role in Amazon's supply chain operations. We invent and deliver software solutions that facilitate Customer Promise Speed, Order Planning, and Fulfillment.  
  
The FO Support team leverages data, process improvement, and innovative technologies — including AI and agentic automation — to provide comprehensive engineering-excellence services and solutions across FO's product portfolios. title: Engineering Director
description:
Who We Are

We are Two Circles. We are a Sports & Entertainment Marketing business. We grow audiences and revenues by knowing fans best.

We work with clients to help them understand and influence fan behaviour — how fans spend their money, the events they attend, the channels they respond to, and the content they engage with. We use this understanding to help our clients grow both direct-to-consumer and business-to-business revenues.

Our platforms and services are trusted by over 1,000 clients globally, including the English Premier League, Red Bull, UEFA, VISA, the NFL, Nike and Amazon. We are over 1,000 people, based across 15 offices worldwide, delivering work for sports and entertainment organisations of all shapes and sizes.

India is a long-term commitment for Two Circles. We're already trusted by the BCCI, one of the biggest and most important properties in world sport, and our Hyderabad office sits at the heart of that relationship. Being here, and succeeding here, is central to how we build a better future for the sports and entertainment industry globally.

Hyderabad is a Two Circles office, not a GCC. Today it's tech-centric, but our ambition is to diversify what we build here over time, growing into a broad Two Circles presence rather than staying confined to technology propositions.

What you will do

We’re looking for an Engineering Director to lead our Hyderabad delivery organisation. You’ll lead a team of around 50 engineers, QA and delivery specialists, and the team is still growing. They work across our Data and Digital Products & CRM practices and deliver for clients and colleagues around the world.

You’ll report to our APAC Managing Director, with a dotted line to our Engineering Directors for Data and for Digital Products & CRM. As the most senior Two Circles leader in our Hyderabad office, you’ll also play an important role in our work with the BCCI, our most important partner in India. The role is based in Hyderabad.

This is a leadership role first and foremost. You’ll build and run a high-performing team and set the tone for its culture. You’ll bring discipline and predictability to how we deliver and make the India team’s performance visible to the rest of the business.

You’ll bring enough fluency in engineering and software delivery to earn the respect of our team, understanding trade-offs, spotting risk, and knowing when and how deep to go. You’ll govern quality and standards within the technical direction set by our global Engineering Directors and ensure excellence in the process for how we deliver software. You won’t be expected to set that direction yourself, but you will be expected to make sure it’s executed brilliantly in India.

We want Hyderabad to be known, by 2029, not just for delivering the work, but for shaping it, owning it, and making it better. That means more ownership of outcomes, greater exposure to our clients and their problems, more leaders and careers built from within Hyderabad, and a reputation for ideas, innovation and smart use of AI, all while protecting the spirit and connection that makes Two Circles what it is as we grow. You'll be the person most accountable for getting us there.

Key responsibilitiesLeading the team and its culture

* Lead, grow and retain the India team, including recruitment, onboarding and development of new team members.
* Co-own the culture of our Hyderabad office with our HR Lead. You’ll treat culture as a core part of your job, not something handed off to the HR team. You will be the role model of Two Circles spirit in the office.
* Build an India leadership layer of Engineering Managers, QA leadership and delivery leadership. Embed progression frameworks, career pathways and regular, structured feedback.
* Be a visible, accessible leader in the office. Build strong relationships and encourage the face-to-face collaboration that builds trust and improves delivery.

Delivery and engineering excellence

* Own the software delivery lifecycle across India projects, with consistent processes that drive quality and predictability.
* Oversee QA and release management standards across India builds, aligned with our global standards.
* Stay close to the work: attend key governance forums, review delivery health weekly, and step in when projects need support.
* Work with our Tech Leads to ensure technical standards and architectural approaches are followed, in line with the direction set by our Engineering Directors for Data and Digital Products & CRM.
* Embed the agentic engineering practices being rolled out across our global teams. Drive adoption in India and share what you learn.
* Help the India team take increasing ownership of outcomes end-to-end, including design, not just execution, and reduce reliance on other regions to unblock problems.

Performance, metrics and governance

* Create and run a monthly governance process and health report for the India team. It should cover hiring, onboarding, attrition, utilisation, quality and performance, and progress on major initiatives.
* Own delivery, quality and team health metrics, including code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues. Track how the project leaders the India team works with in other regions rate its work.
* Own utilisation and cost efficiency across India delivery. Propose the India hiring plan and work with Delivery Directors globally on resource planning and hotspots.

Global collaboration

* Give leadership upward visibility, and give teams clarity on priorities, outcomes and decisions.
* Work with Directors in Melbourne, London and Vancouver to develop operating models that let teams work smoothly across regions.
* Work effectively across time zones and cultures, bringing structure and clarity to complex, global work.
* Help Hyderabad become a knowledge hub, not just a delivery team: bring in what's working well from London, Melbourne and Vancouver, and feed Hyderabad's own innovations back out to the rest of the business.

What success looks like in your first year

* A high-performing team, shown in hard metrics such as code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues and in strong feedback from the project leaders the team works with across regions.
* A strong culture in our Hyderabad office, measured against our regular pulse checks.
* Our agentic engineering practices widely adopted across the India team.
* A clear monthly view of the India team’s health, shared with the wider business through a regular governance process.
* An India leadership layer in place that can support continued growth.

  
**Requirements**  

* 15+ years’ experience, including senior leadership of an organisation of 50+ people across engineering, QA and delivery, and experience managing managers.
* Direct leadership of engineering and QA teams, ideally having started your career as an engineer. You can contribute credibly to architecture and code-quality discussions across both data engineering and digital product engineering.
* Senior client-facing experience in a services, agency or consultancy business.
* Experience working within a multi-region or global delivery model.
* Hands-on ownership of the software delivery lifecycle, delivery processes, resourcing and talent management.
* Strong emotional intelligence and resilience, and the ability to influence senior peers and stakeholders.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to lead and inspire teams and engage a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.
* An interest in AI-enabled development practices and the drive to lead their adoption.
* Eligibility to work in India.
* Able to travel regularly to Vancouver, London and Melbourne.

Nice to have

* Familiarity with the platforms we build on (CMS, identity, video, CRM and e-commerce) and modern cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.
* Familiarity with sports and entertainment.
* Experience building or leading a Global Capability Centre or an India-based global delivery hub.
* Experience in both startup-style and enterprise-scale environments.

As the leading bank in Asia, DBS Consumer Banking Group is in a unique position to help our customers realise their dreams and ambitions. Our financial solutions are not only the best in the business – they were made just

**Job Purpose**

Lead acquisition, activation, value build-up and retention of high-quality current-account relationships across an assigned cluster. The role owns the cluster’s current-account growth agenda across business segments—including traders, wholesalers, manufacturers, service professionals, institutions and emerging enterprises—while building fee income and cross-sell penetration.

The Cluster Sales Head will lead a team of current-account sales team and relationship managers, work closely with branches and product partners, and ensure the cluster delivers profitable, compliant, transaction-active current-account growth.

**Responsibilities**

**. Cluster Business Ownership**

* Deliver new-to-bank current-account acquisition, account activation, average quarterly balance growth, transaction throughput and fee-income targets for the cluster.
* Build and execute a catchment-led acquisition strategy for high-potential business segments such as wholesalers, distributors, manufacturers, traders, schools, hospitals, clinics, professional firms and service establishments.
* Translate cluster targets into branch-, team- and individual-level productivity plans.
* Own the current-account business plan, sales funnel, conversion pipeline and weekly performance rhythm.
* Improve portfolio quality by prioritising transaction-active, balance-building and cross-sell-ready relationships over dormant or low-value acquisition.

* **Sales Leadership and Channel Execution**

* Lead, coach and motivate a field-sales organisation to consistently deliver acquisition and value-build targets.
* Establish a disciplined sales cadence covering joint calls, market visits, lead reviews, branch huddles, pipeline reviews and conversion tracking.
* Ensure each relationship manager follows a profile-based sales approach rather than a generic product pitch.
* Develop market intelligence on competitor propositions, local business clusters, referral sources and emerging commercial hubs.
* Build productive referral ecosystems with Chartered Accountants, trade associations, market intermediaries, merchant networks, developers, institutional administrators and existing clients.

* **Current-Account Activation and Value Build-Up**

* Ensure newly acquired accounts become transaction-active within defined activation timelines.
* Drive operating balances, inward credits, collections, payment activity and digital banking adoption.
* Track early-warning indicators including low funding, non-activation, declining balances, low transaction velocity and potential attrition.
* Build strategies to migrate primary transaction flows—collections, vendor payments, payroll, taxes and operating cash—to the bank.
* Improve account quality by monitoring average balance, debit transactions, credit transactions and account profitability.

* **Solution-Led Cross-Sell**

* Use the current account as the primary operating hub for business clients and identify the appropriate product solution based on the customer’s business model.
* Drive adoption of corporate internet banking and mobile approvals; cash management and bulk payment solutions; POS, Android POS, QR and Soundbox; sweep-in / sweep-out or FFD structures; debit cards; collections and transaction banking solutions; and promoter, family, wealth and premium savings propositions.
* Partner with product teams to convert business pain points into integrated propositions—for example, POS for collections, Internet Banking for payment controls, FFD for temporary balances and Aspire/premium banking for promoter wallet deepening.

* **Customer Relationship and Service Governance**

* Build senior-level relationships with anchor clients and participate in strategic joint calls for high-value prospects.
* Ensure timely resolution of onboarding, account-opening, transaction, service and digital-banking issues.
* Work with branches and operations teams to reduce turnaround time, improve onboarding quality and strengthen client experience.
* Review top customers and at-risk accounts regularly to protect balances, transactions and wallet share.
* Drive customer retention through proactive engagement, problem solving and relevant product deepening.

* **Risk, Compliance and Portfolio Quality**

* Ensure all sourcing, onboarding and account activation follows internal policies and applicable KYC, AML, fraud-risk and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain high standards of customer due diligence, documentation quality, source-of-funds understanding and business-profile validation.
* Monitor exceptions, unusual transaction behaviour, documentation gaps and operational risks; escalate promptly where needed.
* Build a culture of right-first-time acquisition, with no compromise on compliance for target achievement.

* **People Leadership**

* Recruit, develop, retain and performance-manage a high-quality current-account sales team.
* Set clear scorecards covering acquisition, activation, AQB/AMB, transaction activity, fee income, cross-sell, productivity, service quality and compliance.
* Conduct structured coaching through joint market visits, call observations, weekly reviews and capability-building sessions.
* Identify skill gaps and develop targeted interventions around sales planning, segment understanding, solution selling, digital banking and compliance.
* Maintain a strong talent pipeline and manage attrition proactively.

**Experience**

* 8–15 years of relevant experience in banking, preferably in current accounts, CASA, business banking, SME banking, transaction banking, branch banking or merchant acquiring.
* At least 3–5 years in a people-leadership role managing sales managers, relationship managers or acquisition teams.
* Demonstrated track record of building a current-account portfolio, increasing operating balances and delivering cross-sell revenue.
* Experience in managing business clusters, market catchments, branch ecosystems or multi-location sales teams is preferred.

**Education**

* Graduate degree required.
* MBA / PGDM in Finance, Sales, Marketing or Banking preferred.
* Relevant certifications in banking, KYC/AML, payments or financial products are an advantage.

**Skills and Competencies**

* Strong understanding of current-account economics, CASA, transaction banking, payments, merchant acquiring and business-client needs.
* Proven ability to lead field sales, build market networks and execute through branches and partner channels.
* Solution-selling mindset with ability to connect client pain points to banking products.
* Strong command of sales analytics, funnel management, portfolio reviews and performance dashboards.
* Excellent stakeholder-management skills across branches, products, operations, risk and service.
* High integrity, sound judgement and uncompromising compliance orientation.
* Strong communication, negotiation, coaching and executive-presence skills.

title: Senior Director, AI and Data Platform Delivery
description:
**Our Company:**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**Role Overview**

The Senior Director of AI and Data Platform Delivery is a senior leadership role accountable for **end‑to‑end execution of Teradata’s foundational AI and data platform offerings**, which underpin the company’s hybrid, multi‑cloud, and on‑premises solutions. This role is critical to ensuring that Teradata’s **platform continues to scale, modernize, and reliably support customer workloads**, while enabling company growth through platform differentiation, adoption, and expansion.

This leader owns the **execution strategy, operating model, and talent development** for a combined organization of **Technical Program Managers (TPMs)** and **Global Program Managers (GPMs)**. Together, these teams drive coordinated execution across the end-to-end **New Product Introduction (NPI) process**, ensuring that new platform elements are fully productized, operationally ready, and commercially viable.

Success in this role is measured by **platform delivery predictability, quality, scalability, and business impact**, rather than ownership of individual programs.

**Core Responsibilities**

**Platform Execution & Growth Enablement**

* Own execution outcomes for significant areas of Teradata’s **core data platform and AI roadmap**, including platform modernization, scalability enhancements, cloud parity, and operational hardening.
* Be accountable for execution work that **enables Teradata’s growth and retention targets**, including platform readiness for new use cases, expansions, and customer adoption.
* Translate product and platform strategy into **integrated execution plans** that balance stability, innovation, customer commitments, and long‑term technical health.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and Commercial leadership to align platform execution with **market needs, competitive positioning, and revenue objectives**.
* Provide execution transparency and decision support to senior leadership for **tradeoffs impacting delivery, quality, and customer trust**.

**End‑to‑End New Product Introduction (NPI) Leadership**

* Lead the global NPI execution model for core and AI platform capabilities from concept through general availability and sustained customer adoption.
* Ensure cross‑functional coordination across:
* + Definition, development, and testing
  + Product setup, configuration, and entitlement
  + Legal, compliance, and contractual readiness
  + Pricing, packaging, and lifecycle management
  + Go‑to‑market readiness (Sales, Marketing, Solution Architects)
  + Cloud Operations, infrastructure, and SRE readiness
  + Customer support, field enablement, and documentation
* Establish scalable, repeatable NPI mechanisms that support **frequent platform releases and long‑lived customer environments**.

**Technical & Platform Leadership**

* Provide technical and execution leadership across **large‑scale, distributed, data‑intensive platforms**, spanning cloud, hybrid, and on‑prem deployments.
* Guide teams through complex platform delivery challenges involving **performance, reliability, scalability, security, upgrade paths, and operational continuity**.
* Ensure cross‑team technical and operational risks are proactively identified, clearly owned, and mitigated.
* Partner with senior engineering and architecture leaders to ensure execution plans align with **long‑term platform sustainability and customer trust**.
* Co-own with engineering **platform economics and cost‑to‑serve** by influencing execution tradeoffs that impact margin, scaling limits, and long‑term pricing power.
* Co-own with engineering and product the **platform lifecycle governance and technical debt liquidation** at the portfolio level.

**People & Organizational Leadership**

* Build, lead, and scale a high‑impact organization of **Technical Program Managers and Global Program Managers**.
* Clearly define and reinforce roles and interfaces between TPMs (engineering‑centric delivery) and GPMs (cross‑functional, post‑code, market and operational readiness).
* Own hiring, performance management, development, and succession planning for the platform execution organization.
* Develop senior TPM and GPM leaders capable of operating effectively at **enterprise scale and high ambiguity**.
* Establish clear leveling, expectations, and promotion readiness standards for both TPM and GPM career paths.

**Influence, Communication & Executive Partnership**

* Act as a **trusted execution advisor** to senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Cloud Operations, Sales Engineering, Legal, and Customer organizations.
* Communicate platform execution health, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs clearly at the **VP and executive level**.
* Drive alignment across a highly matrixed organization supporting long‑lived, mission‑critical customer environments.
* Provide executive clarity during high‑impact incidents, major releases, or customer‑sensitive platform transitions.

**Required Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering leadership, product operations, or related technical roles.
* 5+ years of experience leading senior technical and program management professionals.
* Proven success delivering **large‑scale, enterprise data platform initiatives**.
* Strong understanding of **distributed systems, database platforms, cloud infrastructure, and hybrid architectures**.
* Demonstrated ability to drive execution that supports **business growth, customer retention, and platform adoption**.
* Exceptional executive‑level communication and influence skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience delivering or operating **enterprise data platforms** in cloud and hybrid environments.
* Background supporting **platform modernization, cloud transitions, or large customer migrations**.
* Experience building or scaling global NPI and release governance models.
* Familiarity with operational excellence, SRE practices, and enterprise reliability expectations.

**What Success Looks Like**

A successful Senior Director of AI and Data Platform Delivery:

* Enables Teradata to **deliver and evolve its core platform with predictability and confidence**.
* Holds the organization to **best-in-breed standards** across delivery quality, platform performance, and operational reliability — ensuring Teradata's core data platform earns a reputation for excellence.
* Scales execution capabilities to support platform growth, modernization, and increased customer demand.
* Ensures platform capabilities are fully **productized, operationally ready, and commercially viable**.
* Builds a strong TPM and GPM organization trusted across Product, Engineering, and GTM teams.
* Directly supports Teradata’s **growth and retention goals** by strengthening the foundation of its data platform.

title: Senior Director, AI and Data Platform Delivery
description:
**Our Company:**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**Role Overview**

The Senior Director of AI and Data Platform Delivery is a senior leadership role accountable for **end‑to‑end execution of Teradata’s foundational AI and data platform offerings**, which underpin the company’s hybrid, multi‑cloud, and on‑premises solutions. This role is critical to ensuring that Teradata’s **platform continues to scale, modernize, and reliably support customer workloads**, while enabling company growth through platform differentiation, adoption, and expansion.

This leader owns the **execution strategy, operating model, and talent development** for a combined organization of **Technical Program Managers (TPMs)** and **Global Program Managers (GPMs)**. Together, these teams drive coordinated execution across the end-to-end **New Product Introduction (NPI) process**, ensuring that new platform elements are fully productized, operationally ready, and commercially viable.

Success in this role is measured by **platform delivery predictability, quality, scalability, and business impact**, rather than ownership of individual programs.

**Core Responsibilities**

**Platform Execution & Growth Enablement**

* Own execution outcomes for significant areas of Teradata’s **core data platform and AI roadmap**, including platform modernization, scalability enhancements, cloud parity, and operational hardening.
* Be accountable for execution work that **enables Teradata’s growth and retention targets**, including platform readiness for new use cases, expansions, and customer adoption.
* Translate product and platform strategy into **integrated execution plans** that balance stability, innovation, customer commitments, and long‑term technical health.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and Commercial leadership to align platform execution with **market needs, competitive positioning, and revenue objectives**.
* Provide execution transparency and decision support to senior leadership for **tradeoffs impacting delivery, quality, and customer trust**.

**End‑to‑End New Product Introduction (NPI) Leadership**

* Lead the global NPI execution model for core and AI platform capabilities from concept through general availability and sustained customer adoption.
* Ensure cross‑functional coordination across:
* + Definition, development, and testing
  + Product setup, configuration, and entitlement
  + Legal, compliance, and contractual readiness
  + Pricing, packaging, and lifecycle management
  + Go‑to‑market readiness (Sales, Marketing, Solution Architects)
  + Cloud Operations, infrastructure, and SRE readiness
  + Customer support, field enablement, and documentation
* Establish scalable, repeatable NPI mechanisms that support **frequent platform releases and long‑lived customer environments**.

**Technical & Platform Leadership**

* Provide technical and execution leadership across **large‑scale, distributed, data‑intensive platforms**, spanning cloud, hybrid, and on‑prem deployments.
* Guide teams through complex platform delivery challenges involving **performance, reliability, scalability, security, upgrade paths, and operational continuity**.
* Ensure cross‑team technical and operational risks are proactively identified, clearly owned, and mitigated.
* Partner with senior engineering and architecture leaders to ensure execution plans align with **long‑term platform sustainability and customer trust**.
* Co-own with engineering **platform economics and cost‑to‑serve** by influencing execution tradeoffs that impact margin, scaling limits, and long‑term pricing power.
* Co-own with engineering and product the **platform lifecycle governance and technical debt liquidation** at the portfolio level.

**People & Organizational Leadership**

* Build, lead, and scale a high‑impact organization of **Technical Program Managers and Global Program Managers**.
* Clearly define and reinforce roles and interfaces between TPMs (engineering‑centric delivery) and GPMs (cross‑functional, post‑code, market and operational readiness).
* Own hiring, performance management, development, and succession planning for the platform execution organization.
* Develop senior TPM and GPM leaders capable of operating effectively at **enterprise scale and high ambiguity**.
* Establish clear leveling, expectations, and promotion readiness standards for both TPM and GPM career paths.

**Influence, Communication & Executive Partnership**

* Act as a **trusted execution advisor** to senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Cloud Operations, Sales Engineering, Legal, and Customer organizations.
* Communicate platform execution health, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs clearly at the **VP and executive level**.
* Drive alignment across a highly matrixed organization supporting long‑lived, mission‑critical customer environments.
* Provide executive clarity during high‑impact incidents, major releases, or customer‑sensitive platform transitions.

**Required Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering leadership, product operations, or related technical roles.
* 5+ years of experience leading senior technical and program management professionals.
* Proven success delivering **large‑scale, enterprise data platform initiatives**.
* Strong understanding of **distributed systems, database platforms, cloud infrastructure, and hybrid architectures**.
* Demonstrated ability to drive execution that supports **business growth, customer retention, and platform adoption**.
* Exceptional executive‑level communication and influence skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience delivering or operating **enterprise data platforms** in cloud and hybrid environments.
* Background supporting **platform modernization, cloud transitions, or large customer migrations**.
* Experience building or scaling global NPI and release governance models.
* Familiarity with operational excellence, SRE practices, and enterprise reliability expectations.

**What Success Looks Like**

A successful Senior Director of AI and Data Platform Delivery:

* Enables Teradata to **deliver and evolve its core platform with predictability and confidence**.
* Holds the organization to **best-in-breed standards** across delivery quality, platform performance, and operational reliability — ensuring Teradata's core data platform earns a reputation for excellence.
* Scales execution capabilities to support platform growth, modernization, and increased customer demand.
* Ensures platform capabilities are fully **productized, operationally ready, and commercially viable**.
* Builds a strong TPM and GPM organization trusted across Product, Engineering, and GTM teams.
* Directly supports Teradata’s **growth and retention goals** by strengthening the foundation of its data platform.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with asset management best practices across various industries including manufacturing, utilities, healthcare, or facilities management.

title: Systems Development Engineer II, FO Support
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon.com is seeking a Systems Development Engineer to join a Fulfillment Optimization team that helps promise, plan, and execute the delivery of millions of packages to customers worldwide — faster and cheaper each day — while providing an extraordinary customer experience from the website to doorstep delivery. Our systems handle millions of requests per second and make business recommendations that impact billions of dollars each year. With rapid expansion into new geographies, increasing complexity of the transportation network, and an expanding selection of products, the Fulfillment Optimization team builds solutions that scale and propel the business with best-in-class technology innovations.  
  
We are looking for passionate, hard-working, and talented engineers who have experience supporting innovative, mission-critical, high-volume applications — and who are excited to apply AI and agentic automation to how large-scale systems are supported and operated. You will have an enormous opportunity to work across multiple systems: researching and identifying common issues, building AI-powered tooling that diagnoses and prevents them, and driving teams toward resolution to have a positive impact on the customer experience. Your solutions will impact our customers directly. This role requires you to hit the ground running; your ability to learn quickly and work on disparate and overlapping tasks will define your success.  
  
The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, has superior verbal and written communication skills and strong organizational skills, can juggle multiple tasks at once, works independently, and maintains professionalism under pressure. You must be able to identify problems before they happen and implement solutions that detect and prevent outages. Your ability to accurately prioritize work, make sound technical trade-offs, improve the customer experience, and get the right things done will have a direct impact on Amazon's Supply Chain Optimization and fulfillment-network efficiency.  
  
As a SysDE II on this team, you will work autonomously on difficult, team- and component-level problems, build resilient and well-tested solutions, and increasingly act as a force multiplier — enabling other builders through the tools, automation, and AI capabilities you deliver.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Dive deeply into technical details to diagnose, reproduce, and root-cause issues across Amazon technology products (services, tools, data solutions, etc.), and drive them to resolution or escalation.
* Design, build, and operate AI-powered and agentic support capabilities — diagnostic agents, automated root-cause analysis, anomaly detection, and self-healing/auto-remediation — that detect and prevent issues before they impact customers.
* Apply AI across the software development lifecycle (spec-driven and AI-assisted development, agentic workflows) to raise engineering velocity and quality.
* Automate repetitive operational tasks to increase efficiency and reduce manual toil, and build tooling that enables other engineers.
* Manage trouble tickets through to resolution or escalation using existing documentation, procedures, and tools, and improve those mechanisms over time.
* Use technology to monitor security vulnerabilities and eliminate risk; identify and mitigate reliability risks at the team and component level.
* Improve service resilience, performance, and operational metrics; define and apply operational-excellence practices for the team.
* Participate in a team on-call rotation, providing operational support for the services the team owns.
* Collaborate with partner teams, Technical Program Managers, and Product Managers to deliver on shared goals.
* Work in an Agile environment using the Scrum methodology.

  
About the team  
The Fulfillment Optimization (FO) Support team plays a crucial role in Amazon's supply chain operations. We invent and deliver software solutions that facilitate Customer Promise Speed, Order Planning, and Fulfillment.  
  
The FO Support team leverages data, process improvement, and innovative technologies — including AI and agentic automation — to provide comprehensive engineering-excellence services and solutions across FO's product portfolios. The team is responsible for FO services as front-line support and plays a central role in the organization's success.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
* Knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals (networking, storage, operating systems)
* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience building services using AWS products
* Experience with distributed systems at scale
* Experience with Linux/Unix
* Experience leveraging AI (Artificial Intelligence) agents for security review automation, spec-driven development practices, or adversarial red teaming
* Experience building or integrating AI/GenAI-powered solutions (e.g., LLM-based tools, agentic frameworks, automated diagnostics or remediation)
* Ability to work independently and solve problems using knowledge of an object-oriented programming language

title: Sr. Relationship Manager (Business Development)

description:
**Job Description: Senior Relationship Manager – Distribution (Business Development)**

**Location:** Mumbai | Full-time

**Purpose**

To build, deepen and retain relationships with HNI and mass-affluent clients by understanding their investment requirements, presenting suitable investment products and delivering a high-quality client experience, while contributing to the company’s growth through responsible and compliant distribution practices.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, retain and expand relationships with HNI and mass-affluent clients through proactive relationship management and client servicing.
* Understand clients’ financial objectives, investment preferences, risk profile and product requirements to facilitate appropriate product recommendations within the scope of the firm’s distribution activities.
* Present and explain suitable investment products across relevant categories, including mutual funds, PMS, insurance and fixed income, in accordance with applicable regulations and internal processes.
* Drive client acquisition, business development, AUM growth and revenue through prospecting, networking, referrals and existing-client relationships.
* Conduct regular client reviews and portfolio discussions within the permitted scope of distribution activities, and identify opportunities for additional investments or product requirements.
* Coordinate with the Advisory, Research, Operations and Compliance teams to ensure smooth execution and servicing of client requirements.
* Ensure all client interactions, product presentations, documentation and transactions comply with applicable SEBI, AMFI, IRDAI and other relevant regulatory requirements and internal governance standards.
* Maintain accurate and timely records of client interactions, opportunities, transactions and follow-ups in the firm’s CRM and other systems.
* Represent Blue Ocean Financial Services professionally and build long-term client trust through transparent communication, product knowledge and responsive service.

**Critical Skills & Competencies**

* **Product Knowledge:** Strong understanding of mutual funds, PMS, insurance, fixed income and other relevant investment products.
* **Relationship Management:** Ability to build trust, maintain long-term relationships and proactively address client requirements.
* **Business Development:** Strong prospecting, networking, client acquisition and referral-generation capabilities.
* **Client Understanding:** Ability to understand client objectives, preferences and requirements and map them to appropriate products within the permitted distribution framework.
* **Sales Acumen:** Consultative selling, objection handling, negotiation and ability to convert opportunities into business.
* **Compliance Orientation:** Strong understanding of applicable SEBI, AMFI, IRDAI and other relevant regulatory requirements and disciplined adherence to internal processes.
* **Digital Savvy:** Comfortable using CRM systems, client management tools and digital platforms for client engagement and business tracking.
* **Professional Presence:** Strong communication, presentation and interpersonal skills with the ability to interact confidently with HNI and mass-affluent clients.

**Qualifications**

* Postgraduate in Finance / Business / Economics / or any other relevant postgraduate qualification.
* Minimum of **3 years of experience in investment product or insurance sales/distribution**.
* **NISM certification relevant to the products handled is mandatory**; relevant additional certifications are preferred.
* Experience in wealth management, financial product distribution, private banking or a similar client-facing financial-services environment will be preferred.

**What Makes You Stand Out**

* Highly motivated towards sales, client relationships and customer delight.
* Strong understanding of investment products and genuine interest in financial markets.
* Proven sales orientation with a consistent track record of acquiring clients, generating business and converting opportunities into long-term client relationships.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust with clients and promoters alike.
* Proven ability to develop new relationships and generate business through referrals and networking.
* Ability to work independently with accountability and ownership.
* High energy, discipline and commitment to results.
* Flexibility to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving and people-centric setup.

**Work Hours and Benefits**

At Blue Ocean, we don’t call our people *employees* – we call them team members.  
Because here, every individual counts and our success is truly shared.

We value balance, ownership and trust. You’re encouraged to design your workday around what helps you serve clients best – while also nurturing your own life outside work.

**Our Promise**

* **Above-Market Rewards:** Your skills and contribution are recognized – we ensure compensation that’s a notch above industry standards for the right talent.
* **Freedom with Responsibility:** Flexibility to work smart, stay client-focused and own your outcomes.
* **Growth Together:** Learn, experiment and evolve with a team that’s building something meaningful in wealth management.
* **A People-First Culture:** Professional excellence with a personal touch – **that’s the Blue Ocean way.**

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

* We need at least 3 years of experience in Client Acquisition, new business development in BFSI products / Insurance Sales, do you have that?

Company: Chemnine LLP

Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra

JOB DESCRIPTION

Chemnine LLP is looking for an experienced and result-oriented Sales Manager with a strong background in hardcore B2B sales, business development, and customer acquisition in the specialty chemicals industry.

The ideal candidate must have a proven track record of generating new business, acquiring customers, achieving sales targets, and driving revenue growth in the chemical distribution sector.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

\* Drive new business development and generate revenue through aggressive B2B sales.

\* Identify, approach, and acquire new customers in the specialty chemicals industry.

\* Develop and manage a strong customer portfolio across industrial segments.

\* Build relationships with purchase managers, procurement heads, business owners, and key decision-makers.

\* Generate leads through market visits, cold calling, references, networking, and customer meetings.

**Leads will be provided by Unilights.** Your responsibility will be to take those leads, connect with the right people, arrange meetings, build relationships, understand their projects and ultimately **convert them into Unilights clients.**

* Extremely confident and comfortable speaking with senior professionals.
* Well-spoken with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Energetic, presentable and professional.

We are looking for someone who wants to **build a career, build relationships and build a reputation.**

The right candidate should have the confidence to meet a Principal Architect, start a conversation, understand their business, present Unilights professionally and keep following up until an opportunity is created.

**You don't need to know everything about lighting when you join us.**

**Energy.**  
**Persistence.**  
**People skills.**  
**The desire to win.**

Your job is to:

title: Senior Executive - Buying & Merchandising (Footwear)
description:
The Senior Executive – Buying, Merchandising & Product Development will support the seasonal range planning, assortment building, buying and merchandising activities, product performance analysis, EOSS planning, and product development initiatives for the Footwear category at Skechers India.  
The role will work closely with the Buying & Merchandising, Product Development, Planning, Marketing, Retail Operations, Visual Merchandising, and other cross-functional teams to ensure the right product, assortment, quantity, timing, pricing and channel mix are delivered in line with business objectives.  
The position will also be responsible for monitoring category and product performance at the store, region, channel, gender, style and size level, identifying opportunities and supporting corrective actions to maximise sales, sell-through, inventory productivity and profitability.

**Designation:** Senior Executive

**Role:** Buying & Merchandising

**Department:** Category - Footwear

**Position:** Permanent

**Location:** Mumbai

**Reporting To:** Deputy General Manager - B&M

Individual Contributor role

**KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Season Range Planning & Assortment Building**

* Support the development of **seasonal footwear ranges** based on business objectives, historical performance, market trends and consumer requirements.
* Analyse previous-season performance to identify **winning styles, underperforming products, gaps and opportunities** for the upcoming season.
* Support assortment planning across **categories, gender, product types, price points, technologies, franchises and channels**.
* Assist in determining the optimum width and depth of assortment based on store grades, regional requirements and channel potential.
* Support the development of **OTB and buy recommendations** in line with business plans.
* Ensure the assortment is balanced across core, fashion, seasonal and newness products.
* Participate in seasonal range reviews and product selection meetings with relevant stakeholders.

**2. Buying & Merchandise Planning**

* Support the Buying Manager/Senior Manager in developing the seasonal buying plan for the assigned category.
* Prepare and maintain **buy forms, assortment sheets, range plans, catalogues and other buying-related documents**.
* Track planned versus actual buys and highlight significant deviations.
* Monitor product availability and ensure adequate inventory coverage for key styles and periods.
* Coordinate with Planning and Supply Chain teams to ensure product availability as per the agreed seasonal calendar.
* Support decisions related to **replenishment, stock balancing, liquidation and inventory movement** based on product performance.
* Monitor inventory ageing and identify potential risks to minimise excess and obsolete inventory.

**3. Season Launch & Delivery Tracking**

* Take ownership of tracking **seasonal product deliveries** for the respective category.
* Maintain detailed trackers for planned, received and pending deliveries.
* Coordinate with relevant internal teams to identify and resolve delays or gaps impacting season launches.
* Ensure key launches are aligned with the agreed **Go-To-Market calendar**.
* Highlight delivery risks and provide timely updates to the Buying/Merchandising leadership team.
* Support cross-functional teams in ensuring that new-season products are available in stores within the planned launch timelines.

**4. Product Performance & Sell-Through Management**

* Conduct periodic, in-depth analysis of category performance across:
  + Region
  + Store grade
  + Store/channel
  + Category
  + Gender
  + Product/style
  + Size
  + Price point
  + Season
* Monitor **sales, sell-through, stock cover, inventory levels, ageing, markdowns and profitability**.
* Identify top-performing and underperforming styles and recommend appropriate actions.
* Analyse store-level performance and identify assortment gaps or over/under-stock situations.
* Support initiatives to improve **full-price sell-through and inventory productivity**.
* Provide regular performance dashboards and actionable insights to the Buying & Merchandising team.
* Track agreed **GM% and category profitability deliverables** and highlight areas requiring corrective action.

**5. EOSS & Markdown Planning**

* Support the Buying Manager in planning and executing **End of Season Sale (EOSS)** activities.
* Analyse ageing and slow-moving inventory to identify products requiring markdown or liquidation.
* Support markdown recommendations based on product performance, inventory position, store/channel and seasonality.
* Monitor EOSS performance and sell-through during the sale period.
* Track inventory liquidation and identify opportunities to minimise carry-forward stock.
* Prepare post-EOSS analysis and recommendations for future seasons.

**6. Product Development**

* Support **new product development initiatives** for key channels, strategic partners and specific market opportunities.
* Coordinate with internal Product Development/Design teams and other stakeholders for product briefs, specifications and development timelines.
* Conduct market and competitor analysis to identify **product gaps, consumer trends and emerging opportunities**.
* Support development of products based on channel/customer requirements while maintaining Skechers brand standards.
* Assist in tracking product development milestones from **concept/brief through sampling, approval and finalisation**.
* Coordinate feedback on samples, specifications, colourways, materials, pricing and commercial viability.
* Maintain product development trackers and ensure timelines are adhered to.
* Support the development of commercially viable products with the right balance of **consumer relevance, brand fit, price point and margin**.

**7. Product Knowledge & Training**

* Conduct seasonal **product conferences and product knowledge sessions** in coordination with relevant teams.
* Develop product knowledge and understanding among store teams, including:
  + Product features
  + Technologies
  + Key selling points
  + Consumer benefits
  + Product differentiation
  + Target consumer
* Work with Retail Operations and L&D teams to ensure effective communication of new-season product information.
* Support creation and dissemination of product training material and product information.

**8. Marketing & Visual Merchandising Support**

* Work closely with Marketing and Visual Merchandising teams to align product launches with the **seasonal marketing calendar**.
* Support key marketing initiatives and product-focused campaigns.
* Provide product information and key selling propositions required for marketing communication.
* Assist in developing **merchandise display plans** for new-season products.
* Coordinate with Visual Merchandising and Retail Operations to ensure appropriate product presentation in stores.
* Support key launches and campaigns through timely availability of products and relevant product information.

**9. Store & Regional Performance Analysis**

* Conduct regular reviews of product performance across stores and regions.
* Identify variations in performance based on **store grade, geography, channel and consumer profile**.
* Recommend assortment adjustments based on regional and store-level trends.
* Identify size-level gaps and recommend appropriate size curves for future buys.
* Analyse store-level sell-through to identify opportunities for stock transfers, replenishment or assortment optimisation.
* Partner with Retail Operations and regional teams to understand market feedback and translate insights into merchandising actions.

**10. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with **Buying, Merchandising, Planning, Product Development, Supply Chain, Marketing, Visual Merchandising, Retail Operations, Finance and other relevant teams**.
* Ensure timely communication of category plans, product launches, delivery status and performance insights.
* Participate in regular business reviews and provide relevant data and recommendations.
* Ensure alignment between product strategy, inventory availability and commercial objectives.
* Build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners/vendors, wherever required.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)**

The role will be measured on:

* Seasonal range planning and assortment effectiveness
* Category sales achievement
* Sell-through % and full-price sell-through
* GM% / gross margin delivery
* Inventory productivity and stock cover
* New-season launch and delivery adherence
* EOSS sell-through and liquidation
* Reduction in aged/excess inventory
* Style and size-level productivity
* New product development timelines
* Product launch readiness
* Store and regional assortment effectiveness
* Accuracy and timeliness of MIS/analysis
* Effectiveness of cross-functional execution

**ROLE SPECIFICATIONS**

**Qualification**

* Graduate from **FDDI (Footwear Design & Development Institute)** preferred.
* Degree/Diploma in Footwear, Fashion, Retail, Merchandising or a related discipline will be an added advantage.

**Experience**

* **Minimum 4 years of relevant experience** in Buying & Merchandising, preferably within the **footwear, fashion, sportswear, lifestyle or retail industry**.
* Experience in seasonal range planning, assortment building and product performance analysis.
* Exposure to product development and working with cross-functional teams will be preferred.

Experience in a multi-store retail environment would be an advantage.

**CORE COMPETENCIES**

**Functional Competencies**

* Season range planning and assortment building
* Buying & merchandise planning
* Sell-through management
* Category performance management
* Inventory and stock productivity
* EOSS and markdown planning
* Style and size-level analysis
* Store and regional performance analysis
* GM% and margin management
* Product development
* Product lifecycle management
* Market and competitor analysis
* Product knowledge and training
* Merchandise display planning

**Behavioural Competencies**

* Strong analytical and numerical ability
* Commercial acumen
* Customer and consumer orientation
* Strong attention to detail
* Planning and execution skills
* Ability to work with multiple stakeholders
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Problem-solving and decision-making ability
* Ownership and accountability
* Ability to work in a fast-paced retail environment
* Collaborative and team-oriented approach

**Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in **MS Excel**, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, charts and data analysis.
* Good understanding of merchandising reports and retail KPIs.
* Exposure to ERP/retail merchandising systems would be an advantage.
* Ability to prepare management reports, dashboards and presentations using **Excel and PowerPoint**.

**KEY STAKEHOLDERS**

**Internal:**  
Buying & Merchandising | Planning | Product Development | Retail Operations | Marketing | Visual Merchandising | Supply Chain | Finance | HR/L&D

**External:**  
Vendors | Product Development Partners | Strategic Channel/Business Partners | Other relevant external stakeholders

**IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE**

The ideal candidate should have a strong combination of **merchandising expertise, commercial understanding, analytical capability and product orientation**. The candidate should be comfortable working with large volumes of product and store-level data, translating insights into actionable buying and merchandising decisions, and collaborating with multiple teams to deliver seasonal business objectives.

Experience in the **footwear or sportswear industry** would be highly preferred, with an understanding of product technologies, consumer preferences, retail dynamics, seasonal buying cycles and product lifecycle management.

**About Skechers**

Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations.

title: Hospitality Manager – Luxury Sales Gallery Operations
description:
Team: Management

  

Job Title: Hospitality Manager – Luxury Sales Gallery Operations

Location: Mumbai (Multiple Premium Sales Gallery Locations)

Department: Hospitality & Guest Experience

  
  

**Job Purpose**

The Hospitality Manager is responsible for leading end-to-end hospitality operations across premium luxury real estate sales galleries. This role ensures the delivery of exceptional, personalized guest experiences that mirror internationally recognized five-star luxury hotel standards. By overseeing guest-facing operations, team leadership, service excellence, vendor management, and operational efficiency, the Hospitality Manager elevates the customer journey, strengthens brand image, and creates memorable experiences for HNI, UHNI, NRI, celebrity, and VIP visitors.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities**

  
  

**1. Guest Experience Leadership**

* Design and deliver an exceptional guest journey from arrival to departure.
* Ensure every visitor receives personalized, warm, and professional service aligned with luxury hospitality standards.
* Develop memorable experiences for HNI, UHNI, NRI investors, celebrities, and VIP guests.
* Personally oversee all VIP visits and high-profile customer engagements.
* Resolve guest concerns promptly with professionalism and discretion.
* Monitor guest feedback and implement continuous service improvement initiatives.
  

  

**2. Hospitality Operations Management**

* Provide strategic leadership for all hospitality functions including Front Office, Reception, Guest Relations, Concierge, Butler Services, Pantry & Refreshment Operations, Food & Beverage, Housekeeping, Lounge Management, Meeting Rooms, Boardrooms, and Event Hospitality.
* Maintain impeccable presentation and luxury hotel standards across all areas.
  

  

**3. Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, inspire, and develop a high-performing team of Guest Relations Executives, Reception Associates, Concierge Associates, Butler Team, Pantry Associates, Housekeeping Supervisors, Housekeeping Associates, and support staff.
* Handle recruitment, onboarding, performance management, training, grooming & etiquette coaching, shift planning, employee engagement, and succession planning.
* Foster a culture of service excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  

  

**4. Luxury Service Excellence**

* Maintain uncompromising standards in Guest Welcome, Service Etiquette, Grooming, Uniforms, Floral Décor, Ambient Music, Fragrance Management, Food & Beverage Presentation, Lounge Ambience, Washroom Excellence, and Public Area Cleanliness.
* Conduct regular service audits and coaching sessions to ensure consistency.
  

  

**5. Food & Beverage Management**

* Oversee premium pantry and refreshment operations with focus on presentation, inventory management, product quality, food safety, vendor coordination, cost control, and wastage minimization.
  

  

**6. Vendor & Service Partner Management**

* Manage vendors for Housekeeping, Security, Pest Control, HVAC, Landscaping, Floral Services, Coffee Machines, Water Purification, Consumables, and Waste Management.
* Monitor performance through SLAs, periodic reviews, and quality audits.
  

  

**7. Facility Coordination**

* Collaborate with technical teams to ensure uninterrupted operations of HVAC, Electrical, Plumbing, Carpentry, Lighting, and Preventive Maintenance systems.
* Maintain full operational readiness of the sales gallery at all times.
* Maintain AMC and Service Records and follow-up timely services
* Facilitate breakdown recovery by handymen services or authroised vendor partners
  

  

**8. Financial & Inventory Management**

* Manage operational budgets, hospitality costs, inventory planning, stock audits, asset tracking, consumption analysis, vendor billing, and cost optimization.
  

  

**9. Quality Assurance & Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to SOPs, Brand Standards, Safety & Hygiene protocols, and Operational Checklists.
* Conduct audits and implement corrective actions.
  

  

**10. Reporting & Management Information**

* Prepare Daily Operations Reports, Weekly Dashboards, Guest Feedback Analysis, Incident Reports, Vendor Reviews, Budget Reports, and Monthly Hospitality Scorecards.
* Provide data-driven recommendations for improvement.
  

  

**Educational Qualifications**

Bachelor’s Degree in Hotel Management, Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or Tourism Management. Master’s Degree or PG in Hospitality Management is preferred.

Experience

7–12 years of progressive experience in luxury hospitality with a minimum 3 years in a managerial/leadership role. Experience in luxury hotels (Taj, Oberoi, Four Seasons preferred).

  
  

**Key Competencies**

• Luxury Guest Experience & VIP Management • Front Office, Concierge & Butler Services • Housekeeping & Food & Beverage Operations • Team Leadership & People Development • Vendor & Contract Management • Budget & Inventory Control • Quality Assurance & Service Audits • Excellent Communication & Presentation Skills • Microsoft Office Suite

  
  

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT/NPS)
* Audit Scores
* Vendor SLA Compliance
* Team Productivity & Retention
* Budget Adherence
  

  

**Typical Daily Tasks**

* Oversee daily guest arrival, welcome experience, and personalized service delivery.
* Conduct team briefings and assign shifts.
* Monitor lounge, pantry, housekeeping, and public area standards.
* Personally supervise VIP visits and high-profile engagements.
* Review guest feedback and resolve concerns on the same day.
* Coordinate with vendors and technical teams for facility readiness.
* Perform service audits and grooming checks.
* Update operational reports and dashboards.
* Ensure inventory levels and presentation standards are maintained.
* Prepare Daily/Weekly/ Monthly reports and conduct operations review
  

  

**Self-Image Required**

The Hospitality Manager must project a sophisticated, polished, and executive presence that embodies luxury hospitality. This includes impeccable grooming, professional attire, warm yet dignified demeanor, and a natural ability to make every guest feel valued. The individual should reflect the organization’s commitment to excellence, discretion, and personalized service at all times.

  
  

**Traits**

The ideal candidate should exhibit the following traits:

* Executive Presence & Impeccable Grooming
* Exceptional Emotional Intelligence and Empathy
* Strong Leadership and Coaching Ability
* Meticulous Attention to Detail
* Proactive and Solution-Oriented Mindset
* High Professional Integrity and Discretion
* Ability to Perform Calmly Under Pressure
* Passion for Delivering Memorable Luxury Experiences
* Collaborative and Stakeholder Management Skills
