title: Business Development Executive - Seller Acquisition
description:
Business Development Executive | Seller Acquisition

**Company:** TrueVolt  
**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Location:** Ahmedabad / Surat / Rajkot / Mumbai / Delhi  
**Department:** Sales & Business Development  
**Experience:** 0–3 years  
**Employment Type:** On-site / Field Sales

About TrueVolt

TrueVolt is building an open marketplace for smartphones, electronics, accessories and related products.

We connect local retailers and sellers with customers looking to purchase products in their area. Our platform helps sellers not only list their inventory but also generate sales by making their products discoverable to nearby customers through the TrueVolt app.

We are now expanding our seller network across major cities in India and are looking for energetic, target-driven people to join our Sales & Business Development team.

About the Role

As a **Business Development Executive for Seller Acquisition**, you will be responsible for expanding TrueVolt's seller network in your assigned city.

Your primary responsibility will be to identify potential sellers, visit their stores, explain the TrueVolt platform, onboard them, and build a strong relationship with them.

This is a **field sales role**, so you should be comfortable spending most of your working day in the market meeting shop owners and business owners.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and map potential sellers, retailers and mobile/electronics stores in your assigned territory.
* Visit shops and meet business owners / decision-makers.
* Introduce TrueVolt and explain how the platform can help sellers generate additional sales.
* Acquire and onboard new sellers onto the TrueVolt platform.
* Explain the seller onboarding process, platform features and commercial terms.
* Collect and verify required seller/business information and documents.
* Maintain regular follow-ups with prospective sellers and convert leads into active sellers.
* Build strong relationships with onboarded sellers.
* Help sellers understand how to effectively use the TrueVolt platform.
* Maintain daily activity and sales reports.
* Achieve weekly and monthly seller acquisition targets.
* Identify new market opportunities and competitor activity.
* Work closely with the TrueVolt operations and growth teams to improve seller acquisition and activation.

What We Are Looking For

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Comfortable speaking with shop owners and business professionals.
* Good convincing and negotiation ability.
* Self-motivated and target-oriented.
* Comfortable with field work and travelling within the assigned city.
* Ability to independently identify and approach potential sellers.
* Basic knowledge of smartphones, electronics, mobile accessories or retail is an advantage.
* Prior experience in field sales, merchant acquisition, B2B sales, retail sales or business development is preferred.
* Freshers with strong communication skills and a sales mindset are also welcome.

Who Will Do Well in This Role?

This role is ideal for someone who:

* Enjoys meeting new people every day.
* Is comfortable approaching businesses directly.
* Doesn't hesitate to make cold calls or walk into stores.
* Can convince a business owner to try a new platform.
* Enjoys working with targets and incentives.
* Takes ownership instead of waiting for instructions.
* Wants to grow in a fast-moving startup environment.

Performance Metrics

Your performance will primarily be measured on:

* New seller acquisition
* Seller activation
* Daily/weekly market visits
* Lead-to-onboarding conversion
* Active sellers generated
* Monthly sales/business targets

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in the education or EdTech industry, with expertise in performance marketing, large-scale budget management, lead generation, website management, social media, SEO, and brand development.

The candidate will be responsible for developing and executing integrated marketing strategies, managing a creative and performance marketing team, optimizing marketing investments, and driving measurable business growth through quality leads and improved conversions.

The role requires hands-on expertise in managing large marketing budgets, evaluating campaign performance, and aligning marketing initiatives with business and admission targets.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Digital Marketing Strategy & Leadership

* Develop and implement comprehensive digital marketing strategies aligned with business objectives, student acquisition targets, and revenue goals.
* Lead the overall digital marketing function and manage a team of graphic designers, video editors, performance marketers, and other marketing resources.
* Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns across digital platforms.
* Identify new marketing opportunities, channels, and growth strategies to improve brand visibility and lead generation.
* Work closely with sales and admissions teams to align marketing activities with business requirements.
* Establish marketing processes, performance benchmarks, and reporting mechanisms.

2. Performance Marketing & Lead Generation

* Plan, execute, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other relevant digital platforms.
* Develop strategies to generate high-quality leads for various courses, programs, and locations.
* Manage and optimize substantial advertising budgets, with prior experience handling a marketing budget of **at least ₹10 crore**.
* Monitor campaign performance, lead quality, cost per lead (CPL), cost per acquisition (CPA), return on ad spend (ROAS), and conversion rates.
* Optimize campaign budgets and audience targeting to improve lead quality and reduce acquisition costs.
* Analyze campaign performance and implement corrective actions to improve results.
* Collaborate with sales and admissions teams to understand lead quality, conversion rates, and enrollment outcomes.
* Build scalable lead-generation strategies to support business expansion and student enrollment targets.

3. Website Management & Conversion Optimization

* Oversee the company's website, landing pages, course pages, and lead-generation forms.
* Ensure website content, course information, and promotional campaigns are updated regularly.
* Improve website user experience, navigation, engagement, and inquiry generation.
* Monitor website traffic, visitor behavior, conversion rates, and lead sources.
* Work with website developers and external agencies to implement improvements and new functionalities.
* Optimize landing pages to improve campaign performance and lead conversion.
* Ensure accurate tracking and routing of website-generated inquiries.
* Identify opportunities to improve website performance and digital conversion funnels.

4. Social Media & Content Strategy

* Develop and execute social media strategies across Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
* Create and manage content calendars aligned with marketing campaigns and business objectives.
* Plan engaging content formats, including reels, videos, carousels, student testimonials, success stories, educational posts, faculty content, and promotional campaigns.
* Lead the development of creative content that strengthens brand awareness and drives inquiries.
* Monitor social media performance through reach, engagement, views, clicks, inquiries, and lead generation.
* Identify trending topics, new content formats, and opportunities to improve organic reach.
* Ensure consistency in brand messaging, content quality, and publishing schedules.
* Develop strategies to increase audience engagement and convert social media interest into prospective student inquiries.

5. SEO & Organic Growth

* Develop and implement SEO strategies to improve website visibility and organic traffic.
* Oversee keyword research, on-page SEO, technical SEO, content optimization, and link-building initiatives.
* Work with content teams and website developers to improve search engine rankings.
* Develop organic growth strategies to reduce dependence on paid advertising over time.
* Monitor organic traffic, keyword rankings, website performance, and organic lead generation.
* Identify opportunities to improve search visibility for courses, certifications, and finance education programs.
* Use SEO analytics and performance reports to identify gaps and implement improvements.

6. Creative Team Management

* Lead and manage graphic designers, video editors, and other creative resources.
* Plan and prioritize requirements for social media posts, reels, videos, advertisements, event creatives, and promotional campaigns.
* Provide clear creative briefs, campaign objectives, references, and timelines.
* Review and approve creative assets before publication.
* Ensure consistency with the company's brand guidelines and marketing objectives.
* Monitor team productivity, quality of output, and turnaround time.
* Encourage innovative ideas and creative approaches to improve audience engagement and campaign performance.

7. Marketing Budget & Financial Management

* Develop annual, quarterly, and monthly marketing budgets aligned with business goals.
* Manage and optimize marketing budgets of at least ₹10 crore, ensuring effective utilization and measurable returns.
* Allocate budgets across paid advertising, SEO, content, social media, website initiatives, and other marketing channels.
* Monitor advertising expenditure and campaign-level financial performance.
* Track CPL, CPA, ROAS, cost per enrollment, and overall marketing ROI.
* Identify inefficient spending and implement strategies to improve cost efficiency.
* Forecast lead generation and marketing expenditure based on business requirements.
* Present budget utilization, campaign performance, and growth recommendations to management.

8. Marketing Analytics & Reporting

* Develop regular marketing performance reports and dashboards.
* Track leads generated by source, campaign, platform, and location.
* Monitor lead quality, sales conversion rates, and enrollment performance.
* Evaluate campaign effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Use analytics tools to measure website performance, advertising results, and organic growth.
* Ensure accurate lead-source tracking and reporting across marketing channels.
* Present actionable insights and recommendations to management.
* Establish measurable KPIs for the digital marketing team.

9. Brand Building & Student Engagement

* Develop strategies to strengthen the company's brand presence among students, working professionals, colleges, and industry stakeholders.
* Plan digital campaigns, interactive content, quizzes, polls, contests, and community-building initiatives.
* Promote student achievements, faculty expertise, success stories, events, and career opportunities.
* Explore collaborations with educational institutions, influencers, industry professionals, and relevant communities.
* Develop innovative campaigns around admissions, course launches, festivals, and academic milestones.
* Improve brand recall, audience participation, and inbound inquiries through engaging marketing initiatives.

10. Marketing Automation & Growth Initiatives

* Explore marketing automation, retargeting, audience segmentation, and lead-nurturing strategies.
* Improve tracking of prospective students across the marketing and admissions funnel.
* Evaluate new marketing tools and technologies to improve campaign efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to improve lead management, follow-up processes, and conversion rates.
* Develop scalable marketing strategies to support business growth and expansion.

**REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Digital Marketing, or a related field. An MBA in Marketing will be an advantage.
* 6–10+ years of relevant experience in digital marketing, performance marketing, and team management.
* **Prior experience in the education or EdTech industry is strongly preferred.**
* **Demonstrated experience managing marketing budgets of at least ₹10 crore.**
* Strong expertise in Google Ads, Meta Ads, performance marketing, and multi-channel lead generation.
* Proven ability to drive high-quality leads and improve lead-to-enrollment conversion rates.
* Strong understanding of website management, landing page optimization, SEO, and organic growth.
* Experience managing social media strategy, content calendars, video marketing, and digital campaigns.
* Experience leading creative teams, including graphic designers and video editors.
* Strong understanding of marketing analytics, campaign attribution, budget allocation, and ROI optimization.
* Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards.
* Excellent leadership, communication, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to translate marketing data into actionable business strategies.
* A results-oriented approach with a strong focus on lead quality, cost efficiency, and business growth.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Achievement of monthly and quarterly lead-generation targets.
* Improvement in lead quality and lead-to-enrollment conversion rates.
* Optimization of cost per lead and cost per acquisition.
* Effective utilization of marketing budgets and improvement in campaign ROI.
* Growth in website traffic, organic leads, and landing-page conversions.
* Improvement in social media reach, engagement, and video performance.
* Improvement in SEO rankings and organic visibility.
* Timely execution of marketing campaigns and content calendars.
* Productivity and performance of the digital marketing and creative teams.
* Successful execution of brand-building and student engagement initiatives.
* Accuracy of marketing analytics, reporting, and budget tracking.

**IDEAL CANDIDATE**

The ideal candidate will be a strategic marketing leader with substantial experience in the education or EdTech industry and a proven track record of managing large-scale marketing budgets of at least ₹10 crore.

They should possess strong expertise in performance marketing, website management, social media, SEO, lead generation, and marketing analytics, along with the ability to lead creative teams and drive integrated marketing initiatives.

The candidate must be comfortable taking ownership of the complete digital marketing function, making data-driven decisions, optimizing marketing investments, and delivering measurable business outcomes through improved lead quality, student enrollments, and sustainable growth.

Pay: ₹150,000.00 - ₹200,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time

title: Senior Executive - Buying & Merchandising (Footwear)
description:
The Senior Executive – Buying, Merchandising & Product Development will support the seasonal range planning, assortment building, buying and merchandising activities, product performance analysis, EOSS planning, and product development initiatives for the Footwear category at Skechers India.  
The role will work closely with the Buying & Merchandising, Product Development, Planning, Marketing, Retail Operations, Visual Merchandising, and other cross-functional teams to ensure the right product, assortment, quantity, timing, pricing and channel mix are delivered in line with business objectives.  
The position will also be responsible for monitoring category and product performance at the store, region, channel, gender, style and size level, identifying opportunities and supporting corrective actions to maximise sales, sell-through, inventory productivity and profitability.

**Designation:** Senior Executive

**Role:** Buying & Merchandising

**Department:** Category - Footwear

**Position:** Permanent

**Location:** Mumbai

**Reporting To:** Deputy General Manager - B&M

Individual Contributor role

**KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Season Range Planning & Assortment Building**

* Support the development of **seasonal footwear ranges** based on business objectives, historical performance, market trends and consumer requirements.
* Analyse previous-season performance to identify **winning styles, underperforming products, gaps and opportunities** for the upcoming season.
* Support assortment planning across **categories, gender, product types, price points, technologies, franchises and channels**.
* Assist in determining the optimum width and depth of assortment based on store grades, regional requirements and channel potential.
* Support the development of **OTB and buy recommendations** in line with business plans.
* Ensure the assortment is balanced across core, fashion, seasonal and newness products.
* Participate in seasonal range reviews and product selection meetings with relevant stakeholders.

**2. Buying & Merchandise Planning**

* Support the Buying Manager/Senior Manager in developing the seasonal buying plan for the assigned category.
* Prepare and maintain **buy forms, assortment sheets, range plans, catalogues and other buying-related documents**.
* Track planned versus actual buys and highlight significant deviations.
* Monitor product availability and ensure adequate inventory coverage for key styles and periods.
* Coordinate with Planning and Supply Chain teams to ensure product availability as per the agreed seasonal calendar.
* Support decisions related to **replenishment, stock balancing, liquidation and inventory movement** based on product performance.
* Monitor inventory ageing and identify potential risks to minimise excess and obsolete inventory.

**3. Season Launch & Delivery Tracking**

* Take ownership of tracking **seasonal product deliveries** for the respective category.
* Maintain detailed trackers for planned, received and pending deliveries.
* Coordinate with relevant internal teams to identify and resolve delays or gaps impacting season launches.
* Ensure key launches are aligned with the agreed **Go-To-Market calendar**.
* Highlight delivery risks and provide timely updates to the Buying/Merchandising leadership team.
* Support cross-functional teams in ensuring that new-season products are available in stores within the planned launch timelines.

**4. Product Performance & Sell-Through Management**

* Conduct periodic, in-depth analysis of category performance across:
  + Region
  + Store grade
  + Store/channel
  + Category
  + Gender
  + Product/style
  + Size
  + Price point
  + Season
* Monitor **sales, sell-through, stock cover, inventory levels, ageing, markdowns and profitability**.
* Identify top-performing and underperforming styles and recommend appropriate actions.
* Analyse store-level performance and identify assortment gaps or over/under-stock situations.
* Support initiatives to improve **full-price sell-through and inventory productivity**.
* Provide regular performance dashboards and actionable insights to the Buying & Merchandising team.
* Track agreed **GM% and category profitability deliverables** and highlight areas requiring corrective action.

**5. EOSS & Markdown Planning**

* Support the Buying Manager in planning and executing **End of Season Sale (EOSS)** activities.
* Analyse ageing and slow-moving inventory to identify products requiring markdown or liquidation.
* Support markdown recommendations based on product performance, inventory position, store/channel and seasonality.
* Monitor EOSS performance and sell-through during the sale period.
* Track inventory liquidation and identify opportunities to minimise carry-forward stock.
* Prepare post-EOSS analysis and recommendations for future seasons.

**6. Product Development**

* Support **new product development initiatives** for key channels, strategic partners and specific market opportunities.
* Coordinate with internal Product Development/Design teams and other stakeholders for product briefs, specifications and development timelines.
* Conduct market and competitor analysis to identify **product gaps, consumer trends and emerging opportunities**.
* Support development of products based on channel/customer requirements while maintaining Skechers brand standards.
* Assist in tracking product development milestones from **concept/brief through sampling, approval and finalisation**.
* Coordinate feedback on samples, specifications, colourways, materials, pricing and commercial viability.
* Maintain product development trackers and ensure timelines are adhered to.
* Support the development of commercially viable products with the right balance of **consumer relevance, brand fit, price point and margin**.

**7. Product Knowledge & Training**

* Conduct seasonal **product conferences and product knowledge sessions** in coordination with relevant teams.
* Develop product knowledge and understanding among store teams, including:
  + Product features
  + Technologies
  + Key selling points
  + Consumer benefits
  + Product differentiation
  + Target consumer
* Work with Retail Operations and L&D teams to ensure effective communication of new-season product information.
* Support creation and dissemination of product training material and product information.

**8. Marketing & Visual Merchandising Support**

* Work closely with Marketing and Visual Merchandising teams to align product launches with the **seasonal marketing calendar**.
* Support key marketing initiatives and product-focused campaigns.
* Provide product information and key selling propositions required for marketing communication.
* Assist in developing **merchandise display plans** for new-season products.
* Coordinate with Visual Merchandising and Retail Operations to ensure appropriate product presentation in stores.
* Support key launches and campaigns through timely availability of products and relevant product information.

**9. Store & Regional Performance Analysis**

* Conduct regular reviews of product performance across stores and regions.
* Identify variations in performance based on **store grade, geography, channel and consumer profile**.
* Recommend assortment adjustments based on regional and store-level trends.
* Identify size-level gaps and recommend appropriate size curves for future buys.
* Analyse store-level sell-through to identify opportunities for stock transfers, replenishment or assortment optimisation.
* Partner with Retail Operations and regional teams to understand market feedback and translate insights into merchandising actions.

**10. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with **Buying, Merchandising, Planning, Product Development, Supply Chain, Marketing, Visual Merchandising, Retail Operations, Finance and other relevant teams**.
* Ensure timely communication of category plans, product launches, delivery status and performance insights.
* Participate in regular business reviews and provide relevant data and recommendations.
* Ensure alignment between product strategy, inventory availability and commercial objectives.
* Build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners/vendors, wherever required.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)**

The role will be measured on:

* Seasonal range planning and assortment effectiveness
* Category sales achievement
* Sell-through % and full-price sell-through
* GM% / gross margin delivery
* Inventory productivity and stock cover
* New-season launch and delivery adherence
* EOSS sell-through and liquidation
* Reduction in aged/excess inventory
* Style and size-level productivity
* New product development timelines
* Product launch readiness
* Store and regional assortment effectiveness
* Accuracy and timeliness of MIS/analysis
* Effectiveness of cross-functional execution

**ROLE SPECIFICATIONS**

**Qualification**

* Graduate from **FDDI (Footwear Design & Development Institute)** preferred.
* Degree/Diploma in Footwear, Fashion, Retail, Merchandising or a related discipline will be an added advantage.

**Experience**

* **Minimum 4 years of relevant experience** in Buying & Merchandising, preferably within the **footwear, fashion, sportswear, lifestyle or retail industry**.
* Experience in seasonal range planning, assortment building and product performance analysis.
* Exposure to product development and working with cross-functional teams will be preferred.

Experience in a multi-store retail environment would be an advantage.

**CORE COMPETENCIES**

**Functional Competencies**

* Season range planning and assortment building
* Buying & merchandise planning
* Sell-through management
* Category performance management
* Inventory and stock productivity
* EOSS and markdown planning
* Style and size-level analysis
* Store and regional performance analysis
* GM% and margin management
* Product development
* Product lifecycle management
* Market and competitor analysis
* Product knowledge and training
* Merchandise display planning

**Behavioural Competencies**

* Strong analytical and numerical ability
* Commercial acumen
* Customer and consumer orientation
* Strong attention to detail
* Planning and execution skills
* Ability to work with multiple stakeholders
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Problem-solving and decision-making ability
* Ownership and accountability
* Ability to work in a fast-paced retail environment
* Collaborative and team-oriented approach

**Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in **MS Excel**, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, charts and data analysis.
* Good understanding of merchandising reports and retail KPIs.
* Exposure to ERP/retail merchandising systems would be an advantage.
* Ability to prepare management reports, dashboards and presentations using **Excel and PowerPoint**.

**KEY STAKEHOLDERS**

**Internal:**  
Buying & Merchandising | Planning | Product Development | Retail Operations | Marketing | Visual Merchandising | Supply Chain | Finance | HR/L&D

**External:**  
Vendors | Product Development Partners | Strategic Channel/Business Partners | Other relevant external stakeholders

**IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE**

The ideal candidate should have a strong combination of **merchandising expertise, commercial understanding, analytical capability and product orientation**. The candidate should be comfortable working with large volumes of product and store-level data, translating insights into actionable buying and merchandising decisions, and collaborating with multiple teams to deliver seasonal business objectives.

Experience in the **footwear or sportswear industry** would be highly preferred, with an understanding of product technologies, consumer preferences, retail dynamics, seasonal buying cycles and product lifecycle management.

**About Skechers**

Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations.

description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Manager, AI Services Consultant– Job Description**

  

**Why This Role? Why Now?**

Customer experience is transforming through AI-driven innovation. At Zendesk, we don’t just embrace this change; we lead it. Our Professional Services team is revolutionising how we help our customers implement and adopt AI by building an AI Delivery team and methodology. As the technical and product expert for our AI-powered Resolution Platform, the AI Services Manager role is integral to delivering quick time to value while guiding our customers through their configuration and optimisation.

  

**Mission**

As the AI Services Manager at Zendesk, you will be leading a team by example with product expertise, and joining a management team in our expanding AI Delivery team.Your mission is to provide technical solutions and remove roadblocks for your customers to drive resolutions on our AI Platform. You will act as a technical expert and trusted advisor, guiding customers through complex configurations with agility and precision. Your strong consulting skills and project management expertise will ensure **seamless integration and optimisation of AI solutions** , driving transformative business outcomes.

  

**Overarching Objective For The Role**

* Accelerate customers’ time‑to‑value by driving adoption and operational excellence for Zendesk AI solutions, ensuring customers realise measurable business impact from initial deployment through scale.
* Be the customer’s AI technical expert. Turn goals into the right configuration, integrations, and design choices, and remove blockers fast.
* Lead smooth, on-time delivery. Run projects end-to-end with clear scope, timelines, and stakeholder alignment to deliver reliably.
Build and lead the new AI Delivery team. Stand up the team, methodology and ways of working, while staying hands-on in customer delivery.  

  

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

  

**Strategic Accountabilities**

* **Technical Expertise & Guidance:** Provide expert advice on the **implementation and optimisation of Zendesk AI products,** ensuring customers leverage the full capabilities of the technology to meet their business goals.
* **Change Management & Training:** Facilitate change management processes and deliver consultative sessions to ensure smooth adoption and **integration of AI solutions** within customer organisations.
* **Successful Project Delivery:** Accountable for the timely and successful delivery of AI projects, both your own and your team’s, owning delivery quality, capacity and utilization across the team, meeting or exceeding customer expectations and maintaining high standards of quality.
* **Customer Satisfaction:** Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction, contributing to customer retention and potential upsell opportunities.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with internal teams, including Customer Success and Sales, to ensure alignment on the customer’s AI Roadmap and address any technical challenges that would block the customer from adopting AI.
* **Tactical solutions for business outcomes:** Ensure that AI solutions are effectively aligned with customer business goals, resulting in measurable improvements in customer experience and AI Adoption.
* **Team Building & Leadership:** Build and lead the new AI Delivery team end to end, including hiring and onboarding, defining the delivery methodology and ways of working, assigning tasks and workloads, conducting performance evaluations, and creating individual growth plans to build a high-performing team.

  

**What You’ll Need to Succeed**

  

**Strategic Skills & Expertise**

* **Consulting Expertise:** Strong consulting skills with the ability to assess client needs, develop strategic solutions, and provide expert guidance throughout the project lifecycle.
* **Strong Communication Skills:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* **Project Management:** Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of AI projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within scope, and meet quality standards.
* **Technical Proficiency in AI:** Deep understanding of AI technologies, particularly Zendesk AI products, with the ability to implement and optimise these solutions effectively.
* **Agility and Adaptability:** Ability to work effectively in diverse and dynamic environments, adapting to changing client needs and industry trends.
* **Problem-Solving Abilities:** Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify challenges and develop innovative solutions.
* **Continuous Learning:** Commitment to staying updated on the latest AI trends and advancements, ensuring the delivery of cutting-edge solutions to clients.

  

**Qualifications**

* Must have a minimum of 8+ years of related experience in Consulting / Professional Services.
* Previous experience in go-to-customer/GTM roles in enterprise technology / SaaS; either customer success management, professional services/consulting, technical account management, or solutions engineering/pre-sales consulting.
* **Strong hands-on experience working with API integration, specifically REST APIs, with a solid understanding of JSON and SQL scripting.**
* **End-to-end team handling experience, including conducting performance evaluations, creating growth plans, and assigning tasks.**
* Demonstrated experience in using adoption and health analytics to build predictive models and forecasts for churn and expansion; surface early risk signals and recommend mitigations to secure retention and growth.
* Demonstrated experience designing and executing success plans or roadmaps that drive measurable customer outcomes.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degrees; certifications in AI strategy or project management preferred.
* Experience managing AI or software adoption programs with demonstrated impact on business metrics such as retention or satisfaction.
* Certifications in AI strategy or project management preferred.
* Excellent program management and cross-functional influence skills.
* Familiarity with emerging AI trends is a plus.
Ability to distill complex AI concepts for diverse audiences, especially executive stakeholders.  

  

Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based.

**The intelligent heart of customer experience**

Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.

Zendesk believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. Our hybrid way of working, enables us to purposefully come together in person, at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn whilst also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week.

**Overview**
------------

### **About us**

We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

**About Business Assurance**

  
We help companies ensure compliance, build high-performing management systems, and meet competence needs within a wide range of industries. DNV helps companies understand Working with us, you can be involved in technically challenging and innovative projects worldwide demanding a broad variety of expertise. ### **About the role**

The Marketing Technology & Operations Manager will work closely with the Head of Digital to oversee DNV's global web ecosystem, ensuring the effective delivery, governance, and evolution of our digital presence. The role is accountable for website operations, platform strategy, digital performance, and the successful delivery of initiatives that support business growth, customer engagement, and marketing effectiveness.

This role is part of the Global Digital team and involves working closely with stakeholders across different regions and business functions to improve customer experience, optimize digital platforms, and support global marketing initiatives. The position plays a key role in strengthening DNV’s digital capabilities and helping achieve strategic business goals. The Marketing Technology & Operations Manager will report to the Head of Digital and will be based in Pune, India.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead the strategy, governance, and overall performance of DNV’s global website ecosystem.
* Manage and develop a team responsible for website operations, content publishing, optimization, and campaign execution.
* Establish web standards, policies, and processes to ensure consistency, compliance, accessibility, and brand alignment.
* Serve as the business owner for website platforms, coordinating with technical teams, content owners, and external vendors.
* Drive improvements in user experience, SEO, AI discoverability, personalization, conversion rates, and digital performance.

* Manage relationships with technology vendors and agencies to ensure successful project delivery within timelines and budgets.
* Assess and implement marketing technology solutions to improve operational efficiency and business outcomes.
* Act as the subject matter expert for web technologies, digital best practices, and emerging industry trends.

DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.

### **About you**

* At least 8 years of experience in website management, digital marketing operations, marketing technology, or similar digital-focused roles.

* Experience supporting and enabling digital marketing campaigns through websites, landing pages, forms, and customer journey initiatives.
* Good knowledge of SEO, AI-driven search optimization, user experience (UX), and conversion rate optimization (CRO).
* Hands-on experience with web analytics tools such as Google Analytics 4, Ahrefs, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with marketing technology platforms including CRM systems, marketing automation tools, lead management solutions, and web analytics platforms. Experience with Oracle Sales Cloud (OSC), Oracle Eloqua, or similar enterprise solutions is an added advantage.
* Ability to work effectively with development teams, IT functions, agencies, and technology vendors to deliver digital projects and enhancements.

**Key Competencies**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong leadership capabilities with a proven ability to develop, coach, and motivate teams while fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture.
* Ability to lead and support change initiatives in a global business environment.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build alignment across functions, regions, and organizational levels.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on converting insights into actionable business outcomes.
* Good commercial awareness and understanding of digital marketing, customer engagement, and business objectives.
* Excellent planning and organizational skills, capable of balancing strategic priorities with operational execution.
* Self-motivated with the ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and make informed decisions in a fast-paced environment.
* Able to simplify complex technical concepts and communicate them effectively to business stakeholders.
* Data-driven, curious, and passionate about continuous improvement and innovation.
* Strong networking and relationship-building skills.
* High attention to detail and commitment to delivering quality results.

  
*Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country-specific laws and practices.*

**Benefits**
------------

Please note that some benefits may vary depending on location, business area, and employment terms. Please confirm with your recruiter.

### **Profit Share**

You’ll be part of our global profit share scheme that means we all share in our success as a business. If we profit, so do you. This will be part of our Total Compensation approach each year and depends on our year-end results.

### **Professional Development**

We believe in the 70/20/10 learning model, where 70% of your learning comes from performing your everyday tasks and working on different projects, new areas and initiatives to gain new skills. 20% from working with others and mentoring and the rest from formal education.

### **Hybrid Work Model**

We work in a hybrid model (three days from the office) and have flexible starting hours. This means you can fit your work and life together in a way that works for you.

### **Global Opportunities**

We support you in exploring different career opportunities or shifting between teams, business areas, or geographies, so that you can shape your career according to what you find motivating.

### **Modern Office in Pune**

Our office in Pune has a modern look and feel and you’ll find zones for both focused work and team integration. Sit/stand desks, high-quality adjustable chairs and balance balls are just a few examples of what ergonomic office means at DNV.

### **Integration Events**

Depending on where you are located, you’ll have the opportunity to participate in offsite meetings as well as different initiatives and fun events at the office. We believe that a well-integrated team is a well-functioning team.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**
-----------------------------------

At DNV, our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is not only an ethical choice, but also a business decision.

Diversity, fairness, and a sense of belonging are a source of strength for our people, our business, and our customers, and help us to deliver on our purpose, vision, and values.

about DEI

Transcript

Business Assurance is a unit of DNV where we are working with our customers towards verifying them if they are compliant with some particular rules. We are responsible for scheduling audits. We need to assign the right person with the right competences to conduct such an audit. And we are analysing and improving their processes. But sometimes we need to register some findings like observation, opportunity for improvement, or even non-conformities. I verify our clients' system management by observing them, how they work, how they produce. It's very interesting because we are delivering some additional information for our customers, what they cannot see or discover in their own systems. My work life as an auditor is completely different than employees who are working from the office every day. Because usually I'm travelling to our customers that are located in a different part of our country. Almost every week I work with different people in different companies. So if you like travel, if you are well organized, DNV can be for you.

description:
**Job Description: Product Manager - AI & Digital Initiatives**

**Overview**

We are seeking a skilled and proactive Product Manager to join our dynamic team and drive key AI and digital transformation initiatives. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in building and scaling AI products, with proven experience in the fintech or financial services space. This role is critical to our mission of leveraging cutting-edge technology to enhance customer experience, optimize operations, and drive innovation as a leader in the Indian banking sector.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Product Strategy & Roadmap:** Contribute to the product strategy and manage the execution of the roadmap for our AI-powered solutions, including but not limited to, voice bots, OCR-driven document processing, and internal AI agents.
* **Platform-Level Requirements:** Act as the primary interface between business needs and the engineering team. **Develop detailed product requirements and Gherkin specifications** to ensure that AI capabilities are built as reusable platforms that can be applied to various use cases across the bank.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner closely with data scientists, engineers, designers, and business stakeholders to conceptualize, build, and launch new AI products and features. **This role is focused on the 'what' and 'why', collaborating with engineering on the 'how'.**
* **Customer & Market Insight:** Conduct in-depth market research, competitive analysis, and customer feedback sessions to identify opportunities and inform product decisions.
* **Product Lifecycle Management:** Manage the entire product lifecycle from ideation to launch and post-launch optimization, ensuring products meet business goals and user needs.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Effectively communicate product vision, progress, and results to senior management and other key stakeholders.
* **Go-to-Market Strategy:** Partner with marketing, sales, and operations teams to develop and execute go-to-market plans for new product launches.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Experience:**
  + Minimum of **5-7 years of experience** in product management, with at least 3 years specifically focused on building and shipping **AI products.**
  + Proven experience building and launching **voice bots** for customer service or internal operations.
  + Hands-on experience with **Optical Character Recognition (OCR) AI** for document processing and data extraction.
  + Track record of creating and deploying **AI agents for various business roles** , such as underwriting, fraud analysis, or sales support.
  + Demonstrated experience working in a **fintech** or financial services company is a significant advantage.
  + A strong portfolio of successful products launched and scaled.
* **Technical & Domain Expertise:**
  + Solid understanding of the AI/ML product development lifecycle, including data pipelines, model training, and deployment.
  + Proven ability to write clear, actionable **Gherkin syntax and technical requirements** for a platform-based approach.
  + Familiarity with modern AI technologies such as Generative AI, machine learning, and natural language processing (NLP).
* **Certifications:**
  + Possession of relevant certifications in AI, machine learning, or product management (e.g., PMP, CSPO, or specialized AI/ML certifications from reputable providers like Google, AWS, or Coursera) is a plus.
* **Soft Skills:**
  + Excellent communication, leadership, and analytical skills.
  + Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment.
  Strong problem-solving abilities and a data-driven approach to decision-making.

**Join Date**

The ideal candidate should be able to join within **one month** of the offer acceptance.

**Why Join Us?**

You will be part of a forward-thinking team at the forefront of digital innovation in the Indian banking sector. We offer a challenging and rewarding environment where your work will have a direct impact on millions of customers and our bank's strategic growth.

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

If you are highly analytical, organized and detailed, yet able to extrapolate and summarize key information, as needed; have experience in leading or participating in small to medium-scale projects and business process mapping; have led or contributed to legal entity merger or acquisition-type projects, preferably, then your search ends here.

As a Project Manager in the 'Chief Administrative Office - Purchase to Pay (Tech Product Management team)', you'd be part of a team that is responsible for the global governance and standards of all projects across its businesses and ensures complete alignment of project portfolios with strategic priorities. In addition, the team centralizes the review and prioritization of all demand – whether new projects or modifications to existing work and provides oversight and transparency of all project activities, risks and dependencies. We currently manage a portfolio of 150+ projects that support firmwide initiatives, business model redesigns, business process improvements, short-term pilots, enhancements and technology deployments and migrations – of which around 70% relate to the firm's legal entity mergers & acquisitions, new onboardings and liquidations that you'd be part of.

The team is dedicated to ensuring full transparency, alignment, consistency in approach, cross-functional coordination and risk management across all portfolios/ projects. The team partners with the CAO businesses - including Global Security, Global Real Estate, Global Supplier Services, Amenity Services, Corporate Insurance Services, Technology, Lines of Businesses, Controllers, CAO Controls, and other groups, as needed.

The team includes dedicated full-time Program/ Project Managers responsible for full end-to-end management of a portfolio of complex, multi-functional, high-risk projects. The Portfolio Manager for CAO PMO is responsible for day-to-day management of all project and portfolio information, standards and reports; supported by Program Managers. All Program Managers are supported by a team of Project Managers and Project Analysts/ Test Managers that support project deliverables, development of standards and lead small to medium-scale projects.

**Job responsibilities:**

* Support CAO PMO Program Managers with project and portfolio deliverables, including:
  + Lead and/ or participate in design sessions and requirements gathering sessions to capture business/ functional requirements, business rules and controls.
  + Interface with cross-functional stakeholders to outline and confirm that their project plan actions are followed up and completed within the stipulated deadlines.

Also, lead project working group/ UAT status meetings/ ad-hoc meetings, as required.
  + Lead UAT/ Hypercare tollgates – ensuring all stakeholders approve before moving to the next project phase.
  + Document minutes of meetings; follow up on open actions to closure; report on project status and own project plan updates for assigned projects.
  + Support first review of project documentation/ minutes drafted by Project Analysts – for projects assigned.

  + Provide analytical and logical thinking to understand and analyze complex business processes, identifying risks and defining possible solutions.
* Lead small projects for CAO PMO – from concept through closure and guide/ support/ track actions of peers partnering with you on your projects.
* Work closely with Program Managers to analyze existing PMO systems and make recommendations for improvement, if asked to.
* Conduct and record business process mapping (current vs. target state) of processes, systems/ applications, controls and documents, conduct gap analysis and summarize findings to develop CAO-wide standards.
* Participate in strategy discussions to define future state operating models.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities and skills**

* You are highly analytical, organized and detailed, yet able to extrapolate and summarize key information, as needed.
* You have experience leading or participating in projects independently and confidently and can manage small projects within the established CAO PMO framework, including business process mapping and reporting (current vs. target state).
* You are able to quickly pick up subject matter and possess proficient written and verbal communication skills.
* You are highly motivated, know when to raise red flags, and are able to communicate regularly and clearly.
* You communicate clearly and consistently, listen carefully to different perspectives, follow through on commitments, and maintain humility by seeking help and owning mistakes when appropriate.
* You improve relentlessly by seeking and acting on feedback, speaking up early about risks or opportunities, learning quickly from experience, and identifying practical ways to improve project delivery, processes and stakeholder outcomes.
* You believe in doing the right thing by working collaboratively across teams, treating colleagues and stakeholders with respect, use sound judgment and data to make decisions, and uphold standards for risk, controls, conduct and integrity.
* You embrace innovation and AI by remaining open to new ideas, emerging technologies, and the responsible use of AI to improve efficiency, quality, decision-making and stakeholder outcomes, while adhering to risk, control and data protection requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities and skills**

* 6 to 9 years of experience preferred.
* Prior experience in leading or contributing to legal entity merger or acquisition-type projects or to product delivery will be an added advantage.
* Basic to intermediate level experience in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint and project analysis. Experience in qTest, Visio, PEGA and Jira preferred.

· Conduct regular store visits to review operations, staff performance, merchandising, customer service, and compliance.

· Monitor gross margins, discounting, operating expenses, cash handling, billing controls, and preventable losses.

· Ensure product displays, pricing labels, promotional schemes, store hygiene, and customer service standards are maintained.

· Handle escalated customer complaints and implement actions to improve satisfaction and repeat purchases.

· Coordinate with Purchase, Warehouse, Supply Chain, Marketing, Finance, and HR for smooth store operations.

· Submit accurate daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports with sales analysis, issues, action plans, and business forecasts.

title: Senior Manager - Integrated Intelligence
description:
**Job Description:**  
Job Purpose
  
Mars Snacking brings together iconic brands and distinctive capabilities to shape the future of snacking.Within the portfolio, this role will be the voice of the consumer and a strategic partner to Marketing, while also working closely with RD and Sales to support product development and solve business challenges.
  
  
The role will turn consumer, shopper, category and business data into clear choices that strengthen brand strategy, accelerate innovation and unlock sustainable growth.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Shape portfolio and brand strategy
  
  

* Build and deliver a focused learning agenda aligned to the portfolio’s biggest growth questions and commercial priorities.
* Synthesize consumer, category, cultural and competitive signals to identify penetration, frequency, premiumisation and market-level growth opportunities.
* Partner brand and category teams to translate insights into sharper strategies, propositions, communication and activation choices.

Lead insight-driven innovation and mix development
  
  

* Guide innovation and renovation from opportunity identification through concept, product, pack, pricing, communication and launch learning.
* Design fit-for-purpose qualitative and quantitative learning plans, balancing rigour, agility, cost and speed.
* Bring deep consumer and cultural understanding to create distinctive, locally relevant mixes and improve first-time-right decision making.

Connect data to action
  
  

* Work Hands-on and deep dive into Retail Audit, Household Panel, Brand Tracking, point-of-sale, digital commerce, media, internal sales and other available sources to deliver one coherent business story.
* Lead regular performance reviews and deep dives, moving beyond reporting to diagnose the “why”, identify growth opportunities and recommend actions.
* Partner stakeholders on marketing effectiveness, pricing, portfolio and channel questions using advanced analytics and experimentation where relevant.

Build consumer and shopper closeness
  
  

* Deepen understanding of shoppers, retail environments and emerging channels, translating learning into implementable actions for Marketing and Sales.
* Bring the outside-in through immersions, trend work, competitive intelligence and direct consumer connection.
* Champion a culture of consumer obsession by making insights accessible, memorable and easy to use.

Influence and deliver with excellence
  
  

* Act as a trusted, objective thought partner who can challenge constructively, resolve debates through evidence and influence stakeholders.
* Manage research partners end to end, including briefing, methodology selection, quality, timelines, budgets and action-oriented delivery.
* Experiment with agile, digital and AI-enabled approaches while protecting research quality, responsible data use and confidentiality.

Job Specifications
  
  

* Post-graduate qualification; an MBA or specialization in marketing, consumer behaviour, analytics or research is advantageous.
* Approximately 5-10 years of relevant experience in consumer and market insights, analytics or research, gained in FMCG and/or a high-quality research or consulting organization.
* Hands-on experience across qualitative and quantitative research, with strong capability in translating learning into commercial recommendations.
* Experience working with syndicated and business data such as Retail Audit, Household Panel, Brand Tracking, POS/e-commerce and internal sales data is critical and prior experience in it is an added advantage
* Strong strategic thinking, storytelling and presentation skills, with the confidence to simplify complexity and influence cross-functional stakeholders.
* A curious, collaborative and action-oriented mindset, with high standards of ownership, ethics and execution.

title: Manager Employee Workplace Solutions, MSF
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

**Business Description:**

International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the WPB team.

**Principal Responsibilities:**

  

* Source new accounts from the existing corporate base and deliver on meeting New-To-Bank targets.
* Cross-sell asset products of the bank- mainly Home Loans (via referral), Personal Loans, Cards, Premier (referral)
* Ensure the KYC/AML norms of the bank are complied with at all times.
* Execute marketing events and promotions to generate business in their catchments, in conjunction with support departments such as Marketing.
* Respond to Corporate Employee Programme (CEP) complaints in a timely manner and to customer satisfaction
* Ensure a consistently high level of product and service delivery for relevant customer touch points
* Develop and maintain good customer relations and ensure effective service delivery
* Use learnings from customer/area visits and discussions to sharpen the proposition and enhance delivery and provide feedback to leadership / central teams
* Comply to all relevant AML regulations & Global Standards
* Develop a collaborative environment with all members of sales team
* Be a role model of HSBC Group Values, lead by demonstrating and driving value based culture that imbibes Treating Customer Fairly (TCF) principles in all spheres of IWPB Business.
* Ensure bank processes are followed in view of product documentation, complaint management, system usage etc.
* Ensure end to end usage of leads allocated within allocated timelines with correct updation on CRMS
* Safeguard the bank from potential loss/ damage arising out of stakeholder complaints.
* Comply with the applicable laws, regulations, Group and local policy related to Sanctions and AML policy of HSBC while undertaking various day to day operations.
* Demonstrate an understanding of PEP acceptance, prohibition, CDD & EDD guidelines in order to ensure that the INM IWPB is fully compliant with the PEP LoBP. Demonstrate an understanding of PEP acceptance, prohibition, CDD & EDD guidelines in order to ensure that the INM IWPB is fully compliant with the PEP LoBP.
* Be aware and identify high risk indicators for various products and Services offered by INM IWPB (ex. cash, insurance, credit cards products etc.)
* Ensure that all records are obtained in respect of INM IWPB customers or New to bank customer for any products and services provided by HSBC are as per the process laid down.
* Ensure Adherence to the regulatory guidelines and internal AML & Sanction Policy of HSBC, which includes pouch and mail, monetary instruments, cash services and payment transparency Line of Business Procedures
* Must be aware of the scope of services of various products and services that are offered and those which are prohibited because of the guidelines laid down in the line of Business procedures and must ensure the same is communicated to customer in an effective and polite manner

**Qualifications - External**

  

* Graduate/ Post Graduate (Masters)/ MBA with three to five years’ work exp.
* Experience (preferable) in frontline customer services/ relationship management.
* Strong communication, client focus and influencing skills
* Sound knowledge on the Banking sector in general
* Able to communicate well in English and local languages

**Pro-tip : Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage**

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

**Position Overview**

  
  

Autodesk's Platform team is seeking a motivated Software Engineer (Java AWS) to join our growing engineering organization. Our ecosystem is built around cloud-native services and modern applications that power Autodesk's platform capabilities.

In this role, you will contribute to the development and evolution of Autodesk's cloud data platform while learning to build reliable, scalable software used by millions of customers worldwide. You will work alongside experienced engineers, architects, and product managers and gain hands-on experience with modern cloud technologies and engineering practices.

You will be based in **Pune** and report to the Manager of Software Development. We offer a flexible hybrid work model.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

  
  

* Participate in the software development lifecycle, including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance
* Develop, test, troubleshoot, and maintain high-quality software primarily using Java and Spring Boot
* Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following established engineering practices
* Work with experienced engineers and architects to understand technical designs and translate requirements into software features
* Contribute to cloud-native services and RESTful APIs running on AWS
* Build automated unit and integration tests to improve software quality and reliability
* Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to continuously improve your engineering skills
* Learn and contribute to CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, monitoring, and production support practices
* Collaborate with team members to diagnose and resolve software defects and production issues
* Contribute ideas that improve engineering practices, developer productivity, and product quality
* Use modern AI-assisted development tools and practices, including code generation, automated reviews, and Spec-Driven Development, with appropriate engineering validation and oversight
  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience

* Good understanding of Java and object-oriented programming concepts
* Understanding of fundamental data structures, algorithms, and software engineering principles
* Familiarity with Spring or Spring Boot, gained through coursework, projects, internships, or professional experience
* Basic understanding of RESTful APIs and web application development.
* Familiarity with relational or NoSQL databases
* Experience using Git or another source-control system
* Understanding of software testing concepts, including unit and integration testing
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills
* Ability and enthusiasm to learn new technologies and work collaboratively in an engineering team
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  
  

Experience in the following areas is helpful but not required:

  
  

* Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, including services such as S3, SQS, DynamoDB, Lambda, or IAM
* Familiarity with microservices and cloud-native application development
* Exposure to Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform
* Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and tools
* Experience with shell scripting or Linux development environments
* Exposure to application monitoring, observability, or production support
* Familiarity with Docker or containerized applications
* Exposure to streaming or distributed data technologies such as Apache Flink
* Experience using AI-assisted software development tools

title: Head of IT - GIFT
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

**Business Description:**

Our GCIO organisation plays a critical role for the bank. This team partners with our businesses to build the platforms, systems, and products that our customers use every day. This team keeps people’s money and data safe, and is at the forefront of driving innovation for our businesses, customers, and colleagues.

**Role purpose**

The Technology Country Management role is accountable to the Regional CIO for in-country business relationships, execution of global and regional Technology strategy, and management/oversight of local execution, change portfolio, and Technology services within the country.

This role provides end-to-end leadership across engineering, delivery, governance, regulatory engagement and audit readiness—ensuring Technology outcomes are secure, resilient, compliant, and aligned to business priorities.

**Key responsibilities**

**Country Technology leadership & stakeholder management**

* Provide in-country oversight and coordination for Technology services and business relationships, managing resources across multiple Technology disciplines.
* Act as the senior Technology point of contact for country stakeholders, ensuring priorities, risks, and dependencies are clearly understood and managed.
* Attend relevant COO-chaired governance committees, leading key Technology discussions and driving decisions to closure.

**Strategy execution & roadmap ownership**

* Drive and implement the Technology strategy defined by the Group CIO, GB/GF CIOs, Technology Function Heads and Regional CIO—translating it into an executable country plan.
* Develop and maintain the Country Technology roadmap, covering all relevant GB/GF and Technology Function activities, aligned to business objectives and regulatory expectations.
* Ensure local demand is clearly articulated into global portfolios, with the right data to enable prioritisation and investment decisions.

**Regulatory engagement, audit management & control assurance**

* Maintain strong relationships with relevant regulators and government stakeholders, supporting the Regional CIO and country leadership in regulatory engagement.
* Face regulators as required: present Technology strategy, control posture, resilience, cyber/operational risk management, and remediation progress with clear, evidence-based narratives.
* Lead Technology responses to internal audit, external audit, and regulatory examinations: coordinate walkthroughs, evidence packs, management responses, and closure plans.
* Ensure audit findings and regulatory observations are remediated on time with clear ownership, milestones, and sustainable control improvements.

**Engineering leadership (Cloud, API, DevSecOps, AI)**

* Provide strong engineering oversight across modern technology stacks, including:  
    
  Cloud engineering (architecture, security, resilience, cost governance)  
  API platforms/integration (design standards, lifecycle management, reliability)  
  DevSecOps (CI/CD, automated testing, security scanning, policy-as-code, release governance)  
  AI/ML enablement (responsible adoption, model risk considerations, data controls, secure deployment patterns)
* Ensure engineering practices meet enterprise standards for security-by-design, reliability, observability, and operational resilience.
* Oversee application development, remediation, and service management for non GB/GF CIO-owned solutions/services (where applicable).

**Portfolio, programme & project management (large change portfolio)**

* Provide management and oversight of the country change portfolio, including prioritisation, sequencing, dependency management, and benefits tracking.
* Lead governance for a large portfolio of programmes and projects, ensuring delivery discipline across scope, schedule, budget, risk, and quality.
* Drive consistent delivery reporting (RAID, milestones, financials, resource plans) and intervene early to unblock delivery issues.
* Ensure change governance supports safe delivery (release controls, change approvals, incident learnings, post-implementation reviews).

**Service management, incident leadership & operational resilience**

* Provide full oversight and advice on Technology issues in-country, including resolution of critical incidents and coordination of key deployments.
* Own end-to-end development and running of non GB/GF CIO-owned country Technology services, including problem management and change governance to ensure service quality.
* Strengthen operational resilience through improved monitoring, capacity planning, DR readiness, and continuous service improvement.

**Financial, resource & people leadership**

* Own direct cost and headcount management for country teams, including annual planning and forecasting.
* Lead people change activities (including restructuring where required) in partnership with HR and in line with local requirements.
* Build a high-performing culture with clear objectives, talent development, and strong accountability.

**Skills and experience (requirements)**

* Senior Technology leadership experience in a regulated environment, with proven delivery of country-level execution and service oversight.
* Demonstrated experience facing regulators and managing audit/exam activities, including evidence preparation and remediation closure.
* Strong engineering depth across Cloud, APIs, DevSecOps and modern software delivery practices; working knowledge of AI/ML delivery and governance.
* Proven capability managing a large portfolio with strong programme and project management discipline (multi-year roadmaps, complex dependencies, multiple stakeholders).
* Excellent communication and executive presence—able to translate complex technical topics into clear business and regulatory outcomes.
* Strong governance mindset: risk management, control ownership, operational resilience, and service management.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.

**Pro-Tip:** Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

title: Specialist - Experience Platform & Integrations
description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.

We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.

Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.

Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.

**The Role**
------------

As the Specialist - Experience Platform & Integrations, you will drive the administration, governance, and technical evolution of our core enterprise feedback systems (currently Qualtrics). Being part of the “System Owner” team you will have to blend robust technical aptitude with foundational project management skills, in order to safeguard the platform's integrity while architecting extensions into broader data ecosystems.

This role bridges the gap between operations (running the existing Qualtrics setup) and IT (extending the functionality by analyzing, developing and deploying new integrations) combining daily system administration and stakeholder enablement with advanced survey architecture and insightful reporting**.**

**Primary Mandate:** Serve as a core member of the system owners team, governing the full portfolio of customer satisfaction projects, core metrics, and our evolving suite of analytics tools.

**Broader Impact:** Embrace secondary opportunities to showcase your technical skills and forward-thinking mindset by contributing to broader technology projects within Customer Service beyond the core survey platform

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Survey management:** Create, configure, and maintain surveys, forms, and questionnaires.
* **User administration:** Create/manage user accounts, roles, permissions, and access, across CX and EX platforms.
* **Workflows:** Set up automated workflows, notifications, and actions based on survey responses. Monitor and maintain workflows connected to HRIS and EX automation triggers connected to Employee lifecycle events.
* **Data management:** Monitor survey data, Imports, exports, integrations, and data quality.
* **Troubleshooting:** Resolve issues related to surveys, permissions, workflows, and platform functionality.
* **Governance:** Ensure proper usage, security, access controls, and data privacy.
* **Support:** Help HR, CX, EX, or other business teams use Qualtrics effectively.
* Demonstrate tech-stack flexibility and open-mindedness about the existing tech stack, with a clear readiness to transition away from Qualtrics to alternative platforms if business needs dictate a change.
* Act as a trusted advisor to operations, providing best-practice guidance and suggestions on survey design rather than acting as a passive order-taker.
* Own the integration roadmap for the platform, architecting and overseeing seamless data connections between the survey system, current enterprise applications, and future tech stack expansions.
* Drive end-to-end integration strategy, bridging the feedback platform with existing and future enterprise systems to create a unified data ecosystem.
* Be able to expand platform extensibility by designing and possibly introducing new databases or data lake entities, ensuring enterprise repositories are enriched with Customer Experience (CX) or Employee Experience (EX) data for future connections.

**Technical & System Requirements**
-----------------------------------

* **Platform Expertise:** 4+ years of hands-on administration, governance, and advanced survey architecture experience in Qualtrics (CoreXM, CX, EX). Certification (e.g., Qualtrics CX/EX Expert) is highly preferred.
* **Integrations & APIs:** Proven experience building and managing APIs, webhooks, ETL pipelines to connect feedback platforms with enterprise ecosystems (CRMs like Salesforce/Zendesk, HRIS like Workday/SuccessFactors, and BI tools).
