title: Technical Engineering Manager_Core AI
description:
As an AI Engineering Manager on our Core AI team in India, you will be a cornerstone of FloQast's AI transformation and a key leader in our growing global engineering organization. You will manage and scale a team of high-performing software and AI engineers responsible for architecting and deploying production AI systems—powering our accounting automation platform and bringing our vision of an AI accountant teammate to life.

This role requires a balance between people leadership, operational excellence, and technical leadership in modern AI paradigms. You will partner with global engineering leadership, product management, and architecture teams to establish technical standards for agentic workflows, model context protocols (MCP), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and LLMOps across FloQast. Reporting to the VP of Engineering, you will play a critical role in expanding FloQast’s AI footprint by recruiting, mentoring, and developing top-tier engineering talent in India.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* **Team Leadership & Development:** Lead, manage, mentor, and develop teams of AI software engineers. Grow your team members’ career paths through consistent coaching, performance management, and continuous feedback.
* **AI Technical Direction & Delivery:** Guide your team in the architecture and delivery of scalable production AI products, including intelligent chatbots, document processing systems, and agentic workflows using Python and modern AI frameworks.
* **Recruiting & Site Growth:** Actively recruit, interview, and retain top-tier AI engineering talent to build out FloQast's Core AI capabilities in India.
* **Global Collaboration:** Collaborate effectively with product managers, QA, architecture, security, and global engineering leaders to design and implement our centralized AI platform (model routing, provider management, vector search).
* **Process & Culture:** Cultivate an engineering culture of innovative, egoless, high-trust problem solving. Champion lean software development, Agile principles, and robust LLMOps/DevOps practices for AI systems.
* **Production Excellence:** Ensure your team builds robust, compliant, and observable AI products that integrate seamlessly with diverse technologies (accounting systems, external APIs) in a B2B SaaS environment.

### **What You'll Bring**

* **5+ years of software engineering management experience,** with a track record of leading teams to deliver complex backend or AI products to a paying customer base.
* **5+ years of experience as an individual contributor** as a software engineer, with a strong background in Python, backend development, and cloud-native environments (AWS preferred).
* **Production AI Experience:** Familiarity with LLM APIs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), conversational AI, and scalable system design for AI products.
* **Distributed Team Leadership:** Proven experience leading and managing teams that are geographically distributed, driving alignment across time zones.
* **Recruiting & Mentorship:** Hands-on experience recruiting and interviewing engineering personnel, alongside a strong track record of managing individuals' performance and career growth.
* **Agile & Delivery Mastery:** 5+ years working on teams using Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) with a strong commitment to automated testing, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.
* **Communication & Alignment:** Strong ability to communicate complex system designs and AI strategies to both technical and business stakeholders.

### **Nice To Haves**

* Experience managing managers of software engineering teams.
* Hands-on experience with advanced RAG architectures, reranking systems, semantic search systems, or AI observability/monitoring tools.
* Experience working on B2B SaaS products, particularly in the financial or accounting space.
* Familiarity with our broader web stack (MongoDB, Express, React, and Node) to facilitate seamless integration between AI services and core applications.
* Knowledge of model context protocols (MCP) or reinforcement learning techniques (RLHF).

description: ABOUT QUINCEQuince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. title: Expert Senior Manager, AI Engineering
description:
**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
**About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)**
Bain’s AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.
  
  
**The Impact You’ll Have**
Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.
  
  
As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.
  
  
**The Role**
The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle — from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization — and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders.
  
  
You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.
  
  
Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Architect multi-component pipelines, including:

+ Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
+ Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
+ Embedding generation and optimization
+ Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)

* Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows
* Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems
* Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment
* Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment
* Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:

+ Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
+ Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards

* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:

+ Hallucination rate and factual consistency
+ Relevance and precision/recall
+ Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
+ Cost tracking and efficiency

* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps
* Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

**What We’re Looking For**

* 8–12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production
* Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders
* Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups
* Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design
* Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps
* Deep experience with:
* Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval)
* Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection)
* ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
* AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Clear ability to lead, mentor, and inspire technical teams
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

**Working Model & Travel**

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

Associates often interact with clients across levels and geography from cases they are aligned to.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Proficient with sound business logic and ability to structure approaches/presentations for adding value in complex business analysis.

title: Product Manager-  Payments Gateway
description: Job Title: Product Manager – Digital Payments (Checkout & Integrations) Experience: 4–5 Years Location: Gurugram Department: Product Management Position Overview We are seeking a data-driven and execution-focused Product Manager (4–5 years of experience) to own and scale our core payment infrastructure. In this role, you will be responsible for building seamless checkout experiences, integrating payment gateways (PGs), optimizing transaction routing, and leading consumer/merchant payment flows across UPI, cards, netbanking, mandates and alternative payment methods. You will act as the bridge between engineering, design, risk, compliance, and partner banks/aggregators to drive higher transaction success rates, reduce checkout friction, and maintain strict adherence to regulatory standards (NPCI/RBI). Key Responsibilities Checkout & PG Integrations: Own the end-to-end checkout funnel. Design, integrate, and optimize payment gateways, aggregators, routing engines, and tokenization solutions to lower latency and increase Payment Success Rates (PSR). • Payment journeys: product initiatives across payment stacks: UPI(Intent, Collect, QR, AutoPay, Credit on UPI), Cards – Debit & credit, Netbanking, Wallets and BNPL Product Discovery & Execution: Define the payment strategy, prioritize the product backlog, and write clear, engineering-ready PRDs with explicit technical acceptance criteria and edge-case handling logic. Conversion Optimization & Funnel Analysis: Use analytical tools (SQL, Mixpanel, Amplitude) to identify drop-off points, design A/B tests, and optimize payment recovery flows (e.g., auto-retry mechanisms, dynamic fallback options). Reconciliation & Settlement Operations: Collaborate with finance and operations to build reliable automated reconciliation, refund, payout, and chargeback/dispute resolution workflows. Regulatory Compliance & Security: Maintain strict compliance with RBI, NPCI, PCI-DSS guidelines, and PA/PG regulatory frameworks from initial spec to production rollout. Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner directly with Engineering, UX/UI Design, Risk & Fraud, Legal, and Bank/Partner Integration teams to deliver features on schedule. Requirements & Qualifications Experience: 4–5 years of hands-on Product Management experience within Fintech, Digital Payments, or E-commerce. Domain Mastery: Proven experience with PG/PA integrations, checkout funnel optimization, UPI infrastructure (P2P/P2M, AutoPay) Technical Aptitude: Strong ability to read API documentation, map sequence diagrams, understand webhook architectures, and collaborate closely with backend/infrastructure engineers. Data-Driven Mindset: Hands-on experience analyzing funnel metrics, building reports via SQL or BI tools, and conducting hypothesis-driven experimentation. Regulatory Knowledge: Deep understanding of the Indian digital payments ecosystem, including NPCI circulars, RBI payment guidelines, and tokenization mandates. Execution Excellence: Track record of taking complex 0-to-1 or 1-to-10 payment products from concept to launch in fast-paced environments. Preferred Qualifications Experience with merchant onboarding/activation flows or developer-facing APIs/SDKs. Hands-on familiarity with fraud mitigation tools, risk engines, or AI-assisted product development workflows.

Product – Content

Shape how content and creators influence shopping at Nykaa. This role offers ownership across consumer and creator experiences, with a direct opportunity to connect product innovation to measurable business growth.

title: Manager, Program Development, India
company: The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet
description:
The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) works for a world where everyone has access to affordable, reliable, clean electricity and the means to use it to improve their lives. Our Alliance builds transformative public, private, philanthropic partnerships to end energy poverty and accelerate green economic opportunity. Founded in 2021 by The Rockefeller Foundation, IKEA Foundation, and Bezos Earth Fund, we design innovative projects/programs, unlock finance, strengthen institutions and transform markets, delivering progress anchored in deep community engagement. By uniting actors across the value chain, from households to heads of state, we go beyond individual projects to drive lasting systems change. With work in more than 30 countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, our Alliance aims to reach 1 billion people with clean electricity, prevent 4 billion tons of carbon emissions and create or improve 150 million jobs.
  
  
**Contract type: Fulltime, Open ended**
**Reports Directly To**
Direct Reports:
  
  
MD, Country Delivery - India
  
  
None
  
  
**Overview Of The Role**
The Program Development Manager role will support initiatives focused on emerging renewable energy solutions as part of the sustainable energy transition in India. In this mission-driven role, this role will work at the intersection of technical innovation, stakeholder engagement, and policy advocacy, driving impactful solutions that empower communities and promote clean energy access. The Program Development Manager will work closely with the India Country Delivery team and with the Country Delivery teams from other regions to share learning points and expertise.
  
  
**Accountabilities**
**Program Designing:**

* Understand the rural livelihood sector and identify areas which needs intervention
* Scope the market to quantify level of opportunity and size of opportunity. Establish potential to scale.
* Develop sustainable and commercially viable business models for all stake holders.
* Based on primary & secondary research and considering the market gaps & business model, create program design for efficient implementation.
* Develop detailed project plans, including resource allocation, risk management, and performance tracking.
* Work closely with the program and impact team to estimate on ground social impacts.

**Project Management**

* Identification of partnerships required for efficient implementation.
* On boarding of partners – developers, financial institutes, implementation partners, etc.
* Establish well defined milestones with quantifiable outcomes.
* Ensuring timely implementation
* Tracking and monitoring of program implementation indicators – timelines, budgets and outcomes.
* Monitor and evaluate project performance, documenting lessons learned and sharing insights for continuous improvement.

**Knowledge Products & Alliancing**

* Develop tools, templates, and resources to standardize and improve project management processes in India.
* Create case studies and white paper based on learnings from the project.
* Identify potential funders with common priorities & mandate.
* Create fund raising pitch documents to initiate funder conversations.
* Represent the organization in discussions with sectoral experts, partners, and funders, providing updates on project progress and learnings.
* Develop decks, write ups and reports on potential roadmap for scale.

**BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES**
**Preferred Attributes**

* Working in Partnership: Learning with, learning from, and learning for our partners, particularly those who are closest to the work on the ground. Balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders and working in partnership wherever possible.
* Directs Work: Being strategic with efforts and generating information that informs decision making and improves impact. Providing direction and removing obstacles to get work done.
* Manages Complexity: Makes sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
* Values Differences: Recognizes the value of different perspectives and commits to inclusion, equity, and diversity in every aspect of work.
* Intellectual Humility: We know that we don’t have all the answer. We strive to be equally comfortable talking about what is not working as we are celebrating our successes. We listen to the voices of those we serve.
* Innovation and Entrepreneurial Spirit: A self-starter who takes initiative to identify areas of improvement and uses an energetic, pragmatic, and creative approach to optimize practice; embodying ‘Start-Up Philosophy.’

**Required Experience**
The ideal candidate would be a self-starter with positive intent and common sense. They will be willing to “roll up their sleeves” to adapt to working in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Recognising GEA’s unique position and its stage of organisational life, the ideal candidate would be interested in contributing to and building a strong, enduring organisation.
  
  
**Essential Qualifications, Skills And Experience Include**

* Qualifications: Degree or post graduate qualifications; engineering, renewable energy or a related field preferable;
* The most important qualification is Intent & Common Sense.
* Experience: At least 8 years’ experience in the design and implementation of programs, experience of renewable energy systems is an added benefit.
* Network: Good network in the energy or developmental sectors;
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills;
* Market knowledge: Good understanding of the India rural market and livelihood landscape at state and national level;
* Organisation and management: Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to multi-task effectively and a willingness to take ownership and responsibility for own work. Strong organisation and prioritisation skills with good attention to detail.

**In Addition, The Following Would Be a Bonus**

* Experience of working on energy and infrastructure-related matters including, specifically, climate finance, renewable energy, energy transition and sustainable development; and
* Experience working on energy and infrastructure related projects in Asia.

Our collaborative engagement approach helps our clients evaluate more opportunities faster and better manage their existing investments while still maintaining the rigor of their investment process. Our solutions manage over $800 billion of notional for 100+ clients including 20 of the top 30 global investment banks, 10 of the top 15 global private credit investment firms, 5 of the top 10 global private equity firms, and 10 of the top 25 alternative asset managers. Founded in 2014 by former credit traders from Deutsche Bank, Oxane Partners has grown to a team of 600+ highly skilled financial analysts and technology experts. * Provide guidance and support in various aspects of investment transactions including performing/non-performing loan portfolios, real estate, middle-market, and specialty financing.

title: Head – Hotel Projects (Civil)
description:
**Position Title: Head – Projects (Civil)**

**Department: Projects**

**Position Profile**

**Reports to: Director**

**Reportees: Civil Project team, Construction Managers, planning, QA/QC and site execution teams**

**Level: AVP / VP / GM (based on experience and last designation)**

**Direct interface with:**
Architects, structural consultants, PMC, hotel operator/brand, MEP and specialist consultants, QS, Billing & Contracts, Finance, HR, Commercial, Legal, Procurement and statutory authorities

**Next career path: As per organisation structure and performance**

***Position Objective:***

The Head – Projects (Civil) will be responsible for end-to-end civil and structural delivery of a Greenfield luxury five-star hotel, providing single-point leadership for execution from pre-construction, excavation and foundations through construction, completion and final handover. The role is accountable for approved time, cost, quality, safety, statutory compliance and stakeholder coordination.

The ideal candidate will have strong technical and managerial knowledge of hotel construction, civil and structural systems, design management, contracts, QS, BOQs, construction planning, façade, waterproofing, finishes and coordination with MEP, interiors and specialist hospitality systems. The candidate must have personally led five-star hotel projects through completion and handover.

***Qualifications:***

Full-time regular B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering with 25–30 years of post-qualification experience. Must have independently led multiple five-star hotel construction projects, including Greenfield development, from excavation/foundation through completion and final handover. Residential or commercial project experience may be useful but will not substitute for the mandatory five-star hotel construction experience.

***Competencies:***

* Proven leadership in delivery of multiple five-star hotel projects, including Greenfield developments.
* Strong civil and structural engineering knowledge and construction execution capability.
* Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and manage complex interfaces and critical paths.
* Strong planning, commercial, budgeting, contract and cost-control capabilities.
* Expertise in design review, constructability, quality assurance and safety leadership.
* Experience with Primavera P6, Microsoft Project or similar planning software.
* Strong stakeholder management with hotel operators/brands, consultants and contractors.
* Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi; ability to work under pressure.

**Job Description:**

* Assume single-point responsibility for civil and structural delivery against approved scope, time, cost, quality, safety and compliance parameters.
* Develop the project delivery strategy and integrated master plan from pre-construction through completion and handover.
* Lead site mobilisation, excavation, foundations, substructure, superstructure, façade, waterproofing, masonry, finishes and external development.
* Coordinate design management and constructability reviews with architects, structural consultants, façade specialists, interiors teams, MEP consultants, PMC (if any) and hotel operator/brand representatives.
* Review drawings, specifications, BOQs, estimates, tender packages, construction methodologies and value-engineering proposals.
* Recommend selection and appointment of civil contractors, specialist vendors and consultants in coordination with Procurement, QS & Contracts.
* Lead project planning, scheduling, resource deployment, cost planning, cash-flow monitoring and risk management.
* Monitor progress against baseline programme and critical path; identify delays early and implement recovery plans.
* Coordinate civil works with MEP, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire and life safety, ELV (Extra Low Voltage), lifts, kitchen, laundry, interiors, landscape and external utilities.
* Ensure hotel-specific quality benchmarks, mock-ups, sample rooms and approved finish standards are achieved.
* Oversee quality inspections, material testing, method statements, inspection and test plans, and closure of non-conformances.
* Ensure compliance with applicable approvals, statutory conditions, labour requirements, environmental controls and site safety standards.
* Review contractor bills, variations, claims, commitments and forecast final cost with QS & Contracts and Finance.
* Lead progress and performance reviews with contractors and consultants; resolve technical and execution bottlenecks.
* Build, lead and develop the civil project team; define responsibilities, reporting systems and review cadence.
* Maintain project records, drawings, approvals, progress reports, risk registers, change logs and management dashboards.
* Coordinate with authorities and utility agencies for construction-related approvals, inspections and connections.
* Plan civil-side completion, snagging, defect rectification and readiness for integrated testing and commissioning.
* Ensure as-built drawings, warranties, O&M information, quality records and completion dossiers are complete.
* Lead civil-side readiness for hotel operator inspections, phased handover and final project handover.
* Provide periodic management reports covering schedule, budget, risks, decisions required and corrective actions.
* Perform other project-related responsibilities as assigned by management.

title: Brand Management (Middle East Markets)
description:
We are hiring a
**Brand Management Specialist**
for our Middle East markets!

**About the Role**

The Brand Manager makes sure every Lenskart's Middle East product launch & partnership campaign goes live on time, in both UAE and KSA. The role owns the project from brief to launch day, and holds the Creative Lead, Design, Social Media, VM and other teams to their deliverables and deadlines.

It also leads AI-first production of launch assets - brand visuals, campaign videos and 3D product videos are created with AI tools, in line with the creative direction set by the Creative Lead, through THE CONTENT FACTORY workflow.

The role sits in India but works for the Middle East. It needs someone who understands Gulf consumers and retail calendars, and who can run a launch across two markets and several teams without losing a deadline

**Responsibilities**

*Product launches and partnership campaigns*

* Own end-to-end delivery of all Lenskart ME product launches (e.g. Celestia, ONYX, Gilded, seasonal collections) and partnership campaigns, making sure every campaign and its content launch on time and to the highest quality standard
* Build and deliver the launch toolkit for every launch and partnership campaign: key visuals, videos, key messages, social and CRM assets, VM and in-store guidelines, market-specific versions for UAE and KSA
* Build each launch plan from brief to go-live
* Make sure launches go live on time and in sync in both markets, adapting for each market's retail calendar and cultural moments (Saudi National Day, Ramadan, Eid, Riyadh Season)
* Run the launch cadence
* Spot risks early, resolve blockers and escalate when a deadline is at risk

*Cross-functional delivery*

* Coordinate every team that contributes to a launch, holding each to its deliverables and dates: the Creative Lead (creative direction), design, social media, VM, trade and retail, CRM, and partner brands
* Keep one shared launch timeline as the single source of truth for all teams and both markets
* Run THE CONTENT FACTORY workflow (briefing-to-delivery, asset library, templates) so launch assets arrive on time and on brand
* Make sure every brief leaves with clear objectives, deliverables, owners and deadlines
* Protect brand consistency across all launch touchpoints in UAE and KSA

*AI creative production and capability*

* Lead AI-generated production of launch assets: brand visuals, campaign videos and 3D product videos, in line with the creative direction set by the Creative Lead
* Select, test and integrate AI tools (e.g. Higgsfield, Midjourney, Claude) into design and project workflows to improve speed, quality and cost
* Build the team's AI capability through quarterly training and on-the-job support, and track adoption
* Document prompts, workflows and tool set-ups so the capability stays with the team, not one person

*Middle East market grounding*

* Travel to UAE and KSA twice a quarter for market immersion: stores, consumers, competitors and cultural moments
* Share a written insight report within one week of each visit, and show where findings shaped creative decisions
* Work closely with the KSA Creative Lead and KSA Brand & Content Executive to keep creative locally authentic, not translated

**Qualifications**

* 3-6 years in brand management, launch management or marketing project management, ideally in fashion, beauty, eyewear or lifestyle
* Proven experience working on Middle East (GCC) brands or markets: in-house for a brand with GCC operations, or at an agency handling GCC clients
* Strong understanding of Gulf consumers and retail moments
* Hands-on AI creative production: a portfolio showing AI-generated brand visuals, video and 3D product content, using tools such as Higgsfield, Midjourney or similar
* Strong stakeholder management
* Highly organised, comfortable with project management tools and running several launches at once
* Fluent written and spoken English; Arabic is a plus
* Able and willing to travel to UAE and KSA twice a quarter

description:
**Experience:**
2–5 years in B2B sales, preferably in the food, FMCG, HoReCa, or food service industry

**Reporting To:**
Business Head

**About CookSafari:**

CookSafari provides ready-to-cook and ready-to-eat Indian food products and kitchen solutions for the food service industry. Its offerings help restaurants, hotels, cafés, cloud kitchens, caterers, and institutional kitchens deliver consistent food quality while reducing preparation time, kitchen complexity, and dependency on skilled manpower.

CookSafari combines authentic Indian flavours with convenient food preparation solutions to help food businesses improve kitchen efficiency and maintain consistency across outlets.

**Website:**
https://www.cooksafari.co.in/

**Role Purpose:**

We are looking for a result-oriented B2B sales professional to expand CookSafari's presence across the HoReCa and institutional food service markets.

The person will be responsible for identifying potential customers, generating leads, arranging product demonstrations and sampling sessions, converting prospects into paying customers, and developing long-term business relationships.

The role requires someone who can independently approach customers, explain the commercial benefits of CookSafari's products, negotiate business terms, and build a consistent pipeline of new orders.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. New Business Development

• Identify and acquire new customers across hotels, restaurants, cafés, cloud kitchens, catering companies, corporate cafeterias, hospitals, hostels, and other institutional kitchens.

• Build a database of prospective customers, restaurant chains, multi-outlet operators, and food service businesses.

• Generate leads through cold calling, field visits, referrals, LinkedIn, industry networks, and direct outreach.

• Schedule meetings with restaurant owners, chefs, procurement managers, F&B managers, and business decision-makers.

• Develop new accounts and achieve assigned sales and revenue targets.

2. Product Sales and Demonstrations

• Present CookSafari's ready-to-cook and ready-to-eat products to prospective customers.

• Arrange product sampling, kitchen trials, and demonstrations to showcase taste, preparation convenience, and consistency.

• Explain how CookSafari's products can reduce preparation time, kitchen wastage, and dependence on skilled cooks.

• Identify opportunities for standardising menu items and maintaining consistent taste across multiple outlets.

• Understand customer menus, consumption patterns, kitchen operations, and product requirements to recommend suitable products.

3. B2B Account Acquisition and Order Conversion

• Convert product trials and customer discussions into commercial orders.

• Prepare quotations, product proposals, and commercial offers.

• Negotiate pricing, order quantities, delivery schedules, and payment terms within approved company guidelines.

• Follow up on samples, quotations, trials, and pending orders until closure.

• Build repeat business by maintaining regular contact with existing customers and monitoring their product requirements.

4. Market Development and Channel Sales

• Explore new markets and customer segments for CookSafari's products.

• Identify opportunities with restaurant chains, franchise operators, distributors, food service suppliers, and institutional buyers.

• Develop relationships with distributors and channel partners where required.

• Track competitor offerings, pricing, customer preferences, and market demand.

• Share market feedback with the management team to improve product positioning and identify new business opportunities.

5. Customer Relationship Management

• Maintain regular contact with customers to understand satisfaction levels and future requirements.

• Coordinate with operations and dispatch teams to support timely order fulfilment.

• Follow up on repeat orders, payment collections, and outstanding receivables.

• Identify opportunities to expand product sales within existing accounts.

• Address customer concerns and coordinate internally for timely resolution.

6. Sales Reporting and Pipeline Management

• Maintain accurate records of prospects, meetings, product trials, quotations, orders, and collections.

• Prepare weekly sales pipeline and activity reports.

• Track customer conversion rates, order frequency, average order value, and account growth.

• Provide market intelligence and sales forecasts to management.

• Ensure that sales activities and customer commitments are documented and followed through.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

• Graduate in any discipline; an MBA in Sales or Marketing is an advantage.

• 2–5 years of experience in B2B sales or business development.

• Experience in HoReCa, FMCG, food products, food service, institutional catering, or hospitality supplies will be preferred.

• Experience selling to restaurant owners, chefs, procurement teams, or multi-outlet food businesses is desirable.

• Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and customer relationship skills.

• Comfortable with cold calling, field sales, customer visits, and product demonstrations.

• Ability to work independently, manage a sales pipeline, and achieve measurable targets.

• Basic proficiency in Excel, sales reporting, and CRM tools.

• Willingness to travel locally for customer meetings and product trials.

About Hubhopper

Hubhopper is a leading content and podcast company specializing in the creation, production, distribution, and growth of premium audio and video content for brands, creators, founders, and businesses.

We work with brands to develop compelling content-led properties across podcasts, video, branded content, and digital media. As we continue to expand our content solutions business, we are looking for an experienced Content Sales Manager who can build strong client relationships, identify content opportunities, and drive revenue through high-value branded content and production partnerships.

About the Role

We are looking for a Content Sales Manager with 4–6 years of relevant experience in media, content sales, video production, or audio-visual businesses.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of how brands evaluate and invest in content, and should be comfortable selling solutions rather than simply selling media inventory. You will be responsible for identifying prospective clients, developing relationships with marketing and business leaders, understanding their content requirements, and converting those opportunities into high-value projects.

You will own the sales cycle end-to-end from prospecting and relationship building to pitching, negotiation, closure, and account handover.

Key Responsibilities1. Content Sales & Business Development

* Drive new business for Hubhopper's branded content, podcast, video production, and content marketing solutions.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective brands and clients.
* Identify organizations with potential content, video, podcast, and digital storytelling requirements.
* Own the sales process from initial outreach through negotiation and closure.

2. Client Relationship Management

* Build relationships with senior stakeholders across marketing, brand, communications, digital, partnerships, and business teams.
* Understand client objectives, budgets, audiences, and content requirements.
* Develop long-term relationships that lead to repeat business and larger accounts.
* Act as a trusted content partner rather than a transactional salesperson.

3. Pitching & Solution Development

* Work closely with internal creative, production, and strategy teams to develop customized client proposals.
* Translate client business objectives into relevant content solutions.
* Lead client presentations, pitches, and commercial discussions.
* Develop compelling proposals across podcasts, video series, branded content, creator-led content, and other digital formats.

4. Market & Client Development

* Identify emerging content trends, categories, and industries with strong potential for branded content.
* Build a target list of brands and decision-makers across relevant sectors.
* Track competitor offerings and understand evolving brand-content requirements.
* Develop new avenues for revenue through partnerships, content properties, and integrated campaigns.

5. Sales Pipeline & Reporting

* Maintain an accurate and healthy sales pipeline.
* Track leads, opportunities, proposals, negotiations, and closures.
* Forecast revenue and provide regular updates on pipeline performance.
* Work against defined monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue goals.

Ideal Candidate Profile

* 4–6 years of professional experience in content sales, branded content, media sales, video production, digital media, or related fields.
* Prior experience in- media, video production, PR agency, creative agency, digital content, advertising, or similar company.
* Strong understanding of the branded content and digital media ecosystem.
* Demonstrated experience in B2B sales and closing high-value deals.
* Existing relationships with brands, agencies, marketing teams, or relevant decision-makers will be an advantage.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Comfortable engaging with senior marketing and business stakeholders.
* Ability to understand a client's business problem and translate it into a content solution.
* Strong commercial orientation with a demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with significant individual ownership.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who understands content as a business solution, someone who can identify a brand's communication objective, develop the right content proposition, build the business case, and close the deal.

The ideal candidate is:

* Relationship-driven, but commercially sharp.
* Consultative, rather than transactional.
* Comfortable selling creative and content-led solutions.
* Hungry to close and grow accounts.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity and taking ownership of outcomes.

Why Join Hubhopper?

* Work with leading brands, creators, founders, and businesses on high-impact content projects.
* Own a significant revenue mandate with direct visibility into business outcomes.
* Work across podcasts, video, branded content, and emerging digital formats.
* Collaborate closely with creative, production, strategy, and business teams.
* Opportunity to build and manage long-term relationships with senior brand stakeholders.
* Performance-linked earning potential in addition to fixed compensation.
* High-ownership role in a growing content and media business

Job Summary

We are seeking an accomplished, commercially aware Executive Chef to lead all culinary operations across a multi-cuisine restaurant. The ideal candidate will bring broad expertise across Indian and international cuisines, strong kitchen leadership, menu innovation and financial management. The role requires the ability to maintain consistent quality across kitchen sections, develop commercially successful menus, build a high-performing team and deliver an excellent guest experience.

Key Responsibilities

· Lead and oversee all kitchen sections and cuisine categories, ensuring consistent food quality, flavour, presentation and service standards.

· Plan, develop and periodically refresh menus across relevant cuisines, including Indian and regional Indian, tandoor, Asian, Continental, European and other concepts offered by the restaurant.

· Create signature dishes, seasonal menus, tasting menus, chef’s specials and menus for private dining, banquets and special events.

· Ensure menus reflect the restaurant’s positioning, target clientele, ingredient availability and commercial objectives.

· Standardise recipes, portion sizes, plating, preparation methods and kitchen SOPs across all sections.

· Oversee daily mise en place, production planning, kitchen workflow, service coordination and timely food dispatch.

· Work closely with section heads and specialist chefs to ensure each cuisine is executed authentically and to the required standard.

· Demonstrate sufficient technical understanding of core cooking methods across cuisines and ensure specialist sections are led by appropriately skilled chefs.

· Manage recruitment, training, performance reviews, staff deployment, duty rosters and succession planning for the culinary team.

· Establish a collaborative, disciplined and professional kitchen culture, with clear accountability and communication.

· Prepare and manage food-cost budgets, monitor food-cost percentages and gross margins, and take corrective action when required.

· Oversee recipe costing, menu engineering, purchasing, supplier negotiations, receiving standards, stock rotation and inventory audits.

· Control food wastage, monitor portion sizes and reduce avoidable costs without compromising quality.

· Maintain compliance with applicable FSSAI requirements and internal standards for hygiene, sanitation, allergen handling, food storage and temperature control.

· Conduct regular kitchen inspections and ensure equipment is safe, clean, maintained and fit for use.

· Coordinate with restaurant operations, service, bar, sales and events teams to plan launches, promotions, guest experiences and special occasions.

· Review guest feedback, resolve food-related complaints and use feedback and sales data to improve menus and service.

· Monitor kitchen performance through regular reporting on food costs, wastage, sales mix, quality, staffing and guest satisfaction.

· Stay informed about culinary trends, techniques, ingredient developments and competitor offerings relevant to the restaurant.

Required Skills & Qualifications

description:
Cold Email Lead Generation Executive – B2B Prospecting & Email Deliverability

Job Description

We are looking for a detail-oriented **Cold Email Lead Generation Executive** to build targeted B2B prospect lists, identify decision-makers, verify business email addresses, and run effective cold email campaigns that generate qualified leads.

This role combines **B2B lead generation, data extraction, email research, list enrichment, cold email campaign management, and email deliverability**. You will use prospecting platforms, verification tools, automation, and AI-powered workflows to reach relevant businesses and start meaningful sales conversations.

The goal is to generate quality business opportunities through accurate data, personalized outreach, strong inbox placement, and continuous campaign optimization—not simply to send a high volume of emails.

What You’ll Do1. B2B Data Extraction & Prospect Research

* Extract business information from Google Maps, online directories, company websites, LinkedIn, and other publicly available sources.
* Build targeted prospect lists based on industry, location, business type, company size, and ideal customer profile.
* Identify key decision-makers, including Founders, Business Owners, Directors, CEOs, and Marketing Heads.
* Research company details and enrich existing prospect databases using data enrichment and AI tools.
* Organize prospect information into structured lists for accurate targeting and personalized outreach.

2. Email Finding, Verification & Database Management

* Find business email addresses using email discovery platforms and prospecting tools.
* Verify email addresses before campaigns to reduce invalid contacts and unnecessary bounces.
* Clean, deduplicate, segment, and maintain prospect databases.
* Identify missing information and improve list quality through data enrichment.
* Maintain accurate records of prospects, contact details, campaign status, and lead qualification.

3. Cold Email Campaign Setup & Deliverability

* Set up and manage sending domains, email inboxes, and campaign infrastructure.
* Configure and monitor email authentication protocols, including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.
* Manage appropriate inbox warm-up practices and monitor sender reputation.
* Follow deliverability best practices to improve the likelihood of emails reaching recipients’ inboxes.
* Monitor inbox placement, bounce rates, spam complaints, and sending performance.
* Identify deliverability issues and take corrective action to maintain campaign health.

4. Cold Email Outreach & Automation

* Create and manage cold email campaigns targeting relevant businesses and decision-makers.
* Write or adapt personalized email copy based on the prospect’s industry, role, business needs, and potential challenges.
* Segment prospect lists and tailor messaging to different audiences.
* Set up automated follow-up sequences with appropriate timing and personalization.
* Use AI writing tools and automation platforms to improve research, personalization, and campaign efficiency.
* Ensure outreach remains relevant, professional, and aligned with applicable email marketing and privacy requirements.

5. Campaign Monitoring & Optimization

* Track email delivery, bounce rates, replies, positive responses, and qualified leads.
* Test subject lines, email copy, calls to action, audience segments, and targeting approaches.
* Analyze campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve reply rates and lead quality.
* Troubleshoot campaign and deliverability problems promptly.
* Track positive replies and pass qualified prospects to the sales team with relevant context.
* Maintain unsubscribe and suppression lists and ensure opted-out contacts are excluded from future campaigns.
* Prepare regular reports on prospect data quality, campaign performance, deliverability, and lead generation results.

Tools & Platforms

* Google Maps and online business directories
* Apollo.io and LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* Clay, Hunter, Snov.io, and RocketReach
* Lusha and email verification tools
* Instantly, Smartlead, and lemlist
* Google Workspace and Microsoft 365
* CRM and lead management systems
* Excel and Google Sheets
* AI-powered research, writing, and automation tools

Experience

Experience in cold email lead generation, B2B prospecting, email research, data extraction, email marketing, campaign management, or email deliverability is preferred.

Candidates with practical knowledge of prospect list building, email verification, campaign setup, and outreach optimization are encouraged to apply. Relevant hands-on skills and the ability to learn new tools are important.

Who Can Apply

* Freshers and experienced candidates interested in B2B lead generation and cold email outreach.
* Candidates who can research businesses and identify relevant decision-makers.
* Individuals who understand email finding, verification, list cleaning, and prospect segmentation.
* Candidates interested in cold email campaign setup, automation, and deliverability.
* People who can write clear, professional, and personalized business emails in English.
* Candidates who are comfortable working with spreadsheets, databases, CRM systems, and multiple prospecting tools.
* Individuals who pay close attention to data accuracy, campaign performance, and follow-up processes.
* Candidates willing to learn email authentication, deliverability monitoring, AI-powered research, and campaign optimization.

Skills Required

* B2B lead generation and prospect research
* Business data extraction and list building
* Decision-maker identification
* Email finding, verification, and enrichment
* Database cleaning, deduplication, and segmentation
* Cold email campaign setup and management
* Email deliverability and sender reputation monitoring
* Basic understanding of SPF, DKIM, and DMARC
* Personalized email copy and automated follow-ups
* Campaign analytics and A/B testing
* CRM, Excel, and Google Sheets
* AI tools and marketing automation
* Attention to detail, analytical thinking, and time management

Role Objective & Success Metrics

Success in this role is measured by:

* Accurate, verified, and well-targeted prospect lists.
* Healthy email deliverability and controlled bounce rates.
* Relevant, personalized cold email campaigns.
* Positive replies and meaningful conversations with potential clients.

description:
B2B Lead Generation Executive – Prospect Research & Sales Outreach

Job Description

We are looking for a detail-oriented **B2B Lead Generation Executive** to identify potential business customers, research key decision-makers, build accurate prospect databases, and generate qualified sales opportunities through targeted outreach.

In this role, you will research businesses based on industry, location, company size, business needs, and buying signals. You will use lead generation tools, professional networking platforms, email outreach, and follow-up strategies to connect with relevant prospects and support the sales team.

The focus is on **lead quality, relevant conversations, and qualified sales opportunities—not simply building large contact lists.**

What You’ll Do1. B2B Prospect Research

* Research target businesses based on industry, location, company size, service requirements, and ideal customer profile.
* Identify potential customers using Google Search, Google Maps, business directories, LinkedIn, and lead generation platforms.
* Look for buying signals, business expansion, hiring activity, and other indicators that suggest a potential need for our services.
* Build targeted prospect lists aligned with business objectives and sales priorities.

2. Decision-Maker Identification & Data Verification

* Identify relevant decision-makers, including Founders, CEOs, Directors, Business Owners, and Marketing Heads.
* Find and verify professional contact details, including business email addresses, phone numbers, LinkedIn profiles, and company information.
* Use prospecting and email verification tools to improve data accuracy.
* Research company websites and business profiles to understand each prospect’s services, market, and potential requirements.
* Maintain accurate contact records and remove duplicate, invalid, or outdated information.

3. Lead Database Building & Management

* Build, clean, organize, and segment B2B prospect databases.
* Categorize leads by industry, location, company size, decision-maker role, and potential service requirements.
* Maintain consistent data quality across spreadsheets and CRM systems.
* Update prospect information as new details become available.
* Ensure the sales team receives organized, relevant, and usable lead data.

4. Outreach & Follow-Up

* Run personalized cold email and LinkedIn outreach campaigns to relevant business prospects.
* Use WhatsApp for professional follow-ups where appropriate and permitted.
* Personalize outreach based on the prospect’s business, role, potential challenges, and service needs.
* Manage follow-up sequences for prospects who have not responded.
* Respond professionally to enquiries and maintain consistent communication with interested prospects.
* Use AI research and outreach tools to improve personalization and productivity without compromising message quality.

5. Lead Qualification & Sales Coordination

* Review prospect responses to identify genuine interest and potential business opportunities.
* Qualify leads based on their requirements, relevance, interest, and fit with the services offered.
* Schedule meetings with interested prospects or transfer qualified leads to the sales team.
* Record conversations, lead status, next steps, and follow-up dates in the CRM or tracking sheet.
* Coordinate with the sales team to understand which leads convert and refine prospecting criteria accordingly.

6. Performance Tracking & Optimization

* Track prospects researched, verified contacts, outreach activity, responses, meetings booked, and qualified leads.
* Test new industries, target audiences, prospecting sources, and messaging approaches.
* Identify which channels and research methods generate the best-quality opportunities.
* Use feedback from the sales team to improve targeting, qualification, and lead generation processes.
* Maintain regular reports on lead quality, outreach performance, and sales pipeline contribution.

Tools & Platforms

* Apollo.io
* LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* Google Search and Google Maps
* Business directories and company websites
* Email finding and verification tools
* CRM and lead management systems
* Excel and Google Sheets
* AI-powered research, data enrichment, and outreach tools

Experience

Experience in B2B lead generation, prospect research, sales development, cold outreach, appointment setting, or business development is preferred.

Candidates with practical skills in identifying target businesses, finding decision-makers, verifying contact information, and generating qualified leads are encouraged to apply.

Who Can Apply

* Freshers and experienced candidates interested in B2B lead generation and sales research.
* Candidates who can research businesses and identify relevant prospects.
* Individuals who understand how to find decision-makers and verify business contact details.
* Candidates with an interest in cold email, LinkedIn outreach, and lead follow-up.
* People who are comfortable using spreadsheets, CRM systems, and online research tools.
* Individuals who can write clear, professional business messages in English.
* Candidates who are organized, detail-oriented, and consistent with follow-ups.
* People who are willing to learn new lead generation platforms, AI tools, and qualification methods.

Skills Required

* B2B lead generation and prospect research
* Target audience and ideal customer profile identification
* Decision-maker research and contact verification
* Lead database building, cleaning, and segmentation
* Cold email and LinkedIn outreach
* Personalized messaging and follow-up management
* Basic lead qualification and appointment setting
* CRM and Excel/Google Sheets management
* Data accuracy and attention to detail
* AI-powered research and outreach tools
* Communication and time management
* Analytical thinking and continuous improvement

Role Objective & Success Metrics

Success in this role is measured by:

* Accurate, relevant, and well-segmented prospect databases.
* Verified contact details for the right decision-makers.
* Meaningful responses and qualified sales conversations.
* Relevant meetings booked and qualified leads passed to sales.
* Consistent follow-ups and reliable CRM records.
* Improved lead quality through testing, sales feedback, and ongoing optimization—not simply the size of the database.

description:
**You will be responsible for:**
================================

**1. Regional Business Strategy & Growth**
------------------------------------------

* Drive the development and execution of the regional business strategy for the Farm Replacement Sales business, leveraging market potential, industry dynamics, competitive intelligence, pricing trends, and customer insights to identify growth opportunities and strengthen Goodyear’s competitive position.
* Translate business priorities into robust annual operating plans (AOPs), sales forecasts, and regional growth projections, ensuring alignment with national business objectives, market realities, and long-term growth ambitions.
* Identify priority markets, high-potential territories, and emerging business segments to accelerate regional expansion, strengthen market penetration, and deliver sustainable volume and revenue growth.
* Lead periodic business reviews to evaluate performance against planned objectives, identify gaps and emerging risks, and implement corrective strategies to ensure consistent achievement of regional business targets.

**2. Sales Planning & Commercial Performance**
----------------------------------------------

* Develop and execute comprehensive regional sales plans covering volume growth, pricing, profitable product mix, inventory planning, distribution strategy, and resource allocation to maximize business performance.
* Translate approved business plans into actionable territory-level objectives, ensuring effective deployment of sales resources, clear accountability, and disciplined execution across the regional sales organization.
* Monitor sales performance against forecasts and operating plans, proactively identifying variances and driving timely corrective interventions to optimize sales productivity, profitability, and target achievement.
* Evaluate market pricing, product positioning, and competitive offerings to recommend commercially viable sales strategies that balance volume growth, margin delivery, and long-term business sustainability.

**3. Market Development & Share Expansion**
-------------------------------------------

* Assess regional market potential and competitive dynamics to identify underpenetrated territories, emerging customer segments, and opportunities to expand Goodyear’s presence in the Farm Replacement market.
* Develop and strengthen the regional dealer and distribution network by identifying new channel partners, optimizing market coverage, and enhancing the productivity and effectiveness of existing distribution channels.
* Drive initiatives to improve Share of Market (SOM) and Share of Accounts (SOA), strengthen customer engagement, and increase brand preference through targeted market development strategies and focused field execution.
* Establish effective market intelligence mechanisms to capture field-level insights on customer behavior, competitor activities, pricing movements, and evolving market requirements, translating insights into actionable business strategies.
* Partner with the National Head – Sales to provide data-driven market assessments, competitive insights, and strategic recommendations that support regional growth and national business priorities.

**4. Marketing Alignment & Brand Development**
----------------------------------------------

* Partner with Marketing and other cross-functional stakeholders to translate regional market requirements into actionable marketing strategies, customer engagement initiatives, and demand-generation programmes.
* Drive the development and execution of regional sales schemes, trade promotions, and brand-building initiatives, ensuring alignment with business priorities and measurable impact on primary and secondary sales.
* Oversee the development and performance of branded retail outlets and other customer-facing initiatives to strengthen brand visibility, improve customer experience, and enhance Goodyear’s positioning in the regional market.
* Monitor the effectiveness of marketing interventions, promotional investments, and brand activation initiatives, recommending improvements to maximize business impact and return on investment.

**5. Channel Management & Distribution Excellence**
---------------------------------------------------

* Lead the strategic development and optimization of the regional dealer and distributor ecosystem, ensuring appropriate market coverage, channel capability, and alignment with business growth objectives.
* Evaluate, approve, and onboard dealers in accordance with established policies and business requirements, while continuously assessing channel performance, commercial viability, and growth potential.
* Drive effective inventory planning, stock availability, and inventory liquidation strategies across the distribution network to maintain healthy channel inventory, improve product availability, and minimize business risks.
* Monitor distributor and carrying and forwarding (C&F) operations for compliance with company policies, operational standards, and agreed business processes.
* Develop strong relationships with key distributors, dealers, and strategic channel partners to improve engagement, strengthen commercial partnerships, and create a sustainable foundation for regional business expansion.
* Collaborate with service and technical teams to address customer requirements, improve service responsiveness, and enhance the overall effectiveness of the regional distribution ecosystem.

**6. Financial Discipline & Profitable Business Growth**
--------------------------------------------------------

* Drive regional commercial performance by closely monitoring sales realization, collections, outstanding receivables, credit exposure, and other key financial indicators to ensure healthy cash flow and sustainable business growth.
* Partner with the Zonal Finance Manager and relevant stakeholders to strengthen collection discipline, address overdue accounts, evaluate commercial risks, and establish appropriate corrective measures.
* Monitor primary and secondary sales performance against projections, ensuring alignment between market demand, distributor inventory, sales execution, and financial objectives.
* Evaluate the commercial effectiveness of dealer discounts, regional schemes, and promotional investments, ensuring appropriate governance, financial discipline, and measurable business returns.
* Identify opportunities to improve regional profitability through disciplined pricing, optimized product mix, effective inventory management, and stronger commercial decision-making.

**7. People Leadership & Organizational Capability**
----------------------------------------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop the regional sales organization by establishing a clear strategic direction, translating business priorities into individual objectives, and fostering a culture of ownership, accountability, and performance excellence.
* Build a high-performing sales team by identifying capability gaps, strengthening sales effectiveness, and implementing structured coaching, mentoring, and development interventions aligned with current and future business requirements.
* Establish a robust performance management framework through regular business reviews, field assessments, and individual performance discussions, ensuring clear expectations, objective evaluation, and timely performance interventions.
* Develop the leadership capabilities of direct reports and strengthen the regional talent pipeline through succession planning, talent reviews, cross-functional exposure, and targeted development opportunities.
* Drive the adoption of structured sales processes, effective field-force management practices, and appropriate digital tools to enhance team productivity, improve market execution, and strengthen data-driven decision-making.
* Foster collaboration across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and Technical Service teams to ensure seamless execution of regional priorities and a unified approach to business growth.

**8. Business Governance & Execution Excellence**
-------------------------------------------------

* Establish effective operating rhythms, performance dashboards, and review mechanisms to monitor key business metrics, including volume achievement, sales growth, market share, channel expansion, collections, inventory health, and team productivity.
* Ensure adherence to company policies, commercial guidelines, and established operating processes across the regional sales network, maintaining appropriate governance and business controls.
* Proactively identify regional business risks, operational bottlenecks, and emerging market challenges, developing contingency plans and mitigation strategies to safeguard business continuity and target achievement.
* Provide timely, actionable business updates and strategic recommendations to national leadership, enabling informed decision-making, effective resource allocation, and continuous improvement in regional performance.

title: Product Manager
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Product Manager to help shape and scale our EdTech platform for JEE, NEET, and board-exam aspirants. You will own one or more product areas — learning, assessments, content, or growth — and will drive the roadmap from discovery to launch across web, Android, and iOS. You will work closely with founders, engineering, design, content, and marketing teams to deliver products that measurably improve student outcomes and business metrics.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the roadmap for your product area and align it with business, content, and engineering priorities.
* Talk to students, parents, teachers, and internal teams to deeply understand pain points and learning behavior.
* Translate insights into clear PRDs, user stories, flows, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with design on wireframes, prototypes, and user testing; partner with engineering on scope, trade-offs, and delivery.
* Define, instrument, and track success metrics — engagement, retention, conversion, learning outcomes, and revenue.
* Run A/B experiments on pricing, paywalls, onboarding, notifications, and content discovery — and make data-backed calls on what ships.
* Collaborate on our conversion funnel — from YouTube/Shorts traffic to free users to paid course subscribers.
* Own feature launches end-to-end — launch plans, GTM alignment, customer comms, and post-launch monitoring.
* Prioritize ruthlessly using frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW, impact-effort) and communicate priorities clearly to stakeholders.
* Use product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA, or similar) and work with data/BI to build dashboards for your area.
* Keep a close eye on the competitive landscape (Physics Wallah, Unacademy, Vedantu, etc.) and translate learnings into opportunities.

**Must-Have Skills**

* 4+ years of product management experience in a consumer-facing product (preferably EdTech, mobile, or content platforms).
* Proven track record of shipping features that moved measurable business or user metrics.
* Strong user research skills — interviewing students/users, synthesizing insights, and turning them into product decisions.
* Strong analytical skills and fluency with product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA) and basic SQL for self-serve data pulls.
* Hands-on experience designing and running A/B tests and interpreting results with statistical rigor.
* Experience writing clear PRDs, success criteria, and release plans that engineering and design teams can execute on.
* Strong understanding of conversion funnels, retention, and monetization patterns — especially freemium / tiered pricing.
* Comfort working closely with engineering on technical trade-offs — APIs, microservices, mobile constraints, performance.
* Experience shipping on mobile-first products (Android and iOS) and understanding platform-specific nuances.
* Strong written and verbal communication — you can write a crisp one-pager, present to founders, and debate trade-offs clearly.
* Bias for action, high ownership, and comfort navigating ambiguity.

**Good to Have**

* Prior experience in EdTech — particularly JEE/NEET/boards, K-12, or test-prep products.
* Experience building or scaling content-driven products (YouTube/Shorts funnels, creator-led GTM, live classes).
* Experience with assessments and test platforms — question banks, live tests, analytics on student performance.
* Familiarity with growth loops, referrals, student ambassador programs, and community-led growth.
* Exposure to live streaming products, push notification strategy, or personalization/recommendations.
* Prior startup experience — 0®1 product building and operating in early/growth-stage environments.
* MBA or equivalent structured business education (not required if experience is strong).

**What We're Looking For**

* Student-obsessed — you genuinely care about learning outcomes, not just feature velocity.
* First-principles thinker who can simplify complex problems and drive clarity for the team.
* Comfortable going from strategy to pixel-level detail in the same week.
* Data-driven, but not data-blind — you balance metrics with intuition and user empathy.
* Collaborative leader who earns trust across engineering, design, content, and marketing.
* High-agency — you spot problems, propose solutions, and drive them to completion.

**ABOUT LOANWALLE**

LoanWalle is a brand of Ampire Fintech Private Limited that helps Indians compare loans, insurance, mutual funds and fixed deposits from trusted financial partners, all on one platform. Through a network of 50+ lending partners, we serve salaried and self-employed borrowers across India, and over 4 lakh customers have used LoanWalle so far.

We believe your financial journey is bigger than your next loan. People come to us for credit; we want them to leave financially stronger, with less expensive debt, an emergency fund, the right insurance and a habit of investing. You will turn that belief into what our customers read, watch and receive from us every day.

**WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS**

Paid media sits with our Performance Marketing Lead and agency, and ad creatives come from a creative agency. We need one person to own everything a customer sees from us outside paid ads, and make it sound like one brand: simple, honest and helpful, in English.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* **Strategy:** turn the CMO’s brand strategy into a monthly content calendar across all channels, built around customer moments like salary day, festivals, tax season and emergencies.
* **Instagram and LinkedIn:** own the Instagram handle end to end (reels, carousels, captions, community replies) and run the LinkedIn page, including ghostwriting for leadership. Brief the creative agency and review their work.
* **Website:** own the words on loanwalle.com (product pages, FAQs, blogs, calculators) and publish 4–8 quality blogs a month with the SEO agency.
* **CRM and lifecycle:** plan, write and run journeys across email, SMS, WhatsApp, RCS and push, from welcome and drop-off to EMI reminders and FD cross-sell. Build segments and run A/B tests, using DLT-approved templates and following DPDP consent rules.
* **Performance support:** share hooks and customer insights with the Performance Marketing Lead, and keep ads, landing pages and follow-up messages telling the same story.
* **Compliance and reputation:** keep every post, page and message within RBI digital lending rules, ASCI guidelines and Meta/Google financial-services policies. Monitor comments, DMs and reviews, and route complaints to support quickly.
* **Reporting:** share a short weekly dashboard every Monday and a monthly review of what worked and what we will change.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* 2–4 years managing social media and content for a brand, with at least one account you grew yourself (please share it)
* Hands-on experience writing and running CRM campaigns (email, SMS or WhatsApp) for a consumer brand or app
* Excellent English writing, and comfort with Hindi/Hinglish
* Ability to write reel scripts and brief designers and video editors clearly
* Comfort with numbers: Instagram Insights, GA4 and campaign reports
* Organised enough to run a calendar across 5+ channels and several agencies

Good to have: fintech, BFSI or investing content experience; basic knowledge of RBI digital lending rules and ASCI guidelines; SEO writing and CMS experience; quick edits in Canva or CapCut; genuine interest in personal finance.

Tools: Instagram, LinkedIn, Meta Business Suite, Canva, CapCut, GA4, Search Console, a CRM tool (MoEngage, WebEngage, CleverTap or Braze), WhatsApp Business API, and AI assistants for research and first drafts.

We are looking for an enthusiastic, customer-focused and sales-oriented **Travel Sales Executive / Holiday Planner** who can understand travellers' requirements, design suitable holiday packages, manage enquiries and convert prospective customers into confirmed bookings.

If you enjoy travelling, communicating with people, planning holidays and achieving sales targets, we would love to hear from you.

* Coordinate with the operations team for confirmed bookings, vouchers, transfers and other travel arrangements.

* Domestic and international holiday packages.
