Cold Email Lead Generation Executive

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented **Cold Email Lead Generation Executive** who can build accurate prospect databases, identify key decision-makers, find and verify business email addresses, and run targeted cold email campaigns that generate qualified leads.

This role combines **B2B lead generation, data research, email enrichment, campaign management, and email deliverability**. You will use prospecting platforms, verification tools, automation, and AI-powered solutions to reach the right businesses with relevant, personalized emails.

Success is measured by verified prospects, inbox deliverability, positive replies, and qualified sales opportunities—not simply the number of emails sent.

Key Responsibilities1. B2B Data Extraction & Prospect Research

* Extract business data from Google Maps, online directories, company websites, LinkedIn, and other public sources.
* Build targeted prospect lists based on industry, location, business type, company size, and other relevant criteria.
* Identify key decision-makers, including Founders, Owners, CEOs, Directors, and Marketing Heads.
* Use lead enrichment platforms and AI tools to complete missing information and improve existing databases.
* Organize prospect data into structured, accurate, and usable lead lists.

2. Email Finding, Verification & Database Management

* Find relevant business email addresses using email discovery and data enrichment tools.
* Verify email addresses before campaign launch to reduce invalid addresses and bounce rates.
* Maintain clean, deduplicated, segmented, and regularly updated prospect databases.
* Categorize leads according to industry, decision-maker role, location, business requirements, and campaign objectives.
* Maintain accurate records in Excel, Google Sheets, or the CRM.

3. Cold Email Campaign Setup & Management

* Set up and manage sending domains, email inboxes, and campaign infrastructure.
* Configure and monitor email authentication protocols, including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.
* Manage inbox warm-up where appropriate and follow responsible sending practices to protect sender reputation.
* Create and manage targeted cold email campaigns using platforms such as Instantly, Smartlead, or lemlist.
* Develop personalized, segmented email copy with relevant subject lines, calls to action, and automated follow-ups.
* Use AI writing and automation tools to improve research, personalization, and campaign efficiency.

4. Email Deliverability & Performance Optimization

* Monitor bounce rates, spam complaints, inbox placement, reply rates, and other campaign performance indicators.
* Investigate deliverability issues and take corrective action to protect sender reputation.
* Test subject lines, email copy, calls to action, audience segments, and targeting strategies.
* Analyze campaign results and continuously improve email relevance and engagement.
* Follow appropriate sending limits and inbox health practices rather than relying on excessive email volume.

5. Lead Qualification & Sales Handover

* Track positive replies and identify prospects who show genuine interest in our services.
* Qualify responses based on business fit, expressed needs, and potential sales opportunities.
* Pass qualified leads and relevant conversation context to the sales team.
* Maintain accurate campaign reports covering verified prospects, deliverability, positive replies, and qualified leads.
* Recommend improvements based on campaign data and lead quality.

6. Compliance & Responsible Email Outreach

* Maintain unsubscribe, opt-out, and suppression lists.
* Honor unsubscribe requests and avoid contacting suppressed addresses.
* Follow applicable email marketing, data protection, privacy, and anti-spam requirements.
* Use prospect data responsibly and prioritize relevant, professional business communication.

Tools & Platforms

* **Business Data Research:** Google Maps, company directories, websites
* **Lead Generation & Enrichment:** Apollo.io, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Clay, Hunter, Snov.io, RocketReach, Lusha
* **Email Verification:** Email verification and validation tools
* **Cold Email Campaigns:** Instantly, Smartlead, lemlist
* **Email Infrastructure:** Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, sending domains and inboxes
* **Data Management:** CRM systems, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets
* **Automation & AI:** AI writing, lead enrichment, and workflow automation tools

Required Skills & Experience

* Understanding of B2B lead generation, prospect research, and cold email outreach.
* Ability to extract, organize, enrich, and validate business contact data.
* Experience identifying decision-makers and building targeted prospect lists.
* Familiarity with email finding, verification, and database management tools.
* Understanding of cold email campaign setup, personalization, segmentation, and automated follow-ups.
* Working knowledge of email deliverability concepts, including SPF, DKIM, DMARC, bounce management, and sender reputation.
* Ability to monitor campaign metrics, identify issues, and optimize performance.
* Good research, analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets and willingness to use AI and automation tools.
* Attention to detail when managing prospect data, campaign settings, and compliance requirements.

Who Can Apply?

Candidates with experience or an interest in B2B lead generation, cold email outreach, email marketing operations, sales development, data extraction, prospect research, or marketing automation can apply.

Candidates who understand both the data side of lead generation and the technical requirements of cold email campaigns will be well suited to this role.

Role Objective & Performance Metrics

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Accuracy and quality of prospect databases.
* Percentage of email addresses verified before sending.
* Email deliverability and bounce-rate management.
* Positive reply rates and prospect engagement.
* Number and quality of qualified leads generated.
* Campaign optimization and reporting accuracy.
* Compliance with unsubscribe, suppression, and applicable privacy requirements.

**Important:** The objective is to reach the right decision-makers with accurate data and relevant emails, maintain healthy deliverability, and generate qualified business opportunities—not to maximize email volume.

title: Lead Research Executive
description:
Lead Research Executive

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented **Lead Research Executive** to identify potential business customers and build accurate, relevant prospect databases for our sales and business development team.

The role involves researching businesses through Google Maps, Justdial, IndiaMART, LinkedIn, company websites, and other online sources; identifying business owners and decision-makers; collecting and verifying contact information; and spotting companies that may need digital marketing services.

The primary focus is **lead quality, data accuracy, and prospect relevance—not simply collecting large volumes of random contact details.**

Key Responsibilities1. Business & Prospect Research

* Research businesses using Google Maps, Justdial, IndiaMART, LinkedIn, company websites, online directories, and other relevant sources.
* Identify potential customers based on industry, location, business type, company size, and defined target criteria.
* Find businesses that may benefit from digital marketing, paid advertising, lead generation, or related agency services.
* Research companies to understand their business activities, online presence, and potential marketing needs.
* Explore different online sources to discover new prospects and expand the lead database.

2. Decision-Maker & Contact Research

* Identify business owners, Founders, CEOs, Directors, Marketing Heads, and other relevant decision-makers.
* Collect useful business contact information, including names, professional email addresses, phone numbers, LinkedIn profiles, and company details.
* Research company websites and public business profiles to find relevant contact information.
* Identify the appropriate decision-maker for each prospect wherever possible.
* Verify collected information before adding it to the prospect database.

3. Prospect Identification & Lead Quality

* Identify stronger prospects, including newly launched businesses, companies actively running advertisements, and businesses with weak websites or limited online visibility.
* Look for signs that a business may benefit from improved digital marketing or online lead generation.
* Evaluate prospects against the defined target customer profile and research criteria.
* Prioritize relevant businesses with potential service needs rather than collecting random or unsuitable leads.
* Organize prospects according to industry, location, business category, and potential opportunity.

4. Data Verification & Database Management

* Build, organize, and maintain accurate B2B prospect lists.
* Check contact information and company details for accuracy before submitting research.
* Identify and remove duplicate, outdated, incomplete, or irrelevant records.
* Maintain consistent data formatting and clearly organized spreadsheet columns.
* Update existing databases when new or more accurate information becomes available.
* Record the source of prospect information where required.

5. Lead Qualification & Sales Support

* Conduct preliminary research to assess whether a business matches the target customer profile.
* Identify potential marketing needs based on publicly available business information.
* Categorize prospects based on relevance and available qualification criteria.
* Prepare clear, structured lead lists that the sales and business development team can use for outreach.
* Follow defined research instructions and deliver consistent, reliable data within agreed timelines.

Experience

**Freshers and experienced candidates can apply.**

Candidates with previous experience in any of the following areas will be preferred:

* Lead research and lead generation
* B2B prospect research
* Data research and contact research
* Market research
* Business database building
* Decision-maker identification
* Sales research and prospect qualification

Freshers with strong online research skills, attention to detail, and an interest in B2B lead generation are also encouraged to apply.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Strong online research and information-gathering skills.
* Ability to identify relevant businesses using defined industry, location, and business criteria.
* Familiarity with Google Maps, Justdial, IndiaMART, LinkedIn, and company websites.
* Ability to find business owners, decision-makers, and relevant contact details.
* Basic understanding of B2B prospecting and lead qualification.
* Ability to recognize potential marketing opportunities from a business's online presence.
* Good data verification, organization, and duplicate-removal skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
* Familiarity with CRM systems is an advantage.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Ability to follow research guidelines and meet deadlines consistently.

Who Can Apply?

This role is suitable for candidates interested in lead research, data research, B2B prospecting, market research, contact discovery, sales research, or digital marketing lead generation.

We are looking for someone who is curious, systematic, and capable of finding relevant business information online. The ideal candidate understands that accurate, well-researched prospects are more valuable than large databases filled with irrelevant contacts.

Skills & Keywords

Lead Research · Lead Research Executive · B2B Prospect Research · Google Maps Research · Justdial Research · IndiaMART Research · LinkedIn Research · Contact Research · Decision-Maker Research · Data Research · Market Research · Lead Qualification · Data Verification · Prospect Identification · Database Management · Spreadsheet Management · CRM · Lead Generation

Role Objective

The primary objective is to build a consistent pipeline of accurate, relevant, and actionable B2B prospects for the sales and business development team.

Success will be measured by data accuracy, contact completeness, prospect relevance, research quality, and consistency of delivery—not simply the number of records collected.

description:

* Design end-to-end AI automation solutions, including workflows, APIs, data flow, AI models, and human approval processes.

* Prepare solution designs, project scopes, timelines, estimates, and demonstrations.
* Explain technical concepts in simple language and set realistic expectations.

* Manage cloud deployments, server infrastructure, credentials, access permissions, and backups.
* Implement secure API integrations, MFA, least-privilege access, and appropriate data protection.
* Protect AI systems against prompt injection, data leakage, unauthorized actions, and excessive API costs.

  **n8n**
  , plus working knowledge of Make and/or Zapier.

* Strong proficiency in Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, Git, SQL, and at least one vector database.
* Experience with AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure, including deployment and infrastructure management.
* Experience with CRM automation using HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, Pipedrive, or Zoho.
* Knowledge of RAG systems, prompt engineering, AI evaluation, cost optimization, and AI security.
* Proven ability to lead engineers, review technical work, and manage project delivery.
* Excellent English communication, troubleshooting, and documentation skills.

We need a hands-on technical leader who can design, build, debug, secure, and maintain production-ready systems—not someone whose experience is limited to project management or basic automation templates. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a practical technical assessment.

title: Microsoft-CRM Technical-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**AI Business Solutions – Dynamics CRM Technical Manager Specialized:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for a Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Manager to lead large‑scale CRM and Power Platform initiatives, drive technical excellence, and manage high‑performing delivery teams. This role combines strategic oversight, architecture leadership, and people management to deliver scalable, high‑quality solutions that enable business transformation.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the technical design, architecture, and implementation of Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions, ensuring alignment with business objectives and industry best practices.
* Own end‑to‑end delivery across D365 modules such as Sales, Customer Service, Marketing, and Field Service, with accountability for quality and outcomes.
* Manage and mentor a team of developers, leads, and technical consultants, providing direction, performance feedback, and career development support.
* Collaborate closely with functional consultants, architects, and business stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Oversee development of custom plugins, workflows, integrations, and extensions using C#, JavaScript, Dynamics 365 SDK, and Power Platform technologies.
* Establish and enforce development standards through code reviews, design governance, testing strategies, and solution validation.
* Drive solution scalability, security, and performance by overseeing system architecture, integration patterns, and optimization efforts.
* Manage project timelines, budgets, scope, and resource utilization to ensure on‑time and within‑budget delivery.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation including architecture diagrams, integration designs, and deployment standards.
* Act as a senior technical advisor to stakeholders, clearly articulating risks, trade‑offs, and recommendations.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong leadership experience managing technical teams in Dynamics 365 and Power Platform delivery environments.
* Deep expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM customization, extensibility, and solution architecture.
* Solid hands‑on understanding of C#, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and integration patterns (Azure and Power Platform).
* Proven experience delivering complex, enterprise‑scale CRM implementations.
* Strong grasp of Agile delivery models, estimation, planning, and governance.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and executive‑level presentation skills.
* Strategic mindset with strong problem‑solving, decision‑making, and prioritization capabilities.
* Developed and customized AI Copilots and agents using Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Dynamics 365 CRM, integrating workflows, Dataverse, and APIs to support intelligent automation and conversational experiences.

**<< Ideally, you’ll also>>**
**The following skills and experiences are preferred and will be considered an advantage:**

* Power Pages
* Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps (Code Apps)
* PCF (PowerApps Component Framework) Controls
* Integrations using Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, and Azure Service Bus
* Data Migration using SSIS (KingswaySoft) and Azure Data Factory
* Copilot Studio
* Dynamics 365 Project Operations
* Dynamics 365 Field Service
* Dynamics 365 Contact Center

**<< What we look for>>**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum of 7+ years of experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM development and implementation, with at least 1 year in a managerial or leadership role.
* Strong understanding of CRM data models, security, compliance, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience managing budgets, delivery risk, and resource planning for complex programs.
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 and/or Power Platform certifications are preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and retain high‑performing technical teams.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Principal Technical Program Manager (Analytics or AI/ML Platform)
description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The Analytics Platform is Atlassian’s AI-ready data backbone, enabling trusted analytics across cloud environments while simplifying the underlying architecture to make data reliable, discoverable, and cost-effective at scale. By unifying a consistent data foundation, low-latency analytics, and governed access patterns, it helps both people and AI agents move from raw data to self-service insights faster and with greater confidence. The Analytics Platform is the data platform foundation for AI-native experiences such as intelligent assistants, embedded analytics, faster time to first query, and future ML use cases while preserving the reliability, permissions, and metric integrity required for enterprise-grade decision-making.
  
  
As a Technical Program Manager, reporting to a Head of TPM on the Analytics Platform team you will define product/program technical strategy. You will create long term vision for the team and associated roadmap for your areas of ownership and ensure buy in from stakeholders. You will leverage deep domain expertise and technical acumen to ensure successful delivery of large cross organization initiatives. You will demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of fundamental business challenges, shape technical requirements and collaborate with stakeholders to develop comprehensive solutions. You will utilize your technical expertise to influence solution architecture to meet the emerging needs of the business and contribute to programs and process across organizational boundaries.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Analyze business objectives, customer needs, product adoption inhibitors and opportunities, industry trends, and based on these, in close collaboration with your stakeholders, define a long-term strategy and roadmap for your platform and product components.
* Understand business objectives and translate them into technical systems problems that need to be prioritized solved in the current business environment.
* Define specific systems programs and create a plan of action for realizing those programs. Such programs could be around capacity planning, migration efforts, high availability, network architecture, performance optimization, reliability improvements and more.
* Use your technical understanding of Atlassian and related systems to partner with and influence engineers and architects in making progress on these problems.
* Responsible for taking a systematic approach to engineering problems. This includes: prioritizing tasks, scoping out the project, defining objectives, and making consistent progress against each of these.
* Be accountable for the success of these technical programs by managing the entire lifecycle from initiation to forecasting, budgeting, scheduling, etc.
* Manage complex dependencies and projects with a broad scope across the company

**Qualifications**
At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
  
  
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  
  

* 8+ years of experience on software teams as Development Manager or TPM
* Strategic thinking and ability to understand business objectives to translate them into technical problems and programs.
* Technical understanding of systems involved. Willingness to develop domain expertise in the area they operate - storage, networking, authentication, capacity management, service deployments, etc.

+ TPMs are not expected to write or read code, but are expected to understand system flows, block architectures, APIs and such.

* Experience defining and running end-to-end complex technical programs
* Strong leadership, organizational, and communication skills

**Benefits & Perks**
Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
**go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits**
**.**
**About Atlassian**
At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
  
  
We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
  
  
To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit
**go.atlassian.com/crh**
**.**

title: SAP CPM-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Consulting – SAP – CPM Functional – Manager:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a skilled SAP Commercial Project Management (CPM) Consultant to support the design, implementation, enhancement, and maintenance of SAP CPM solutions. The role offers a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of large-scale SAP transformation programs while developing expertise at the intersection of finance, strategy, project delivery, and commercial management.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Commercial Project Governance**

* Act as the commercial lead for SAP implementation, support, migration, and transformation programs.
* Establish and maintain commercial governance frameworks across project portfolios.
* Support project leadership in ensuring projects are delivered within approved budgets, schedules, and contractual commitments.
* Drive project profitability while balancing customer satisfaction and delivery objectives.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, financial controls, and regulatory requirements.

**Financial Management & Project Controlling**

* Own project financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting activities.
* Monitor project revenue, costs, gross margins, and cash flow performance.
* Analyze project financial health and proactively identify variances against forecasts.
* Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reviews.
* Drive corrective actions to improve project profitability and financial performance.
* Ensure accurate revenue recognition and project accounting in line with corporate and statutory requirements.

**Contract & Commercial Management**

* Review customer contracts, Statements of Work (SOWs), Master Service Agreements (MSAs), and change requests.
* Ensure contractual obligations, commercial terms, and project assumptions are properly managed.
* Identify contractual risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Lead commercial negotiations related to scope changes, claims management, and contract amendments.
* Support bid reviews and project handovers from sales to delivery teams.

**Risk Management**

* Identify financial, contractual, operational, and compliance risks throughout the project lifecycle.
* Develop risk mitigation plans and track closure of identified risks.
* Monitor project performance indicators and escalate issues proactively.
* Support contingency planning and financial recovery strategies where applicable.

**Portfolio & Business Performance Management**

* Manage commercial oversight for multiple SAP projects and accounts.
* Track portfolio-level financial metrics including revenue, backlog, utilization, margin, and working capital.
* Provide insights and recommendations to improve overall business performance.
* Support leadership with dashboards, KPIs, and executive reporting.

**Change Request and Scope Management**

* Ensure all scope changes are formally assessed and approved.
* Quantify financial and commercial impacts of project changes.
* Collaborate with delivery and customer stakeholders to secure change order approvals.
* Maximize revenue realization through effective scope management.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with Project Managers, Program Managers, Delivery Leads, and Customer Executives.
* Serve as a trusted advisor on commercial and financial matters.
* Communicate project financial performance to senior leadership and stakeholders.
* Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support successful project execution.

**Compliance & Audit Support**

* Ensure compliance with organizational policies and governance requirements.
* Support internal and external audits.
* Maintain project documentation supporting financial and commercial decisions.
* Ensure adherence to revenue recognition, procurement, and financial reporting standards.

**Team Leadership & People Development**

* Mentor and coach junior CPM professionals and project controllers.
* Drive best practices in commercial management across SAP programs.
* Contribute to organizational capability development and process improvements.
* Participate in recruitment, performance management, and career development activities.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 8+ years of experience in project financial management, commercial management, project controlling, or program governance.
* Experience in SAP implementation, ERP transformation, managed services, or consulting environments.
* Strong understanding of project accounting, budgeting, forecasting, and revenue recognition.
* Knowledge of contract management and commercial risk management principles.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you select a country where the role is based. The GCFO AI lead is accountable for transforming the Finance operating model through process excellence, re-engineering, intelligent automation, and artificial intelligence. The role leads the redesign and optimization of GCFO's end-to-end processes, controls, data, and operating model, embedding simplified, standardized, and scalable ways of working across the function. As the architect of Finance transformation, the role drives continuous improvement, productivity, control effectiveness, and digital innovation, creating a highly efficient, insight-led, and AI-enabled Finance organisation. title: Regional Business Head, East, Farm Repl Sales
description:
**You Will Be Responsible For**

* Regional Business Strategy & Growth
* Drive the development and execution of the regional business strategy for the Farm Replacement Sales business, leveraging market potential, industry dynamics, competitive intelligence, pricing trends, and customer insights to identify growth opportunities and strengthen Goodyear’s competitive position.
* Translate business priorities into robust annual operating plans (AOPs), sales forecasts, and regional growth projections, ensuring alignment with national business objectives, market realities, and long-term growth ambitions.
* Identify priority markets, high-potential territories, and emerging business segments to accelerate regional expansion, strengthen market penetration, and deliver sustainable volume and revenue growth.
* Lead periodic business reviews to evaluate performance against planned objectives, identify gaps and emerging risks, and implement corrective strategies to ensure consistent achievement of regional business targets.
* Sales Planning & Commercial Performance
* Develop and execute comprehensive regional sales plans covering volume growth, pricing, profitable product mix, inventory planning, distribution strategy, and resource allocation to maximize business performance.
* Translate approved business plans into actionable territory-level objectives, ensuring effective deployment of sales resources, clear accountability, and disciplined execution across the regional sales organization.
* Monitor sales performance against forecasts and operating plans, proactively identifying variances and driving timely corrective interventions to optimize sales productivity, profitability, and target achievement.
* Evaluate market pricing, product positioning, and competitive offerings to recommend commercially viable sales strategies that balance volume growth, margin delivery, and long-term business sustainability.
* Market Development & Share Expansion
* Assess regional market potential and competitive dynamics to identify underpenetrated territories, emerging customer segments, and opportunities to expand Goodyear’s presence in the Farm Replacement market.
* Develop and strengthen the regional dealer and distribution network by identifying new channel partners, optimizing market coverage, and enhancing the productivity and effectiveness of existing distribution channels.
* Drive initiatives to improve Share of Market (SOM) and Share of Accounts (SOA), strengthen customer engagement, and increase brand preference through targeted market development strategies and focused field execution.
* Establish effective market intelligence mechanisms to capture field-level insights on customer behavior, competitor activities, pricing movements, and evolving market requirements, translating insights into actionable business strategies.
* Partner with the National Head – Sales to provide data-driven market assessments, competitive insights, and strategic recommendations that support regional growth and national business priorities.
* Marketing Alignment & Brand Development
* Partner with Marketing and other cross-functional stakeholders to translate regional market requirements into actionable marketing strategies, customer engagement initiatives, and demand-generation programmes.
* Drive the development and execution of regional sales schemes, trade promotions, and brand-building initiatives, ensuring alignment with business priorities and measurable impact on primary and secondary sales.
* Oversee the development and performance of branded retail outlets and other customer-facing initiatives to strengthen brand visibility, improve customer experience, and enhance Goodyear’s positioning in the regional market.
* Monitor the effectiveness of marketing interventions, promotional investments, and brand activation initiatives, recommending improvements to maximize business impact and return on investment.
* Channel Management & Distribution Excellence
* Lead the strategic development and optimization of the regional dealer and distributor ecosystem, ensuring appropriate market coverage, channel capability, and alignment with business growth objectives.
* Evaluate, approve, and onboard dealers in accordance with established policies and business requirements, while continuously assessing channel performance, commercial viability, and growth potential.
* Drive effective inventory planning, stock availability, and inventory liquidation strategies across the distribution network to maintain healthy channel inventory, improve product availability, and minimize business risks.
* Monitor distributor and carrying and forwarding (C&F) operations for compliance with company policies, operational standards, and agreed business processes.
* Develop strong relationships with key distributors, dealers, and strategic channel partners to improve engagement, strengthen commercial partnerships, and create a sustainable foundation for regional business expansion.
* Collaborate with service and technical teams to address customer requirements, improve service responsiveness, and enhance the overall effectiveness of the regional distribution ecosystem.
* Financial Discipline & Profitable Business Growth
* Drive regional commercial performance by closely monitoring sales realization, collections, outstanding receivables, credit exposure, and other key financial indicators to ensure healthy cash flow and sustainable business growth.
* Partner with the Zonal Finance Manager and relevant stakeholders to strengthen collection discipline, address overdue accounts, evaluate commercial risks, and establish appropriate corrective measures.
* Monitor primary and secondary sales performance against projections, ensuring alignment between market demand, distributor inventory, sales execution, and financial objectives.
* Evaluate the commercial effectiveness of dealer discounts, regional schemes, and promotional investments, ensuring appropriate governance, financial discipline, and measurable business returns.
* Identify opportunities to improve regional profitability through disciplined pricing, optimized product mix, effective inventory management, and stronger commercial decision-making.
* People Leadership & Organizational Capability
* Lead, coach, and develop the regional sales organization by establishing a clear strategic direction, translating business priorities into individual objectives, and fostering a culture of ownership, accountability, and performance excellence.
* Build a high-performing sales team by identifying capability gaps, strengthening sales effectiveness, and implementing structured coaching, mentoring, and development interventions aligned with current and future business requirements.
* Establish a robust performance management framework through regular business reviews, field assessments, and individual performance discussions, ensuring clear expectations, objective evaluation, and timely performance interventions.
* Develop the leadership capabilities of direct reports and strengthen the regional talent pipeline through succession planning, talent reviews, cross-functional exposure, and targeted development opportunities.
* Drive the adoption of structured sales processes, effective field-force management practices, and appropriate digital tools to enhance team productivity, improve market execution, and strengthen data-driven decision-making.
* Foster collaboration across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and Technical Service teams to ensure seamless execution of regional priorities and a unified approach to business growth.
* Business Governance & Execution Excellence
* Establish effective operating rhythms, performance dashboards, and review mechanisms to monitor key business metrics, including volume achievement, sales growth, market share, channel expansion, collections, inventory health, and team productivity.
* Ensure adherence to company policies, commercial guidelines, and established operating processes across the regional sales network, maintaining appropriate governance and business controls.
* Proactively identify regional business risks, operational bottlenecks, and emerging market challenges, developing contingency plans and mitigation strategies to safeguard business continuity and target achievement.
* Provide timely, actionable business updates and strategic recommendations to national leadership, enabling informed decision-making, effective resource allocation, and continuous improvement in regional performance.

description:
Business Development Associate (BDA)
  
  
**Sales & Business Growth | Full-Time | Kolkata (Work from Office)**
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for dynamic, result-oriented
**Business Development Associates**
to join our growing team.
  
  
You will engage prospective learners through outbound calling, understand their professional development needs, and guide them toward the right upskilling solutions across our EdTech brand portfolio.
  
  
Position Details
  
  
**Compensation:**
Up to ₹6 LPA Fixed + up to ₹3 LPA Incentives (Up to ₹9 LPA)
  
  
**Location:**
Kolkata — Work from Office
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Experience:**
1-3 Years
  
  
**Work Days:**
6 Days/Week — Thursday Off
  
  
**Work Hours:**
01:30 PM - 11:30 PM
  
  
**Education:**
Graduate / Postgraduate — Any Discipline
  
  
**Laptop:**
Personal laptop mandatory (rental option available)
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Initiate outbound calls to prospective customers and introduce House of EdTech's course offerings.
* Understand learner needs and recommend the most suitable upskilling programs.
* Pitch courses in Excel, Python, Power BI, AI, Finance, and Stock Market Training.
* Build rapport with leads, follow up consistently, and close sales to meet monthly targets.
* Maintain accurate CRM records of customer interactions and sales activity.
* Collaborate with the marketing team to refine outreach and improve lead conversion.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Excellent verbal communication and persuasion skills.
* Ability to identify customer pain points and offer tailored solutions.
* Target-driven mindset with strong negotiation and follow-up discipline.
* Self-motivated and resilient in a fast-paced environment.
* Prior sales or telecalling experience is a plus.
* Experience handling international customers.
* Basic familiarity with Excel, Python, Power BI, or AI tools is preferred.

What We Offer
  
  

* Comprehensive training on our product portfolio and sales techniques.
* Clear career growth path within a high-growth EdTech organization.
* Collaborative work culture with experienced mentors.

**About House Of EdTech**
House of EdTech (Goenka Kachave LLP) is a high-growth, multi-entity EdTech organization focused on delivering large-scale, outcome-driven professional education across high-impact domains including Artificial Intelligence, Finance, Data, Product Management, and Business Skills.
  
  
Founded by
**Aditya Goenka and Aditya Kachave, IIT Kharagpur alumni**
, the organization has rapidly emerged as one of India's most dynamic EdTech groups — combining cutting-edge curriculum, practitioner-led training, and performance-driven execution.
  
  
With a learner-first philosophy and deep expertise in digital education delivery, House of EdTech enables working professionals and entrepreneurs to upskill, increase productivity, and unlock measurable career and income growth.
  
  
**Today, The Organization**

* Serves over 5 million learners across India and global markets.
* Operates at an ARR exceeding ₹500 crore.
* Employs 2,500+ professionals across sales, marketing, tech, product, and operations.
* Maintains a strong presence in Pune, Kolkata, and Bangalore, supported by pan-India digital reach.

Diversified Brand Portfolio
  
  
**Be10x**
- Practical AI tools and productivity solutions for professionals
  
  
**Office Master**
- Advanced MS Excel, Power BI, and Office productivity programs
  
  
**AI for Techies**
- Hands-on AI, Python, and SQL for tech and analytics professionals
  
  
**Dr. Finance**
- Structured personal finance education for informed wealth management
  
  
**Profit Uni**
- Applied stock market and trading with practical strategies
  
  
**Springpad**
- Analytics and business intelligence programs for job-ready skills

title: International Customer Service Representative
description:
Business Development Executive
  
  
About Us
  
  
Connect2Learn is a fast-growing global EdTech platform dedicated to delivering high-quality, personalized learning experiences across academic and non-academic disciplines. Our mission is to empower students by connecting them with passionate and qualified educators from around the world.
  
Through live one-on-one sessions, customized lesson plans, and student-focused learning approaches, we help learners unlock their full potential and achieve academic success with confidence.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
As a Business Development Executive (BDE), you will play a key role in introducing prospective students and parents to Connect2Learn’s learning programs. Your primary responsibility will be to engage with leads, build trust, and schedule free demo classes with our expert educators.This role is ideal for energetic individuals who enjoy communication, relationship-building, and working in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Make outbound calls to students and parents to explain Connect2Learn’s programs and offerings.
  
Schedule free demo classes by engaging families in meaningful and informative conversations.
  
Handle inbound inquiries and provide accurate information regarding courses and learning options.
  
Conduct regular follow-ups to ensure demo classes are scheduled and attended successfully.
  
Maintain and update CRM systems with accurate lead details and interaction status.
  
Coordinate with counselors and operations teams to ensure a seamless demo experience.
  
Achieve daily and weekly demo booking targets.
  
  
Requirements
  
  
Freshers and interns are welcome — complete training will be provided.
  
Strong verbal communication and spoken English skills.
  
Confidence in interacting with parents and students professionally.
  
Goal-oriented mindset with enthusiasm to achieve targets.
  
Basic knowledge of MS Office, Google Sheets, and CRM tools.
  
Candidates must be based in Kolkata or willing to relocate immediately.
  
  
Perks & Benefits
  
  
Fixed salary with attractive performance-based incentives.
  
Technology allowance and travel reimbursement (where applicable).
  
Excellent growth opportunities in counseling and sales domains.
  
Supportive, energetic, and youthful work culture.
  
Exposure to international markets including the UK, USA, Canada, and Australia.
  
  
Selection Process
  
Shortlisted candidates will receive a quick introductory call from our team.
  
Your first job shapes your future — choose growth, learning, and opportunity with Connect2Learn.
  
Start your professional journey with us today.

title: Sales Manager
description:

The company is one of the oldest and most established LED lighting companies in India and has successfully executed prestigious projects across the country, many of which were inaugurated by the Prime Minister. It is a turnkey lighting designer and manufacturer and a Class “A” electrical contractor, with extensive experience in internal, outdoor, architectural, façade, and industrial lighting solutions.

Its notable projects include Signature Bridge, Gujarat Bhawan, H.P. Bhawan, Crafts Complex (Vasant Kunj), Vijaya Bhawan (Ministry of Commerce), and over 20 airport projects in the past decade.

**Job Description**

The company is seeking dynamic, driven professionals for the positions of Sales Manager and Mid-Level Sales Executive, specializing in B2B and B2G project sales. The roles will focus on expanding the company’s business portfolio, especially in government projects, with key responsibilities in business development, client relations, and project execution.

title: ECommerce and Modern Trade
description:
**Company Description**
Shree Gopal Agri is a leading processor of groundnuts and roasted peanuts, focused on delivering high-quality products to domestic and international markets. The company sources groundnuts directly from farmers, ensuring traceability, freshness, and fair value across the supply chain. Its operations are guided by strong values of pride, honesty, professional ethics, and fair business practices. With locations in Jetpur, Saurashtra, and Ahmedabad, Shree Gopal Agri benefits from access to one of India’s best groundnut-growing regions and a robust distribution network for efficient market reach.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site role based in Ahmedabad, focused on ECommerce and Modern Trade for SHREGO. The role involves managing online marketplaces and eCommerce platforms, including product listings, pricing, promotions, and inventory coordination. The individual will build and maintain relationships with modern trade partners, negotiate listings and visibility, and ensure timely execution of promotions and planograms. Day-to-day responsibilities include monitoring sales performance, analyzing channel data, tracking competitor activity, and coordinating with supply chain and marketing teams to support growth. The role also requires regular reporting on key metrics, implementing channel-specific strategies, and ensuring a consistent brand presence across all modern trade and eCommerce channels.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in ECommerce management and online marketplace operations, including handling product catalogs, pricing, and promotions.
* Skills in modern trade account management, including relationship building, negotiation, and execution of in-store and channel-specific activities.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to work with sales data, channel performance metrics, and market insights.
* Knowledge of FMCG or food/agri products, with an understanding of retail, distribution, and consumer buying behavior.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and other productivity tools; familiarity with ERP or inventory management systems is an advantage.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across sales, marketing, and operations teams.
* Ability to work on-site in Ahmedabad, manage multiple priorities, and maintain high standards of integrity and professionalism.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Commerce, or a related field; prior experience in ECommerce or modern trade channels is preferred.

title: Lead Product Engineer - MIPI Protocol
description:
**At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.**
**Job Title:**
Lead Product Engineer
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore/Ahmedabad
  
  
**Cadence**
is a pivotal leader in electronic design, building upon more than 30 years of computational software expertise. The company applies its underlying Intelligent System Design strategy to deliver software, hardware and IP that turn design concepts into reality. Cadence customers are the world’s most innovative companies, delivering extraordinary electronic products from chips to boards to systems for the most dynamic market applications including consumer, hyperscale computing, 5G communications, automotive, aerospace industrial and health.
  
  
**The Cadence Advantage**

* The opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology in an environment that encourages you to be creative, innovative, and to make an impact.
* Cadence’s employee-friendly policies focus on the physical and mental well-being of employees, career development, providing opportunities for learning, and celebrating success in recognition of specific needs of the employees.
* The unique “One Cadence – One Team” culture promotes collaboration within and across teams to ensure customer success

**Job Summary**
Drives development of products and technologies and has material responsibility for the success of that product/technology.
*VIP PE is expected to be an expert in MIPI domain of Verification IP family- protocol and product-wise. PE main role is to help accelerate VIP portfolio adoption at Cadence’s top tier customers by supporting pre-sales technical activities. To ensure that, one must have strong verification expertise and understand customer design and verification flows. As an MIPI VIP and protocol expert, PE drives product knowledge transfer across our field engineers and customer, providing training and developing collaterals. The PE will also need to translate high-level requirements from customers into a technical spec and drive the product definition that fits the customer needs. PE is expected to work independently and collaborate with other team members (R&D, Marketing, support) to ensure all dimensions of the product are aligned. This role requires approximately 20% travel on average.*
**Job responsibilities: (edit as per the requirement)**

* Leads projects with high resource, risk and/or complexity
* Develops and leads large and multiple cross-functional and cross-organizational programs, initiatives, and activities with high resource requirements, risk and/or complexity
* Continually evaluates technology effectiveness/data interoperability of complex systems
* Manages issue resolution with vendors on tech/product quality and functionality and influences vendor roadmap and direction of products
* Communicates highly-complex ideas, anticipates potential objections and persuades others, often at senior levels, to adopt a different point of view.

**Experience And Technical Skills Required**

* At least 7 + to 12 years of experience with Verification and Design
* Working knowledge with MIPI(CSI2/DSI/I3C/PHY) protocols is a must
* Experience with Developing Verification environments using System Verilog
* Working knowledge and experience with the UVM methodology
* Good experience on solving complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of various factors.
* Exercises judgment within broadly defined practices and policies in selecting methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for obtaining results.
* Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills

**Behavioral Skills Required**

* Must possess strong written, verbal and presentation skills
* Ability to establish a close working relationship with both customer peers and management
* Explore what’s possible to get the job done, including creative use of unconventional solutions
* Work effectively across functions and geographies
* Push to raise the bar while always operating with integrity

**We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.**

title: Founder's Office Associate
description:
**We're hiring a Founder's Office Associate at BuildBit. Ahmedabad, on-site.**

Most people spend three years learning how a company works. You'd learn it in six months, sitting next to the people making the calls.

BuildBit builds production software for clients across the US, UK, Middle East, Africa and Australia: AI automation, web and mobile apps, Web3, industrial automation. Wellcome Care, Frakt360, NeamBladi and may more have trusted our work.

**The role**

There's no fixed job description, because the job changes as fast as the company does. One week it's product, the next it's ops, hiring, or a client pitch. You'll:

• Work directly with the CEO on the week's real priorities

• Take features from idea to shipped: specs, coordination with design and engineering, testing, docs

• Keep operations tight across teams: trackers, timelines, reporting, vendors

• Build decks, proposals and research for client and business conversations

• Own small projects end to end and report outcomes, not status updates

• Find what's broken internally and fix it before anyone asks

**🙅🏻‍♂️If you want a narrow, predictable role, this isn't it.🙅🏻‍♀️**

**You'll fit if you have**

• Sharp written and spoken English (you'll write a lot)

• Structured thinking: you can turn a vague ask into steps

• High ownership: you close loops without reminders

• Comfort with Sheets, docs and decks, and the appetite to learn AI tools fast

• Real curiosity about technology and how software businesses run

Any degree. Freshers and experienced candidates both welcome.

**What you get**

* A front-row seat to how a software company is actually run
* Real ownership from week one, not shadow work
* A clear path into product, operations or business, depending on where you're strongest
* Scope and compensation that grow as fast as you deliver
* Full-time, permanent. 6 days a week, on-site at Ahmedabad Office

**How to apply**

Email your CV to shandhen@buildbit.ai with the subject "Founder's Office, Ahmedabad". In the body, tell us why this role, and one thing you've built, run or fixed on your own.

Questions? Call 9886846555.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
**About the Company**

E2M Solutions works as a trusted white-label partner for digital agencies, supporting agencies with consistent and reliable delivery across website design, web development, eCommerce, SEO, AI SEO, PPC, AI automation, and content writing

Founded on strong business ethics, we are an equal opportunity organisation powered by 300+ experienced professionals, partnering with 400+ digital agencies across the US, UK, Canada, Europe, and Australia.

At E2M, we value ownership, consistency, and people who are committed to doing meaningful work and growing together. If you’re someone who dreams big and has the gumption to make them come true, E2M has a place for you.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly skilled PPC Project Manager who can lead end-to-end performance marketing operations, manage client relationships, and drive measurable growth across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other social platforms. This role requires someone who understands both the technical depth of PPC and the strategic clarity of project management, ensuring every campaign is executed at the highest level.

**Work Location**

* Candidates relocating to Ahmedabad will be required to work from our Ahmedabad office for the first 3 months, after which they can continue working remotely.
* This does not apply to candidates already based in Ahmedabad.

**Responsibilities**

***Campaign Strategy & Execution***

* Plan, launch, and manage high-performance campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and supporting channels.
* Build strategic plans to improve ROI, lower CPA, and scale lead generation and eCommerce revenue.
* Perform deep keyword/audience research, competitor analysis, and funnel strategy planning.
* Create and test new ad copy, creatives, angles, and offers to improve performance.
* Build and optimize retargeting and remarketing funnels, including dynamic ads and multi-step nurturing.

***Client Management & Retention***

* Serve as the primary escalation point for clients—handling concerns, queries, and critical issues with clarity and confidence.
* Lead strategic discussions, performance reviews, and roadmap presentations with clients.
* Focus on client retention through proactive communication, transparency, and result-driven execution.
* Translate client requirements into actionable tasks for the internal delivery team.
* Ensure expectations are aligned and properly documented to avoid scope gaps or misunderstandings.

***Process, SOP, and Quality Management***

* Develop, refine, and maintain internal SOPs, templates, QA checklists, and delivery frameworks.
* Bring structure to campaign setup, reporting, creative requests, optimization cycles, and documentation.
* Improve team workflows and identify gaps in processes, communication, or resource allocation.
* Implement best-practice standards across keywords, ads, tracking, landing pages, and reporting.
* Coordinate with design, content, analytics, and technical teams to ensure predictable delivery quality.

***Performance Monitoring & Reporting***

* Oversee daily, weekly, and monthly performance checks across all PPC accounts.
* Use GA4, platform analytics, and conversion tracking to diagnose issues and identify opportunities.
* Build clean, client-ready dashboards and reports using Looker Studio.
* Conduct landing page, creative, and audience A/B testing to continuously improve performance.

***Team Leadership & White-Label Coordination***

* Lead and support PPC analysts, ensuring tasks are completed with accuracy and consistency.
* Mentor junior team members and conduct reviews to maintain execution standards.
* Work closely with agency partners in a white-label environment, understanding:
* Their client relationships
* Their delivery expectations
* How to communicate strategically under their brand
* Ensure seamless communication between internal teams and white-label partners.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of hands-on PPC experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads.
* Strong project management & leadership skills: planning, prioritisation, delivery, and documentation.
* Proven experience handling client escalations and turning difficult situations into retention wins.
* Deep understanding of white-label agency dynamics—communication sensitivity, brand alignment, and reporting style.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to convert data into insights and strategic action.
* Excellent spoken & written client-friendly communication.
* Experience with US clients and international markets.
* Comfort working in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments.
* Bonus: Good copywriting instincts, CRO/landing page understanding, or funnel experience.

**Required Skills**

* PPC (Google Ads, Meta Ads)
* Project management
* Client communication and escalation handling
* Analytics and reporting (including GA4, Looker Studio)
* White-label agency coordination

**Preferred Skills**

* Good copywriting instincts
* CRO/landing page understanding
* Funnel experience

  through SAP and Salesforce, and the development of a robust CRM organization. The role must provide clear commercial direction, review performance at defined intervals, remove execution bottlenecks and ensure that business commitments are delivered through disciplined cross-functional coordination.

**Role and Responsibilities:**

**International Business Strategy and Revenue Delivery**

* Translate the approved annual international distribution strategy into market-wise, quarter-wise and customer-wise execution plans.
* Own the achievement of the approved export distribution sales invoicing target and review progress against quarterly milestones.
* Drive year-on-year growth through existing-customer expansion, new customer acquisition, customer upgrades and improved premium-product penetration.
* Review the performance of assigned regions, distribution partners, direct offices and customer segments, and implement corrective actions for target gaps.
* Lead preparation for the annual business plan and budget process and ensure that the operating plan is supported by realistic forecasts, customer actions and collection plans.

**Business Development and Customer Growth**

* Engage existing and potential international customers for business development and relationship expansion.
* Establish customer-segmentation priorities and ensure structured engagement with A and B customers, along with periodic follow-up for C and D customers.
* Drive business from new and upgraded customers in line with the approved annual and quarterly contribution targets.
* Review regional opportunities, market constraints, forecast-versus-actual gaps and customer-specific actions with regional stakeholders.

**CRM and Customer-Service Governance**

* Ensure a high and consistent level of service to existing and potential customers throughout the enquiry-to-order, order-to-shipment and post-shipment lifecycle.
* Lead CRM governance across assigned markets, including customer master data, follow-up trackers, customer health reports, customer feedback, open-point closure and service escalations.
* Ensure timely customer communication on order status, documentation, payments, shipment schedules, complaints, returns and regulatory requirements.
* Review customer follow-up presentations, customer-focused inputs, collected 4Q feedback and customer action plans before management reviews.
* Ensure that the CRM team maintains complete, accurate and current records in Salesforce, SAP and approved trackers.

**Sales Forecasting, Invoice Planning and Performance Reviews**

* Govern the 12-week rolling forecast process and ensure that forecast inputs are collected, validated, consolidated and reviewed at the prescribed frequency.
* Review the monthly invoice plan, expected sales and collection position, order pipeline, dispatch readiness and forecast-versus-actual challenges.
* Review sales, order, invoice and collection dashboards and ensure that data is available for global sales and collection performance meetings.
* Ensure periodic review of order-to-shipment reports, customer health reports, pending sales orders and key operational trackers.

**Order-to-Cash, DSO and Collection Control**

* Own DSO performance for the assigned international distribution business and drive progressive achievement of the approved quarterly DSO milestones.
* Review customer ledgers, overdue and due receivables, collection plans, credit risks and shipment holds with the CRM team.
* Ensure that monthly collection plans are prepared, communicated and actively followed up with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure that proforma invoices, sales contracts and orders are processed within the approved turnaround time, subject to receipt of advance payment where applicable.
* Ensure that orders are correctly created, verified, approved and released in SAP and that OBD, invoicing and shipment activities are completed within defined service levels.
* Escalate material payment, credit, documentation or shipment risks early and ensure closure through cross-functional coordination.

**Distributor Agreements and Commercial Documentation**

* Oversee preparation, validation, issuance and execution of distributor agreements for assigned markets.
* Ensure that agreement data is correctly uploaded and maintained in SAP and Salesforce.
* Oversee preparation and customer acceptance of sales contracts, pro forma invoices and related commercial documents for each order.
* Drive implementation and adoption of the Agreement Module in Salesforce in accordance with the approved project plan and go-live milestone.
* Ensure document completeness, version control, approval compliance and accessibility for audit and operational use.

**Logistics, Shipment and Inventory Coordination**

* Review order and logistics efficiency, pending dispatches, shipment risks and order-to-shipment performance with CRM and logistics stakeholders.
* Support the transition and review of FOB-to-CIF processes and ensure that nominated-agent details are made available for FOB shipments where required.
* Review non-moving stock and ensure that market, customer and shipment actions are defined and tracked to reduce inventory risk.
* Ensure timely resolution of documentation, payment, regulatory and logistics issues that may delay shipment.
* Govern implementation of the Salesforce Freight Portal and ensure process adoption after go-live.

**Regulatory, Quality, PMS and Returns Coordination**

* Ensure that product registration information and certificates received from customers or regional teams are shared with the Regulatory function in a timely manner.
* Ensure follow-up on product registration trackers with the Regulatory team for assigned markets.
* Ensure collection and tracking of customer-wise and product-wise post-market-surveillance feedback in line with defined requirements.
* Ensure that customer complaints are supported by complete complaint forms and routed through the approved quality-management process, including Track Wise/DMS activities.
* Ensure that goods-return details are correctly processed in SAP after confirmation from the relevant stores or operations team.
* Support applicable MDR and compliance audits and ensure timely closure of assigned observations.

**Systems, Digital Transformation and Process Improvement**

* Drive SAP-Salesforce automation, Salesforce master-data quality, process controls and management dashboards, including Power BI or other approved tools.
* Lead the Agreement Module and Freight Portal projects in Salesforce from project initiation through go-live and stabilization.
* Support development and adoption of online PMS feedback tools and other approved CRM/process solutions.
* Review process performance, identify control gaps, standardize workflows and sponsor continuous-improvement initiatives through the Menlo Park/Kaizen mechanism.

**Management Reporting, Meetings and Compliance**

* Prepare and present accurate information for management reviews, global sales and collection performance meetings, customer-focused meetings and business-plan discussions.
* Ensure that dashboards, trackers and review packs clearly show target achievement, DSO, collections, forecasts, customer actions, premium-product mix, new/upgrade business and project status.

**Functional Skills Required:**

* International distribution sales strategy and business development
* CRM governance, customer lifecycle management and service escalation
* Sales forecasting, gap analysis, pipeline and performance dashboards
* DSO, receivables, collection planning and credit-risk management
* Order-to-cash process, SAP order release, OBD, invoicing and shipment coordination
