title: Creative Project Manager
description:
**Creative Project Manager**

Because — Ahmedabad · Full-time · On-site

We're
**Because**
— an AI-native brand and marketing agency working across education, real estate, lifestyle, sports and financial services. This role is for someone who is genuinely two things at once: sharp enough to run client relationships, and creative enough to do the actual work. You'll own 4–6 accounts, report directly to a senior strategist, and be expected to think, write, plan, coordinate, and execute — often on the same day. If that sounds exhausting rather than exciting, this probably isn't the right fit.

**What you'll own**

* Manage 3–4 client accounts end-to-end — timelines, feedback cycles, approvals, and proactive communication. Clients should never have to follow up with you.
* Develop content strategy and campaign concepts — not just execute briefs, but help shape what the brief should be in the first place.
* Write copy across formats — social captions, scripts, brand messaging, ad copy, emailers — in English, Hindi, or Gujarati depending on the client.
* Build client presentations and strategy decks that make a clear argument and hold the room.
* Contribute to pitches — own your section, know the prospect's business, and present with conviction.
* Plan and coordinate shoots — brief photographers and videographers, prepare shot lists and call sheets, manage on-ground logistics, and ensure the output matches the creative vision.
* Write scripts for reels, brand films, ads, and talking-head content — punchy, platform-aware, and on-brief.
* Reference and brief designers and video editors with enough visual and tonal direction that they don't have to guess what you want.
* Manage social media hands-on for select clients — content calendars, scheduling, captions, and community responses.
* Coordinate with external vendors — studios, talent, print vendors, photographers — and hold them to timelines and quality standards.

**You're a fit if**

* You have 3–4 years at a creative or marketing agency and you've genuinely done both sides — not just one with a footnote of the other.
* You can write in at least two of the three: English, Hindi, Gujarati. Fluency in all three is a real advantage here.
* You can hold a client conversation in the morning, brief a designer at noon, review a script by evening, and not mix up which client is which.
* Your strategy thinking is grounded — you back ideas with audience insight, not just instinct.
* You've been on set. You know what a shot list is, how to manage a photographer who runs late, and what "we'll fix it in post" actually costs.
* You use AI tools actively — for copy drafts, research, referencing, strategy frameworks — and you've built your own workflow around them.
* You push back on bad briefs and bad ideas — politely, with reasoning — rather than just executing whatever lands in your inbox.
* Nothing falls through the cracks on your accounts. Not because someone's checking, but because that's just how you work.

**Work samples are mandatory.**
Share a deck you built, copy you wrote, a campaign you managed, or a shoot you coordinated.

Our solutions span predictive maintenance, energy analytics, digital twins and video analytics, deployed across Cement, Automotive, Chemical, FMCG, Steel, Metals and Pharma. Today,

MachineAstro is trusted by 350+ manufacturing plants across the globe. We have installed 25,000+ IoT devices on 6,000+ assets and helped our customers avoid 8,000+ hours of unplanned downtime. Those are not pilot numbers. They are production numbers, earned one plant at a time.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are entering our next phase of growth and need enterprising, self-motivated people who want to own outcomes. People who are comfortable walking into a steel plant or a pharma line, understanding what keeps the plant head awake at night, and translating that into a solution the customer will pay for and keep. People who treat a customer's downtime as their own problem.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* Own key accounts: build and run strategic account plans for assigned manufacturing customers, and be the senior point of contact from plant reliability engineers to business heads.
* Prove value: turn condition-monitoring and diagnostics data into business cases customer leadership will fund - downtime avoided, failures prevented, maintenance cost reduced.
* Grow the account: hunt for opportunities inside existing customers — more assets, more plants and adjacent MachineAstro solutions — through consultative, value-based cross-sell and upsell.
* Be the technical authority: review vibration and condition-monitoring findings with plant teams, validate diagnoses on site, and make sure recommendations are acted on.
* Run executive engagement: lead periodic business reviews with plant and corporate leadership, presenting outcomes, risks and the expansion roadmap.
* Lead cross-functionally: coordinate deployment, analytics, product and sales teams to resolve escalations and close the loop on customer issues.
* Be on the plant floor: travel to customer plants and sites across India.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* BE / B.Tech: Mechanical Engineering preferred.
* 12+ years of relevant experience in industry, reliability, condition monitoring, predictive maintenance, industrial automation, consultative selling or related fields.
* CAT-II / CAT-III Vibration Certification is strongly preferred.
* MBA in Marketing, Sales, Business Management or a related discipline preferred.
* Experience with manufacturing / process industries is highly desirable.
* Strong strategic key account management, account expansion, cross-sell and upsell skills.
* Proven opportunity hunting, consultative selling, value selling and business case development abilities.
* Sound understanding of vibration and condition monitoring.
* Comfortable engaging with plant engineers as well as senior business leaders, combining technical credibility with strong commercial ownership.
* Strong customer and executive stakeholder management, problem-solving and cross-functional leadership. - Strong communication, presentation and plant-level engagement skills.
* Flexibility to travel to customer plants and sites across India.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Health insurance coverage
* Dynamic work environment
* Opportunity to learn with growth mindset team

**HOW TO APPLY**

Send your resume to naina@machineastro.com with the subject line "GM / Sr Manager – Customer Success".

Ortho

  through SAP and Salesforce, and the development of a robust CRM organization. The role must provide clear commercial direction, review performance at defined intervals, remove execution bottlenecks and ensure that business commitments are delivered through disciplined cross-functional coordination.

**Role and Responsibilities:**

**International Business Strategy and Revenue Delivery**

* Translate the approved annual international distribution strategy into market-wise, quarter-wise and customer-wise execution plans.
* Own the achievement of the approved export distribution sales invoicing target and review progress against quarterly milestones.
* Drive year-on-year growth through existing-customer expansion, new customer acquisition, customer upgrades and improved premium-product penetration.
* Review the performance of assigned regions, distribution partners, direct offices and customer segments, and implement corrective actions for target gaps.
* Lead preparation for the annual business plan and budget process and ensure that the operating plan is supported by realistic forecasts, customer actions and collection plans.

**Business Development and Customer Growth**

* Engage existing and potential international customers for business development and relationship expansion.
* Establish customer-segmentation priorities and ensure structured engagement with A and B customers, along with periodic follow-up for C and D customers.
* Drive business from new and upgraded customers in line with the approved annual and quarterly contribution targets.
* Review regional opportunities, market constraints, forecast-versus-actual gaps and customer-specific actions with regional stakeholders.

**CRM and Customer-Service Governance**

* Ensure a high and consistent level of service to existing and potential customers throughout the enquiry-to-order, order-to-shipment and post-shipment lifecycle.
* Lead CRM governance across assigned markets, including customer master data, follow-up trackers, customer health reports, customer feedback, open-point closure and service escalations.
* Ensure timely customer communication on order status, documentation, payments, shipment schedules, complaints, returns and regulatory requirements.
* Review customer follow-up presentations, customer-focused inputs, collected 4Q feedback and customer action plans before management reviews.
* Ensure that the CRM team maintains complete, accurate and current records in Salesforce, SAP and approved trackers.

**Sales Forecasting, Invoice Planning and Performance Reviews**

* Govern the 12-week rolling forecast process and ensure that forecast inputs are collected, validated, consolidated and reviewed at the prescribed frequency.
* Review the monthly invoice plan, expected sales and collection position, order pipeline, dispatch readiness and forecast-versus-actual challenges.
* Review sales, order, invoice and collection dashboards and ensure that data is available for global sales and collection performance meetings.
* Ensure periodic review of order-to-shipment reports, customer health reports, pending sales orders and key operational trackers.

**Order-to-Cash, DSO and Collection Control**

* Own DSO performance for the assigned international distribution business and drive progressive achievement of the approved quarterly DSO milestones.
* Review customer ledgers, overdue and due receivables, collection plans, credit risks and shipment holds with the CRM team.
* Ensure that monthly collection plans are prepared, communicated and actively followed up with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure that proforma invoices, sales contracts and orders are processed within the approved turnaround time, subject to receipt of advance payment where applicable.
* Ensure that orders are correctly created, verified, approved and released in SAP and that OBD, invoicing and shipment activities are completed within defined service levels.
* Escalate material payment, credit, documentation or shipment risks early and ensure closure through cross-functional coordination.

**Distributor Agreements and Commercial Documentation**

* Oversee preparation, validation, issuance and execution of distributor agreements for assigned markets.
* Ensure that agreement data is correctly uploaded and maintained in SAP and Salesforce.
* Oversee preparation and customer acceptance of sales contracts, pro forma invoices and related commercial documents for each order.
* Drive implementation and adoption of the Agreement Module in Salesforce in accordance with the approved project plan and go-live milestone.
* Ensure document completeness, version control, approval compliance and accessibility for audit and operational use.

**Logistics, Shipment and Inventory Coordination**

* Review order and logistics efficiency, pending dispatches, shipment risks and order-to-shipment performance with CRM and logistics stakeholders.
* Support the transition and review of FOB-to-CIF processes and ensure that nominated-agent details are made available for FOB shipments where required.
* Review non-moving stock and ensure that market, customer and shipment actions are defined and tracked to reduce inventory risk.
* Ensure timely resolution of documentation, payment, regulatory and logistics issues that may delay shipment.
* Govern implementation of the Salesforce Freight Portal and ensure process adoption after go-live.

**Regulatory, Quality, PMS and Returns Coordination**

* Ensure that product registration information and certificates received from customers or regional teams are shared with the Regulatory function in a timely manner.
* Ensure follow-up on product registration trackers with the Regulatory team for assigned markets.
* Ensure collection and tracking of customer-wise and product-wise post-market-surveillance feedback in line with defined requirements.
* Ensure that customer complaints are supported by complete complaint forms and routed through the approved quality-management process, including Track Wise/DMS activities.
* Ensure that goods-return details are correctly processed in SAP after confirmation from the relevant stores or operations team.
* Support applicable MDR and compliance audits and ensure timely closure of assigned observations.

**Systems, Digital Transformation and Process Improvement**

* Drive SAP-Salesforce automation, Salesforce master-data quality, process controls and management dashboards, including Power BI or other approved tools.
* Lead the Agreement Module and Freight Portal projects in Salesforce from project initiation through go-live and stabilization.
* Support development and adoption of online PMS feedback tools and other approved CRM/process solutions.
* Review process performance, identify control gaps, standardize workflows and sponsor continuous-improvement initiatives through the Menlo Park/Kaizen mechanism.

**Management Reporting, Meetings and Compliance**

* Prepare and present accurate information for management reviews, global sales and collection performance meetings, customer-focused meetings and business-plan discussions.
* Ensure that dashboards, trackers and review packs clearly show target achievement, DSO, collections, forecasts, customer actions, premium-product mix, new/upgrade business and project status.

**Functional Skills Required:**

* International distribution sales strategy and business development
* CRM governance, customer lifecycle management and service escalation
* Sales forecasting, gap analysis, pipeline and performance dashboards
* DSO, receivables, collection planning and credit-risk management
* Order-to-cash process, SAP order release, OBD, invoicing and shipment coordination
* Distributor agreements, sales contracts and proforma-invoice governance
* SAP and Salesforce implementation, automation and master-data control
* Management reporting, Power BI/analytics and executive presentations
* Regulatory registration, PMS feedback, complaint and returns coordination
* Process improvement, SOP governance, audits, budgeting and project management
* Team structure design, performance management, coaching and capability building

**Behavioural Skills Required:**

* Customer orientation and service ownership
* Commercial drive, aggressiveness and will to win
* Innovation, adaptability and change leadership
* Entrepreneurial thinking and opportunity orientation
* Passion, commitment and personal accountability
* Analytical thinking and evidence-based decision-making
* Clear communication, influencing and cross-cultural stakeholder management
* Respectful people leadership, coaching, collaboration, high process discipline, integrity, effective prioritization and timely action closure

**Team Size to be Handled:**

* Role involves managing a team of 2 members.

**Specific Professional Competencies:**

* Business Acumen, Customer Focus, Drive for results, Problem-solving, Peer relationship, Negotiation skills, Functional/ technical skills, Presentation skills, Adherence to Ethics and Values, Integrity.

title: Admin & Facility Executive
description:
**Job Description – Travel Desk Executive**
===========================================

**Company:** Anblicks

**Position:** Travel Desk Executive

**Department:** Administration / Finance & Operations

**Location:** India

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Work Timing:** India working hours with required overlap with US business hours

**Role Summary**
----------------

The Travel Desk Executive will be responsible for managing and coordinating end-to-end business travel requirements for Anblicks employees and leadership across **India and the USA**.

The role will ensure timely travel arrangements, cost-effective bookings, adherence to the Company’s Travel Policy, appropriate approvals, accurate documentation, and seamless coordination with employees, vendors, Admin, HR, and Finance teams.

As the role supports Anblicks' US operations, the candidate will be required to maintain **regular working-hour overlap with the US team** and should be flexible to support urgent or time-sensitive travel requirements across different time zones.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Travel Planning & Booking**

* Manage domestic and international business travel requirements for employees and leadership across India and the USA.
* Arrange flights, hotels, ground transportation, rental cars, and other travel-related services.
* Identify cost-effective travel options while considering business requirements, employee convenience, and Company policy.
* Handle booking modifications, cancellations, rescheduling, refunds, and travel disruptions.
* Support urgent and last-minute travel requirements, including requests received during the required US-hours overlap.
* Share complete travel itineraries and booking confirmations with travelers on time.

### **USA Travel Support**

* Provide travel desk support to employees and leadership based in or traveling within the USA.
* Coordinate domestic US travel, including flights, hotels, rental cars, and ground transportation.
* Support India-to-USA and USA-to-India international travel requirements.
* Coordinate effectively with US-based employees, Admin, HR, Finance, Sales, and Delivery teams.
* Understand and manage travel requirements across different US time zones.
* Maintain appropriate overlap with US business hours to ensure timely response and support.

### **Travel Approvals & Policy Compliance**

* Ensure appropriate business and financial approvals are obtained before confirming bookings.
* Verify that travel requests comply with the Company's Travel Policy, including travel class, hotel limits, advance booking requirements, and applicable spending limits.
* Identify and escalate exceptions or out-of-policy requests before booking.
* Maintain proper documentation and approval trails for travel transactions.

### **International Travel & Documentation**

* Coordinate international travel arrangements, including flight and hotel bookings.
* Support employees with visa-related documentation, travel insurance, invitation letters, and other travel documentation in coordination with HR/Admin.
* Track visa timelines and travel documentation requirements.
* Ensure travelers receive necessary itinerary and documentation information before travel.

### **Vendor Management & Cost Optimization**

* Coordinate with travel agencies, airlines, hotels, rental car providers, cab providers, and other travel vendors in India and the USA.
* Compare available travel options and quotations to ensure competitive pricing.
* Support negotiation of corporate rates and commercial arrangements with travel vendors.
* Monitor vendor service quality, response time, pricing, and billing accuracy.
* Identify opportunities to reduce travel costs through advance booking, preferred vendors, corporate rates, and better travel planning.

### **Billing & Finance Coordination**

* Verify travel vendor invoices against approved bookings and supporting documents before submission to Finance.
* Ensure appropriate employee, department, project/customer, and cost-center information is captured.
* Coordinate with Finance for vendor payments, employee travel advances, reimbursements, and corporate card transactions, as applicable.
* Track cancellations, refunds, airline credits, hotel refunds, and unused ticket credits.
* Follow up with vendors to ensure timely recovery and utilization of outstanding credits.

### **Travel MIS & Reporting**

Maintain accurate travel records and prepare periodic MIS covering:

* Employee-wise travel expenses
* Department/project/customer-wise travel expenses
* India and USA travel spend
* Domestic vs. international travel
* Airfare, hotel, rental car, and ground transportation expenses
* Booking lead time
* Cancellation and rescheduling costs
* Refunds and unused travel credits
* Policy exceptions
* Vendor-wise spend
* Travel cost trends and savings opportunities

Provide monthly travel reports to Finance/Management and highlight significant variances, exceptions, and cost-saving opportunities.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
-------------------------------------

Performance may be measured based on:

* Turnaround time for travel requests
* Travel Policy compliance
* Cost savings through fare comparison and advance booking
* Accuracy of bookings and travel documentation
* Timely resolution of urgent India and US travel requests
* Timely reconciliation of cancellations, refunds, and travel credits
* Accuracy and timeliness of Travel MIS
* Vendor performance
* Employee satisfaction with travel desk support

**Required Qualifications & Experience**
----------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Travel & Tourism, or a related field.
* **2–5 years of experience** in corporate travel management or travel desk operations.
* Experience handling **India and US corporate travel** is strongly preferred.
* Experience managing domestic and international flight, hotel, rental car, and ground transportation bookings.
* Familiarity with US travel arrangements and major US time zones will be an advantage.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and MIS reporting.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

**Key Skills & Competencies**
-----------------------------

* Strong coordination and follow-up skills
* Excellent attention to detail
* Cost-conscious and commercially aware
* Strong negotiation and vendor management skills
* Ability to manage multiple requests across different time zones
* Ability to work under pressure and handle last-minute requirements
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Good Excel and reporting skills
* High level of ownership and accountability
* Customer-service-oriented approach
* Understanding of financial controls and approval processes

**Working Hours / Shift Requirement**
-------------------------------------

This role is based in India but supports Anblicks' **India and USA operations**. The candidate must be comfortable working in a schedule that provides **regular overlap with US business hours**.

The role requires flexibility to coordinate with US-based employees and stakeholders and to address urgent travel requirements that may arise during the US working day.

Candidates should therefore be comfortable with **extended/evening working hours in India as required based on business and travel needs**.

description:
About the Role

We are looking for an organized, proactive, and detail-oriented **Sales Coordinator** to support our sales team and ensure smooth day-to-day sales operations. In this role, you will work closely with Sales Associates, Field Sales Executives, retailers, wholesalers, distributors, and the Sales Head to manage order coordination, maintain accurate sales records, monitor inventory, and ensure timely product resupply.

You will play a key role in connecting the sales team with business partners, tracking order requirements, and supporting future sales planning. If you have strong communication and coordination skills, enjoy working with data, and can manage multiple tasks efficiently, we’d love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Sales Team Coordination:** Coordinate with Sales Associates and Field Sales Executives to track daily sales activities, follow up on customer requirements, resolve order-related issues, and ensure smooth communication between the field team and management.

**2. Retailer, Wholesaler & Distributor Data Management:** Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of retailers, wholesalers, and distributors, including contact details, order history, stock requirements, outstanding orders, and resupply schedules.

**3. Order Follow-ups & Resupply Coordination:** Regularly follow up with retailers, wholesalers, and distributors to understand their replenishment requirements, collect repeat orders, track pending orders, and coordinate timely resupply to prevent stock shortages.

**4. Production & Inventory Tracking:** Monitor production inventory and available stock levels to ensure product availability aligns with incoming orders and market demand. Coordinate with the relevant internal teams to identify potential shortages and communicate replenishment requirements in advance.

**5. Sales Reporting & Documentation:** Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports, order summaries, inventory updates, customer follow-up records, and other relevant documentation to support business operations and decision-making.

**6. Coordination with the Sales Head:** Work directly with the Sales Head to review sales performance, discuss market requirements, share updates on retailer and distributor demand, and assist in planning future sales activities and distribution strategies.

**7. Sales Planning & Forecasting Support:** Help identify upcoming product requirements by analyzing past orders, repeat purchase patterns, inventory movement, and feedback from field sales teams. Support the preparation of sales forecasts and resupply plans.

**8. Pending Orders & Issue Resolution:** Track delayed, incomplete, or pending orders and coordinate with the concerned teams to ensure timely resolution. Communicate order status updates to relevant stakeholders and maintain proper follow-up records.

**9. Customer Relationship Support:** Maintain professional communication with retailers, wholesalers, and distributors to strengthen business relationships, understand their concerns, and ensure a smooth and reliable ordering experience.

**10. Internal Communication & Operational Support:** Act as a coordination point between the sales team, inventory or production team, and management to ensure accurate information flow, timely updates, and efficient execution of sales operations.

Qualifications & Requirements

**Communication Skills:** Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to coordinate professionally with sales teams, retailers, wholesalers, distributors, and management.

**Language Proficiency:** Proficiency in Hindi and English is preferred. Knowledge of additional regional languages is an advantage.

**Organizational Skills:** Strong attention to detail, time management, and the ability to handle multiple follow-ups, maintain records, and prioritize tasks effectively.

**Data Management:** Ability to maintain accurate customer databases, order logs, inventory records, and sales reports.

**Technical Skills:** Basic to intermediate knowledge of MS Excel or Google Sheets is preferred. Familiarity with CRM, ERP, inventory management, or order management software is an added advantage.

**Problem-Solving Ability:** Ability to identify order discrepancies, track pending requirements, communicate stock shortages, and coordinate with the relevant teams to resolve operational issues.

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Marketing, or a related field is preferred. Candidates with relevant practical experience may also be considered.

**Experience:** Freshers with strong organizational and communication skills may apply. Prior experience in sales coordination, sales operations, customer support, inventory management, or order processing is an advantage.

**Work Approach:** Must be responsible, proactive, systematic, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment that requires regular follow-ups and coordination across multiple teams.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary based on skills and experience.
* Attractive incentive structure, offering additional earning potential based on sales performance.
* Opportunity to work closely with the Sales Head and understand business operations.
* Exposure to sales planning, inventory management, distribution, and customer relationship management.
* Opportunities for professional growth in sales operations and business coordination.
* A collaborative and supportive work environment.

title: ST - Telco-Nokia Flow One-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Technology Consulting - Manager – Nokia FlowOne Solution Architect**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
In this role at EY GDS Consulting, you will play a key role in shaping innovative solutions for telecom clients, acting as their trusted advisor in transformation leveraging Nokia FlowOne driven solutions. You will apply leading industry standards along with Nokia FlowOne expertise to solve complex telecommunication challenges and leverage cutting-edge technologies to drive Telco transformations. You will support the Partners and the Markets team in any opportunities that are initiated by clients.
  
  
You will be responsible to create a market for EY offerings across the telecommunications value chain and generate new leads and opportunities based on the client relationships you already have. Additionally, you will be responsible for delivery of key client outcomes on engagements by managing the teams on ground and client expectations of delivery, helping project teams mitigate delivery risk and identifying key issues that hinder outcomes for the client.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Provide solution architecture and thought leadership on Zero Touch Fulfilment and Autonomous Networks leveraging Nokia FlowOne and other Nokia suite of OSS products
* Lead the implementation of related solutions, ensuring adherence to project timelines and quality standards.
* Driving presales response for OSS transformation RFIs/RFPs.
* Develop comprehensive documentation for network architectures, designs, and processes.
* Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in Autonomous networks, AI, and Machine learning with hands on experience in leveraging leading AI tools for deliveries.
* Develop and apply solution architecture standards, processes, and principles.
* Evaluate and recommend technologies, tools, and platforms that support autonomous networking initiatives.
* You will be the day-to-day point of contact for clients and managers on projects. You structure and engage teams to deliver high-quality outputs.
* Take the lead in identifying client issues and proposing the most appropriate approach for challenges that the telecommunication industry players face.
* You help develop the business and acquire new clients and engagements, including the identification and pursuit of business opportunities by forging strong client relationships.
* You build and maintain long-term relationships with senior clients.
* You drive strategic discussions regarding business objectives and strategy KPIs.
* Delivering qualified solutions to meet business objectives, providing focus to ensure scope and objectives are maintained throughout the project and program life cycles ensuring benefits realization.
* Result oriented leadership style, setting achievable goals and leading by example – linking commercial and technical arenas.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Consultant with 10-12 Years proven experience and hands-on professional experience in Nokia FlowOne, driving large programs and should have worked as an Architect/Designer for at least 5 years.
* Understanding of 5G Slicing, 5G SA/NSA networks, IP/MPLS, Optics, IMS, VoLTE, NFV/SDN, Fixed network.
* In depth knowledge of TMForum’s Open Digital Architecture (ODA) and related ODA components along with TMForum Open APIs.
* Deep knowledge of OSS Architecture, Processes and Systems with practical and proven experience of solutioning for large telecom companies.
* Experience in architecting Zero-Touch operations, Closed Loop Automation, Autonomous Networks and implementing Intent-Driven Management systems to translate business goals to machine readable “Intents” in telecom domain.
* Experience in building comprehensive solutions and response to complex RFx during presales, especially leveraging Nokia’s OSS product suite.
* Providing Autonomous Networks (AN) thought leadership, solution implementation leadership, application expertise and solution vision to clients.
* Additional experience in other Nokia suite of OSS products will be an added advantage.
* Hands-on experience in Java, Python, Kubernetes, Microservices, Databases, etc.
* Expertise and experience to provide thought leadership and guidance on resolving complex implementation and solution issues.
* Expertise to review and approve methods design and development solution documents, internal and external test strategies, plans and scripts.
* Navigate complex client relationships and large transformation related challenges.
* Extensive RFP exposure - developing capability needs and supplier liaison.
* Process development for both 'As Is' and 'To Be' to aid requirement and solution definition and scoping.
* A bachelor’s degree in Electronics/Computer Science/Information Technology/ or any other relevant discipline.
* Relevant certifications (E.g., TOGAF, eTOM, ODA) are a plus.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

**Ideally, you will also have:**

* Strong leadership skills, teaming and communications
* Strong drive to excel professionally, and to guide and motivate others.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Dedicated, resourceful and able to work under pressure.

**What we look for:**
Highly motivated individuals with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize shifting workloads in a rapidly changing industry. An effective communicator, you’ll be a confident leader equipped with strong people management skills and a genuine passion to make things happen in a dynamic organization. If you’re ready to take on a wide range of responsibilities and are committed to seeking out new ways to make a difference, this role is for you.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Lead Business Analyst Engineer
description:
**Senior Business Analyst - Payments**
**Location:**
| Open to any location | Occasional UAE travel
  
  
**About The Role**
We build compliance payment products used by banks and financial institutions across the UAE and GCC to process domestic, cross-border, instant, and WPS payments.
  
  
As a Senior Business Analyst, you will own the functional analysis from requirement through release. You'll work closely with bank stakeholders, sales, Key account Managers, architects, engineers, QA, and delivery teams.
  
  
You will be expected to understand the business problem behind each requirement, challenge unclear or impractical requests, define how the solution should behave, and stay involved through testing and release.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* Functional analysis of payment capabilities. This covers business rules, validations, exceptions, failures, returns, reconciliation, and downstream impact.
* Requirement workshops with bank business, operations, and technology stakeholders. You'll convert ambiguous business needs into clear, complete, and testable requirements.
* Functional specifications that engineering teams can build from. These include user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, API requirements, data mapping, and business rules.
* Feasibility, gap, scope, dependency, and impact analysis for new requirements and change requests.
* Requirement traceability from business need through development, testing, UAT, and release.
* Testing support. You'll support SIT and UAT, clarify expected behaviour during defect triage, and validate delivered functionality against agreed requirements.

**Must-Haves**

* 5+ years as a Business Analyst, including at least 3 years on payments products or payment projects in banking or financial services preferably in UAE or any other GCCs.
* Experience analysing at least one end-to-end payment flow, including transaction processing, failures, returns, and reconciliation.
* Good understanding of REST APIs, including authentication, request and response structures, validations, error handling, and data mapping.
* Working knowledge of ISO 20022 message concepts and structures, such as pacs, pain, and camt.
* Experience conducting requirement workshops directly with bank or business stakeholders.
* Ability to write basic SQL queries for data validation and defect investigation.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with UAE payment schemes, such as UAEFTS, WPS, and Aani.
* Experience with payment hubs, orchestration, instant payments, open banking, clearing and settlement, or transaction monitoring.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar tools.
* Experience across Agile and Waterfall delivery environments.

**How You'll Work With AI**
We encourage analysts to use AI where it improves speed, analysis, and quality, and we'll support you in learning the tools. All use must follow company and client data-security policies.
  
  
**Typical Use Cases Include**

* Diagrams as code: creating process flows, sequence diagrams, and system workflows using tools such as Mermaid, so diagrams stay close to requirements and are easy to update.
* Early validation: building wireframes, clickable prototypes, or proofs of concept to test requirements with stakeholders before development starts.
* Automation: using small scripts to generate test data, validate payment messages, or run reconciliation checks.
* Requirement quality: using AI to surface ambiguity, missing scenarios, and edge cases. The analyst remains responsible for validating the result.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Within 3 months: you can explain the end-to-end flow of your payment capability, including its integrations, key rules, exceptions, dependencies, and limitations.
* Within 6 months: you are the primary functional point of contact for that capability across engineering, QA, delivery, and business stakeholders.

description:
**Company Description**
JFS Logistics is a Dubai-based logistics and supply chain company that simplifies global trade through tailored, end-to-end solutions. The organization specializes in international air and sea freight, land transportation across the GCC and Middle East, customs clearance, warehousing, distribution, and supply chain management, including dangerous goods handling. With a strong network across GCC, Asia, Europe, and Africa, JFS Logistics serves clients in sectors such as perfumes, FMCG, electronics, fashion, and industrial goods. The company emphasizes reliability, global reach, customer commitment, and safety, and is known for professionalism, transparency, and long-term partnerships. With a team of 51–200 employees, JFS Logistics offers a dynamic environment for logistics and creative professionals.

**Role Overview**

JFS Logistics is seeking a creative, organised, and client-focused Account Manager for its Branding and Marketing Department.

The ideal candidate will have experience in content creation, creative leadership, brand management, or marketing and will be able to manage projects from the initial brief through creative development, approval, and final publication.

* Manage assigned client and internal brand accounts.

* Manage multiple projects, accounts, and deadlines simultaneously.

description:
Location: Kochi

Other locations: Anywhere in Country

Salary: Competitive

Date: Oct 12, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1744627

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Role Title:** GDS Microsoft Co-Investments Lead Analyst

**Alliance:** Microsoft

**Competency:** Co-Investments

**Function:** GDS ES Growth & Innovation

**Rank:** Supervising Associate

**Sub Function:** GDS Alliances Program Ops CoE

**The opportunity**

Microsoft is one of EY’s most strategic alliance relationships, helping clients accelerate transformation through cloud, data, AI, automation and emerging technologies. Within this context, the Co-Investment team plays an important role in bringing structure, governance and execution discipline to investments that support joint growth priorities with Microsoft.

The GDS Microsoft Co-Investments Lead Analyst will support the Microsoft Co-Investments team by coordinating investment governance, funding administration, portfolio visibility, reporting, stakeholder follow-through and outcome tracking across global and regional initiatives.

This role is suited to a structured, commercially aware professional who can translate investment priorities into practical execution support. The incumbent will work with Microsoft Alliance leadership, Microsoft stakeholders, regional alliance teams, solution area leads, finance, commercial, sales, marketing and GDS teams to help ensure co-investment activities are planned, governed, tracked and activated with clear ownership and measurable outcomes.

The role will also contribute to AI-led investment priorities across Copilot, Azure AI, Data & AI, automation and emerging Microsoft solution areas by supporting structured assessment, tracking and reporting of business value, responsible AI considerations and commercialization readiness.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Coordinate the co-investment governance model, operating rhythm and business review cadence for Microsoft-aligned investment initiatives.
* Support planning, prioritization and tracking of investment requests, funding decisions, approvals, utilization, risks, dependencies and outcomes.
* Support programs and initiatives aligned to the Co-Investments stakeholder agenda and Microsoft Alliance priorities, with guidance from senior team members and stakeholders.
* Work with alliance leadership, finance, commercial, solution area and regional teams to maintain visibility of investment progress, evidence requirements, approval status and key decision points.
* Prepare clear analysis, concise updates and leadership-ready summaries to support investment prioritization, governance discussions and timely follow-through.
* Develop and maintain investment trackers, dashboards, status reports, business review materials, action logs and governance documentation
* Develop and maintain investment trackers, dashboards, status reports, business review materials, governance documentation and executive reporting to support effective management of Microsoft co-investment and funding programs, including utilization tracking, compliance oversight, business outcome measurement and stakeholder accountability.
* Support business case development for co-investment opportunities, including strategic rationale, expected outcomes, activation approach, evidence requirements and performance measures.
* Track portfolio performance across investment themes, solution areas, regions, activation milestones, utilization, pipeline influence and commercialization outcomes. Track portfolio performance across investment programs, solution areas, regions, activation milestones, utilization, pipeline influence, opportunity progression and commercialization outcomes
* Coordinate with sales, marketing and solution teams to support go-to-market activation, enablement, awareness and adoption of investment-backed initiatives.
* Support AI-focused investment initiatives by helping assess value potential, scalability, adoption readiness, data and privacy considerations, and responsible AI alignment in a practical and consistent manner.
* Contribute to efficiencies, automation and standardization across co-investment workflows, reporting processes, document management and day-to-day operations.
* Maintain collaboration tools, SharePoint repositories and working materials to enable stakeholder coordination and audit-ready documentation.
* Partner with onshore Co-Investment and Alliance Operations contacts, Microsoft stakeholders and alliance leadership on strategic projects, special initiatives, process improvements and leadership requests.
* Identify risks, process gaps and operational issues that may affect investment delivery, and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to support timely resolution.
* Coordinate with Brand, Marketing and Communications teams where investment-backed campaigns, client-facing narratives, marketplace assets or enablement content are required to drive adoption, utilization and value realization of approved investments.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Good understanding of alliance operations, investment governance, funding coordination, portfolio tracking and executive reporting.
* Commercial awareness, including understanding of sales cycles, pipeline reporting, business case inputs, utilization tracking and outcome measurement.
* Technology aptitude and comfort working at a business level across Microsoft solution areas such as Copilot, Azure AI, Data & AI, Cloud, Security, Business Applications and automation.
* Practical understanding of AI-enabled transformation, with the ability to support assessment of AI investment opportunities based on business value, adoption readiness, scalability and responsible AI considerations.
* Exposure to continuous process improvement, workflow standardization, automation, process documentation, internal controls and audit readiness.
* Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills; Power BI, dashboarding, workflow tools and AI-enabled productivity tools would be an added advantage.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships with onshore stakeholders and operate effectively in a matrixed global environment.
* Strong problem-solving capability, analytical thinking, root-cause evaluation and mitigation planning, with the ability to work across multiple teams toward practical resolution.
* Good project management skills, including prioritization, tracking, governance, execution discipline, status reporting and management of multiple workstreams with competing timelines.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to create concise leadership updates, business narratives and decision-oriented materials.
* Experience working with alliance or partner programs in a professional services, consulting or technology-led organization; knowledge of EY and GDS operating models will be an advantage.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* University degree required; technology, business, finance or marketing background preferred.
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification would be an added advantage.
* 8 or more years of relevant experience in alliance operations, co-investments, Microsoft funding programs, strategic operations, portfolio management, consulting or commercial operations.
* Experience supporting senior stakeholders, global cross-functional teams across alliance, sales, marketing, finance and technology functions. iFlexibility to support assignments and priorities based on evolving business requirements, strategic initiatives and leadership priorities
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, matrixed environment while managing multiple workstreams, competing priorities and stakeholder expectations.

  

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* Multi-domain exposure across alliances, finance, sales, marketing, operations, technology or transformation.
* Exposure to Microsoft ecosystem programs, co-investment funding, go-to-market initiatives, marketplace activation, Copilot, Azure AI or related Microsoft solution areas.
* Experience supporting strategic initiatives, leadership requests, governance improvements, process standardization and reporting automation.

  

**Technologies and Tools**

* Microsoft 365 productivity and collaboration tools, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, Outlook and SharePoint.
* Working knowledge of Power BI, dashboards, workflow tools and AI-enabled productivity solutions.

  

**What we look for**

We are looking for a structured, commercially aware and proactive professional who can bring discipline, clarity and follow-through to Microsoft co-investment priorities. The ideal candidate will combine stakeholder confidence, operational rigor, analytical thinking and a practical understanding of Microsoft-led innovation, including AI-enabled growth opportunities.

**US ET or CT working hours are mandatory for this role.**

  

**What we offer**

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic global delivery network that plays a vital role in advancing EY’s growth strategy. Working across locations including Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK, GDS teams collaborate with EY service lines, geographies and sectors to deliver high-quality work for clients around the world. In GDS, you will have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects, collaborate with diverse teams and build capabilities across an expanding ecosystem of people, learning, technology and insights that support long-term career growth.

* **Continuous learning:** Develop the mindset, skills and confidence to adapt, grow and navigate what comes next.
* **Success, as defined by you:** Access the tools, flexibility and support to make a meaningful impact in the way that works best for you.
* **Transformative leadership:** Gain insights, coaching and experiences that help you grow into the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** Be valued for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Responsibilities**
The Cisco Supply Chain Product Operations team is looking for a motivated and skilled Product Lifecycle New Product Project Manager to drive the successful introduction of new products to market. You will lead cross-functional teams through the entire product lifecycle, ensuring critical milestones are achieved, risks are proactively mitigated, and rigorous quality standards are upheld. This is a unique opportunity to shape product strategy and drive operational excellence across Cisco’s global landscape. Responsibilities include:
  
  

* End-to-End Lifecycle Management: Lead and manage the full project lifecycle for New Product Introductions (NPI), from initial concept through to launch and post-launch support.
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Facilitate seamless collaboration between Engineering, Product Management, Supply Chain, Marketing, and Sales teams.

* Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify, track, and resolve project risks and issues to ensure timely and successful delivery.
* Performance Tracking: Monitor project performance, manage budget allocations, and provide consistent status updates toS takeholders.
* Continuous Improvement: Drive process enhancements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of our product lifecycle management frameworks.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, or a related field.
* 5-10 years of experience in project management, with a focus on product development or product lifecycle management.
* Demonstrated ability to influence and lead cross-functional teams and complex projects without direct authority within a fast-paced environment.
* Advanced understanding of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) methodologies and tools.
* Outstanding communication, negotiation, and customer management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PMP or equivalent project management certification.
* Validated experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Prior experience within the technology or networking industry.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: PRINCIPAL, TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER
description:
**About Team**
Walmart Global Tech team enables our stores and eCommerce operations across the world. The platforms that we build are used in most of the markets where Walmart has its presence. Global Marketplace team focuses on building Seller Platforms and interfaces which enables sellers across multiple countries to sell and generate business on eCommerce platforms.
  
  
We're looking for highly skilled and experienced Principal Technical Program Manager with a breadth of skills who can create and execute a plan for new strategic initiatives as well as driving the global technology platforms across Global Tech. You should be able to drive high level design, solutioning & delivery of program with our next generation platforms keeping scalability, robustness and security aspects in focus. The platforms we build will be used by customers & sellers across multiple countries with each of them being a multi billion dollar business for Walmart. If you thrive on solving complex technical problems and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment with passionate software developers, then this could be the perfect opportunity for you. As our business continues to expand into new opportunities and evolve with innovations in supply chain and customer experience, we have an exciting opportunity to build software that scales our operations, leads the industry through innovation, and delights millions of customers worldwide. We leverage cutting-edge technologies such as big data, machine learning, AI, real-time analytics, and high-volume, low-latency, high-availability services to achieve these goals.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
As a part of the Marketplace Program Management team you will impact the shopping of our customers to build solutions that will enable a seamless, highly scalable omni-channel experience for a multi-billion dollar enterprise. You impact the Walmart business directly in driving technology strategies to enable the sellers with the best user experience to onboard, list items and sell and grow their business by selling on Walmart eComm platforms. You may have to travel to the United States and other international locations, working closely with Business Stakeholders, World Class Product Teams, and fellow globally based engineering teams, bridging the gap between business and technology worlds.
  
  
Your main responsibilities will revolve around managing large software development programs. You will work closely with architects, engineers, product, design and business leaders to ensure the successful completion of these programs' To do this, you will need to have a deep understanding of software architecture and software design principles. You will also need to demonstrate influential skills by building strong relationships with stakeholders across Walmart, ensuring alignment on roles, responsibilities, and programs project cadences. Your role will involve defining goals, stage gates, critical delivery paths, and key deliverables for large-scale programs that incorporate multiple programs with dependencies across multiple areas of work, timelines, and resource constraints. Efficient engineering resource utilization and delivery will be a priority, and you will need to simplify and clarify priorities and create plans with appropriate milestones for advance planning and executive buy-in. You will also establish a resource capacity allocation process and tool to transform the planning process. Your problem-solving and decision-making skills will be crucial in navigating any setbacks or obstacles that may arise. Overall, as a seasoned professional, your expertise and passion for driving technical projects to success will be invaluable in this role at Walmart Global Tech.
  
  

* Drive quarterly planning efforts, effectively negotiate against priorities, resources, and timelines to secure commitments from partner teams.
* Create the environment for effective collaboration across 4ITB by establishing appropriate forums and enabling Ways of Working improvements.
* Establish processes that drive efficient planning and execution.
* Work with product and engineering in solutioning of new capabilities, driving clarity in product requirements.
* Create a detailed program plan with milestones and timelines and maintain program documentation.
* Resolve ambiguous situations and bring clarity to the program teams.
* Manage program scope, including changes and scope creep ensuring that the program stays aligned with its original scope.
* Monitor program progress against the established schedule and provide weekly status reports to the program stakeholders.
* Proactively identify potential risks and develop mitigation plan and manage cross-functional issues to unblock program team.
* Ensure monitoring and alerting are set up and ensure effective operational excellence frameworks are implemented.
* Ensure that the program adheres to the organization’s standards, policies, and best practices.

**What You'll Bring**
A bachelor’s degree in computerscience/engineering or equivalent.
  
  
Overall 15+ years of technical experience with 8+years of experience as a Technical Program Manager in software delivery within a related industry managing aggressive schedules and significant business impact.
  
  
Experienced in system/platform design concepts,architecture,UXdesign, services, APIs, and technologies.
  
  
Build positive relationships and collaborate with product managers to understand target personas and business process needs, which you will then translate into features and user stories that engineers will leverage to iterate products quickly.
  
  
Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with a love for data and solving complex problems.
  
  
Expertise in change & risk management methodologies, projectmanagement tools, techniques, project tracking tools, dashboards, and reports
  
  
Strong communicator in both verbal and written forms and are equally adept in communicating upwards, outwards, and downward.
  
  
Deep understanding of JIRA, JIRA Align, BigPicture, GenAI etc.would be advantageous.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* 8+years of experience as a Technical Program Manager in software delivery within a related industry managing aggressive schedules and significant business impact.
* Project Management Certification.

**About Walmart Global Tech**
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.
  
  
We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
  
  
Work
  
  
Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Bangalore office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives
  
  
**Benefits**
Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Walmart, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer – By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing diversity- unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions – while being inclusive of all people

description:

The Real Estate and Infrastructure Fitouts Lead will serve as the primary technical and execution authority for all civil construction and interior fitout projects across LTM’s India portfolio. This role demands a seasoned professional who can seamlessly bridge design intent and on-site delivery, while managing multi-vendor ecosystems, cost controls, and stakeholder expectations in a fast-paced corporate environment. Prior exposure to IT/ITES workplace projects is strongly preferred.

**Job Title**
:
**Senior Manager - Real Estate & Administration**

**Location**
:

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Execution & Site Management**

* Lead and oversee site activities for all Civil Core & shell construction and interior fitout projects across India, from initiation through handover.
* Manage concurrent projects simultaneously, maintaining focus on quality, timelines, and budget adherence.
* Support base build and fitout works execution, coordinating inputs across Interiors, Furniture, Security, and MEP streams.
* Implement and enforce quality assurance programmes, health and safety procedures, and compliance frameworks across all sites.

**Design Review & Value Engineering**

* Review GFC (Good for Construction) drawings and conduct value engineering exercises by identifying alternate design approaches, methods, and materiality.
* Evaluate layouts, look & feel, design basis reports, and detailed design packages; provide structured technical inputs to the design team.
* Review Makes, tender specifications, and Bills of Quantities (BOQs) for accuracy and completeness.
* Leverage AutoCAD drafting knowledge to validate design outputs and contribute to project documentation.

**Cost Management & Commercial Oversight**

* Maintain current awareness of local market rates for Core & shell structure, Façade and civil & interior items; use this knowledge to benchmark and validate vendor quotes.
* Evaluate rate analyses, ratify extra-item claims raised by contractors, and provide documented recommendations for approval.
* Process, certify, and validate vendor invoices to ensure accuracy and timeliness of payments.
* Assist in budgeting and cost tracking across the project lifecycle, flagging variances and recommending corrective actions.

**Stakeholder & Vendor Management**

* Coordinate with External design teams and external vendor partners; prepare clear scope-of-work statements for all design and project management consultancy services.
* Proactively explore and onboard new vendor partners from the market for civil and interior works, strengthening the approved vendor ecosystem.
* Organise and chair regular interface meetings and workshops with design teams to ensure timely responsiveness to RFIs, submittals, sample approvals, and schedule milestones.
* Act as a key point of contact for customer and stakeholder issue resolution; coordinate internal resources and third-party vendors for seamless project delivery.

**Scope, Risk & Documentation**

* Assist in defining project scope and objectives in collaboration with all relevant stakeholders, ensuring technical feasibility is validated upfront.
* Manage changes to project scope, schedule, and costs using appropriate change-control and verification processes.
* Measure and report project performance using relevant tools and techniques; maintain rigorous project documentation throughout the lifecycle.
* Perform risk assessments and implement risk management strategies to proactively minimise project exposure.
* Translate business requirements into actionable project execution plans with defined budgets and timelines.
* Support facility management teams with all project-related technical inputs post-handover.

**Core Competencies**

* Project & construction management
* Stakeholder & vendor management
* Risk identification & mitigation
* Commercial expertise & negotiation
* Customer focus & issue resolution
* Multi-project execution

**Technical Skills**

* AutoCAD (design & project execution)
* Budgeting & cost tracking
* BOQ preparation & review
* Interior fitout & civil works
* Quantity surveying
* Project planning & documentation

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Education:**
Bachelor of Engineering (BE) in Civil Engineering

**Experience:**
12–14 years in site execution and project planning for real estate Building construction and Interior fitout projects

**Industry Preference:**
IT/ITES workplace environments; experience with corporate fitout mandates at scale

**Other Requirements:**
Demonstrated ability to manage pan-India project portfolios across multiple concurrent sites

title: Senior Technical Program Manager - IT GTM
description:
**About The Role**
We are seeking an accomplished and highly driven Senior Technical Program Manager to lead strategic Sales & Marketing programs in Rubrik IT. You will own planning and delivery of high-impact cross-functional programs that span Go-To-Market, Marketing automation, Web marketing, Sales Compensation, and Partner enablement. You will provide visible leadership, accountability, and governance across initiatives, from intake and prioritization through execution, go-live, and post-implementation optimization.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with a proven track record delivering complex technology programs, a deep understanding of Sales & Marketing processes, and exceptional collaboration skills to partner effectively with business stakeholders and technical teams.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
  
  

* Program Strategy & Governance

+ Define, champion, and execute the Sales & Marketing IT initiatives, aligned to company-wide business objectives, GTM strategy, and annual planning priorities.
+ Lead one or more concurrent, complex programs involving one or more of these domains - CRM, CPQ, Marketing Automation, Web Marketing, Sales Performance Management, and Sales Commissions.
+ Champion responsible use of LLMs (e.g., Claude) in Sales & Marketing workflows, setting guardrails for security, compliance, and data privacy in collaboration with InfoSec and Legal.
+ Partner with IT and business teams to translate business goals (Pipeline growth, Conversion, retention, Marketing efficiency, Partner performance) into clear program charters, success metrics, and implementation plans.
+ Establish program governance (cadence, forums, decision-making, risk and issue management) for Sales & Marketing IT initiatives.
+ Implement and continuously improve a unified Program Management framework and tooling (e.g., JIRA, Confluence) for Sales & Marketing IT.
+ Leverage AI into the overall SDLC in alignment with Rubrik’s Native AI expectations.

* Program Delivery & Execution

+ Create and own the program plan including cross-functional key deliverables. Negotiate and get cross functional alignment. Partner with Business and IT teams to align and commit on the program Scope, Schedule and Resources.
+ Own the full lifecycle: demand intake, scoping, solution approach, detailed planning, execution, testing / UAT, deployment, stabilization, and post-go-live optimization.
+ Build and manage integrated plans that cover business milestones, technical delivery, dependencies, data and reporting, and change management.
+ Track scope, timeline, budget, and quality, proactively identify risks and interdependencies and drive mitigations and trade-off decisions with stakeholders.

* Sales & Marketing Domain Leadership

+ Partner with Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, Product Operations, Channel/Partner teams, and Commissions to prioritize and deliver programs across:

- CRM (i.e. CPQ Cloud, Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing integrations)
- Marketing automation and web marketing (i.e. Marketo, Adobe Experience Manager, campaign and lead lifecycle)
- Sales performance management and commissions (i.e. Xactly Incent)
- Partner portals and enablement tools

+ Ensure solutions are designed with scalability, data quality, compliance, and user experience in mind.

* Stakeholders, Vendors & Continuous Improvement

+ Act as the central point of contact across business stakeholders and IT delivery teams.
+ Facilitate alignment between business stakeholders, product managers, architects, developers, QA, data engineers, and admins for each program.
+ Communicate program status, risks, decisions, and outcomes clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
+ Drive structured stakeholder engagement, including steering committees, executive readouts, business reviews, and change-management updates.
+ Partner with Procurement, Finance, and Legal to manage vendor relationships, SaaS licensing, and contracts across Sales & Marketing tools.
+ Track budgets and spend across programs, provide regular financial updates, including forecasts, variances, and cost-saving opportunities.
+ Ensure vendors and system integrators deliver to contracted scope, quality, and timelines.
+ Champion best practices in program management, GTM process design, and application lifecycle management for Sales & Marketing IT.
+ Identify and drive continuous improvement initiatives that reduce manual work, improve data quality, and enhance user experience.
+ Mentor project managers, business analysts, and scrum masters, foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.

**Experience You’ll Need**

* 12+ years of progressive experience in IT program / project management, technology consulting, or enterprise applications, with at least 8 years leading Sales & Marketing or GTM-focused programs.
* Understanding of Sales & Marketing processes across lead lifecycle, opportunity management, forecasting, campaign management, sales performance management, commissions, and partner programs.
* Hands-on experience delivering complex programs on CRM and marketing platforms (e.g., Salesforce Sales Cloud / Service Cloud, Marketo, Adobe Experience Manager, or equivalent).

* People Management, Team handling and set up governance around project planning activities

* Working knowledge of analytical tools such as PowerBI, Smartsheets, Power Query, Alteryx, Macros would be preferred

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Project management skills
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Team handling and people management skills

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 3000+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY-P practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career
