title: Legal Data Program Manager
description:
**Introduction**
IBM is seeking an experienced Legal Data Program Manager to serve as the primary operational lead for assigned eDiscovery, litigation, investigation, and compliance matters. Reporting to the Global eDiscovery Senior Manager, this role owns matters from intake through closeout and coordinates internal counsel, outside counsel, business stakeholders, IT, security, privacy, and service providers to deliver timely, cost-effective, and defensible outcomes.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines hands-on command of the full legal data and eDiscovery lifecycle with disciplined case management, strong judgment, and clear communication. The successful candidate will anticipate risk, maintain accurate matter records, translate legal strategy into executable workflows, and use data, technology, and vendor partnerships to improve quality, speed, transparency, and cost control across a global portfolio.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
End-to-End Matter Management
  
  

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned matters and own execution from intake, scoping, and planning through preservation, collection, processing, review, production, and matter closeout.
* Translate legal strategy and deadlines into documented project plans, milestones, roles, dependencies, budgets, quality controls, and escalation paths.
* Lead matter kickoff calls and recurring status meetings; coordinate internal counsel, outside counsel, business units, technical teams, and service providers.
* Provide assistance with meet-and-confer preparation, ESI protocols, search-term negotiations, production specifications, and declarations or documentation concerning discovery processes.
* Maintain complete and accurate matter records, including scope decisions, chain-of-custody documentation, data maps, collection logs, exceptions, approvals, productions, and closeout records.
* Track matter health, deadlines, data volumes, review progress, risks, issues, spend, and forecast-to-complete; provide concise reporting and escalate material concerns with recommended actions.
* Conduct post-matter reviews and coordinate secure data disposition, return, or retention in accordance with legal, contractual, and IBM requirements.

Stakeholder Advisory and Case Strategy
  
  

* Advise attorneys and case teams on auditable, proportionate, and practical approaches to preservation, collection, search, review, analytics, privilege, and production.
* Assess matter complexity, data sources, jurisdictional requirements, privacy constraints, cost drivers, and technical risks; recommend an appropriate execution strategy.
* Explain technical concepts, platform capabilities, limitations, and tradeoffs to legal and non-technical audiences and convert decisions into clear operational requirements.
* Serve as a trusted advisor during high-risk or high-visibility matters, applying sound judgment and escalating issues promptly.

Technology, Analytics, and Process Improvement
  
  

* Evaluate and apply technology-assisted review, continuous active learning, advanced analytics, AI-assisted review, and other automation where appropriate, with documented objectives, validation methods, quality controls, and defensibility considerations.
* Develop repeatable workflows, templates, playbooks, and quality-assurance standards that improve consistency and scalability across matters.
* Identify operational gaps and recommend process, configuration, integration, or automation improvements based on matter data and lessons learned.
* Support the implementation, governance, adoption, and responsible use of approved eDiscovery technologies.
* Deliver practical training and guidance to attorneys, case teams, and internal partners on eDiscovery processes and tools.

**Preferred Education**
Doctorate Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
Required Professional and Technical Expertise
  
  
**Experience**

* 6+ years of eDiscovery program management experience, gained in-house, at a law firm, consultancy, or eDiscovery service provider.
* Experience managing complex global legal data and eDiscovery matters and programs.
* Deep, hands-on knowledge of the full legal data and eDiscovery lifecycle and workflows, including legal hold, preservation, collection, processing, review, production, and data disposition.
* Experience with global eDiscovery matters spanning multiple jurisdictions, data privacy regimes (e.g., GDPR), and cross-border production challenges.
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent, complex matters with competing deadlines and shifting priorities.
* Significant experience interacting with and advising senior stakeholders, outside counsel, and cross-functional partners.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Hands-on proficiency with one or more leading eDiscovery platforms such as Relativity, Nuix, Reveal, or Everlaw, or comparable tools
* Experience with TAR/CAL workflows, predictive analytics, and AI-driven document review methodologies.
* Experience explaining and guiding legal teams on search algorithms, Boolean search logic, and analytics tools.
* Familiarity with modern enterprise productivity platforms and cloud-based data sources (e.g., Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Slack, Teams).
* Deep understanding of the Electronic Discovery Reference Model (EDRM) and eDiscovery industry best practices.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted review tools and a demonstrated desire to continue learning emerging AI methodologies.

Professional Skills
  
  

* Strong project and time management skills with the ability to prioritize, solve problems, and meet deadlines under pressure.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to communicate technical specifics to non-technical audiences.
* Highly organized, with strong judgment and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to quickly learn new processes and systems and apply that knowledge effectively across matters.
* Strong ethical standards and commitment to compliance.
* Ability to support global teams, including occasional flexibility outside standard business hours when needed.

**Preferred Skills**
**Preferred technical and professional experience**

* Project management or eDiscovery accreditations such as PMP, ACEDS, or RCA.

title: Manager - Projects & Qs
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION: MANAGER – PROJECTS & QS**

**Position Vacant**

Manager – Projects & QS

**Organization Name**

Covestays Pvt Ltd (Cove Offices)

**Reports To**

Management

**Education**

* B.E. / B.Tech – Civil (preferred), Electrical or Mechanical.
* Diploma in Engineering with strong relevant execution and QS experience will also be considered.
* Certification in Quantity Surveying (RICS / IIQS), Project Management (PMP) or Construction Management (NICMAR) is a plus.

**Job Description / Responsibilities**

An engineer who started in site execution and has moved onto a project management track, with strong quantity surveying ability.

The role spans budgeting, planning, estimation, billing and quality across Cove’s fit-out and modification projects.

This is a hands-on role – the person must be able to produce a BOQ from a drawing, check a contractor’s bill and oversee execution of interior fit-out projects.

**Budgeting & Estimation**

* Prepare project budgets for new centres, client interior modifications and repair or upgrade works.
* Quantity take-off from architectural and MEP drawings; prepare detailed BOQs covering civil, interiors, electrical, HVAC, fire fighting, plumbing, IT and networking, and access control.
* Rate analysis and benchmarking against prevailing Chennai and Bangalore market rates; build and maintain an internal rate library.
* Develop cost per seat and cost per sq.ft. benchmarks by centre and by scope, and provide fit-out cost inputs for client proposals and landlord negotiations.

**Planning & Scheduling**

* Prepare project schedules identifying the critical path and the activities that must run in sequence versus in parallel.
* Prepare procurement and material delivery schedules aligned to the construction programme.
* Track actual progress against baseline, flag slippage early and prepare recovery plans.
* Maintain look-ahead plans and daily and weekly progress reporting.

**Tendering & Procurement**

* Prepare tender documents, float RFQs and RFIs, and run pre-bid clarifications.
* Prepare technical and commercial comparative statements and recommend award.
* Draft work orders with unambiguous scope, rates, measurement basis, payment terms and timelines.
* Identify and develop new vendors and contractors across civil, MEP and specialist trades.

**Measurement, Billing & Certification**

* Carry out joint measurement at site and record measurements in the measurement book.
* Verify contractor RA bills against the BOQ, work order rates and actual site measurement, and certify for payment.
* Maintain deviation and variation statements with rate justification for non-BOQ and extra items.
* Reconcile free-issue and client-supplied material.
* Track advances, retention, recoveries, debit notes, and final bill settlement and closure.
* Coordinate with finance for release of payments against certification.

**QA / QC**

* Prepare and enforce inspection and test plans, stage-wise quality checklists and the material approval process.
* Check executed work against drawings, specifications and approved samples at each stage.
* Conduct pre-handover testing – electrical load and earthing, HVAC balancing and airflow, fire system testing, plumbing pressure testing, network certification and access control commissioning.
* Prepare and close snag lists; complete handover documentation including as-builts, warranties, O&M manuals and asset registers.

**Cost Control & Reporting**

* Track estimated versus actual cost line by line; maintain a variation register and flag overruns before they are incurred.
* Identify value-engineering opportunities and quantify the saving and the trade-off.
* Prepare monthly MIS on cost, schedule and quality across all live projects.
* Prepare decision notes and options analyses for management on technical and commercial matters.

**Technical Support to Management**

* Act as the technical point of contact for management – site inspections, technical assessment of prospective buildings, and assessment of landlord fit-out obligations and base-build condition.
* Scope, cost and advise on chargeability of client fit-out and modification requests.
* Prepare technical inputs for client agreements, scope schedules, snag and handover documents.
* Represent Cove in meetings with landlords, architects, consultants and contractors.

**Desired profile of the candidate**

* An execution engineer on a project management track, with strong quantity surveying skills. This is not a supervisory-only profile – the person must personally build budgets, check measurements and certify bills.
* Experience with a PMC, design-build contractor, IPC, developer, or a retail / flex-space rollout operator, handling commercial interior fit-out projects.
* Comfortable working across civil, electrical and MEP scopes rather than a single trade.
* Strong numerical discipline and documentation habits.
* Willing to travel across Chennai and Bangalore. Primary place of posting – Chennai / Bangalore.

**Desired work experience (in complete years)**

5 – 8 yrs, including at least 2 – 3 yrs of direct site execution.

**Compensation Offered (Salary Range)**

₹7.00L – ₹10.00L p.a.

**Competencies**

* Advanced MS Excel – mandatory
* MS Project or Primavera for scheduling.
* AutoCAD for drawing reading, measurement and markups.
* Standard methods of measurement – IS 1200 / CPWD norms; familiarity with SOR practice.
* Ability to read and coordinate civil, electrical, HVAC, fire fighting, plumbing and IT/networking drawings.
* Knowledge of commercial interior fit-out materials, systems and work methodologies.
* Clear written and verbal communication; ability to summarise and escalate to management concisely.
* Experience working across multiple sites and managing multiple contractors simultaneously.

**Must Have**

* Demonstrated bill verification and certification experience, with responsibility for the value certified.
* Ability to independently prepare a BOQ from a drawing set.
* Hands-on knowledge of civil, electrical and MEP works – not limited to one discipline.
* Languages: fluency in English conversational Tamil / Hindi / Kannada.

**Selection Process**

* Timed technical case study – project budget and BOQ, project plan, drawing list, testing and pre-opening checks, and risk assessment, against a given fit-out drawing and scope.
* Technical interview on measurement, billing and MEP coordination.
* Management interview.

**Location of posting**

Chennai / Bangalore

**Company Profile**

COVE is real estate for the rental economy. We offer innovative and hassle-free solutions to the problem of shared offices and rental residences in Indian cities. We offer custom-built solutions to short- and long-term renters without any unnecessary frills. Our centres lie in close vicinity to major industrial and technology parks and similar hubs of economic activity.

Cove operates around 5,000 workstation seats across multiple centres in Bangalore and Chennai.

At Cove, you will find a workplace that allows you to express your talents and skills. You will find an entrepreneurial culture that encourages you to take responsibility and learn by doing.

If real estate excites you, if you seek excellence in your work, if you like taking on responsibility and challenges, if you are the type that never settles for less, get in touch. We’d love to see how you could fit in.

title: Program Manager-Investigation Excellence Team, Central Operations
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Investigation Excellence (IE)  
At Amazon we believe that every day is still day one. A day to take the first step and a day to look forward to new challenges. And today is that day for you. It's your day to be part of something great. A day to make your ideas come to life and your day to join a company that redefines itself every day. That's the energy and passion behind Amazon.  
  
investigation Excellence Overview  
Investigation Excellence (IE) is the deep-dive team within ATS Central Operations, owning root-cause investigation across Amazon's European Transportation Surface Transportation network. IE dives deep into every DEA miss — tracing VRIDs from origin to destination, separating true root cause from recovery, and ensuring each disruption is attributed to the right controllable owner. Rather than accepting metrics at face value, the team operates at the lowest level of detail, audits the data themselves, and stays connected to the specifics. IE plays a critical role in giving the network an honest, accurate picture of performance — which is what allows the right teams to fix the right problems and keep Amazon serving customers on time.  
  
Purview of a Program Manager  
As a program manager within Investigation Excellence, your role centers on diving deep into transportation execution data to uncover the true drivers behind DEA misses, and on inventing and simplifying the way we investigate — turning manual, repetitive deep dives into scalable, automated solutions (e.g. Kiro, Quick investigation tooling). You will own root-cause classification and attribution logic, drive accuracy and standardization so investigations can be consistently applied across teams, and monitor performance metrics to drive continuous improvement. You hold a high bar for quality and data integrity, look for ways to eliminate effort rather than add it, and foster cross-functional collaboration. Above all, you provide leadership and direction that keeps IE operating as a high-performance, self-sufficient investigation team — focused on efficiency, accuracy, and simplification.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* On-going generation and creation of reporting.
* Analyzing data to outline any reasons for under/over performance and take actions to improve performance.
* Support the delivery of productivity targets for all KPI's
* Ensure accurate recording and reporting of metrics.
* Work closely with leadership to identify “hot spots” and take appropriate actions to minimize any impacts.
* Communicate and interact effectively with operations and support functions to provide internal customers with information/data needs in a timely manner.
* Evaluate and implement opportunities for improving workflow processes and automation of processes. (Using Excel VBA or in any other tool)
* Raise awareness to any areas for development or recognition.
* Convert all excel reporting to tool (Quick sight, SQL, Tableau etc).

  
A day in the life  
Typically begins the day by reviewing and analyzing data to track key performance indicators and identify trends. They collaborate with various departments to gather information and ensure accurate reporting, while also preparing and presenting reports to stakeholders to inform decision-making processes. Additionally, they may oversee the development and implementation of reporting systems and processes to streamline operations and improve efficiency.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2+ years of program or project management experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)
* Knowledge of SQL
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
* Experience in MS Access and SQL
* Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document

title: Project Manager
description:
PROJECT MANAGER

Industry: Real Estate / Property Development – Residential Projects

Location: Mumbai (Thane)

Experience: 4+ Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

Department: Operations – Project Delivery

Reports To: Project Head

**1. Planning & Schedule Governance**

* Own the project baseline schedule and drive execution against approved timelines.
* Develop monthly, weekly, and daily look-ahead plans with clearly assigned responsibilities.
* Coordinate with the Planning team to manage critical paths and identify scheduling risks proactively.
* Ensure the availability of manpower, materials, and resources before execution begins.
* Develop and implement documented recovery plans to address schedule deviations.
* Provide accurate and timely weekly project progress reports.

**2. Execution & Site Governance**

* Ensure site execution complies with the approved Bill of Quantities (BOQ), issued-for-construction drawings, and finalized designs.
* Ensure all project variations are documented and approved before execution.
* Obtain Engineering validation and necessary drawing clarifications before commencing work.
* Ensure joint measurements and quality clearances are completed before certification.
* Maintain construction quality standards and coordinate with the Quality team to address non-compliant work.
* Ensure compliance with site safety, statutory requirements, and labour regulations.

**3. Budget & Cost Management**

* Manage project execution within the approved budget.
* Track committed costs, certified amounts, payments, and forecast costs to completion.
* Monitor cumulative variation costs and identify potential budget overruns.
* Ensure payment requests are aligned with certified measurements.
* Coordinate with Finance on project cash-flow forecasting and escalate liquidity risks.
* Drive cost optimization and value-engineering initiatives with Engineering and Procurement.

**4. Contracts & Contractor Performance**

* Define work package scope and sequencing requirements in coordination with Engineering and Procurement.
* Manage contractor mobilization, manpower deployment, productivity, and contractual commitments.
* Monitor contractor performance across progress, quality, manpower, safety, and documentation.
* Issue formal notices for contractor non-performance, demand recovery plans, and escalate persistent issues with supporting evidence.
* Coordinate the Running Account (RA) billing cycle and ensure timely certification.
* Align material requirements with procurement plans and ensure vendor instructions follow approved procedures.

**5. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Coordinate with Engineering, Procurement, Planning, Finance, Sales, and CRM teams to ensure seamless project execution.
* Lead weekly project execution review meetings and track action items, owners, and closure dates.
* Resolve interdepartmental execution issues and escalate matters requiring higher-level intervention.
* Coordinate with Sales and CRM to align possession timelines with actual project progress.
* Ensure statutory approvals, No Objection Certificates (NOCs), inspections, and legal compliance requirements are incorporated into project schedules.

**6. Escalation & Reporting**

* Escalate milestone deviations exceeding 7% of the baseline schedule and budget variances exceeding 5%.
* Identify and escalate contractor performance issues, excessive variations, and delays in Engineering clarifications.
* Prepare escalation reports covering root causes, schedule impact, budget implications, recovery plans, and required support.
* Maintain accurate, transparent, and timely project status reporting.
* Own project MIS covering progress, cost, quality, manpower, and risk data.

**7. Team Leadership & Handover Readiness**

* Lead and develop site teams, including Site Engineers, Quality Engineers, Billing Engineers, MEP Coordinators, Supervisors, and Stores personnel.
* Define individual responsibilities and maintain accountability for execution, reporting, and documentation.
* Drive snagging, de-snagging, and finishing activities well ahead of the handover date.
* Ensure testing, commissioning, statutory clearances, and completion documentation are completed before possession.
* Coordinate with CRM to ensure units are ready for handover and minimize customer complaints.

**The Project Manager will be responsible for:**

* Directing site execution sequencing and deploying the site team within the approved plan.
* Addressing contractor non-performance and requiring documented recovery plans.
* Halting work that is unsafe, non-compliant, or outside the approved scope.
* Recommending project variations with technical and commercial justification.

title: Technical Program Manager – Funding & Payments
description:
Overview:

**Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.**  
  
With 5,400+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.  
  
Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.

**Business Segment Overview**

**Corporate:** Engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies.

**Position Purpose:** We are looking to recruit a Program Manager to lead delivery across our Funding and Payments portfolio, based out of our Pune, India office. The successful candidate will have previous experience leading complex, large-scale technical program deliveries spanning multiple geographies, business units and platforms, ideally across client funding, cash management and payments.

Working closely with the EPMO, Payments and Treasury leadership, Product, Technology, Operations and third-party providers, you will drive delivery of a strategic, multi-year portfolio of funding and payments initiatives. This includes the Funding as a Service (FaaS) program, which brings client funding, cash management, and ACH authorization and entitlements to commercial, introducing broker and newly integrated client bases, alongside Global Payments initiatives such as real-time payment (RTP) currencies through correspondent banks, a payment status and tracking engine, cross-currency accounts and operations automation. Much of the payments development capacity sits in India, so you will play a central role in keeping those teams aligned to firm-wide priorities. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, challenging and collaborative working environment and who is results-driven.

Responsibilities:

**Primary duties will include:**

Driving overall delivery of a strategic program of work across Funding and Payments. Your role is to define the different stages of implementation and ensure they are met. Your main roles and responsibilities will be as follows, but are not limited to:

* Work with Payments, Treasury, Product, commercial teams and senior stakeholders to identify program scope and objectives across the funding and payments lifecycle – client funding, payment initiation, authorization, routing, execution, confirmation, reconciliation and reporting
* Work with delivery teams and solution architects to build out agreed scope, define requirements and build robust plans for delivery across payment channels and rails, including ACH, wires/SWIFT, real-time payments and correspondent banking
* Define the projects and features that make up the program, bringing consensus to the most efficient way to deliver value to the organization as quickly as possible
* Monitor and assess program performance, overseeing delivery of the projects and features that make up the program, ensuring completion on time, to scope and within budget
* Take overall responsibility for ensuring everyone on the program is clear on what needs to happen, when it needs to happen by, how it is going to happen and who by
* Identify, track and monitor dependencies across shared payments development teams, dependent programs (such as CRM, client onboarding and trading platform launches) and downstream Operations and Treasury teams
* Coordinate delivery across internal teams, correspondent and partner banks, payment service providers and other third-party vendors, ensuring alignment of business, operational and technology outcomes
* Secure resource commitment and hold teams to account, applying the firm’s portfolio prioritization framework to resolve competing demands on shared development capacity quickly and transparently
* Identify high-level risks and issues and track them through to resolution, escalating promptly to sponsors where priority or resourcing conflicts put milestones at risk
* Partner with Operations, Risk, Compliance, Legal and Technology to ensure regulatory and control requirements, such as payment authorization, entitlements and audit trails, are embedded in delivery
* Own program financials: report spend to date (hrs and $) against budget, forecast to completion, and raise change and funding requests when scope or dependencies shift
* Clearly, concisely and accurately communicate program progress, RAG status, risks and decisions at regular intervals to sponsors, working groups and steering committees across the US, UK and Europe
* Build relationships with stakeholders, delivery teams, vendors and EPMO team members, acting as the EPMO’s on-the-ground delivery lead in Pune
* Identify, address and resolve differences between individuals and/or interest groups

Qualifications:

**To land this role you will need**:

* **7+ years of full-time program management experience or equivalent**
* **Proven success delivering large and complex change initiatives at program level, ideally in financial services and with budgets of over $2m / 10,000 person days**
* **Knowledge of payments and cash management is a must, including ACH and Stable Coin.**
* **Familiarity with payment platforms and messaging, such as payment hubs, payment status and tracking solutions, SWIFT and ISO 20022, or comparable treasury and cash management systems**
* Comfortable working with internal teams of 50+ people across multiple geographies and time zones, with regular overlap with UK and US business hours
* A key collaborator – inclusive, results-driven, who leads by example and brings the best out of teams
* Ability to work with people, both internally and externally, to build support to achieve intended outcomes
* Knowledge of complex technical ecosystems and financial services preferred; exposure to futures, brokerage or FCM client funding would be an advantage
* Direct experience working with IT development teams, platforms and solution architects
* Ability to quickly adapt to shifting priorities, demands and timelines
* Ability to thrive in a challenging, fast-paced environment
* Strong leadership qualities with the capability to manage diverse teams
* Ability to master and navigate new subject domains quickly
* Confident in communicating with C-suites and technical delivery teams
* Experience in Jira and Confluence, Agile and Waterfall
* A background in business analysis would be an advantage.
* The role will be based in the Pune, India office 4 days per week
* A professional qualification in project / program management (e.g., PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2 or MSP) is preferred
* **Candidates based in Pune location is preferred**

**Working environment:**

* 4 days' a week in office.

**Organization Mission and Objectives**

UNFPA is the lead UN agency for delivering a world where every pregnancy is wanted, every childbirth is safe and every young person's potential is fulfilled.

UNFPA’s Strategic Plan 2026–2029 is anchored in the ICPD vision and focuses on four interconnected outcomes: ending unmet need for family planning; ending preventable maternal deaths; ending gender-based violence and harmful practices; and enabling countries to anticipate and respond to demographic change through evidence- and rights-based policies.

UNFPA has been a longstanding partner of the Government of India since 1974. It is currently implementing its 10th Country Programme. The Country Programme leverages large-scale government initiatives to strengthen reproductive health outcomes, advance quality of care and reproductive rights.

The Project Manager will provide management and coordination support for implementation of the donor-supported family planning projects.

The position will facilitate coordination among UNFPA Country Office and State Offices, Government counterparts, implementing partners, technical agencies and other stakeholders. The Project Manager will support planning, implementation, monitoring, budget tracking, reporting, field coordination and documentation of projects’ results and learning.

title: Head of Product Marketing
description:
**About RateGain**

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality, working with 13,000+ customers and 700+ partners across 160+ countries. RateGain helps travel and hospitality businesses accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion.

Today, RateGain is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data, enabling revenue management, distribution, and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, metasearch companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises, and ferries to drive better business outcomes.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, RateGain works with 33 of the Top 40 Hotel Chains, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, 7 of the Top 10 Car Rental companies, and leading Destination Marketing Organizations, Online Travel Agents, and metasearch platforms, including 25 Global Fortune 500 companies, unlocking new revenue every day.

Recognized globally for its innovation and impact, RateGain has been named Best Digital Marketing Agency by HotelTechReport Awards and Best Channel Manager by the World Travel Tech Awards. In 2025, RateGain was honored as Emerging Company of the Year at The Economic Times Awards for Corporate Excellence, named among Deloitte India Technology Fast 50 for the sixth time, and won Excellence in Best AI Solution Showcase for UNO VIVA at the CII National AI Awards 2025.

**The Mission**

RateGain has built a broad portfolio of technology products serving the global travel and hospitality ecosystem. As we continue to scale across businesses, products, customer segments, and geographies, the opportunity now is to bring these capabilities together into a clear, differentiated, and compelling story for the market while ensuring each business and product has the positioning and go-to-market strategy it needs to win.

The Head of Product Marketing will build and lead Product Marketing across RateGain’s global portfolio, defining how customers and the market understand what we build, why it matter, and why RateGain wins.

Sitting at the intersection of Product, Marketing, Sales, Strategy, and the customer, this leader will translate complex technology into compelling customer value, bring customer and competitive insight into Product and commercial decisions, and build a Product Marketing organization that can operate strategically across multiple businesses while staying close to execution.

The mandate is not simply to market a collection of products. It is to shape the story of RateGain as a whole, strengthen the positioning of our businesses and products, and help define the categories and markets in which we choose to lead.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Product Marketing Strategy & Portfolio Positioning

* Define and own the Product Marketing strategy across RateGain’s businesses and product portfolio.
* Build a clear overarching narrative while ensuring each product and business line has differentiated positioning and value propositions.
* Translate complex product capabilities and technical differentiation into clear customer outcomes.
* Develop differentiated messaging across customer segments, use cases, products, markets, and buying audiences.
* Bring customer, market and competitive intelligence into Product and commercial strategy.
* Establish a consistent Product Marketing discipline across the organization, from strategy through execution.

**Portfolio, Market & Category Leadership**

* Develop a deep understanding of the markets, customers and competitive environments across RateGain’s different businesses and product lines.
* Identify the customer problems and market opportunities that matter most across the portfolio.
* Build differentiated positioning against established and emerging competitors.
* Identify opportunities to create and shape new market narratives rather than simply respond to existing categories.
* Ensure RateGain has a compelling and connected story across its broader portfolio while retaining the differentiation of individual products and businesses.

**Product Launch & GTM Excellence**

* Build a scalable and repeatable GTM framework across multiple businesses and product lines.
* Lead the Product Marketing contribution to major product, platform and portfolio launches.
* Drive positioning, messaging, customer and market validation, sales enablement, customer storytelling and advocacy.
* Partner with business and commercial teams to drive product adoption and growth.
* Establish post-launch adoption and lifecycle strategies and continuously improve the GTM playbook based on results.

**Product, Customer & Market Alignment**

* Act as the strategic bridge between what RateGain builds and what customers and markets need.
* Bring an outside-in customer and competitive perspective into Product decisions.
* Partner with Product leadership across businesses to influence roadmap priorities based on customer needs, market opportunity, and competitive dynamics.
* Connect insights across different products and businesses to identify broader portfolio opportunities.
* Strengthen alignment across Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, Strategy and Marketing.

**Product Marketing Organization & Leadership**

* Lead and develop a team of approximately 12 Product Marketing professionals supporting RateGain’s portfolio.
* Define the Product Marketing operating model, priorities, roles, and accountability across businesses.
* Build strong Product Marketing capabilities and develop future leaders.
* Increase Product Marketing's strategic maturity and influence across the organization.
* Build a culture that combines strategic thinking, customer obsession, high standards and a strong bias for execution.

**Functional KPIs**

* Establish a clear Product Marketing strategy and operating model across RateGain’s businesses and product portfolio.
* Sharpen positioning, messaging and value propositions across priority products and markets.
* Build a coherent portfolio narrative while maintaining strong product-level differentiation.
* Establish a scalable product launch and GTM framework across businesses.
* Elevate the quality and consistency of product storytelling across RateGain.
* Strengthen customer, market, and competitive intelligence across Product and commercial decisions.
* Build and develop a high-performing Product Marketing organization.

**Strategic KPIs**

* Increase Product Marketing’s influence on Product and business decisions across RateGain.
* Strengthen competitive positioning across priority businesses, products and markets.
* Establish a compelling and connected narrative across RateGain’s broader portfolio.
* Strengthen alignment between Product, Marketing, Sales and Customer Success across business lines.
* Improve RateGain’s ability to translate technology and product innovation into clear customer value and commercial outcomes.
* Identify opportunities for cross-portfolio positioning, adoption and growth.
* Position Product Marketing as a strategic growth partner to Product and the broader business.

**Key Competencies:**

* Deep expertise across positioning, messaging, value propositions, GTM strategy, launches, and competitive intelligence.
* Ability to operate across multiple products and businesses, creating an overarching narrative without losing individual product differentiation.
* Strong outside-in thinking and the ability to translate customer, market, and competitive insights into Product and business decisions.
* Ability to understand complex B2B technology and translate technical capabilities into compelling customer value.
* Ability to develop differentiated market narratives and shape how markets understand complex products and platforms.
* Strong understanding of how Product Marketing contributes to adoption, competitive wins, and commercial growth.
* Credibility to challenge thinking and influence Product strategy and roadmap priorities across multiple businesses.
* Ability to engage and influence senior Product, Sales, Marketing, and business leadership.
* Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing Product Marketing teams.
* Able to move seamlessly between setting portfolio-level strategy and personally getting involved in positioning, customer conversations, and launch execution.
* Comfortable creating and evolving the playbook in a high-growth, entrepreneurial environment.

**Education & Work Experience**

* 14+ years of experience with significant depth in Product Marketing.
* Experience leading Product Marketing at Director, Senior Director, Head, or equivalent level.
* Strong experience across positioning, messaging, product launches, GTM strategy, competitive intelligence, and sales enablement.
* Demonstrated experience operating across a multi-product or multi-business portfolio.
* Experience translating complex technical capabilities into simple, compelling customer value.
* Experience working directly with senior Product, Sales, and executive leadership.
* Experience operating across multiple customer segments, markets, and geographies.
* Strong people leadership experience, ideally managing teams of 10+.
* Experience in high-growth, entrepreneurial, or transformation environments.
* Experience in global B2B SaaS, technology, data, commerce, platform, or other complex technology ecosystems would be highly relevant.
* Travel and hospitality technology experience would be an advantage.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

title: Human Resource Specialist (Marketing agency)
description:
A
**Marketing agency**
is hiring for the profile of
**Human Resources Specialist.**

**Location:**
Noida

**Experience:**
**3+ years of progressive HR experience, specifically within an advertising, digital**

**marketing, PR, or creative agency environment.**

**Position Summary**

The HR Specialist will lead end-to-end people operations within our fast-paced, deadline-driven

agency environment. In this role, you will act as a strategic partner to creative, account, and technical teams, executing core HR functions with high velocity. The ideal candidate has deep experience navigating the unique dynamics of agency life-balancing rapid talent acquisition, payroll accuracy, compliance, and burnout mitigation to keep our billable teams motivated and high-performing.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. High-Velocity Talent Acquisition & Onboarding**

● Full-Cycle Recruitment: Lead full-cycle hiring for creative, strategy, account management, and

technical roles, ensuring a pipeline of top-tier industry talent.

● Talent Branding: Partner with marketing and hiring managers to enhance candidate pipelines

and optimize the time-to-hire metric.

● Onboarding Integration: Execute an efficient integration framework that accelerates

time-to-productivity for all new hires.

**2. Compensation & Payroll Operations**

● Payroll Lifecycle: Manage and audit monthly payroll inputs (attendance, leaves, overtime,

and performance-based bonuses) to ensure 100% accuracy.

● Benefits Oversight: Manage health, wellness, and statutory benefit programs customized to

support.

**3. Performance & Retention Management**

● Agile Performance Reviews: Facilitate continuous feedback loops and structured appraisal

frameworks aligned with project velocity and KPIs.

● Retention & Burnout Mitigation: Proactively identify signs of burnout and implement

targeted wellness initiatives to maintain high morale and reduce turnover.

● Career Mapping: Map clear growth trajectories for creative and account teams to foster

long-term internal growth.

**4. Compliance & Employee Relations**

● Labor Law Compliance: Ensure strict adherence to local labor laws and corporate

governance.

● Conflict Resolution: Serve as an objective mediator for workplace grievances, managing

employee relations fairly and confidentially.

● Policy Governance: Update and enforce agency-specific guidelines (e.g., client confidentiality,

intellectual property, remote work rules).

**5. HRIS & People Analytics**

● Data Integrity: Maintain accurate real-time records in the HRIS, ensuring data security and

confidentiality.

● Metrics & Reporting: Generate weekly/monthly metrics on headcount utilization,

recruitment velocity, and attrition trends to help leadership make data-driven decisions.

**Core Competencies & Qualifications**

1. Experience: 3+ years of progressive HR experience, specifically within an advertising, digital

marketing, PR, or creative agency environment.

2. Industry Knowledge: Deep understanding of agency structures, client-servicing dynamics,

and billable vs. non-billable time metrics.

3. Technical Proficiency: Strong hands-on knowledge of HRIS and ATS (Applicant Tracking

Systems) platforms.

4. Traits: Exceptionally organized, emotionally intelligent, resilient under pressure, and highly

skilled at communicating with diverse, creative personalities.

title: Team Lead, Trust & Safety Ops (Bangalore)
description:
**About MoonPay**
MoonPay is for builders with something to prove.
  
  
This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 30M+ customers and 500+ ecosystem partners run on us. Licensed in the U.S. Regulated across the UK, EU, Canada, and Australia.
  
  
AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.
  
  
You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.
  
  
The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building for what's next, for humans and agents.
  
  
**Recent recognition:**
Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 .
  
  
2nd in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100
  
  
The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running
  
  
**Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot.**
**Locations Supported 🌍**

* India (Bangalore) - EU hour coverage

**Relocation available:**
No
  
  
**Work pattern:**

* This role is remote until we have an office set up in Bengaluru. This role requires weekend and shift work, depending on business needs.

**About The Opportunity**
We’re looking for a Team Lead, Trust & Safety Operations to lead MoonPay’s Bangalore-based Trust & Safety Ops analyst team across Fraud Operations and Disputes / Chargebacks workflows.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for leading a team of Trust & Safety Analysts, ensuring operational excellence across fraud alerts, transaction monitoring, manual reviews, disputes handling, chargebacks, and escalations. You will own team performance, coaching, process maturity, operational execution, and continuous improvement - while partnering closely with the Quality Analyst to improve decision quality, consistency, and standards across the team.
  
  
Your work will directly impact fraud prevention, chargeback rates, customer experience, operational quality, SLA performance, and the scalability of MoonPay’s Trust & Safety function.
  
  
This is a great opportunity for someone who is not only strong at running high-performing BAU operations, but who also brings structure, urgency, curiosity, and strategic thinking. We’re looking for someone who proactively identifies problems, brings solutions, uses data to drive improvements, and is comfortable leveraging AI and automation tools to make operations smarter, faster, and more effective.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Lead and coach a team of Trust & Safety Analysts across Fraud Operations and Disputes workflows.
* Own daily operational performance across fraud alerts, transaction monitoring, manual reviews, disputes, escalations, productivity, quality, and SLA adherence.
* Act as the senior operational escalation point for complex cases, ensuring decisions are timely, consistent, and risk-based.
* Drive high standards of communication, structure, and follow-through across the team, ensuring priorities, risks, escalations, and decisions are clearly documented and communicated.
* Partner closely with the L2 Analysts to improve decision quality, run calibration sessions, identify knowledge gaps, and ensure analysts are aligned with internal policies, risk frameworks, and card network rules.
* Use QA insights, operational data, case trends, and analyst performance data to coach the team, improve playbooks, and strengthen decision-making across fraud and disputes workflows.
* Identify fraud and chargeback trends, operational bottlenecks, control gaps, and emerging risks, then turn these insights into clear action plans and measurable improvements.
* Lead strategic initiatives across Trust & Safety Ops, including process redesign, workflow optimisation, playbook development, tooling improvements, automation opportunities, and AI-enabled operational enhancements.
* Collaborate with other teams to improve fraud controls, dispute outcomes, customer experience, and operational scalability.
* Create a high-accountability team culture where ownership, responsiveness, operational discipline, and proactive problem-solving are the standard.

**About You**
**Must-have experience and skills**

description:
Job Description: Program Manager

**Company:** Vihat Creation  
**Industry:** Advertising, Brand Activation & Event Management  
**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
**Experience:** 4–7 years (preferred)  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

About Vihat Creation

Vihat Creation is a full-scale advertising, brand activation, and event management agency established in 2015. With a team of 25+ professionals and over 300 projects delivered across India, we specialize in creating impactful campaigns through strategic planning, creative execution, and on-ground implementation.

Our services include roadshows, mobile van campaigns, product sampling, retail and in-shop activities, dealer and retailer branding, outdoor advertising, product launches, corporate events, and promotional activations.

Job Purpose

The Program Manager will be responsible for planning, coordinating, executing, and monitoring multiple advertising, branding, activation, and event campaigns. The role requires strong project management skills, client coordination, team leadership, budget control, and the ability to ensure timely, high-quality execution across multiple locations.

Key Responsibilities1. Program Planning & Execution

* Plan and manage end-to-end execution of brand activation campaigns, roadshows, mobile van activities, sampling programs, retail branding, dealer boards, retailer boards, and events.
* Develop project timelines, execution plans, resource requirements, and delivery schedules.
* Coordinate multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring timely completion and quality standards.
* Ensure all campaign activities are executed according to approved client briefs and brand guidelines.

2. Client Management

* Act as the primary coordination point between clients and internal teams.
* Understand client requirements and translate them into actionable execution plans.
* Share project updates, progress reports, photographs, and execution feedback with clients.
* Handle client concerns, resolve operational issues, and maintain strong professional relationships.

3. Team & Vendor Management

* Coordinate with field teams, supervisors, promoters, production teams, logistics partners, fabricators, printers, and event vendors.
* Allocate responsibilities and monitor team performance across project locations.
* Ensure materials, vehicles, branding assets, manpower, and equipment are available on time.
* Conduct team briefings and provide clear execution instructions.

4. Budgeting & Cost Control

* Prepare project budgets, cost estimates, and resource plans.
* Monitor actual expenses against approved budgets.
* Negotiate with vendors and suppliers to maintain cost efficiency without compromising quality.
* Track purchase orders, vendor bills, team expenses, travel costs, and other project-related expenditures.
* Ensure timely submission of expense statements and project cost reports.

5. On-Ground Monitoring & Quality Control

* Monitor campaign execution through field visits, supervisor reports, photographs, videos, and digital tracking tools.
* Ensure branding materials and installations meet approved specifications.
* Verify attendance, product sampling, stock movement, sales data, and daily activity reports wherever applicable.
* Identify execution gaps and take immediate corrective action.

6. MIS & Reporting

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly program status reports.
* Maintain project trackers for timelines, budgets, manpower, materials, stock, sales, sampling, and campaign performance.
* Prepare campaign closure reports with photographs, key metrics, expenditure summaries, and client feedback.
* Maintain accurate documentation for internal reviews and client presentations.

7. Business Coordination & Growth

* Identify opportunities to improve campaign efficiency and service quality.
* Support the business development team with proposals, execution plans, costing, and presentations.
* Build long-term relationships with clients, vendors, and execution partners.
* Recommend innovative activation ideas and operational improvements.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Graduate in Business Administration, Marketing, Event Management, or a related field.
* 2–3 years of relevant experience in advertising, BTL marketing, brand activation, events, retail execution, or project management.

title: Project Architect
description:
**Role Summary:**

The Project Architec & Planning Engineer is responsible for preparing, monitoring, and controlling project schedules to ensure timely execution of construction activities. The role involves project planning, resource scheduling, progress monitoring, delay analysis, reporting, and coordination with internal teams, consultants, contractors, and clients to achieve project objectives within the approved timelines and budgets.

**Responsibilities:**

**Project Planning & Scheduling:**

Prepare detailed project schedules using Primavera P6 and/or Microsoft Project. Develop baseline programmes, work breakdown structures (WBS), milestones, and activity sequencing.

Prepare master schedules, look-ahead schedules, recovery plans, and catch-up programmes.

Coordinate with project teams during project planning and mobilization.

**Project Monitoring & Control:**

Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly project progress against approved schedules.

Track critical activities and identify potential delays and schedule risks.

Analyze project performance using planned vs. actual progress.

Recommend corrective and preventive actions to maintain project timelines.

**Resource Planning:**

Prepare manpower, equipment, and material deployment schedules.

Coordinate with procurement and site teams to ensure timely resource availability.

Monitor resource utilization and productivity.

**Progress Reporting:**

Prepare weekly and monthly progress reports for management and clients.

Develop project dashboards, S-curves, histograms, and KPI reports.

Present schedule updates during project review meetings.

Maintain project planning documentation and records.

**Cost & Time Control:**

Support project cost monitoring by integrating schedule and cost information.

Assist in tracking project budgets against work progress.

Monitor earned value indicators where applicable.

Support preparation of cash flow forecasts linked to project schedules.

**Risk & Delay Analysis :**

Identify scheduling risks and recommend mitigation strategies.

Perform delay analysis and impact assessments.

Assist in extension of time (EOT) claims and supporting documentation.

Maintain risk registers related to project schedules.

**Coordination & Communication**

Coordinate with architects, consultants, contractors, vendors, procurement, and project teams.

Participate in project coordination meetings.

Ensure planning information is communicated accurately across stakeholders.

Support management in decision-making through timely project insights.

**Documentation & Compliance :**

Maintain all planning documents, revisions, and project records.

Ensure compliance with contractual planning requirements.

Follow company project management procedures and reporting standards.

Support quality, safety, and regulatory compliance initiatives.

**Skills:**

▪ High level of ownership and accountability

▪ Team player with the ability to work across multidisciplinary teams.

▪ Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities.

▪ Excellent problem-solving and risk assessment skills.

▪ Excellent verbal and written communication skill

▪ Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills

**Qualification & Experience Experience:**

2–3 years of experience in construction, infrastructure, or real estate project planning. Experience in high-rise buildings, commercial developments, mixed-use projects, or residential developments is preferred.

**Technical Knowledge: Proficiency in Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, and advanced Microsoft Excel.**

**Education:** Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering. Certification in Primavera P6 is preferred. PMP or Project Management certification will be an added advantage.

Pay: ₹18,000.00 - ₹69,000.00 per month

description:

**Role Overview**
Within the State Pod, you will be the analytical brain driving regional user acquisition and business efficiency. You will analyze funnel metrics, identify drop-offs, and run rapid growth experiments across user acquisition, retention, supply availability, and category levers

* Data-Driven Diagnostics: Deep-dive into acquisition channels, retention cohorts, conversion funnels, supply metrics, and category performance to pinpoint regional growth opportunities and bottlenecks.

* Cross-Functional Execution: Work closely with central product, performance marketing, category, and supply chain teams to land region-specific growth initiatives.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* Experience: 2–4 years of experience in data-driven growth, performance marketing, product analytics, or management consulting.
* Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving abilities with high proficiency in cohort analysis, funnel optimization, and data slicing.
* Execution & Velocity: Proven ability to build hypotheses, run rapid experiments, and iterate based on real-time feedback and metrics.
* Education & Context: Strong academic background from a recognized institute; familiarity with regional market dynamics is preferred.
* Key Skills: Cohort Analysis, Funnel Optimization, A/B Testing, Data Slicing, Cross-Functional Execution.

Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.
  
  
Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.
  
  
What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.
  
  
In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.

title: Scrum Master
description:
* Full-time

**Company Description**
-----------------------

Technology is our how. And people are our why. For over two decades, we have been harnessing technology to drive meaningful change.  
  
By combining world-class engineering, industry expertise and a people-centric mindset, we consult and partner with leading brands from various industries to create dynamic platforms and intelligent digital experiences that drive innovation and transform businesses.  
  
From prototype to real-world impact - be part of a global shift by doing work that matters.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Role Summary**

Scrum Masters enable the implementation of scrum framework and its principles, values, and practices within a squad. The role acts as a servant leader who helps their teams to deliver value incrementally in a collaborative manner. They are aligned to one or two squads.

**Core Duties/Responsibilities**

The successful candidate will be responsible for the following:

* Acts as a servant leader by serving the needs of the Scrum Team, removing obstacles, and empowering team members to take ownership of their work.
* Promotes continuous improvement by facilitating Sprint Retrospectives, identifying opportunities, and implementing action plans.
* Encourages reflection on processes and supports incremental changes.
* Continuously develops personal knowledge and skills by engaging with Scrum communities, attending training, obtaining certifications, and seeking feedback.
* Coaches the Scrum Team on Scrum practices, principles, and values, fostering self-organization and continuous improvement.
* Facilitates collaboration and communication within the team and with stakeholders, promoting transparency and a culture of openness and trust.
* Encourages cross-functional collaboration between Development Teams and other groups.
* Supports the Product Owner in managing the Product Backlog, refining User Stories, and prioritizing work to maximize value.
* Supports up to one Squad by facilitating group activities or workshops in complex and ambiguous situations with competing stakeholder needs.
* Designs structured sequences of meetings, events, or workshops to solve complex problems.
* Understands required outcomes and guides the team to deliver them.
* Facilitates all Scrum events—Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives—ensuring they are effective, focused, and time-boxed.
* Removes impediments by identifying blockers, collaborating with stakeholders, and resolving issues proactively. Protects the team from external distractions during the Sprint.
* Helps improve team processes and performance in meetings, events, or workshops.
* Ensures Scrum artifacts such as the Product Backlog, Sprint Backlog, and Burndown Charts are transparent and up-to-date by working closely with the Product Owner and Development Team.
* Provides key metrics to senior stakeholders to maintain visibility into progress and priorities.

The duties and responsibilities outlined above are to be regarded as broad areas of responsibility and do not necessarily detail all tasks which the post holder may be required to perform.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Skills, Capabilities and Attributes**

The ideal candidate will have the below skills, capabilities and attributes essential or preferred.

* Azure DevOps
* Jira
* Agile Methodologies - Scrum/Kanban
* Awareness of Scaling
* Leading, educating, and coaching
* Efficiency improvement
* Documentation
* Lifecycle management
* Problem solving

**Measures of success**

* Improves team flow and delivery predictability through effective Scrum facilitation and coaching practices.
* Drives continuous improvement through retrospectives, actionable insights and measurable team outcomes.
* Removes impediments quickly while protecting team focus and enabling consistent Sprint delivery.
* Strengthens collaboration, transparency and trust across teams and stakeholders consistently.
* Ensures Scrum artefacts are accurate, visible and support informed decision-making effectively.
* Supports Product Owner to refine backlog, improving clarity, prioritisation and delivery value.

title: Principal Consultant
description:
**Opportunity Overview:**  
  
As a Principal Consultant (Delivery Enterprise Architect) within the Dell organization, aligned to Consulting Service Delivery, you will provide consultative business and technical delivery services for a range of complex customer-facing consulting engagements, in partnership with Global Pre-Sales, Account Management and Solutioning Teams. Specifically, you will be part of projects deploying, administering and configurating Large Language Model and Generative AI software stacks. These projects will focus on allowing Dell customers to deploy and fine-tune GenAI models.  
  
Also, as the senior-most technical member of the Services Delivery team, for the GenAI/Data Science Practice, you will work alongside other Dell badged Consultants, to earn the customers trust through competence, technical acumen, consulting expertise, and partnership. You would also be responsible for providing guidance/oversight to these individuals and technical grooming activities for their skill upgrading. This position requires a dynamic individual with expert customer-facing skills, leadership qualities and forecasting abilities for a particular technology and its lifecycle. The ability to guide customers and communicate technical processes and ideas is essential. These engagements often ensure that the customer is also enabled in the technologies being delivered.  
  
The person should have the common traits and capabilities that are listed in Section 2 (Essential Requirements) and meet many of the capabilities listed in Section 3 (Desirable Requirements).  
  
**Key Requirements:**  
  
**Experience and qualifications:**  
  

* 18+ years in the IT industry, preferably with a masters degree in Data Science, Machine Learning, or a related field.
* 8+ years in Artificial Intelligence and Big Data within a customer-facing services delivery role, including the ability to engage Data Scientists and assess their current and future ecosystems.
* 5+ years implementing and supporting infrastructure deployment, setup, and configuration through automation (agentic automation a strong plus).

  
**Generative & Agentic AI:**  
  

* Deep, hands-on knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) and the broader Generative AI tooling ecosystem.
* Proven experience designing agentic AI solutions and agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, CrewAI, Langfuse, and LangSmith.
* Familiarity with the NVIDIA AI software suite, including NVIDIA Base Command Manager (formerly Bright Cluster Manager), the NeMo framework, and Triton Inference Server.

  
**MLOps & AIOps Platforms:**  
  

* Deep understanding of the MLOps and AIOps ecosystem, with hands-on experience across platforms such as Kubeflow, MLflow, Run:ai, ClearML, Ray, H2O, and Cohere.

  
**Data Engineering & Distributed Systems:**  
  

* Extensive production experience with distributed query and processing engines Kafka, Trino (Starburst) and Apache Spark.
* Hands-on experience with modern table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi) for managing large-scale datasets.
* Mastery of cloud-native storage and compute e.g., AWS S3/EMR, GCP BigQuery/Dataproc, or Azure ADLS/Databricks.
* Deep understanding of columnar storage formats (Parquet, Avro) and how to optimize them for different query patterns.

  
**DevOps, IaC & CI/CD:**  
  

* Proven application of DevOps and Infrastructure-as-Code practices across both application development and infrastructure automation including desired-state configuration, GitOps, and CI/CD pipeline design.
* Extensive experience with CI/CD tooling such as GitLab, Argo CD, and Tekton.

  
**Kubernetes & Containers:**  
  

* Proven experience deploying and configuring Kubernetes (e.g., OpenShift), with deep knowledge of application deployments, Helm charts, and Kubernetes operators.
* Extensive experience building containerized applications, including container image signing.
* Knowledge of AI-related Kubernetes operators, such as the NVIDIA GPU, Network, and Storage operators.

  
**Consulting & Delivery Skills:**  
  

* Ability to earn customer trust and to plan, organize, and lead customer workshops; excellent written and spoken English is essential.
* Comfortable working in efficient Agile teams (Scrum or Kanban), including extended pairing and enablement sessions that drive knowledge transfer in complex domains.
* Ability to influence and interact with confidence and credibility at all levels within Dell and across customers, partners, and vendors.
* Experience delivering within a defined project methodology while adhering to SOW, margin, and planning requirements.
* Willingness and ability to be onsite for customer workshops and enablement sessions.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

Can operate independently or with minimum supervision.

  

**What we offer you**

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

title: Senior Scrum Master
description:
**Company Overview**
Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
We are seeking a strong Sr. Scrum Master who can help with an organizations SAFe Agile Transformation, supporting global technology and business teams. As an Sr. Scrum Master, you will play a critical role in driving the adoption and implementation of SAFe Agile methodologies across the organization. You will work closely with teams and stakeholders to foster a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, and high performance. Your expertise will help us accelerate our product development cycles, improve quality, and deliver innovative solutions.
  
  
The ideal candidate will be responsible for Product Team motivation and innovation. Must have the ability and experience to push, drive, and motivate the product teams for completing all work according to the business value. Must continuously be two steps ahead of the team, and stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Scrum Facilitation:**

* Guide and coach multiple Scrum teams on the adoption and implementation of Agile/Scrum practices.
* Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Ensure that Scrum practices are followed, and team members understand and adhere to Agile principles.

**Team Support And Development**

* Serve as a mentor and coach to Scrum Masters, Product Owners, and team members.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, encouraging teams to experiment, learn, and adapt their processes.
* Support the development of team members by providing feedback, identifying growth opportunities, and promoting professional development.

**Impediment Removal**

* Identify and address any impediments that may hinder the team's progress.
* Collaborate with team members and stakeholders to remove obstacles and ensure smooth project execution.
* Escalate issues when necessary to ensure timely resolution.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Work closely with Product Owners and other stakeholders to ensure alignment on project goals, priorities, and deliverables.
* Facilitate effective communication between the development team and stakeholders.
* Assist in the development and management of product backlogs, ensuring they are well-groomed and prioritized.

**Process Improvement**

* Identify and remove impediments that hinder Agile adoption and team productivity.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement by encouraging teams to experiment, learn, and adapt their processes.
* Ensure teams maintain compliance with pharma regulatory requirements, including GxPwhere applicable.

**Metrics And Reporting**

* Track and analyze key performance metrics to assess team performance and identify areas for improvement.
* Provide regular reports on team progress, sprint outcomes, and overall project status to stakeholders.
* Utilize data-driven insights to recommend and implement process improvements.

**Agile Advocacy**

* Promote Agile principles and practices across the organization.
* Lead training sessions and workshops to educate teams and stakeholders on Agile methodologies.
* Stay up to date with industry trends and emerging Agile practices and introduce new ideas to the organization.

**Ceremonies/Events**

* Daily Stand-up
* Backlog Refinement (Grooming)
* Sprint Planning
* Sprint Retrospectives
* Demo's
* UAT's

**Tools**

* Jira / Jira Align
* Smartsheet
* Confluence
* MS Office 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams)
* OneNote
* WebEx
* Miro

**Qualifications**

* 8-12 years of experience working with Agile methodologies, including Scrum, Kanban, and SAFe.
* Demonstrated success as a Scrum Master for newly forming teams, guiding them from startup to maturity.
* Experience working in large-scale organizations with global, multi-geographic team structures.
* Proficiency in Agile collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or Rally.
* Advanced communication and facilitation skills with ability to influence and collaborate across organizational levels.
* Proven ability to manage cross-functional dependencies and navigate complex stakeholder landscapes.
* Pharma or life sciences experience preferred, particularly in regulated environments (e.g., GxP).
* PI Planning (Quarterly Planning) experience required.
* Agile certifications such as SAFe Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or equivalent certification are required.
* Familiarity with pharma-specific projects and product delivery lifecycles.

**Compensation**
Estimated Pay Range:
  
  
Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.
  
  
****Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion****
At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.
  
  
Milestone Technologies provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law, or local ordinance. Milestone also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled applicants and employees.
  
  
We welcome the unique background, culture, experiences, knowledge, innovation, self-expression and perspectives you can bring to our global community. Our recruitment team is looking forward to meeting you.
  
  
  
**\*\*\*Notice to Job Seekers Regarding Impersonation and Fraudulent Job Offers\*\*\***
It has come to our attention that unauthorized individuals and entities are impersonating Milestone Technologies, Inc. on various job boards/portals,
**specifically Naukri.com and Linkedin.com**
**Please be advised of the following official Milestone Technologies recruitment policies:**
**Official Communication Channels**
All legitimate email communications from our recruitment team will originate ONLY from the domains:
**@milestone.tech.**
We do not use generic email services (e.g. @gmail.com, @yahoo.com, @outlook.com) or unofficial third party messaging apps to conduct formal business.
  
  
**No Recruitment Fees**
Milestone Technologies never requests any form of payment, "security deposit", "laptop/equipment fee", or "processing fee" at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any request for money in exchange for an interview or job offer is a scam.
