title: Senior Specialist, Data Analysis
description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Specialist, Data Analysis**
**The Opportunity**
Join a global biopharma company with a 130-year legacy and mission to achieve new milestones in healthcare. Be part of a technology-driven, data-led organization supporting a diversified portfolio of medicines, vaccines, and animal health products. Work alongside passionate teams that use data, analytics, and insights to drive decisions and tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats.
  
  
Our Technology Centers are globally distributed hubs that enable our digital transformation and business outcomes across IT. They bring together diverse teams to collaborate, share best practices, and deliver solutions that save and improve lives.
  
  
This role is based at our Hyderabad Tech Center and follows a hybrid working model (3 days onsite, 2 days remote). Candidates are expected to reside within commuting distance of the Hyderabad office.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for Senior Specialist with strong Functional analysis, data analysis, functional testing, UAT coordination, stakeholder communication, and Scrum Master responsibilities for one or two squads. Understand business data needs and perform descriptive and investigative analysis across relevant solution-delivery phases. Query, explore, and validate data to identify patterns, anomalies, quality issues, business rules, and functional impacts. Work with Value Team Business Analysts and Product Managers to translate business needs into functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and validation requirements. Support functional testing and UAT to confirm delivered solutions and data outputs meet agreed business requirements. Serve as Scrum Master for one or two squads by enabling Agile ceremonies, backlog readiness, impediment removal, transparency, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**What Will You Do In This Role**

* Analyze and validate data from relevant databases and sources to identify trends, anomalies, data-quality issues, and business impacts.
* Write SQL queries for data extraction, validation, reconciliation, defect analysis, functional testing, and root-cause assessment.
* Triage data questions, defects, and functional issues; communicate findings clearly and coordinate with teams through resolution.
* Partner with Value Team Business Analysts and Product Managers to clarify business processes, requirements, and expected outcomes.
* Convert requirements into functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, business rules, test scenarios, and traceability artifacts.
* Ensure functional specifications are complete, testable, aligned to business priorities, and ready for squad implementation.
* Define and execute functional test scenarios using data analysis and SQL where appropriate.
* Coordinate functional testing across business, QA, and technology teams, including test-data readiness, execution tracking, defect clarification, and retesting.
* Support UAT planning, business-user coordination, execution guidance, defect management, evidence collection, and business sign-off.
* Validate delivered functionality and data outputs for quality, timeliness, compliance, and user experience.
* Act as Scrum Master for one or two squads; facilitate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Work with Product Owners and Product Managers to maintain a prioritized, ready backlog with clear acceptance criteria.
* Help squads remove impediments, manage dependencies, maintain delivery transparency, and achieve sprint goals.
* Track sprint progress, risks, actions, dependencies, and improvement commitments; provide concise updates to stakeholders.
* Build trusted stakeholder relationships and collaborate effectively across global teams and matrix organizations.

**What Should You Have**

* 8+ years of experience
* Data analysis and investigative problem solving
* SQL query writing for extraction, validation, reconciliation, testing, and root-cause analysis
* Data validation, reconciliation, and data-quality assessment
* Functional analysis and functional specification writing
* User story, acceptance criteria, business rule, and process-flow definition
* Functional testing and requirement-to-test traceability
* UAT planning, coordination, defect clarification, retesting, evidence collection, and sign-off support
* Scrum Mastery and Agile ceremony facilitation
* Backlog readiness, dependency tracking, impediment removal, and delivery transparency
* Stakeholder relationship management across business, product, QA, and technology teams
* Clear written and verbal communication for technical and non-technical audiences
* Global matrix collaboration and influencing without direct authority
* SQL and relational databases
* Data-analysis and data-validation techniques
* Agile work-management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Rally, or equivalent
* Testing, defect-management, and UAT coordination practices
* Demonstrated experience in data analysis, data validation, and issue investigation using SQL.
* Experience partnering with Business Analysts and Product Managers to create functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Hands-on experience with functional testing and UAT support or coordination, including defects, retesting, and sign-off readiness.
* Experience performing Scrum Master responsibilities for one or more Agile squads.
* Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, and written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams in a matrix organization.
* Scrum Master certification such as CSM, PSM, SAFe Scrum Master, or equivalent is preferred.

**Primary Skills**
Scrum Master, Functional analysis, data analysis, functional testing, UAT coordination, SQL
  
  
**Secondary Skills**
Data analyst
  
  
**Who We Are**
We are known as well-known org Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
  
  
**What We Look For**
Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.
  
  
**Additional location(s) Compensation Information**
**Required Skills**
Data Analysis, Functional Analysis, Functional Testing, Scrum, Structured Query Language (SQL), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), User Acceptance Testing Support
  
  
**Preferred Skills**
Data Analytics

title: Engineering Manager IT
description:
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Manager, IT Delivery role manages and leads a team of technical support staff who design, develop, test, implement, and monitor software and tools; works with business leaders to define scope and requirements, and plans and executes the development of various systems; and acts as liaison with business sponsors and principals, while leading cross-functional teams, managing project risks and resources, and integrating cybersecurity best practices to ensure secure and successful project delivery.
  
  
**Responsibilites**

* Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures.
* Responsible for delivering software releases relating to the product for the business units. Works with business clients to determine scope, and develops environmental requirements for each project.
* Works closely with management to develop and implement staffing and operational plans. Participates in the development of short and long term department goals. Monitors and reports on service delivery metrics and overall performance.
* Develops and implements changes to department policies and procedures to meet changing business needs and to achieve department objectives. Identifies opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Leads quality initiatives to improve the delivery of service levels. Works with senior management in the planning, development, and execution of short and long range goals.
* Presents status, metrics, and department initiatives at meetings with management and project peers. Maintains relationships with technical teams, IT, and business partners.
* Participates in the development of the department budget. Reviews expenses and ensures department operates within budgetary guidelines.
* Ensures staff complies with information technology and information security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Lead cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration and effectively communicating project progress and updates to stakeholders.
* Identify potential risks throughout the project lifecycle and implement strategies to mitigate them, ensuring smooth project delivery.
* Develop comprehensive project plans, set timelines, allocate resources efficiently, and manage budgets to ensure successful project delivery.
* Enhance cybersecurity frameworks by integrating advanced security measures and best practices into IT projects to safeguard company data and assets.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Minimum 8 years of experience in IT project management, software development, or IT service delivery. Previous leadership experience required.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. PMP, ITIL, or Agile certifications preferred.
* Strong expertise in IT project management, Agile methodologies, and SDLC best practices with experience in IT infrastructure, software development, and enterprise IT solutions.
* Must have skills: Node.js, TypeScript, ECS, Kubernetes,Kore.AI, Android, iOS development
* Proficiency in risk management, budgeting, and IT governance. Understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and IT compliance standards.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
**Benefits**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

description:

title: Associate Engineering Director
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

As an Associate Engineering Director at Medtronic, you will be a second-line leader accountable for a software organization spanning multiple teams and product areas. You will lead through both engineers and other managers, owning the health, capability, and delivery performance of your organization. Where an Engineering Manager drives a team, you will shape the technical and organizational strategy across teams, build the leadership bench beneath you, and serve as a primary partner to R&D, Quality, Regulatory, and Program Management leadership on multi-year roadmap.  

**A Day in the Life**

As an Associate Engineering Director at Medtronic, you will be a second-line leader accountable for a software organization spanning multiple teams and product areas. You will lead through both engineers and other managers, owning the health, capability, and delivery performance of your organization. Where an Engineering Manager drives a team, you will shape the technical and organizational strategy across teams, build the leadership bench beneath you, and serve as a primary partner to R&D, Quality, Regulatory, and Program Management leadership on multi-year roadmap.

  

**You Will:**

· Lead a multi-team software organization (typically 40+ engineers) designing and developing software applications for medical devices across web, mobile, desktop, and cloud.

· Manage, coach, and develop Engineering Managers and senior technical leads; build succession plans and a strong leadership pipeline within your organization.

· Own end-to-end delivery across your operating unit: capacity and resource planning, multi-project prioritization, dependency management, risk escalation, and executive-level reporting on commitments and metrics.

· Set technical direction and architectural standards in partnership with Principal Engineers and Architects; make and defend build/buy/platform decisions.

· Partner with the broader R&D organization (Quality, Systems, Regulatory, Clinical) and with global sites to align on design controls, V&V strategy, and submission readiness.

· Define and institutionalize sustainable product development processes; drive continuous improvement in engineering practices, quality, and cycle time across teams, not just within one team.

· Own hiring strategy, workforce planning, vendor/partner engagement, and budget inputs for your organization.

· Represent the software organization to OU and site leadership, and in design reviews, phase gates, and audits.

· Remove systemic barriers, resolve cross-team conflicts, and create the conditions for teams to deliver predictably.

· Champion a culture of engineering excellence, psychological safety, patient safety, and compliance.

  

Engineers create our market-leading portfolio of innovations. Combine the best of your experience with training and mentorship to move your career forward. If you want a challenging, energizing, rewarding career that changes lives, join us. Help us bring the next generation of life-changing medical technology to patients worldwide.

If you are a pioneer and would like to have a big impact into the new world of medical robotics – then come join our team!

  

**Must Have: Minimum Requirements**

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum of 18+ years of applicable work experience in a SW product development & Global team environment.
* Minimum 8+ years of people-management experience, including 2+ years leading multiple teams simultaneously.
* Deep understanding of enterprise application full stack development (desktop, mobile, cloud) and V&V strategy, including automated verification.
* Experience in developing and maintaining a deep technical understanding of product lines and technologies.
* Experience in developing departmental budget and manages expenses in line with organizational objectives; approves departmental expenditures including capital and manpower expense.
* Excellent Technology management, project management skills; demonstrated success executing complex engineering projects with diverse technical teams.
* Proven ability to lead programs within a global matrix structure, including influencing peers and leaders without direct authority.
* Demonstrated ability to blend organizational leadership with credible technical depth — able to set strategy and to engage substantively in architecture and design decisions.
* Track record of developing engineers with measurable outcomes in retention, promotion, and capability growth.
* Excellent communication skills, including the ability to present status, risk, and strategy to senior leadership.
* Good financial acumen; strong mathematical and financial capabilities.
* Must have leadership skills and personal strength to protect projects from unsubstantial change requests while ensuring project focus remains in place.

title: AI Product Builder
description:
Location: Andheri, Mumbai
  
  
**About BOMBAYDC**
BOMBAYDC is a strategic digital platform firm helping enterprises build intelligent digital platforms that increase adoption, retention and revenue.
  
  
We work at the intersection of strategy, product, design, technology and AI to turn complex business problems into products people actually use.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We're looking for an AI Product Builder who can take a product from client requirement to working prototype.
  
  
This is not a traditional Product Manager, Designer or Developer role. You’ll operate across all three — understanding the problem, defining the product, designing the experience and using AI-native tools to rapidly build and prototype the solution.
  
  
You should be comfortable taking an idea from “Here’s the problem” → “Here’s what we should build” → “Here’s the working prototype.”
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Understand client requirements, business goals and user problems
* Translate ambiguous requirements into clear product concepts and user flows
* Define product scope, features and MVPs
* Design intuitive UX/UI and product experiences
* Use AI and no/low-code tools to rapidly build functional prototypes
* Work with engineers and designers to take concepts further
* Manage the project end-to-end — from discovery to prototype delivery
* Present ideas and prototypes to clients and incorporate feedback quickly
* Make smart trade-offs between user experience, business requirements and technical feasibility
* Use AI tools extensively across research, ideation, design, development and documentation

**You'll Probably Enjoy This Role If You Have**

* Strong product thinking with good UX/UI fundamentals
* Experience taking products from problem definition to prototype
* A builder mindset — you like making things, not just documenting them
* Comfort working directly with clients and senior stakeholders
* Ability to independently manage projects and coordinate designers and developers
* Strong understanding of modern AI tools and AI-native product development
* Ability to quickly learn new tools and technologies
* Strong communication, ownership and execution skills
* Curiosity about how AI is changing the way products are built

Experience across B2B SaaS, Banking, FinTech, Enterprise Platforms, Commerce or AI products is valuable.
  
  
**Success In This Role**
Within 3–6 months, you should be able to independently take a client problem, define the right product direction and deliver a high-quality working prototype.
  
  
Over time, we expect you to become someone who can own entire product initiatives — from client conversation to shipped experience.
  
  
**What You'll Get**

* Opportunity to work on complex enterprise products
* Direct exposure to clients, founders and senior leadership
* Freedom to experiment with AI-native tools and workflows
* Ownership from problem definition to product delivery
* One remote working day every week
* Extended year-end winter break of 7 days
* Clear growth opportunities as the company scales

**Our Culture**
We're a fairly ambitious company and we care deeply about the quality of our work.
  
  
We don't believe in working long hours for the sake of it, but we do believe in ownership and doing what's required to deliver great outcomes.
  
  
People here get a lot of responsibility very early. We value curiosity, independent thinking, attention to detail and a desire to continuously improve.
  
  
We're not a highly process-heavy or layered organization.
  
  
We expect people to ask good questions, challenge assumptions and keep raising the bar for themselves and the team.
  
  
We welcome people who are excited about building for the new world with AI. We move very fast. You should too.
  
  
If you enjoy moving between product, design, technology, AI and client conversations — and want to build real products rather than just manage them — you'll probably enjoy this role.
  
  
Apply through LinkedIn or drop an email to work@bombaydc.com with your resume and portfolio.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Let’s be real: waiting for a health crisis to start taking care of your body is officially out. Proactive, specialist-led care is the new flex.
  
  
Welcome to
**MetaGO**
, where we are totally flipping the script on metabolic health and obesity in India. Kyunki scene ye hai, we want to change
**when India treats these issues, not just how**
.
  
  
Built by the OGs
**Varun Sheth, Zaheer Adenwala, and Kunal Kapoor**
—the same trio that scaled Ketto into a massive firm—MetaGO is rooted in one unapologetic truth:
**nobody should have to fight their biology alone**
.
  
  
Type 2 diabetes and heart disease do not just pop up overnight. They ghost you for years before turning into a full-blown crisis. We are here to intercept them in the talking stage, way before things get messy.
  
  
The Playbook
  
  
Faltu ka gyan nahi, just pure science.
  
  
Every MetaGO journey kicks off with a massive
**35+ biomarker deep dive**
. From there, we bring in the heavy hitters—endocrinologists, cardiologists, and internal medicine experts—to craft a highly personalized roadmap.
  
  
Throw in
**GLP-1 therapies when clinically appropriate**
, killer fitness coaching, and track it all seamlessly on the
**MetaGO app**
. With absolute legends like
**Dr. Kaushal Patel**
leading our medical board, apna health scene poora sorted hai.
  
  
The Growth & Product Team
  
  
**Where the GO of MetaGO happens!**
This is the engine room. Yahan sirf hustle aur main character energy chalti hai. Everything a member, doctor, coach, or ops teammate touches is cooked up and owned right here.
  
  
You are not just shipping minor updates; you are building the entire ecosystem.
  
  
Here’s What You’ll Be Driving
  
  

* The AI Frontier: We are going full sci-fi. You will be building out next-level AI Health and Fitness Coaches, AI-driven sales flows, predictive AI alerts, content marketing, hyper-intelligent chatbots, human-like AI voice calls, and even tapping into AI video generation. Sab kuch smart, sab kuch next level.
* Omnichannel Tooling: Building the ultimate operating systems that make workflows totally makhan for every internal squad. You will own the CRM and tech for Acquisition, Sales, Customer Success and Support, Medical Operations, and Supply Chain Management.
* The MetaGO App: The daily companion keeping our members on track.
* The Meds Pipeline: The zero-friction logistics network getting meds from a prescription pad straight to a member’s doorstep.
* The Data Brain: The ultimate platform connecting every single consult, lab report, dose, and weigh-in.

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* Experience: Years are just a number. If you have worked in the right environment, you have what it takes. But yeah, we definitely want a strong product background.
* Leadership: You enjoy leading from the front and really value stakeholder relationships.
* Strategy: You can lay out a product vision and a multi-year strategy that gets everyone hyped to build.
* Execution: You know how to break down that big strategy into well-prioritized quarterly roadmaps and actually get things done.
* Data-Backed Decisions: You can ask the right questions and let the numbers guide your moves.
* Business Acumen: You are here to build a massive business, not just ship random product features.
* Technical Proficiency: You can sit with the engineering squad and actually influence the design and architecture.
* Fun Personality: People genuinely love working with you. Good vibes only.
* Superstar: That is exactly what we want you to become here at MetaGO.

Picture Abhi Baaki Hai, Mere Dost :)
  
  
Our current lineup covers
**medically supervised GLP-1 and non-GLP-1 programs, diagnostics, and coaching**
. But with the AI scale and massive product roadmap we are unlocking, honestly, picture abhi baaki hai mere dost :)
  
  
We are a fast-moving, high-energy crew that takes massive challenges head-on and owns them to the ground.
  
  
If you believe healthcare should start way before the panic sets in, and you want to build the tech that actually makes a dent,
**we need to talk**
.
  
  
**Let’s build something epic together.**

title: Product Manager - India
description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.
  
  
Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**About You And This Role**
As a
**Product Manager,**
to be located at Navi Mumbai, India, you will be responsible for driving product portfolio competitiveness, profitability, supply flexibility, and growth enablement across the India Consumer Solutions business. The role serves as a key business leader responsible for evaluating and executing strategies that optimize manufacturing footprint, external contract manufacturing (ECM), sourcing options, product supply networks, and overall value chain performance.
  
  
This role operates at the intersection of commercial strategy, product management, manufacturing, supply chain, procurement, and finance. The incumbent is responsible for assessing and recommending make-versus-buy, buy-sell, external manufacturing, and strategic partnership opportunities that improve profitability, increase supply resilience, support growth, and strengthen long-term competitiveness within India.
  
  
The Product Manager translates business strategy into actionable initiatives, governs value chain improvement programs, and drives disciplined execution through cross-functional teams. The role requires balancing short-term operational requirements with longer-term portfolio, manufacturing, and investment decisions while ensuring alignment with business objectives and customer commitments.
  
  
Working closely with regional Product Management, Commercial, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Technology, and external manufacturing partners, the Product Manager provides thought leadership and decision support for strategic initiatives that maximize value creation across the India business.
  
  
The role requires strong business acumen, financial analysis capabilities, strategic thinking, and the ability to influence complex decisions across a matrixed organization without direct authority.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead product portfolio competitiveness initiatives across India by identifying and executing opportunities that improve profitability, supply reliability, operational flexibility, and long-term growth.
* Develop and maintain an India-focused manufacturing and sourcing strategy that evaluates internal production, external manufacturing, buy-sell arrangements, and strategic partnerships to optimize business performance.
* Identify, evaluate, and develop strategic partnerships and external manufacturing opportunities that support market growth, improve flexibility, and strengthen supply network competitiveness. (Derived from the strategic partnership mandate you described.)
* Lead and govern Value Chain Management Team (VCMT) initiatives by establishing accountability, monitoring key performance indicators, tracking progress, and ensuring timely delivery of business commitments.
* Partner with Commercial, Manufacturing, Procurement, Supply Chain, Technology, and Finance functions to identify and implement opportunities that improve cost position, product availability, service performance, and margin expansion.
* Conduct financial and business analyses to identify profitability gaps, competitiveness challenges, hidden cost drivers, and value creation opportunities across the portfolio.
* Develop business cases and recommendations for manufacturing footprint optimization, strategic partnerships, and supply network improvements that support future business growth.
* Influence regional product, supply, manufacturing, innovation, and investment strategies to ensure alignment with India business priorities and market opportunities.
* Communicate strategic recommendations, business risks, opportunity assessments, and execution updates effectively to senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Chemical Engineering/Mechanical /Production Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business, Finance, or related discipline.
* Minimum 6-10 years of relevant experience in Product Management, Commercial, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Strategy, Business Operations, Procurement, or related business roles.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex business decisions involving profitability, competitiveness, sourcing, manufacturing, supply strategy, or external partnerships.
* Strong understanding of business economics, product profitability, cost structures, supply-demand balancing, and value chain optimization.
* Proven ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams within a matrixed organization.
* Strong analytical and financial evaluation capabilities with demonstrated ability to translate data into business decisions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA or Master's Degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, or related field.
* Experience with External Contract Manufacturing (ECM), toll manufacturing, contract manufacturing, or third-party supply partnerships.
* Experience in product portfolio management, manufacturing economics, asset utilization, and supply network optimization.
* Experience evaluating make-buy, sourcing, footprint optimization, or strategic partnership decisions.
* Lean Six Sigma certification preferred.
* Project, Program, or Portfolio Management certification preferred but not required.

**Your Skills**

* Strategic Business Leadership
* Financial and Commercial Acumen
* External Partnership Management
* Cross-Functional Leadership and Influence
* Product Portfolio Management
* Strategic Decision Making
* Program Governance and Execution
* Executive Communication

**Additional Notes**

* Ability to support and collaborate across multiple global functions and time zones.
* Periodic domestic and international travel may be required.
* Relocation support is not provided for this role.

**Benefits – What Dow Offers You**
We invest in you.
  
  
Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
  
  
Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:
  
  

* Equitable and market-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives.
* Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it.
* Competitive retirement program that may include company-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial-goals.

title: Technical Delivery Manager
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled Technical Delivery Manager to join us on an exciting journey as we modernize our core platforms to make them Simpler, Leaner and more Efficient. You will utilize your strong industry and domain expertise to shape up our Technology product offerings to meet the Business requirements for the future. You'll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unparalleled customer experiences.
  
  
To be successful as a Technical Delivery Manager you should have experience with:
  
  
  

* Experience in managing large multi-year complex projects involving global teams, through the full project lifecycle from inception to implementation.
* Collaborating with an experienced team of SMEs, Operations, Dev managers, and other Global Business stakeholders to understand the requirements and project deliverables.
* Managing Risks, Assumptions, Issues and Dependencies closely, across all aspects of the project.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, together with well-developed collaborative mindset.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**

* Formal credentials in PMP/SAFE.
* Estimation skills for tasks, including design, development, technical debt, and testing.
* Exposure to Cloud Technologies (public or private).
* Understanding of any Liquidity Management or Core Banking Product suite.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
The role is based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To manage the efficient delivery of large-scale technical projects and capabilities across the bank and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to understand their needs and expectations throughout the software product lifecycle, adhering to agreed time, budget and quality requirements.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Management of the delivery, resource allocation and improvement of complex technical project capabilities across the bank using Agile/Scrum methodologies for planning, stand-ups, demos, retrospectives and the execution of sprints.
* Collaboration with customers and business teams to manage and implement customer trails to support the proposal of technically feasible solutions, and effort and timeline expectations.
* Collaboration with software engineers, quality teams, product managers and other engineering teams to deliver high-quality products and features through the software project lifecycle aligned to the banks objectives, regulation and security policies.
* Identification, assessment, and mitigation of risks associated with technical projects to prepare the bank for potential challenges.
* Management of change requests and communication with stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Management of vendor relations involved in technical projects to ensure they deliver according to agreed terms.
* Stay abreast of the latest industry technology trends and technologies, to evaluate and adopt new approaches to improving deliver outcomes and to foster a culture of continuous learning, technical excellence and growth.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Senior Project Manager_3418
description:
**Role Description & Responsibilities**
*Are you energised by turning complex, multi-team technology programmes into predictable delivery for one of the world's largest financial services groups?*
*If so, this role puts you at the centre of that work. You will own the end-to-end delivery of projects across the Allianz Data Platform and the wider DAP portfolio, from initiation and planning through execution, monitoring, and closure, translating complex business requirements into clear technical deliverables that engineering teams can act on.*
*The role sits at the crossroads of business, technology, and data, which means the governance you put in place, from risk and dependency management through to status reporting and escalation, shapes how thousands of colleagues across Allianz Group turn data into decisions.*
*To get there, you will facilitate agile ceremonies and cross-team coordination across geographically distributed teams, and work alongside Senior Engineers, Principal Engineers, and Platform Architects to keep delivery aligned with DAP's three-year architecture and delivery roadmap.*
*What we value most is your ability to bring structure to ambiguity, engage credibly with engineers on technical trade-offs, navigate stakeholders, product owners, and vendors, and coach the project managers coming up behind you.*
**As Part Of This Role You Will**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of large-scale data, analytics, and AI platform projects, from initiation and planning through execution, monitoring, and closure.
* Translate complex business requirements into clear technical deliverables, ensuring alignment between stakeholder expectations and engineering outcomes.
* Work closely with new and emerging technologies to improve platform usability, performance, and scalability across the DAP ecosystem.
* Participate in the full development lifecycle, from design and implementation through testing, documentation, delivery, and ongoing maintenance, acting as the connective tissue between workstreams.
* Evaluate and make informed decisions around the adoption of new or existing technologies, tools, and project management methodologies.
* Define and maintain project governance frameworks, including risk management plans, dependency tracking, status reporting, and escalation paths.
* Facilitate agile ceremonies and cross-team coordination across geographically distributed teams.
* Coach and mentor junior project managers and support the professional development of team members across the organisation.
* Collaborate with Senior Engineers, Principal Engineers, and Platform Architects to contribute to and align with the DAP's three-year architecture and delivery roadmap.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, product owners, and external vendors or partners.
* Drive continuous improvement in project delivery practices, tooling, and team ways of working.

**✅ Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor/Master degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline.
* 5+ years of professional experience in technical project management, with a proven track record of delivering complex, cross-functional technology projects, ideally within financial services, insurance, or another regulated industry.
* 1+ years of experience contributing to system design or architecture discussions (architecture, design patterns, reliability, and scaling) within data, analytics, AI, or platform engineering contexts.
* Solid understanding of software development lifecycles and the ability to engage credibly with engineering teams on technical topics.
* Experience working with at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., Python, SQL, Bash) at a level sufficient to understand technical trade-offs and review technical documentation.
* Demonstrated experience in object-oriented or data-oriented programming concepts, enabling effective collaboration with development teams.
* Experience with end-to-end (E2E) Data Product Management, including data governance, quality, and lifecycle management.
* Strong command of agile project management methodologies, including SAFe, Scrum, and/or Kanban.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills in English (additional languages are a plus).

**⭐ Preferred Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience in technical project management, ideally within data engineering, analytics platforms, cloud infrastructure, or enterprise software environments.
* Experience managing the full software or data product development lifecycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing pipelines, and operational support.
* Relevant certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, Certified Scrum Master (CSM), SAFe, or equivalent.
* Hands-on familiarity with modern data stack technologies (e.g., Spark, dbt, Airflow, Kafka, Snowflake, Databricks, or similar).
* Experience working in a multinational or globally distributed organisation, ideally within financial services, insurance, or a regulated industry.

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us.
  
  
At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. And the foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and nurtures a culture grounded in integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust.
  
  
We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.
  
  
Join us
**. Let's care for tomorrow.**

description:
**Overview:**
The Software Engineering Manager (M2) is responsible for providing leadership and day-to-day direction to a cross functional engineering team. This role involves establishing and executing operational plans, driving team process and technology productivity improvements, managing relationships with internal and external customers, and overseeing technical fulfillment projects. The manager also supports sales verticals in customer interactions and ensures the delivery of technology solutions aligns with business needs.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Build strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders including product, business and sales partners. Demonstrate excellent communication skills with the ability to both simplify complex problems and also dive deeper if needed
* Manage teams with cross functional skills that include software, quality, reliability engineers, project managers and scrum masters. Mentor, coach and develop junior and senior software, quality and reliability engineers. Collaborate with the architects, SRE leads and other technical leadership on strategic technical direction, guidelines, and best practices
* Ensure compliance with EFX secure software development guidelines and best practices and responsible for meeting and maintaining QE, DevSec, and FinOps KPIs.
* Define, maintain and report SLA, SLO, SLIs meeting EFX engineering standards in partnership with the product, engineering and architecture teams
* Drive technical documentation including support, end user documentation and run books. Lead Production Support processes, Sprint planning, Sprint Retrospectives and other team activities
* Implement architecture decision making associated with Product features/stories, refactoring work, and EOSL decisions
* Create and deliver technical presentations to internal and external technical and non-technical stakeholders communicating with clarity and precision, and present complex information in a concise format that is audience appropriate
* Provides coaching, leadership and talent development; ensures teams functions as a high-performing team; able to identify performance gaps and opportunities for upskilling and transition when necessary.
* Drives culture of accountability through actions and stakeholder engagement and expectation management
* Develop the long-term technical vision and roadmap within, and often beyond, the scope of your teams.
* Oversee systems designs within the scope of the broader area, and review product or system development code to solve ambiguous problems
* Identify and resolve problems affecting day-to-day operations
* Set priorities for the engineering team and coordinate work activities with other supervisors
* Cloud Certification Strongly Preferred

**What experience you need:**

* BS or MS degree in a STEM major or equivalent job experience required
* 10+ years’ experience in software development and delivery
* You adore working in a fast paced and agile development environment
* You possess excellent communication, sharp analytical abilities, and proven design skills
* You have detailed knowledge of modern software development lifecycles including CI / CD
* You have the ability to operate across a broad and complex business unit with multiple stakeholders
* You have an understanding of the key aspects of finance especially as related to Technology. Specifically including total cost of ownership and value

* Experience managing Kanban processes, and various techniques to prioritize critical issues or features in a customer-support setting.

* Source code control management systems (e.g. SVN/Git, Subversion) and build tools like Maven

* Design patterns
* Agile environments (e.g. KanBan, Scrum, XP)
* Software development best practices such as TDD (e.g. JUnit), automated testing (e.g. Gauge, Cucumber, FitNesse), continuous integration (e.g. Jenkins, GoCD)
* Linux command line and shell scripting languages
* Relational databases (e.g. SQL Server, MySQL)
* Cloud computing, SaaS (Software as a Service)
* Atlassian tooling (e.g. JIRA, Confluence, and Bitbucket)
* Experience working in financial services
* Experience working with open source frameworks; preferably Spring, though we would also consider Ruby, Apache Struts, Symfony, Django, etc.
* Automated Testing: JUnit, Selenium, LoadRunner, SoapUI

**Behaviors:**

* Customer-focused with a drive to exceed expectations.
* Demonstrates integrity and accountability.
* Intellectually curious and driven to innovate.
* Values diversity and fosters collaboration.
* Results-oriented with a sense of urgency and agility.

The successful candidate will combine strong project management, technical leadership, stakeholder management, and operational governance skills to drive remediation outcomes, improve process effectiveness, and enhance adoption of VET and Control Workbench (CWB) capabilities across Deutsche Bank Technology.

* Proven experience working with technology engineering teams, application owners, and senior stakeholders.
* Experience delivering large-scale remediation, transformation, or regulatory initiatives.
* Experience operating within global organizations and distributed teams.
* Strong knowledge of SDLC, DevOps, Vulnerability Management, and IT Risk Management frameworks.
* Experience working within regulated financial institutions is highly desirable.

**VET Close & Verify Governance**

* Track remediation progress and escalate risks, blockers, and aging vulnerabilities where appropriate.

* Present status updates, metrics, risks, and remediation progress to senior management.

**Operational Effectiveness & Process Improvement**

* Drive automation opportunities across vulnerability ingestion, analysis, remediation tracking, and reporting.
* Identify process bottlenecks and implement operational improvements.
* Support enhancement initiatives within Control Workbench (CWB) and VET.
* Promote end-to-end traceability from vulnerability identification through close and verify activities.

**Reporting & Governance**

* Monitor and report on:
* + Vulnerability remediation progress
  + Open and overdue findings
  + Exception management status
  + Risk exposure trends
  + CIO and application-level performance metrics
* Support governance forums and steering committees with actionable insights and recommendations.
* Ensure audit-ready evidence and remediation traceability are maintained.

**Risk & Exception Management**

* Coordinate central exception review processes.
* Ensure proper documentation and approval of risk acceptances and exceptions.
* Validate remediation evidence submitted by engineering teams.
* Support regulatory, audit, and internal review activities relating to vulnerability management.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

**Project & Program Management**

* Strong project management and delivery leadership experience.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent workstreams across global organizations.
* Proven ability to drive delivery against challenging timelines.
* Strong planning, prioritization, and organizational skills.
* Experience managing executive stakeholders and governance forums.

**Technical Leadership**

* Strong understanding of software engineering and infrastructure environments.
* Working knowledge of:
* + Vulnerability Management
  + Application Security
  + SDLC
  + DevOps
  + Cloud Platforms
  + Infrastructure Operations

title: Staff Product Designer
description:
**Location:**
Gurugram(Work From Office)

**Position:**
Staff / Lead Product Designer

**Experience Level:**
7+ Years of crafting great user experience and driving innovation

**Industry:**
Beauty B2C

**Know about the company**

India’s largest beauty and wellness destination with more than half a million happy customers. Design at Nykaa welcomes candidates with diverse backgrounds, expertise, and perspectives. It offers opportunities for constant learning with fun and interactive sessions. It is a place where you’d feel welcomed and can contribute your skills and expertise to help build the business growth. We are committed to the safety and well-being of our employees, vendors, and clients.

**Life at Nykaa Design: Where Style, Meets Strategy ✨**

Imagine vibrant hues of creativity, collaborative spirits that thrive on trust, and an unending bank of ideas that’s every day at Nykaa Design. We are a tight bunch of progressive youth making beauty and fashion accessible to all through user-first experiences. We don’t just accept your unique style; we celebrate it! Whether it’s fun interactive sessions or working as a collective to build exceptional shopping journeys, Nykaa Design is a place where every member is an equal and every voice matters.

**The Role: Creative, Visionary & Pragmatic Problem-Solver**

As a Staff/Lead Product Designer, you aren’t just designing screens; you are setting the long-term vision for our digital products. As you stand as a custodian for our consumers, keeping your views in front of leaders within the org. You’ll also be the guardian to the team enriching, defending, challenging and ensuring delivery. While we revolutionize how the world learns and shops beauty.

**What You’ll Do: Lead, Innovate, & Elevate**

Innovate & Elevate: Stay on top of design trends and emerging technologies, bringing fresh ideas that push the boundaries of user experience on B2C platforms.

**Product Design Execution/Ownership:**

* Own product experiences in certain pod structures, from early concepts and user flows to final execution and launch.
* Define design direction for key product areas and ensure a clear, consistent experience across multiple touchpoints while advocating for users and balancing customer needs with business goals and technical constraints.
* Solving complex user and business problems by turning insights, data, and customer needs into simple, effective experiences.

**Functional Ownership:**

* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and other teams. Influence product decisions beyond visual design and help teams make clear, user-focused decisions.
* Identify opportunities to improve the overall customer experience across the product ecosystem.
* Lead and mentor designers, helping them grow their craft, product thinking, and ownership by setting clear design standards and ways of working across the team.
* Provide thoughtful feedback, challenge ideas constructively, and help designers make stronger decisions.
* Foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where designers can experiment, take ownership, and do their best work. Raise the overall quality and maturity of the design practice through better processes, principles, and collaboration.

**Who You Are**

* You have 7+ years of experience designing compelling user experiences for B2C platforms.
* You are a systems thinker who sees the larger ecosystem, not just isolated features.
* You possess the psychological power to place yourself in the user's shoes and a highly refined aesthetic sense.
* You are opinionated, able to give constructive feedback, and passionate about establishing a perspective behind design decisions.

**Why You’ll Love It Here**

**Unparalleled Ownership:**
Freedom to take initiative and make mistakes so we can learn together.

**Learning Playground:**
Constant learning, regular sync-ups, and a transparent, feedback-positive environment.

**Celebration & Support:**
Timely celebrations to acknowledge success and leaders who are approachable and eager to support you.

**How Our Team Looks**

We’re a close-knit team of designers, researchers, writers, visual designers. These are super creative minds from different backgrounds and cultures. Different perspectives, one shared love for making things better for our users. We brainstorm, debate, experiment, obsess over details, and occasionally ask, “But what if we tried this?” Our intrapreneurial culture gives us the space to explore ideas, solve tricky problems, and build experiences people love.

**Different disciplines. One team. Lots of ideas.**

**🎨Product Designers**

We turn “this could be better” into “this feels effortless.” Our Product Designers work across Nykaa’s products, making complex things feel simple, intuitive, and delightful. They think about the big picture, sweat the small stuff, and keep iterating until the experience feels just right.

**🔍UX Research**

We’re curious. Very curious. Our UX Researchers dig into what customers do, need, think, and sometimes don’t say. Their insights help us uncover opportunities, challenge assumptions, and make better product decisions.

**✍️UX Writing**

Yes, we really do debate one word. Our UX Writers make sure Nykaa’s products don’t just look good, they sound good too. From tiny bits of microcopy to larger content experiences, they turn complex moments into clear, helpful, and human ones.

**⚙️Design Operations**

Someone has to keep all the creative chaos moving. Design Operations makes it easier for everyone to do their best work. They think about tools, workflows, collaboration, learning, and culture basically, all the things that help a design team run smoothly.

**✨Product Visual Design**

Product Visual Design, Illustration & Motion The team that makes us stop and say, “Ooh, nice.” They bring personality to Nykaa through colour, type, illustration, animation, and all the little details in between. They collaborate with Product Designers to turn ideas into experiences that are polished, expressive, and unmistakably Nykaa.

title: Senior UX/UI Designer
description:
Senior UX Designer
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an exceptional
**Senior UX Designer**
to drive end-to-end user experience for our core enterprise platform. In this role, you will tackle high-complexity workflows, untangle dense data environments, and translate complex business domains into clear, effortless user experiences.
  
  
You are a deep domain thinker - someone who excels at information architecture, interaction mechanics, and system-level UX rather than just surface-level interface polish.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Drive End-to-End UX Architecture: Own the full user experience lifecycle - from discovery, domain modeling, and user flows to wireframing, high-fidelity interaction design, and engineering delivery.
* Master Enterprise Complexity: Craft intuitive workflows for data-dense, multi-role B2B/SaaS systems without compromising on speed or clarity.
* Lead Accessibility & Standards: Infuse WCAG standards and inclusive design practices natively into every stage of the design process.
* Scale Design Systems: Contribute to and expand our enterprise component libraries and interaction standards for consistency across applications.
* Cross-Functional Influence: Partner with Product, Engineering, and domain experts to align design strategy with product vision and technical feasibility.

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 5-8+ Years in Complex Digital Products: Demonstrated track record leading UX strategy and execution for enterprise-grade, data-dense, or B2B SaaS platforms.
* Systems & Architectural Thinking: Deep expertise in information architecture, complex mental models, interaction mechanics, and edge-case mapping.
* Design Systems & Scalability: Deep understanding of component architecture, tokens, and multi-platform design principles.
* Innate Accessibility Knowledge: Fluent in WCAG guidelines and designing for diverse usability needs as a core design principle.
* High-Impact Communication: Ability to articulate design decisions, trade-offs, and rationale to executive stakeholders and technical teams.
* Prototyping & Tools: High proficiency in modern design tools (Figma, etc.) and interactive prototyping to validate complex concepts before development.

Great to Have
  
  

* Research & Usability Practices: Experience structuring evaluative usability studies or collaborating effectively with dedicated UXR teams.

title: CRO Specialist
description:
**About the role**

Axeno’s conversion rate optimization (CRO) and experimentation practice helps enterprise clients grow website conversion. We turn analytics evidence into prioritised experiments and personalized experiences, and prove the business impact.

As Scrum Master & CRO Specialist you are the analytical and delivery lead of a CRO squad. You own journey analysis, drop-off diagnosis, hypotheses, experiment design and KPI interpretation, and you run the sprint cadence that keeps every cycle on time, evidence-backed and decision-ready. You will also strengthen the practice by evolving the playbooks, templates and ways of working we reuse across clients.

**What you will do**

**CRO and insights**

•   
**Journey and funnel analysis.**
Analyse the end-to-end website journey in Adobe Analytics. Build funnels, fallout and cohort views by source, device and new vs returning traffic.

•   
**Drop-off diagnosis.**
Combine quantitative funnels with session replay, heatmaps, zoning and journey analysis from Microsoft Clarity and Contentsquare to explain friction.

•   
**Hypotheses.**
Produce focused insight briefs with ranked hypotheses, each with evidence, affected audience and a primary KPI.

•   
**Experiment design.**
Specify tests (A/B, experience targeting, personalization rules) with primary KPI, eligible audience, minimum detectable effect, allocation, control and decision window. Report absolute and relative effect with uncertainty and guardrails, and call “continue learning” when the evidence says so.

•   
**Measurement integrity.**
Define and maintain a measurement contract: journey events, experiment IDs, and reconciliation across SDK, analytics and server/CRM counts. Link website conversions to downstream lead quality.

•   
**Reporting.**
Maintain KPI dashboards covering conversion, lead quality and guardrails (Core Web Vitals, form reliability, personalization delivery, data integrity).

•   
**Activation partnership.**
Work with personalization and engineering specialists on Adobe Target and Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization campaigns: targeting logic, preview and tracking QA, rollout and rollback.

**Scrum and delivery**

•   
Run a fortnightly delivery cycle: evidence mining, test agreement, build and verify, release and review. Facilitate planning, daily check-ins, backlog refinement, reviews and retrospectives.

•   
Own the prioritised backlog and a written decision log (launch, continue, revise, stop, escalate). Prioritise by opportunity, effort and traffic using a framework such as ICE or PIE.

•   
Track dependencies on client platform, data and BAU teams (access, consent, SDK, approved content). Raise blockers and risks early, and keep acceptance evidence for every deliverable.

•   
Be the day-to-day contact for client marketing and digital stakeholders. Present readouts in plain business language, without overclaiming uplift.

**Practice contribution**

•   
Maintain and improve reusable assets: hypothesis and experiment brief templates, QA checklists, KPI frameworks, dashboards and a CRO operating playbook.

•   
Support pre-sales and proposals with CRO approach, scoping and case studies. Coach junior analysts and personalization specialists across the team.

**﻿
Must-have requirements**

**Non-negotiable**

*Hands-on CRO delivery for comparable customers (large consumer or lead-generation websites, ideally automotive, BFSI or other high-consideration journeys), with proven, quantified impact you can walk us through.*

•   
6–7 years in web analytics, CRO or digital optimization, with at least 3 years running an experimentation programme end to end.

•   
Case studies we can verify: the problem, hypothesis, test design, result (with confidence or uncertainty) and business impact, e.g. lift in lead or conversion rate without loss in lead quality.

•   
Strong Adobe Analytics skills: Analysis Workspace, segments, calculated metrics, fallout and flow, eVars/props/events.

•   
Hands-on experience with Adobe Target (activities, audiences, A/B and experience targeting, QA; A4T is a plus).

•   
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Clarity and Contentsquare for session replay, heatmaps, zone-based and journey analysis.

•   
Working knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization (Interaction Studio) and how Data Cloud segments feed website personalization.

•   
Solid grasp of experiment statistics: sample size and MDE, significance and confidence intervals, sample ratio mismatch, novelty effects, overlapping tests.

•   
Scrum fundamentals: you can run ceremonies, manage a backlog and unblock a team. CSM or PSM certification preferred.

•   
Clear written and verbal communication, able to turn data into a recommendation for non-technical stakeholders.

**Good to have**

•   
Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target or Salesforce certifications.

•   
Experience with consent-aware measurement and privacy-safe personalization (including India DPDP requirements).

•   
Familiarity with Core Web Vitals, tag management (Adobe Launch, GTM) and basic SQL or Python for ad-hoc analysis.

•   
Experience linking web leads to CRM or dealer outcomes (Salesforce, Data Cloud).

•   
Agency or consulting background with client-facing experience.

roles.

B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, MCA, or M.Tech/M.Sc. in Computer Science.

* Experience designing test automation architecture, frameworks, reusable

components, and test strategies.  

* Proven experience with Selenium and/or Playwright; Appium experience is an

advantage.  

* Strong experience in REST API testing and automation.

* Working knowledge of PowerShell or scripting for automation and engineering

tasks.  

* Basic working knowledge of AWS and cloud-based environments.
* Hands-on experience with GitHub Copilot or similar AI-assisted development

tools.  

* Good understanding of software testing, QA methodologies, and quality

engineering practices.  

* Good working knowledge of HTML/CSS.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.

Good-to-Have  

* System Integration Testing (SIT) experience.
* Performance testing experience.
* Experience with AI-driven test automation or LLM-based testing solutions.
* Docker/containerization experience.
* Automotive domain knowledge.
* Basics of Embedded Systems

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
**About the Role**
We are seeking an experienced and highly capable
**Salesforce Lead**
to drive the technical delivery of our next-generation
**Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform**
powered by Salesforce, Agentforce, AI, Data Cloud, and MuleSoft.
  
  
This is a hands-on technical leadership role for professionals who can
**lead development teams, guide solution design, mentor developers and senior developers, and closely partner with architects to deliver scalable enterprise solutions**
. The ideal candidate combines deep Salesforce platform expertise with strong people leadership, delivery ownership, and architectural thinking.
  
  
As a Salesforce Lead, you will be responsible for translating business and platform strategy into high-quality technical solutions while ensuring adherence to architecture, governance, security, and engineering best practices. You will lead cross-functional teams building intelligent service management experiences across Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Agentforce, Enterprise Service Management (ESM), ITSM, CMDB, IT Asset Management, and enterprise integrations.
  
  
This role offers an opportunity to play a key leadership position in shaping the future of AI-powered service management and conversational enterprise platforms.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership & Delivery**

* Lead a team of Salesforce Developers and Senior Salesforce Developers across multiple workstreams.
* Provide technical leadership throughout the full software development lifecycle, from solution design to production deployment.
* Partner closely with Salesforce Architects to translate architectural vision into scalable and maintainable technical solutions.
* Own technical delivery, ensuring solutions meet business, security, scalability, and performance requirements.
* Drive estimation, sprint planning, technical task allocation, and delivery execution.
* Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and architecture compliance reviews.
* Establish and enforce Salesforce development standards, coding conventions, CI/CD processes, and governance frameworks.

**Solution Design & Development**

* Lead the design and development of Salesforce solutions supporting the organization's Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform.
* Design scalable solutions leveraging Salesforce Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Platform, and Agentforce capabilities.
* Build intelligent service experiences utilizing Agentforce, AI-driven workflows, conversational experiences, and autonomous service capabilities.
* Design and develop complex solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, Platform Events, Integration Patterns, and Salesforce APIs.
* Guide implementation of enterprise service management processes including:

+ Incident Management
+ Service Request Management
+ Change Management
+ Problem Management
+ Knowledge Management
+ Employee Support Services
+ CMDB Management
+ IT Asset Management
+ Service Catalog Management

**Integration & Enterprise Architecture**

* Lead enterprise integration initiatives using MuleSoft and API-led connectivity patterns.
* Design reusable integration frameworks connecting Salesforce with ITSM, ERP, HR, Monitoring, Collaboration, Identity, and Business Systems.
* Collaborate with enterprise architects and integration teams to ensure platform interoperability and data consistency.
* Drive API governance, performance optimization, security controls, and integration best practices.

**Team Leadership & Mentoring**

* Mentor Salesforce Developers and Senior Developers through coaching, design guidance, and hands-on technical support.
* Support career development and capability building within the Salesforce team.
* Identify skill gaps and define technical learning and certification roadmaps.
* Foster a culture of engineering excellence, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Act as the primary technical escalation point for complex solution and production challenges.

**AI & Platform Innovation**

* Champion adoption of Agentforce, Generative AI, Data Cloud, and emerging Salesforce innovations.
* Guide implementation of conversational AI, agentic workflows, intelligent automation, and self-service experiences.
* Evaluate new platform capabilities and recommend innovative solutions that improve service delivery and operational efficiency.
* Contribute to strategic platform roadmaps and technology decision-making.

**Required Qualifications**
**Must Have**

* 7 to 10 years of Salesforce platform experience with at least 2-3 years in a technical lead role.
* Strong hands-on expertise across:

+ Service Cloud
+ Sales Cloud
+ Experience Cloud
+ Salesforce Platform

* Deep technical expertise in:

+ Apex
+ Lightning Web Components (LWC)
+ Salesforce Flows
+ SOQL/SOSL
+ Platform Events
+ Integration Patterns
+ REST/SOAP APIs
+ Salesforce Security Model

* Strong experience with large-scale Salesforce implementations and enterprise delivery programs.
* Experience leading and mentoring development teams.
* Experience working alongside solution architects and enterprise architects.
* Proven ability to drive technical decision-making and delivery governance.
* Strong understanding of:

+ Data Architecture
+ Security & Sharing Models
+ DevOps & CI/CD
+ Release Management
+ Application Lifecycle Management

* Experience in Agile, Scrum, and DevOps-driven environments.
* Strong stakeholder communication and leadership skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing Enterprise Service Management (ESM) and IT Service Management (ITSM) solutions.
* Experience with:

+ CMDB
+ IT Asset Management (ITAM)
+ Service Catalog
+ Enterprise Operations Management

* Hands-on experience with MuleSoft and API Management.
* Experience working in global delivery models.
* Salesforce Platform Developer I & II Certifications.
* Salesforce Application Architect or System Architect Certification.
* Scrum Master, SAFe, or Agile certifications.

**Added Advantage**

* Hands-on experience with Salesforce Agentforce.
* Experience building Conversational AI and autonomous service experiences.
* Exposure to Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, Agentic AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts.
* Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud.
* Experience delivering Digital Transformation and Enterprise Automation initiatives.
* Knowledge of Service Operations, ITIL, or Enterprise Service Management frameworks.

**What We Are Looking For**
We are seeking professionals who:
  
  

* Think like technical leaders while remaining hands-on contributors.
* Can successfully lead teams while maintaining a strong engineering mindset.
* Are comfortable partnering with architects and influencing platform strategy.
* Enjoy solving complex enterprise-scale technology challenges.
* Can balance delivery excellence, innovation, governance, and stakeholder expectations.
* Are passionate about Agentforce, AI, Conversational Platforms, and Intelligent Automation.
* Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and strong decision-making capabilities.
* Thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

**Why Join Us?**

* Lead the technical delivery of a strategic Salesforce-powered Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform.
* Work with cutting-edge technologies including Agentforce, AI, Data Cloud, MuleSoft, and Enterprise Automation.
* Influence platform architecture and engineering direction.
* Lead and mentor a high-performing Salesforce engineering team.
* Collaborate with architects, integration specialists, AI engineers, and business leaders.
* Accelerate your career toward Solution Architect and Engineering Leadership pathways.
* Be part of a rapidly growing organization where innovation and impact are valued.

**Join Us ?**
If you are a seasoned Salesforce professional with a passion for technical leadership, team mentoring, enterprise-scale solution delivery, and AI-driven innovation, we invite you to join us in building the future of
**Conversational Agentic ITSM on Salesforce**
. This role offers the opportunity to combine
**technical excellence, people leadership, and architectural influence**
while shaping a transformative platform that redefines enterprise service management.
  
  
**Compensation**

We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.
