* Use customer insights and product analytics to identify friction points and continuously improve product performance.
* Contribute to the development of product management talent through collaboration, mentoring and strong product practices.
* Present product plans, progress and performance insights to senior stakeholders, ensuring alignment on priorities and expected outcomes.

What We're Looking For

* 10+ years of overall experience, including substantial experience in product management and ownership of technology products.
* Experience building and growing digital products in fintech, payments, consumer technology, B2B or B2C platforms or other transaction-oriented businesses.
* Evidence of taking products from problem identification and validation through launch, adoption and subsequent optimisation.
* Experience delivering AI/ML-powered features or products, with an understanding of how data, models and product workflows work together.
* Ability to assess the suitability of AI for a business problem and understand the practical considerations involved in deployment, quality measurement and ongoing monitoring.
* Familiarity with generative AI, LLM applications, AI agents and prompt/context design is desirable; the ability to build and test prototypes is a strong advantage.
* Strong analytical skills, with experience using product metrics and customer insights to prioritise initiatives and evaluate results.
* Ability to work effectively with engineering teams, understand technical dependencies and communicate product requirements clearly.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication and decision-making skills.
* A proactive, ownership-driven approach with the flexibility to work through ambiguity and engage directly in execution when necessary.

title: AVP – Partnerships & Operations (Founder’s Office)
description:
**About Robotex India**

Robotex India is a non-profit on a mission to make future skills (robotics, coding, AI, IoT and STEAM) accessible to every child from government schools and colleges
in India.

Founded in Pune in 2018, Robotex India brought one of the world’s largest robotics festival, Robotex International, to Indian classrooms. Our focus has been on children who rarely get this opportunity: students in government, rural and tribal schools/colleges, majorly first-generation learners.

**What we’ve built so far**

* **Scale:**
  1.5 million+ students reached across 15 states and 500+ schools
* **Teachers:**
  300,000 teachers training in progress on AI in pedagogy with Microsoft
* **Girls in STEM:**
  520,000+ girls brought into robotics, coding, STEM and AI
* **Robotex for Rural:**
  a CSR-funded programme, launched in 2019, that teaches coding, programming, AI and robotics to students from marginalised communities
* **Government partnerships:**
  we work directly with state governments and Zila Parishads so that programmes reach the most underserved communities
* **India’s first digital hackathon:**
  organised during the pandemic with FICCI FLO Pune and the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, keeping learning alive when schools shut
* **National Championship:**
  the Robotex India National Championship is one of the country’s largest grassroots technology platforms. So far 250+ government school students won podium places and represented India at Robotex International in Estonia. All from government, rural and tribal schools.
* **STEAM and robotics labs:**
  set up in government schools and colleges through CSR sponsors
* **Innoveda:**
  our future-skills programme for schools and colleges, now expanding to new cities

**The Role**

This is the most important hire we’ll make this year.

You’ll be directly working with the Founder: a senior leader who shares the load across fundraising, grants, operations, growth and outreach, and who owns outcomes end to end. You’ll be handed goals and trusted to get there.

This role suits a seasoned AVP or senior manager from the NGO, CSR or development sector. It also suits an exceptional, qualified Executive Manager or Chief of Staff who is ready to step up and grow into a leadership position. What matters most is ownership, judgement and drive.

You’ll report directly to the Founder & Director and work closely with the programme, finance, outreach and digital teams.

What You’ll Do

1. **Fundraising & CSR Partnerships**

* Build and manage a pipeline of prospective CSR partners, foundations, HNIs and institutional donors
* Research companies’ CSR priorities and Schedule VII alignment, and match them to Robotex India programmes
* Lead pitches from first meeting to signed MoU, with tailored proposals, decks and budgets
* Grow existing partnerships through renewals, expanded scope, multi-year commitments and new geographies
* Manage donor relationships with regular updates, impact stories, site visits and event invitations
* Keep the funding pipeline, forecasts and partner database up to date in a CRM or tracker

2. Grant Management

* Track grant opportunities from CSR, government, multilateral and international funders
* Lead applications from research and concept note through to full proposal and submission
* Own the post-award cycle: deliverables, timelines, milestones and funder commitments
* Prepare progress, impact and financial reports with the programme and finance teams
* Ensure compliance with funder requirements, including utilisation certificates, audit support and CSR-1 / 12A / 80G documentation
* Build a clean, audit-ready grant documentation system

3. Operations

* Oversee programme delivery across states, schools and districts to time, budget and quality
* Coordinate with trainers, coordinators and volunteers for workshops, labs and competitions
* Support the Robotex India National Championship: planning, logistics, partners and team travel for the international finals
* Build SOPs, trackers, dashboards and reviews that let the organisation run without bottlenecks
* Coordinate with finance on budgets, vendor payments, procurement and cost control
* Support hiring, onboarding and performance rhythms for the team

4. Growth & Innoveda Outreach

* Drive Innoveda’s expansion to new schools and cities, from outreach to onboarding
* Open partnerships with school groups, universities, state education departments and Zila Parishads
* Identify new programme and revenue opportunities that strengthen long-term sustainability
* Represent Robotex India at conferences, CSR forums, education events and government meetings

5. Digital Footprint & Communications

* Oversee our social media, website and digital presence with the digital team
* Make sure donors, schools and partners consistently see credible, up-to-date impact stories
* Build impact communications: case studies, annual reports, partner decks and newsletters
* Strengthen Robotex India’s and the Founder’s visibility in media, LinkedIn and sector platforms

6. Founder’s Office

* Manage the Founder’s priorities, calendar, meetings, travel and follow-ups
* Prepare briefs, notes and documents for partner, donor and government meetings
* Track key decisions and commitments, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks
* Act as the Founder’s representative with partners, donors and the team when needed
* Bring fresh thinking: spot problems early, propose solutions and run with them

**What Success Looks Like**

**In your first 30 days:**
you know every programme, partner and grant in our portfolio, and you’ve taken ownership of the funding pipeline and grant calendar.

**In 90 days:**
you’ve closed or renewed CSR partnerships, submitted new grant applications, and put working systems in place for reporting and operations.

**In 12 months:**
Robotex India has a significantly larger donor and CSR base, Innoveda is in new cities, and the Founder’s time is freed up for vision, strategy and relationships.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Must-haves**

* [7–12] years of experience in NGO, CSR, development sector, EdTech, a founder’s office or a high-growth organisation
* A proven track record in CSR fundraising, donor partnerships or grant management, with funds raised or partnerships closed that you can speak to
* Strong understanding of CSR in India: Schedule VII, CSR-1, 12A / 80G and funder reporting requirements
* Excellent written and spoken English; you can write a proposal that gets funded and an email that gets a reply
* Strong project management and follow-through across many moving parts
* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, PowerPoint/Canva and CRM or tracking tools
* An owner’s mindset: proactive, resourceful and comfortable with ambiguity
* Ability to join immediately and work from our Pune office

**Good to have**

* Postgraduate degree: MBA, MSW, Development Studies, Public Policy or similar
* Existing network among CSR heads, foundations or corporate leaders
* Experience with government partnerships or education programmes
* Familiarity with STEM, future skills, disruptive technologies, robotics or EdTech
* Hindi or Marathi fluency

**Who you are**

* You think in systems but act fast
* You’re as comfortable in a boardroom pitch as in a government school visit
* You bring ideas nobody asked for, and then make them happen
* You care about children’s education and want your work to show up in their lives

**How to Apply**

Apply directly on LinkedIn, or email your CV to
**[**
hr@robotex-india.in
**]**
with the subject line:

**“Application – AVP Partnerships & Operations – [Your Name]”**

Please include:

1. Your CV
2. A short note (5–6 lines) on why this role, and one partnership or grant you’re proud of, with the result
3. Current CTC, expected CTC and the earliest date you can join

**This is an immediate-joining role based in Pune.**
We’re reviewing applications on a rolling basis, and candidates available to start right away will be prioritised.

*Robotex India is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, and especially encourage women and first-generation professionals to apply.*

This is a high-impact, cross-functional role at the intersection of strategy, data, and commercialization — built for someone who can turn raw market signals into clear, revenue-driving decisions
*and*
translate those decisions into compelling market narratives that move buyers.
  
  
You will be the connective tissue between what the market demands and how Certify goes to market — owning not just the intelligence and strategy, but the activation of that strategy through product marketing, sales enablement, and positioning. This role is as much about execution as it is about insight.
  
  
**About the role:**
We are seeking a Head of Product Marketing to own market intelligence, pricing strategy, product portfolio optimization, and go-to-market execution for Certify's Provider Data Management platform. This is a high-impact, cross-functional role at the intersection of strategy, data, and commercialization — built for someone who can turn raw market signals into clear, revenue-driving decisions
*and*
translate those decisions into compelling market narratives that move buyers.
  
  
You will be the connective tissue between what the market demands and how Certify goes to market — owning not just the intelligence and strategy, but the activation of that strategy through product marketing, sales enablement, and positioning. This role is as much about execution as it is about insight.
  
  
**What you'll do:**

* Competitive Intelligence & Market Research
* Own end-to-end competitive intelligence for the Provider Data Management (PDM) space — tracking competitor positioning, product roadmaps, pricing moves, and win/loss patterns.
* Build and maintain a continuous market monitoring system — synthesizing signals from analyst reports, customer interviews, sales conversations, and public filings into a living intelligence database.
* Deliver weekly, monthly, and quarterly market reports with clear insights and recommended actions for product, sales, and leadership — including building AI-driven architecture to automate reporting workflows.
* Conduct regular primary research (customer interviews, prospect calls, win/loss debriefs) to pressure-test hypotheses and surface ground-truth insights that secondary research can't provide.
* Pricing Strategy & Revenue Optimization
* Develop and own Certify's pricing strategy across all products and segments — balancing customer value, competitive dynamics, and revenue growth objectives.
* Model pricing scenarios for new products, expansions, and enterprise deals — providing finance and sales with clear pricing frameworks that maximize deal velocity without leaving revenue on the table.
* Design and test pricing experiments (e.g., value-based vs. usage-based models) informed by customer willingness-to-pay data, cohort analysis, and market benchmarks.
* Product Portfolio & Packaging Optimization
* Evaluate and optimize Certify's product portfolio to ensure packaging, bundling, and feature prioritization align with business goals and maximize revenue per customer.
* Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities by analyzing product usage data, customer segments, and whitespace in the market — translating findings into actionable packaging recommendations.
* Monitor product performance metrics continuously and make data-backed recommendations for improvements across pricing, packaging, and feature differentiation.
* Product Marketing & Messaging
* This is where research meets revenue. You won't hand off insights to a separate team — you'll own the translation of market intelligence into the positioning, messaging, and content that drives pipeline and closes deals.
* Own Certify's product positioning and messaging framework — defining how each product and capability is described, differentiated, and sold across all buyer segments and personas.
* Develop and maintain a full library of sales and marketing assets: battlecards, one-pagers, solution briefs, case studies, pitch decks, ROI calculators, and objection-handling guides — built from your own research and updated continuously as the market evolves.
* Lead go-to-market launches for new products, features, and packaging changes — coordinating with Product, Sales, and Marketing to ensure launches land with clarity and drive measurable adoption.
* Build and own Certify's buyer persona library — deeply understanding the motivations, objections, evaluation criteria, and success metrics of key decision-makers (health plan medical directors, credentialing ops leaders, procurement, IT, etc.).
* Develop thought leadership content and market narratives — white papers, market sizing analyses, industry benchmarks — that position Certify as the authoritative voice in the PDM space and support demand generation efforts.
* Partner with Marketing to ensure campaign messaging is grounded in validated market intelligence and resonates with target segments — bridging the gap between data and creative execution.
* Support demand generation by identifying the highest-value market segments and building the research-backed targeting rationale that informs campaign strategy and ABM prioritization.
* Product Team Integration & Roadmap Influence
* This role has a uniquely close relationship with the Product team — functioning as the market-facing counterpart to Product's internal-facing focus. Where Product owns the what and how of the platform, you own the why and for whom — and the two must be deeply integrated.
* Serve as the primary voice of the market inside product planning — bringing customer research, competitive data, and market sizing into roadmap discussions to ensure investment flows toward the highest-value opportunities.
* Co-own the product discovery process with Product leadership — designing and running customer research programs (user interviews, surveys, advisory boards) that generate the qualitative and quantitative signals needed to prioritize effectively.
* Translate product capabilities into market-ready value propositions for every significant release — working hand-in-hand with Product Managers to ensure new features land with clear messaging, adoption materials, and sales training.
* Maintain a continuous feedback loop between Sales, Customer Success, and Product — capturing field intelligence, win/loss themes, and customer sentiment and synthesizing it into structured quarterly product input reports.
* Define and track product marketing KPIs — feature adoption rates, enablement utilization, message resonance scores — and use these to continuously refine positioning and packaging recommendations.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Market Intelligence Velocity: Weekly competitive briefings delivered to leadership; automated reporting pipeline live within 90 days.
* Pricing Impact: Measurable improvement in ACV and win rates within 6 months of pricing strategy implementation; ≥2 pricing model updates per year informed by data.
* Portfolio Clarity: 100% of product lines have a documented packaging and tiering rationale; portfolio reviewed and updated quarterly.
* GTM Enablement: Competitive battlecards and pricing guides maintained for 100% of active competitors; ≥80% of sales reps rating intelligence materials as highly useful in quarterly surveys.
* Product Marketing Coverage: Full positioning and messaging framework documented and live within 60 days; all major product releases launched with complete go-to-market packages.
* Revenue Contribution: Research insights directly traceable to at least two new revenue-generating initiatives per year, including upsell opportunities or new segment entry.

**What you’ll need:**
**Must-Have Experience**

* 5–8+ years in competitive intelligence, market research, pricing strategy, or product strategy in a SaaS or technology-driven industry.
* Demonstrated track record developing and deploying pricing models that improved win rates, ACV, or NRR in a B2B context.
* Strong analytical skills — fluent in data and able to independently build financial models, analyze usage data, and synthesize qualitative and quantitative signals into crisp recommendations.
* Background in healthcare SaaS, health plan operations, or provider data — familiarity with credentialing, network management, or regulatory compliance a strong plus.
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams (Product, Sales, Finance, Marketing) and drive strategic decisions without direct authority.
* Exceptional communication and executive presentation skills — able to distill complex market dynamics into clear, compelling narratives for senior leadership and board-level audiences.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience building or scaling a competitive intelligence function from scratch, including designing research processes, tooling, and reporting cadences.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools to accelerate research workflows — e.g., automated monitoring, LLM-powered analysis, or data aggregation pipelines.
* Familiarity with usage-based or value-based pricing models, willingness-to-pay research methods, or conjoint analysis.

**Our Research & Culture Principles**

* Ground Truth First: No insight without validation. You talk to customers, prospects, and the market — you don’t just read reports.
* Insight to Action: Research without a recommended action is incomplete. You close the loop between intelligence and business impact.
* Low Ego, High Standards: Nothing is beneath you — you dive into the data, own the details, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes.
* Prioritize Relentlessly: The market generates infinite signals. You know which ones matter and focus your energy accordingly.
* Deliver A+ Work: “Good enough” is not our bar. The quality of your research reflects on Certify’s credibility with customers, investors, and partners.

**Benefits Of Working At Certify**

* At Certify, we’re building with intention and taking care of the people doing the work.
* Your well-being matters to us. We provide 100% coverage of health, dental, and vision insurance premiums for employees. Our US-based team benefits from unlimited PTO, with at least two weeks off each year to recharge. In India, employees are supported with health insurance, statutory leave benefits, and additional wellness (menstrual) leave for women.

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to do their best work, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences.
  
  
If you require reasonable accommodations during the application process, please contact recruiting@certifyos.com.
  
  
We are also committed to pay transparency and foster an open culture where compensation conversations are encouraged and respected.

title: Conversion UX Strategist
description:
Conversion UX Strategist – Landing Page Strategy & CRO

Job Description

We are looking for a **Conversion UX Strategist** who can independently research a client’s business, understand its target audience, and develop a complete landing page strategy focused on conversions.

You will translate business goals and campaign objectives into a clear landing page journey, deciding what information visitors need, how the content should flow, which objections must be addressed, and where calls to action should appear.

This is a **strategy-first role, not a website design or development role**. You should be comfortable conducting research, structuring content, writing strategic recommendations, explaining conversion decisions, and presenting your plan for client approval before design begins.

We value practical thinking, strong written communication, and the ability to create a well-reasoned landing page plan from scratch without relying on a ready-made layout or predefined section list.

What You’ll Do1. Business, Audience & Competitor Research

* Understand the client’s business model, products or services, target customers, and campaign objectives.
* Research the target audience, customer intent, pain points, motivations, objections, and decision-making factors.
* Analyze competitor landing pages and relevant market messaging to identify opportunities for differentiation.
* Determine what information potential customers need before taking action.
* Identify gaps in the available business information and ask focused questions to clarify the strategy.

2. Landing Page Strategy & Conversion Planning

* Plan the complete landing page journey from the first screen to the final call to action.
* Decide the most appropriate section structure and content sequence based on the campaign goal and customer intent.
* Define what visitors should understand, feel, and do at each stage of the page.
* Establish the messaging direction, content hierarchy, CTA placement, and conversion flow.
* Identify the trust signals, proof points, testimonials, case studies, credentials, and other credibility elements needed to build confidence.
* Address customer objections and information gaps through the recommended page structure.
* Develop the strategy independently rather than waiting for a client-provided layout, section list, or design reference.

3. Content Structure & Messaging Direction

* Define the purpose and required content of every recommended landing page section.
* Plan headline direction, supporting messages, benefit statements, proof points, and calls to action.
* Determine how product or service features should be communicated in terms of customer benefits and business value.
* Recommend the information hierarchy so visitors can understand the offer quickly and navigate the page logically.
* Ensure the messaging aligns with the audience, advertising campaign, offer, and desired conversion action.
* Provide clear content guidance that designers and AI design tools can use to turn the approved strategy into a landing page.

4. Strategy Documentation & Client Approval

Before design begins, prepare a structured Google Doc that presents the complete landing page strategy for client review and approval.

The document should cover:

* Client business overview and campaign objective
* Product or service being promoted
* Primary conversion goal and desired visitor action
* Target audience, customer intent, pain points, and objections
* Recommended landing page journey and section-by-section structure
* Purpose, content requirements, and information hierarchy of each section
* Messaging direction and headline recommendations
* CTA strategy and conversion flow
* Recommended trust, credibility, and proof elements
* Missing business information and questions requiring client input
* Strategic reasoning behind the proposed page structure and recommendations

You will explain why each major decision supports the client’s business objective and how the proposed page journey is intended to move visitors toward conversion.

5. Client Communication & Strategy Presentation

* Present landing page recommendations in clear, professional language.
* Explain the reasoning behind section order, messaging choices, CTA placement, and trust elements.
* Gather missing information from clients through focused questions.
* Incorporate relevant client feedback while maintaining a clear conversion strategy.
* Revise the strategy document based on feedback and secure approval before the design stage.
* Communicate the approved plan clearly to the team responsible for creating the landing page.

6. AI-Assisted Landing Page Workflow

* Prepare detailed, structured strategy documents that can be translated into landing pages using AI design tools.
* Ensure the approved strategy provides sufficient direction for page structure, content, messaging, and conversion elements.
* Review AI-generated page outputs against the approved strategy and identify gaps in the content flow or conversion logic.
* Recommend strategic improvements when the generated page does not adequately support the campaign objective.

Experience

Practical experience in conversion strategy, landing page planning, UX research, CRO, website content strategy, digital marketing strategy, or customer journey planning is preferred.

We are more interested in your **ability to independently develop a strong landing page strategy** than in your previous job title. Candidates who can demonstrate practical work, strategy documents, landing page analyses, or portfolio-quality thinking are encouraged to apply.

Who Can Apply

* Freshers and experienced candidates who can demonstrate strong strategic thinking and practical ability.
* Candidates with experience in landing page strategy, conversion rate optimization, UX research, content strategy, or digital marketing.
* Individuals who can research a business and its audience before recommending a page structure.
* Candidates who can plan a complete landing page journey from scratch without relying on templates or predefined layouts.
* People who can explain why each section, message, trust element, and CTA belongs on the page.
* Candidates with strong written communication and documentation skills.
* Individuals comfortable preparing structured Google Docs and presenting recommendations for client approval.
* Candidates interested in using AI design tools to turn approved strategies into landing pages.

Skills Required

* Landing page strategy and conversion planning
* Conversion rate optimization (CRO) fundamentals
* Business, audience, and competitor research
* Customer intent and objection analysis
* User journey and information architecture planning
* Content structuring and messaging strategy
* CTA strategy and conversion flow
* Trust and credibility element planning
* Strategic writing and Google Docs documentation
* Client communication and presentation
* Critical thinking and problem-solving
* AI-assisted landing page workflows

Important Role Clarification

This position is focused on **research, strategy, content planning, conversion logic, and client approval**. It is not primarily a graphic design, UI design, or website development role.

The ideal candidate can take a client brief, identify what is needed, ask the right questions, independently plan the full landing page, document and justify every major decision, and get the strategy approved before the page is designed using AI tools.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Food provided

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Anand Vihar, Delhi, Delhi: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Conversion UX Strategist - Funnel Planning · Landing Pages · AI-Assisted UI
description:
Conversion UX Strategist

**Funnel Planning · Landing Pages · AI-Assisted UI**

Please Read Before Applying

This is **not a traditional website designer or website developer role**. We are not looking for someone whose primary skill is building websites on WordPress, Shopify, or Wix, or writing HTML/CSS.

We need someone who thinks strategically before designing: understands the client's business, identifies the campaign goal, plans the complete visitor journey, and creates landing pages designed to generate enquiries.

**Strategy comes first. Design comes second. Conversions are the goal.**

About the Role

As a Conversion UX Strategist, you will plan and design landing pages for our digital advertising campaigns. You will research the client's product or service, understand the target audience, analyze competitors, and map the journey from an ad click to an enquiry.

Before starting the design, you will prepare a clear strategy document and wireframes for client approval. Once approved, you will use AI-assisted design tools to create mobile-first landing pages aligned with the campaign message.

You will also collaborate with the ads team and developers during launch, monitor performance, and recommend improvements to generate more qualified enquiries.

Key Responsibilities1. Business & Campaign Research

* Understand the client's business, primary product or service, unique selling proposition (USP), and competitive advantages.
* Identify the campaign objective, such as phone calls, WhatsApp enquiries, form submissions, or bookings.
* Understand the target audience, including their needs, pain points, expectations, objections, and reasons to trust a business.
* Review competitor landing pages and advertisements to identify gaps, useful insights, and opportunities for differentiation.
* Align the landing page strategy with the client's business goals and advertising campaign.

2. Conversion Funnel & User Journey Planning

* Plan the complete conversion journey from **ad → landing page → enquiry form → thank-you page**.
* Determine what visitors should see first and how each section should move them toward the desired action.
* Develop the page structure, including headlines, offers, benefits, trust signals, supporting content, and calls to action (CTAs).
* Decide which sections are necessary, what information each section should communicate, and how the content should be prioritized.
* Plan enquiry forms and conversion steps according to the campaign objective.
* Ensure the landing page message matches the advertisement that brings visitors to the page.
* Explain the conversion logic behind each major structural and messaging decision.

3. Strategy Documentation & Client Approval

* Prepare a clear, structured strategy document outlining the recommended landing page approach.
* Create wireframes that communicate the page layout, content hierarchy, section sequence, and conversion flow.
* Document the campaign goal, target audience, key messaging, USP, offer, CTAs, and trust elements.
* Explain why each section is included and how it supports the visitor's journey toward an enquiry.
* Share the strategy document and wireframes with the client for review and approval before design begins.
* Identify missing information and ask the client relevant questions before finalizing the plan.
* Incorporate feedback and refine the strategy when required.

4. AI-Assisted Landing Page Design

* Use AI-assisted design tools to turn approved strategies and wireframes into landing page UI designs.
* Create mobile-first layouts that are clear, user-friendly, and aligned with the campaign objective.
* Maintain consistency between the ad message, landing page content, offer, and CTA.
* Apply conversion-focused principles to content hierarchy, page flow, readability, and user experience.
* Ensure the final design follows the approved strategy rather than starting with a template or visual concept.

5. Launch Coordination & Conversion Optimization

* Coordinate with the advertising team and developers to support landing page launch.
* Ensure the intended enquiry actions and tracking requirements are communicated clearly.
* Work with the relevant team members to support enquiry tracking for calls, WhatsApp, forms, or bookings.
* Review post-launch performance and available conversion data.
* Identify potential friction points and recommend changes to improve enquiry generation.
* Suggest improvements to page messaging, structure, forms, CTAs, and user journey based on campaign results.

Required Skills & Experience

* Strong understanding of conversion-focused landing pages and funnel planning.
* Ability to understand business goals, campaign objectives, customer intent, and target audiences.
* Experience planning landing pages for paid advertising campaigns.
* Knowledge of landing page structure, wireframes, content hierarchy, CTAs, and trust-building elements.
* Ability to analyze competitor pages and advertising messages.
* Strong research, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to prepare clear strategy documents and wireframes that clients can understand and approve.
* Confidence in explaining the reasoning behind page structure and design decisions.
* Practical familiarity with AI tools for wireframing and UI design.
* Understanding of mobile-first design and enquiry tracking.
* Ability to collaborate with advertising teams and developers during implementation.

Who Should Apply?

This role is suitable for candidates with experience or skills in:

* Conversion rate optimization (CRO)
* UX strategy and user journey mapping
* Landing page and funnel planning
* Conversion-focused UI/UX design
* Digital marketing and paid advertising funnels
* AI-assisted wireframing and interface design
* Landing page performance analysis

Candidates must be comfortable handling both **strategic planning and AI-assisted page design**. Pure design execution without an understanding of conversion goals is not sufficient.

This Role Is NOT for You If

* Your primary work is building websites on WordPress, Shopify, or Wix, or coding in HTML/CSS.
* You begin projects by choosing a template or creating the visual design before understanding the business goal.
* Your portfolio contains only website screenshots without explaining the objective, strategy, or outcomes.
* You have never prepared a landing page plan or strategy document for a client.
* You cannot explain why particular sections, messages, trust elements, or CTAs are included on a page.

This Role IS for You If

* You ask, **"What is the goal, and who is the audience?"** before opening a design tool.
* You can independently plan the journey from an advertisement to a completed enquiry.
* You understand why each landing page section exists and how it contributes to conversion.
* You have planned landing pages for advertising campaigns and can discuss their enquiry or conversion performance.
* You can prepare a clear, practical strategy document that a client can review and approve.
* You are comfortable using AI tools to create wireframes and UI designs efficiently.
* You use research, campaign objectives, customer needs, and performance data to guide your decisions.

Portfolio Expectations

Applicants should be prepared to demonstrate landing page projects that show more than the final design. Relevant examples should explain:

* The client's business and campaign objective.
* The target audience and key customer insights.
* The planned funnel and landing page structure.
* The reasoning behind the messaging, sections, trust elements, and CTAs.
* The wireframes or strategy document, where available.
* The results achieved, such as enquiries or conversion performance, where available.

Role Objective

Your primary objective is to **plan, design, and improve landing pages that turn advertising traffic into enquiries**.

Success means understanding the business before designing, producing a strategy the client can approve, creating a page aligned with the campaign, and using post-launch results to recommend meaningful improvements.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Food provided

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Customer Intelligence Analyst
description:
We are looking for a highly analytical and curious
**Customer Intelligence Analyst**
who will help our teams better understand how customers experience our products.
  
  
This role goes beyond traditional reporting and analytics. The successful candidate will act as a
**Customer Reality Champion**
, connecting customer feedback, product usage data, operational signals, UX research insights, and validation findings into a clear and actionable understanding of customer experience.
  
  
The ideal candidate is not only skilled at working with data but also passionate about uncovering patterns, identifying meaningful signals, and helping teams make better decisions. They will collaborate closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, Engineers, Customer Success teams, and Experience Validation specialists to surface insights that improve customer outcomes and drive product decisions.
  
  
This role is critical to scaling Product Experience across the organization by transforming fragmented information into reusable intelligence that teams can leverage throughout the product lifecycle.
  
  
**Responsibilities And Deliverables**

* Connect customer feedback, product usage data, operational signals, UX research findings, and validation insights into a unified intelligence view
* Design and maintain taxonomies, classifications, and information structures that enable consistent analysis across products and portfolios
* Extract, clean, combine, and analyze data from various sources including APIs, analytics platforms, operational systems, exports, and internal repositories
* Identify trends, patterns, experience gaps, adoption challenges, and opportunities across customer workflows
* Distinguish meaningful customer and product signals from noise, incomplete information, and collection artifacts
* Partner with UX, Product Management, Engineering, Customer Success, and Experience Validation teams to support evidence-based decision making
* Create repeatable approaches for organizing and scaling customer intelligence across portfolios
* Translate complex data and findings into clear, actionable recommendations for business and technical stakeholders
* Support experience measurement and validation initiatives through intelligence gathering and analysis
* Develop and maintain documentation, standards, definitions, and intelligence assets that improve organizational understanding
* Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate analysis and knowledge synthesis while maintaining appropriate quality controls
* Identify opportunities to improve how customer insights, experience data, and operational signals are captured and leveraged across the organization
* Contribute to post-release analysis and ongoing monitoring of customer experience outcomes

**ORGANIZATIONAL ALIGNMENT**

* Reports to the Senior Manager, User Experience
* Works closely with UX Designers, Product Managers, Engineers, Customer Success, Implementation teams, and Experience Validation specialists
* Partners closely with the PXV Enablement Specialist to support scalable validation and customer understanding practices
* Willing to work across time zones

**Qualifications**
**SKILLS & WORK TRAITS**

* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to identify meaningful patterns across multiple data sources
* Ability to create structure from ambiguous, incomplete, or inconsistent information
* Experience developing taxonomies, classifications, frameworks, or information models
* Excellent communication and documentation skills with the ability to translate findings into actionable insights
* Strong problem-solving skills and intellectual curiosity
* Self-starter who is comfortable working in a greenfield environment with evolving requirements
* Ability to collaborate effectively across Product, UX, Engineering, Customer Success, and Validation teams
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity and independently investigating problems
* Values-driven, curious, and proactive in identifying opportunities to improve customer outcomes
* Strong judgment and healthy skepticism when interpreting data and AI-generated outputs

**TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES**
**Required**

* Strong SQL skills for querying and analyzing data
* Experience using Python for data analysis, transformation, or automation
* Experience gathering and analyzing data from multiple systems and sources
* Ability to work with structured and semi-structured datasets
* Experience documenting findings, insights, and data definitions
* Familiarity with modern AI tools and AI-assisted workflows

**Preferred**

* Experience with Google Analytics, BigQuery, Gong, New Relic, Salesforce, ServiceNow, or similar platforms
* Experience with customer intelligence, product intelligence, or business intelligence initiatives
* Experience creating taxonomies, metadata models, knowledge structures, or information architectures
* Experience supporting AI, search, retrieval, or knowledge-management initiatives
* Enterprise SaaS experience
* Experience working with highly configurable, multi-tenant software platforms

**Experience Required**

* 4+ years of experience in analytics, customer intelligence, product intelligence, business analysis, research operations, product operations, or a related field. Equivalent combinations of experience and demonstrated capability will be considered.
* Demonstrated experience transforming multiple data sources into actionable business insights
* Experience working directly with product, customer, or operational data
* Experience presenting findings and recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders
* Proven ability to independently investigate complex questions using qualitative and quantitative information
* Experience working in collaborative, cross-functional product organizations

title: Founder's Office Intern
description:
**About BiteSpeed**

Hey there! We are a
**Sequoia-backed SaaS startup**
building an AI-native Marketing, Support & Sales suite for e-commerce brands.

We’re currently working with
**2500+ e-commerce brands**
globally across 50+ countries and are fortunate to have
**raised $5.5M+**
along the journey with marquee investors like Sequoia Capital India, Kunal Shah, Gaurav Munjal & more backing us.

💡
**Read more about our mission and the story of commerce here!**

**Check out more about us here**
- https://www.bitespeed.co/ and do read through our 200+ odd 5-star reviews to get a sense of what our customers say about us (we openly brag about this 😉).

**We’ve had some solid investors back us**
(making it easier for you to stalk us since you’d do this anyway) -

Ecommerce AI startup BiteSpeed raised USD 3.5 million

E-commerce AI start-up BiteSpeed raises $3.5 million funding led by Peak XV’s Surge

BiteSpeed Raises $1.9 Million Seed Funding From Sequoia India's Surge

**About the role**

Some problems at BiteSpeed have a clear owner, a clear process and a clear answer. This role is for the ones that don't.

We're looking for a
**Founder’s Office Intern**
who enjoys figuring things out. You could be working on a market research project in the morning, analysing a business problem in the afternoon and building a simple process or automation by evening. The common thread is that you'll be expected to
**take an ambiguous problem, break it down and make something happen.**

You'll work closely with the founders and leadership team across different parts of the business. This isn't a role where you'll have a neatly defined job description or do the same thing every day. You'll get exposure to
**strategy, operations, product, GTM, AI and whatever else is important to the business at that point in time.**

**What you’ll do**

* Work closely with the founders on
  **high-priority business problems**
  across functions.

* Take ambiguous questions and turn them into
  **structured problems, analyses and actionable next steps**
  .

* Conduct market, customer and competitor research to help the team make better decisions.
* Analyse business data, identify patterns and translate them into insights.

* Build simple processes, systems, dashboards or automations to solve recurring problems.

* Work with different teams across
  **Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Success and Operations**
  to get things moving.

* Take ownership of projects from
  **figuring out what needs to be done to actually getting it done**
  .

* Identify bottlenecks and ask, "Why are we doing this manually?" or "Is there a better way to do this?"

* Support strategic projects that could range from
  **new market research to GTM experiments, AI use cases, process improvements and special projects**
  .

* Present your thinking clearly to founders and leadership, including what you found, what you recommend and why.

* Learn fast, switch contexts quickly and get comfortable working on problems where the answer isn't obvious.

**What makes you a good fit**

* You naturally enjoy
  **solving problems**
  . Give you a messy question and your first instinct is to figure out how to break it down.

* You're a
  **generalist at heart**
  . You don't need a perfectly defined function to do good work.

* You're highly curious and enjoy learning about how businesses work.

* You have strong
  **analytical and structured thinking**
  and can work comfortably with numbers and data.

* You have high agency. If something needs to get done, you don't wait around for someone to tell you exactly how.

* You're comfortable saying,
  **"I don't know, but I'll figure it out."**

* You communicate clearly and can put your thoughts into a simple, compelling story.

* You're comfortable working with ambiguity and changing priorities.

* You care about the quality of your work, but don't get stuck trying to make everything perfect.

* You're excited by startups and would rather have
  **ownership over a problem than a fancy job title**
  .

* Prior experience in startups, consulting, strategy, product, operations, entrepreneurship or similar is a plus, but
  **we care more about how you think than what's on your resume.**

**Salary and Location**

**Location:**
Bangalore

**Expected CTC:**
We pay top of market for the right folks and also offer generous equity (ESOP) to everyone in the team

**Our Way Of Life**

Over time we’ve realised that while we’re super excited about shaping the future of commerce, a big part of why people join us and stick with us is because they resonate with our way of life. You could call it work culture - but it ends up becoming more than just that.

It’s taken us time to discover and articulate what our culture feels like, this evolving document is an attempt to candidly share what it’s like working at BiteSpeed.

**Our Purpose**

At BiteSpeed, work is personal. You could blame this on us being existential, but most of us are spending the best years of our lives doing this and we want to be purposeful about the kind of workplace we’re trying to create. Our purpose is about why we’re here and what we care about:-

* **Personal Transformation:**
  We like to think of BiteSpeed as being a gym for our careers. It’s where we come to do great work we can be proud of and push ourselves in the pursuit of excellence. Is it comfortable? No. Is it painful? Sometimes. Is it fulfilling? Yes. We were never the company that was supposed to win - We started out of a dorm room, solo founder, early engineers who hadn’t written code in their lives setting out to build a global SaaS company. Our roots are in doing things we are unqualified for and we bet on people who want that journey for themselves. There are stories of people across the company from a 20 year old who’s never done sales closing enterprise deals to a college intern owning an enterprise product lifecycle - these are the stories we are proud of. If someone can look back after 2 years of working at BiteSpeed and say they don’t identify with who they were, we’d call it a success and we want to help them get there.

* **Wealth Creation:**
  Somehow most companies are shy about wanting to make money. It’s looked at as this thing which everyone does but no one really talks about. We’re not ashamed of doing it for the money. Wealth unlocks choice. If life is an amusement park, we think there is value to getting an unlimited rides pass. It's purposeful for us to try to create wealth that allows people to achieve their life's dreams - whether that's owning a house or booking a dream vacation for their parents. We do this by ensuring everyone in the team gets equity and there are generous cash & equity bumps on a frequent basis to reward performance and alignment in values.

* **Winning Together:**
  We’re not here for a participation certificate. We’re playing to win. The keyword here is ‘together’. Winning ‘together’ is about recognising it’s a team sport. We don't care about man of the match awards, either we win the trophy or we don’t. There is a certain camaraderie that comes with winning together that’s hard to explain, but it’s deeply fulfilling and energising. The question we ask ourselves is - can we play the game like it’s never been played before?

**Our Values**

Our values are about how we do what we do. Values define the right thing to do. We hire, reward and sometimes have to let go based on our values. We have 5 core values:-

* **Go Above And Beyond:**
  We value people who care about doing a good job. Going above and beyond is about doing more than the bare minimum that gets the job done and raising the bar each time we have the opportunity to do so

* **Making Things Happen:**
  Each company has an operating rhythm and this is that for us. Making things happen is the opposite of being passive. It’s about high agency, about always believing there is a way to get what we want and either finding the way or making the way

* **Say It Like It Is:**
  We are candid and direct when it comes to sharing feedback, transparent with our numbers and intellectually honest about the realities of any business situation

* **Progress Over Perfection:**
  We’re not building rockets. We care about moving fast and iterating towards perfection. We like to take a minimum viable approach to prioritisation and problem solving and actively look for 80/20 solutions

* **Don’t Take Yourself Seriously, Take Your Work Seriously:**
  Great things are built when people can contribute to pursuits beyond themselves. Being low ego, not needing praise to do a good job, taking feedback with humility, being self-critical all add up to this

**Perks & Benefits**

Small things we’ve done to ensure we take care of our wellness, learning & keep things fun:-

* **Health Insurance**
  - Health insurance cover and accident coverage for extra cushion and mental peace when rainy days hit us.
* **Quarterly Off-sites**
  - Quarterly off-sites are a core part of the BiteSpeed culture. Our off-sites range from intense quarter planning sessions to crazy mafia nights and competitive cricket matches (with a lot of trash talking).
* **Cult Fitness Membership**
  - All work and no play makes jack a dull boy. Cult Fit and Cult Play passes to make sure we hit the gym more often.
* **Personal Development**
  - We sponsor courses, conference tickets, books on a case to case basis to ensure we’re constantly growing.
* **Salary In Advance**
  - Trust first, by default. We pay out salaries in the first week of the month.

**How to apply?**

If this sounds interesting
**drop a personal note**
with why you'd want to work with us and what makes you a good fit on
**nikita@bitespeed.co**
. Tell us about something you shipped that you’re particularly proud of (could be due to quality or constraints or anything that made it valuable for you).

Know someone who might be a great fit?
**Refer them to us**
, if they end up joining we'll send you an
**Apple Airpods Pro**
as a gesture of thanks!

For any queries feel free to write to talent@bitespeed.co.

title: Product Operations Associate
description:
Swish is building the next generation of food delivery by owning the entire value chain, from menu design and pricing to kitchen operations and customer experience. Backed by leading investors, we're building the future of food delivery by continuously launching new products, expanding into new markets, and creating innovative operating models.

You’ll sit at the intersection of
**Product, Engineering, and Operations**
, ensuring what we build ships well, works on the ground, and drives business impact.

* **Analytics:**
  Measure the impact of product launches through data, identify what worked and what didn’t, and turn insights into clear actions.
* **Program Management:**
  Work closely with Product and Operations teams on testing, rollout RCAs, and execution, turning on-ground learnings into product improvements.

**What You’ll Do**

**Measure product impact through data**

Define success metrics before each launch, such as conversion, order frequency, delivery time, cancellations, and ratings. Build dashboards to track adoption and health after go-live, run pre/post and A/B analyses, and write concise readouts with clear recommendations to scale, iterate, or roll back.

**Program-manage product launches**

Own launch plans from start to finish, including timelines, owners, dependencies, readiness checklists, and go/no-go calls. Coordinate across Product, Tech, Operations, Rider Operations, and Support, while tracking product-related issues and enhancements during scale-up.

**Run product testing**

title: Senior Researcher, Device & Platform Intelligence
description:
Senior Researcher, Device & Platform Intelligence

**Location:**
Hyderabad

About the Role

We are looking for a senior researcher who owns the platform side of our device research strategy — how iOS, Android, browsers, CDNs, and network protocols expose signal that can be used to identify and contextualise a device. You will own research directions end-to-end: forming hypotheses about new signal sources, building prototypes and research tooling, validating findings, and partnering with product and engineering to graduate proven concepts into production.

This role is a company-wide subject-matter expert for platform-level research, sitting alongside a parallel researcher focused on adversarial detection (bots, anti-detect tooling, and threat actors), and collaborating with our data science function for signal modelling and productionisation.

What You Will Do

* Own research strategy for cross-domain device identity discovery across browser, native mobile app, network, and AI-agent surfaces.
* Track Apple and Android developer/product documentation, App Store and Play Store policy changes, OS betas, and browser vendor roadmaps to anticipate changes that affect signal availability — before they ship.
* Research web protocol innovation beyond JavaScript: HTTP semantics, TLS and network fingerprints, client hints, privacy sandbox mechanisms, and emerging browser standards, and their implications for device identification.
* Explore deployment directly into CDNs to observe traffic in flight across a client's entire estate, extending signal collection beyond the endpoint to the network path itself.
* Develop lightweight collectors that simplify deployment, maximise digital interaction coverage, and capture a growing set of digital attributes.
* Track the agentic AI ecosystem (MCP and similar agent protocols, agent architectures) and how agentic clients interact with web and API surfaces, identifying where cross-domain device identity needs to extend to agent traffic.
* Build proof-of-concept collectors and research tooling; document findings; hand validated techniques to engineering for product development.
* Partner with the data science function to translate raw signal discoveries into features and inputs for production models; you are not responsible for building or maintaining those models.
* Serve as the company-wide subject-matter expert for platform-level (iOS/Android/browser/network) research; produce detailed internal documentation.

Experience

* 8+ years in software engineering or platform/security research, with at least 3 years in a research-oriented role.

Tech Skills — Must Have

* Deep expertise in at least two of: native mobile app development at scale (iOS/Android SDKs, App Store/Play environments), browser internals and web protocols, network-level fingerprinting, or CDN architecture.
* Strong CDN knowledge — understanding of how content delivery networks route, cache, and terminate traffic, and how they could be used as a deployment point to observe traffic in flight.
* Demonstrated experience going beyond documented APIs — mining developer documentation, OS release notes, and standards proposals to discover signal opportunities and predict environment changes.
* Experience developing lightweight collectors that simplify deployment, maximise digital interaction coverage, and capture a growing set of digital attributes.
* Strong programming skills in JavaScript/TypeScript plus at least one of Swift, Kotlin, or Go; comfort writing non-production proof-of-concept code quickly.
* Ability to turn ambiguous problem statements into clear experiments with measurable outcomes; strong written and verbal communication in English.

Tech Skills — Nice to Have

* Familiarity with privacy regulation and privacy-preserving signal design (consent frameworks, on-device processing).
* Working knowledge of the agentic AI ecosystem: MCP or similar agent protocols, and how agentic clients interact with web and API surfaces.
* Exposure to reverse engineering or threat analysis, even if not the primary focus of past roles.

title: Founders Office Intern
description:
**Founder’s Office Intern – India**

**Job Description | Pramaanit**

**About**
**Pramaanit**

Pramaanit is building a global trust and verification infrastructure focused on verified identity, student credential verification, digital trust, eSign integrations, compliance workflows, and blockchain-backed verification systems for enterprises, universities, governments, and regulated industries.

We are looking for highly driven Founder’s Office Interns who want first-hand exposure to building a fast-scaling startup from the ground up.

The role involves working directly with the founders across strategy, operations, partnerships, market research, product execution, investor readiness, and growth initiatives. Founder’s Office roles in startups are typically high-agency, cross-functional positions designed to expand founder bandwidth and drive execution across the company.

**Role: Founder’s Office Intern**

**Location:**
India (Remote / Hybrid)

**Duration:**
6 Months

**Type:**
Internship

**Reporting To:**
Founder & Core Leadership Team

**Role Overview**

As a Founder’s Office Intern at Pramaanit, you will work directly with the founders on high-priority strategic and operational initiatives. This is not a conventional internship — you will be involved in real business decisions, product launches, GTM initiatives, partnerships, and market expansion projects.

This role is ideal for candidates who thrive in ambiguity, enjoy solving problems, and want exposure to startup building, business strategy, and execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy & Research**

* Conduct market research across India, UK, Singapore, and global markets
* Analyze competitors in identity verification, eSign, blockchain, RegTech, EdTech, and compliance sectors
* Support preparation of GTM strategies, expansion plans, and business models
* Build reports, dashboards, and strategic presentations

**Founder Support**

* Work closely with founders on daily business priorities
* Coordinate cross-functional projects and ensure execution timelines are met
* Assist in investor decks, partnership proposals, and business documentation
* Participate in leadership discussions and internal reviews

**Operations & Execution**

* Help streamline operational workflows
* Coordinate with product, tech, marketing, and sales teams
* Track KPIs and prepare weekly progress reports
* Support hiring, vendor coordination, and ecosystem outreach

**Growth & Partnerships**

* Research universities, enterprises, and ecosystem partners
* Support outbound outreach campaigns
* Assist in partnership onboarding and relationship management
* Identify new business opportunities and strategic collaborations

**Product & Innovation**

* Gather user feedback and market insights
* Assist in product testing and documentation
* Support product launch initiatives and pilot programs
* Work on AI, blockchain, identity, and verification use cases

**What We’re Looking For**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent communication and presentation abilities
* High ownership mindset and execution capability
* Ability to work in fast-paced startup environments
* Curiosity about startups, technology, AI, blockchain, identity systems, or compliance ecosystems
* Comfortable handling ambiguity and multitasking

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Pursuing or recently completed:
* MBA
* Engineering
* Business / Economics
* Technology / Data-related programs
* Prior internship/startup experience is a plus
* Familiarity with Excel, PowerPoint, Notion, Canva, or project management tools

**What You’ll Gain**

* Direct mentorship from startup founders
* Exposure to fundraising, strategy, GTM, and startup operations
* Opportunity to work on global-scale trust infrastructure products
* Hands-on experience across multiple business functions
* Potential pathway to PPO / full-time Founder’s Office Associate role

**Ideal Candidate Traits**

* Entrepreneurial mindset
* Strong ownership mentality
* Fast learner
* Structured thinker
* Detail-oriented executor
* Comfortable taking initiative without constant supervision

**Compensation**

* Stipend: Based on experience and skill set
* Performance-based incentives / PPO opportunities
* Certificate & recommendation upon successful completion

title: Manager, Product Design: Application Observability
description: We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!Your opportunityNew Relic is hiring an on-site design manager for our Hyderabad team, leading design for Application Performance Monitoring (APM) and Log Management — two of the platform's most used products. APM gives engineering teams full-stack visibility across their applications: connecting traces, metrics, and infrastructure data so they can find what's breaking and understand why. Log Management is where engineers go to make sense of raw data at scale — ingesting, parsing, and querying log data across their entire stack, without the operational overhead of managing it separately. These are the products engineers open when something is on fire, which means the design work is high-stakes and high-visibility.This is an on-site role in Hyderabad. Many of the engineers and product managers you'll partner with are there too, and being present — in standups, reviews, and the quick conversations before a decision gets made — is part of how you'll build the relationships that make design effective. You'll also work closely with design, product, and engineering partners in the US and Spain, so operating across time zones and communicating well in writing are part of the job, not an afterthought.You'll manage a small team of designers, own the quality of design work across APM and Logs, and stay close enough to the craft to contribute directly when it matters. If you've led a small design team on complex technical products and want clear ownership of both the work and the people — this is that role.What you'll doManage and develop your designers — run consistent 1:1s including regular career development conversations, give direct and specific feedback, set clear expectations for each person, and invest in their growth. Build a team culture where people feel they belong and different perspectives are welcome. You'll represent your team in calibration conversations and advocate for their work and careers within the broader design org.Own design quality across APM and Logs — review work critically, raise problems before they reach partners, and make sure the team is solving the right problems at the right level of craft. You're accountable for what ships.Keep the user's perspective in the conversation — design managers at New Relic are the voice of the user in product and engineering discussions. You bring user needs and research insights into roadmap conversations, not just design reviews.Partner with PM and Engineering — work with your product and engineering counterparts as a peer. Hold the design perspective, push back when the direction needs it, and communicate design's value in terms of outcomes the business tracks: adoption, retention, time to value.Keep the team focused and on track — manage incoming work, maintain visibility into what's in flight, help the team balance competing priorities, and set clear expectations with PM and Engineering partners about what's possible and when.Help your team use AI well — stay curious about tools like Figma AI, Claude, and Gemini and how they can help your designers work better: faster exploration, smarter prototyping, better research synthesis. Roll up your sleeves when it's the right call; delegate when it isn't.Hire well — contribute to recruiting when the team has open roles. Use each hire to bring in diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and build the kind of team where different viewpoints make the work better.Connect Hyderabad to the rest of the design org — bridge your team to design, product, and engineering partners in the US and Spain. We work hard to make everyone feel comfortable bringing their best, most authentic selves to work every day. We celebrate our talented Relics’ different backgrounds and abilities, and recognize the different paths they took to reach us – including nontraditional ones. Their experiences and perspectives inspire us to make our products and company the best they can be. We’re looking for people who feel connected to our mission and values, not just candidates who check off all the boxes.If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruiting process, please reach out to resume@newrelic.com.We believe in empowering all Relics to achieve professional and business success through a flexible workforce model. This model allows us to work in a variety of workplaces that best support our success, including fully office-based, fully remote, or hybrid.Our hiring processIn compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work and to complete employment eligibility verification. Note: Our stewardship of the data of thousands of customers means that a criminal background check is required to join New Relic.We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records based on individual circumstances and in accordance with applicable law including, but not limited to, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. New Relic does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes, and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with New Relic.New Relic develops and distributes encryption software and technology that complies with U.S. export controls and licensing requirements. Certain New Relic roles require candidates to pass an export compliance assessment as a condition of employment in any global location. If relevant, we will provide more information later in the application process.Candidates are evaluated based on qualifications, regardless of race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, age, disability, neurodiversity, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other legally protected characteristics.Review our Applicant Privacy Notice at https://newrelic.com/termsandconditions/applicant-privacy-policy

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
**Overview**
Are you passionate about using data, experimentation, and analytics to shape product strategy and customer experiences? Do you enjoy helping teams make better decisions through evidence, measurement, and actionable insights? Does the opportunity to influence products used by millions of customers through data-driven recommendations excite you? If so, we would love to talk to you.
  
  
We are the Data & Applied Sciences team for Windows in Hyderabad, India. Our mission is to use data science, analytics, experimentation, and measurement to inform decision making, improve customer experiences, and maximize business impact across the Windows ecosystem. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Research, and business stakeholders to answer critical questions, evaluate investments, measure outcomes, and influence product strategy.
  
  
We're looking for an experienced
**Senior Data Scientist**
to help drive product and business decisions through data-driven insights, experimentation, measurement frameworks, and advanced analytics for experiences running on Windows devices worldwide.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As a Senior Data Scientist, you will tackle complex business and product challenges by applying analytical rigor, statistical techniques, experimentation, and data-driven thinking. You will partner closely with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities, evaluate product investments, measure customer impact, and influence strategic decisions.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities Will Include**

* Developing analytical frameworks that help teams understand customer behavior, product health, engagement trends, and growth opportunities.
* Identifying actionable insights and translating them into recommendations that influence product strategy and prioritization.
* Measuring the impact of product launches, feature investments, and strategic initiatives.

* Bachelor's Degree or higher in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Mathematics, or another quantitative discipline.
* 8+ years of experience in Data Science, Analytics, Applied Statistics, or a related field.
* Experience applying statistical inference, predictive modeling, forecasting, and quantitative analysis to solve business and product challenges.
* Deep experience in experimentation, A/B testing, causal inference, and statistical analysis.
* Experience designing and operationalizing product, customer, or business success metrics.
* Experience working with large-scale data platforms such as Spark, Hadoop, Cosmos, or similar technologies.
* Solid programming skills in Python, SQL, C#, Java, or similar languages.

* Exceptional collaboration, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

* Passion for mentoring others and continuously learning emerging analytical and AI-related techniques.

* Experience building executive-facing narratives and communicating complex analytical findings in a simple, actionable manner.

title: Quality Control (QC) – Culling Expert
description:
At Aftershoot, we’re building a global community of photographers who spend less time behind their screens and more time behind the lens. Every feature we create, every update we ship, is designed to make post-processing easier, faster, and smarter for photographers around the world.
  
  
From culling to editing to retouching. Our AI tools do all the heavy lifting, so photographers can focus on what they do best: capturing moments, telling stories, and creating magic.
  
  
We’re a fast-growing, passionate team backed over 100K+ active users globally. Double-digit ARR in less than 4 years, amazing investors and team who truly believe in our mission.
  
  
Our mission is clear: Become the default companion for every photographer in the world.
  
  
If you care deeply about building meaningful products, working with curious and driven teammates, and being part of a team that genuinely loves what they do, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
Let’s create the future of AI in photography, together.
  
  
**About The Role**
This role focuses on
**quality, critique, and real-world photography workflows**
.
  
  
As a QC, you will review labelled data and AI outputs inside the Aftershoot app, evaluating them from a photographer’s perspective. You’ll help identify gaps between what photographers expect and what the product currently delivers.
  
  
If you’ve used multiple photography tools and enjoy giving thoughtful, structured feedback on image selections and product behaviour, this role is for you.
  
  
**💼 What you’ll do:**

* Perform quality checks on labelled datasets and flag errors or inconsistencies
* Review AI culling outputs within the Aftershoot app
* Critique selections from a photographer’s point of view
* Identify edge cases, failure patterns, and quality gaps
* Provide clear, actionable feedback to improve labelling standards
* Share suggestions to improve product behaviour and culling logic
* Collaborate with ML and Product teams to align outputs with real photographer workflows

**🫂What You’ll Bring**

* Professional photography experience or deep hands-on usage of photography tools
* Strong understanding of real-world photography workflows
* Experience using other culling or editing tools (Lightroom, Photo Mechanic, etc.)
* Ability to critique image selections and explain why something works or doesn’t
* Strong attention to detail and structured thinking
* Comfort working from the Delhi office on a full time basis

**What happens after you apply?**

* Step 1: If your profile aligns with our vibe and requirements for the role, our people team will reach out to you for a brief phone call.
* Step 2: If everything aligns, your next chat will be with one of your future team members to better understand the role and your experience.
* Step 3: You will then be given a task - this helps us evaluate your thought process and help you showcase your expertise.
* Step 4: If everything goes well, you will meet the leadership for a quick bar-raiser round.
* Step 5: If you do manage to clear all rounds, this is the point we make an offer, shake hands, and welcome you to the team.

y

title: CRO Specialist
description:
**About the role**

Axeno’s conversion rate optimization (CRO) and experimentation practice helps enterprise clients grow website conversion. We turn analytics evidence into prioritised experiments and personalized experiences, and prove the business impact.

As Scrum Master & CRO Specialist you are the analytical and delivery lead of a CRO squad. You own journey analysis, drop-off diagnosis, hypotheses, experiment design and KPI interpretation, and you run the sprint cadence that keeps every cycle on time, evidence-backed and decision-ready. You will also strengthen the practice by evolving the playbooks, templates and ways of working we reuse across clients.

**What you will do**

**CRO and insights**

•   
**Journey and funnel analysis.**
Analyse the end-to-end website journey in Adobe Analytics. Build funnels, fallout and cohort views by source, device and new vs returning traffic.

•   
**Drop-off diagnosis.**
Combine quantitative funnels with session replay, heatmaps, zoning and journey analysis from Microsoft Clarity and Contentsquare to explain friction.

•   
**Hypotheses.**
Produce focused insight briefs with ranked hypotheses, each with evidence, affected audience and a primary KPI.

•   
**Experiment design.**
Specify tests (A/B, experience targeting, personalization rules) with primary KPI, eligible audience, minimum detectable effect, allocation, control and decision window. Report absolute and relative effect with uncertainty and guardrails, and call “continue learning” when the evidence says so.

•   
**Measurement integrity.**
Define and maintain a measurement contract: journey events, experiment IDs, and reconciliation across SDK, analytics and server/CRM counts. Link website conversions to downstream lead quality.

•   
**Reporting.**
Maintain KPI dashboards covering conversion, lead quality and guardrails (Core Web Vitals, form reliability, personalization delivery, data integrity).

•   
**Activation partnership.**
Work with personalization and engineering specialists on Adobe Target and Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization campaigns: targeting logic, preview and tracking QA, rollout and rollback.

**Scrum and delivery**

•   
Run a fortnightly delivery cycle: evidence mining, test agreement, build and verify, release and review. Facilitate planning, daily check-ins, backlog refinement, reviews and retrospectives.

•   
Own the prioritised backlog and a written decision log (launch, continue, revise, stop, escalate). Prioritise by opportunity, effort and traffic using a framework such as ICE or PIE.

•   
Track dependencies on client platform, data and BAU teams (access, consent, SDK, approved content). Raise blockers and risks early, and keep acceptance evidence for every deliverable.

•   
Be the day-to-day contact for client marketing and digital stakeholders. Present readouts in plain business language, without overclaiming uplift.

**Practice contribution**

•   
Maintain and improve reusable assets: hypothesis and experiment brief templates, QA checklists, KPI frameworks, dashboards and a CRO operating playbook.

•   
Support pre-sales and proposals with CRO approach, scoping and case studies. Coach junior analysts and personalization specialists across the team.

**﻿
Must-have requirements**

**Non-negotiable**

Agency or consulting background with client-facing experience.
