title: Business and Growth Intern
description:
Business & Growth Intern

Duration: 6 Months

Start Date: Immediate

Location: Kolkata

Company: PopLotus (Nutralike Superfoods Pvt. Ltd.)

Role Summary

PopLotus is a growing Indian snacking brand focused on building the next generation of premium, better-for-you makhana products. As a Business & Growth Intern, you will work closely with the core team across multiple functions of the business and gain hands-on exposure to how a consumer brand is built and scaled.

This is a high-ownership, cross-functional role designed for someone who wants to understand the complete business rather than work within a single function. Your responsibilities will span e-commerce and quick commerce, exports and foreign trade, business analytics, marketing and brand building, general trade, logistics, and HR/business operations.

You will be expected to take ownership of projects, work with data, identify opportunities, coordinate with external partners, and contribute directly to business decisions.

What Success Looks Like
  

Success in this role means becoming someone the core team can rely on to independently take a problem, analyse it, execute a solution, and measure the outcome.

By the end of the internship, you should have developed a strong understanding of how a consumer/FMCG business operates across online, offline, domestic and international channels, while having contributed tangible results to PopLotus' growth.

Responsibilities
  

* Support the growth and management of PopLotus across e-commerce and quick-commerce platforms, including marketplace operations, catalogue management, pricing, promotions, inventory and platform performance.
* Analyse sales, customer, SKU and channel-level data to identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement, and translate insights into actionable business recommendations.
* Assist in developing and maintaining data-driven dashboards and reports to track sales, margins, inventory, channel performance and other key business metrics.
* Support foreign trade and export development, including identifying potential buyers and distributors, researching international markets, generating leads, coordinating samples, and assisting with export documentation and follow-ups.
* Research international markets data to identify potential opportunities for Indian makhana and better-for-you snacking products, including competitor, pricing and market analysis.
* Contribute to brand building and marketing initiatives, including campaign planning, content coordination, market research, consumer insights and competitor tracking.
* Assist in expanding PopLotus' general trade and distribution network, including distributor research, retailer mapping, lead generation, outreach and sales coordination.
* Develop an understanding of the Indian makhana and FMCG snacking ecosystem, including sourcing, grades, pricing, competitors, distribution models and consumer trends.
* Coordinate with logistics partners, warehouses, vendors and internal teams to support inventory movement, order fulfilment, dispatches and operational efficiency.
* Assist with vendor and partner coordination across different business functions and ensure timely follow-ups and execution.
* Support HR and people operations, including recruitment coordination, candidate screening, onboarding, intern coordination and other day-to-day HR activities.
* Conduct market and competitor research across products, brands, pricing, distribution, consumer behaviour and emerging trends.
* Take ownership of ad-hoc strategic and operational projects that contribute to the growth and development of PopLotus.
* Work closely with the founding/core team and provide regular updates on project progress, findings, challenges and recommendations.

Qualifications
  

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Management, Commerce, Economics, Marketing, Finance or a related field.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to work comfortably with numbers and data.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets; familiarity with data analysis and dashboards is an advantage.
* Strong research skills and the ability to independently find, interpret and present information.
* Interest in FMCG, D2C brands, e-commerce, quick commerce, exports, consumer businesses or startups.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where responsibilities can evolve quickly.
* Proactive mindset with a willingness to take ownership rather than wait for instructions.
* Ability to communicate professionally with customers, vendors, distributors, logistics partners and other external stakeholders.

What You Will Gain

* Hands-on exposure to building and scaling an FMCG consumer brand from the ground up.
* Exposure to e-commerce, quick commerce, general trade and international markets.
* Practical experience in exports and foreign trade.
* Experience working with real business data and making data-driven decisions.
* Direct interaction with founders and senior stakeholders.
* Cross-functional exposure across sales, marketing, operations, logistics, analytics and HR.
* An opportunity to take ownership of projects with measurable business impact.

The team works on conversational AI agents that help travelers discover options, compare products, plan trips, and receive assistance throughout their travel journey.

You will play a key role in evaluating the quality, accuracy, relevance, and reliability of AI-generated responses against established guidelines and quality metrics. You will analyze evaluation results, identify recurring errors and quality gaps, and translate findings into actionable insights that help improve AI agent performance.

This role requires a strong foundation in data annotation, quality evaluation, analytical problem-solving, and guideline-based decision-making. The position is suited to professionals who enjoy hands-on evaluation and analysis of AI outputs rather than traditional business reporting or dashboard development.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is an experienced, hands-on professional who combines strong evaluation and quality assurance skills with analytical thinking. They should be comfortable reviewing large volumes of information, applying structured guidelines, identifying recurring quality issues, and converting observations into meaningful insights.

Candidates with experience in AI evaluation, data annotation, content quality, search relevance, or similar quality-focused roles are encouraged to apply. Direct experience with LLMs or conversational AI is an advantage but is not mandatory for candidates with strong transferable experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Evaluate AI-generated responses from conversational agents against predefined guidelines, evaluation criteria, and quality standards.
* Perform and review data annotation, labelling, and classification to assess the accuracy, relevance, completeness, and appropriateness of AI-generated content.
* Identify and document incorrect, misleading, incomplete, inconsistent, or irrelevant responses, including potential AI hallucinations.
* Conduct quality assurance reviews to ensure consistency, accuracy, and adherence to evaluation guidelines.
* Analyze large and complex datasets to identify recurring errors, quality trends, performance gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
* Interpret quality metrics such as error rates, evaluation consistency, reviewer disagreement, and other relevant indicators.
* Investigate ambiguous or borderline cases and apply sound judgment while adhering to established evaluation criteria.
* Prepare clear documentation of evaluation findings, root causes, observations, and recommended improvements.
* Use Excel or Google Sheets and, where applicable, basic SQL to filter, analyze, and summarize evaluation data.
* Collaborate with Machine Learning Scientists, AI product teams, and other stakeholders to communicate quality insights and support improvements in AI agent performance.
* Contribute to the refinement of evaluation guidelines, quality frameworks, and review processes based on observed issues and emerging patterns.
* Maintain accurate documentation and track identified issues through appropriate ticketing and workflow management systems.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in data annotation, data labeling, AI evaluation, content quality, quality assurance, search relevance evaluation, or similar guideline-based assessment roles.
* Strong experience evaluating data, content, or system outputs against predefined guidelines, quality standards, and measurable criteria.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze large datasets, identify patterns, investigate quality issues, and derive actionable insights.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, particularly when dealing with ambiguous or inconsistent information.
* Excellent attention to detail and the ability to apply evaluation criteria consistently.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for data filtering, analysis, quality tracking, and reporting.
* Strong written communication skills and the ability to document findings, explain issues, and communicate insights clearly.
* Ability to work independently on evaluation tasks while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Genuine interest in artificial intelligence, conversational AI, and data-driven product improvement.
* Experience with Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) workflows, AI training data validation, model output assessment, or LLM-as-a-judge evaluation.

**Good to Have**

* Exposure to Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, conversational agents, or AI-generated content evaluation.
* Familiarity with evaluating AI responses for factual accuracy, relevance, completeness, helpfulness, and hallucinations.
* Basic SQL knowledge for extracting, filtering, and analyzing datasets.
* Experience with quality metrics such as error rates, inter-annotator agreement, reviewer disagreement, and evaluation consistency.
* Experience maintaining evaluation guidelines, quality documentation, review workflows, or issue-tracking systems.
* Exposure to travel, hospitality, customer experience, search relevance, policy evaluation, or content quality operations.

title: B2B Content Specialist
description:
2Base Technologies is at a deliberate stage of building its marketing function, and this role owns the written voice of that function end to end.

We are a technology services company with over 16 years of delivery experience, working with mid-market and enterprise clients across the United States and the United Kingdom. Our work spans AI implementation, custom software development, legacy system modernisation, and operational transformation.

This is a writing role with a specific, demanding purpose. It is not a content management role or a social media role. If that distinction is unclear from the outset, this is probably not the right fit.

**What This Role Exists to Do**

This role does not invent the voice. It operationalises, applies, and enforces it across all written output: long-form content that earns search traffic, content written in the voice of senior leadership for professional publishing, and the quality standard for everything written that leaves this company.

The audience spans technical leaders and business decision-makers at mid-market companies. CTOs and IT Directors who evaluate architecture decisions, and Founders, COOs, and Operations leaders who are accountable for technology outcomes without always having a technical background. Writing that works across that range, without oversimplifying for one end or losing the other, is the actual craft challenge of this role. Technically credible, commercially relevant, and written with a clear point of view. That is the standard this role is hired to meet and maintain.

**What You Will Own**

* All long-form written content: pillar pages, blogs, playbooks, decision frameworks, and use-case libraries targeting senior decision-makers in the US and UK
* Written content produced in the voice of senior leadership for professional platforms, which requires the ability to write convincingly as someone other than yourself
* The 2Base content voice, including auditing all published content to ensure it meets the company's brand standards
* Content briefs written clearly enough that a junior team member can produce a first draft without needing to ask clarifying questions
* The content quality gate: nothing is published without passing through this role first
* AI tool usage as a productivity layer, not as a substitute for thinking

**What You Will Not Own**

* SEO keyword selection: the SEO Specialist sets this and you write within it
* Social media scheduling and publishing: a separate team member owns this
* Visual design of content assets: the Visual Designer owns this
* Distribution strategy: the Marketing & Growth Lead decides which channels content goes to
* ICP definition: you write for the ICP and you do not define it

**What We Are Looking For**

**Experience**

* Minimum 2 to 6 years writing B2B content
* Has written content that ranked on Google, not just content that was published
* Has written in voices other than their own, for executives, founders, or senior professionals
* Understands SEO at a working level: knows what search intent means and can write to it without being an SEO specialist
* Has worked with AI writing tools and knows both their value and their limits
* Can show content that contributed to a measurable outcome: traffic, leads, or engagement with the right audience
* Background in technology, SaaS, or professional services strongly preferred

**Writing Ability**

* Writes with a clear point of view, not neutral summaries of other people's ideas
* Can explain complex technical concepts in plain language without losing technical credibility
* Writes concisely with no filler, no padding, and no unnecessary qualification
* Can write in different voices and make each one sound authentic, not just adjusted

**Mindset**

* Treats content as a commercial tool, not a creative exercise
* Comfortable being edited and does not treat feedback as personal criticism
* Genuinely curious about AI, technology, and business operations, not faking interest to get the job
* Fast: this team moves at pace and cannot wait three days for a first draft

**What We Are Not Looking For**

* Portfolios of "Top 10 Tips" articles or trend summaries with no original thinking
* Writers who cannot explain how any of their content performed or what it contributed to
* Anyone who has never written for a technical or senior business audience and considers that detail irrelevant
* Writers who only produce self-directed content and have never worked consistently to a brief
* Anyone who cannot write convincingly in a voice other than their own
* Candidates who treat AI tools as the primary author and apply only light editing

**An Honest Note on This Role**

You will work with a documented marketing strategy and a defined brand voice from Day 1. You will take ownership of B2B content creation and help build the content workflow, writing briefs, and quality review process.

This role suits someone who enjoys writing for business decision-makers, translating technical concepts into clear content, and maintaining a consistent company voice. You should be comfortable taking initiative and building content practices as the team grows.

To apply, send your CV and two writing samples: one long-form B2B piece and one shorter piece written in a voice other than your own. If you do not have the second, tell us why in your cover note.

title: Document Coordinator
description:
**Are you looking for a next step in your professional career?**
Join us as a
**Document Coordinator**
and play a key role in ensuring accurate, timely, and efficient document management across projects. You will work closely with customers, vendors, and project teams to manage document flow, maintain compliance with documentation schedules, and support successful project execution. In this role, your organization, attention to detail, and ability to work independently will directly contribute to delivering project documentation on time and according to contractual requirements.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Managing project document flow between Company and Customer in accordance with contract document schedule; managing electronic documents through document publication systems introduced by Company or Customer.
* Managing project document flow between Company and Vendors in accordance with contract document schedule; managing electronic documents through document publication systems introduced by Company.
* Determining of Customer documentation requirements and preparing documentation instructions accordingly for the Project and Vendors.
* Customer Document publication system training and support for the Project.
* Controlling document delivery schedule and readiness of project documents when delivered to Customer or received from Vendors.
* Controlling erection drawing deliveries to project sites in accordance with document schedule.
* Manage project document flow between the company and customers in line with contract document schedules.
* Manage project document flow between the company and vendors according to agreed documentation schedules.
* Administer document version control, language versions, and backup procedures in line with company guidelines.
* Prepare project documents in master formats suitable for distribution through paper copies, web platforms, and electronic systems.
* Publish and manage electronic documents through customer and company document management systems.
* Determine customer documentation requirements and prepare documentation instructions for project teams and vendors.
* Provide training and support on customer document publication systems to project teams.
* Monitor document delivery schedules and ensure project documents are ready before submission to customers or receipt from vendors.
* Control erection drawing deliveries to project sites according to established document schedules.
* Arrange document distribution and provide copying and administrative documentation support as required.

Expectations from you
  
  

* 4 years of relevant experience in document control, document management, or project administration.
* Experience managing document flow between multiple stakeholders, including customers, vendors, and project teams.
* Knowledge of document version control, document distribution, and backup processes.
* Familiarity with electronic document management and publication systems.
* Ability to coordinate documentation schedules and maintain accurate project records.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple documentation activities simultaneously.
* Ability to work independently, demonstrate initiative, and apply sound judgment in problem solving.
* Experience supporting documentation requirements in project environments.
* Comfortable working within a primarily national geographical scope.

To succeed in this role
  
  
Success in this role requires experience managing project documentation throughout its lifecycle, strong coordination skills, and the ability to maintain accuracy while handling multiple documentation activities. You will need to effectively manage document schedules, collaborate with customers and vendors, and ensure documentation requirements are met on time. The ability to work independently, take initiative, and maintain high standards of document control is essential.
  
  
We Also Expect You To Align With Valmet’s Leadership Principles, Practical Behaviors That Guide How We Lead, Collaborate, And Succeed Together
  
  

* Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through
* Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly
* Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety
* Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value

We offer
  
  
You will be part of a team that supports project execution through effective document control and administration. The team manages documentation requirements between customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders, ensuring documents are prepared, distributed, tracked, and delivered according to project schedules and contractual requirements. You will contribute to maintaining documentation quality, enabling efficient communication, and supporting successful project delivery. The role offers opportunities to develop expertise in document management systems, project coordination, and stakeholder collaboration while working independently on varied documentation activities.
  
  
Valmet offers an inspiring and challenging position with opportunities to contribute to business success. You will work in a collaborative and professional environment that supports learning, development, and continuous improvement. We value our employees and provide modern tools, learning opportunities, and an environment where you can grow both professionally and personally.
  
  
When everything works together
  
  
*Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow. At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. We are committed to a respectful and inclusive environment, where people can be themselves and are supported to contribute at their best. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential, never on personal characteristics such as gender, gender identity, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, neurodiversity, religion, sexual orientation, or political views. Join the team and lead the way with us!*
*www.valmet.com/careers*

title: Commercial excellence coordinator
description:
**Coordinate tender governance and project review processes**
Are you interested in supporting commercial governance and decision-making in a global organisation? As a Commercial Excellence Coordinator, you will coordinate tender approval and project review activities across Grid Solutions, helping ensure consistent commercial execution, effective risk management, and sustainable competitiveness. This is an opportunity to work with international teams, senior stakeholders, and cross-functional partners while contributing to the continued growth of NKT. Do you want to be part of a collaborative global environment?
  
  
Coordinate commercial reviews across global teams
  
  
As a Commercial Excellence Coordinator, you will support the tender approval and project review processes across Grid Solutions. The role focuses on planning, documentation management, stakeholder coordination, meeting administration, workflow support, and process development. You will work closely with commercial teams, project execution teams, finance, and leadership stakeholders to ensure information is accurate, distributed on time, and properly documented. Your contribution will help maintain governance standards, improve decision-making, and ensure consistency across regions and hubs.
  
  
**Your Responsibility Will Be To**

* Coordinate tender approval meetings, agendas, participants, and documentation according to approval requirements
* Manage document quality reviews, distribution, archiving, and approval records
* Prepare and distribute decisions, actions, and meeting minutes within agreed timelines
* Coordinate project review meetings based on project risk categorisation and governance requirements
* Maintain workflow automation tools and support continuous process improvements

This position reports to the Head of Commercial Excellence and collaborates with global Grid Solutions stakeholders across commercial, project execution, installation management, finance, and leadership teams. Location: NKT office location to be confirmed. Limited travel may be required.
  
  
**Organised coordinator with effective stakeholder collaboration**
The ideal person enjoys bringing structure to complex activities, managing competing priorities, and working with colleagues across different locations and functions. They communicate clearly, build trusted working relationships, and maintain attention to detail even when handling multiple deadlines. They are accountable, consistent, and committed to high-quality outcomes. A continuous improvement mindset and an interest in improving processes and ways of working will support long-term performance in this role.
  
  
**You Also Have**

* Relevant degree in Business, Engineering, Finance, or equivalent
* Experience maintaining process methodologies, templates, and guidelines for tender and/or project reviews
* Experience working in global matrix organisations
* Basic understanding of risk management and project governance principles
* Professional written and spoken English
* Experience with SharePoint and Power Automate

Contribute to efficient decisions for a greener tomorrow
  
  
We aim to create a workplace where people of all backgrounds are valued, supported, and able to do their best work.
  
  
We are dedicated to increasing gender diversity at NKT and welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. We welcome varied backgrounds and career paths—even if you don’t meet every single requirement. We believe inclusive teams contribute to positive results and create a better everyday work environment.
  
  
This role offers opportunities to develop your career within an international organisation while collaborating with colleagues across regions and functions. You will expand your knowledge of commercial governance, project reviews, workflow automation, and stakeholder management while contributing to process improvements that support NKT’s continued growth and the green transition.
  
  
Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!
  
  
We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than
**31st October 2026**
. Be aware that personality and cognitive tests might be included in the recruitment process. Please note that due to the GDPR regulations we cannot accept any applications via e-mail.
  
  
We collect confidential candidate experience feedback to improve our recruitment process. Your responses are for quality development only and do not affect hiring decisions.
  
  
Be a Connector of the green tomorrow!
  
  
**About NKT**
*Join a diverse and international team within NKT’s Grid Solutions business, supporting the delivery and operation of reliable power grids worldwide. We deliver HVAC onshore cable systems and provide specialist service for AC and DC cable systems onshore and offshore. As a global organisation with operations across Europe, Australia, the United States, and the Middle East, Grid Solutions works closely with customers around the world and across the full lifecycle of power cable systems.*
*At NKT, we are all Connectors. We connect to develop leading power cable technologies that enable the world’s transition to renewable energy - and we stay connected to grow as people and professionals. As a company, NKT connects a greener world with high-quality power cable technology and plays a key role as the world moves towards clean energy. NKT designs, manufactures and installs low-, medium- and high-voltage power cable solutions enabling reliable energy transmission. Since 1891, NKT has innovated the power cable technology, building the infrastructure from the first light bulbs to the megawatts created by renewable energy today.*
*NKT is headquartered in Denmark, operates from more than 30 countries worldwide, and employs 6,500 people globally. NKT is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and realised a revenue of EUR 3.6 billion in 2025. NKT - We connect a greener world. www.nkt.com*

description:

Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Supports drafting proposals and/or statement of work (SOW).

Technical Delivery

Works with account team to ensure One Microsoft approach. Shares lessons learned with workgroup and consultant community.

Business Development

Drives innovation and digital transformation. Ensures the use of the existing intellectual property (IP).

Identifies certifications and readiness plans in partnership with World Wide Learning. Leads or participates in relevant technical communities and conducts training sessions to evangelize technology and/or offerings based on availability. Mentors team members and acts as a technical advisor for stakeholders by providing thought leadership, articulation of solutions value, and outcomes of business strategies.
  
  
Operational Excellence
  
  
Completes operational tasks and readiness and ensures timeliness and accuracy. Follows Microsoft policies, compliance, and procedures (e.g., Enterprise Services Authorization Policy, Standards of Business Conduct, labor logging, expenses, travel guidelines). Leads by example and guides team members on operational tasks, readiness, and compliance. 
  
  
**Other**
Embody our culture and values

Required/Minimum Qualifications
  
  
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Finance, Business, or related field AND 3+ years leadership experience in relevant area of business
  
  
OR equivalent experience.

5+ years leadership experience in relevant area of business.
  
  
Technical certifications based on domain/service line (e.g., Azure, Security, Dynamics).

title: Content Writer & Social Media Manager
description:
**Company:**
Febla Technologies LLC

**Location:**
Hyderabad, Telangana, India

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Experience:**
Minimum 1 Year

**Salary:**
₹20,000 – ₹25,000 per month

About the Role

Febla Technologies LLC is looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and proactive
**Content Writer & Social Media Manager**
to join our team in Hyderabad.

We are seeking someone who can develop engaging written content, manage social media platforms, and execute content strategies that strengthen brand awareness, increase audience engagement, and support business growth.

The ideal candidate should have strong storytelling skills, a good understanding of social media trends, and the ability to create content that connects with the target audience.

Key ResponsibilitiesContent Writing & Copywriting

* Create engaging content for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other digital platforms.
* Write creative captions, short-form video scripts, promotional content, and advertising copy.
* Develop attention-grabbing hooks, storytelling concepts, and calls to action for social media campaigns.
* Write website content, blog articles, product descriptions, and marketing materials as required.
* Ensure all content maintains consistent brand messaging, tone, and quality.
* Research industry trends, audience interests, and competitor content to generate fresh ideas.

Social Media Management

* Manage and maintain company social media accounts across multiple platforms.
* Develop and execute weekly and monthly social media content calendars.
* Plan, schedule, and publish posts, reels, stories, and promotional campaigns.
* Monitor comments, messages, and audience interactions, and respond professionally.
* Identify trending topics, hashtags, and content formats to improve organic reach.
* Collaborate with designers and video editors to produce engaging social media content.
* Maintain consistent branding across social media channels.

Content Strategy & Growth

* Develop creative strategies to improve brand visibility, follower growth, and audience engagement.
* Generate new content ideas for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn posts, and promotional campaigns.
* Analyze social media performance using platform analytics and reporting tools.
* Track key metrics such as reach, impressions, engagement, follower growth, and website traffic.
* Recommend improvements based on audience behavior and content performance.
* Support influencer collaborations, promotional campaigns, and community-building initiatives.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Minimum 1 year of experience in content writing, social media management, digital marketing, or a related field.
* Strong English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills.
* Experience creating social media captions, promotional copy, and short-form video scripts.
* Good understanding of Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.
* Ability to create engaging content tailored to different audiences and platforms.
* Familiarity with social media scheduling and analytics tools.
* Understanding of social media algorithms, content trends, and organic growth strategies.
* Strong communication, creativity, time management, and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple content tasks and meet deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience using Canva or similar content design tools.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted writing tools such as ChatGPT.
* Knowledge of SEO content writing and keyword research.
* Experience with Meta Business Suite and social media analytics.
* Understanding of influencer marketing and community engagement.
* Experience managing social media accounts for startups, mobile applications, or technology brands.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who can think beyond simply publishing posts.

The ideal candidate should understand what makes people stop scrolling, engage with content, and share it with others.

We value candidates who can independently research ideas, write compelling content, maintain a consistent publishing schedule, and contribute to measurable social media growth.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply through LinkedIn with an updated resume.

**Portfolio Preferred:**
Please include samples of social media captions, content writing, video scripts, or links to social media pages you have previously managed.

* **Join Febla Technologies LLC and help us build engaging content, meaningful audience connections, and a stronger digital presence.**

title: Specialist, Engineering Maintenance Solutions - HYD
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Join Deloitte as a Specialist, Engineering Maintenance Solutions, supporting controlled change and release activities across technology platforms. You will help assess change requests, coordinate release planning, manage dependencies and risks, and support stable deployments to live environments. This role offers the opportunity to strengthen service continuity through disciplined planning, transparent communication, and effective service-management practices.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Specialist, Engineering Maintenance Solutions on the Change & Release Management team, you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Execute Change and Release Management processes to help minimize service disruption and degradation throughout the change lifecycle.
* Coordinate change and release planning, including stakeholder communications, dependency management, conflict resolution, and prioritization.
* Plan and coordinate system testing, user acceptance testing, release activities, and deployments to support production readiness.
* Evaluate change requests for supported platforms; identify, analyze, and document risks, issues, dependencies, and mitigation actions.
* Maintain change and release records, schedules, documentation, and status reporting to support governance and continuous service improvement.

**The team**
At Deloitte, we’re all about collaboration. And nowhere is this more apparent than among our 2,000-strong internal services team. With our combined specialist skills, we provide all the essential support and advice our client-facing colleagues need, right across the firm. This enables them to focus all their efforts on delivering the best service possible to their clients. Covering seven distinct areas; Human Resources, Clients & Industries, Finance & Legal, Practice Support Services, Quality & Risk Services, IT Services, and Workplace Services & Real Estate, together we live, breathe and deliver the Deloitte experience.
  
  
Change Management: The quality control process that sets the stage ready by assessing, planning, and getting the right approvals for deployment of one or multiple changes and this ensures minimal disruption to live environment.
  
  
Release Management: Release management involves owning the release life cycle from assessment up and till deployment co-ordinating with the various build teams and testing teams along the way while maintaining the integrity of ongoing services.
  
  
**Location: Hyderabad**
**Shift Timings:**
1-10 PM IST / 2-11 PM IST
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Experience supporting Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL)-aligned Change, Release, and Service Transition processes.
* Experience facilitating Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings and coordinating change approvals.
* Experience planning and maintaining release schedules, dependencies, and deployment activities.
* Experience conducting change and release readiness assessments, including risk identification and mitigation documentation.
* Experience using Information Technology Service Management (ITSM) tools, such as ServiceNow, Remedy, or an equivalent platform, to track and manage changes and releases.
* Experience preparing change and release communications, operational documentation, and performance reports using Microsoft Office applications.
* ITIL v3 or ITIL 4 Foundation certification.

Preferred:
  
  

* ITIL v3 or ITIL 4 certification above the Foundation level.
* Project Management Professional (PMP), Projects IN Controlled Environments (PRINCE2), or Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) certification.
* Experience managing IT service delivery activities across change, release, incident, or problem management.
* Experience working with Agile delivery methods and DevOps practices.
* Lean or Six Sigma certification.
* Experience developing operational documentation and training materials.

This position is aligned with the Core Talent Model. To view the associated benefit package, please reference this document .
  
  
**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

title: Medical & Technical Content Writer
description:
**Medical & Technical Content Writer**

**Phytomedicine, Preclinical Data & B2B Scientific Communication**

**Department R&D / Scientific Marketing**

**Location Hyderabad preferred | Hybrid may be considered**

**Experience 3-5 years in scientific or medical writing**

**Reports to Head of R&D; dotted line to Commercial**

**Focus Technical dossiers, evidence translation, and buyer-facing scientific assets**

The Opportunity

Convert Ariv’s extraction science, analytical data, and preclinical findings into technically rigorous, readable

materials that earn trust with US formulation, quality, regulatory, and procurement teams. This is a scientific

writing role - not general content marketing or social-media copywriting.

What Success Looks Like

 A controlled core technical dossier and product monograph for each commercial ingredient.

 Buyer-ready specification sheets, scientific presentations, FAQs, and evidence summaries.

 Clear, appropriately qualified mechanism-of-action and structure-function claim support narratives.

 Fast, accurate responses to technical questionnaires and scientific due-diligence requests.

 A searchable evidence library with traceable references, version control, and claim substantiation.

Key Responsibilities

 Data translation: Synthesize extraction parameters, phytochemical characterization, analytical methods,

bioassays, and preclinical findings into clear scientific narratives.

 Technical dossiers: Author and maintain product monographs, technical data sheets, white papers, MoA

summaries, FAQs, slide decks, and study summaries.

 Evidence management: Conduct structured literature reviews, assess study quality and relevance,

manage references, and maintain evidence-to-claim traceability.

 Claims support: Draft scientifically defensible structure-function wording within US dietary supplement

boundaries, in partnership with Regulatory.

 Study documentation: Support protocol synopses, investigator briefs, reports, abstracts, posters, and

publication-ready summaries for in-vitro and in-vivo work.

 Customer support: Draft responses for technical questionnaires and scientific queries from customer

R&D, QA, and Regulatory teams.

 Cross-functional control: Maintain approved language, document versions, review workflows, source

files, and consistency across scientific and commercial materials.

Candidate Profile

 Education: Master’s degree or PhD in Pharmacology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Life Sciences,

Pharmacy, or a closely related discipline.

 Experience: 3-5 years in medical writing, scientific communications, regulatory writing, or technical

documentation in nutraceuticals, phytomedicine, botanical drugs, or pharma.

 Scientific reasoning: Able to interpret assay design, controls, endpoints, dose-response data, statistical

outputs, limitations, and biological relevance.

Ariv Biosciences | Confidential Recruitment Document

 Writing quality: Excellent English, precise citation practice, strong document architecture, and ability to

adapt one evidence base for scientific and commercial audiences.

 Regulatory awareness: Practical understanding of structure-function claims, substantiation, DSHEA

boundaries, and the distinction between ingredient evidence and finished-product claims.

 Tools: Proficiency with reference managers and document collaboration/version-control workflows.

Non-Negotiable Hiring Criteria

 Submitted writing samples showing technical or medical authorship; generic blogs alone are insufficient.

 Ability to critically interpret primary research and preclinical data rather than merely summarize abstracts.

 Experience working with scientific, quality, regulatory, or clinical stakeholders through review cycles.

 No plagiarism, invented citations, overstatement, or disease-treatment language.

Preferred / Advantageous

 Experience with botanical standardization, phytochemistry, natural products, or dietary supplement

ingredients.

 Publication, poster, protocol, or technical dossier experience.

 Familiarity with PubMed, Zotero/EndNote/Mendeley, and AI-assisted research with rigorous human

verification.

 Understanding of common analytical techniques such as HPLC/UPLC, LC-MS, spectroscopy, or validated

bioassays.

title: AI FDE Lead/Architect - Enterprise Solutions
description:
*We are looking for a True AI Forward Deployed Engineer (as coined by Palantir!) preferably with Supply Chain Domain Expertise. We are not looking for someone to run AI experiments. We are looking for someone to take AI all the way — from first conversation with a client to a system that runs in production and creates real business value.*

— 01 · THE OPPORTUNITY

AI leadership role.

Anthrobyte builds production-grade enterprise AI systems for global clients across Supply Chains & Enterprise Solutions. As we scale, we need an AI leader with Supply Chain Domain expertise who can hold the full journey: presales and discovery, solution design, consulting, and end-to-end development & deployment — all as one coherent capability.

This is less a traditional technical role and more a seat at the client table. You will work directly with the CTO, founding team, and enterprise clients to define how AI is scoped, architected, communicated, and delivered inside complex organisations. You will be the person who walks into a room with a messy problem and walks out with a solution the client believes in — and then makes it real.

**FOUNDING ROLE**

**AI Lead / Supply Chain Expertise**

Own the full AI engagement journey in Supply Chain — presales, solution design, consulting, and forward deployment — as one coherent capability.

**GROWTH TRACK · MERIT-BASED**

**Principal AI & Solutions Lead**

Grow into executive-level technical leadership — shaping company strategy, IP development, and client transformation at scale.

Requirements
  
  

**Requirements**

02 ·
**RESPONSIBILITIES**

Own the solution. Drive it to production.

**Presales & Solution Design**

— Lead the pre-sales and technical discovery sessions with enterprise and mid-market clients globally — understand their pain points, data maturity, and AI readiness before anyone writes a line of code

— Own the solution design for AI proposals: use case scoping, high-level system design, data requirements, and ROI framing

— Build and present compelling PoC demos, solution blueprints, and technical proposals in partnership with the commercial team

— Respond to RFPs and RFIs with technically rigorous and commercially sharp responses that win confidence

·
**Consulting & Client Engagement**

— Act as a trusted AI advisor to client stakeholders — CXOs, VPs of Operations, IT leaders — not just a technical vendor on the call

— Run workshops, AI readiness assessments, and value stream mapping sessions at client sites and remotely

— Navigate ambiguous problem spaces and help clients articulate what they actually want to solve with AI, and why it matters

— Build long-term client relationships that translate into deepened engagements, referrals, and expanded mandates

·
**Forward Deployment & Technical Delivery**

— Be deeply involved in deployment — not just design. Understand production constraints, integration complexity, and change management realities

— Collaborate with engineering and data science teams to ensure solution designs are buildable and delivered to the quality clients expect

— Drive go-live milestones, client acceptance, and post-deployment success metrics with accountability

— Debug, iterate, and adapt: you own outcomes, not just deliverables. If something is broken, you fix it

·
**Solution Design & Thought Leadership**

— Define AI architecture patterns for the firm: LLM orchestration, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, multi-modal systems

— Stay ahead on applied AI research and emerging frameworks; bring relevant signals back to the team before the market does

— Mentor junior AI engineers and consultants on both client engagement craft and solution architecture rigour

— Contribute to Anthrobyte's knowledge capital — case studies, whitepapers, internal playbooks, and reusable solution accelerators

✶ The Growth Pathway

Demonstrate consistent excellence and the scope expands. You will grow into principal technical leadership — shaping company strategy, representing AI at investor and board conversations, building and leading a growing solutions team, and defining how AI transformation is delivered across every client engagement. This is not a title — it is a level of ownership that must be earned and continually re-earned.

**03 · WHO YOU ARE**

You operate across the full stack — from model architecture to client boardroom. You simplify complex problems without losing what makes them real, and you're as comfortable presenting to a VP of Supply Chain as you are reviewing a model eval report with a data science team.

You Bring

· 5+ years of hands-on AI/ML experience (LLMs, NLP, computer vision, or advanced analytics) in production

· Proven presales or solution consulting track record — you win client confidence with credibility

· Strong storytelling: complex AI concepts made accessible to business audiences, without dumbing them down

· Global client exposure (US, Europe, Middle East, or SEA) and cross-cultural fluency

· Hands-on with Python, LLM frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, HuggingFace), and cloud AI (AWS, Azure, GCP)

· Experience designing end-to-end AI systems: ingestion, pipelines, deployment, monitoring, and iteration

· Comfort in ambiguity and 0→1 environments; startup or early-stage experience preferred

Bonus Signals

Supply Chain AI · Forward Deployment · Presales / SE · LLMs & RAG · MLOps · Global Clients · IIT / IIM / Tier-1 · B2B SaaS AI · Manufacturing / Logistics

Our Legal Business Services Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) practice is expanding its Application Managed Services team (AMS). As a CLM AMS Portfolio lead/Manager within the Application Managed Services (AMS) Team, you will manage multiple AMS projects within the CLM practice, ensuring client requirements are met and service levels are consistently maintained or exceeded. you will play a pivotal role in leading teams to deliver high-quality support, drive continuous improvement, and ensure the success of our clients’ business-critical applications throughout their transformation journey.
  
  
You will oversee and mentor cross-functional teams, coordinate with internal stakeholders, and foster strategic client relationships to deliver exceptional service. Your responsibilities include managing escalations, overseeing client communications, ensuring adherence to SLAs, and identifying opportunities for innovation and process optimization at scale. This role requires strong leadership, strategic thinking, and client management skills, along with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  
  
As a CLM AMS Portfolio Lead/Manager, you will contribute to the growth and success of Deloitte Tax LLP in a variety of way, including:
  
  
**Client Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for key client stakeholders, building trusted advisor relationships and ensuring client satisfaction.
* Prepare and present regular status reports to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Work closely with customers to answer questions about the features and capabilities of our product.

**Delivery**

* Oversee the resolution of complex or escalated issues, providing guidance and direction to team members.
* Assist in the development and execution of test plans for system changes, enhancements, and new releases. Oversee quality assurance and ensure best practices are followed.

* Collaborate with clients and internal leadership to understand business objectives and translate them into system strategies, configurations, or enhancements.
* Stay current on CLM technology trends and best practices to provide innovative solutions to clients. Share insights and best practices with both clients and internal teams.

**Support**

* Document processes, configurations, and solutions to ensure knowledge transfer and continuity. Establish and maintain documentation standards across the team.
* Support user training and adoption activities, including the creation of user guides and training materials. Drive change management and adoption strategies for clients.
* Support resource planning, onboarding, and training for project teams.

* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to optimize CLM processes and system performance. Lead process improvement projects and champion innovation within the team.

**Cross Functional Teaming**

* Collaborate with clients and internal leadership to understand business objectives and translate them into system strategies, configurations, or enhancements.

**People Development**

* Support resource planning, onboarding, and training for project teams.
* Oversee the resolution of complex or escalated issues, providing guidance and direction to team members.

**Business Development**

* Contribute to business development efforts, including proposal development, client presentations, and identifying opportunities for expanding AMS services.

**The team**
At Deloitte Tax LLP, our Legal Business Services group within the Tax Technology Consulting (TTC) practice helps legal departments pursue a streamlined, transparent, and efficient legal function that enhances the core responsibilities of operations, contracting, compliance, reporting and planning, while also positioning Deloitte as a strategic business advisor for the digital era. We specialize in advising legal departments and can effectively address a corporate legal function’s unique needs, requirements and obligations. As legal operations and contracting specialists, we help clients make appropriate operations and technology choices. Our team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients with contract lifecycle management, legal entity management, and legal operations services.
  
  
Deloitte TTC-LBS professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to support our clients’ objectives and address their challenges. Our team’s multi-disciplinary approach combines technical and technology skillsets, enabling greater impact and efficiency within our client’s organization. TTC’s Legal Business Services team helps clients with operating model evaluation, roadmap development for a desired future state, data management solutions, automation opportunities, contract lifecycle management, legal entity management, and legal operating models. Learn more about Deloitte Legal Business Services.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or related field.
* 6+ years of experience in CLM System configuration, application management, system support, or technology consulting, with CLM platforms (e.g., Icertis, Conga, DocuSign CLM, Agiloft, etc.).

Icertis certified ICI Administrator, Icertis Certified Functional Professional, Sirion Certified CLM Specialist)

title: Complaints Team Lead
description:
**Company Description**
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
  
  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
  
  
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
  
  
**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
More about
**our mission**
and
**what we offer**
.
  
  
We’re looking for a new Team Lead to work with our teams based in Hyderabad to join our mission! Along with our other Complaints Team Leads you’ll be responsible for looking after the needs of our Complaints Officers, as well as working with our product and compliance teams to rectify systemic issues so we can continue to scale and grow. If you’re passionate about people and want to extend your skills into the realm of project management, risk assessment, and generally being part of something amazing and fast-paced, then this role is for you!
  
  
As a Complaints Team Lead at Wise, you will be instrumental in ensuring that our customers receive exceptional service and that their concerns are addressed promptly and effectively. Your primary purpose will be to execute a robust complaints management strategy that aligns with regulatory standards and supports our commitment to transparency and customer satisfaction.
  
  
You will lead a dedicated team of Complaints Officers, providing guidance, coaching, and support to ensure that all complaints are handled efficiently and in accordance with established procedures. By analysing complaints data and identifying underlying trends, you will drive continuous improvement initiatives aimed at addressing root causes and enhancing our overall customer experience.
  
  
This role offers a unique opportunity to collaborate with cross-functional teams and influence the development of products and processes to minimise complaints and optimise customer outcomes. You will also serve as a key point of contact for regulatory inquiries and audits related to complaints management, demonstrating Wise's commitment to compliance and operational excellence.
  
  
Ultimately, your role will be critical in shaping Wise's reputation as a customer-centric organization that values transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement in resolving customer concerns globally.
  
  
Additionally, you will be responsible for identifying and mitigating potential risks associated with complaints management, ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements, and implementing risk-mitigation strategies to safeguard Wise's reputation and operational integrity.
  
  
**What activities does a Complaints Lead undertake?**
**Management and Leadership**

* Own the performance of your team and deliver departmental KPI's that enable the Complaints function to be successful.
* Develop talent mapping approaches that help identify everything from future talent that requires nurturing to current gaps within the performance of your team.
* Remedy any performance gaps utilising the relevant people policy as a guideline.
* Develop and implement training programmes to enhanced skills and capabilities of Complaint Officers, ensuring consistency in handling customer complaints across regions.
* Serve as a subject matter expert on complaints management during cross-functional projects, providing guidance on best practice and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain a proactive approach to risk management, identifying emerging trends and potential issues and help deliver strategies to mitigate risks associated with complaints.
* Ensure regular communication is maintained with the team through effective team meetings and town hall attendance.
* Hire in line with company policy when there is a need to scale the team further.
* Doing things better
* Continuously evaluate and enhance the operational delivery of complaints, as per the strategy, to drive improvements in performance, customer experience and compliance.
* Suggestion innovative solutions and best practice to reduce complaint resolution times and enhance the overall quality of responses to customer concerns.
* Using data and analytics, identify recurring issues and root causes of complaints leading to targeted process improvements and service enhancements.
* Champion a customer-centric approach to complaints handling, advocating for proactive communication.
* Help create and maintain a culture of continuous learning and improvement, encouraging experimentation and knowledge sharing to drive innovation.

**Customer Experience Enhancement**

* Executive strategies and initiatives to enhance customer experience through effective complaints resolution and proactive management.
* Implement feedback loops to capture customer insights and integrate them into initiatives that support service improvement and product development.
* Act as the voice of the customer from a complaints perspective, ensuring that you make a valid contribution to efforts that gravitate around improving our customer's service experience.

**Continuous Professional Development**

* Stay current with industry trends, best practice and emerging technology in complaints management.
* Pursue professional development opportunities such as certifications, workshops and conferences related to customer advocacy and complaints management.

**Qualifications**
**What You'll Bring:**

* Operational & Analytical Mastery: Proven history of leading front-line operations teams to achieve challenging KPIs. Skilled in setting clear OKRs, streamlining processes, and using data to solve root cause issues.
* Team Leadership & People Management: 2+ years of direct management experience building and scaling high-performing teams. Passionate about talent growth, coaching through feedback, and cultivating a positive team culture.
* Change Navigation: Skilled at leading teams through operational changes and structural pivots while keeping team morale high and raising execution standards.
* Strategic Stakeholder Influence: Clear, persuasive communicator who builds strong working relationships and constructively challenges existing norms when needed.
* Accountability & Ownership Mindset: Highly autonomous leader who owns team results end-to-end, fights for the customer experience, and leads with humility.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing or collaborating with cross-border, international teams.
* Fintech, payments, or banking background, particularly with experience working alongside Product and Engineering teams.
* Prior experience leading customer support escalations, disputes, or complaints management functions.

Additional Information
  
  
**Additional Information**
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
  
  
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
  
  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

title: Territory Business Manager
description:
**Role Overview**
The role is accountable for sales targets & delivery, ensuring timely collections, driving DG, and overseeing product liquidation in the assigned territory. The role requires effective market penetration, distributor and retailer management, and strong channel engagement while ensuring seamless execution of sales strategies.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead DG, ensuring liquidation targets while acting as a knowledge hub on crop, pest, competition, and farmer practices for their territory.
* Work on segmentation, targeting, positioning, and preseason planning, ensuring execution of liquidation strategies.
* Drive sales through distributors and retailers, ensuring market penetration, share growth, and service excellence. Track distributor/retailer performance vs. POs, manage collections, and reconcile accounts.
* Monitor and consolidate product movement from distributor to retailer to farmer, ensuring accurate reporting of liquidation, inventory, and sales data.
* Strengthen distributor/retailer relationships, implement national programs, enforce trade discipline, manage stock returns, and communicate pricing and schemes.
* Liaise with KVKs, government agencies, and Agri. Dept. officials to drive local coordination.
* Work closely with ZDCLs & ZBMs for seamless execution of DG activities and regularly update the sales team.
* Collaborate with the NC team to identify hotspots and connect farmers to VPDs.
* Supervise key DG activities, including farmer meetings and field days, ensuring strong market engagement.

**Activity Plan Breakdown**

* Retail Servicing & Territory Planning (50%) – Ensure effective retail engagement, optimize territory coverage, and drive sales through planned servicing (13 days).
* Distribution Management (10%) – Strengthen distributor relationships, ensure stock availability, and streamline inventory operations (3 days).
* DG Delivery & Supervision (30%) – Oversee DG initiatives, ensure execution excellence, and drive farmer engagement (8 days).
* Reporting, Planning & Meetings (10%) – Track progress, analyse data, and align with teams for strategic decision-making to create comprehensive territory channel & sales strategy (3 days).

**Qualification, Experience & Skills**

* Bachelor's / Master’s Degree in Agriculture.
* 3 to 5 years’ experience in agro-input industry.
* Good communication -oral and written- in both English and local language.
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Capability to achieve sales targets, by still retaining control on the market.
* Strong commercial acumen, understanding of the margin structure, conceptualizing schemes and articulating the advantages of our margins and schemes to the retailers and Distributors.

**The Opportunity**
In this role at EY GDS Consulting, you will play a key role in shaping innovative solutions for telecom clients, acting as their trusted advisor in transformation leveraging Nokia FlowOne driven solutions. You will apply leading industry standards along with Nokia FlowOne expertise to solve complex telecommunication challenges and leverage cutting-edge technologies to drive Telco transformations. You will support the Partners and the Markets team in any opportunities that are initiated by clients.
  
  
You will be responsible to create a market for EY offerings across the telecommunications value chain and generate new leads and opportunities based on the client relationships you already have. Additionally, you will be responsible for delivery of key client outcomes on engagements by managing the teams on ground and client expectations of delivery, helping project teams mitigate delivery risk and identifying key issues that hinder outcomes for the client.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Provide solution architecture and thought leadership on Zero Touch Fulfilment and Autonomous Networks leveraging Nokia FlowOne and other Nokia suite of OSS products
* Lead the implementation of related solutions, ensuring adherence to project timelines and quality standards.
* Driving presales response for OSS transformation RFIs/RFPs.
* Develop comprehensive documentation for network architectures, designs, and processes.
* Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in Autonomous networks, AI, and Machine learning with hands on experience in leveraging leading AI tools for deliveries.
* Develop and apply solution architecture standards, processes, and principles.
* Evaluate and recommend technologies, tools, and platforms that support autonomous networking initiatives.
* You will be the day-to-day point of contact for clients and managers on projects. You structure and engage teams to deliver high-quality outputs.
* Take the lead in identifying client issues and proposing the most appropriate approach for challenges that the telecommunication industry players face.
* You help develop the business and acquire new clients and engagements, including the identification and pursuit of business opportunities by forging strong client relationships.
* You build and maintain long-term relationships with senior clients.
* You drive strategic discussions regarding business objectives and strategy KPIs.
* Delivering qualified solutions to meet business objectives, providing focus to ensure scope and objectives are maintained throughout the project and program life cycles ensuring benefits realization.
* Result oriented leadership style, setting achievable goals and leading by example – linking commercial and technical arenas.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Consultant with 10-12 Years proven experience and hands-on professional experience in Nokia FlowOne, driving large programs and should have worked as an Architect/Designer for at least 5 years.
* Understanding of 5G Slicing, 5G SA/NSA networks, IP/MPLS, Optics, IMS, VoLTE, NFV/SDN, Fixed network.
* In depth knowledge of TMForum’s Open Digital Architecture (ODA) and related ODA components along with TMForum Open APIs.
* Deep knowledge of OSS Architecture, Processes and Systems with practical and proven experience of solutioning for large telecom companies.
* Experience in architecting Zero-Touch operations, Closed Loop Automation, Autonomous Networks and implementing Intent-Driven Management systems to translate business goals to machine readable “Intents” in telecom domain.
* Experience in building comprehensive solutions and response to complex RFx during presales, especially leveraging Nokia’s OSS product suite.
* Providing Autonomous Networks (AN) thought leadership, solution implementation leadership, application expertise and solution vision to clients.
* Additional experience in other Nokia suite of OSS products will be an added advantage.
* Hands-on experience in Java, Python, Kubernetes, Microservices, Databases, etc.
* Expertise and experience to provide thought leadership and guidance on resolving complex implementation and solution issues.
* Expertise to review and approve methods design and development solution documents, internal and external test strategies, plans and scripts.
* Navigate complex client relationships and large transformation related challenges.
* Extensive RFP exposure - developing capability needs and supplier liaison.
* Process development for both 'As Is' and 'To Be' to aid requirement and solution definition and scoping.
* A bachelor’s degree in Electronics/Computer Science/Information Technology/ or any other relevant discipline.
* Relevant certifications (E.g., TOGAF, eTOM, ODA) are a plus.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

**Ideally, you will also have:**

* Strong leadership skills, teaming and communications
* Strong drive to excel professionally, and to guide and motivate others.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Dedicated, resourceful and able to work under pressure.

**What we look for:**
Highly motivated individuals with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize shifting workloads in a rapidly changing industry. An effective communicator, you’ll be a confident leader equipped with strong people management skills and a genuine passion to make things happen in a dynamic organization. If you’re ready to take on a wide range of responsibilities and are committed to seeking out new ways to make a difference, this role is for you.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: License Owner & Operator, Hyderabad
description:
**Love football (soccer) and have an entrepreneurial mindset?
  
  
Stranger Soccer is expanding across key cities worldwide and is seeking a License Owner to launch and grow the Stranger Soccer operation in Hyderabad.**
**This is not a salaried management role—it's an opportunity for an entrepreneurial individual to build and operate something of their own while making football more accessible in their local community. We're looking for someone ambitious, community-driven, and passionate about the game.**
**Does This Sound Like You?**
Visit
**www.strangersoccer.com**
and explore the
**"Bring Stranger Soccer to Your City"**
section to learn more.
  
  
If this opportunity aligns with your goals, complete the interest form to start the conversation. We also recommend downloading the Stranger Soccer app to experience the platform firsthand.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Launch and grow the Stranger Soccer brand in Hyderabad
* Recruit, train, and manage a small local team (2-3 people), supported by Official Hosts
* Secure suitable football venues and regular playing opportunities
* Drive marketing and customer growth through digital and local initiatives
* Oversee game operations while delivering an outstanding player experience
* Work closely with Stranger Soccer HQ, supported by established operations and technology teams

**What We're Looking For**

* Passion for football and strong connections within the local football community
* Experience in management, operations, sales, or customer-facing roles
* An entrepreneurial mindset and ability to work independently
* A strong sense of ownership and ambition to grow Stranger Soccer locally
* Motivation to deliver results, with rewards tied to performance and growth

**About Stranger Soccer**
Football is loved by billions, yet many still struggle to play regularly. Stranger Soccer makes playing football as easy and convenient as going for a jog or visiting the gym.
  
  
Our app lets players discover nearby games, book a spot, and simply turn up to play.
  
  
Founded in Singapore, Stranger Soccer now operates across 10+ cities and has delivered over 100,000 games worldwide. We're looking for passionate License Owners who want to bring this experience to their communities—whether you call it Fussball, Fútbol, Calcio, or football.
  
  
**Our Mission**
To make playing football as easy as going for a jog.
  
  
**Our Vision**
A world where playing football is as popular and accessible as watching football.
  
  
**Ready to be part of the journey?**
We'd love to hear from you.

**Our Mission & Vision**
At
**ModMed**

**Manager, Support Services**

Your mission is to drive customer satisfaction by overseeing rapid issue resolution, optimizing support workflows, and advocating for product enhancements that improve usability for the medical practices we serve.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**
You will lead with a "values-first" mentality to achieve the following:
  
  

* **Team Leadership :**
  Manage, mentor, and develop a team of 6-10 support specialists, setting performance goals and providing regular feedback to foster growth.
* **Customer Support Excellence :**
  Oversee the timely and effective resolution of customer inquiries and technical escalations, ensuring strict adherence to SLAs.
* **Process Optimization :**
  Design and implement innovative support workflows, knowledge bases, and tools to streamline efficiency and enhance the customer experience.
* **Performance Metrics :**
  Monitor and report on key metrics such as response time, resolution rate, and CSAT to drive team accountability and service quality.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration :**
  Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and QA to communicate customer feedback and influence product improvements.
* **Issue Escalation & Advocacy :**
  Handle high-priority customer cases and act as the "voice of the customer" to advocate for product enhancements based on support trends.
