* **Technical Savvy:**
  Proficiency with support tools like
  **Zendesk, Salesforce, and JIRA**
  , along with a strong ability to translate technical issues for non-technical stakeholders.
* **Problem Solver:**
  Proven track record of resolving complex customer issues in high-pressure, high-volume environments.

**Leading ModMed Competencies**
We align passion with purpose. You must demonstrate proficiency in:
  
  

* **Accountability:**
  Holding yourself and your team accountable to deliver successful outcomes for our clients.
* **Communication:**
  Clearly expressing ideas to build trust and collaborate effectively across multiple business units and countries.
* **Customer Focus:**
  Building strong, positive relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
* **Team Leadership:**
  Building high-performing teams through empathetic leadership, performance coaching, and strategic talent planning

**What We Offer**

* A collaborative environment where you can
  **Innovate Boldly**
  by designing new support systems and workflows.
* The opportunity to
  **Save Time**
  for medical professionals by ensuring their technical issues are resolved with precision and speed.
* A culture that encourages you to
  **Think Big, Have Fun, and Do Good**
  while directly impacting patient outcomes through superior software support.

**ModMed is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.**

* bold\*ModMed Benefits Highlight: At ModMed, we believe it’s important to offer a competitive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of our growing workforce. Eligible Modernizers can enroll in a wide range of benefits:
* Meals & Snacks: Enjoy complimentary office lunches & dinners on select days and healthy snacks delivered to your desk,
* Insurance Coverage: Comprehensive health, accidental, and life insurance plans, including coverage for family members, all at no cost to employees,
* Allowances: Annual wellness allowance to support your well-being and productivity,
* Earned, casual, and sick leaves to maintain a healthy work-life balance,
* Bereavement leave for difficult times and extended medical leave options,
* Paid parental leaves, including maternity, paternity, adoption, surrogacy, and abortion leave,
* Celebration leave to make your special day even more memorable, and company-paid holidays to recharge and unwind.
* bold\*PHISHING SCAM WARNING: ModMed is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving imposters posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from ModMed without a formal interview process, and valid communications from our hiring team will come from our employees with a ModMed email address (first.lastname@modmed.com). Please check senders’ email addresses carefully. Additionally, ModMed will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you are receiving communications as described above, please report them to the FTC website.
* bold\*ModMed Technologies India Private Limited follows a strict, merit-based and transparent recruitment process conducted only through official and authorized channels.

**We do not:**

* Charge any fees, processing charges, or amount by any nomenclature, whether as a fee or deposit at any stage of the recruitment process;

* Conduct hiring via informal messaging apps or personal email IDs.

All official communication is made only through verified channels, our website, and recognised recruitment platforms.
  
  
We strongly advise candidates not to share personal/financial information or make any payments in response to suspicious communications. Any such instances may be reported to us at hrcompliance@modmed.com .
  
  

* bold\*ModMed Technologies India Private Limited will not be responsible for any loss arising from fraudulent or unauthorised communications.

title: Senior Legal Counsel - India
description:
**Location:**
Hyderabad, Telangana, India. On site at the offices of Unseen Realities.

**Employment Type:**
Full Time

**Reporting To:**
Chief Legal Officer, Analog

**About Analog and Unseen Realities**

**Analog is pioneering the era of physical intelligence.**
Where digital intelligence transformed our online lives, Analog is transforming the lived world, making cities more adaptive, industries more resilient, services more human centered, and experiences more extraordinary.

At the heart of our approach are living world models, continuously updated, enriched by every capture point, every device, every interaction. Within them resides Ana, the Analog Neural Agent. Ana perceives, adapts, and guides, transforming raw data into foresight and orchestration that improves outcomes across sectors, from safeguarding high value assets to enhancing human performance.

**Unseen Realities, based out of Hyderabad, Telangana, is part of the Analog group, and serves as Analog's operating entity in India supporting customers and partners in the region**
. It will also serve as Analog's research and development hub in India, building engineering and applied AI capabilities that feed the global Analog platform. Everyone joining Unseen Realities works as part of the wider Analog group, and has the opportunity to shape how physical intelligence takes root in one of the world's fastest-growing technology markets.

**Job Description**

We are seeking an experienced and proactive Senior Legal Counsel to lead the full spectrum of Unseen Realities’ legal needs, and serve as the primary legal point of contact for Analog’s business, operations, and opportunities in India. As the first India-based counsel at Unseen Realities, you will work independently and will be the India law and market expert for the Analog legal team. At the same time, you will be a full member of the Analog legal team, working closely with and supported by your colleagues in the Abu Dhabi office.

The successful candidate will take end to end ownership of Indian corporate law and governance, company secretarial processes, commercial contracting, regulatory compliance, and the management of Unseen Realities’ interests in its India joint venture and its participation in wider Analog group arrangements, which together form the core of the role. This is a unique opportunity to shape key business decisions and drive Analog’s growth within a fast evolving technology market in India.

In this highly visible role, you will also lead intellectual property licensing and technology transactions in India, ensuring the protection and proper use of Analog’s intellectual property in customer, supplier and joint venture-facing arrangements, safeguarding Analog’s legal interests while fostering strategic relationships with our partners, as Analog expands its portfolio of physical intelligence-driven products into India.

You will also oversee legal risk management, employment matters, disputes, and legal operations, including the supervision of external counsel and the project management of legal matters across the business.

**What You’ll Do**

As Senior Legal Counsel, you will own a broad range of legal matters, with a critical focus on Indian corporate law and governance, corporate processes, joint venture management, commercial contracting, regulatory compliance, and a working understanding of intellectual property and technology transaction issues.

You will:

**India corporate law, governance and corporate actions**

* Own, with support from external company secretarial providers where appropriate, all corporate and company secretarial processes for Unseen Realities, including convening board and shareholder meetings, preparing agendas, notices, board and shareholder resolutions, circulation resolutions and minutes, and supporting board / committee governance processes.
* Manage key corporate actions, including share issuances and transfers, dividends and other distributions, amendments to the constitutional documents, maintenance of share capital and shareholding records, and the creation and satisfaction of charges.
* Manage director and officer appointments, resignations and removals, including director identification number (DIN), know your customer (KYC) requirements and related filings.
* Oversee the maintenance of statutory registers, statutory filings, and the compliance calendar under the Companies Act, 2013.
* Coordinate exchange control and foreign investment reporting for inbound investment into Unseen Realities and for any joint venture shareholding, including FC-GPR / FC-TRS filings, and downstream investment reporting under the Foreign Exchange Management (Non-debt Instruments) Rules 2019, working with the authorized dealer bank and external counsel where required.

**Commercial contracting**

* Draft, review, and negotiate a broad range of commercial contracts, including master services agreements, technology and software arrangements, intellectual property licenses, supplier and subcontractor terms, procurement and services agreements, non-disclosure agreements, data processing / privacy terms, and customer facing terms.
* Review and negotiate channel, reseller, distribution, system integrator, consortium and joint bidding arrangements, including arrangements entered into in order to respond to requests for proposal, public procurement processes, and tenders in India.
* Provide legal expertise on memorandums of understanding (MOUs) and partnership agreements, and advise business stakeholders on contractual risk, liability, and compliance considerations.
* Develop and maintain Indian law contract templates, playbooks and fallback positions for use across the business, streamlining the contracting process and reducing reliance on external counsel.

**Analog group and joint venture arrangements**

* Manage Unseen Realities’ interests in its India joint venture or partnership arrangements, including the exercise of its rights and the performance of its obligations under any joint venture or shareholders’ agreements and joint venture constitutional documents, reserved matter approvals, delegation of authority implementation, and support for the directors and shareholder representatives appointed by Unseen Realities.
* Negotiate and administer the corporate and commercial arrangements between Unseen Realities and its joint venture partners or joint venture entities, and between Unseen Realities and other Analog group companies, including product sales agreements, intellectual property licenses, branding arrangements, technology arrangements, and services arrangements, in each case on arm’s length terms.
* Coordinate with your colleagues in the Analog legal function on Analog group corporate governance and related party transaction requirements.

**Regulatory, risk management and compliance**

* Provide legal advice on Indian regulatory matters and ensure that all agreements and business activities comply with applicable Indian laws and regulations, including the Companies Act, 2013, exchange control and foreign investment rules, data protection under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023, labour and employment laws, competition law, anti-bribery and anti-corruption legislation, and sector-specific regulations, as applicable.
* Support the design, implementation, and maintenance of compliance programs and internal policies, including adapting the Analog group’s compliance and other policies to address local law deviations where necessary.
* Identify, assess, and proactively mitigate legal and compliance risks to protect Analog’s business in India.
* Monitor legal and regulatory developments in India to assess impact on the business.

**Intellectual Property and licensing**

* Advise on intellectual property ownership and manage intellectual property licensing arrangements in India, ensuring the protection and proper use of the Analog group’s intellectual property, including in customer, partner and joint venture facing contracts.
* Manage, through external agents, Indian trade mark, patent, copyright and design filings and prosecution, and manage brand use, enforcement, and domain name issues.

**Legal operations, cross functional collaboration and management of external counsel**

* Work closely with your colleagues in the Analog legal function and with the India business to ensure that legal considerations are aligned with business strategies and embedded into business operations.
* Instruct and manage Indian external counsel, company secretarial providers and other advisers, ensuring cost effective and comprehensive legal support and control of legal spend.

**Employment and HR legal support**

* Advise the Analog People team on employment matters, including hiring, terminations, disciplinary matters, investigations and employee relations, coordinating with external legal counsels for specialist or sensitive matters.
* Draft and review employment contracts, consultant and contractor agreements, policies, and internal guidelines.

**Litigation and dispute management**

* Manage and oversee, with external counsel, litigation, arbitration, regulatory matters, notices, and pre-litigation correspondence in India.
* Develop dispute-resolution strategies aligned with business objectives and escalate material disputes to the Analog CLO and relevant business stakeholders.

**What You’ll Bring**

* LL.B. or B.A. LL.B. from a recognized Indian university, or an equivalent legal degree enabling enrolment with a State Bar Council in India.
* Minimum of 10 years of post-qualification experience (PQE), with demonstrable depth in both (i) Indian corporate law and processes, including board and shareholder matters, corporate actions and statutory filings, and (ii) commercial contracts governed by Indian law.
* Strong background in contract negotiation, regulatory compliance, risk management, and external counsel management, including budget and performance oversight.
* Ability to translate complex legal issues into clear, practical business advice in support of business objectives.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Ability to work independently as, initially, the sole legal resource based in India, and to collaborate as part of a geographically distributed team in a fast paced, dynamic environment.
* Qualified to practice law in India, including enrolment with a State Bar Council under the Advocates Act 1961, whether current or suspended for the duration of full time salaried employment.
* Based in Hyderabad, or willing to relocate to Hyderabad, and able to work from the offices of Unseen Realities. Ability to travel within India, and occasionally internationally, as business needs require, would be helpful.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior in-house experience, preferably in a technology business.
* Experience advising an India subsidiary or India joint venture of a foreign-headquartered or multinational group.
* Strong experience in Indian intellectual property law, particularly intellectual property licensing, ownership, brand use, and India market technology transactions.
* Strong working knowledge of technology law, data protection, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, and the regulatory framework applicable to technology businesses in India, including procurement and tendering by government and public sector customers.
* Experience of joint venture governance, including exchange control and downstream investment requirements.
* Experience advising on AI-related legal issues and understanding of the ethical, regulatory, and commercial implications of AI.
* Proven ability to manage complex legal projects and advise senior stakeholders and executive leadership teams.
* High level of integrity, judgment, discretion, and professionalism.
* Experience of company secretarial processes, and of working with company secretaries, registrars and the Ministry of Corporate Affairs portal filings.
* Working proficiency in Hindi or Telugu, in addition to English, would be an advantage but is not essential.

**What Working at Analog Offers**

**Culture:**
A collaborative, globally minded team building the future of physical intelligence. We value curiosity, courage, and creativity, and we’re united by a belief that technology should amplify human potential rather than replace it.

**Impact:**
The opportunity to work on projects with national and global significance, from adaptive cities and resilient infrastructure to next generation sports, entertainment, healthcare, and energy. Every product you help build contributes to shaping a safer, smarter, more human centered world.

**Growth:**
Outstanding opportunities for learning and career development. You’ll collaborate with leaders across AI, robotics, mixed reality, and systems engineering, while working on industry first, frontier scale solutions.

**Rewards:**
A competitive compensation package.

**Unseen Realities is an equal opportunity employer**
. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment in accordance with applicable law and without discrimination on the basis of any protected characteristic under applicable laws of India.

title: Sr. Tax Program Manager, Tax and Account Compliance
description:
**Description**
Amazon's Tax Account Compliance team is seeking a Senior Tax Program Manager to drive end-to-end program management for tax across Amazon's global Marketplace business. In this role, you will act as the embedded business risk owner, accountable for proactively identifying, assessing, and mitigating tax risks. You will also translate regulatory requirements into detailed program requirements, coordinate cross-functional delivery with tech, product, legal, tax planning, operations and other partner teams, and program manage regulatory changes from scoping through to execution. At the same time, you will ensure programs are proportionate and risk-calibrated, minimizing false positives and protecting legitimate sellers while maintaining marketplace integrity.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a pragmatic, innovative program manager with experience building programs from the ground up, launching scalable solutions across multiple functions and organizations, and understanding seller pain points. You will raise the seller experience bar by optimizing controls, removing unnecessary friction, and reducing business impact from tax obligations. Problem-solving, program management skills, and executive communication are essential to be successful in this role.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Drive VP/Director level goals
* Translate regulatory requirements (e.g., VAT, JSL, Deemed Reseller) into detailed program requirements, working with tech and product partners on the development of new products and functionalities
* Program manage end-to-end tax launches from scoping and requirements definition through cross-functional delivery and post-launch validation
* Coordinate cross-functionally with legal, tax, tech, product, and operations teams to deliver scalable solutions
* Raise the seller experience bar by optimizing controls, removing unnecessary friction, and reducing business impact from new and existing compliance obligations
* Identify and resolve tax issues, bottlenecks, and dependencies; own remediation plans and drive continual process simplification
* Oversee program health end-to-end and prepare program updates and recommendations for senior leadership
* Perform competitive benchmarking to ensure Amazon programs meet or exceed industry standards
* Promote a culture of compliance, proactively engaging stakeholders across business, operations, and technology teams
* Influence roadmap prioritization by clearly articulating risk exposure and business impact
* Proactively identify pain points and opportunities for continual process simplification and improvements.

A day in the life
  
  
You are joining a global team spread across the US, EU, Japan, and India. You will partner closely with Tax Governance and collaborate heavily with Risk teams to ensure Amazon's compliance controls are in the best possible working order.
  
  
Your days will blend regulatory analysis, cross-functional delivery, seller experience optimization, and stakeholder coordination. One morning you are translating a new regulation into program requirements; the afternoon you are preparing materials for a senior leadership review.
  
  
No two days are the same, but the constant is pace, impact, and global reach.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 6+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
* Experience managing projects
* Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment, or experience communicating results to senior leadership

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree or equivalent
* Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
* Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent

title: Scientific Business Development Lead
description:
**Company Description**
Aganitha applies advanced AI to accelerate scientific innovation for global biopharma, consumer care, and material science organizations. The team combines data-driven agentic and generative AI with multi-omics and physics-based simulations to support the full biopharma R&D value chain, from target and biomarker discovery through therapeutic design, formulation, and patient stratification. Aganitha works across diverse therapeutic areas, including immunology, metabolic and cardiovascular disorders, rare genetic diseases, oncology, neuroscience, and infectious diseases, turning complex data into actionable insights. Its flagship Igniva™ Agentic AI platform encapsulates over eight years of global R&D collaboration experience into reusable scientific workflows that scale across teams and programs. For consumer care and material science, Aganitha’s solutions enable next-generation formulations through integrated AI, simulation, and multi-omics approaches.
  
**Role Description**
The Scientific Business Development Lead will drive growth by identifying, developing, and closing opportunities with biopharma, consumer care, and material science clients, with a strong focus on AI-enabled R&D solutions. This full-time, on-site role in Hyderabad involves working closely with scientific, technical, and commercial stakeholders to understand client R&D challenges and translate them into tailored solution proposals based on Aganitha’s platforms and services. Day-to-day responsibilities include prospecting and qualifying leads, conducting discovery meetings, preparing and delivering scientific and business presentations, and managing the end-to-end sales cycle. The role also includes collaborating with internal scientific and product teams to shape offerings, contributing to go-to-market strategies, and maintaining long-term client relationships through account management and strategic planning. The Scientific Business Development Lead will be expected to track market trends, gather competitive intelligence, and provide feedback that informs product roadmap and positioning.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex scientific and business data and convert insights into clear value propositions.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills for engaging scientific, technical, and executive stakeholders, both written and verbal.
* Laboratory skills and hands-on exposure to experimental or computational workflows in life sciences or related disciplines are beneficial.
* Experience in Research and Development (R&D) and research, ideally in biopharma, life sciences, or materials science, with familiarity in AI or data-driven approaches.
* Background in a scientific field such as biology, biotechnology, chemistry, pharmacology, materials science, or a related discipline; an advanced degree is a plus.
* Proven experience in business development, sales, or customer-facing scientific consulting, preferably with global clients.
* Ability to work cross-functionally with scientific, product, and engineering teams and manage multiple opportunities in parallel.
* Comfort with AI

title: Supervisor, Technical Writer
description:
**Description**

**Who is USP?**

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

**Brief Job Overview**

The Supervisor, Technical Writer supports USP’s global Advanced Manufacturing Technologies (AMT) and Resiliency Center work by developing clear, accurate, and audience-appropriate materials for external use. This role translates scientific, technical, and operational information for external audiences and supports alignment between content development and community engagement activities. The Supervisor, Technical Writer collaborates with technical experts, project leads, and communications stakeholders across regions and supervises the Community Engagement Specialist.

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**

As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.

Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.

The Supervisor, Technical Writer has the following responsibilities:

* Develop written content such as articles, briefs, reports, blogs, presentations, case studies, and other communication materials supporting AMT and Supply Chain Solutions initiatives.
* Translate complex scientific, technical, manufacturing, and supply chain information — including technical outlines, interview notes, research findings, meeting summaries, and subject matter expert input — into clear, accurate, and accessible written materials for external audiences.
* Collaborate with subject matter experts and project teams to gather information, validate technical accuracy, and incorporate feedback throughout the content development process.
* Support market-facing, educational, conference, and sales enablement materials that communicate USP's global AMT and Resiliency Center expertise, programs, services, and public health mission.
* Edit and refine draft materials to improve clarity, consistency, readability, and audience relevance.
* Apply USP brand standards, messaging priorities, and scientific quality expectations to written materials.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONTendering Executive / Tendering Engineer

**Company:** Exodrone Systems  
**Location:** Hyderabad, Telangana  
**Department:** Business Development / Tendering  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

1. Job Summary

Exodrone Systems is looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Tendering Executive / Tendering Engineer to identify, evaluate, prepare, and submit tenders for drone manufacturing, UAV systems, surveillance solutions, agricultural drones, defence applications, and other government and industrial projects.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the complete tendering process, from identifying suitable opportunities on government portals to preparing technical and commercial bids, coordinating documentation, and tracking tender results.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Tender Identification and Opportunity Research**

* Identify relevant tenders on GeM, CPPP, eProcurement portals, state government portals, defence procurement portals, and other platforms.
* Search for opportunities related to drones, UAVs, drone services, surveillance systems, agriculture, surveying, manufacturing, and defence technology.
* Evaluate tender eligibility, EMD, turnover requirements, prior experience, technical qualifications, and submission deadlines.
* Maintain a database of upcoming, ongoing, and submitted tenders.

**B. Tender Documentation and Submission**

* Prepare and submit technical bids, commercial bids, and supporting documents.
* Review tender documents, RFPs, BOQs, eligibility criteria, and technical specifications.
* Prepare compliance statements, technical datasheets, declarations, undertakings, and other required documents.
* Coordinate the preparation of company profiles, GST certificates, PAN, MSME/Udyam certificates, financial statements, work orders, and experience certificates.
* Ensure all tender submissions are complete, accurate, and submitted before deadlines.
* Manage online bid submission, document uploads, digital signatures, and portal-related formalities.

**C. Technical and Commercial Coordination**

* Coordinate with the engineering team to prepare technical specifications and compliance matrices.
* Obtain quotations from vendors and suppliers for components, equipment, and third-party products.
* Prepare cost sheets, BOQs, pricing comparisons, and commercial proposals.
* Coordinate internally to ensure that proposed products meet the tender requirements.
* Flag deviations, restrictive specifications, missing certifications, and risks before bid submission.

**D. Government and Institutional Liaison**

* Track tender clarifications, pre-bid meetings, corrigenda, amendments, and submission extensions.
* Prepare responses to buyer queries and requests for additional documentation.
* Coordinate with government departments, PSUs, defence organisations, and institutional buyers wherever required.
* Track technical evaluation, financial bid opening, results, purchase orders, and contract requirements.

**E. Tender Pipeline and Reporting**

* Maintain an updated tender tracker with deadlines, estimated values, eligibility, bid status, and outcomes.
* Prepare weekly reports on identified opportunities, submitted bids, and upcoming deadlines.
* Maintain an organised digital archive of tender documents and previous submissions.
* Analyse unsuccessful bids and recommend improvements to future submissions.

3. Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Engineering, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in tendering, government procurement, or bid management preferred.
* Freshers with strong documentation, research, and computer skills may also apply.
* Experience with GeM, CPPP, eProcurement portals, or government tender submissions is preferred.

4. Required Skills

* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong documentation, research, and organisational abilities.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel, Word, PDF tools, and online procurement portals.
* Ability to understand technical specifications and eligibility conditions.
* Strong attention to detail and deadline management.
* Ability to coordinate with engineering, accounts, vendors, and management teams.
* Knowledge of GST, EMD, bid security, performance security, and government procurement procedures is an advantage.

5. Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of relevant tenders identified and evaluated.
* Number of eligible tenders submitted before deadlines.
* Accuracy and completeness of tender documentation.
* Tender qualification and technical acceptance rate.
* Number and value of orders won.
* Timely tracking of tender updates, clarifications, and results.

6. Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be proactive, disciplined, comfortable working with government procurement portals, and capable of independently managing multiple tenders. Experience in drone technology, aerospace, defence equipment, electronics, engineering products, or industrial manufacturing will be an added advantage.

7. Compensation

Salary: As per experience and capabilities.

8. How to Apply

Interested candidates may submit their resume highlighting relevant tendering experience, government procurement portal knowledge, and previous tender submissions.

description:
**Job Information**

**Job Description**
-------------------

At Prolifics, we are currently implementing multiple solutions, and we are looking to hire Change Management Lead for our development centre in India. This position would be based out of Hyderabad and is a permanent position.

If you are looking for a high growth company with rock-solid stability, if you thrive in the energetic atmosphere of high-profile projects, we want to talk to you today! Let’s connect and explore possibilities of having you onboard the Prolifics team!

Job Title: Change Management Lead

Primary Skill: Lead change management activities across technology, product, process, and organizational transformation initiatives.  
Secondary Skill: Assess the business and organizational impact of proposed changes across different user groups and functions.  
Location: Hyderabad
  
Educational Qualification: B.Tech/BE/M.Tech/MCA/M.Sc  
YOE: 5-10 yrs

**Job Description:**

We are looking for an experienced Change Management professional to lead organizational change initiatives associated with technology implementations, product launches, process transformations, and business change programs.

The role will be responsible for assessing the impact of change, preparing stakeholders and end users, developing communication and training strategies, managing adoption, and ensuring that changes are successfully embedded into day-to-day operations.

The ideal candidate will have strong stakeholder management, communication, training, and organizational change skills, with the ability to work across business, technology, product, and delivery teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead change management activities across technology, product, process, and organizational transformation initiatives.
* Assess the business and organizational impact of proposed changes across different user groups and functions.
* Develop and execute comprehensive Change Management and Adoption Plans.
* Identify impacted stakeholders, user groups, processes, systems, and business functions.
* Develop stakeholder maps and assess stakeholder readiness, influence, impact, and potential resistance.
* Partner with business leaders, Product Owners, Project Managers, Technology teams, HR, Training, and Communications teams.
* Develop effective communication strategies and messaging for different stakeholder groups.
* Create and manage communication materials including announcements, newsletters, FAQs, presentations, executive updates, and change notifications.
* Develop training and enablement strategies aligned with the change roadmap.
* Coordinate training, demonstrations, workshops, knowledge-transfer sessions, and user enablement activities.
* Work with Technical Writers and Product Trainers to ensure documentation and training materials are aligned with the new processes and product capabilities.
* Establish stakeholder engagement plans and conduct regular readiness and feedback sessions.
* Identify potential resistance to change and develop appropriate mitigation and engagement strategies.
* Monitor adoption, user readiness, training completion, and change effectiveness.
* Develop and track change readiness and adoption metrics.
* Gather feedback from users and stakeholders and use insights to improve adoption.
* Support UAT, pilot programs, rollout planning, go-live, and post-production stabilization.
* Develop transition and operational-readiness plans to ensure smooth movement from project delivery to business-as-usual operations.
* Coordinate change activities across multiple locations, business units, and geographically distributed teams.
* Maintain change management risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and action items.
* Provide regular status updates and executive-level reporting on change readiness, adoption, risks, and key actions.
* Establish reusable change management frameworks, templates, processes, and best practices.

**About us:**

**Prolifics Corporation Limited** is a Global Technology Solutions Provider with presence across North America (USA and Canada), Europe (UK and Germany), Middle East & Asia. In India, we have offshore development centers: 3 in Hyderabad & 1 in Pune.

For more than 40 years, Prolifics has transformed enterprises of all sizes including over 100 Fortune 1000 companies by solving their complex IT challenges. Our clients include Fortune 50 and Fortune 100 companies across a broad range of industries including Financial Services, Insurance, Government, Healthcare, Telecommunications, Manufacturing and Retail. We rank consistently in **Dream Companies to Work For**and**Dream Employer of the Year**ranking from World HRD Congress, ranked 7 in 2019.

We encourage you to visit us on **www.prolifics.com** or follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube and other social media to know more about us.

title: Senior Technical Writer
description:
The MongoDB Documentation team is a group of writers and engineers who develop and maintain the documentation for the MongoDB product family. Our goal is to help our readers, both humans and AI, successfully use MongoDB products by providing outstanding documentation. The MongoDB Documentation team is a part of the MongoDB Core Product organization and is tightly integrated with the engineering teams responsible for each product.
  
  
The Docs team is responsible for documenting all aspects of the MongoDB data platform including the database, query language, Atlas, Vector Search, VoyageAI models, Full-Text Search, Stream Processing, client libraries, administrative tools, connectors, and more.
  
  
Your AI-forward mindset coupled with strong writing and technical skills will create clear reference docs and tutorials on high-complexity features. Your work, along with the other two MongoDB Docs teams, support AI agents, answer engines, and a large global community of new and experienced MongoDB users.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurgaon, Bengaluru or Mumbai for our hybrid working model.
  
  
Candidate Profile:
  
  
Candidates must have experience in a technical writing, technical communications, developer relations, or similar role in the software industry. Beyond industry experience, we are looking for someone who:
  
  

* Has experience writing technical documentation from scratch in English
* Possesses strong critical reading and writing skills
* Has hands-on experience using AI tools to accelerate documentation work
* Leverages sound editorial judgment to evaluate AI-generated content against source material for technical accuracy
* Has experience with cloud and database technologies
* Is able to read code for technical examples in at least one programming language (e.g., C++, C#, Java, Python, JavaScript)
* Has experience testing and validating documentable features and concepts

Position Expectations:
  
  

* Advocate for users in everything you write
* Work with technical and non-technical teams to meet the documentation needs of our users
* Research complex product features and validate with diligent testing
* Produce technically accurate and well-written documentation
* Contribute feedback to the team through copy review and planning discussions

Success Measures:
  
  
In 3 months:
  
  

* You'll be comfortable with our toolchain, AI tooling, and writing workflow
* You can implement small to medium complexity documentation requests
* You're getting to know our server engineers and are getting comfortable with participating in intra and inter team discussions
* You've completed the required technical training and courses required for MongoDB Engineering

In 6 months:
  
  

* You are getting comfortable doing deep dives into database architecture and technology as part of feature documentation
* You've got a working knowledge of the MongoDB data platform and know who to follow up with when you need to learn more
* You've adapted to our style of writing and your work demonstrates technical writing best practices
* You begin reviewing the work of your peers and learning from it
* You and your manager have discussed your career trajectory and growth opportunities
* You've helped the team improve and establish effective, well-vetted AI-assisted workflows for drafting and review

In 12 months:
  
  

* You're creating consistently high quality documentation for entire feature sets, complex tutorials, and high level concepts
* You know how much work you can manage and are contributing at a healthy pace
* You provide quality copy and technical reviews for your team members
* You provide best practices and coaching on AI-assisted workflows for your team members

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

title: Product Analyst Intern
description:
**About the Role**

We are rebuilding a large enterprise operations platform. The Product Analyst Intern will work closely with the Product Manager across documentation, requirement analysis and internal research through the specification and validation phase.

The work is mostly about understanding how a complex process works, writing it down clearly, and spotting where the existing documentation is incomplete or contradicts itself. Good fit for someone who reads carefully, writes cleanly and likes getting to the bottom of how something actually works.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Documentation**

• Draft and maintain product documentation — process flows, requirement breakdowns, configuration guides, release and change notes

• Convert workshop discussions and stakeholder inputs into structured written requirements

• Keep the document set current and version-controlled as decisions change

**Requirement analysis**

• Review business requirement documents for gaps, contradictions and outdated references; maintain an open-items register with proposed resolutions

• Map existing process rules and workflows and identify where they diverge from the documented standard

• Prepare test scenarios and validation checklists from existing specifications

**Internal research**

• Work with operations and client-facing teams to understand how the current process actually runs, and write up the findings

• Trace how specific cases and exceptions are handled today to surface undocumented behaviour
**Analysis**

• Work with operational datasets and configuration workbooks to reconcile inconsistencies and support requirement decisions with evidence

**Support to the Product Manager**

• Day-to-day BAU — meeting notes and action tracking, stakeholder follow-ups, status updates, query logs and quick turnaround asks

**Required skills**

• Strong written communication — able to explain a complex process simply and precisely

• Strong reading comprehension for long business documents

• Structured thinking and high attention to detail

• Working knowledge of Excel and comfort with documentation tools (Word, Confluence or similar) • Pursuing or recently completed a degree in engineering, business, economics, statistics or a related field

**Good to Have**

• Python (pandas) or SQL for basic data work

• Exposure to business process documentation, workflow tools or rule-based systems

• Familiarity with a high-volume operations or compliance environment

**What you will get**

• Direct exposure to how a large enterprise product is specified, validated and built

• Ownership of independent deliverables alongside hands-on support work

• Regular feedback and a portfolio of documentation and research work at the end

title: Lead Developer Advocate
description:
**Description**
**Who We Are**
Trailblazer Relations APAC is a team of creative, highly technical advocates, community builders, and program leaders. We inspire, enable, engage, and support the ever-growing Trailblazer community across Asia Pacific. We help Trailblazers succeed on the Salesforce Platform and use cutting-edge technologies like AIforce, Agentforce and Data Cloud.
  
  
Our work goes well beyond developer advocacy. We grow and support Trailblazer Community Groups, MVPs, and Group Leaders. We run community events and executive engagements. We also partner with customers, partners, and local ecosystems across the region. For developers, we write blog posts, produce video content, host workshops, and engage in person and virtually at Salesforce and third-party events.
  
  
We work closely with Trailblazer Community, Architect Evangelists, marketing, product management, engineering, and product marketing. We are the "voice of the Trailblazer" in APAC, bringing regional perspectives into the company to shape the Salesforce experience, especially around AI and data.
  
  
**Who You Are**
You're a seasoned technologist who thinks in systems. You know which tool and which feature fits the problem. That means choosing between probabilistic AI and deterministic code, and between visual builders and building from scratch. You're equally comfortable with front-end and back-end languages and APIs, and you're eager to explore new paradigms in AI-driven development.
  
  
You're curious about the full Salesforce portfolio, including platforms like MuleSoft and Heroku, and you enjoy connecting them to solve real problems. You show the "art of the possible" with prototypes that span multiple products.
  
  
You can shift between audiences, from students and new developers in emerging markets to senior architects and CTOs in mature ones. You're a lighthouse in the community, comfortable on camera and on stage in front of audiences of hundreds or thousands. You're ready to travel across APAC to meet them.
  
  
**You Are Excited About This Role Because You Will**

* Design technical content, reference apps, and demos that span AIforce, Agentforce, Data Cloud, and the wider Salesforce platform built for reuse across events and year-long regional programs.
* Collaborate with Architect Evangelists to incorporate architect content into the programs, campaigns and hands-on activities in the region.
* Contextualize global advocacy campaigns for APAC. For example, adapt one global message into narratives that work for a student-heavy market like India and an enterprise-heavy one like ANZ.
* Own the technical workstreams for flagship events such as World Tours, TDX, and Dreamforce. Design high-scale engagement models for 1000+ audiences, using gamification and interactive coding.
* Own content strategy and assets for programs such as Journey to Salesforce (J2S)
* Delegate component building while personally owning final testing and quality assurance.
* Identify gaps between product, market, and developer needs. Take real-world friction back to product and engineering as the "voice of the Trailblazer."
* Represent the team in strategic discussions, so Trailblazer and developer needs are prioritized in marketing motions.
* Coach non-technical team members, community leaders, and external presenters to deliver technical content at scale.
* Work with Community Group Leaders and MVPs to help them grow and succeed.

**We're Excited About You, Because You Have**

* 8+ years of experience implementing on the Salesforce Platform, with architect-level design skills.
* Recognized cross-product expertise, with a proven ability to build prototypes that connect multiple Salesforce products. Certifications or equivalent hands-on experience.
* Proven expertise in web applications, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Apex, and APIs, plus hands-on curiosity about AIforce, Agentforce and Data Cloud.
* Excellent presentation, interpersonal, and communication skills, and experience making complex concepts accessible.
* Proven ability to influence without authority across regional stakeholders.
* Experience coaching and mentoring others, and a track record of raising the bar on code and content quality.
* An understanding of how quickly the ways people consume content and share experiences are shifting.
* A strategic mind and strong problem-solving and analytical skills. You work well solo and as a collaborative team player.
* Ability to travel up to 30%.

title: TECHNICAL WRITER
description:
Dear Candidates,

Greetings from Infinnium !

We are hiring for the position of
**Technical Writer – Product Documentation**
to join our growing US-based IT company in Ahmedabad.

**Designation: Technical Writer – Product Documentation**

**Location: Ahmedabad**

**Employment Type: Full-Time | On-Site**

**Openings: 2**

**About Company:**

Infinnium Infotech is redefining the way organizations engage with data to gain actionable intelligence. We develop software solutions for corporations, law firms, and government agencies using modern technologies such as AI and machine learning to support information governance, including compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, and other privacy regulations, litigation readiness, and electronic discovery.Our software product brings simplicity to the complex world of digital data, combining the strength of people and modern technology to help organizations effectively address today’s complex information governance needs and realize the intrinsic value of their data.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a Technical Writer / Product Documentation Specialist to join our team and help create and maintain clear, accurate, and user-friendly product documentation.

The role involves working closely with Product, Development, QA, and Support teams to understand product functionality, UI changes, new features, enhancements, and workflows, and convert this information into comprehensive help documentation.

This role will be particularly important as we undergo a major UI transformation of the product, requiring significant documentation updates and new content within defined timelines. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with technical information, reviewing development stories, understanding application workflows, coordinating with technical teams, and using AI powered tools to improve documentation quality and efficiency.

**Role Summary :**

This position is ideal for a technically inclined writer who enjoys learning software products, collaborating with engineering and QA teams, and turning complex product functionality into clear, practical user documentation. Candidates who combine strong English communication skills with technical curiosity, attention to detail, and effective use of AI-assisted tools are encouraged to apply.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Review TFS/Azure DevOps stories, requirements, acceptance criteria, and technical details to understand new features and product changes.
* Analyze existing and newly developed product functionality and understand end-to-end user workflows.
* Work closely with developers, QA/testers, product teams, and support teams to clarify functionality and documentation requirements.
* Participate in discussions, demonstrations, and walkthroughs with developers and testers to understand how features work in the actual product.
* Create and update product help files, user guides, feature documentation, configuration guides, and workflow documentation.
* Document new features and UI changes with clear, structured, and easy-to-understand explanations.
* Review the application UI and ensure documentation accurately reflects the latest screens, fields, buttons, options, workflows, and terminology.
* Identify gaps or inconsistencies between product functionality and existing documentation and coordinate with relevant teams for clarification.
* Document configuration options, prerequisites, permissions, limitations, dependencies, and expected behavior where applicable.
* Update existing documentation whenever product functionality, workflows, or UI elements change.
* Maintain consistency in terminology, formatting, structure, screenshots, and documentation standards across the product.
* Coordinate documentation updates with product releases and ensure documentation is completed within required timelines.
* Upload and publish completed documentation to the product/help system as required.

**Required Skills:**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Excellent technical writing and documentation skills.
* Ability to understand software functionality and explain it in simple, user-friendly language.
* Experience working with software products, SaaS applications, or technical platforms.
* Ability to read and understand user stories, requirements, acceptance criteria, and technical discussions.
* Ability to work effectively with developers and QA/testers to understand functionality and validate documentation.
* Good understanding of software development and testing processes.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly when documenting UI elements, workflows, configurations, and system behavior.
* Familiarity with TFS/Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar work-management tools.
* Experience with documentation/help-authoring tools or knowledge bases.
* Experience with screenshots, screen annotation, flow diagrams, and other visual documentation.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and similar productivity tools.
* Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, or equivalent tools.

**Apply Here:**

https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/1hGjZ99xUj

**Thanks & Regards,**

**Yamini Patel**

**Infinnium**

**Company:** Bright India Ai  
**Position:** Field Sales Executive  
**Experience:** Fresher to 2 years  
**Location:** Gujarat, India  
**Job Type:** Full-time, Field-Based

Job Overview

India Connect is looking for an energetic, confident, and motivated **Field Sales & Marketing Executive** to promote our AI-powered products and services.  
This is primarily an **on-field sales role**, requiring daily door-to-door marketing, business visits, face-to-face customer interactions, and lead generation.  
We are not looking for highly experienced candidates. Freshers with strong communication skills, confidence, a willingness to travel locally, and an interest in learning about AI and technology are welcome.

* Basic smartphone and computer knowledge preferred.
* Willingness to travel locally for daily business visits is essential.

title: Federal Proposal Writer
description:
Job Title

**Federal Proposal Writer / Capture Manager – GSA MAS**

Job Type

Full-Time | Remote

Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced
**Federal Proposal Writer / Capture Manager**
with strong knowledge of the
**U.S. federal contracting environment**
, particularly
**GSA Multiple Award Schedule (MAS)**
opportunities. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience supporting the full federal business development lifecycle, including
**opportunity identification, capture strategy, solicitation analysis, proposal development, compliance, pricing coordination, and submission**
.

The candidate will work closely with business development, recruiting, delivery, contracts, pricing, and leadership teams to develop compelling, compliant, and competitive proposals for federal government opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

**Federal Capture Management**

* Identify and evaluate federal contracting opportunities aligned with company capabilities and growth objectives.
* Support the capture lifecycle from
  **early opportunity identification through proposal submission and award**
  .
* Develop and maintain
  **capture plans, opportunity assessments, win strategies, call plans, and action plans**
  .
* Analyze agency requirements, procurement history, incumbent information, competition, contract vehicles, and anticipated acquisition strategies.
* Track opportunities through
  **SAM.gov, GSA eBuy, agency procurement forecasts, and other federal procurement sources**
  .
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to establish bid/no-bid recommendations based on documented opportunity factors.

**Proposal Development & Writing**

* Lead or support the development of federal government proposals, RFIs, Sources Sought responses, RFQs, RFP responses, capability statements, and task-order proposals.
* Develop persuasive content for
  **Technical, Management, Staffing, Past Performance, Corporate Experience, and Executive Summary**
  sections.
* Translate technical and operational information from SMEs into clear, compliant, evaluator-focused proposal content.
* Develop proposal outlines, compliance matrices, annotated outlines, storyboards, and content plans.
* Ensure proposals clearly address
  **Section L instructions and Section M evaluation criteria**
  , where applicable.
* Coordinate proposal inputs from SMEs, recruiting, operations, finance, contracts, and leadership.
* Edit and quality-check proposal content for clarity, consistency, grammar, formatting, and compliance.

**GSA MAS Experience**

* Support proposal and contract activities associated with the
  **GSA Multiple Award Schedule (MAS)**
  .
* Demonstrate familiarity with the GSA MAS solicitation structure, SINs, labor categories, pricing requirements, and applicable proposal documentation.
* Assist with identifying appropriate
  **Special Item Numbers (SINs)**
  based on company capabilities.
* Support preparation and maintenance of GSA MAS-related documentation, including labor category descriptions, qualifications, pricing information, and supporting narratives.
* Understand the importance of maintaining consistency between the company's capabilities, labor categories, pricing, and federal proposal submissions.
* Support responses to GSA/eBuy RFQs and task-order opportunities under applicable contract vehicles.

**Compliance & Proposal Management**

* Develop and maintain detailed
  **compliance matrices**
  mapping solicitation requirements to proposal responses.
* Track solicitation amendments, questions and answers, deadlines, deliverables, and proposal responsibilities.
* Conduct color-team reviews such as
  **Pink Team, Red Team, and Gold Team**
  reviews as appropriate.
* Identify proposal gaps, inconsistencies, risks, and missing solicitation requirements before submission.
* Maintain proposal libraries, reusable content, past-performance information, resumes, corporate qualifications, and relevant project descriptions.

**Business Development & Capture Support**

* Collaborate with leadership and business development teams to strengthen federal market positioning.
* Research federal agencies, buying patterns, competitors, incumbents, and upcoming procurements.
* Assist with development of
  **capability statements, one-pagers, presentations, white papers, and sources-sought responses**
  .
* Support teaming and subcontractor research when required.
* Maintain accurate opportunity and capture information within CRM or pipeline-management systems.

Required Qualifications

* **3+ years of experience**
  in federal proposal writing, capture management, business development, or federal contracting.
* Demonstrated experience with
  **U.S. federal government proposals and solicitations**
  .
* Hands-on experience with
  **GSA MAS / GSA eBuy**
  is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of federal solicitation terminology, including
  **RFI, Sources Sought, RFQ, RFP, SOW, PWS, SOO, L/M sections, evaluation criteria, and compliance matrices**
  .
* Experience researching opportunities through
  **SAM.gov**
  and other federal procurement resources.
* Strong proposal writing, editing, proofreading, and document-management skills.
* Experience working with technical SMEs and translating technical information into proposal-ready content.
* Ability to manage multiple proposals and competing deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to identify compliance gaps.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience supporting
  **GSA MAS SINs and eBuy opportunities**
  .
* Experience with
  **IDIQ, GWAC, BPA, BOA, and task-order competitions**
  .
* Knowledge of federal acquisition processes and
  **FAR/DFARS**
  requirements.
* Experience with federal staffing, IT services, professional services, or technology contracts.
* Experience supporting
  **8(a), SDVOSB, WOSB, HUBZone, or other small-business federal contracting programs**
  .
* Proposal certification such as
  **APMP**
  is a plus.
* Experience with proposal management tools, CRM systems, or platforms such as
  **GovWin, Deltek, Salesforce, Loopio, Responsive, or similar systems**
  .

Core Competencies

* Federal Proposal Writing
* Capture Management
* GSA MAS
* GSA eBuy
* Federal Business Development
* SME Coordination
* Proposal Reviews
* FAR/DFARS Awareness
* SAM.gov Research
* Task-Order Proposal Development

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should understand
**how to interpret the solicitation once released, and how to turn that strategy into a compliant and persuasive proposal**
.

Particular value will be placed on candidates who have
**personally supported GSA MAS activities and GSA eBuy opportunities**
, rather than candidates whose experience is limited to commercial proposals.

title: Legal Executive
description:
**About the Role**

Quambiant Developers is looking for a **Legal Executive** to support its expanding real estate development and building operations in Bangalore. The role will involve managing **real estate and property-related legal matters, statutory compliance, contract documentation, RERA compliance, title due diligence, registration processes, and coordination with external legal counsel**.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of real estate documentation and regulatory processes, with the ability to independently coordinate multiple legal requirements across projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Land & Real Estate Due Diligence**

* Conduct legal due diligence for prospective land parcels, joint-development properties, and acquisition opportunities.
* Review historical title deeds, Encumbrance Certificates, revenue records, RTCs, Khata certificates, and other relevant property documents.
* Identify and highlight potential legal risks or title-related concerns.

**2. Statutory Compliance & Approvals**

* Assist in tracking, securing, and maintaining documentation for statutory and regulatory approvals.
* Coordinate for approvals and clearances from authorities such as **BBMP, BDA, BMRDA, KSPCB**, and other relevant regulatory bodies.
* Track environmental clearances, building plan sanctions, and other project-related approvals.

**3. Contract Drafting & Management**

* Draft, review, and coordinate legal documentation for real estate transactions, including:
* Sale Agreements
* Sale Deeds
* Joint Venture (JV) Agreements
* Development Agreements
* General Powers of Attorney (GPA)
* Review and manage operational contracts, including architectural, engineering, contractor, procurement, lease, and rental agreements.

**4. RERA & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure ongoing and upcoming projects in Karnataka comply with **Karnataka RERA (K-RERA/KERA)** requirements.
* Monitor project-related legal documentation, disclosures, filings, and regulatory compliance.
* Maintain appropriate records and documentation to support ongoing compliance.

**5. Corporate Secretarial Coordination**

* Coordinate with corporate counsel and external Company Secretaries for statutory requirements.
* Assist with statutory filings, maintenance of registers, board resolutions, and entity-level documentation.
* Support legal documentation requirements for local branches and entities.

**6. Litigation & Legal Case Management**

* Maintain records and track ongoing or potential legal matters.
* Monitor RERA complaints, consumer court matters, land disputes, and other legal proceedings.
* Coordinate with external/panel advocates and ensure timely follow-up on legal matters.

**7. Customer & Property Documentation**

* Standardize and oversee customer-facing legal documentation, including:
* Booking Forms
* Allotment Letters
* Builder-Buyer Agreements
* Tripartite Agreements
* Ensure documentation is accurate, complete, and legally compliant.

**8. Registration & Conveyance**

* Coordinate execution and registration of Sale Deeds and Conveyance Deeds.
* Liaise with local Sub-Registrar Offices in Bangalore for property registrations.
* Ensure smooth and timely completion of registration and property handover documentation.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Strong understanding of **real estate and property laws**.
* Good knowledge of legal documentation and contract management.
* Understanding of **RERA/K-RERA and local regulatory approvals**.
* Strong drafting, reviewing, and negotiation skills.
* Excellent documentation and record-management abilities.
* Strong coordination skills with internal teams, government authorities, consultants, and external legal counsel.
* Attention to detail and ability to identify legal and documentation risks.
* Good communication and follow-up skills.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in **real estate, property development, construction, or infrastructure** legal functions will be preferred.
* Candidates with hands-on experience in **property due diligence, real estate agreements, RERA compliance, registrations, and litigation coordination** will be preferred.

**What You Will Do**

This role will serve as an important legal support function across Quambiant's Bangalore operations, ensuring that **property transactions, project approvals, contracts, customer documentation, registrations, and regulatory requirements are handled accurately, efficiently, and in compliance with applicable laws**.

title: Principal Consultant
description:
**Opportunity Overview:**  
  
As a Principal Consultant (Delivery Enterprise Architect) within the Dell organization, aligned to Consulting Service Delivery, you will provide consultative business and technical delivery services for a range of complex customer-facing consulting engagements, in partnership with Global Pre-Sales, Account Management and Solutioning Teams. Specifically, you will be part of projects deploying, administering and configurating Large Language Model and Generative AI software stacks. These projects will focus on allowing Dell customers to deploy and fine-tune GenAI models.  
  
Also, as the senior-most technical member of the Services Delivery team, for the GenAI/Data Science Practice, you will work alongside other Dell badged Consultants, to earn the customers trust through competence, technical acumen, consulting expertise, and partnership. You would also be responsible for providing guidance/oversight to these individuals and technical grooming activities for their skill upgrading. This position requires a dynamic individual with expert customer-facing skills, leadership qualities and forecasting abilities for a particular technology and its lifecycle. The ability to guide customers and communicate technical processes and ideas is essential. These engagements often ensure that the customer is also enabled in the technologies being delivered.  
  
The person should have the common traits and capabilities that are listed in Section 2 (Essential Requirements) and meet many of the capabilities listed in Section 3 (Desirable Requirements).  
  
**Key Requirements:**  
  
**Experience and qualifications:**  
  

* 18+ years in the IT industry, preferably with a masters degree in Data Science, Machine Learning, or a related field.
* 8+ years in Artificial Intelligence and Big Data within a customer-facing services delivery role, including the ability to engage Data Scientists and assess their current and future ecosystems.
* 5+ years implementing and supporting infrastructure deployment, setup, and configuration through automation (agentic automation a strong plus).

  
**Generative & Agentic AI:**  
  

* Deep, hands-on knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) and the broader Generative AI tooling ecosystem.
* Proven experience designing agentic AI solutions and agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, CrewAI, Langfuse, and LangSmith.
* Familiarity with the NVIDIA AI software suite, including NVIDIA Base Command Manager (formerly Bright Cluster Manager), the NeMo framework, and Triton Inference Server.

  
**MLOps & AIOps Platforms:**  
  

* Deep understanding of the MLOps and AIOps ecosystem, with hands-on experience across platforms such as Kubeflow, MLflow, Run:ai, ClearML, Ray, H2O, and Cohere.

  
**Data Engineering & Distributed Systems:**  
  

* Extensive production experience with distributed query and processing engines Kafka, Trino (Starburst) and Apache Spark.
* Hands-on experience with modern table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi) for managing large-scale datasets.
* Mastery of cloud-native storage and compute e.g., AWS S3/EMR, GCP BigQuery/Dataproc, or Azure ADLS/Databricks.
* Deep understanding of columnar storage formats (Parquet, Avro) and how to optimize them for different query patterns.

  
**DevOps, IaC & CI/CD:**  
  

* Proven application of DevOps and Infrastructure-as-Code practices across both application development and infrastructure automation including desired-state configuration, GitOps, and CI/CD pipeline design.
* Extensive experience with CI/CD tooling such as GitLab, Argo CD, and Tekton.

  
**Kubernetes & Containers:**  
  

* Proven experience deploying and configuring Kubernetes (e.g., OpenShift), with deep knowledge of application deployments, Helm charts, and Kubernetes operators.
* Extensive experience building containerized applications, including container image signing.
* Knowledge of AI-related Kubernetes operators, such as the NVIDIA GPU, Network, and Storage operators.

  
**Consulting & Delivery Skills:**  
  

* Ability to earn customer trust and to plan, organize, and lead customer workshops; excellent written and spoken English is essential.
* Comfortable working in efficient Agile teams (Scrum or Kanban), including extended pairing and enablement sessions that drive knowledge transfer in complex domains.
* Ability to influence and interact with confidence and credibility at all levels within Dell and across customers, partners, and vendors.
* Experience delivering within a defined project methodology while adhering to SOW, margin, and planning requirements.
* Willingness and ability to be onsite for customer workshops and enablement sessions.
