title: Lead Designer, Brand & Communications
description:
Candescent is a forward-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in-person channels.

Our Experience-Led, Intelligence-Driven approach combines human-centered design with data, automation, and cloud-based innovation. Built on an API-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.

**Job Summary**
---------------

*Role Purpose*

Candescent is seeking a highly skilled Lead Designer to join our Brand & Communications team from one of our India office locations. This role will help bring the Candescent brand to life across internal, client-facing, executive, event, digital, and sales enablement materials. The ideal candidate combines strong design craft, production discipline, visual problem-solving, and brand stewardship with the ability to move quickly across a wide range of requests.

This is a hands-on design role, not a review-only or coordination role. The Senior Designer will personally create, refine, and finalize high-quality work while partnering closely with brand, communications, marketing, product marketing, sales, events, and executive stakeholders. Success requires excellent judgment, strong typography and layout skills, comfort with content-heavy materials, and the ability to maintain a consistent visual standard across every touchpoint.

**Key Responsibilities and Deliverables**
-----------------------------------------

*What you will be responsible for and what you will do*

### **Brand Design & Visual Execution**

* Create polished visual solutions across digital, print, presentation, event, environmental, sales enablement, and internal communications projects.
* Design a wide range of assets including executive presentations, sales and marketing decks, one-pagers, ebooks, infographics, newsletters, social graphics, event materials, signage, and internal communications visuals.
* Translate complex, content-heavy, or abstract information into clear, engaging, and visually compelling communications.
* Elevate layouts, typography, hierarchy, imagery, icons, charts, and data visualizations so materials are easy to understand and unmistakably on brand.

### **Brand Consistency & Design Systems**

* Apply and extend Candescent brand standards across all assigned work, including typography, color, layout, iconography, imagery, presentation systems, and data visualization.
* Help maintain a consistent visual experience across internal and external channels, ensuring work feels connected, professional, and aligned to the company’s brand narrative.
* Use established templates and systems appropriately, while identifying opportunities to improve usability, scalability, and consistency.
* Spot and correct brand drift, formatting inconsistencies, visual clutter, and production issues before materials are delivered.

### **Production, Quality Control & Delivery**

* Prepare accurate, production-ready files for digital, print, presentation, large-format, and event applications.
* Proof work carefully for alignment, spacing, hierarchy, accuracy, pagination, export settings, image quality, and brand compliance.
* Manage multiple projects and deadlines at once while maintaining a high standard of craft and attention to detail.
* Respond quickly to feedback, incorporate revisions thoughtfully, and deliver final assets that require minimal rework.

### **Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Brand & Communications team members and cross-functional stakeholders to clarify objectives, understand audiences, and translate business needs into effective visual communications.
* Collaborate with US-based stakeholders and global team members through clear communication, organized handoffs, and reliable follow-through.
* Work with agencies, vendors, freelancers, or production partners when needed, providing files, feedback, specifications, and guidance that support high-quality outcomes.
* Operate with ownership and accountability, knowing when to ask questions, when to recommend a stronger solution, and when to move quickly to execution.

**Experience**
--------------

*Demonstrated skills, competencies, and required experience*

* 10+ years of professional graphic design experience, preferably within an in-house creative team, agency, corporate brand team, B2B, fintech, SaaS, or enterprise environment.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional design execution across presentations, print, digital, sales enablement, events, internal communications, and brand storytelling materials.
* Expert proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, including InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop.
* Advanced PowerPoint design skills, including executive-level presentations, slide systems, master templates, visual hierarchy, charts, diagrams, and content-heavy storytelling.
* Strong typography, layout, composition, information design, and visual storytelling skills.
* Deep understanding of brand systems and how to apply them consistently across multiple channels, audiences, and formats.
* Strong production knowledge, including file preparation, print production, vendor coordination, export specifications, and large-format applications.
* Experience turning complex or technical subject matter into clear, polished, visually engaging communications.
* Proven ability to manage multiple projects, adapt to shifting priorities, and deliver high-quality work on deadline.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain design decisions clearly and professionally.

**Qualifications & Preferred Distinctions**
-------------------------------------------

*Additional accomplishments*

* Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Communication Design, Fine Arts, or a related field; equivalent professional experience and a strong portfolio may be considered in lieu of a formal degree.
* Experience supporting financial services, technology, B2B, SaaS, or enterprise software brands is preferred.
* Experience designing for executive, client, consultant, partner, or sales audiences is preferred.
* Experience with Figma, Canva, After Effects, motion graphics, web design, or digital campaign tools is a plus.
* Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Brand and communications materials are polished, consistent, accurate, and recognizably Candescent across every touchpoint.
* Executive, client-facing, sales, and internal materials are visually clear, easy to follow, and delivered with a high level of craft.
* The Brand & Communications team can rely on this role for dependable, hands-on execution with minimal rework.
* Templates, systems, and recurring materials become easier to use, more consistent, and faster to produce over time.
* Stakeholders receive thoughtful design partnership, clear communication, and high-quality deliverables on deadline.
* The candidate demonstrates ownership, flexibility, and sound judgment while supporting a lean, fast-moving global team.

**What Will Make You Successful**
---------------------------------

* Outstanding typography, layout, and information design skills.
* Strong visual judgment, meticulous attention to detail, and a commitment to design craftsmanship.
* Ability to create polished, production-ready work with minimal direction.
* Comfort moving quickly between projects while maintaining a consistently high quality bar.
* A practical understanding of how design supports brand perception, business goals, sales effectiveness, employee engagement, and client confidence.
* A collaborative, low-ego working style with the confidence to recommend stronger design solutions when needed.
* Strong organization, follow-through, and accountability in a global, fast-paced environment.

**Statement to Third Party Agencies**  
To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

**Industry:** Real Estate / Property Development  
**Department:** Legal  
**Designation:** Legal Manager

**Experience:** 08-10 years  
**Salary Range:** ₹40,000 – ₹50,000 per month  
**Location:** Chennai

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Legal Manager to handle legal documentation, property registration, land-related legal matters, and statutory approvals for our real estate projects. The candidate should have strong knowledge of property laws, excellent drafting skills, and the ability to maintain a good professional rapport with government officials and registration authorities.

Key Responsibilities1. Legal Document Drafting

* Draft, review, and finalize sale agreements, construction agreements, allocation agreements, joint venture agreements, and other property-related legal documents.
* Prepare and review sale deeds, power of attorney documents, affidavits, undertakings, and related legal paperwork.
* Verify land documents, title deeds, encumbrance certificates, parent documents, patta, chitta, and other relevant property records.
* Ensure the accuracy and legal compliance of all documents before execution and registration.
* Maintain physical and digital copies of legal documents with proper project-wise filing.

2. Property Registration Process

* Coordinate and manage the registration of sale deeds, construction agreements, and other property-related documents.
* Liaise with Sub-Registrar Offices (SROs), registration departments, and other relevant authorities.
* Verify document requirements, stamp duty, registration fees, and applicable statutory procedures.
* Coordinate with customers, legal consultants, advocates, and internal departments to complete registrations on time.
* Track registration status and ensure registered documents are collected and filed properly.

3. Government Liaison and Approvals

* Maintain a strong and professional working relationship with government officials, registration authorities, revenue department officials, and other relevant departments.
* Coordinate for property records, land-related documentation, statutory approvals, and required certificates.
* Follow up on pending applications and resolve documentation-related issues through lawful procedures.
* Stay updated on changes in property laws, registration rules, government procedures, and applicable regulations.

4. Real Estate Project Legal Support

* Handle legal documentation for apartment, villa, residential layout, and land development projects.
* Support land acquisition, joint venture arrangements, landowner agreements, and property due diligence.
* Coordinate for APF processing, project documentation, and other applicable legal formalities.
* Respond to customer legal queries and support the sales and CRM teams with property-related documentation.
* Identify legal risks and escalate title disputes, encumbrances, and other significant issues to management.

5. Team Coordination and Reporting

* Coordinate with Sales, CRM, Accounts, Purchase, and Project teams for legal requirements.
* Maintain a project-wise tracker for agreements, registrations, approvals, and pending legal matters.
* Monitor document preparation and registration timelines.
* Provide regular updates to management regarding registration progress, pending approvals, and legal risks.
* Supervise legal executives or documentation staff, where applicable.

Required Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Law (LL.B.) is preferred.
* 5–8 years of relevant experience in real estate legal documentation and property registration.
* Strong knowledge of property laws and registration procedures in Tamil Nadu.
* Hands-on experience in drafting and reviewing property-related legal documents.
* Proven experience coordinating with Sub-Registrar Offices and government departments.
* Good communication, negotiation, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office, document management, and legal record maintenance.

Key Skills

* Legal drafting and document verification
* Property registration and statutory compliance
* Government liaison and professional relationship management
* Land documentation and title verification
* Real estate legal due diligence
* Follow-up and issue resolution
* Team management and reporting
* Attention to detail and time management

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely completion of legal document drafting and review.
* Percentage of property registrations completed within the planned timeline.
* Accuracy and completeness of legal documentation.
* Timely follow-up on approvals and pending registrations.
* Reduction in documentation errors and registration delays.
* Effective resolution of customer and internal legal queries.
* Proper maintenance of project-wise legal records.
* Compliance with applicable laws and registration procedures.

description:
**MARKETING EXECUTIVE – JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Job description:**

The Field Marketing Representative plays a crucial role in driving brand visibility and sales for the corporate tiles industry by engaging with clients directly in the field. This role involves meeting prospective clients, promoting tiles and related products, conducting market surveys, and ensuring that customer requirements are met. The ideal candidate will be dynamic, self-motivated, and have excellent interpersonal skills, with a strong understanding of the tiles industry and market dynamics.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. On-field Client Engagement:**

* Visit prospective clients, including architects, builders, contractors, and retailers, to promote the company’s tiles and products.
* Build and nurture relationships with customers through regular follow-ups and on-site meetings.
* Address client inquiries and provide product demonstrations to explain features, benefits, and applications.

**2. Market Research and Analysis:**

* Conduct market surveys to identify new opportunities, trends, and competitor activities.
* Gather feedback from customers to understand their needs, preferences, and challenges.
* Provide detailed reports on market insights to the marketing and sales teams for strategy refinement.

**3. Product Promotion and Awareness:**

* Distribute marketing materials such as brochures, catalogues, and samples to potential clients.
* Educate customers on new product launches, offers, and promotions to drive interest and sales.

**4. Sales and Lead Conversion:**

* Identify and generate leads in the field, ensuring consistent follow-up to convert them into sales.
* Collaborate with the sales team to achieve individual and team sales targets.
* Negotiate pricing and terms with clients to close deals effectively.

**5. Reporting and Documentation:**

* Maintain accurate records of daily visits, client interactions, and sales activities.
* Prepare regular reports on field marketing activities, market trends, and sales performance.
* Use CRM tools or other systems to update client information and track progress.

**6. Coordination with Internal Teams:**

* Work closely with the marketing, sales, and logistics teams to ensure timely delivery and customer satisfaction.
* Communicate customer feedback and market requirements to the relevant departments for continuous improvement.

**Qualifications:**

* **Bachelor’s degree** in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred).
* **1-3 years of experience** in field marketing, sales, or business development.
* Knowledge of tiles, their features, and applications is highly advantageous.

**Key Skills:**

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to engage with clients and build relationships.
* Strong persuasion and negotiation skills to convert leads into sales.
* Analytical and problem-solving abilities to understand market trends and client needs.
* Proficiency in using CRM software, Microsoft Office, and other reporting tools.
* Organizational skills to manage schedules, client visits, and reporting effectively.

**Working Conditions:**

* Majority of work will be field-based, involving travel to client sites, project locations, and events.
* Flexible working hours, including evenings or weekends, as per client requirements.
* Regular interaction with clients and coordination with internal teams.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

* Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.
* Travel and communication allowances.
* Health insurance and other benefits.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.

title: Senior Executive - Finance
description:
**About Rocketlane**

Rocketlane is a fast-growing, innovative SaaS company making waves in professional services automation (PSA) and customer onboarding.

Our mission? To empower B2B companies with a smooth, consistent, and efficient way to manage client projects, resources, time, and billing—reducing chaos and boosting customer satisfaction across industries.

We’re a close-knit team of 150+ passionate professionals, building a product teams love to use. Backed by top investors like Insight Partners, 8VC, Matrix Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners, we’re scaling fast—and now’s the perfect time to join the rocketship.

**What will you do?**

As a Senior Executive – Finance, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring financial accuracy, compliance, and efficiency across our India and US operations. You will manage critical finance functions while working closely with internal teams, auditors, and external stakeholders.

Here’s what you’ll get to do:

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date books of accounts in compliance with applicable accounting standards. Collaborate with external consultants to ensure timely monthly closure of accounts, and oversee the preparation of MIS reports to support business decision-making.

* Ensure full compliance with statutory requirements under Indian laws including Income Tax, Companies Act, FEMA, and GST. This involves timely filings, accurate tax computation, monitoring regulatory changes, liaising with consultants/authorities as needed, and implementing robust internal controls to mitigate compliance risks.

* Oversee compliance with US financial regulations including sales and use tax, payroll tax, and related reporting obligations. Work closely with external advisors and payroll providers to ensure timely filings, accurate withholding, and adherence to state and federal laws.

* Oversee the administration of vendor contracts, manage the end-to-end process of invoice verification, approval, and payment.

* Act as the primary liaison with statutory auditors by providing all necessary documentation, explanations, and information.

**You should apply if**

* You have qualified CA/ACCA with 2–5 years of experience in finance or accounting, preferably in a SaaS or multinational environment.

* You possess strong knowledge of Indian taxation, compliance, and accounting standards, along with exposure to US compliance requirements.

You are detail-oriented, analytical, and adept at managing end-to-end finance operations. You are comfortable working with accounting software and ERP systems.

* You communicate clearly, work collaboratively across teams, and can manage multiple priorities with ease.

**Why join us?**

At Rocketlane, we’re all about building a great product and a great place to work. Here’s why you’ll actually look forward to Mondays:

* **Impact and ownership**: You won’t just be another cog in the machine; here, you’re more like a turbocharged engine part. Bring your ideas, make them happen.

* **Work with the best**: We’re a team of passionate, quirky, and ridiculously talented people. Come for the work, stay for the memes.

* **Celebrate wins**: Whether we’re hitting major milestones or celebrating new funding, we like to mix it up. From rap videos to team outings, we believe in celebrating big.

* **Learn and grow**: We’re all about learning—and we’re not just talking about the latest SaaS trends. You’ll grow your career, pick up new skills, and maybe even learn to love Excel (or at least tolerate it).

* **Flexibility and balance**: While we love collaborating in the office five days a week, we know everyone has their own rhythm. That’s why we offer flexibility around hours—so you can bring your best energy, whether you’re an early bird or a night owl. Pajamas optional (at least outside the office).

title: Cluster Assistant Human Resource Manager_South Region
description:
**Cluster Assistant Human Resource Manager**
============================================

**Brand:** Holiday Inn Express – IHG Hotels & Resorts  
**Department:** Human Resources  
**Job Band:** 06  
**Location:** Cluster Role – Hyderabad, Bengaluru & Chennai, India  
**Reports To:** Portfolio HR Director  
**Travel Requirement:** Frequent inter-property travel across assigned hotels

**About Holiday Inn Express**
-----------------------------

At Holiday Inn Express, we believe in making travel simple and smart. We focus on delivering a comfortable stay, friendly service and the essentials that matter most to our guests.

As part of IHG Hotels & Resorts, we are committed to creating True Hospitality for everyone. We are looking for a people-oriented HR professional who can support our hotel teams, strengthen employee engagement and drive consistent HR practices across our multi-property portfolio.

**Role Overview – What Is the Job?**
------------------------------------

The Cluster Assistant HR Manager will support and drive the Human Resources function across assigned Holiday Inn Express hotels in Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Chennai. The role will be responsible for implementing HR policies and procedures, talent acquisition, employee engagement, learning and development, performance management, employee relations, payroll coordination and statutory compliance.

The position will work closely with General Managers, Hotel Managers, Department Heads and the Portfolio HR Director to build a positive workplace culture, ensure compliance with applicable employment laws and support business performance through effective people management.

This is a multi-property role requiring strong execution, stakeholder management, analytical skills and the ability to travel regularly across assigned hotel locations.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. Human Resources Operations**

* Manage and coordinate day-to-day HR operations across assigned hotel properties, ensuring consistency in HR processes and adherence to company policies.
* Maintain accurate employee records, personnel files, HR documentation, attendance and employee lifecycle data.
* Coordinate onboarding, induction, confirmation, transfers, promotions, employee separations and full-and-final settlement inputs.
* Support the implementation and effective utilisation of HRMS and recruitment systems.
* Ensure timely preparation of HR reports, manpower updates, organisational structures and other management reports.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of employee information and HR records.

### **2. Talent Acquisition and Manpower Planning**

* Coordinate end-to-end recruitment activities, including manpower requisitions, candidate sourcing, interview scheduling, selection coordination and offer management.
* Partner with General Managers and Department Heads to understand manpower requirements and ensure timely recruitment.
* Monitor vacancies, recruitment turnaround time, joining ratios and manpower availability across the assigned hotels.
* Ensure recruitment practices comply with IHG standards, company policies and applicable employment requirements.
* Support effective manpower planning, internal career progression and talent development initiatives.

### **3. Payroll, Compensation & Benefits**

* Coordinate monthly attendance, payroll inputs, employee master updates, leave data, incentives and other salary-related information with the respective stakeholders and payroll team.
* Review payroll inputs for completeness and accuracy and facilitate timely resolution of discrepancies.
* Coordinate employee benefits, salary revisions, reimbursements and other compensation-related processes as applicable.
* Monitor employee costs and manpower expenses against approved budgets.
* Support preparation and validation of payroll reports, employee cost analysis and related management information.

### **4. Statutory Compliance and Employee Documentation**

* Ensure timely coordination and monitoring of applicable statutory compliances, including EPF, ESIC, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, minimum wages, bonus, gratuity and other applicable employment requirements.
* Coordinate with payroll teams, external consultants, vendors and relevant stakeholders for statutory calculations, payments, returns, registers and documentation.
* Monitor applicable central and state employment laws, statutory deadlines, regulatory changes and establishment-specific requirements.
* Maintain compliance records, licences, registers, notices and other prescribed documentation as applicable.
* Conduct periodic HR compliance reviews and support internal and external audits.
* Track compliance gaps, facilitate corrective actions and escalate material risks to the Portfolio HR Director and relevant management.

### **5. Employee Engagement, Relations & Retention**

* Promote the IHG Winning Ways culture and create a positive, inclusive and engaging work environment.
* Plan and coordinate employee engagement activities, recognition programmes, celebrations and team-building initiatives.
* Support employee satisfaction surveys and develop action plans based on feedback.
* Address employee queries, grievances and workplace concerns promptly, fairly and confidentially.
* Conduct exit interviews, analyse attrition and absenteeism trends, and recommend appropriate retention initiatives.
* Build effective relationships with employees, Department Heads and hotel leadership teams.

### **6. Learning, Development & Performance Management**

* Coordinate new-joiner induction, HR orientation and employee awareness programmes.
* Support training needs identification and the implementation of learning and development initiatives.
* Guide managers on HR policies, performance management, employee development and people-related matters.
* Monitor performance appraisal cycles, probation reviews and confirmation processes.
* Support succession planning, talent development and internal career opportunities.
* Encourage continuous learning and reinforce the service culture expected at Holiday Inn Express.

### **7. Employee Welfare, POSH & Workplace Standards**

* Support implementation of employee welfare initiatives and workplace policies.
* Coordinate awareness programmes relating to the Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) and other applicable workplace requirements.
* Support the appropriate handling and escalation of workplace complaints in accordance with company policy and applicable law.
* Promote respectful workplace behaviour, equal opportunity and a culture of inclusion.
* Ensure employee-related departmental SOPs and HR standards are communicated and followed.

### **8. Business Partnership & Guest Experience**

* Partner with General Managers and Department Heads to align HR initiatives with hotel business objectives and guest service standards.
* Support service standards audits and communicate relevant people-related observations and improvement opportunities.
* Develop initiatives to motivate employees and improve service delivery, productivity and guest satisfaction.
* Monitor staffing levels, employee productivity and labour costs to support operational efficiency.
* Contribute to regional and portfolio-level HR initiatives, projects and special assignments as directed by the Portfolio HR Director.

### **9. HR Reporting, Analytics & Continuous Improvement**

* Prepare periodic HR dashboards and reports covering manpower, vacancies, attrition, absenteeism, employee movements, payroll costs and other key HR metrics.
* Analyse workforce trends and provide actionable insights to hotel leadership.
* Maintain accurate and timely HR data across all assigned properties.
* Identify opportunities to simplify HR processes, improve employee experience and strengthen operational controls.
* Ensure timely completion of assigned deliverables, management reports and compliance trackers.

**Qualifications & Experience**
-------------------------------

* Graduate degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Hotel Management or a related discipline.
* Approximately 3–4 years of relevant Human Resources experience, preferably in the hospitality industry or a multi-property environment.
* Working knowledge of recruitment, payroll coordination, employee relations, HR operations and statutory compliance.
* Understanding of applicable Indian labour laws and employment regulations.
* Experience working with HRMS, recruitment systems, Microsoft Excel and HR reporting tools.
* Strong communication, coordination, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and travel frequently across assigned hotel locations.

**Key Skills & Competencies**
-----------------------------

* Multi-property HR operations and execution.
* Talent acquisition and manpower planning.
* Payroll coordination and statutory compliance.
* Employee engagement and grievance handling.
* HR analytics, reporting and Excel proficiency.
* Communication, collaboration and influencing skills.
* Confidentiality, integrity and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating with hotel leadership teams.
* A service-oriented mindset and commitment to continuous improvement.

**How Will You Deliver Success?**
---------------------------------

At IHG, our commitment to True Hospitality is reflected in how we work and how we treat people.

* **True Attitude:** Demonstrate care, respect and a genuine desire to make a positive difference.
* **True Confidence:** Apply HR knowledge and professional judgement to support employees and business leaders.
* **True Listening:** Understand employee and stakeholder concerns and respond with empathy and professionalism.
* **True Responsiveness:** Resolve queries efficiently, meet deadlines and take ownership of commitments.

Success in this role will be reflected in consistent HR execution across assigned properties, timely recruitment and payroll coordination, strong employee engagement, reliable compliance management and effective partnership with hotel leadership.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* The opportunity to work with the globally recognised IHG Hotels & Resorts brand.
* Exposure to multi-property HR operations and business partnering.
* Opportunities for professional learning, development and career growth.
* A collaborative and inclusive working environment.
* Access to applicable IHG employee benefits, training and development programmes, subject to company policy.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

IHG Hotels & Resorts is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace where colleagues are respected, valued and encouraged to contribute their best.

**Join us and be part of a team that brings True Hospitality to life every day.**

title: Senior Engineer, IAM with designing and architecturing AI/ML systems

**Job Description**

**Senior Engineer, IAM, Chennai**

NielsenIQ is looking for an individual who can join our Identity and Access Management (IAM) Program. We are evolving our enterprise Identity and Access ecosystem by embedding AI and machine learning to improve security posture, automation, and user experience at scale. To support this effort, we are seeking a Senior AI/ML Engineer with strong experience in architecting, designing, building, and operationalizing machine learning systems in complex, distributed, and cloud-based environments.  
In this role, you will lead the development of AI-driven identity, access, and security intelligence solutions, working closely with Cybersecurity, Engineering, and AI teams. You will be responsible for designing ML architectures, building production-grade pipelines, deploying models at scale, and driving measurable outcomes through applied AI for supporting out Identity Security initiative. This is a hands-on Senior Engineering role with significant technical ownership and architectural influence.  
The ideal candidate is a self-driven problem solver who enjoys working at the intersection of AI/ML, Cybersecurity, Cloud platforms, and automation, and who wants to be part of growing NIQ global IAM program.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design and evolution of the IAM technology stack, ensuring adherence to top-tier security practices across architecture, implementation, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancements.
* Design, build, and evolve AI/ML solutions that analyze identity, access, and behavioral data to detect anomalies, reduce risk, and automate identity security services to enforce IAM, PAM and Secrets Management controls.
* Lead the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, model development, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Architect and implement scalable ML pipelines using Python, cloud-native services, APIs, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Partner with Cybersecurity and other Engineering teams to integrate ML models into enterprise IAM, PAM, and Secrets Management workflows and drive roadmap decisions and enterprise-scale adoption and enforcement.
* Apply advanced security engineering principles to analyze, design, develop, deploy, and support complex software solutions and infrastructure upgrades, setting standards for best practices.
* Develop and deploy real-time and batch inference services for identity and access pattern recognition.
* Apply advanced ML techniques (anomaly detection, clustering, classification, graph-based models, etc.,) to human and non-human identity use cases.
* Design model monitoring, drift detection, and performance metrics aligned to security KPIs and business outcomes.
* Leverage cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) for distributed training, model serving, and data processing.
* Drive the adoption of MLOps best practices, including CI/CD for models, versioning, reproducibility, and observability.
* Collaborate with product owners and stakeholders to translate security problems into well-defined ML use cases.
* Communicate technical concepts, trade-offs, and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Mentor junior engineers and help establish Cybersecurity engineering standards for applied AI across the organization.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer science, Computer Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field (Master’s preferred).
* 7+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years focused on architecting and designing AI/ML systems at global scale (Cybersecurity preferred).
* Strong proficiency in Python and experience building ML systems using modern frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn).
* Hands-on experience with data pipelines, APIs, and distributed systems.
* Broad knowledge of IAM capabilities, identity stores, authentication/authorization, strong authentication, privileged access methodologies, and Zero Trust principles
* Experience deploying and operating ML models in cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Practical knowledge of MLOps practices, including model versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, and automation.
* Experience working with identity, security, or behavioral data (IAM, access logs, telemetry, or similar domains).
* Familiarity with REST APIs, Git-based workflows, containerization, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Understanding of non-human identities, service accounts, secrets, and automation-driven access patterns is a strong plus.
* Ability to design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, explainability, and operational reliability.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills in ambiguous, real-world environments.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
* Proven ability to work independently while driving complex initiatives across large organizations.
* Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a fast-paced environment, balancing risk reduction with business objectives.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, capable of translating complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for diverse stakeholders.
* Strong ability to work autonomously while influencing cross-functional teams and have proven track record of driving adoption of security best practices across large organizations.

Are you a delivery leader who is passionate about complex Technology Delivery and helping CIOs, CTOs and business executives drive technology change that delivers real commercial outcomes? If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation practice and lead and deliver complex, high-value transformation portfolios for global clients. Working at C-suite level, you will take Revenue (P&L) accountability for accounts and portfolios, managing budgets from $5M to $30M, scaling delivery organisations, and ensuring transformation investments generate lasting revenue and business value. You will govern multi-programme portfolios, drive commercial growth, and serve as a trusted strategic advisor on delivery and transformation at the highest levels of client organisations.

**The Practice – A Brief Sketch**

Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of Digital Core Reinvention Partner and focuses on our clients’ most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through technology transformation initiatives, aimed at modernising delivery, improving operational performance and generating measurable enterprise value.

We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep-rooted in Technology Strategy, large-scale programme delivery and business transformation, where you will work with key global clients to drive the next evolution of enterprise technology change. As part of this high-performing team, you will lead organisations through complex transformation journeys — from translating transformation vision into measurable business outcomes through disciplined execution across global teams, functions, and delivery partners. This is a delivery leadership role with direct accountability for transformation outcomes These are some of the initiatives you will support:

**Enterprise Transformation Portfolio Leadership:** Own and lead a portfolio of strategic transformation initiatives aligned to enterprise priorities and growth objectives**,** ensure transformation programs deliver measurable business outcomes, operational improvements, customer impact, and financial value. **End-to-End Delivery Accountability:** Assume full accountability for transformation execution from mobilization through implementation, stabilization, and value realization — including complex systems implementation, Mainframe Modernisation, and cloud-native migration programmes**,** lead multiple concurrent, large-scale transformation programs with significant organizational, operational, and technology complexity**.** **Revenue Management and Financial Governance:** Carry P&L accountability for accounts and portfolios with budgets of $5M–$30M; manage actuals, forecasts, margin protection, revenue recognition and commercial change control; identify and drive revenue growth opportunities and account expansions **AI & Intelligent Transformation Leadership:** Lead and manage scaled deployment of Agentic AI, Generative AI, automation, and digital workforce solutions as part of enterprise transformation programs, establish governance, risk management, and adoption frameworks for responsible deployment of AI-enabled transformation initiatives. **Integration and Dependency Management:** Govern complex multi-programme integration across internal teams, client stakeholders and third-party vendors; manage interdependencies, interface points, data migration streams and system integration programmes to ensure coherent, risk-managed portfolio delivery; lead cloud-native and API-led architecture transitions within delivery programmes **Value Realisation and Benefits Framework:** Track measurable transformation outcomes across the portfolio — cost reduction, revenue growth, operational efficiency, risk reduction and speed-to-market; report on value delivered at board level **Global Delivery Leadership:** Act as a trusted partner to C-suite executives and senior business leaders, lead executive governance forums and transformation steering committees, communicate complex delivery and business challenges clearly, providing actionable recommendations and mitigation strategies. **Executive Stakeholder Leadership:** Shape CxO narratives, transformation roadmaps and investment choices at portfolio level; advise on vendor strategy and scale-up plans; lead deal-shaping and account growth, representing Accenture externally and contributing to practice development and market offerings

**Role Summary**
----------------

As Delivery Lead Associate Director, you are accountable for the overall delivery performance of an account or portfolio of transformation programmes with budgets of $5M–$30M. You will lead high-impact delivery for programs on a scale, carry P&L accountability, and align outcomes to strategic client objectives. You will engage at C-suite level, govern Senior Manager delivery leads, drive revenue management and commercial growth, embed continuous improvement, and make decisions that carry major, lasting impact across the organisation.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Own delivery accountability across an account or portfolio of programmes;**
* **Define and enforce portfolio-level delivery standards, governance frameworks, and quality controls; lead the introduction and embedment of Agile delivery models, CICD practices and modern ways of working within client organisations.**
* **Lead executive-level governance forums and Steering Committees; act as executive delivery sponsor with the client.**
* **Manage relationships at C-suite and board level; act as a trusted strategic advisor on delivery and transformation.**
* **Drive Agentic AI-powered transformation; articulate and demonstrate prior experience using Agentic AI in transformation contexts to clients and internal stakeholders, building confidence and adoption.**
* **Accountability for the account P&L; manage budgets of $5M–$30M, protect margin, drive revenue recognition and pursue revenue growth opportunities.**
* **Shape and negotiate commercial terms; manage material changes to contract scope and commercial structure.**
* **Manage and facilitate the governance of large programs comprising 50-150+ FTEs including mentoring and coaching people in the programs.**
* **Manage risk, escalation decisions, and demand/supply balance across the portfolio.**
* **Lead identification and scaling of continuous improvement and delivery innovation initiatives across the portfolio.**
* **Lead deal-shaping and proposal strategy for significant account expansions and new pursuits.**
* **Represent Accenture externally; contribute to practice development, capability strategy, and market offerings.**

  

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

title: B2B Sales Advisor
description:
This is a high-ownership Inside Sales role for a professional who can do more than follow a script. You will define who we sell to, build the outreach engine, run consultative conversations, and drive revenue across individual and corporate accounts. The product category may evolve — what stays constant is your responsibility to own the full sales journey, from identifying the right buyer to closing the deal.

This is not a telecalling or lead-passing role. We are looking for someone who can think like a market strategist, act like a trusted advisor, and close like a seasoned sales professional.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**ICP Definition & Market Mapping**

* Define and refine Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs) — by segment, industry, company size, job role, and buying motivation
* Map total addressable market, identify high-potential segments, and prioritise outreach accordingly
* Stay current on market trends, competitive dynamics, and buyer behaviour to sharpen targeting over time

**Prospecting & Lead Generation**

* Build and execute multi-channel outbound prospecting across LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp, and cold calling
* Qualify inbound leads from marketing campaigns, webinars, referrals, and partner channels against defined criteria
* Maintain a consistently healthy, well-segmented pipeline to support monthly and quarterly revenue targets

**Consultative Selling & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Conduct discovery conversations to understand business challenges, decision-making processes, and buying triggers
* Position solutions in the context of the buyer's goals — not features-first, but outcomes-first
* Engage confidently with business owners, functional leaders, HR/L&D teams, and individual decision-makers

**Pipeline Management & Follow-Through**

* Manage multiple opportunities simultaneously across different stages of the funnel
* Follow up persistently and intelligently across channels to advance conversations and prevent drop-off
* Handle pricing, ROI, urgency, credibility, and competitive objections independently and with confidence

**Corporate & Group Account Development**

* Identify and develop multi-seat or team-level opportunities within mid-market and enterprise accounts
* Manage commercial coordination including proposals, invoicing, purchase orders, and multi-stakeholder alignment
* Build account relationships that create repeat business, referrals, and expanded engagement over time

**Reporting & Revenue Ownership**

* Maintain accurate CRM records, pipeline data, and activity logs at all times
* Provide regular forecasts and sales updates aligned to batch launches, product cycles, or campaign calendars
* Take full accountability for monthly enrolment, conversion, and revenue targets

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**Must Have**

* 1–5 years in Inside Sales, Business Development, Corporate Sales, or Solution Selling
* Demonstrated experience selling B2B services — training, SaaS, consulting, HRTech, professional services, or similar
* Strong consultative selling and objection-handling capability
* Ability to manage a multi-stage pipeline with discipline and rigour
* Excellent written and verbal communication — effective across email, LinkedIn, calls, and in-person meetings
* Comfort engaging with diverse buyer types: business owners, functional heads, HR professionals, and individual buyers

**Preferred**

* Experience selling to mid-market or SME segments
* Familiarity with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, HubSpot, Zoho CRM, or equivalent tools
* Understanding of corporate buying processes — proposals, POs, approvals, multi-stakeholder dynamics

**WHY JOIN BOOKMYSALES**

* Own the full sales cycle — this is a role with real accountability and real recognition
* Work directly with founders and senior business leaders with a short feedback loop
* Strong performance incentives with uncapped earning potential
* Fast-track growth path into Business Development Manager or Enterprise Sales roles
* Exposure to a variety of solution categories, markets, and client types as we scale

title: Senior CRM Manager – Real Estate
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: **Senior CRM – Real Estate (Pre-Sales & Post-Sales)**

**Company:** Profound Group  
**Department:** Customer Relationship Management (CRM)  
**Designation:** Senior CRM / Senior Customer Relationship Manager  
**Experience:** 8+ Years  
**Industry:** Real Estate – Residential Apartments, Luxury Villas & Commercial Properties  
**Work Location:** Kondapur, Hyderabad, Telangana  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**1. Job Purpose**: We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented **Senior CRM professional** to lead and manage the complete customer lifecycle, covering both pre-sales coordination and post-sales operations across residential apartments, premium villas, and commercial real estate projects.

The ideal candidate must possess strong expertise in customer relationship management, sales coordination, Agreement of Sale (AoS) preparation and execution, documentation, payment follow-ups, registration coordination, possession management, and customer grievance resolution.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring a seamless customer journey from the initial enquiry and booking stage through agreement execution, construction updates, registration, property handover, and post-possession support, while maintaining regulatory compliance, documentation accuracy, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency.

**2. Key Roles & ResponsibilitiesA. Pre-Sales CRM & Customer Coordination**

* Manage customer interactions from initial enquiry, site visit, property selection, and booking through to sales closure.
* Coordinate with the Sales and Marketing teams to ensure timely follow-ups, booking confirmations, and customer communication.
* Explain project details, unit specifications, floor plans, amenities, payment schedules, pricing structures, and applicable terms to prospective customers within approved company guidelines.
* Coordinate site visits, project presentations, customer meetings, and booking formalities.
* Verify customer details and ensure accurate collection of KYC documents, booking forms, and other preliminary documentation.
* Maintain customer databases, enquiry records, booking status, and follow-up schedules in the CRM system.
* Coordinate with the Sales team on inventory availability, unit blocking, booking status, and customer-specific requirements.
* Ensure a smooth transition of customer information from the pre-sales team to the post-sales CRM team.
* Monitor pending customer actions and proactively resolve coordination gaps that may affect booking conversion.

**B. Post-Sales CRM & Customer Lifecycle Management**

* Independently manage the complete post-sales process from booking confirmation until registration, possession, and post-handover support.
* Act as the primary point of contact for customers after booking and provide timely, accurate updates on their property transactions.
* Coordinate with Sales, Accounts, Legal, Projects, Construction, and Site Operations teams to resolve customer-related matters.
* Maintain customer-wise transaction records, communication logs, payment status, documentation status, and pending activities.
* Ensure all post-sales activities are completed within agreed timelines and in accordance with company policies and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Establish a structured customer communication process for construction progress, payment milestones, registration readiness, and possession schedules.
* Track customer satisfaction, identify recurring issues, and implement corrective measures to improve the overall customer experience.
* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), checklists, and service-level timelines for all CRM activities.

**C. Agreement of Sale & Legal Documentation**

* Prepare, review, coordinate, and track **Agreements of Sale (AoS)**, booking forms, allotment letters, payment schedules, and other customer-related transaction documents in coordination with the Legal team.
* Ensure agreements are prepared using approved templates and accurately reflect customer details, unit specifications, sale consideration, payment terms, and other approved commercial terms.
* Coordinate agreement drafts, customer clarifications, legal review, execution, stamping, and registration-related documentation, as applicable.
* Ensure timely execution of agreements within the defined company timelines.
* Verify and maintain customer KYC documents, PAN, identity and address proofs, company documents for corporate buyers, and other required records.
* Track pending agreements, unsigned documents, incomplete customer files, amendments, cancellations, and other documentation exceptions.
* Coordinate with the Legal team for agreement amendments, addendums, transfer requests, cancellations, refunds, and other contractual matters.
* Maintain secure physical and digital customer files with proper indexing, version control, and audit trails.
* Coordinate with authorized legal professionals and registration teams for sale deed execution and property registration.
* Ensure documentation complies with applicable RERA requirements, Telangana registration procedures, and other relevant legal and statutory requirements.

**D. Payment Follow-Ups & Collections Coordination**

* Coordinate with the Accounts and Finance teams to track customer payments against agreed payment schedules and construction-linked milestones.
* Monitor booking advances, instalments, milestone payments, registration charges, maintenance deposits, and other applicable dues.
* Issue or coordinate payment reminders, demand letters, receipts, and statements of account in accordance with company procedures.
* Maintain customer-wise outstanding reports, ageing reports, overdue payment trackers, and collection follow-up records.
* Proactively follow up with customers regarding overdue payments and escalate delayed or disputed payments to the appropriate management team.
* Reconcile customer ledgers with the Accounts team and resolve discrepancies in payment records.
* Coordinate with Finance on loan disbursements, bank documentation, and home-loan-related customer requirements.
* Support the preparation of periodic reports covering collections, outstanding dues, payment commitments, and collection risks.

**E. Registration, Possession & Handover Management**

* Prepare and maintain registration and possession readiness trackers for all booked units.
* Coordinate with customers, Legal, Finance, site teams, and registration professionals to complete sale deed registration and possession formalities.
* Ensure applicable customer dues and documentation requirements are verified before possession, in accordance with approved company policies and contractual terms.
* Coordinate pre-handover inspections, snag identification, rectification tracking, and customer walkthroughs.
* Ensure handover documents, possession letters, key handover records, meter details, warranty information, and relevant property documents are properly prepared.
* Coordinate with the Projects and Engineering teams to resolve outstanding snags and communicate realistic closure timelines to customers.
* Maintain a unit-wise handover checklist and ensure proper customer acknowledgements and records.
* Coordinate the transfer of relevant information to facility management, maintenance, or property management teams wherever applicable.
* Monitor handover timelines and escalate delays, unresolved defects, or customer concerns to management.

**F. Customer Grievance Management & Relationship Building**

* Handle customer complaints, escalations, service requests, and transaction-related disputes professionally and promptly.
* Establish a structured complaint management process with defined ownership, priority levels, turnaround times, and escalation procedures.
* Coordinate with internal departments to investigate issues, communicate resolutions, and prevent recurrence.
* Manage sensitive customer interactions involving payment disputes, documentation delays, construction updates, possession timelines, and property defects.
* Maintain complaint registers, escalation reports, closure records, and customer feedback.
* Build long-term customer relationships through transparent communication, accountability, and timely service.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer satisfaction, referral generation, and the overall customer experience.

**G. CRM Systems, MIS & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate customer data in the CRM software and ensure regular updates of booking, agreement, payment, registration, and possession statuses.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports for management review.
* Track key operational metrics, including:
* Enquiries and booking status coordination.
* Booking-to-agreement turnaround time.
* Agreements pending execution.
* Customer documentation completion.
* Collections and overdue payments.
* Registration and possession readiness.
* Customer complaints and resolution timelines.
* Handover status and outstanding snags.
* Develop dashboards, trackers, and management reports using Excel and CRM tools.
* Maintain data accuracy, confidentiality, document traceability, and timely reporting.
* Recommend process improvements, automation opportunities, and CRM system enhancements.

**H. Team Management & Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Guide and supervise CRM executives and coordinators, where applicable.
* Allocate responsibilities, review pending tasks, and monitor team performance against defined KPIs.
* Establish standardized workflows, checklists, templates, and reporting formats.
* Coordinate regularly with Sales, Marketing, Legal, Finance, Projects, Engineering, and Facility Management teams.
* Conduct periodic reviews of pending customer cases, documentation gaps, payment issues, and handover commitments.
* Ensure clear accountability and timely closure of all customer-related activities.
* Support management in improving CRM processes, service standards, and departmental efficiency.

**3. Required Experience & Qualifications**

* **Experience:** Minimum 8+ years of relevant experience in real estate CRM, with substantial hands-on exposure to both pre-sales coordination and post-sales operations.
* **Industry Background:** Residential apartments, gated communities, luxury villas, plotted developments, and/or commercial real estate.
* Graduate in Business Administration, Commerce, Management, or a related discipline. An MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage.
* Strong practical experience in Agreements of Sale, customer documentation, payment coordination, registration, and property handover.
* Experience working with real estate developers or reputed property development companies is preferred.
* Prior experience handling premium residential customers, high-value transactions, and customer escalations is desirable.
* Experience managing a CRM team or coordinating across multiple departments will be an added advantage.

**4. Essential Skills & Competencies**

* Strong understanding of the complete real estate sales and post-sales lifecycle.
* Excellent knowledge of Agreement of Sale workflows, booking documentation, registration coordination, and customer file management.
* Strong customer relationship management, negotiation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with Legal, Finance, Sales, Projects, and Engineering teams.
* Strong command of MS Excel, Word, email communication, MIS reporting, and CRM software.
* Ability to prepare trackers, dashboards, SOPs, and structured management reports.
* Strong follow-up discipline, attention to detail, ownership, and execution capability.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, customer portfolios, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Professional handling of confidential customer information and sensitive commercial matters.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; Telugu and Hindi proficiency will be an advantage.

**5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The performance of the Senior CRM professional will be evaluated on the following parameters:

* **Agreement Execution TAT:** Timely preparation, review coordination, and execution of customer agreements.
* **Documentation Accuracy:** Completeness and accuracy of customer files, KYC records, and transaction documents.
* **Payment Follow-Up Efficiency:** Timely follow-up on overdue amounts and accurate reporting of outstanding customer dues.
* **Registration Turnaround:** Timely completion of registration-related coordination, subject to customer, legal, and statutory dependencies.
* **Possession & Handover Efficiency:** Completion of handover formalities within approved project schedules.
* **Customer Satisfaction:** Customer feedback, complaint recurrence, and service quality.
* **Grievance Resolution TAT:** Timely resolution or escalation of customer complaints within defined service levels.
* **CRM Data Accuracy:** Up-to-date customer records, transaction statuses, and reporting accuracy.
* **MIS & Reporting Discipline:** Timely submission of accurate daily, weekly, and monthly reports.
* **Cross-Functional Coordination:** Effective follow-up and closure of customer-related tasks across departments.
* **Team Productivity:** Achievement of assigned targets and adherence to defined CRM processes, wherever team management applies.

**6. Preferred Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is a mature, customer-focused, process-oriented professional who can independently manage complex customer transactions and coordinate with multiple internal departments without constant supervision.

The candidate must be equally strong in **customer-facing communication and backend documentation**, particularly Agreements of Sale, payment coordination, registration, and possession management. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, anticipates potential delays, maintains accurate records, and ensures that every customer receives a professional and transparent experience.

Candidates who have worked with established real estate developers and have managed the complete customer lifecycle across apartments, villas, and commercial projects will be preferred.

**7. Application Details**

Interested candidates with relevant real estate CRM experience may share their updated CV, highlighting their experience in pre-sales, post-sales, agreement execution, collections coordination, registration, possession, and customer relationship management.

**Shortlisting Priority:** Candidates with strong hands-on expertise in both pre-sales and post-sales operations, particularly Agreement of Sale documentation and end-to-end customer lifecycle management, will be given preference.

description:

As the leading bank in Asia, DBS Consumer Banking Group is in a unique position to help our customers realise their dreams and ambitions. Our financial solutions are not only the best in the business – they were made just

**Job Purpose**

Lead acquisition, activation, value build-up and retention of high-quality current-account relationships across an assigned cluster. The role owns the cluster’s current-account growth agenda across business segments—including traders, wholesalers, manufacturers, service professionals, institutions and emerging enterprises—while building fee income and cross-sell penetration.

The Cluster Sales Head will lead a team of current-account sales team and relationship managers, work closely with branches and product partners, and ensure the cluster delivers profitable, compliant, transaction-active current-account growth.

**Responsibilities**

**. Cluster Business Ownership**

* Deliver new-to-bank current-account acquisition, account activation, average quarterly balance growth, transaction throughput and fee-income targets for the cluster.
* Build and execute a catchment-led acquisition strategy for high-potential business segments such as wholesalers, distributors, manufacturers, traders, schools, hospitals, clinics, professional firms and service establishments.
* Translate cluster targets into branch-, team- and individual-level productivity plans.
* Own the current-account business plan, sales funnel, conversion pipeline and weekly performance rhythm.
* Improve portfolio quality by prioritising transaction-active, balance-building and cross-sell-ready relationships over dormant or low-value acquisition.

* **Sales Leadership and Channel Execution**

* Lead, coach and motivate a field-sales organisation to consistently deliver acquisition and value-build targets.
* Establish a disciplined sales cadence covering joint calls, market visits, lead reviews, branch huddles, pipeline reviews and conversion tracking.
* Ensure each relationship manager follows a profile-based sales approach rather than a generic product pitch.
* Develop market intelligence on competitor propositions, local business clusters, referral sources and emerging commercial hubs.
* Build productive referral ecosystems with Chartered Accountants, trade associations, market intermediaries, merchant networks, developers, institutional administrators and existing clients.

* **Current-Account Activation and Value Build-Up**

* Ensure newly acquired accounts become transaction-active within defined activation timelines.
* Drive operating balances, inward credits, collections, payment activity and digital banking adoption.
* Track early-warning indicators including low funding, non-activation, declining balances, low transaction velocity and potential attrition.
* Build strategies to migrate primary transaction flows—collections, vendor payments, payroll, taxes and operating cash—to the bank.
* Improve account quality by monitoring average balance, debit transactions, credit transactions and account profitability.

* **Solution-Led Cross-Sell**

* Use the current account as the primary operating hub for business clients and identify the appropriate product solution based on the customer’s business model.
* Drive adoption of corporate internet banking and mobile approvals; cash management and bulk payment solutions; POS, Android POS, QR and Soundbox; sweep-in / sweep-out or FFD structures; debit cards; collections and transaction banking solutions; and promoter, family, wealth and premium savings propositions.
* Partner with product teams to convert business pain points into integrated propositions—for example, POS for collections, Internet Banking for payment controls, FFD for temporary balances and Aspire/premium banking for promoter wallet deepening.

* **Customer Relationship and Service Governance**

* Build senior-level relationships with anchor clients and participate in strategic joint calls for high-value prospects.
* Ensure timely resolution of onboarding, account-opening, transaction, service and digital-banking issues.
* Work with branches and operations teams to reduce turnaround time, improve onboarding quality and strengthen client experience.
* Review top customers and at-risk accounts regularly to protect balances, transactions and wallet share.
* Drive customer retention through proactive engagement, problem solving and relevant product deepening.

* **Risk, Compliance and Portfolio Quality**

* Ensure all sourcing, onboarding and account activation follows internal policies and applicable KYC, AML, fraud-risk and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain high standards of customer due diligence, documentation quality, source-of-funds understanding and business-profile validation.
* Monitor exceptions, unusual transaction behaviour, documentation gaps and operational risks; escalate promptly where needed.
* Build a culture of right-first-time acquisition, with no compromise on compliance for target achievement.

* **People Leadership**

* Recruit, develop, retain and performance-manage a high-quality current-account sales team.
* Set clear scorecards covering acquisition, activation, AQB/AMB, transaction activity, fee income, cross-sell, productivity, service quality and compliance.
* Conduct structured coaching through joint market visits, call observations, weekly reviews and capability-building sessions.
* Identify skill gaps and develop targeted interventions around sales planning, segment understanding, solution selling, digital banking and compliance.
* Maintain a strong talent pipeline and manage attrition proactively.

**Experience**

* 8–15 years of relevant experience in banking, preferably in current accounts, CASA, business banking, SME banking, transaction banking, branch banking or merchant acquiring.
* At least 3–5 years in a people-leadership role managing sales managers, relationship managers or acquisition teams.
* Demonstrated track record of building a current-account portfolio, increasing operating balances and delivering cross-sell revenue.
* Experience in managing business clusters, market catchments, branch ecosystems or multi-location sales teams is preferred.

**Education**

* Graduate degree required.
* MBA / PGDM in Finance, Sales, Marketing or Banking preferred.
* Relevant certifications in banking, KYC/AML, payments or financial products are an advantage.

**Skills and Competencies**

* Strong understanding of current-account economics, CASA, transaction banking, payments, merchant acquiring and business-client needs.

* Excellent stakeholder-management skills across branches, products, operations, risk and service.

title: Analyst / Senior Analyst - Finance
description:
**Company Description**

**Enviri Corporation** is a market-leading global provider of environmental solutions for industrial, retail, and medical waste streams, as well as innovative equipment and technology for the rail sector. We have an unrivaled breadth of experience across the globe and an impressive reputation that stretches back more than a century. Based in Camp Hill, PA, with more than 8500 employees and the company operates in more than 30 countries.

**About Enviri GSC**

Enviri GSC handles a wide range of services, including finance and accounting shared services, global HR shared services, providing IT services and helpdesk support, and market research support to Harsco globally. We have been operating since 2008 & serving 30+ Countries

 **Job Description**

**Purpose:** The Finance Business Partner serves as the primary finance representative and Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for assigned legal entities, regions, and business stakeholders. This role is accountable for financial integrity, governance, compliance, business support, statutory reporting, financial analysis, process excellence, and continuous improvement across the end-to-end finance organization.

The position acts as the bridge between Business Operations, Shared Services, Corporate Finance, Tax, Treasury, FP&A, Internal Audit, and External Auditors while ensuring accurate financial reporting, robust controls, and effective decision support.

**Position Summary and Primary Responsibilities**

1. Business Partnership & Stakeholder Management

* Function as the primary Finance SPOC for assigned business units, legal entities, and operational leaders.
* Serve as the trusted advisor to business management on financial and operational matters.
* Translate business requirements into finance solutions and actionable insights.
* Provide decision support through financial analysis and business recommendations.
* Facilitate alignment between Business, GSC, Corporate Finance, Tax, Treasury, and FP&A teams.
* Lead periodic financial review meetings with stakeholders.

2. Legal Entity Controllership & Financial Governance

* Own overall financial governance and performance of assigned legal entities.
* Ensure accuracy and completeness of financial statements and management reports.
* Review monthly trial balances, financial results, and key accounting judgments.
* Coordinate period-end close activities across multiple finance functions.
* Monitor compliance with company accounting policies, US GAAP, IFRS, and local statutory requirements.
* Drive financial discipline and accountability across the legal entities.

3. Financial Reporting Quality

* Ensure timely and accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting.
* Review financial statements, disclosures, and support schedules.
* Validate reporting packages submitted to Corporate Finance.
* Ensure consistency, transparency, and quality of management reporting.
* Identify reporting risks and implement remediation plans.
* Support HFM, FCCS, NetSuite, and other consolidation and reporting platforms.

4. Balance Sheet Governance & Reconciliation Review

* Review and approve all balance sheet reconciliations on a recurring basis.
* Challenge aged balances, unusual transactions, and unreconciled items.
* Ensure compliance with global reconciliation policies.
* Drive timely resolution of balance sheet exceptions.
* Review intercompany balances and eliminations.
* Monitor account certification and sign-off processes.

5. Financial Planning & Analysis Support

* Coordinate FP&A data collection and validation activities.
* Support annual budget, forecast, and strategic planning processes.
* Consolidate financial data and business assumptions.
* Analyze variances against budget, forecast, and prior periods.
* Support scenario modelling and sensitivity analysis.
* Provide data-driven recommendations to leadership teams.

6. Financial Analysis & Decision Support

* Perform profitability, margin, and cost analysis.
* Evaluate operating performance and identify business drivers.
* Analyze trends impacting revenue, expenses, working capital, and cash flow.
* Develop management dashboards and KPI reporting.
* Support strategic initiatives, investments, and capital expenditure reviews.
* Prepare executive-level financial presentations and business reviews.

7. Statutory Audit & Regulatory Compliance

* Lead finance coordination for annual statutory audits.
* Serve as the primary contact for external and internal auditors.
* Manage audit schedules, requests, and deliverables.
* Review statutory financial statements and disclosures.
* Coordinate audit adjustments and remediation actions.
* Ensure timely closure of audit findings and recommendations.

8. Tax Support & Compliance

* Partner with Corporate Tax and external advisors on tax compliance matters.
* Support corporate income tax, indirect tax, transfer pricing, and statutory filings.
* Review tax account reconciliations and tax-related balance sheet accounts.
* Assist in tax audits and regulatory inquiries.
* Ensure completeness and accuracy of tax provisions and reporting.
* Monitor tax risks and compliance requirements.

9. Contract Management & Commercial Support

* Partner with Procurement, Operations, and Legal teams on contract reviews.
* Review commercial terms, pricing structures, and financial obligations.
* Assess accounting, compliance, and financial implications of contracts.
* Monitor contract performance and financial commitments.
* Support contract renewals, amendments, and business cases.
* Drive governance and visibility through contract management practices.

10. Global Process Setup & Transformation Support

* Support establishment of new accounting processes, entities, and business operations.
* Lead finance workstreams during acquisitions, integrations, carve-outs, and restructuring initiatives.
* Assist ERP implementations, migrations, and global process deployments.
* Partner with global process owners to standardize finance activities.
* Support automation, digitization, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Drive adoption of best practices across regions.

11. Transition Management

* Lead migration of activities into or out of Shared Services.
* Develop transition plans, governance frameworks, and risk assessments.
* Coordinate knowledge transfer activities and stabilization support.
* Ensure seamless handover of processes and controls.
* Monitor transition milestones and stakeholder commitments.
* Support post-transition performance reviews and process optimization.

12. Controls, Compliance & Risk Management

* Ensure adherence to SOX, internal controls, and corporate compliance requirements.
* Monitor effectiveness of finance controls across assigned entities.
* Identify process risks and implement corrective actions.
* Support internal audit and compliance reviews.
* Promote strong governance and accountability culture.
* Ensure segregation of duties and policy adherence.

13. SOPs, Desk Procedures & Process Documentation

* Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Prepare and update Desk Procedures and Process Narratives.
* Maintain end-to-end process flow documentation.
* Ensure documentation aligns with actual operating practices.
* Support training and onboarding through process documentation.
* Drive standardization across regions and functions.

14. Leadership & Continuous Improvement

* Lead cross-functional finance improvement initiatives.
* Mentor finance team members and support capability building.
* Drive Lean, Six Sigma, automation, and process optimization opportunities.
* Promote data-driven decision-making and accountability.
* Champion finance transformation initiatives across the organization.

  
**Qualifications**

**Education and Experience**

* Professional degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business, or MBA with specialization in Accounting/ Finance.
* Inter CA / CMA/ CWA / ACCA / CIMA.

* Lean Six Sigma certification is advantageous.
* Experience of 2 to 4 years working as a finance manager or finance controller
* Have a clear understanding of all financial modules.
* Ready to work in the afternoon shift - 2.00 PM to 11.00 PM IST

**Interpersonal Skills**

* Excellent communication skills (Written and verbal) and Good interpersonal skills.
* Able to build and maintain sound relationships with individuals at all levels and with onsite clients.
* Results-driven with the ability to work under pressure.
* Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from senior management.
* Adapt to a multicultural environment.

**Technical Skills**

* Financial Reporting & Controllership, Legal Entity Management, Business Partnering
* FP&A and Forecasting
* US GAAP / IFRS, Statutory Accounting & Audit, Internal Controls & SOX
* Tax Compliance, Contract Management, Shared Services Operations
* ERP Systems (NetSuite, Oracle, SAP, HFM, HP, FCCS), Power BI and Advanced Excel

**Key Success Factors and KPI’s**

* Financial close completed within timelines, Balance sheet reconciliation compliance (>98%), zero material audit findings.
* Forecast accuracy achievement.
* Statutory filing compliance, Control effectiveness, and SOX compliance
* Financial reporting, quality, and accuracy
* Stakeholder satisfaction scores, Successful transition, and transformation initiatives
* Process standardization and automation benefits realized.

Junior Executive – After-Sales Support & Supplier Coordination

You will be the person who makes sure an order goes right after the customer says yes: chasing our factories for production and dispatch, and looking after our overseas customers until the goods are delivered and any issue is closed.

Company

India Pack (indiapack.co.in)
