Reports to - Co-founder

Working days - Mon–Sat (Sundays Off)

About India Pack

India Pack is a Pune-based B2B packaging sourcing company, now about 10 years old. We supply FIBCs (jumbo bags), PP woven bags, BOPP bags, flexible pouches and container liners from 10+ audited Indian manufacturers to buyers in the UK, Germany, Scandinavia, the USA and the Middle East.

What you will do

**After-sales support (customers)**

* Be the day-to-day contact for international customers once an order is confirmed: order status, dispatch dates, shipping documents.
* Send shipment updates before the customer has to ask, and confirm delivery at their end.
* Share and file order documents: invoice, packing list, bill of lading, test reports and certificates.
* Register every complaint or quality claim the day it arrives. Collect photos, quantities, batch details and usage conditions from the customer.
* Work with the supplier and our technical team to find the cause, agree the corrective action, and keep the customer updated until the claim is closed.
* Follow up after delivery for feedback and pass repeat-order signals to the sales team.

**Supplier coordination (factories)**

* Follow up with our manufacturing partners by phone and email on production schedules, samples, print proofs and dispatch readiness.
* Track each order from purchase order to shipment and keep the order tracker and ERP/CRM up to date.
* Flag delays or spec deviations early, with a revised date and a proposed fix, not just the problem.
* Coordinate pre-shipment inspections and check test reports against the customer's specification.
* Collect supplier documents on time so that shipping paperwork is never the reason for a delay.

**Reporting**

* Maintain the open-orders and open-claims lists and present a short status every week.

Who we are looking for

**Must have**

* A graduate in any stream (B.Com, BBA, B.Sc, BE or a diploma are all fine).
* Clear, polite written English. Most of your day is email with overseas customers.
* Comfortable speaking Hindi on the phone with factory teams.
* Working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets: filters, sorting, simple formulas.
* A habit of following up without being reminded, and of writing things down.
* Calm with an unhappy customer: you listen, collect the facts, and respond the same day.

**Good to have**

* Exposure to export documentation, Incoterms or freight forwarding.
* A background in packaging, plastics, textiles or any manufacturing environment.
* Experience with an ERP or CRM or a shared helpdesk inbox.
* Gujarati or Marathi for supplier conversations.

What you will get

* Daily, direct work with customers in Europe, the USA and the Middle East from your first month.
* Hands-on training in FIBC and woven packaging products, quality standards and the export process from order to delivery.
* A small team where you work directly with the founders and your work is visible.
* A growth path to Account Manager, owning a set of customers and suppliers end to end.

title: Senior Director, AI and Data Platform Delivery
description:
**Our Company:**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**Role Overview**

The Senior Director of AI and Data Platform Delivery is a senior leadership role accountable for **end‑to‑end execution of Teradata’s foundational AI and data platform offerings**, which underpin the company’s hybrid, multi‑cloud, and on‑premises solutions. This role is critical to ensuring that Teradata’s **platform continues to scale, modernize, and reliably support customer workloads**, while enabling company growth through platform differentiation, adoption, and expansion.

This leader owns the **execution strategy, operating model, and talent development** for a combined organization of **Technical Program Managers (TPMs)** and **Global Program Managers (GPMs)**. Together, these teams drive coordinated execution across the end-to-end **New Product Introduction (NPI) process**, ensuring that new platform elements are fully productized, operationally ready, and commercially viable.

Success in this role is measured by **platform delivery predictability, quality, scalability, and business impact**, rather than ownership of individual programs.

**Core Responsibilities**

**Platform Execution & Growth Enablement**

* Own execution outcomes for significant areas of Teradata’s **core data platform and AI roadmap**, including platform modernization, scalability enhancements, cloud parity, and operational hardening.
* Be accountable for execution work that **enables Teradata’s growth and retention targets**, including platform readiness for new use cases, expansions, and customer adoption.
* Translate product and platform strategy into **integrated execution plans** that balance stability, innovation, customer commitments, and long‑term technical health.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and Commercial leadership to align platform execution with **market needs, competitive positioning, and revenue objectives**.
* Provide execution transparency and decision support to senior leadership for **tradeoffs impacting delivery, quality, and customer trust**.

**End‑to‑End New Product Introduction (NPI) Leadership**

* Lead the global NPI execution model for core and AI platform capabilities from concept through general availability and sustained customer adoption.
* Ensure cross‑functional coordination across:
* + Definition, development, and testing
  + Product setup, configuration, and entitlement
  + Legal, compliance, and contractual readiness
  + Pricing, packaging, and lifecycle management
  + Go‑to‑market readiness (Sales, Marketing, Solution Architects)
  + Cloud Operations, infrastructure, and SRE readiness
  + Customer support, field enablement, and documentation
* Establish scalable, repeatable NPI mechanisms that support **frequent platform releases and long‑lived customer environments**.

**Technical & Platform Leadership**

* Provide technical and execution leadership across **large‑scale, distributed, data‑intensive platforms**, spanning cloud, hybrid, and on‑prem deployments.
* Guide teams through complex platform delivery challenges involving **performance, reliability, scalability, security, upgrade paths, and operational continuity**.
* Ensure cross‑team technical and operational risks are proactively identified, clearly owned, and mitigated.
* Partner with senior engineering and architecture leaders to ensure execution plans align with **long‑term platform sustainability and customer trust**.
* Co-own with engineering **platform economics and cost‑to‑serve** by influencing execution tradeoffs that impact margin, scaling limits, and long‑term pricing power.
* Co-own with engineering and product the **platform lifecycle governance and technical debt liquidation** at the portfolio level.

**People & Organizational Leadership**

* Build, lead, and scale a high‑impact organization of **Technical Program Managers and Global Program Managers**.
* Clearly define and reinforce roles and interfaces between TPMs (engineering‑centric delivery) and GPMs (cross‑functional, post‑code, market and operational readiness).
* Own hiring, performance management, development, and succession planning for the platform execution organization.
* Develop senior TPM and GPM leaders capable of operating effectively at **enterprise scale and high ambiguity**.
* Establish clear leveling, expectations, and promotion readiness standards for both TPM and GPM career paths.

**Influence, Communication & Executive Partnership**

* Act as a **trusted execution advisor** to senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Cloud Operations, Sales Engineering, Legal, and Customer organizations.
* Communicate platform execution health, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs clearly at the **VP and executive level**.
* Drive alignment across a highly matrixed organization supporting long‑lived, mission‑critical customer environments.
* Provide executive clarity during high‑impact incidents, major releases, or customer‑sensitive platform transitions.

**Required Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering leadership, product operations, or related technical roles.
* 5+ years of experience leading senior technical and program management professionals.
* Proven success delivering **large‑scale, enterprise data platform initiatives**.
* Strong understanding of **distributed systems, database platforms, cloud infrastructure, and hybrid architectures**.
* Demonstrated ability to drive execution that supports **business growth, customer retention, and platform adoption**.
* Exceptional executive‑level communication and influence skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience delivering or operating **enterprise data platforms** in cloud and hybrid environments.
* Background supporting **platform modernization, cloud transitions, or large customer migrations**.
* Experience building or scaling global NPI and release governance models.
* Familiarity with operational excellence, SRE practices, and enterprise reliability expectations.

**What Success Looks Like**

A successful Senior Director of AI and Data Platform Delivery:

* Enables Teradata to **deliver and evolve its core platform with predictability and confidence**.
* Holds the organization to **best-in-breed standards** across delivery quality, platform performance, and operational reliability — ensuring Teradata's core data platform earns a reputation for excellence.
* Scales execution capabilities to support platform growth, modernization, and increased customer demand.
* Ensures platform capabilities are fully **productized, operationally ready, and commercially viable**.
* Builds a strong TPM and GPM organization trusted across Product, Engineering, and GTM teams.
* Directly supports Teradata’s **growth and retention goals** by strengthening the foundation of its data platform.

We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

title: Senior Legal Counsel - India
description:
**Location:** Hyderabad, Telangana, India. On site at the offices of Unseen Realities.

**Employment Type:** Full Time

**Reporting To:** Chief Legal Officer, Analog

**About Analog and Unseen Realities**
-------------------------------------

**Analog is pioneering the era of physical intelligence.** Where digital intelligence transformed our online lives, Analog is transforming the lived world, making cities more adaptive, industries more resilient, services more human centered, and experiences more extraordinary.

At the heart of our approach are living world models, continuously updated, enriched by every capture point, every device, every interaction. Within them resides Ana, the Analog Neural Agent. Ana perceives, adapts, and guides, transforming raw data into foresight and orchestration that improves outcomes across sectors, from safeguarding high value assets to enhancing human performance.

**Unseen Realities, based out of Hyderabad, Telangana, is part of the Analog group, and serves as Analog's operating entity in India supporting customers and partners in the region**. It will also serve as Analog's research and development hub in India, building engineering and applied AI capabilities that feed the global Analog platform. Everyone joining Unseen Realities works as part of the wider Analog group, and has the opportunity to shape how physical intelligence takes root in one of the world's fastest-growing technology markets.

**Job Description**
-------------------

We are seeking an experienced and proactive Senior Legal Counsel to lead the full spectrum of Unseen Realities’ legal needs, and serve as the primary legal point of contact for Analog’s business, operations, and opportunities in India. As the first India-based counsel at Unseen Realities, you will work independently and will be the India law and market expert for the Analog legal team. At the same time, you will be a full member of the Analog legal team, working closely with and supported by your colleagues in the Abu Dhabi office.

The successful candidate will take end to end ownership of Indian corporate law and governance, company secretarial processes, commercial contracting, regulatory compliance, and the management of Unseen Realities’ interests in its India joint venture and its participation in wider Analog group arrangements, which together form the core of the role. This is a unique opportunity to shape key business decisions and drive Analog’s growth within a fast evolving technology market in India.

In this highly visible role, you will also lead intellectual property licensing and technology transactions in India, ensuring the protection and proper use of Analog’s intellectual property in customer, supplier and joint venture-facing arrangements, safeguarding Analog’s legal interests while fostering strategic relationships with our partners, as Analog expands its portfolio of physical intelligence-driven products into India.

You will also oversee legal risk management, employment matters, disputes, and legal operations, including the supervision of external counsel and the project management of legal matters across the business.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

As Senior Legal Counsel, you will own a broad range of legal matters, with a critical focus on Indian corporate law and governance, corporate processes, joint venture management, commercial contracting, regulatory compliance, and a working understanding of intellectual property and technology transaction issues.

You will:

**India corporate law, governance and corporate actions**

* Own, with support from external company secretarial providers where appropriate, all corporate and company secretarial processes for Unseen Realities, including convening board and shareholder meetings, preparing agendas, notices, board and shareholder resolutions, circulation resolutions and minutes, and supporting board / committee governance processes.
* Manage key corporate actions, including share issuances and transfers, dividends and other distributions, amendments to the constitutional documents, maintenance of share capital and shareholding records, and the creation and satisfaction of charges.
* Manage director and officer appointments, resignations and removals, including director identification number (DIN), know your customer (KYC) requirements and related filings.
* Oversee the maintenance of statutory registers, statutory filings, and the compliance calendar under the Companies Act, 2013.
* Coordinate exchange control and foreign investment reporting for inbound investment into Unseen Realities and for any joint venture shareholding, including FC-GPR / FC-TRS filings, and downstream investment reporting under the Foreign Exchange Management (Non-debt Instruments) Rules 2019, working with the authorized dealer bank and external counsel where required.

**Commercial contracting**

* Draft, review, and negotiate a broad range of commercial contracts, including master services agreements, technology and software arrangements, intellectual property licenses, supplier and subcontractor terms, procurement and services agreements, non-disclosure agreements, data processing / privacy terms, and customer facing terms.
* Review and negotiate channel, reseller, distribution, system integrator, consortium and joint bidding arrangements, including arrangements entered into in order to respond to requests for proposal, public procurement processes, and tenders in India.
* Provide legal expertise on memorandums of understanding (MOUs) and partnership agreements, and advise business stakeholders on contractual risk, liability, and compliance considerations.
* Develop and maintain Indian law contract templates, playbooks and fallback positions for use across the business, streamlining the contracting process and reducing reliance on external counsel.

**Analog group and joint venture arrangements**

* Manage Unseen Realities’ interests in its India joint venture or partnership arrangements, including the exercise of its rights and the performance of its obligations under any joint venture or shareholders’ agreements and joint venture constitutional documents, reserved matter approvals, delegation of authority implementation, and support for the directors and shareholder representatives appointed by Unseen Realities.
* Negotiate and administer the corporate and commercial arrangements between Unseen Realities and its joint venture partners or joint venture entities, and between Unseen Realities and other Analog group companies, including product sales agreements, intellectual property licenses, branding arrangements, technology arrangements, and services arrangements, in each case on arm’s length terms.
* Coordinate with your colleagues in the Analog legal function on Analog group corporate governance and related party transaction requirements.

**Regulatory, risk management and compliance**

* Provide legal advice on Indian regulatory matters and ensure that all agreements and business activities comply with applicable Indian laws and regulations, including the Companies Act, 2013, exchange control and foreign investment rules, data protection under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023, labour and employment laws, competition law, anti-bribery and anti-corruption legislation, and sector-specific regulations, as applicable.
* Support the design, implementation, and maintenance of compliance programs and internal policies, including adapting the Analog group’s compliance and other policies to address local law deviations where necessary.
* Identify, assess, and proactively mitigate legal and compliance risks to protect Analog’s business in India.
* Monitor legal and regulatory developments in India to assess impact on the business.

**Intellectual Property and licensing**

* Advise on intellectual property ownership and manage intellectual property licensing arrangements in India, ensuring the protection and proper use of the Analog group’s intellectual property, including in customer, partner and joint venture facing contracts.
* Manage, through external agents, Indian trade mark, patent, copyright and design filings and prosecution, and manage brand use, enforcement, and domain name issues.

**Legal operations, cross functional collaboration and management of external counsel**

* Work closely with your colleagues in the Analog legal function and with the India business to ensure that legal considerations are aligned with business strategies and embedded into business operations.
* Instruct and manage Indian external counsel, company secretarial providers and other advisers, ensuring cost effective and comprehensive legal support and control of legal spend.

**Employment and HR legal support**

* Advise the Analog People team on employment matters, including hiring, terminations, disciplinary matters, investigations and employee relations, coordinating with external legal counsels for specialist or sensitive matters.
* Draft and review employment contracts, consultant and contractor agreements, policies, and internal guidelines.

**Litigation and dispute management**

* Manage and oversee, with external counsel, litigation, arbitration, regulatory matters, notices, and pre-litigation correspondence in India.
* Develop dispute-resolution strategies aligned with business objectives and escalate material disputes to the Analog CLO and relevant business stakeholders.

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------

* LL.B. or B.A. LL.B. from a recognized Indian university, or an equivalent legal degree enabling enrolment with a State Bar Council in India.
* Minimum of 10 years of post-qualification experience (PQE), with demonstrable depth in both (i) Indian corporate law and processes, including board and shareholder matters, corporate actions and statutory filings, and (ii) commercial contracts governed by Indian law.
* Strong background in contract negotiation, regulatory compliance, risk management, and external counsel management, including budget and performance oversight.
* Ability to translate complex legal issues into clear, practical business advice in support of business objectives.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Ability to work independently as, initially, the sole legal resource based in India, and to collaborate as part of a geographically distributed team in a fast paced, dynamic environment.
* Qualified to practice law in India, including enrolment with a State Bar Council under the Advocates Act 1961, whether current or suspended for the duration of full time salaried employment.
* Based in Hyderabad, or willing to relocate to Hyderabad, and able to work from the offices of Unseen Realities. Ability to travel within India, and occasionally internationally, as business needs require, would be helpful.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Prior in-house experience, preferably in a technology business.
* Experience advising an India subsidiary or India joint venture of a foreign-headquartered or multinational group.
* Strong experience in Indian intellectual property law, particularly intellectual property licensing, ownership, brand use, and India market technology transactions.
* Strong working knowledge of technology law, data protection, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, and the regulatory framework applicable to technology businesses in India, including procurement and tendering by government and public sector customers.
* Experience of joint venture governance, including exchange control and downstream investment requirements.
* Experience advising on AI-related legal issues and understanding of the ethical, regulatory, and commercial implications of AI.
* Proven ability to manage complex legal projects and advise senior stakeholders and executive leadership teams.
* High level of integrity, judgment, discretion, and professionalism.
* Experience of company secretarial processes, and of working with company secretaries, registrars and the Ministry of Corporate Affairs portal filings.
* Working proficiency in Hindi or Telugu, in addition to English, would be an advantage but is not essential.

**What Working at Analog Offers**
---------------------------------

**Culture:** A collaborative, globally minded team building the future of physical intelligence. We value curiosity, courage, and creativity, and we’re united by a belief that technology should amplify human potential rather than replace it.

**Impact:** The opportunity to work on projects with national and global significance, from adaptive cities and resilient infrastructure to next generation sports, entertainment, healthcare, and energy. Every product you help build contributes to shaping a safer, smarter, more human centered world.

**Growth:** Outstanding opportunities for learning and career development. You’ll collaborate with leaders across AI, robotics, mixed reality, and systems engineering, while working on industry first, frontier scale solutions.

**Rewards:** A competitive compensation package.

**Unseen Realities is an equal opportunity employer**. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment in accordance with applicable law and without discrimination on the basis of any protected characteristic under applicable laws of India.

* Communication: Fluent in English, with outstanding presentation, negotiation, and cross-cultural communication skills.

* Build and grow multiple sales channels with high ownership.
* Work closely with the founders and leadership team.
* Gain exposure to B2B sales, wedding sales, concierge selling, corporate gifting, and premium retail experiences.
* Attractive performance-based incentives and excellent career growth opportunities.

title: Accounts Executive - Finance & Accounts
description:
**Job Objective**

To manage sales accounting, customer ledger reconciliation, debtors monitoring, timely collection follow-ups, and related accounting activities to ensure accurate sales records, effective credit control, and timely realization of outstanding receivables.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Sales Accounting & Billing**

* Prepare and process sales invoices, credit notes, and debit notes accurately and within stipulated timelines.
* Verify sales orders, customer details, pricing, applicable GST, HSN codes, and other relevant documentation.
* Ensure proper accounting of domestic and export sales, including applicable tax and statutory requirements.
* Coordinate with the sales, dispatch, and logistics teams for timely invoicing and documentation.
* Maintain proper records of sales transactions, returns, discounts, and other adjustments.

**2. Debtors Management & Receivables**

* Monitor customer outstanding balances and maintain an updated debtor ageing report.
* Follow up with customers and the sales team for timely collection of outstanding payments.
* Track payments against agreed credit periods and highlight overdue balances.
* Monitor customer credit limits and payment terms and escalate potential credit risks to the reporting manager.
* Reconcile customer accounts and resolve discrepancies relating to invoices, payments, deductions, and credit notes.
* Ensure timely allocation and accounting of customer receipts, advances, and on-account payments.
* Identify long pending and disputed receivables and coordinate for their resolution.

**3. Reconciliation & MIS Reporting**

* Perform periodic reconciliation of customer ledgers and customer confirmations, wherever required.
* Prepare and circulate daily/weekly collection reports and periodic debtor ageing reports.
* Provide sales, outstanding receivables, overdue balances, and collection status reports to management.
* Track collection targets against actual collections and highlight significant deviations.
* Assist in month-end and year-end closing activities relating to sales and receivables.

**4. GST & Documentation Compliance**

* Ensure accurate GST reporting-related data for sales invoices, credit notes, and amendments.
* Coordinate for reconciliation of sales records with GSTR-1 and other relevant GST records, as applicable.
* Ensure proper maintenance of supporting documents for sales transactions, customer balances, and collections.
* Assist in audit requirements and provide supporting schedules and documents to internal and external auditors.

**5. Coordination & Process Improvement**

* Coordinate with sales, dispatch, logistics, and other internal teams to resolve billing and collection issues.
* Maintain systematic records and ensure timely updating of accounting entries in the ERP/accounting system.
* Identify opportunities to improve invoicing accuracy, debtor follow-ups, reconciliation, and reporting processes.
* Support automation of routine reports and receivables tracking wherever feasible.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* B.Com / M.Com or equivalent qualification in Accounting or Finance.
* Approximately 1-2 years of relevant experience in sales accounting and debtor management.
* Working knowledge of GST and sales accounting procedures.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting software such as Tally, SAP or an ERP system.
* Good communication, reconciliation, follow-up, and analytical skills.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely and accurate sales invoicing.
* Reduction in overdue receivables and long-pending outstanding balances.
* Achievement of collection targets within agreed credit periods.
* Timely completion of debtor reconciliations.
* Accuracy and timely submission of debtor ageing and collection MIS.
* Timely resolution of customer billing and account-related disputes.
* Compliance with internal accounting controls and documentation requirements.

title: Services Sales Executive-IT Sales/SaaS
description:
**SERVICES SALES EXECUTIVE — INDIA**

Software Development & Managed Engineering · 12th Wonder · Pune

12th Wonder has delivered custom software and managed engineering teams to 100+ Indian enterprises since 2012. The delivery engine is proven — 70 engineers, a Pune centre operational since 2019, and a client base that renews.

What's missing is a dedicated hunter who can systematically connect this capability to new buyers. We're hiring a Services Sales Executive to own a territory, build pipeline from scratch, and close new-logo deals across India.

**THE ROLE**

This is a pure selling role. No team to manage in year one. No SDR motion to build. Your job is to find enterprise buyers who need custom software development or managed engineering capacity, and close them.

**You'll spend 80%+ of your time in front of customers**
— identifying strategic accounts, building relationships with CXOs and engineering leaders, running discovery, shaping solutions with our pre-sales and delivery teams, writing proposals, negotiating contracts, and closing. The remaining time goes into pipeline hygiene, forecasting, and sharpening your territory plan.

**You own your territory and your number.**
You'll define target accounts within assigned segments, decide your outbound approach, and run your own pipeline cadence. You'll have a pre-sales engineer and delivery leadership behind you on every qualified opportunity — but the deal is yours to win or lose.

**Your buyer:**
India-domiciled enterprises across three primary segments — automotive OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers, testing and certification (TIC) labs, and enterprise engineering R&D centres. Rupee-denominated, relationship-led, CXO-level deals averaging ~₹20 lakh. Pune's position inside the Chakan–Talegaon supplier belt puts the densest cluster of target accounts within a morning's drive.

**WHAT YOU'RE SELLING**

Two proven service lines, both with referenceable customers and repeatable delivery models:

**Custom software development.**
Full-stack engineering teams that design, build, and ship applications for enterprise clients — web, mobile, cloud, data, and integration. Engagements typically start as fixed-scope projects and expand into ongoing development partnerships.

**Managed engineering teams.**
Dedicated engineering capacity operated from our Pune centre, embedded in the client's product or platform roadmap. Longer-duration, higher-ACV engagements with sticky renewal economics. Clients retain technical control; we provide the team, the management layer, and the delivery infrastructure.

Both service lines sell to the same buyers through the same motion. The typical land is a ₹15–25 lakh project engagement; the expand is a managed team at 3–5x the initial contract value

**MILESTONES**

***Exhibit 1: Year-one de***

**First 30 days**

Territory plan defined. Target account list of 50+ accounts built and prioritised. CRM configured. First outbound sequences live.

**First 60 days**

Minimum 15 first meetings completed. At least 5 qualified opportunities in pipeline with identified budget and decision-maker.

﻿First 90 days

Pipeline value at 2x forward target. First proposals submitted. At least one deal in advanced negotiation

**First 180 days**

First closed-won deals on the board. Pipeline coverage at 3x forward target. Clear expansion path identified in at least two landed accounts

**End of year one**

₹75 lakh in closed revenue — roughly four deals at our average size. At least one account in active expansion from project to managed team.

**COMPENSATION**

Cash role — fixed plus variable, no ESOP attached. We'd rather be transparent about the economics than quote an OTE and let you reverse-engineer it.

***Exhibit 2: Compensation structure***

Fixed ₹12–15L

Target ₹75 lakh

Variable Plan ₹5.6L

OTE AT Plan ₹18–21L

**FIXARGE**
**VARIABLE AT PLA**
**OTE AT PLA**

**Variable is a flat 7.5% of closed revenue, uncapped.**
The rate doesn't taper past target — close ₹1 crore and the plan pays ₹7.5L variable, no renegotiation. Variable pays pro-rata from 70% of target, on revenue closed at or above floor margin. We're not going to pay you to discount, and you shouldn't want a plan that does.

**DETAILS**

***Exhibit 3: Role parameters***

**Location**

Pune. Remote (India) considered for strong candidates, with monthly onsite weeks.

**Buyer geography**

India-domiciled enterprises

**Reports to**

Chief Operating Officer

**Year-one target**

₹75 lakh in closed revenue

**Typical deal size**

~₹20 lakh

**Travel**

~30%, primarily metro India and the Pune industrial belt

**Team**

Individual contributor. Pre-sales and delivery support on qualified deals.

**Start**

Immediate

**HOW HIRING WORKS**

Three conversations over about two weeks:

**1. Screening call (30 min)**
— your track record, deal examples, and whether the buyer profile matches what you've sold.

**2. Pipeline walkthrough (60 min)**
— pick one of your best deals and walk us through it end-to-end: how you found it, how you qualified it, how you closed it, and what you'd do differently.

**3. Leadership conversation (45 min)**
— with the COO: territory, the number, and the terms.

Decision within 5 working days of the last conversation, either way.

description:
**About BridgeYU**

BridgeYU is building the next generation of learning infrastructure. We empower educators, coaching institutes, schools, universities, and content creators to launch their own branded learning platforms with enterprise-grade features.

We’re at an exciting stage of our journey and looking for a Sales Specialist who wants to build, grow, and win with us. If you’re an optimistic, target-driven seller who thrives on turning opportunities into customers and enjoys building something from the ground up, we’d love to meet you.

**Role Description**

We’re looking for a driven and optimistic Sales Specialist to help scale BridgeYU from 0 to 1.

This role is for someone who loves selling, takes ownership of targets, and sees challenges as opportunities. You’ll be responsible for building a strong sales pipeline, identifying the right customers, converting leads into paying customers, and consistently delivering measurable revenue growth.

You won’t just manage an existing pipeline—you’ll create opportunities, experiment with sales strategies, build relationships, and develop repeatable processes that drive business growth. Working closely with the founders, you’ll play a key role in shaping our go-to-market strategy and establishing BridgeYU’s presence in the market.

We’re looking for a positive, persistent, and results-oriented seller who believes in the product, enjoys talking to customers, and is motivated by achieving—and exceeding—targets.

***Note: Candidates with their own laptop and personal transportation will be preferred***
.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Own Sales Targets:**
  Take complete ownership of revenue goals, consistently meet targets, and work towards exceeding them.
* **Build from 0 to 1:**
  Create and grow the sales pipeline from scratch by identifying potential customers and exploring new opportunities.
* **Generate Quality Leads:**
  Drive lead generation through outbound outreach, referrals, partnerships, networking, and other effective channels.
* **Convert Prospects into Customers:**
  Lead prospects through the sales journey with consultative selling, effective communication, and consistent follow-ups.
* **Maintain a Winning Mindset:**
  Stay optimistic and persistent through rejections, handle objections confidently, and find ways to move deals forward.
* **Build Scalable Sales Processes:**
  Develop sales playbooks, improve follow-up strategies, and create repeatable systems for consistent growth.
* **Track Performance:**
  Monitor sales KPIs, pipeline health, conversion rates, and revenue performance to continuously improve results.
* **Collaborate with Founders:**
  Work closely with the founding team to refine messaging, understand customer needs, and explore new market opportunities.
* **Build Long-Term Relationships:**
  Deliver a strong customer experience that encourages retention, referrals, and long-term partnerships.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in sales, business development, or customer acquisition, preferably in an EdTech startup, SaaS company, or high-growth environment.
* A proven ability to generate leads independently, convert prospects, and consistently work towards sales targets.
* Strong communication, persuasion, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* A positive, optimistic, and resilient attitude, with the ability to stay motivated despite setbacks and rejections.
* A target-driven mindset with a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and urgency.
* Understanding of B2B sales, customer acquisition, and sales pipeline management.
* A data-driven approach to tracking performance, identifying bottlenecks, and improving conversions.
* Comfort working in an early-stage startup where you may need to build processes from scratch and wear multiple hats.
* Familiarity with CRM tools, sales automation platforms, and prospecting tools is a plus.
* Prior EdTech or SaaS sales experience is preferred, but a strong sales mindset and the ability to deliver results matter most.

**Who Will Thrive at BridgeYU?**

* You enjoy selling and are excited by the challenge of building something from the ground up.

description:
**Company Description**
Tekor Minerals (TEKOR) is a leading manufacturer of high-performance fluxes serving the Iron and Steel industry. The company has an established global presence across Asia, the Middle East, and Europe, supplying solutions that support efficient and reliable steel production. Tekor Minerals focuses on product effectiveness, consistent quality, and technical support to meet demanding industrial requirements. **Role Description**
The Technical Sales and Business Executive is a full-time, on-site role based in Pune City. This role is responsible for managing and expanding customer accounts in the Iron and Steel sector, identifying new business opportunities, and promoting TEKOR’s flux products to prospective clients. Daily activities include meeting with customers, providing technical product demonstrations and recommendations, preparing proposals and quotations, and following up on leads to convert them into long-term partnerships. The Executive is expected to maintain accurate sales reports, achieve assigned targets, and represent TEKOR professionally at industry events and client meetings.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong technical understanding of metallurgical processes, especially in the Iron and Steel industry, and the ability to translate technical product features into customer benefits.
* Proven sales, negotiation, and customer relationship management skills, with experience managing industrial or B2B accounts.
* Business development capabilities, including market research, lead generation, opportunity assessment, and strategic planning.
* Clear and professional communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present technical information to diverse stakeholders.

* Prior experience in the steel, metals, or industrial chemicals sector is highly beneficial.
* Proficiency in MS Office and CRM tools, with strong organizational and reporting skills.
* Demonstrated initiative, goal orientation, and a commitment to ethical, non-discriminatory professional conduct.

title: Integrated Marketing Program Manager
description:
Candescent is a forward-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in-person channels.

Our Experience-Led, Intelligence-Driven approach combines human-centered design with data, automation, and cloud-based innovation. Built on an API-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.

***Role Purpose***

Candescent is seeking a Integrated Marketing Program Manager to connect our go-to-market strategy to rigorous execution on the ground. Based in one of our India office locations, you will own the delivery of marketing’s most important and most complex programs — the integrated campaigns, launches, and go-to-market initiatives that build brand visibility, generate pipeline, and support company growth.

This is a senior individual contributor role with real influence. You will be marketing leadership’s trusted planning partner — turning priorities into operating cadences, decision-ready materials, and clear owners, milestones, and outcomes. The integrated marketing calendar is a key tool in this, bridging strategy and execution by connecting agreed priorities to the work actually in flight.

Beyond delivering programs yourself, you will build the program management capability that marketing runs on. You will establish the standards, tools, and best practices that other teams adopt, and serve as the lead practitioner and mentor for a small group of coordination and project management professionals working across marketing operations, brand and communications, and digital.

The role carries high visibility. You will work directly with the Chief Marketing Officer and marketing senior leadership, and engage periodically with the Chief Revenue Officer and leaders across the revenue organization. It is an opportunity to shape how marketing executes, and to directly influence whether our go-to-market goals are met.

**Key Responsibilities and Deliverables**

*What you will be responsible for and what you will do*

**Program Planning & Delivery**

* Personally own end-to-end delivery of marketing’s largest and most complex cross-functional programs, from intake and planning through launch, measurement, and optimization.
* Translate go-to-market and marketing priorities into integrated roadmaps, milestone plans, dependency maps, and risk registers.
* Co-own execution alongside functional leads, partnering with product marketing on launches, brand on creative delivery, and demand generation on campaign activation.
* Ensure campaign briefs, objectives, audience definitions, content requirements, channel plans, measurement plans, and launch criteria are agreed before work enters execution.
* Manage portfolio-level visibility across concurrent programs, including prioritization, capacity trade-offs, escalation, and delivery risk mitigation.
* Own the integrated marketing calendar as the shared view of what marketing is delivering and when, using it to drive sequencing, prioritization, and capacity conversations.

**Center of Excellence & Practice Leadership**

* Establish and run a center of excellence for program and project management across marketing, raising the rigor, consistency, and maturity of how work is coordinated and delivered.
* Build the foundational toolkit other teams use to run their own work, including intake models, briefing standards, project templates, milestone and dependency frameworks, risk and status reporting formats, and launch checklists.
* Define and socialize standards and best practices for marketing execution, and help teams adopt them in a way that improves speed and quality rather than adding process for its own sake.
* Serve as the lead practitioner and mentor for coordination and project management professionals across marketing operations, brand and communications, and digital, creating a strong nucleus of shared standards and common ways of working across teams that do not share a reporting line.
* Coach these colleagues on planning discipline, stakeholder management, risk management, and executive communication; this role leads through influence and does not carry direct people management responsibility.
* Drive measurable improvement in effectiveness, consistency, efficiency, risk mitigation, and return on marketing investment, building capability that outlasts any one individual.

**Operating Cadence & Governance**

* Build and run the operating cadences that keep priorities, risks, dependencies, and next steps visible, including status reviews, planning cycles, and launch readiness forums.
* Help define how marketing operates together — establishing the operating model, rituals, and ways of working that scale as the team and its remit grow.
* Improve intake, prioritization, approval, and launch governance processes across marketing.
* Facilitate senior stakeholder alignment, ensuring decisions, scope changes, approvals, and dependencies are documented, communicated, and resolved.
* Keep planning tools and the marketing calendar current and trusted, so conflicts, gaps, and over-commitment surface before they affect delivery.
* Coordinate closely with the US-based Marketing Operations lead and the US-based process and program management counterpart to keep priorities aligned and standards consistent across regions.
* Apply AI tools practically to accelerate briefs, status reporting, documentation, and synthesis, and help the team adopt them in day-to-day ways of working.
* Maintain a working schedule with sufficient overlap with US business hours on at least a few days each week to enable live collaboration, reviews, and decision-making.

**Executive Engagement & Reporting**

* Partner directly with the Chief Marketing Officer and marketing senior leadership on planning, prioritization, and trade-off decisions, bringing forward the information they need to decide.
* Engage periodically with the Chief Revenue Officer and revenue organization leaders to align marketing execution with sales and pipeline priorities.
* Synthesize inputs from marketing, sales, product, and agency stakeholders into decision-ready briefings and reporting for leadership.
* Provide executive-ready visibility into program health, launch readiness, risks, blockers, trade-offs, and decisions required.
* Communicate clearly and concisely with senior leaders, simplifying complex workstreams and presenting trade-offs rather than escalating problems without options.

**Experience**

*Demonstrated skills, competencies, and required experience*

* 10+ years of experience in marketing program or project management, integrated campaign delivery, or marketing operations, including significant time at a senior level.
* Proven track record personally managing complex, high-visibility, multi-channel marketing programs in a fast-paced B2B environment, working directly with senior marketing leadership.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams, influence senior stakeholders, and drive accountability across functions without direct authority.
* Experience establishing program management standards, tools, or practices that other teams adopted, and mentoring other project or program management professionals.
* Strong working knowledge of how marketing moves from brief to content creation, channel activation, launch, and performance reporting.
* Practical fluency across core marketing channels, including email, web, webinars, events, paid media, organic social, and ABM programs.
* Experience running an integrated marketing calendar or equivalent planning system across multiple teams and channels.
* Excellent executive communication skills, with the ability to simplify complexity, present trade-offs, and escalate risks with recommendations.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

**Qualifications & Preferred Distinctions**

*Additional accomplishments*

* PMP, agile, or equivalent program management certification is preferred.
* Experience in technology, financial services, SaaS, or other complex enterprise go-to-market environments is preferred.
* Experience with marketing automation, CRM, and work management platforms such as Marketo, Salesforce, Smartsheet, Jira, Asana, or Workfront.
* Experience leading ABM or account-focused programs, including target account prioritization, sales alignment, and account-level performance tracking.
* Experience managing external agencies, media partners, freelancers, or offshore and shared-services delivery teams.
* Working knowledge of campaign measurement, including engagement and conversion metrics, pipeline influence, attribution, and funnel movement.
* Experience building a new team, function, or delivery model from the ground up is a strong plus.

Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful.

**Statement to Third Party Agencies**  
To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

title: Manager II, Science, Tech - Science
description:
**About the team**  
  
The Core Analytics & Science Team (CAS) is Uber's primary science organisation, covering both our main lines of business as well as the underlying platform technologies on which those businesses are built. We are a key part of Uber's cross-functional product development teams, helping to drive every stage of product development through data analytic, statistical, and algorithmic expertise. CAS owns the experience and algorithms powering Uber's global Mobility and Delivery products. We optimise and personalise the rider and driver experience, target incentives and introduce customizations for routing and matching for products and use cases that go beyond the core Uber capabilities.
  
  
Within CAS, the Mobility Science team focuses on improving the core rider and driver experience across Uber's Mobility business. Our work spans areas such as marketplace health, pricing and incentives, matching and dispatch, rider experience, and driver experience, with the goal of ensuring a reliable and efficient experience for millions of riders and drivers globally.
  
  
A key part of this mission is enabling high-quality experimentation and causal measurement across product features that influence marketplace dynamics. The team develops and applies advanced experimentation methodologies and quasi-causal inference techniques to evaluate product changes, understand marketplace interventions, and guide data-driven decision making in complex, networked environments where traditional experimentation may not always be feasible.
  
  
**About the Role**  
  
The Mobility and Delivery Science team is Uber's science organisation covering two of our core lines of business. We are a key part of Uber's cross-functional product development teams, helping to drive every stage of product development through data analytic, statistical, and algorithmic expertise. We own the experience and algorithms powering Uber's global Mobility and Delivery products. We optimise and personalise the rider experience, target incentives and introduce customizations for routing and matching for products and use cases that go beyond the core Uber capabilities.
  
  
What the Candidate Will Do

* Lead marketplace analytics, such as understanding rider and driver price sensitivity and the balance of supply and demand, to inform pricing, incentive and matching decisions.
* Develop and grow a team of data scientists
* Work with cross functional stakeholders and influence product roadmap for their respective area, including pricing and marketplace strategy
* Refine ambiguous questions and generate new hypotheses about the product through a deep understanding of the data, our customers, and our business
* Review the design of experiments and help interpret the results to draw detailed and impactful conclusions, across standard A/Bs as well as Switchback setup and quasi-experimental techniques like synthetic controls
* Define how our teams measure success, by developing Key Performance Indicators and other users/business metrics, in close partnership with Product and other subject areas such as engineering, operations and marketing
* Collaborate with data engineers to build and improve on the availability, integrity, accuracy, and reliability of data logging and data pipelines.
* Develop data-driven business insights and work with cross-functional partners to find opportunities and recommend prioritization of product, growth, and optimization initiatives.

Basic Qualifications

* Undergraduate and/or graduate degree in Math, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, or other quantitative fields.
* Educational background in Economics (preferred), or relevant experience in an equivalent domain (preferred), or a strong product science background in the tech industry.
* 9+ years experience in Data Science, Analytics or other types of data analysis-focused functions
* 2+ years experience in managing team of analytics and data science professionals with demonstrated ability to guide and mentor them
* Advanced Python expertise
* Excellent understanding of statistical principles backed by an academic foundation
* Experience with Excel and some dashboarding/data visualization (i.e. Tableau, Mixpanel, Looker, or similar)
* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Ability to mentor, coach and develop junior and senior team members
* Superb organization skills

Preferred Qualifications

* Proven track record to wrangle large datasets, extract insights from data, and summarize learnings/takeaways.
* Proven aptitude toward Data Storytelling and Root Cause Analysis using data
* Ability to learn and adapt to new methodologies for data collection and analysis
* Ability to deliver on tight timelines and prioritize multiple tasks while maintaining quality and detail
Ability to work in a self-guided manner  

  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

**Job Description**

**About the Role:**

You will work with multiple stakeholders and teams. Attend required business meetings to understand the campaign objectives, strategy, segmentation, etc..., then build and manage campaigns using foundational data programming tools (**Python**, **SQL**, or **SAS / SAS CI**),

Making sure campaigns are built and launched without any errors and delays.

Your role will function as an overlay of existing technical and domain experts and bring value through disciplined campaign execution, customer data management, and solution management skills.

**Responsibilities**

* Be the primary point of contact for assigned pursuits to work with the Marketing team for campaign execution, and solutions that meet the business needs of clients

title: Senior Omnichannel Experience Design & Channel Manager
description:
Business Introduction
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

**Purpose of the Role**

Lead the design, execution, and optimization of omnichannel engagement strategies that enhance HCP experience, improve commercial effectiveness, and drive measurable business outcomes. The role will partner closely with Marketing, Sales, Medical, and Commercial Excellence teams to translate business priorities into impactful customer journeys and scalable omnichannel programs.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**Omnichannel Strategy & Experience Design**

* Define and evolve omnichannel engagement frameworks aligned to business priorities.

* Design customer-centric journeys using HCP insights, channel preferences, and engagement data.

* Drive personalization, segmentation, and next-best-action initiatives.

  
  

**Campaign Planning & Orchestration**

* Translate brand objectives into integrated omnichannel campaigns.

* Ensure seamless orchestration across field, digital, events, remote engagement, and content channels.

* Drive campaign reviews and continuous optimization based on performance insights.

  
  

**Analytics & Performance Management**

* Generate actionable insights from customer behavior, channel performance, and campaign outcomes.

* Identify improvement opportunities and drive execution of optimization plans.

  
  

**Channel & Capability Excellence**

* Lead deployment of new engagement capabilities, tools, and ways of working.

* Partner with global and local stakeholders to bring best practices and innovation into the market.

  
  

**Stakeholder & Team Leadership**

* Act as a strategic partner to Brand, Sales, Medical, and Leadership teams.

* Manage cross-functional priorities and ensure delivery excellence.

  
  

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 8-12 years in Omnichannel, Digital Marketing, Commercial Excellence, Customer Experience, CRM, or Analytics.

* Strong analytical, stakeholder management, and project leadership skills.

* Experience in Pharma, Healthcare, or other customer-centric industries preferred.

  
  

**Critical Competencies**

* Customer Centricity

* Strategic Thinking

* Data & Analytics Mindset

* Execution Excellence

* Cross-functional Influence

* Digital Innovation

* People Leadership

* Culture Ambassador

**Skills**

Business Acumen, Customer Experience (CX), Data to Insights, Digital Fluency, Digital Marketing, Product Lifecycle, Scientific Literacy  

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

title: HR & Operations Executive
description:
**Job Title**  
HR & Operations Executive – Recruitment, Payroll & Business Operations

**Job Description**

We are looking for an **HR & Operations Executive** to manage end-to-end human resources activities and support day-to-day business operations in a growing digital marketing agency.

This role offers hands-on experience across recruitment, employee onboarding, attendance, payroll, employee engagement, office administration, client coordination, sales support, and founder’s office operations. You will work closely with the founder, management, employees, clients, and internal teams to keep people processes and business operations running smoothly.

The ideal candidate should be organised, proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable handling multiple responsibilities while maintaining clear communication and consistent follow-ups.

**What You’ll Do**

**Human Resources & Recruitment**

* **Recruitment:** Plan hiring requirements with managers based on upcoming business and client needs. Post jobs on Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, and other job portals. Maintain the company careers page, screen resumes, and manage AI-based candidate screening on the website.
* **Interview Coordination & Selection:** Schedule interviews, coordinate with hiring managers, conduct reference checks and background verification, discuss salary expectations, prepare offer letters, and follow up with selected candidates until they join.
* **Talent Pool Management:** Maintain a database of suitable candidates for current and future hiring requirements.
* **Employee Onboarding:** Prepare appointment letters, NDAs, and joining documents. Collect identity proofs, bank details, certificates, and other required records. Coordinate email accounts, software access, and devices for new employees.
* **Employee Induction:** Conduct first-day orientation covering company policies, services, processes, workplace expectations, and organisational culture.
* **Attendance, Leave & Payroll:** Track attendance, working hours, shift timings, and employee leave records. Maintain the annual holiday calendar and coordinate monthly payroll processing and salary slips.
* **Incentives & Reimbursements:** Calculate sales incentives and commissions, manage employee reimbursements and expense claims, and coordinate payroll-related information with the accounts team.
* **Employee Engagement:** Organise festival celebrations, birthday events, team outings, and team-building activities. Communicate internal announcements and important updates to employees.
* **Employer Branding:** Coordinate company culture posts on LinkedIn and Instagram, share employee achievements and stories, manage company reviews on Glassdoor and AmbitionBox, and represent the organisation at job fairs and college events.

**Office Administration & Business Operations**

* **Office Management:** Manage office supplies, vendors, housekeeping, visitors, and security coordination. Track company assets, including laptops and equipment, and organise business travel and event arrangements.
* **Client Onboarding:** Coordinate new client onboarding by collecting required documents and account access for Google Ads, Meta, and websites. Schedule kickoff meetings and coordinate with the relevant internal teams.
* **Client Experience:** Conduct monthly client satisfaction check-ins, manage feedback surveys, collect client reviews and testimonials for platforms such as Google, Clutch, and GoodFirms, and coordinate festival greetings and gifts for clients.
* **Client Documentation:** Maintain records of client contracts, NDAs, and renewal dates. Follow up with the relevant teams to ensure documentation and renewals are completed on time.
* **Sales Coordination:** Make initial calls to new enquiries, understand basic requirements, and schedule meetings for the sales team.
* **Marketing Support:** Collect information and performance data from internal teams for case studies. Format proposals, presentations, and company profiles, and prepare supporting documents for tenders and requests for proposals (RFPs).
* **Webinars & Events:** Coordinate registrations, reminders, schedules, and arrangements for webinars, company events, and other business activities.

**Founder’s Office & Management Support**

* Manage the founder’s calendar, schedule meetings, coordinate travel, and follow up on pending tasks.
* Coordinate with the accounts team regarding pending client payments and outstanding follow-ups.
* Track company subscriptions, registrations, licences, and renewals to ensure timely completion.
* Coordinate with internal teams to collect updates, resolve pending tasks, and keep important business activities on schedule.

**Experience**

Candidates with relevant experience in HR operations, recruitment, payroll coordination, office administration, business operations, or executive assistance can apply.

Experience in a digital marketing agency, IT company, or other service-based business will be preferred. Candidates who can manage multiple responsibilities, learn new processes, and work independently are encouraged to apply.

**Who Can Apply**

* Candidates with good organisational, communication, coordination, and follow-up skills.
* Candidates who can manage recruitment, interview scheduling, onboarding, and employee documentation.
* Candidates familiar with attendance tracking, leave management, payroll coordination, and employee records.
* Candidates comfortable coordinating with employees, managers, clients, vendors, and leadership.
* Candidates who can manage office administration, client onboarding, documentation, and routine business operations.
* Candidates with the ability to maintain accurate records, track deadlines, and handle multiple tasks efficiently.
* Candidates with clear written and verbal communication skills in English and Hindi.
* Candidates comfortable using Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and common office productivity tools.

**Why You’ll Love This Role**

* Gain exposure to HR, recruitment, payroll, client experience, sales coordination, and business operations.
* Work directly with the founder and management team.
* Understand how a digital marketing agency operates across departments.
* Take ownership of varied responsibilities and contribute to improving internal processes.
* Build opportunities to grow into an HR Manager, HR & Operations Manager, or Business Operations Manager role as the company expands.

**Preferred Skills & Additional Advantages**

* Experience with HRMS and HR software such as Keka, Zoho People, greytHR, or similar platforms.

HR Operations · Human Resource Management · Recruitment · Talent Acquisition · Resume Screening · Interview Coordination · Employee Onboarding · Employee Documentation · Attendance Management · Leave Management · Payroll Coordination · Employee Engagement · Employer Branding · Office Administration · Business Operations · Client Onboarding · Client Coordination · Vendor Management · Sales Coordination · Executive Assistance · Microsoft Excel · Google Sheets · HRMS · English Communication · Hindi Communication

title: Inbound Sales Executive (B2B AI SaaS)
description:
**About the role**

You'll be the person who takes a business from "we saw your ad, tell me more" to "we've signed, let's go live." At JoyzAI, that means talking to founders and business owners who already want what we sell: AI chatbots and AI calling agents that answer every lead, follow up on WhatsApp, and book the next step. You'll figure out where it fits in their business and close the deal.

You won't be cold calling. Every lead you get has filled our form and then been qualified on a call by our own AI calling agent. By the time a lead reaches you, they've confirmed their need, their interest and their intent to talk. These are hot leads, ready for a conversation. You'll be selling the same product that just qualified them.

This is not a lead-forwarding role. You own the deal from start to finish. You understand the product well enough to run the demo yourself, and you're sharp enough with people to know what the customer actually needs. You win deals by understanding the problem, not by pushing a pitch deck. When you close, you earn: fixed pay plus performance incentives.

**What you'll do**

*Hot inbound leads*

* Pick up AI-qualified leads fast. They've already said yes to a conversation, so speed to lead is part of the job.
* Read the AI call summary before you dial, and start the conversation from where the AI left off. Don't make the lead repeat themselves.
* Go deeper than the AI did. Find out how their business makes money, where leads slip through the cracks today, who decides, and what's driving the urgency.

*Demos and closing*

* Run live demos that show the AI handling
  *their*
  kind of customer, not a generic script.
* Map the right solution (chatbot, AI calling, WhatsApp automation, CRM flows) to the number they care about: response time, conversion, or cost per lead.
* Handle objections on pricing, AI accuracy, and "will it sound like a robot?", then negotiate and close. The fact that they were just qualified by our AI is often your best proof point.
* Write clear proposals and quotations, and follow up until you get a yes or a clear no.

*Handoff and pipeline*

* Hand closed deals to the Customer Success team with full context so onboarding starts without anyone asking the client the same questions twice.
* Keep the CRM clean and honest: every lead, every stage, every next step.
* Bring back what you hear on calls (objections, feature requests, lost-deal reasons) so product, marketing and the qualification agent get sharper.

Roughly 70% of your time is live with prospects: calls, demos, follow-ups, and closing.

The other 30% is working out what's moving deals and what's killing them, then fixing your pitch, your process, and the lead flow to match. That includes improving how our AI qualifies leads before they reach you.

We're under 15 people building AI calling agents. This is not a comfortable corporate job. You'll be in the trenches, you'll work hard, and you'll compress ten years of ordinary career growth into two (this means salary growth also, not just more work).

**What we're looking for**

**Must have:**

* Prior experience selling a software or tech product, such as SaaS, IT services, telecom or martech. You've run a pipeline, done demos and closed deals yourself.
* You speak and write clearly in English and Hindi, and you can explain an AI product to someone who has never used one.
* You're comfortable asking for the deal and negotiating on price.
* You follow up without being reminded.

**Good to have:**

* Experience selling to SMB founders or business owners in India.
* Exposure to AI, CRM, WhatsApp or marketing-automation products.

We care more about what you've closed than where you studied. Degrees don't matter much, but your track record does.

**Why JoyzAI?**

✨ Hot, AI-qualified leads: no cold calling. Your time goes into conversations that can close.

✨ Fixed pay + incentives: the more you close, the more you earn.

✨ Utmost freedom and autonomy: you own your pipeline. Run it the way you think is best. We will only suggest.

✨ Complete responsibility: you're accountable for conversions and revenue.

✨ Top-of-the-market pay: we reward high performance with the best packages.

✨ Unlimited leaves: freedom with responsibility.

✨ 5-day working: weekends are yours to recharge.

✨ Work from office in Noida: collaborate, learn, and grow with a passionate team.

✨ High-growth startup: see firsthand how AI changes businesses, and grow into senior sales or team-lead roles.
