title: Sales Account Executive (B2B AI)
description: About Zeko AIZeko builds AI agents for hiring and talent evaluation. Our core product, Avya, runs structured L1 interviews end to end — a real conversation with an AI avatar that adapts its follow-up questions to what the candidate actually says, then produces a scored, evidence-backed report a recruiter can act on in under three minutes.Around that sits a full stack: resume and recruiter screening, voice-based candidate engagement, post-offer follow-up, L2 panel scheduling, proctored assessments, job validation, and AskAvya — a layer that lets a hiring manager interrogate a candidate report in plain language.Where we areGrowing 20% quarter on quarter. Unit economics that work per account, not growth bought with discounts.Enterprise customers with high renewal rates. Persistent, Nagarro, Orion Innovation, Sopra Steria, Schneider Electric, Cholamandalam, Shadowfax, Pierian Services.We survive enterprise scrutiny. InfoSec reviews at Banks and global IT services firms, EU AI Act clauses, DPDPA, SLA and uptime commitments we wrote ourselves. ISO 27001, SOC 2, ISO 42001 and ISO 27701 are in progress. For a seller this matters: it means the deals you work are real, and they close.Best AI Startup awarded 25 lacs by Hon’ble Minister of Electronics and IT at India AI Summit. Top 20 Startups among 10,000+ applications at UAE-India CEPA CouncilWhy this is a good seatThe category is being created right now, and we are early in it. Every enterprise TA function in India is being asked what it is doing about AI. Most do not have an answer. You will not spend your quarter explaining why the problem exists, you will spend it showing a buyer a better way to run something they already do badly.We sell to serious buyers. TA Heads, CHROs, L&D Heads, CISOs, transformation leaders. Deals run ₹5L to ₹1Cr+ with pilots, security reviews and procurement. This is enterprise selling with a real cycle, not transactional SaaS.You get founder-level context. The CEO runs sales directly. You will not be three layers away from the person who sets pricing, ships the product and talks to the board. Decisions that take a quarter elsewhere take a day here.High AI exposure to improve performance. An AI coach runs over our own call recordings. Your demos and negotiations get reviewed against evidence, not impressions. If you want to get materially better at selling within twelve months, the instrumentation for that already exists.The next eighteen months are the interesting ones. The plan is 6x growth in ARR. Whoever joins now builds the function rather than inherits it: the playbook, the verticals, the team. That is a different experience from joining at ₹100 Cr, and it is the honest reason to pick us.Account ExecutiveNoida & Bengaluru · Full-time · 3–6 years in B2B / enterprise SaaS sales · Reports to the Sales Team LeadYou carry a book and a number, and you own every deal in it from first discovery call to signature — including the parts of it you do not control.The real version of this roleThe phrase that matters is including the parts you do not control. A Zeko deal passes through a pilot, a security review, a legal redline, a procurement cycle and sometimes a CISO. None of those are your team. All of them are your deal. The difference between a good AE here and an average one is not demo skill — it is whether a deal ever sits still because someone else had not come back yet.You will not be rescued from your own commercials either. You put the number on the table, you defend it, and you decide what you will trade and what you will not. Your Team Lead sits in on negotiations, but as second chair — present, mostly silent, there to stop a concession being given away live and to debrief with you afterwards. They do not take the call. Once you have closed two deals inside the approved band without an out-of-band concession, they stop joining.You also own solutioning at the level that matters most: taking a messy description of a hiring problem and turning it into the right modules, a scoped pilot and a definition of what success means. Our Success team handles the genuinely complex builds — ATS integrations, multi-geography rollouts, a client's own competency framework, anything touching architecture or security. Everything short of that is yours, because it is the same muscle as qualifying properly.What you ownA named book of accounts in one industry segment, with a quarterly plan behind itDiscovery and demo, diagnosing before pitchingPilot scoping, success criteria and conversion — you own whether the pilot turns into revenue, Success owns whether it runs wellCommercial conversations end to end: value case, pricing posture, negotiation, walk-awaySelf-sourced pipeline. SDRs support your book; they do not fill it for youExpansion inside your accounts — a second business unit, another geography, another moduleAn honest forecast, held within ±15%, reforecast down early rather than defended lateA complete handoff to Success within 48 hours of closing, because the deal you sell is the deal someone has to deliverWhat good looks like after twelve monthsYou have hit quota for two consecutive quarters with a forecast that heldA meaningful share of your closed business came from pipeline you created yourselfYou have expanded at least one existing account into a new module or business unitYou have run a full enterprise cycle — pilot, InfoSec, procurement — without escalating itYou have coached a junior teammate on something specific, and it stuckYou will do well here ifYou qualify hard and are comfortable killing a deal that will not fundYou can name the compelling event, the budget holder and the decision process on every live dealYou hold a price under pressure and trade rather than concedeYou chase the InfoSec response and the legal redline yourself instead of reporting them as blockersYou bring Success, Solutions and Legal in early and give them room, rather than at proposal stageYou call a miss the day you see itWhat this role is notIt is not order-taking on inbound. If you have only ever closed what marketing generated, this will be uncomfortable.It is not a role where someone senior handles the commercials for you above a certain deal size. We deliberately do not work that way, because it stops people learning.It is not a hand-off-and-forget role. You stay connected to the account after it closes, because expansion is where most of our growth comes from.What we offerBase plus variable on a framework built so that a performing AE earns well — our comp design targets a multiple of CTC in quota, not a token bonus. A book with real enterprise logos in it from day one. A Success and Deal Desk function that genuinely absorbs security questionnaires, DPAs and SLAs rather than routing them back to you. Direct access to the CEO on pricing and positioning. Weekly coaching on your own recordings.How we hireWe do not run interviews on impressions. Every role is assessed against the same written competencies with the same rating scale, and every rating has to point at something you actually did or something we watched you do in the process.Expect live exercises rather than only conversation: a cold-call roleplay for the SDR seat, a negotiation roleplay for the AE seat, a coaching exercise on a real call recording for the Team Lead seat. You will be told what each exercise is testing before it starts. We would rather see you work than hear you describe working.Your interview ratings are shared with you and become the baseline for your first quarterly review, so the process is also the start of your development plan.StagesAI Interview with functional depth, with our AI- Avya. Role fitment, knowledge and experience check. Get a revert instantly when you apply, if you are shortlisted.Competency interview with live exercises, with Sales Lead or CEO within 24-48 hours of AI InterviewConversation with the Founders within 4-5 working days after Stage 2Reference checks, then offer within 4-5 working days after Stage 3What we will not pretend aboutWe are still building. The playbook exists but it is not finished, and parts of it you will write. If you need a mature system to operate inside, we are not it yet.Enterprise cycles are long. Six to twelve months with pilots and security reviews. Your first quarter will not look like your fourth.Everyone is close to the work. The CEO reads deal notes. That is useful when you want a decision and uncomfortable if you would rather not be observed.We check what we claim. Attainment, meeting numbers and team development claims are verified at reference stage before an offer, not after.How to applyApply at the link, you will be directed to a conversation with Avya. Complete it and you will hear from us within 24 hours for the next interview

title: Store Executive
description:
**Role Summary**

Proxgy is seeking an experienced, detail-oriented, and dynamic **Store Manager** to oversee our central inventory and warehouse operations. In this role, you will be the backbone of our physical supply chain, managing the lifecycle of our innovative deep-tech IoT hardware products, smart wearables, and industrial safety devices (such as SmartHats, ProHats, smart locks, and tracking units).

You will be responsible for end-to-end store operations, stock accuracy, seamless inward and outward dispatches, RTO handling, and efficient tracking of device movements across internal departments like R&D, Quality Assurance, Production, and Sales.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Store & Inventory Management**

* Maintain **100% inventory accuracy** through systematic stock-taking, cycle counting, and ledger reconciliations.
* Organize and maintain the physical store layout for optimal storage, easy retrieval, and safety of sensitive electronic components, finished IoT devices, and raw materials.
* Implement robust Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) or ERP-driven tracking procedures to monitor stock levels in real time.
* Prevent stock obsolescence, shrinkage, or damage through proactive stock rotations and secure storage practices.

**2. Inward and Outward Dispatches**

* Supervise all **inward shipments**, ensuring rigorous quality checks on incoming raw materials, components, and vendor supplies against purchase orders (POs).
* Manage **outward dispatches** for B2B clients, field deployments, and e-commerce channels, ensuring timely, secure, and cost-effective shipping.
* Coordinate with third-party logistics (3PL) partners and courier services to ensure hassle-free final-mile delivery.
* Ensure all dispatch documentation (eway bills, tax invoices, delivery challans, and packing slips) is meticulously generated and archived.

**3. RTO (Return to Origin) Management**

* Streamline the **RTO and reverse logistics process** by efficiently tracking, receiving, and inspecting returned shipments from clients or transit hubs.
* Categorize returned devices based on condition (e.g., for restocking, refurbishment, or scrapping) and coordinate with the technical/repair teams for rapid turnaround.
* Maintain comprehensive logs and metrics for RTO rates, identifying root causes to minimize future delivery failures.

**4. Internal Device Movement & Inter-Departmental Coordination**

* Track and oversee the issuance, transfer, and return of devices across internal departments (**R&D, Production, QA, and Sales/Demo teams**).
* Maintain strict chain-of-custody logs for prototype hardware, testing units, and high-value demonstration kits moving within the organization.
* Conduct regular internal audits to reconcile physical assets assigned to various teams versus system records.

**Key Requirements & Qualifications**

**Experience:** 2 to 4 years of proven experience in warehouse management, storekeeping, or inventory control, preferably within a hardware, electronics, or IoT manufacturing setup.

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field.

**Technical Skills:**

Proficiency in using ERP systems, WMS software, and advanced MS Excel.

Strong understanding of barcode scanning, inventory tagging, and SKU management.

**Core Competencies:**

Excellent organizational skills with a high level of attention to detail.

Strong problem-solving abilities regarding logistics bottlenecks and transit discrepancies.

Ability to collaborate cross-functionally with fast-paced engineering and sales teams.

Pay: From ₹30,000.00 per month

title: Real Estate Sales Consultant

1. Job Overview

We are looking for ambitious, confident, and result-oriented individuals to join our Real Estate Sales Team. The selected candidates will be responsible for identifying potential property buyers, generating and managing leads, understanding customer requirements, presenting suitable real estate projects, conducting site visits, and converting prospective clients into successful bookings.

This opportunity is ideal for candidates who want to build a long-term career in real estate sales and earn significantly more through performance-based incentives in addition to their fixed monthly salary.

**Our compensation structure offers a fixed monthly salary along with attractive, uncapped performance-based incentives, subject to the company's applicable incentive policy.** Candidates who demonstrate strong sales skills, consistent follow-up, and successful deal closures can increase their overall earnings based on their performance.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Lead Generation & Prospecting

* Generate new business opportunities through outbound calls, referrals, networking, online platforms, and other lead-generation activities.
* Contact potential property buyers, investors, and customers interested in purchasing residential or commercial properties.
* Respond promptly to incoming enquiries and qualify leads based on budget, location, property preferences, and purchasing timelines.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective customers.
* Identify potential investors and high-intent buyers to maximize sales opportunities.

B. Client Handling & Property Consultation

* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable properties based on their needs and budget.
* Explain project specifications, property features, amenities, location advantages, pricing, payment plans, and availability.
* Provide accurate information about the buying process and coordinate with the relevant internal teams for additional details.
* Build trust with prospective customers through professional communication and timely follow-ups.
* Address customer questions, objections, and concerns effectively.

C. Site Visits & Property Presentations

* Schedule and coordinate property site visits with interested clients.
* Accompany customers during site visits and explain the project's features, amenities, and selling points.
* Present the property's benefits in line with customer requirements.
* Follow up after site visits to understand customer feedback, resolve concerns, and move prospects towards booking.
* Maintain accurate records of scheduled, completed, and follow-up site visits.

D. Sales Conversion & Deal Closure

* Convert qualified leads into site visits, bookings, and successful property transactions.
* Negotiate with customers within approved pricing and commercial guidelines.
* Explain booking procedures, payment schedules, and documentation requirements.
* Coordinate with the sales management, CRM, accounts, and documentation teams during the booking process.
* Maintain regular communication with customers until the deal is successfully closed.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business and customer referrals.

E. Reporting & Performance Management

* Achieve assigned daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.
* Maintain accurate records of calls, leads, customer interactions, follow-ups, and deal progress.
* Update the company's CRM or sales tracking system regularly.
* Submit daily activity reports and periodic sales-performance updates to the reporting manager.
* Participate in team meetings, sales reviews, product training, and performance discussions.
* Follow company policies, professional standards, and approved sales practices.

3. Salary Structure & Incentive Opportunities

The company offers a combination of fixed monthly compensation and performance-based incentives.

Compensation ComponentDetailsFixed Monthly SalaryGuaranteed fixed salary as specified in the offer letter, subject to applicable employment termsSales IncentivesAdditional earnings based on eligible sales and the company's incentive structureHigh Performance RewardsAdditional rewards or bonuses, if applicable under company policyCareer GrowthOpportunities to progress into senior sales and team-leadership rolesWhy This Opportunity Is Attractive

* **Fixed Salary:** Earn a stable monthly salary in addition to sales incentives.
* **High Incentive Potential:** Increase your earnings through successful bookings and eligible sales performance.
* **No Stated Incentive Ceiling:** Incentive earnings may grow with performance where the applicable company policy provides uncapped incentives.
* **Performance Recognition:** Strong performers may be considered for additional rewards under company policy.
* **Career Advancement:** Opportunities to grow into Senior Sales Executive, Team Leader, and Sales Manager positions.

*The applicable incentive rates, qualifying conditions, payment timelines, and any caps or thresholds will be communicated transparently by the company. Incentives are subject to the written incentive policy and eligible sales outcomes.*

4. Required Skills & Competencies

* Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong convincing, negotiation, and deal-closing abilities.
* Customer-focused approach and professional relationship management.
* Confidence in interacting with customers from different backgrounds.
* Strong follow-up, lead-management, and prospecting skills.
* Ability to understand customer needs and present appropriate property solutions.
* Self-motivation and a target-oriented mindset.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with the sales team.
* Good time management and organizational skills.
* Basic computer knowledge and familiarity with CRM tools.
* Willingness to travel for client meetings and property site visits.

5. Eligibility & Experience

* Graduate in any discipline preferred.
* Freshers with strong communication skills, confidence, and an interest in sales are welcome to apply.
* Candidates with experience in real estate, property sales, channel sales, banking, insurance, automobile sales, or business development will have an advantage.
* Prior real estate sales experience is preferred but not mandatory unless specified for a particular opening.
* Candidates should be comfortable with client interaction, regular follow-ups, field visits, and performance-based sales objectives.

6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated using relevant metrics, including:

* Number of leads contacted and qualified.
* Number of client follow-ups completed.
* Number of site visits scheduled and conducted.
* Lead-to-site-visit conversion rate.
* Site-visit-to-booking conversion rate.
* Monthly sales and revenue achievement.
* Number and value of successful bookings.
* Customer satisfaction and referral generation.
* Accuracy of CRM updates and sales reporting.

7. Training & Career Development

Selected candidates will receive relevant training on property projects, product knowledge, sales communication, lead management, customer handling, site visits, negotiation, and the booking process.

High-performing employees may have opportunities to advance into senior sales and team-management positions based on performance, leadership ability, and business requirements.

8. Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for individuals who are ambitious, persuasive, hardworking, and motivated by earning potential. The ideal candidate should be comfortable communicating with prospective buyers, building relationships, conducting site visits, following up consistently, and working towards sales targets.

Candidates who want a stable fixed salary with the opportunity to earn additional income through performance-based incentives are encouraged to apply.

Role Purpose

We seek a hands-on finance leader who can build reliable accounting, accurate job costing, effective financial controls, and useful management dashboards, while supporting corporate transition, acquisitions, fundraising, and expansion.

The CFO will lead the existing three-person accounts team and oversee finance across Thermodyne, associated businesses, and future corporate entities. This role requires direct involvement in execution, process building, and team development.

Key Responsibilities

1. Accounting, Reporting and Financial Visibility

Establish accurate, timely, and auditable accounting with clear reconciliation and review procedures.

Implement a disciplined monthly closing process and prepare management accounts with meaningful analysis.

Develop weekly and monthly dashboards covering cash position, profitability, order margins, receivables, inventory, factory performance, and forecasts.

Identify financial trends, explain variances, and recommend actions to the CEO.

Strengthen Tally Prime usage, automated voucher controls, data accuracy, financial integration, and reporting automation.

2. Job Costing, Cost Centres and Budgetary Control

Implement order-wise costing from quotation through manufacturing, dispatch, installation, and warranty.

Capture material, labour, subcontracting, freight, installation, overheads, and other attributable costs.

Compare estimated and actual order margins, identify cost overruns, and support corrective action.

Establish cost centres across factories, departments, and business activities, with appropriate overhead allocation.

Introduce annual budgets, periodic forecasts, and monthly budget-versus-actual reviews.

Drive measurable cost optimisation while protecting quality, delivery commitments, and operational needs.

3. Cash Flow, Working Capital and Banking

Establish a rolling cash-flow forecast, supplier payment schedule, and regular cash reviews.

Monitor overdue receivables, customer credit exposure, and approved payment-after-dispatch arrangements.

Implement inventory ageing, inventory turnover, stock reconciliation, and work-in-progress valuation.

Manage banking relationships, performance bank guarantees, advance bank guarantees, and related limits and charges.

Arrange suitable funding facilities when justified by growth, acquisitions, or working-capital requirements.

4. Internal Controls, SOPs and Compliance

Build practical SOPs and approval controls for purchases, vendor selection, expenses, payroll, payments, and customer credit.

Establish clear delegation of authority, segregation of duties, and supporting-document requirements.

Coordinate inventory verification, internal audits, and closure of control weaknesses.

Own taxation, statutory compliance, audit coordination, and financial risk management, working with external specialists where required.

Maintain a compliance calendar and ensure timely filings, reconciliations, and resolution of outstanding matters.

5. Corporate Transition, Acquisitions and Growth

Lead financial preparation and coordination for the planned transition from proprietorship to a corporate entity.

Work with the CEO, CA, company secretary, and legal advisers on the transition roadmap and implementation.

Strengthen financial records, governance, controls, and reporting to support future fundraising and public-issue readiness.

Evaluate acquisition opportunities through financial due diligence, valuation analysis, funding assessment, and integration planning.

Support pricing, capital expenditure, expansion, and investment decisions with clear financial analysis.

6. Team Leadership and Cross-functional Execution

Develop the existing accounts team through training, defined responsibilities, and performance reviews.

Work closely with purchase, stores, production, sales, service, and HR to ensure reliable financial data and process adherence.

Visit Alwar regularly to review factory controls, stock, costing, and operational performance.

Present financial findings clearly and drive agreed actions to completion.

Authority and Accountability

Within the approved delegation of authority, the CFO will be empowered to:

Enforce financial controls and documentation requirements.

Challenge expenditure and escalate exceptions.

Establish customer credit limits and payment controls.

Participate in pricing, funding, and investment decisions.

Recommend changes to systems, processes, and finance-team structure.

The CFO will be accountable for reporting accuracy, financial visibility, control effectiveness, compliance discipline, and delivery of agreed improvement targets.

Candidate Requirements

Chartered Accountant preferred; CA Intermediate candidates with strong relevant experience will also be considered.

15–20 years out of which 3-5 years of relevant experience, including responsibility for manufacturing finance, costing, controls, and management reporting.

Demonstrated ability to build processes and SOPs in a growing, owner-managed business.

Strong practical knowledge of job costing, inventory and WIP accounting, budgeting, cash-flow forecasting, taxation, and audits.

Working proficiency in Tally Prime, Excel, financial dashboards, and process automation.

Ability to lead a small team while personally handling implementation and problem-solving.

Strong integrity, commercial judgement, communication skills, and willingness to question decisions constructively.

Additional advantages:

Experience in engineering, capital equipment, or customised manufacturing.

Experience transitioning a proprietorship into a company.

Exposure to acquisitions, fundraising, listed-company reporting, or public-issue preparation.

Expected Deliverables

Timeline

Expected Results

First 90 days

Assess accounting and controls; establish a monthly closing calendar, cash-flow forecast, supplier payment schedule, compliance tracker, and initial dashboards; pilot job costing and cost centres.

Within six months

Deliver reliable monthly accounts, stronger cash visibility, order-wise costing, budgetary control, inventory/WIP reporting, improved approval controls, and measurable cost-optimisation actions. Improve overdue collections and establish suitable banking arrangements where needed.

Within 12 months

Embed financial SOPs and reporting across both factories; complete the finance workstream for the planned corporate transition; establish financial readiness for acquisition evaluation and future fundraising.

Performance measures will include: timely monthly closing, reporting accuracy, job-costing coverage, budget variance control, forecast reliability, overdue receivables, inventory efficiency, verified cost savings, compliance timeliness, and transition milestones.

We are looking for a CFO who converts accounting data into clear decisions, builds disciplined processes, and becomes a trusted financial partner to the CEO.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹140,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Talent Insights Manager - Global Businesses & Functions
description:
**Locations**: Gurgaon | London

Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

As a Talent Insights Manager, you will help our Global Businesses & Functions (GBF) build a more integrated and forward-looking understanding of our existing workforce and talent and translate that intelligence into better talent and workforce decisions. You will bring together internal data on workforce composition, roles, competencies, hiring, compensation, performance, potential, career progression, and retention with external intelligence on labor-market dynamics, emerging skills, talent scarcity, and market compensation.

Your focus will be on connecting these signals, not simply reporting them, to identify emerging talent and capability risks and translate them into strategic guidance. You will help leaders understand where critical talent sits today, where internal or external trends may create future risks, and where BCG may need to adjust how we attract, recognize, reward, and retain the talent and capabilities most important to our future.

You will also help advance our analytics maturity over time, moving from primarily historical reporting toward stronger leading indicators, scenario analysis, and increasingly forward-looking workforce insights and decision support.

Key activities:

* Support the continued development of BCG’s workforce reporting and analytics, improving the consistency, quality, and usefulness of existing HR metrics while identifying opportunities to simplify and automate recurring analysis.
* Analyze workforce data including headcount, roles, competencies, hiring, performance, potential, promotions, and attrition to identify trends and areas requiring further investigation.
* Compare talent data across employee populations to identify patterns in hiring, performance, progression, retention, and other workforce outcomes.
* Combine compensation data with performance, potential, career progression, talent scarcity, and available market benchmarks to help assess how effectively BCG is recognizing and retaining key talent and identify where compensation actions may warrant consideration.
* Incorporate external labor-market data to provide context on talent availability, emerging skills, hiring demand, compensation, and areas where critical talent may be harder to attract or retain.
* Build on historical reporting by testing new metrics and leading indicators that can provide earlier visibility into emerging workforce trends and risks and develop scenario analyses that help leaders understand the potential implications of different workforce and talent choices.
* Leverage AI and emerging analytical tools to accelerate analysis, identify patterns and anomalies, test hypotheses, and explore new ways to make workforce insights more scalable and actionable.
* Prepare analyses, dashboards, decision-support tools, and leadership materials that clearly explain findings, supporting data, and areas that may warrant action or further analysis.
* Maintain accuracy and consistency across complex datasets while connecting detailed findings to broader business questions and applying appropriate judgment to the interpretation and use of data and AI-generated insights.

What You'll Bring

* 6–8 years of experience in analytics, HR, workforce planning, talent, consulting, or related roles, with experience using data to inform business decisions.
* Bachelor’s degree with experience working with complex workforce, talent, or business data.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to connect detailed data and metrics to broader workforce and business questions and develop and test hypotheses.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office and Power BI, plus demonstrated ability to use GenAI and other analytical tools to support analysis and problem solving.
* Experience combining and interpreting data from multiple sources to identify trends, relationships, and anomalies, and areas requiring further investigation.
* Experience translating complex analyses into clear, structured materials and insights for senior leadership, including implications and potential areas for action.
* Strong attention to detail and organization, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and data integrity.

The following experience would be beneficial but is not required:

* Experience with workforce planning, compensation, talent analytics, or external labor-market intelligence.
* Experience with scenario analysis, forecasting, or other forward-looking analytical approaches.
* Experience using AI, automation, or other technology to simplify or scale recurring analytical work.

Who You'll Work With

You will be part of our Global Businesses & Function HR team, sitting within the Talent Insights & Compensation team. This team brings together workforce, talent, compensation, and external market information to help our businesses and functions better understand their talent and inform people decisions.

You will work across BCG’s global corporate functions and businesses, partnering with HR and business leaders and teams to understand their workforce questions and translate available data into meaningful insights. You will also collaborate with colleagues across talent, compensation, recruiting, and other HR teams to connect different perspectives and provide a more complete view of our workforce and talent.

Additional info

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

description:
**Organisation:** Susthodisha Community Health Centre  
**Location:** Thakurpukur, Kolkata  
**Department:** Operations & Sales  
**Job Type:** Full-time

About the Role

Susthodisha Community Health Centre is looking for a responsible, organised and target-oriented Back Office cum Sales Executive to manage day-to-day administrative activities, patient enquiries, appointment coordination, sales follow-ups and service promotion.

The candidate will support centre operations while helping increase patient visits for doctor consultations, diagnostic tests, health check-up packages, eye screening and cataract-related services.

Key Responsibilities1. Back Office & Administrative Operations

* Maintain patient records, enquiry registers, appointment schedules and sales databases.
* Enter and update patient and customer information accurately in Excel or the designated software.
* Prepare daily sales reports, appointment reports, lead trackers and follow-up lists.
* Coordinate with doctors, diagnostic staff and other team members regarding patient appointments.
* Assist with billing records, receipts, report collection coordination and routine documentation.
* Maintain organised records of enquiries, bookings, completed services and pending follow-ups.

2. Telecalling & Sales Support

* Make outbound calls to prospective patients, existing patients and previous enquiries.
* Explain available healthcare services, diagnostic packages, doctor consultations and health check-up offers.
* Follow up with interested enquiries and convert them into confirmed appointments.
* Remind patients about scheduled consultations, tests and follow-up visits.
* Promote eye screening, cataract evaluation and community health camps.
* Respond to incoming calls and WhatsApp enquiries professionally.

3. Patient Coordination & Customer Service

* Welcome patients and guide them regarding registration, appointments and service availability.
* Coordinate with the relevant staff to minimise appointment delays.
* Provide accurate information about service timings, prices and preparation instructions approved by the centre.
* Handle routine patient queries politely and escalate clinical questions to qualified healthcare professionals.

4. Sales & Marketing Coordination

* Support the promotion of diagnostic packages and healthcare campaigns.
* Share approved promotional messages and creatives through WhatsApp.
* Coordinate with field sales executives regarding leads generated from pharmacies, clinics, housing societies and community organisations.
* Maintain records of referral sources and track conversions.
* Assist in organising health camps and maintaining participant and follow-up lists.

5. Daily Reporting & Target Achievement

* Submit daily reports on calls made, enquiries received, appointments booked and patient visits.
* Track conversion rates and follow up on unconverted leads.
* Maintain accurate records of revenue generated through sales activities.
* Support the team in achieving monthly patient acquisition and business development targets.

Suggested Daily Targets

* 50–70 outbound calls.
* 10–15 patient enquiries or meaningful conversations converted into qualified leads.
* 5–8 appointment bookings.
* Follow-up on 15–20 pending leads.
* 100% updating of daily enquiry and appointment records.
* Daily reporting of bookings, actual visits and sales conversions.

*Targets should be adjusted according to incoming enquiries, available patient data and business volume.*

title: Head - International Sales (Coatings&Composits)-Ahmedabad
description:
Position : Head – Exports - International Sales

LOCATION: AHMEDABAD (GUJARAT)

Specialization: Coatings & Composits (Resins)

Department: International Business / Exports

Designation: Head – Exports

Reporting To: CEO / Head of Sales

Location: Ahmedabad / As per company requirements, with international travel as required

**Business Segments: Coatings and Composites**

**1. Job Purpose**

To lead and drive the company's international business growth across the Coatings and Composites segments by developing new markets, expanding existing customer relationships, identifying new business opportunities, and increasing export revenue and profitability.

The incumbent will be responsible for developing and executing the international sales strategy across the Middle East, Africa, Asia Pacific and neighbouring countries and other potential markets. The role requires a strong blend of commercial acumen, technical product knowledge, new product development

capabilities, international business expertise, and operational excellence in export execution.

The position will also ensure coordination with CHA, efficient logistics, regulatory compliance, timely shipments, and seamless coordination across internal and external stakeholders.

2.
**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

A. International Sales and Business Development

 Develop and execute the international sales strategy for Coatings and Composites products,

aligned with the company'S business growth and profitability objectives.

 Expand the company's presence in existing export markets and establish business in new

geographies, including the Middle East, Africa, and neighbouring countries.

 Identify and develop new customers, distributors, agents, channel partners, OEMs, and strategic

business relationships.

 Drive customer acquisition, account development, market penetration, and long-term business

partnerships.

 Develop territory-wise business plans, sales forecasts, revenue targets, and customer acquisition

strategies.

 Monitor international market trends, competitor activities, pricing benchmarks, customer

requirements, and emerging business opportunities.

 Negotiate commercial terms, pricing, payment conditions, annual contracts, and supply

agreements to achieve sustainable business growth and margins.

**B. Technical Sales and New Product Development**

 Demonstrate strong technical understanding of specialty resins and their applications in the

Coatings and Composites industries.

 Lead technical selling by understanding customer formulations, application requirements,

performance expectations, and product specifications.

 Collaborate with R&D, Technical Services, Quality, Production, and Marketing teams to develop products tailored to international customer requirements.

 Drive the complete new product development process, from identification of market needs and

customer trials to product validation, commercialisation, and repeat business.

 Coordinate customer sampling, technical presentations, product trials, application testing, and

resolution of technical complaints.

 Identify opportunities for product differentiation, value-added solutions, and expansion into

high-potential applications and markets.

 Translate customer feedback and market intelligence into actionable product development and

innovation initiatives.

**C. International Market Development and Customer Relationship Management**

 Conduct market mapping, identify potential customer segments, assess market attractiveness,

and develop territory-specific entry strategies.

 Build and maintain strong relationships with international customers, distributors, consultants,

and business partners.

 Undertake international customer visits, exhibitions, trade fairs, industry conferences, and

business development meetings.

 Evaluate and appoint suitable channel partners and distributors, where appropriate, and

monitor their performance.

 Develop customer-specific growth plans to improve customer retention, wallet share, and long-

term business value.

 Establish a structured system for tracking leads, enquiries, quotations, samples, customer trials,

orders, and conversion ratios.

**D. Commercial, Legal and Financial Management**

 Possess sound knowledge of international trade practices, export documentation, Incoterms,

Letters of Credit, bank guarantees, foreign exchange exposure, and international payment

mechanisms.

 Evaluate customer creditworthiness, payment risks, commercial exposure, and country-specific

business risks.

 Ensure appropriate commercial terms and contractual safeguards in international sales

agreements.

 Work closely with Finance, Legal, Taxation, and banking partners on export payments, foreign

exchange realisation, credit control, and applicable regulatory requirements.

 Ensure compliance with applicable Indian export regulations, customs requirements, Foreign

Trade Policy, DGFT procedures, GST/export documentation requirements, and relevant

destination-country regulations.

 Understand applicable product registration, chemical regulatory, labelling, safety data sheet,

and other product-specific requirements in target markets.

 Monitor export incentives, trade agreements, customs duties, sanctions, and other

developments that may affect international competitiveness, wherever applicable.

E. Export Operations, Logistics and Documentation

 Oversee the end-to-end export order execution process, from order confirmation and

production coordination to dispatch, shipment, documentation, and payment realisation.

 Ensure accurate and timely preparation and submission of export documents, including

commercial invoices, packing lists, shipping bills, certificates of origin, bills of lading, and other

applicable documents.

 Coordinate air and sea shipments, freight forwarders, customs brokers, shipping lines,

transporters, and other logistics service providers.

 Develop cost-effective and reliable logistics solutions while maintaining delivery commitments,

product quality, and customer service standards.

 Evaluate freight rates, shipping routes, container utilisation, transit times, insurance, and

logistics service provider performance.

 Coordinate with Production, Planning, Quality, Stores, Dispatch, Finance, and Customer Service

to ensure timely order fulfilment.

 Ensure appropriate packaging, labelling, product identification, and handling requirements for

international transportation of chemical products.

 Proactively resolve shipment delays, documentation discrepancies, customs clearance issues,

and customer delivery escalations.

**F. Cross-Functional Leadership and Team Management**

 Build, lead, and develop a capable international sales and export operations team.

 Establish clear goals, responsibilities, performance measures, and accountability for the team.

 Work collaboratively with R&D, Production, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, Legal, and senior

management to achieve business objectives.

 Promote a customer-centric, commercially disciplined, and collaborative working culture.

 Provide regular updates to senior management on sales performance, market development,

customer pipelines, export profitability, and business risks.

**3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The incumbent's performance will be assessed against the following parameters:

1. Export Revenue Growth: Achievement of annual and territory-wise export sales targets.

2. Profitability: Gross contribution and profitability of export business.

3. New Market Development: Successful entry into new countries, regions, and customer

segments.

4. New Customer Acquisition: Number and quality of new customers converted into commercial

business.

5. Existing Customer Growth: Customer retention, repeat orders, and account growth.

6. New Product Commercialisation: Successful conversion of product development initiatives,

trials, and samples into commercial orders.

7. Sales Pipeline Conversion: Enquiry-to-quotation, sample-to-trial, and trial-to-order conversion

rates.

8. Export Execution: On-time shipment, documentation accuracy, and adherence to committed

delivery schedules.

9. Receivables and Risk Management: Timely payment realisation, adherence to credit terms, and

control of overdue receivables.

10. Customer Satisfaction: Resolution of complaints, technical support effectiveness, and customer

feedback.

11. Compliance: Adherence to applicable export, customs, contractual, and product-specific

regulatory requirements.

12. Team Effectiveness: Achievement of team objectives, cross-functional coordination, and

capability development.

**4. Educational Qualifications and Experience**

 Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Chemical Technology, Business Administration, or a

related discipline.

 MBA or postgraduate qualification in International Business, Marketing, Sales, or Supply Chain

Management will be an advantage.

 Minimum 12+ years of experience in international sales, export business development, or

international business leadership, preferably within specialty chemicals, resins, coatings,

composites, or allied chemical industries.

 Demonstrated experience in developing international markets, acquiring new customers,

negotiating commercial agreements, and managing export operations.

 Experience in technical sales, application-based selling, and coordinating new product

development with R&D and technical teams.

 Practical understanding of international logistics, customs procedures, export documentation,

trade finance, and regulatory compliance.

**5. Required Competencies**

Commercial and Strategic

 Strong business development orientation with a demonstrated ability to identify and convert

new opportunities.

 Excellent negotiation, pricing, margin management, and commercial decision-making skills.

 Strategic thinking, market intelligence, and international business planning capabilities.

Technical and Product

 Strong understanding of specialty resins and their applications in coatings and composites.

 Ability to communicate product value propositions and technical benefits to international

customers.

 Strong customer application understanding and new product development orientation.

International Business and Communication

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

 Strong presentation, interpersonal, negotiation, and relationship management skills.

 Ability to work effectively across countries, cultures, time zones, and diverse business

environments.

 Confidence in conducting international customer meetings, technical discussions, and

commercial negotiations.

**Operational and Leadership**

 Strong knowledge of export documentation, air and sea freight, customs clearance, and logistics

management.

 Sound understanding of legal, financial, contractual, and regulatory aspects of international

trade.

 Strong analytical, planning, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.

 High ownership, execution discipline, teamwork, integrity, and customer focus.

6. Expected Outcomes

The Head – Exports is expected to establish a sustainable and profitable international business for

Speciality Resins by expanding the global customer base, increasing market penetration, strengthening technical and commercial customer relationships, accelerating new product commercialisation, and ensuring reliable, compliant, and cost-effective export operations.

title: Senior Manager Budget Control & Management Accounting
description:
**Job Purpose**

The Senior Manager / AGM – Budget Control & Management Accounting will be responsible for establishing and managing a proactive budget control framework across Ishan Technologies Pvt. Ltd. and Saksham AI Private Limited. The role focuses on preventing unbudgeted or inefficient expenditure through pre-commitment budget checks, monitoring actual expenditure against approved budgets, identifying cost inefficiencies, and driving corrective actions in collaboration with department heads (HODs).

The position will ensure financial discipline, accountability, cost optimization, and effective management reporting, with regular reporting to the CFO on budget adherence, exceptions, savings, and corrective action progress.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**A. Budget Control & Expenditure Governance**

* Design, implement, and manage the budget control workflow across both entities, including approval thresholds, authorization matrices, escalation procedures, and CFO sign-offs.
* Ensure all expenditure commitments above the defined threshold are checked against approved budgets before purchase orders (POs), contracts, hiring commitments, capital expenditure (CAPEX), or operating expenditure (OPEX) are finalized.
* Hold expenditure requests that exceed approved budgets until appropriate justification and authorization are obtained.
* Ensure exceptions are properly documented and approved by the designated authority before commitments are made.
* Coordinate with Finance, Procurement, HR, and business departments to strengthen budget adherence and expenditure controls.
* Review compliance with established budget approval policies and recommend improvements to prevent unauthorized spending.

**B. Management Accounting & Budget Monitoring**

* Monitor actual expenditure against approved budgets across cost centers, departments, and business entities.
* Prepare monthly budget-versus-actual reports, variance analysis, forecasts, and management reports.
* Identify budget deviations, overspending trends, recurring variances, and emerging financial risks.
* Analyze expenditure patterns to identify cost inefficiencies, duplicate vendor expenses, project costing discrepancies, and avoidable overruns.
* Provide actionable financial insights to HODs and senior management to improve cost visibility and spending decisions.
* Support periodic budget revisions, reforecasting, and financial planning exercises.

**C. Cost Optimization & Corrective Action Management**

* Investigate the root causes of budget variances and inefficient expenditure in collaboration with the concerned HODs.
* Recommend specific corrective actions with clearly defined responsibilities, timelines, and expected financial outcomes.
* Develop and maintain a corrective action tracker covering identified issues, root causes, agreed actions, accountable owners, deadlines, and closure status.
* Follow up on agreed actions and ensure timely implementation of corrective measures.
* Escalate unresolved corrective actions to the CFO if they remain open beyond two review cycles, along with the HOD's explanation and supporting details.
* Identify opportunities for cost savings, expenditure avoidance, process improvement, and improved utilization of financial resources.
* Validate reported cost savings and expenditure avoidance using appropriate financial evidence.

**D. Budget Reviews & Stakeholder Management**

* Conduct monthly or fortnightly budget review meetings with HODs across both entities.
* Review cost center performance, budget utilization, forecast expenditure, pending commitments, and significant variances.
* Obtain variance explanations from HODs within defined timelines and agree on corrective actions.
* Challenge non-essential or inefficient spending through data-driven analysis and constructive stakeholder discussions.
* Promote financial accountability among department heads and encourage proactive budget management.
* Present budget health, major exceptions, cost optimization initiatives, and corrective action updates to the CFO.

**E. Financial Reporting, Governance & Compliance**

* Prepare periodic reports and dashboards covering budget adherence, cost center performance, expenditure trends, financial exceptions, and corrective action status.
* Maintain accurate records of budget approvals, exception requests, expenditure commitments, and management review outcomes.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for budget control effectiveness and cost optimization.
* Ensure budget control processes are aligned with the organization's financial policies, delegated authority matrix, and internal control requirements.
* Support internal and external audits by maintaining appropriate documentation and audit trails.
* Recommend improvements to ERP-based budget controls, purchase order workflows, reporting systems, and financial governance processes.

**F. Team Management**

* Lead, guide, and develop the analyst team supporting budget control and management accounting across both entities.
* Allocate responsibilities, review analytical outputs, and ensure the timely preparation of reports and variance analyses.
* Establish consistent reporting standards, review mechanisms, and performance expectations for the team.
* Build team capabilities in financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and management reporting.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* CA, CMA, or an equivalent relevant professional qualification.
* 8–12 years of relevant experience in management accounting, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), budgeting, cost control, or financial governance.
* At least three years of experience in a role involving direct responsibility or delegated authority for expenditure approvals and budget control, rather than reporting alone.
* Experience managing budgets across multiple cost centers, departments, business units, or legal entities.
* Strong understanding of CAPEX, OPEX, purchase order controls, budget allocation, variance analysis, forecasting, and cost optimization.
* Experience working closely with HODs, finance leadership, procurement teams, and other business stakeholders.
* Prior experience managing a small finance or analyst team is preferred.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong financial analysis, management accounting, and budgeting expertise.
* Excellent understanding of budget control frameworks and expenditure approval workflows.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and root-cause analysis skills.
* Ability to challenge spending decisions professionally and influence senior stakeholders.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Proficiency in ERP-based financial systems and budget/PO workflows.
* Advanced MS Excel skills and experience with financial dashboards and management reporting tools.
* High attention to detail, integrity, accountability, and a results-oriented approach.
* Ability to balance financial control with business requirements and operational priorities.

* Prepare treasury dashboards, cash position reports, debt reports, banking MIS, and fund utilization reports.

**About Dash Technologies**
---------------------------

Dash Technologies Inc., headquartered in Dublin, Ohio, is a rapidly expanding IT services and staffing organization known for delivering high-quality talent solutions across enterprise and government clients in the United States. We specialize in compliance-driven hiring, VMS/MSP and Direct Client environments, and government-specific requirements, and we partner with over two dozen U.S. state government agencies on critical technology initiatives — including strategic programs such as AI strategy development and implementation.

As we continue to scale our U.S. public sector practice, we are strengthening the leadership of our Business Development team with a professional who understands the nuances of selling into American state and local government agencies and can lead others to do the same.

**Role Summary**
----------------

We are seeking a seasoned Business Development Manager to drive Dash Technologies' continued growth in the U.S. SLED staffing space. This is a dual role: you will lead and drive a team of Business Development Executives (BDEs) while remaining a hands-on individual contributor with your own revenue targets. Our territory is organized by state: each BDE is assigned a set of U.S. states, and you will hold your own individual states in the same way.

The ideal candidate brings more than 8 years of experience, deep familiarity with American state and local government agency environments, exceptional American English communication skills, and sharp analytical capabilities. You will own the full business development cycle — from market research and lead generation to decision-maker engagement, relationship management, and strategic account expansion — for your own accounts, and you will be accountable for how your team executes that same cycle across U.S. State, Local and Education clients.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Team Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and drive a team of Business Development Executives, each responsible for an assigned set of U.S. states, against their lead generation, outreach, meeting, and revenue targets.
* Set weekly and monthly activity plans for the team, run daily huddles and pipeline reviews, and hold each BDE accountable for disciplined follow-up.
* Review outreach quality, join calls with agency IT decisionmakers, and build each BDE's capability in U.S. state and local government selling.
* Report team and individual performance to leadership, including outreach activity, decision-maker meetings, pipeline, and revenue.

**Individual Contribution**

* Assume full responsibility for business development and revenue generation across an assigned territory of U.S. states. Within those states, generate new leads; identify and directly engage key agency decisionmakers, including CIOs, CTOs, IT Directors, and IT Managers; assess business opportunities; and qualify deals aligned with Dash Technologies' growth strategy.

  

* Acquire and develop trusted, long-term relationships with a portfolio of clients in your assigned states, with a primary focus on State, Local & Education government agencies.
* Expand business with existing customers through consistent engagement, deep understanding of client needs, and proactive identification of growth opportunities across their programs.
* Build and sustain direct relationships with agency IT decision-makers through calls, email, LinkedIn, and meetings, so that Dash is known to them before a requirement is released.

**Strategy and Market Development**

* Design and execute comprehensive outbound sales and business development strategies, including structured sales processes, pipeline management, and adoption of industry best practices.
* Conduct and direct in-depth market research using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo.io, ZoomInfo, and other modern AI-powered prospecting tools to track market trends, identify demand signals, and uncover new business opportunities in the U.S. public sector.
* Identify new statewide IT staffing contracts, cooperative vehicles, and local government accounts, and guide the registrations and enrollments needed to sell there.
* Maintain a competitive, market-aware mindset to continuously identify new business avenues that contribute to Dash Technologies' revenue, profitability, and project growth.
* Develop and execute effective sales, marketing, and business development plans, including market database acquisition, segmentation, and CRM integration.
* Consistently meet sales objectives, including project volume, revenue, and profitability targets, for yourself and your team.

**Qualifications & Skills**
---------------------------

* **More than 8 years of Business Development / Sales experience** in a service industry — preferably U.S. IT Consulting or Staffing.
* **Proven experience leading a business development team** while carrying individual targets.
* **Strong familiarity with U.S. state and local government agency environments** — including an understanding of procurement cycles, RFP/RFI processes, VMS/MSP platforms (Fieldglass, Dotstaff, etc.), and prime/subcontractor relationships.
* **Excellent American English communication & comprehension** — both written and verbal — with the ability to engage confidently with U.S. government stakeholders and enterprise decision-makers.
* **Strong analytical skills** — able to interpret market data, evaluate opportunities, read and qualify RFPs, and translate insights into actionable business development strategies.
* A demonstrable record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
* Resourceful and proactive, with a willingness to conduct deep research on clients, prospects, and individual contacts.
* Presentable and professional demeanor suitable for representing Dash Technologies to senior U.S. clients.
* Self-driven, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to coach and motivate others.
* Hands-on proficiency with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo.io, ZoomInfo, CRM tools, and emerging AI-based prospecting platforms.

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

* Prior experience selling staffing or IT services into U.S. State & Local government agencies.
* Existing relationships with IT leadership in U.S. state and local government agencies.
* Exposure to compliance frameworks relevant to government staffing (E-Verify, I-9, state-specific clearances, MBE/WBE certifications).
* Experience working with U.S. Tier-1 System Integrators as a prime/sub partner on state engagements.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* The opportunity to shape and scale a high-growth U.S. public sector practice at a fast-moving, Dublin, Ohio–headquartered IT services firm.
* Leadership of a Business Development team alongside direct ownership of your own assigned states and a meaningful book of U.S. State & Local government clients.
* A collaborative, entrepreneurial environment with strong leadership support and clear career progression.
* Competitive compensation aligned with experience and performance.

title: Head - Accounts & Finance
description:
**Job Description**

**Accounts & Finance Head**

**Position:** Accounts & Finance Head  
**Qualification:** Chartered Accountant (CA)  
**Experience:** 12–15 years of relevant experience  
**Industry Preference:** Real Estate / Construction / Infrastructure /Service Sector  
**Location:** Ahmedabad  
**Reporting To:** Managing Director / Chairman / COO

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented **Accounts & Finance Head** to lead the organisation's finance, accounting, taxation, treasury and financial control functions.

The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring strong financial governance, accurate reporting, effective cash-flow management, statutory compliance, budgeting, MIS and financial planning. The role will also act as a strategic finance partner to the management and business teams.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**1. Financial Management & Reporting**

* Lead the overall finance and accounting function of the organisation.
* Ensure timely and accurate preparation of monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements.
* Prepare and present financial MIS, management reports and dashboards to senior management.
* Analyse financial performance, profitability, costs and key financial indicators.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to management for business decisions.
* Establish and monitor appropriate financial controls and accounting processes.

**2. Budgeting & Financial Planning**

* Lead the annual budgeting and business planning process.
* Prepare budgets, forecasts and financial projections.
* Monitor actual performance against budget and analyse variances.
* Develop financial models and scenario analysis for business and project decisions.
* Support management in evaluating new projects, investments and expansion plans.

**3. Cash Flow & Treasury Management**

* Manage the organisation's overall cash flow and working capital.
* Prepare rolling cash-flow forecasts and ensure optimum utilisation of funds.
* Monitor receivables, payables, advances and outstanding collections.
* Manage banking relationships, working capital facilities and financial arrangements.
* Ensure timely payments while maintaining adequate liquidity.

**4. Accounting & Internal Controls**

* Supervise accounting operations, including general ledger, accounts payable, receivables and reconciliations.
* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and company accounting policies.
* Strengthen internal financial controls and identify potential financial risks.
* Implement processes to improve accuracy, efficiency and transparency of financial operations.
* Review accounting systems, processes and ERP/MIS reports.

**5. Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure timely compliance with **GST, Income Tax, TDS, TCS and other applicable statutory requirements**.
* Coordinate with tax consultants and advisors on assessments, notices and tax matters.
* Review tax computations, returns and statutory filings.
* Ensure proper documentation and maintenance of statutory records.
* Keep management updated on significant changes in taxation and regulatory requirements.

**6. Audit & Compliance**

* Coordinate with statutory auditors, internal auditors and tax auditors.
* Ensure timely completion of statutory, internal and tax audits.
* Review audit observations and ensure corrective actions are implemented.
* Establish a strong compliance and risk-control framework.
* Liaise with regulators, consultants, auditors, banks and other financial institutions as required.

**7. Real Estate / Project Finance – Preferred**

* Monitor project-wise financial performance, budgets and cash flows.
* Track project costs against approved budgets and identify cost overruns.
* Review project profitability and financial feasibility.
* Monitor project receivables, customer collections and project-related payables.
* Coordinate with project, procurement and commercial teams on financial matters.
* Support management in project costing, feasibility analysis and investment decisions.

**8. Banking & Fund Management**

* Manage relationships with banks and financial institutions.
* Negotiate banking facilities, interest rates and other financial arrangements.
* Monitor loans, working capital limits, guarantees and other banking instruments.
* Ensure timely servicing of debt and financial obligations.
* Maintain appropriate documentation for banking and financing arrangements.

**9. MIS & Management Support**

* Develop meaningful financial and business MIS for management review.
* Provide insights on revenue, margins, expenses, working capital and profitability.
* Prepare monthly management review reports.
* Identify financial risks, cost-saving opportunities and process improvements.
* Support the management team in strategic financial decision-making.

**10. Team Leadership**

* Lead, mentor and develop the Accounts & Finance team.
* Define responsibilities, KPIs and performance standards for the finance team.
* Build a strong culture of financial discipline, accountability and compliance.
* Coordinate effectively with HR, Sales, Projects, Procurement, Legal and Operations teams.

**Key Deliverables / KPIs**

* Accuracy and timeliness of monthly and annual financial reporting.
* Budget vs. actual performance and variance control.
* Effective cash-flow and working-capital management.
* Timely statutory and tax compliance.
* Audit completion within defined timelines.
* Reduction in financial leakages and unnecessary costs.
* Project-wise profitability and cost control.
* Timely collections and receivables management.
* Effective banking and treasury management.
* Strengthening of internal financial controls.
* Quality and timeliness of management MIS.

**Candidate Profile**

* CA/CFA/CMA candidate preferred.
* **8–12 years of relevant post-qualification experience** in Accounts & Finance.
* Experience in a **mid-sized/large organisation, group structure or multi-entity environment** preferred.
* Team handling experience is must as team of 5 to 6 subordinates to be managed.
* Experience in **real estate/construction/project finance** will be an advantage.
* Strong knowledge of accounting, taxation, audit, treasury and financial controls.
* Strong analytical and financial decision-making skills.
* Excellent knowledge of **MS Excel and ERP/accounting systems**.
* Strong leadership, communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work independently and interact confidently with senior management.
* High level of integrity, confidentiality and financial discipline.

**Preferred Competencies**

**Technical Skills**

* Financial Accounting & Reporting
* Budgeting & Forecasting
* Financial Planning & Analysis
* GST & Direct Taxation
* Audit & Internal Controls
* Treasury & Cash Flow Management
* Working Capital Management
* Project Finance
* MIS & Business Analytics
* ERP / Accounting Systems

**Leadership Skills**

* Strategic thinking
* Commercial acumen
* Team leadership
* Decision-making
* Problem-solving
* Stakeholder management
* Negotiation skills
* Strong attention to detail

Pay: ₹1,200,000.00 - ₹1,800,000.00 per year

Benefits:

**About Arvind Global Capability Centre Pvt Limited**

Arvind GCC is a new-age, technology-enabled capability centre being built to power the next chapter of growth for the Arvind Group. Going beyond the traditional shared-services model, the GCC will bring together exceptional talent, technology, and operational excellence to enable businesses across the Arvind ecosystem.

As a new-age organization within the Arvind ecosystem, the GCC brings together global talent, contemporary technology, and a culture of innovation and collaboration. It offers an opportunity to work on meaningful, enterprise-scale challenges while helping shape the capabilities, culture, and future of a GCC being built for long-term impact.

**Role Summary**

You will join Arvind GCC in Finance & Accounts as Sr. Analyst - Accounts Receivable, based in Ahmedabad, and support end-to-end Order to Cash operations within a shared services environment. In this individual contributor role, you will own core receivables activities such as cash application, collections support, customer account management, reconciliations, and billing coordination with accuracy and discipline. You will work closely with internal stakeholders to resolve invoice, payment, and deduction issues, while helping strengthen process compliance and service levels. The role is suited to a detail-oriented professional who can manage defined deliverables independently and contribute to continuous improvement in receivables operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* You will perform accurate and timely cash application in SAP, matching customer receipts to invoices and clearing on-account, unapplied, and advance receipts as per policy and SLA.
* You will support collections activities by following up on overdue invoices, tracking commitments, and maintaining clear records of customer and internal communication.
* You will process customer deductions, short payments, and disputes, and route cases to the right stakeholders for timely resolution.
* You will perform periodic customer account reconciliations and follow up on unallocated credits, advances, and debit balances for closure.
* You will support billing and invoicing activities by checking invoice accuracy, customer details, and applicable tax requirements.
* You will manage customer queries on statements, payment status, and account balances with clear and professional communication.
* You will monitor recurring errors, unapplied cash trends, aging build-ups, and system issues, and flag them for corrective action.
* You will coordinate with sales, logistics, procurement, and finance teams to resolve receivables issues and improve process discipline.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Accounts receivable
* Order to Cash
* Cash application
* Customer reconciliations
* Collections support
* Billing coordination
* SAP FI/SD AR
* MS Excel
* GST and TDS/TCS
* Customer communication

**Nice-to-Have Skills**

* SAP AR reporting
* Invoice matching
* Dispute resolution
* Process improvement

* 5-Day Work Week & Flexible Hours
* Hybrid Work Flexibility
* Comprehensive Health & Wellness Benefits
* Learning, Certifications & Career Growth Opportunities
* Internal Mobility Across the Arvind Group
* Inclusive & Employee-Centric Culture
* Employee Discounts and Corporate Travel Benefits

**ECTION III: PURPOSE OF THE ROLE**

* Drive acquisition of new-to-bank clients and deepen existing relationships be delivering a comprehensive suite of banking products and solutions

* Meet clients’ requirements through seamless coordination with internal teams, ensuring superior service delivery, adherence to risk and compliance standards, and continuous improvement in VOC scores.

**SECTION IV: KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & KPIS OF THE ROLE**
**Responsibilities**
**Strategy & Planning**

* Formulate and execute client acquisition and portfolio growth strategies in alignment with the Bank’s overall business objectives.
* Define performance goals at the beginning of the year in consultation with reporting managers and continuously track progress.
* Translate market insights and client intelligence into actionable business plans.
* Contribute to product and process enhancements by providing structured feedback from client and market interactions

**Core Responsibilities**
**Revenue Generation**

* Deliver financial targets relating to earnings, asset growth, liability mobilization, and fee income across multiple product groups.
* Optimize profitability by balancing pricing, portfolio mix, and capital utilization.
* Identify cross-selling opportunities to maximize wallet share and deepen client engagement

**Relationship Management**

* Acquire and cultivate new client relationships by understanding their financial and strategic requirements
* Act as the trusted advisor and single points of contact for clients, ensuring long-term partnership and retention
* Drive superior customer experience through proactive engagement and high-quality service delivery

**Communication/PR of Bank’s products**

* Undertake brand communication initiatives to reinforce the Bank’s positioning in the market.
* Effectively articulate product value propositions through structured presentation, workshops, and client meetings
* Differentiate the Bank’s offerings from competition through solution-driven engagement.

**Market Research**

* Demonstrate deep understanding of clients’ industries, market conditions, and competitive landscape through primary and secondary research.
* Anticipate client needs by analyzing sectoral trends, regulatory changes, and economic conditions
* Provide actionable insights to product, credit and strategy teams for portfolio development

**Credit Appraisal**

* Conduct rigorous analysis of client financials including income statements, balance sheets, cash flows, ratios and projections
* Evaluate management quality, industry risk, and economic factors to structure sound credit proposals.
* Ensure timely renewals, reviews and continuous monitoring of portfolio exposures

**Documentation and Compliance**

* Maintain the highest standards of documentation, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and legal soundness
* Ensure strict adherence to regulatory requirements (KYC, AML, FEMA, RBI guidelines)
* Coordinate with risk, operations, and product teams to ensure seamless compliance across the transaction lifecycle.
* Build expertise in both traditional and digital banking solutions, including CMS and API base offerings.

**Self-Management Responsibilities**

* Define annual performance objectives with reporting managers and ensure consistent progress tracking
* Take ownership of personal learning by identifying developments needs and bridging gaps through training, mentoring, and industry exposure
* Demonstrate mastery of role-specific competencies and actively develop new capabilities
* Stay abreast of industry developments, regulatory changes, and emerging best practices through continuous education and professional networking

**Risk and Internal Control**

* Rigorously apply the Bank’s risk policies and frameworks to mitigate credit, operational, reputational, and compliance risks
* Monitor early warning signals in the portfolio and initiate timely correction action
* Ensure audit readiness through disciplined information management, documentation, and adherence to internal control systems
* Promote a culture of compliance and risk awareness across all client and internal interactions

Interact with credit bureaus and relevant stakeholders
