title: Social Media Marketer
description: Kovai.co is a global B2B SaaS product company building enterprise software from India for businesses worldwide. Over the years, we've grown rapidly and profitably, and today we're on track towards $30 million in annual revenue - with an even bigger journey ahead.Trusted by customers across 100+ countries, including Fortune 500 enterprises and fast-scaling startups, we build products that solve complex, mission-critical problems at scale.At the heart of Kovai.co is a tribe of thoughtful helpers - people passionate about empowering customers, uplifting colleagues, and continuously growing in our own journeys.What we build:BizTalk360 : Our first product, built to help enterprises simplify and manage complex integration environments with confidence - trusted by Microsoft, Mercedes-Benz, Pfizer, Vodafone, BBC, and NBCUniversal.Turbo360 : Our fast-growing Azure Cloud Management and FinOps platform, helping enterprises gain visibility, optimize cloud costs, and run smarter, more efficient cloud operations at scale.Document360 : Our flagship AI-powered knowledge management platform, helping teams create, manage, and deliver exceptional documentation experiences - trusted by companies like Puma, HP, VMware, McDonald's, and Virgin Group.Three products > One culture of innovation, ownership, and customer obsession.How we work:We believe great work happens when talented people are trusted, empowered, and supported to do their best. At Kovai.co, our teams are collaborative, ownership-driven, and deeply invested in craftsmanship, continuous learning, and open communication - creating an environment where people grow together, contribute meaningfully, and build strong relationships alongside impactful outcomes.At Kovai.co, AI isn't just a capability - it's our superpower. We embrace AI-first thinking to help our teams work smarter, solve problems creatively, and create greater impact for our customers and each other.Position: Social Media MarketerWhy this role existsBuyers form a view of Document360 before they ever reach our website, from a technical writer's LinkedIn post, an X thread comparing documentation tools, or a Facebook group debate about migrating a knowledge base.Or they skip all of it and ask ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini which platform to pick. The two are connected: LinkedIn, X, and Facebook are where our category gets discussed in public, and public discussion is what large language models read, learn from, and repeat.We are hiring someone to run social as a growth channel with two connected outcomes: make Document360 the brand buyers already recognize, and the brand AI assistants name first.The outcomes you own•Audience growth on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and other social channel. Own strategy, calendar, and daily publishing with a distinct approach per platform rather than the same post everywhere. Build a repeatable format system, grow followers and engagement against quarterly targets, and manage the social inbox with clear response times.•Content worth stopping for. Be the source of original ideas. Generate and script reels and short form video (product moments, documentation tips, category commentary, customer stories, trend led formats), develop original post concepts (carousels, opinion posts, comparison breakdowns, teardowns, polls, visual explainers), and adapt long form assets natively per platform.•AI assistants recommend Document360. Baseline how we appear in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Copilot answers for high intent category questions, then improve it quarter over quarter. Build the public footprint that shapes those answers through credible commentary on LinkedIn and X, genuinely useful contributions on Reddit and Quora, and content structured to be quotable and citable. Stay current on how generative engines source and cite information.•Highest share of voice in our category. Set a baseline against named competitors and report movement monthly. Run always on listening to catch category conversations, competitor moves, and buying intent threads while they are still live, and track sentiment and mention quality alongside volume.•Our people become visible voices. Run employee advocacy that gets product, support, and engineering experts posting consistently, ghostwrite for leadership and internal experts, and coordinate launch and campaign moments with Product Marketing, Content, SEO, Demand Generation, and Support.•Decisions backed by numbers. Own the dashboard (share of voice, follower and engagement growth, video views and retention, referral traffic, AI mention rate, pipeline contribution), report to leadership on a fixed cadence, and use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Copilot daily to compress research to published, building prompt libraries the wider team can reuse.What we are looking for•3+ years owning social media for a B2B SaaS, developer tools, or technology brand. Channels you grew and numbers you moved.•Real fluency on LinkedIn, X, and Facebook, plus proven ability to take reels and short form ideas from concept to script to published.•Daily hands-on use of ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Copilot, strong prompting instincts, and the judgment to know when an AI draft is not good enough to publish.•A working understanding of how LLMs source and cite information, and genuine interest in generative engine optimization.•Sharp written English, comfort with analytics and social listening tools, and high ownership in a wide scope role.Equal OpportunitiesWe are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We celebrate diverse perspectives and believe that great talent thrives in an environment built on fairness, belonging, and equal opportunity for all.

**Job Description**

**Manager, AI Services Consultant– Job Description**

  

**Why This Role? Why Now?**

Customer experience is transforming through AI-driven innovation. At Zendesk, we don’t just embrace this change; we lead it. Our Professional Services team is revolutionising how we help our customers implement and adopt AI by building an AI Delivery team and methodology. As the technical and product expert for our AI-powered Resolution Platform, the AI Services Manager role is integral to delivering quick time to value while guiding our customers through their configuration and optimisation.

  

**Mission**

As the AI Services Manager at Zendesk, you will be leading a team by example with product expertise, and joining a management team in our expanding AI Delivery team.Your mission is to provide technical solutions and remove roadblocks for your customers to drive resolutions on our AI Platform. You will act as a technical expert and trusted advisor, guiding customers through complex configurations with agility and precision. Your strong consulting skills and project management expertise will ensure **seamless integration and optimisation of AI solutions** , driving transformative business outcomes.

  

**Overarching Objective For The Role**

* Accelerate customers’ time‑to‑value by driving adoption and operational excellence for Zendesk AI solutions, ensuring customers realise measurable business impact from initial deployment through scale.
* Be the customer’s AI technical expert. Turn goals into the right configuration, integrations, and design choices, and remove blockers fast.
* Lead smooth, on-time delivery. Run projects end-to-end with clear scope, timelines, and stakeholder alignment to deliver reliably.
Build and lead the new AI Delivery team. Stand up the team, methodology and ways of working, while staying hands-on in customer delivery.  

  

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

  

**Strategic Accountabilities**

* **Technical Expertise & Guidance:** Provide expert advice on the **implementation and optimisation of Zendesk AI products,** ensuring customers leverage the full capabilities of the technology to meet their business goals.
* **Change Management & Training:** Facilitate change management processes and deliver consultative sessions to ensure smooth adoption and **integration of AI solutions** within customer organisations.
* **Successful Project Delivery:** Accountable for the timely and successful delivery of AI projects, both your own and your team’s, owning delivery quality, capacity and utilization across the team, meeting or exceeding customer expectations and maintaining high standards of quality.
* **Customer Satisfaction:** Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction, contributing to customer retention and potential upsell opportunities.

title: Professional Services Engineer
description:
**ABOUT XPLORETEQ**

Xploreteq is a Pune-based technology and cybersecurity company working with organisations across cybersecurity, AI governance, data protection and DPDP readiness — through advisory, implementation and managed services. We are ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified, serve 50+ enterprise customers across financial services, healthcare, technology, manufacturing and services, and partner with leading platforms including Netskope, CrowdStrike, Menlo Security, Proofpoint, Okta, Varonis and Forcepoint. As we scale our team across sales, delivery and operations, we're looking for people who want to build a specialist practice rather than join a generalist IT shop.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are seeking a client-facing Professional Services Engineer to lead the technical implementation, architecture and integration of edge security solutions for our enterprise clients. Working from a System Integrator perspective, you will assess client environments, design the deployment architecture, and execute migrations onto modern Zero-Trust platforms — bridging legacy infrastructure (on-prem proxies, MPLS) and cloud-native SASE/SSE.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Assessment & Design**

•   Lead technical discovery workshops to map legacy architecture, application portfolios and traffic flows.

•   Author High-Level and Low-Level Design documentation covering traffic steering, proxy chaining, SSL decryption policy and fallback mechanisms.

•   Help clients plan prerequisites — allowlists, firewall exceptions, certificate authority provisioning, IdP sync.

**SASE/SSE Implementation**

•   Build, configure and validate tenants covering Secure Web Gateway, CASB and ZTNA.

•   Implement DLP policies aligned to client regulatory requirements (PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, DPDP) with custom detection rules.

•   Configure traffic steering and client deployment via MDM/GPO, including bypass and smart-steering rules.

•   Deploy Remote Browser Isolation and content-sanitisation (CDR) controls where in scope.

**Integration & Go-Live**

•   Integrate platforms with client Identity Providers (Azure AD/Entra ID, Okta) for provisioning and group-based policy.

•   Configure log/event forwarding into the client's SIEM (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, etc.).

•   Design and execute UAT test matrices; provide post-go-live hypercare support; run technical training and handover sessions for the client's internal operations team.

**REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

•   3–6 years as a Cyber Security Engineer, Consultant or Professional Services engineer, ideally within a System Integrator or MSP.

•   Hands-on deployment experience with at least one SASE/SSE platform (Netskope preferred) or isolation platform (Menlo Security); familiarity with a second (Zscaler, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Forcepoint) is a strong plus.

•   Working knowledge of proxy configuration (PAC files, explicit vs. transparent), GRE/IPsec tunnelling, TLS/SSL inspection and routing fundamentals.

•   Experience deploying endpoint agents at scale via Intune, SCCM, JAMF or GPO.

**PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS**

•   Netskope Cloud Security Integrator (NCSI) or Cloud Security Administrator (NCSA).

•   Palo Alto PCNSE, CISSP or CCSP are a plus.

**COMPETENCIES & SOFT SKILLS**

•   Comfortable walking into varied, unpredictable client environments and deploying a modern security stack on top of messy legacy networks.

•   Strong documentation discipline for HLD/LLDs and runbooks.

•   Able to run more than one client engagement at different lifecycle stages at once.

**WHAT WE VALUE**

At Xploreteq, we value people who take responsibility, communicate openly, solve problems practically, and contribute beyond the boundaries of a job description. For this role, we're particularly looking for someone who can be dropped into a messy client environment and bring order to it.

**REPORTING**

Reports to the Tech Lead.

**TO APPLY**

Interested candidates can share their updated CV to HR@xploreteq.com along with:

•   Current CTC

•   Expected CTC

•   Notice period

•   Current location

•   Brief summary of relevant experience for this role

title: Technical Service Engineer
description:
Castrol is one of the world’s leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. Castrol brands are recognised globally for their premium quality and high performance, shaped by the company’s commitment to innovation and cutting-edge technology. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on roads and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years.
  
  
Whether you're just starting out or ready for your next big move, you're in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol.
  
  
**Job Description**
About the Team
  
  
The Technical Services & Engineering team partners with the Sales organization to drive sustainable business growth by providing technical expertise, application support, and value-based solutions for industrial customers. The team supports customers across key industrial segments including steel, automotive, bearing manufacturing, metalworking, and general engineering industries, working closely with Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Supply Chain, and customer operations teams to deliver measurable business value and operational excellence.
  
  
Key Tasks
  
  

* Provide technical expertise and field-based engineering support to customers and the Sales team across industrial lubricant and metalworking fluid applications.
* Evaluate customer manufacturing processes, identify performance improvement opportunities, and develop value-based solutions that support new business acquisition and retention.
* Conduct product trials, technical assessments, and competitive benchmarking activities to support successful product conversions and competitive displacement opportunities.
* Develop technical business cases, value-selling proposals, and quantify cost-saving recommendations for customers.
* Perform root cause analysis and troubleshooting for lubrication and metalworking fluid-related challenges, ensuring timely resolution and customer satisfaction.
* Create and document customer success stories, case studies, and technical value demonstrations to support business growth initiatives.
* Deliver technical training programs and knowledge-sharing sessions for customers, distributors, and internal stakeholders.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support product implementation, application optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives across the region.

**Experience Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Production Engineering, Metallurgy, Chemical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* Proven experience in industrial lubricants, greases, high-performance lubricants, metalworking fluids, or technical services within the manufacturing or industrial sector.
* Strong knowledge of industrial lubricant technologies, including hydraulic oils, gear oils, greases, rust preventives, specialty lubricants, soluble oils, and neat cutting oils.
* Experience supporting industrial applications such as steel plants, rolling mills, TMT manufacturing, bearing manufacturing, automotive components, metal cutting, metal forming, or general engineering operations.
* Ability to conduct technical assessments, troubleshoot application issues, and perform root cause analysis in customer environments.
* Experience supporting product trials, implementations, and technical customer engagements.

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Functional Consultant specializing in Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) to join our dynamic team. * Proven experience in functional configuration of Oracle Enterprise Asset Management (eAM), Oracle Maintenance Cloud, or Oracle Enterprise Asset Management Cloud modules.
* Strong understanding of maintenance management business processes including preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, predictive maintenance, and asset lifecycle management.
* Hands-on experience with Oracle data tools including ADFDI and FBDI for data loading, migration, and integration activities.
* Demonstrated ability to conduct Conference Room Pilots (CRPs), User Acceptance Testing (UATs), and comprehensive end-user training programs.
* Experience in creating functional documentation including user manuals, training guides, and system configuration documentation.
* Proven track record of collaborating with cross-functional teams in enterprise-level Oracle ERP project implementations.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into functional system configurations.
* Strong multitasking abilities with focus on release priorities and deliverables within the Oracle Fusion applications context.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Oracle certifications in relevant ERP modules, EAM applications, or Oracle Cloud technologies.
* Knowledge of Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence (OTBI) report writing and analytics capabilities.
* Experience with asset management best practices across various industries including manufacturing, utilities, healthcare, or facilities management.
* Understanding of integration touchpoints between EAM and other enterprise systems including CMMS, ERP, and IoT platforms.
* Excellent collaboration skills with proven ability to work with diverse stakeholder groups and manage client relationships effectively.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both business and technical audiences.
* Experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and SaaS deployment models.

This is your opportunity to be at the forefront of enterprise AI transformation. At iteria.us, you’ll work with forward-thinking clients, build game-changing strategies, and help shape the future of AI adoption across industries.
  
  
iteria.us offers a comprehensive benefits package, paid time off, and an employee centric culture.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a skilled SAP Commercial Project Management (CPM) Consultant to support the design, implementation, enhancement, and maintenance of SAP CPM solutions. The role offers a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of large-scale SAP transformation programs while developing expertise at the intersection of finance, strategy, project delivery, and commercial management.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Commercial Project Governance**

* Act as the commercial lead for SAP implementation, support, migration, and transformation programs.
* Establish and maintain commercial governance frameworks across project portfolios.
* Support project leadership in ensuring projects are delivered within approved budgets, schedules, and contractual commitments.
* Drive project profitability while balancing customer satisfaction and delivery objectives.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, financial controls, and regulatory requirements.

**Financial Management & Project Controlling**

* Own project financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting activities.
* Monitor project revenue, costs, gross margins, and cash flow performance.
* Analyze project financial health and proactively identify variances against forecasts.
* Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reviews.
* Drive corrective actions to improve project profitability and financial performance.
* Ensure accurate revenue recognition and project accounting in line with corporate and statutory requirements.

**Contract & Commercial Management**

* Review customer contracts, Statements of Work (SOWs), Master Service Agreements (MSAs), and change requests.
* Ensure contractual obligations, commercial terms, and project assumptions are properly managed.
* Identify contractual risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Lead commercial negotiations related to scope changes, claims management, and contract amendments.
* Support bid reviews and project handovers from sales to delivery teams.

**Risk Management**

* Identify financial, contractual, operational, and compliance risks throughout the project lifecycle.
* Develop risk mitigation plans and track closure of identified risks.
* Monitor project performance indicators and escalate issues proactively.
* Support contingency planning and financial recovery strategies where applicable.

**Portfolio & Business Performance Management**

* Manage commercial oversight for multiple SAP projects and accounts.
* Track portfolio-level financial metrics including revenue, backlog, utilization, margin, and working capital.
* Provide insights and recommendations to improve overall business performance.
* Support leadership with dashboards, KPIs, and executive reporting.

**Change Request and Scope Management**

* Ensure all scope changes are formally assessed and approved.
* Quantify financial and commercial impacts of project changes.
* Collaborate with delivery and customer stakeholders to secure change order approvals.
* Maximize revenue realization through effective scope management.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with Project Managers, Program Managers, Delivery Leads, and Customer Executives.
* Serve as a trusted advisor on commercial and financial matters.
* Communicate project financial performance to senior leadership and stakeholders.
* Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support successful project execution.

**Compliance & Audit Support**

* Ensure compliance with organizational policies and governance requirements.
* Support internal and external audits.
* Maintain project documentation supporting financial and commercial decisions.
* Ensure adherence to revenue recognition, procurement, and financial reporting standards.

**Team Leadership & People Development**

* Mentor and coach junior CPM professionals and project controllers.
* Drive best practices in commercial management across SAP programs.
* Contribute to organizational capability development and process improvements.
* Participate in recruitment, performance management, and career development activities.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 8+ years of experience in project financial management, commercial management, project controlling, or program governance.
* Experience in SAP implementation, ERP transformation, managed services, or consulting environments.
* Strong understanding of project accounting, budgeting, forecasting, and revenue recognition.
* Knowledge of contract management and commercial risk management principles.

title: ST - Telco-Nokia Flow One-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Technology Consulting - Manager – Nokia FlowOne Solution Architect**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
In this role at EY GDS Consulting, you will play a key role in shaping innovative solutions for telecom clients, acting as their trusted advisor in transformation leveraging Nokia FlowOne driven solutions. You will apply leading industry standards along with Nokia FlowOne expertise to solve complex telecommunication challenges and leverage cutting-edge technologies to drive Telco transformations. You will support the Partners and the Markets team in any opportunities that are initiated by clients.
  
  
You will be responsible to create a market for EY offerings across the telecommunications value chain and generate new leads and opportunities based on the client relationships you already have. Additionally, you will be responsible for delivery of key client outcomes on engagements by managing the teams on ground and client expectations of delivery, helping project teams mitigate delivery risk and identifying key issues that hinder outcomes for the client.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Provide solution architecture and thought leadership on Zero Touch Fulfilment and Autonomous Networks leveraging Nokia FlowOne and other Nokia suite of OSS products
* Lead the implementation of related solutions, ensuring adherence to project timelines and quality standards.
* Driving presales response for OSS transformation RFIs/RFPs.
* Develop comprehensive documentation for network architectures, designs, and processes.
* Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in Autonomous networks, AI, and Machine learning with hands on experience in leveraging leading AI tools for deliveries.
* Develop and apply solution architecture standards, processes, and principles.
* Evaluate and recommend technologies, tools, and platforms that support autonomous networking initiatives.
* You will be the day-to-day point of contact for clients and managers on projects. You structure and engage teams to deliver high-quality outputs.
* Take the lead in identifying client issues and proposing the most appropriate approach for challenges that the telecommunication industry players face.
* You help develop the business and acquire new clients and engagements, including the identification and pursuit of business opportunities by forging strong client relationships.
* You build and maintain long-term relationships with senior clients.
* You drive strategic discussions regarding business objectives and strategy KPIs.
* Delivering qualified solutions to meet business objectives, providing focus to ensure scope and objectives are maintained throughout the project and program life cycles ensuring benefits realization.
* Result oriented leadership style, setting achievable goals and leading by example – linking commercial and technical arenas.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Consultant with 10-12 Years proven experience and hands-on professional experience in Nokia FlowOne, driving large programs and should have worked as an Architect/Designer for at least 5 years.
* Understanding of 5G Slicing, 5G SA/NSA networks, IP/MPLS, Optics, IMS, VoLTE, NFV/SDN, Fixed network.
* In depth knowledge of TMForum’s Open Digital Architecture (ODA) and related ODA components along with TMForum Open APIs.
* Deep knowledge of OSS Architecture, Processes and Systems with practical and proven experience of solutioning for large telecom companies.
* Experience in architecting Zero-Touch operations, Closed Loop Automation, Autonomous Networks and implementing Intent-Driven Management systems to translate business goals to machine readable “Intents” in telecom domain.
* Experience in building comprehensive solutions and response to complex RFx during presales, especially leveraging Nokia’s OSS product suite.
* Providing Autonomous Networks (AN) thought leadership, solution implementation leadership, application expertise and solution vision to clients.
* Additional experience in other Nokia suite of OSS products will be an added advantage.
* Hands-on experience in Java, Python, Kubernetes, Microservices, Databases, etc.
* Expertise and experience to provide thought leadership and guidance on resolving complex implementation and solution issues.
* Expertise to review and approve methods design and development solution documents, internal and external test strategies, plans and scripts.
* Navigate complex client relationships and large transformation related challenges.
* Extensive RFP exposure - developing capability needs and supplier liaison.
* Process development for both 'As Is' and 'To Be' to aid requirement and solution definition and scoping.
* A bachelor’s degree in Electronics/Computer Science/Information Technology/ or any other relevant discipline.
* Relevant certifications (E.g., TOGAF, eTOM, ODA) are a plus.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

**Ideally, you will also have:**

* Strong leadership skills, teaming and communications
* Strong drive to excel professionally, and to guide and motivate others.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Dedicated, resourceful and able to work under pressure.

**What we look for:**
Highly motivated individuals with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize shifting workloads in a rapidly changing industry. An effective communicator, you’ll be a confident leader equipped with strong people management skills and a genuine passion to make things happen in a dynamic organization. If you’re ready to take on a wide range of responsibilities and are committed to seeking out new ways to make a difference, this role is for you.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

title: Federal Proposal Writer
description:
Job Title

**Federal Proposal Writer / Capture Manager – GSA MAS**

Job Type

Full-Time | Remote

Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced
**Federal Proposal Writer / Capture Manager**
with strong knowledge of the
**U.S. federal contracting environment**
, particularly
**GSA Multiple Award Schedule (MAS)**
opportunities. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience supporting the full federal business development lifecycle, including
**opportunity identification, capture strategy, solicitation analysis, proposal development, compliance, pricing coordination, and submission**
.

The candidate will work closely with business development, recruiting, delivery, contracts, pricing, and leadership teams to develop compelling, compliant, and competitive proposals for federal government opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

**Federal Capture Management**

* Identify and evaluate federal contracting opportunities aligned with company capabilities and growth objectives.
* Support the capture lifecycle from
  **early opportunity identification through proposal submission and award**
  .
* Develop and maintain
  **capture plans, opportunity assessments, win strategies, call plans, and action plans**
  .
* Analyze agency requirements, procurement history, incumbent information, competition, contract vehicles, and anticipated acquisition strategies.
* Track opportunities through
  **SAM.gov, GSA eBuy, agency procurement forecasts, and other federal procurement sources**
  .
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to establish bid/no-bid recommendations based on documented opportunity factors.

**Proposal Development & Writing**

* Lead or support the development of federal government proposals, RFIs, Sources Sought responses, RFQs, RFP responses, capability statements, and task-order proposals.
* Develop persuasive content for
  **Technical, Management, Staffing, Past Performance, Corporate Experience, and Executive Summary**
  sections.
* Translate technical and operational information from SMEs into clear, compliant, evaluator-focused proposal content.
* Develop proposal outlines, compliance matrices, annotated outlines, storyboards, and content plans.
* Ensure proposals clearly address
  **Section L instructions and Section M evaluation criteria**
  , where applicable.
* Coordinate proposal inputs from SMEs, recruiting, operations, finance, contracts, and leadership.
* Edit and quality-check proposal content for clarity, consistency, grammar, formatting, and compliance.

**GSA MAS Experience**

* Support proposal and contract activities associated with the
  **GSA Multiple Award Schedule (MAS)**
  .
* Demonstrate familiarity with the GSA MAS solicitation structure, SINs, labor categories, pricing requirements, and applicable proposal documentation.
* Assist with identifying appropriate
  **Special Item Numbers (SINs)**
  based on company capabilities.
* Support preparation and maintenance of GSA MAS-related documentation, including labor category descriptions, qualifications, pricing information, and supporting narratives.
* Understand the importance of maintaining consistency between the company's capabilities, labor categories, pricing, and federal proposal submissions.
* Support responses to GSA/eBuy RFQs and task-order opportunities under applicable contract vehicles.

**Compliance & Proposal Management**

* Develop and maintain detailed
  **compliance matrices**
  mapping solicitation requirements to proposal responses.
* Track solicitation amendments, questions and answers, deadlines, deliverables, and proposal responsibilities.
* Conduct color-team reviews such as
  **Pink Team, Red Team, and Gold Team**
  reviews as appropriate.
* Identify proposal gaps, inconsistencies, risks, and missing solicitation requirements before submission.
* Maintain proposal libraries, reusable content, past-performance information, resumes, corporate qualifications, and relevant project descriptions.

**Business Development & Capture Support**

* Collaborate with leadership and business development teams to strengthen federal market positioning.
* Research federal agencies, buying patterns, competitors, incumbents, and upcoming procurements.
* Assist with development of
  **capability statements, one-pagers, presentations, white papers, and sources-sought responses**
  .
* Support teaming and subcontractor research when required.
* Maintain accurate opportunity and capture information within CRM or pipeline-management systems.

Required Qualifications

* **3+ years of experience**
  in federal proposal writing, capture management, business development, or federal contracting.
* Demonstrated experience with
  **U.S. federal government proposals and solicitations**
  .
* Hands-on experience with
  **GSA MAS / GSA eBuy**
  is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of federal solicitation terminology, including
  **RFI, Sources Sought, RFQ, RFP, SOW, PWS, SOO, L/M sections, evaluation criteria, and compliance matrices**
  .
* Experience researching opportunities through
  **SAM.gov**
  and other federal procurement resources.
* Strong proposal writing, editing, proofreading, and document-management skills.
* Experience working with technical SMEs and translating technical information into proposal-ready content.
* Ability to manage multiple proposals and competing deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to identify compliance gaps.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience supporting
  **GSA MAS SINs and eBuy opportunities**
  .
* Experience with
  **IDIQ, GWAC, BPA, BOA, and task-order competitions**
  .
* Knowledge of federal acquisition processes and
  **FAR/DFARS**
  requirements.
* Experience with federal staffing, IT services, professional services, or technology contracts.
* Experience supporting
  **8(a), SDVOSB, WOSB, HUBZone, or other small-business federal contracting programs**
  .
* Proposal certification such as
  **APMP**
  is a plus.
* Experience with proposal management tools, CRM systems, or platforms such as
  **GovWin, Deltek, Salesforce, Loopio, Responsive, or similar systems**
  .

Core Competencies

* Federal Proposal Writing
* Capture Management
* GSA MAS
* GSA eBuy
* Federal Business Development
* SME Coordination
* Proposal Reviews
* FAR/DFARS Awareness
* SAM.gov Research
* Task-Order Proposal Development

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should understand
**how to interpret the solicitation once released, and how to turn that strategy into a compliant and persuasive proposal**
.

Particular value will be placed on candidates who have
**personally supported GSA MAS activities and GSA eBuy opportunities**
, rather than candidates whose experience is limited to commercial proposals.

description:

**Senior Consultant – Subsurface (O&G Upstream)**
**Desired Experience: 3–6 years**
**Mandatory Skill:**

* Subsurface (Reservoir / Petroleum / Production Engineering domain depth)

**Preferred Background:**

* Experience with Integrated Oil Companies such as Exxon Mobil / Shell / BP

**Role Purpose**
Subsurface Subject Matter Expert (SME) embedded within a digital / AI use case delivery squad, acting as the functional bridge between upstream subsurface stakeholders and cross-functional technical teams (product, data science, data engineering, architecture). The role is non-coding and focuses on shaping, translating, validating, and governing subsurface analytics / AI solutions across the upstream value chain.
  
  
**Operating Model & Reporting**

* Individual contributor role within an Agile / product-style delivery environment; supports functional delivery of subsurface use cases from discovery to deployment.
* Works closely with upstream business teams (subsurface, production interface points) and technical delivery teams (product managers, data scientists, data engineers, solution architects).
* Reports to Senior Manager / Manager – Subsurface (O&G Upstream) and supports Consulting Delivery Leadership priorities for SC&O / Digital Ops engagements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Subsurface Use Case Discovery & Functional Support

+ Support discovery workshops with subsurface stakeholders to capture decision workflows, value drivers, pain points, uncertainties, and success criteria.
+ Draft and maintain structured documentation under Manager guidance: use case descriptions, functional requirements, assumptions, constraints, and acceptance criteria.
+ Support alignment of target outcomes and operational realism across subsurface-to-production workflows.

* Digital / AI Use Case Delivery Support (Non-Coding)

+ Translate subsurface requirements into technical inputs for delivery teams (features, inputs, constraints, classifications), ensuring feasibility and traceability.
+ Support domain inputs across upstream analytics / AI solution areas such as:

- Reservoir performance analytics and forecasting
- Production surveillance / optimization linkages
- Well performance diagnostics and root cause analysis
- Decline analysis and anomaly detection
- Field development planning decision support

+ Review and validate analytics / AI outputs and dashboards for domain realism and engineering alignment; escalate concerns and recommendations to the Manager.

* Stakeholder Management & Client-Facing Delivery

+ Engage with subsurface teams, production interface stakeholders, and technical teams to gather structured feedback and convert it into actionable requirements/backlog items.
+ Support pilot deployments and phased rollouts by coordinating feedback cycles and tracking issue resolution with delivery teams.
+ Support preparation of stakeholder-ready narratives and inputs for proposals / solution articulation aligned to subsurface transformation priorities.

* Governance, Quality & Assurance

+ Support definition and application of data quality checks, engineering assumptions, and validation checkpoints for subsurface datasets and model outputs.
+ Contribute to playbooks, solution documentation, and governance artifacts for deployed use cases.
+ Support UAT planning and execution; document findings and confirm outputs are credible and usable for engineering decision-making.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* 3–6 years of upstream Oil & Gas experience with strong subsurface depth (Reservoir / Production / Petroleum Engineering).
* Practical understanding of subsurface workflows (not theory-only), including uncertainty handling and data quality considerations.
* Strong communication and structured documentation skills; ability to translate engineering concepts clearly to non-engineers and technical teams.
* Demonstrated cross-functional delivery experience spanning engineering / operations / digital teams.
* Fluency in English (mandatory).
* Engineering Degree in Chemical / Mechanical / Instrumentation / Petroleum disciplines
* Experience from/with IOC environments and particularly Exxon Mobil / Shell / BP-type operating models.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

* Exposure to AI, advanced analytics, digital transformation, optimization, or surveillance initiatives in upstream contexts.
* Familiarity with engineering / digital tools (surveillance systems, production databases, BI tools).
* Arabic language capability (optional).

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
  
  
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Marketing Partner, APAC Digital Hub
description:
**Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively**
We are looking for a strategic, insight-driven digital marketing professional who combines strong performance marketing expertise with market partnership, stakeholder management, and cross-functional coordination.
  
  
This is a lead-level individual contributor (IC) role within the APAC Digital Hub. As the dedicated Marketing Partner for assigned APAC markets, you will act as the primary interface between market stakeholders and the Digital Hub, understanding business and marketing priorities, translating them into actionable plans, and mobilising the right Hub capabilities to deliver against them.
  
  
Alongside this market-facing responsibility, you will bring strong performance marketing expertise across paid media, analytics, measurement, optimisation, and digital strategy, helping markets make informed marketing decisions and continuously improve performance.
  
  
As APAC markets increasingly transition away from external agency support, this role will play an important part in strengthening internal digital marketing capabilities and establishing the Digital Hub as a trusted marketing partner across the region.
  
  
Success in this role requires the ability to move seamlessly between strategic consultation, relationship management, cross-functional orchestration, and hands-on digital marketing execution, while balancing market relevance with regional and global priorities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Market Partnership & Stakeholder Management
* Act as the primary Digital Hub contact and Marketing Partner for assigned APAC markets.
* Build strong, trusted relationships with market marketing teams and relevant business stakeholders.
* Maintain regular and proactive engagement to understand business priorities, marketing needs, upcoming campaigns, launches, and potential challenges.
* Participate in market planning discussions, business reviews, campaign reviews, and relevant marketing governance forums.
* Align stakeholders on business objectives, strategic priorities, delivery timelines, decision points, and overall success criteria.
* Provide strategic marketing guidance while ensuring activities remain aligned with regional and global strategy, brand standards, and established ways of working.
* Represent market needs, challenges, and opportunities within the Digital Hub while helping markets understand and activate broader regional and global priorities.
* Maintain clear and transparent communication around priorities, progress, dependencies, risks, and next steps.
* Digital Hub Orchestration & Go-to-Market Enablement
* Own the intake, clarification, prioritisation, and coordination of marketing requirements from assigned markets.
* Translate business and marketing needs into clear, actionable briefs for Digital Hub specialists.
* Mobilise and coordinate relevant Hub capabilities across Content, Creative, Website, SEO, Social Media, Performance Marketing, and Analytics.
* Connect specialist workstreams into cohesive marketing solutions rather than managing individual requests in isolation.
* Coordinate priorities, dependencies, timelines, and expectations across multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Support regional and global product launches and strategic initiatives by coordinating digital readiness across relevant channels and workstreams.
* Identify potential delivery gaps, risks, or misalignment early and facilitate corrective action.
* Facilitate collaboration between markets, Digital Hub specialists, regional/global teams, and external partners where required.
* Identify opportunities to reuse and scale successful assets, campaigns, and approaches across APAC while maintaining appropriate local relevance.
* Paid Media Strategy & Campaign Management
* Develop and manage paid media strategies across: Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, YouTube Ads, and Other relevant digital channels
* Build integrated media plans aligned with market objectives, target audiences, customer journeys, and available budgets.
* Recommend channel mix, audience targeting strategies, campaign structures, and budget allocation.
* Manage campaign activation, monitoring, optimisation, and continuous performance improvement.
* Evaluate campaign effectiveness against agreed objectives and recommend actions to improve ROI and lead quality.
* Advise markets on digital media opportunities and investment decisions based on performance data, market context, and business objectives.
* Identify opportunities to improve campaign efficiency and scale successful approaches across markets.
* Performance Analysis & Strategic Advisory
* Own or coordinate monthly and quarterly digital performance reporting for assigned markets and contribute to broader APAC reporting.
* Translate campaign, website, social media, SEO, and wider digital performance into actionable business insights.
* Develop clear, insight-led reporting that explains what happened, why it happened, what actions should be taken next
* Identify cross-channel trends, business risks, market opportunities, and persistent performance gaps, and translate them into strategic recommendations for future planning and investment.
* Develop and maintain performance dashboards using GA4, Looker Studio, and other relevant reporting tools.
* Benchmark performance against historical results, relevant industry benchmarks, and regional trends.
* Use performance insights and market intelligence to inform campaign planning, channel selection, investment recommendations, and future marketing activity.
* Represent Digital Hub performance and contributions in relevant market business reviews and stakeholder forums.
* Bring market learnings back into the Digital Hub to help shape regional approaches, priorities, and future capabilities.
* Advise the Digital Hub Manager on aggregated market needs, recurring capability gaps, investment opportunities, and regional performance patterns across assigned markets.
* Analytics, Attribution & Conversion Optimisation
* Develop and maintain campaign tracking frameworks and measurement governance.
* Ensure accurate performance measurement through: Google Analytics 4,Google Tag Manager,CRM integrations,UTM governance
* Support lead attribution and reporting through CRM platforms where applicable.
* Align stakeholders on KPIs, reporting frameworks, and measurement approaches.
* Collaborate with regional and global stakeholders to maintain reporting consistency and accuracy.
* Partner with Website, SEO, Content, and Creative specialists to identify opportunities to improve landing-page and customer-journey effectiveness.
* Support A/B testing and experimentation across audiences, creatives, messaging, channels, and landing pages.
* Ensure campaigns and digital initiatives launch with appropriate tracking and measurement mechanisms in place.
* Content, Localisation & Market Activation
* Coordinate localisation requirements including translation, transcreation, and content adaptation.
* Assess when regional or global assets can be reused or adapted and when market needs require more specific localisation.
* Partner with Content and Creative specialists to ensure market requirements are translated into effective, locally relevant executions.
* Support market activation of regional and global campaign assets across relevant digital channels.
* Identify opportunities to make localisation and content adaptation more efficient and scalable through shared capabilities and emerging technologies.
* Ensure localised marketing activities remain aligned with applicable brand standards, approved claims, and regulatory requirements.
* Digital Operations & Problem Solving

* Troubleshoot issues across platforms including Google Ads, Meta Business Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, GA4, GTM, and reporting tools.

* Escalate and coordinate with global teams, vendors, or platform support teams where required.
* Provide practical guidance and best practices that strengthen market capabilities and improve digital ways of working.
* AI & Marketing Innovation
* Explore and implement AI-powered tools to improve campaign planning, optimisation, reporting, localisation, content workflows, and operational efficiency.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and marketing innovations that could improve market outcomes or Digital Hub scalability.
* Stay updated on developments in AI-driven marketing, automation, media platforms, analytics, and performance measurement.
* Support responsible adoption of AI-assisted marketing processes and best practices across the Digital Hub and assigned markets.

Tools & Platforms Mandatory
  
  

* Google Ads
* Meta Business Manager
* LinkedIn Campaign Manager
* Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
* Google Tag Manager (GTM)
* Looker Studio
* Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets – Advanced
* ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or equivalent AI tools
* Nice to Have
* Salesforce or other CRM platforms
* HubSpot
* Microsoft Clarity
* Hotjar
* SEMrush
* Ahrefs
* Marketing project/workflow management platforms

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business, Analytics, Communications, or a related field.
* 5–8 years of experience across Performance Marketing, Digital Marketing, Integrated Marketing, Growth Marketing, or related roles.
* Strong hands-on experience in paid media, campaign management, analytics, attribution, reporting, and performance optimisation.
* Demonstrated experience acting as a strategic marketing partner or primary stakeholder contact, ideally supporting multiple markets, business units, or clients.
* Experience translating business requirements into integrated marketing plans and coordinating delivery across specialist teams.
* Demonstrated ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on campaign management, platform administration, troubleshooting, and stakeholder engagement.
* Experience managing or supporting campaigns across multiple markets or regions.
* Strong ability to translate data into strategic recommendations, business insights, and clear stakeholder narratives.
* Strong stakeholder management, presentation, communication, and influencing skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders in a matrixed environment without relying on direct authority.
* Experience working within regional or global marketing teams is preferred.

Ways of Working
  
  

* Proactive and consultative: Anticipates market needs and brings recommendations rather than waiting for requests.
* Commercially and digitally minded: Connects marketing activities and performance data with wider business objectives.
* Collaborative: Brings together specialist expertise and stakeholders to solve problems and deliver outcomes.
* Structured: Manages multiple markets, priorities, dependencies, and deadlines effectively.
* Influential: Builds alignment through expertise, relationships, and evidence rather than direct authority.
* Solution-oriented: Focuses on achieving outcomes while navigating constraints and ambiguity.
* Curious: Continuously explores better approaches, technologies, and opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness.

Candidate Assessment
  
  

* Applicants are required to submit portfolio materials demonstrating both performance marketing expertise and strategic stakeholder partnership. The portfolio should include, where possible:
* At least one campaign case study outlining objectives, strategy, channels used, performance results, key learnings, and optimisation recommendations.
* At least one performance report or dashboard demonstrating the candidate's ability to translate data into actionable insights and business recommendations.
* An example of an integrated marketing initiative involving coordination across multiple disciplines or stakeholders.
* Examples of how campaign or customer data influenced future strategy, budget allocation, channel selection, or business decisions.

Shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a written assessment based on a realistic market-partner scenario, which may include interpreting a market brief, developing a digital or campaign recommendation, analysing performance data, prioritising Digital Hub resources, and communicating recommendations to market stakeholders.

title: Performance Marketing Executive (Meta Ads)
description:
**We’re Hiring: Performance Marketing Executive – D2C Fashion (Meta Ads)**

**Location:**
[Area], Bengaluru (Work From Office)

**Experience:**
1.5 – 3 Years

**Salary:**
₹35,000 – ₹40,000/month

**Working Days:**
Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM

**Preferred:**
Immediate joiners or up to 30 days’ notice

**Job description:**

**The Role**

Own the Meta ads for two of our D2C fashion brands,
**Varanchi**
and
**Ila**
, which bring handcrafted Indian wear to customers across India. You'll handle the full cycle: coming up with creative ideas, getting them made, launching, testing and scaling them. You'll manage a significant monthly ad budget across both brands, which we plan to double within the next year.

**How We Work**

Our ad accounts are already running, with campaigns, catalogs and tracking in place. You'll build on what exists and improve it. This is a role where creative thinking matters as much as numbers: the person who runs the ads also helps decide what the ads should say and look like.

You'll report to our Creative Head, who sets the creative direction, and work closely with our designer and cameraman to get creatives made. Managers will review results with you weekly. Day to day, you'll own your accounts: a fit if you like ownership within a clear direction, less so if you want someone checking every campaign change.

This is a full-time, in-office role at our Bengaluru office, Monday to Friday. Remote or hybrid work isn't possible.

**What We Run**

* **Brands:**
  Varanchi and Ila (D2C fashion, handcrafted Indian wear)
* **Platforms:**
  Meta – Facebook & Instagram
* **Ad formats:**
  Catalog/Advantage+, video (Reels, Stories, feed), static and partnership ads
* **Creative production:**
  In-house designer and cameraman, plus our own studio and store for shoots



**What You'll Do**

* Plan budget allocation across the funnel (prospecting, retargeting, retention) and between both brands, and scale spend profitably
* Launch and manage sales campaigns across all our ad formats
* Monitor delivery, pacing and spend daily, and optimise for ROAS, purchases and cost per purchase, pausing what's not working and scaling what is
* Find scaling opportunities through audience expansion, retargeting and lookalikes
* QA every launch: creatives, tracking links, audiences and conversion events
* Come up with a steady stream of ad ideas, drawing on regular competitor monitoring through Meta Ad Library and Instagram. We're building toward testing around 10 unique creatives per ad set
* Write ad copies, hooks and video scripts, and brief our designer and cameraman to get creatives made on time
* Plan festive and seasonal campaigns (Diwali, weddings, Onam, Pongal and more), including ad shoots in our studio and store
* Work with our purchase and production teams so the products performing well in ads stay in stock and get restocked on time
* Run a creative testing calendar and share a weekly report on results, learnings and next steps



**Must-Have**

* 1.5+ years of hands-on Meta Ads experience on sales/conversion campaigns for e-commerce or D2C brands, managing monthly budgets of ₹4 lakh or more
* Proven track record of scaling brand campaigns
* Strong knowledge of campaign structures, audiences (custom and lookalike), bidding strategies, Meta Pixel and Events Manager
* A good eye for scroll-stopping creatives and strong writing skills for ad copy and scripts
* Experience briefing designers or video teams to get ad creatives made
* Clear communication and reporting: you can explain what happened, why, and what you'll do next
* Strong ownership mindset and attention to detail



**Nice-to-Have (learnable)**

* Fashion or ethnic wear experience
* Experience with catalog, partnership and video ads
* Experience planning photo or video shoots
* Knowledge of WhatsApp marketing (broadcasts, remarketing, click-to-WhatsApp ads)
* Regional language skills for ad copy
* As you settle in, you'll also get the chance to help shape our upcoming creator program.

title: Senior Marketing Manager
description:
**Experience: 7+ Years**

**Reporting To: Chief Revenue Officer (CRO)**

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Senior Marketing Manager**
to work closely with our CRO and Sales Leadership team and take ownership of key marketing initiatives at Techademy.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who understands B2B marketing, brand building, demand generation, content, events, social media, and customer marketing.

The person will work closely with the CRO to identify and execute marketing initiatives that strengthen Techademy's brand, support sales, improve market visibility, and create opportunities for customer acquisition.

We are looking for someone who can think strategically but is equally comfortable getting things done — whether that means identifying the right industry event, managing our LinkedIn presence, developing a customer case study, working with Sales on a campaign, or coordinating with external partners and agencies.

Apply Link - https://forms.gle/NVfkg9VTycwW9iyf7

**What You'll Do**

1.
**Brand & Market Presence**

* Help strengthen and grow Techademy's brand presence across relevant B2B, technology, HR, L&D and enterprise communities.
* Develop and execute initiatives that increase brand awareness and visibility among our target customers.
* Identify relevant industry conversations, trends, platforms, communities and opportunities where Techademy should have a presence.
* Ensure consistent messaging and positioning across marketing channels and customer-facing materials.
* Conduct market and competitor research to identify new opportunities for brand and market positioning.
* Help build Techademy's voice and presence across relevant digital and industry platforms.

2.
**Events & Industry Presence**

* Identify and evaluate industry conferences, events, roundtables, webinars, forums and sponsorship opportunities that Techademy should participate in.
* Build an annual/quarterly event calendar based on target industries, customers and business priorities.
* Work with the CRO and Sales team to decide which events are worth investing in.
* Manage event participation end-to-end, including planning, messaging, collateral, speakers, customer participation and post-event follow-up.
* Look for opportunities for Techademy leaders to speak, participate in panels, moderate discussions or build thought leadership at relevant industry events.
* Track the effectiveness of events and recommend where we should increase, reduce or change our investment.

3.
**Social Media & Content**

* Own and manage Techademy's key social media channels, particularly LinkedIn.
* Develop and maintain a content calendar aligned with business priorities, industry trends and company initiatives.
* Work with internal teams to create content around customers, leadership, industry insights, products, events and company updates.
* Coordinate with designers, content creators and external agencies where required.
* Monitor engagement and performance and continuously improve our content strategy.
* Build a stronger executive and leadership presence on social platforms where relevant.

4.
**Customer Marketing & Sales Support**

* Work closely with Sales to identify opportunities to showcase our customers and success stories.
* Own the development of customer testimonials, case studies, success stories, customer videos and other advocacy content.
* Work with Sales teams to identify strong customer stories and turn them into compelling marketing assets.
* Develop sales collateral, presentations, brochures, one-pagers and other materials that help Sales communicate Techademy's value proposition.
* Support Sales with marketing campaigns and initiatives focused on target accounts and customer acquisition.
* Understand what Sales teams need from Marketing and ensure the right content and support are available.

5.
**Demand Generation & Campaigns**

* Plan and execute marketing campaigns that support brand awareness, lead generation and customer acquisition.
* Work with the CRO and Sales team to identify priority industries, accounts, personas and markets.
* Support targeted campaigns around specific industries, solutions, customer segments or business priorities.
* Work with relevant partners and agencies to execute digital campaigns, email campaigns, webinars and other demand-generation initiatives.
* Track campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve engagement and lead generation.
* Help build a more structured and measurable marketing engine over time.

6.
**CRO & Leadership Projects**

* Work closely with the CRO on strategic marketing and business initiatives.
* Take ownership of special projects that require research, market understanding, content, campaigns or external engagement.
* Prepare marketing plans, presentations and recommendations for leadership.
* Research new markets, industries, customer segments, partnerships and marketing opportunities.
* Help translate business priorities from the CRO and Sales leadership into practical marketing initiatives.
* Be comfortable taking an idea from "we should do this" to planning, execution and measurement.

7.
**Global Marketing Exposure**

* Support marketing initiatives across India and international/global markets as Techademy expands its presence.
* Understand the differences in messaging, channels, events, content and customer engagement across different markets.
* Bring global B2B marketing best practices into Techademy's marketing initiatives.
* Adapt campaigns and content for different geographies and audiences where required.
* Experience working with global teams, customers or markets will be strongly preferred.

**What We're Looking For**

* **7+ years of experience**
  in B2B Marketing, Brand Marketing, Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Content Marketing or a similar role.
* Strong understanding of B2B marketing and enterprise customer audiences.
* Experience working closely with Sales and senior business leaders.
* Strong experience in managing LinkedIn and other social media channels for a B2B organization.
* Experience planning and executing events, conferences, webinars, roundtables or industry initiatives.
* Strong content and communication skills with the ability to create or manage high-quality marketing content.
* Experience developing case studies, customer testimonials and sales collateral.
* Good understanding of demand generation and marketing campaigns.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects from start to finish.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management and presentation skills.

title: Junior Performance Marketing Executive
description:
Junior Performance Marketing Executive

Permanent Role

About Akriveia Technologies!

We are a performance-driven digital marketing agency specializing in creating impactful campaigns that deliver measurable results. Our approach combines data-driven strategies with creative excellence to achieve outcomes that truly matter.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Junior Performance Marketing Executive to run and optimize Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns focused on quality lead generation for our clients, who are mainly in the real estate vertical. You’ll manage day-to-day campaign activity, track performance, and support the team with analysis and reporting. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with lead gen campaigns, a sharp eye for data, and a strong drive to learn and grow into a senior role.

Key Responsibilities

Campaign Setup & Management

Set up, launch, and manage lead generation campaigns on Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen) and Meta Ads (lead forms, website conversions, WhatsApp/click-to-message). Work with ad copy, creatives, audiences, and landing pages to meet client goals under the guidance of senior team members.

Campaign Optimization

Monitor campaigns daily and make data-backed optimizations across budgets, bids, keywords, audiences, placements, and creatives. Focus on improving CPL and lead quality, not just lead volume.

Audience & Keyword Research

Build and refine audience segments (custom, lookalike, interest-based) on Meta, and conduct keyword research, negative keyword management, and search term analysis on Google. Support competitor research for real estate projects and micro-markets.

Lead Quality & Tracking

Ensure conversion tracking is set up correctly (Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, Conversions API, GA4). Coordinate with clients and sales teams to gather lead feedback and use it to improve targeting and campaign quality.

Reporting & Client Communication

Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports using dashboards and spreadsheets. Share clear campaign updates and insights with the team and clients, with support from seniors on strategy discussions.

A/B Testing & Learning

Run structured tests on ad copy, creatives, audiences, and landing pages. Document learnings and stay updated on new features and best practices on Google and Meta.

Collaboration

Work closely with creative, content, and SEO teams to align ads with landing pages and messaging. Take feedback well and share ideas in team discussions.

Qualifications

2 to 3 years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns, preferably for lead generation

Detail-oriented, organized, and able to handle multiple accounts at once

Experience in real estate or other high-ticket lead gen verticals is a big plus

Good understanding of key metrics like CPL, CTR, CPC, CVR, and lead quality indicators

Working knowledge of Google Analytics (GA4), Google Tag Manager, and Meta Events Manager

Strong analytical skills and comfort working with spreadsheets and reporting tools (Looker Studio or similar)

Clear written and verbal communication

Familiarity with CRM tools or lead management systems is a plus

title: Social Media Content Creator
description:
**Content Creator (Full time in office role not for freelancers)**

We’re a design-led luxury consumer brand
looking for a person who can manage our social's and also be the face of our social media pages. If you are someone who understands aesthetics and luxury with good communication skill this role is for you.

**Note:**
**We only accept candidates who already have built / grown a brand or their own public profile on social media.**

**What you’ll do:**

* Script, shoot and edit short-form videos (reels, carousels, stories) for our Instagram, mostly on a phone
* Write hooks and captions in a hushed, intimate brand voice, short copy with space around it, never loud or salesy
* Track trending reel formats and adapt the winning ones to our brand
* Turn one idea into many pieces: the main video, behind-the-scenes, reactions, bloopers, story-times, different hooks
* Handle posting, scheduling and a simple weekly look at what worked (reach, watch time, saves, shares)
* Work directly with the founder to plan the content calendar and you will also be creating content for the founder's handle as well.

**What we’re looking for:**

* A real Instagram page, personal or brand, with reels you made yourself (we will look at your hooks, pacing and editing)
* Someone who will be the face of our brand for social pages and don't mind appearing on the content.
* Hands-on video editing in CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or similar
* Strong scripting and copywriting sense: you know why a reel gets watched in the first 2 seconds
* A feel for luxury and emotion-led storytelling, not discounts and hard-sell
* Comfortable shooting with basic light, a phone and a tripod
* Curious about trends, formats and what makes people share a video
* **Must have: Good Communication Skills (English)**
* Optional: motion graphics, voiceover, photography, Canva or Photoshop

**Who we are looking for:**
 0-2 years of experience in creating content around fashion & lifestyle.

**Location:**
 In-office, West Mambalam, Chennai (Not remote / hybrid)

**Engagement:**

* First 3 months are an internship/probation period
* Role becomes permanent with a salary hike upon successful completion
* Growth opportunities for early team members as the company scales

**Perks:**

* 5-day work week
* 10 AM to 7 PM working hours
* Monthly team outing
* Real creative ownership: your reels go live on our page, not into a large company’s approval queue
* Direct mentorship and close collaboration with the founding team, not buried under layers of management
* Casual, no-hierarchy work culture, your input genuinely shapes decisions
* A strong, portfolio-worthy body of work from a real brand launch
* Standard sick/casual leave

**How to apply:**
 Email buildinguravu@gmail.com with (1) your Instagram handle or 3 reel links you made, and (2) one reel idea for a luxury gift brand: the hook, and the first 3 lines of the script.

**Job Summary**
