Provides day to day leadership to sales associates to achieve property sales objectives with overall responsibility for achieving booking goals and property revenues. Implements the brand’s service strategy and applicable brand initiatives in all aspects of the sales process and focuses on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of the hotel’s’ sales objectives. Evaluates the property’s participation in the various sales channels (e.g., Area Sales, Group Sales within the Sales Office, electronic lead channels, etc.) and develops strong working relationships to proactively position and market the property. Manages the marketing budget to enable development of property specific campaigns, promotions and collateral to drive revenue and meet property objectives. Interfaces with regional marketing communications for regional and national promotions pull through. Develops and implements property–wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target customer profile and property associates and provides a return on investment to the owner and Marriott International.
  
  
**CANDIDATE PROFILE**
**Education And Experience**
**Required:**

* 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

OR
  
  

* 4-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

**Preferred:**

* 4 year college degree.
* Demonstrated skills in supervising a team.
* Lodging sales experience.
* Hotel industry work experience, demonstrating progressive career growth and a pattern of exceptional performance.

**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**
**Managing Sales Activities**

* Manages the development of a strategic account plan for the demand generators in the market.
* Manages the property's reactive and proactive sales efforts.
* Determines and develops marketing communication activities, in conjunction with Regional Marketing Communications.
* Provides customer intelligence in evaluating the market and economic trends that may lead to changes in sales strategy to meet or exceed customer expectations.
* Reviews the Strategic Alignment Review (STAR) report, competitive shopping reports and uses other resources to maintain an awareness of the hotel’s market position.
* Researches competitor’s sales team strategies to identify ways to grow occupancy and RevPAR and increase market share.
* Attends sales strategy meetings to provide input on weekly and overall sales strategy.
* Suggests innovative marketing ideas and develops deployment strategies to continue to grow market share.
* Evaluates and supports participation and account deployment with Area Sales and Group Sales within the Sales Office.
* Serves as the sales contact for the General Manager, property leadership team, Group Sales and Area Sales leaders.
* Serves as the sales contact for customers; serves as the customer advocate.
* Serves as hotel authority on sales processes and sales contracts.
* Serves as the property sales liaison with Area Sales, Group Sales, Revenue Management, Event Management, Regional Marketing Communications and other hotel departments as appropriate.
* Participates in sales calls with members of the Sales and Marketing team to acquire new business and/or close on business.
* Identifies public relations opportunities and coordinates activities to augment the overall marketing communication strategy.
* Supports the General Manager by coordinating crisis communications.
* Executes and supports Marriott’s Customer Service Standards and hotel’s Brand Standards.
* Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (e.g., generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).
* Participates in and practices daily service basics of the brand (e.g., , Marriott Hotels and Resorts (MHR) Spirit to Serve Daily Basics, Renaissance Hotels and Resorts (RHR) Savvy Service Basics, Courtyard, SpringHill Suites, Fairfield Inn Basics of the Day, Residence Inn Daily Huddle, or TownePlace Suites Morning Meeting).
* Implements a seamless turnover from sales to operations and back to sales while consistently delivering high level of service.
* Monitors the effective resolution of guest issues that arise as a result of the sales process by creating mechanisms to channel issues to property leadership and/or other appropriate stakeholders.
* Maintains successful performance by increasing revenues, controlling expenses and providing a return on investment for the owner and Marriott International.
* Implements the brand’s service strategy and applicable brand initiatives in all aspects of the sales process and focuses on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of the hotel’s’ sales objectives.
* Interfaces with regional marketing communications for regional and national promotions pull through.
* Performs other duties, as assigned, to meet business needs.

**Building Successful Relationships**

* Develops strong partnerships with local organizations to further increase brand/product awareness.
* Develops and manages internal key stakeholder relationships.
* Develops strong community and public relations by maintaining property participation in local, regional and national tradeshows and client events.
* Executes exemplary customer service to drive customer satisfaction and loyalty by assisting the customer and monitoring their satisfaction before and during their program/event.
* Serves the customer by understanding their needs and recommending the appropriate features and services that best meet their needs and exceed their expectations, while building a relationship and loyalty to Marriott.
* Gains understanding of the hotel’s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution both prior to, and during the program/event.

**Leadership**

* Functions as the leader of the property’s sales department for properties with bookings over 300 peak rooms and significant local catering revenue.
* Develops sales goals and strategies and verifies alignment with the brand business strategy.
* Executes the sales strategy in order to meet individual booking goals for both self and staff.
* Coaches leaders of revenue generating departments in developing effective revenue strategies and setting aggressive goals that will drive the property's financial performance.
* Verifies Sales team understands and is leveraging Marriott International (MI) demand engines to full potential.
* Works with Human Resources, Engineering and Loss Prevention to monitor compliance with local, state and federal regulations and/or union requirements.
* Partners with Human Resources to attract, develop and retain the right people in order to support the strategic priorities of the market.
* Creates effective structures, processes, jobs and performance management systems are in place.
* Sets goals and expectations for direct reports using the Leadership Performance Process (LPP), aligns performance and rewards, addresses performance issues and holds staff accountable for successful results.
* Forecasts talent needs and manages talent acquisition strategy with Human Resources (HR) to minimize lost time due to turnover.
* Maintains an active list of the competition’s best sales people and executes a recruitment and acquisition plan with HR.
* Supports tools and training resources to educate sales associates on winning catering solutions.
* Champions leadership development and workforce planning priorities by assessing, selecting, retaining and developing diverse, high-caliber talent that can lead the organization today and strengthen the leadership bench for the future; continues to upgrade the sales & marketing talent; works with HR to anticipate future talent needs based on business growth plans.
* Identifies, trains and mentors group sales associates; utilizes all available on the job training tools for associates.
* Transfers functional knowledge and develops group sales skills of other discipline managers.
* Provides day to day leadership to sales associates to achieve property sales objectives with overall responsibility for achieving booking goals and property revenues.
* Evaluates the property’s participation in the various sales channels (e.g., Area Sales, Group Sales within the Sales Office, electronic lead channels, etc.) and develops strong working relationships to proactively position and market the property.
* Manages the marketing budget to enable development of property specific campaigns, promotions and collateral to drive revenue and meet property objectives.

title: Manager - Entertainment PRS, Tamil GEC
description:
* Job Summary This is a team management and revenue enablement role in the Product & Revenue Strategy Function. This position is required to work with the Sales team to support part of the business of the respective cluster/ language . The incumbent will act as a key link between Programming/Content team and Sales teams and drive the brand philosophy and sales/revenue strategy for the channel to maximize revenue. This will be done through effective forecasting, planning, pricing and property integrations based on deep understanding of customer needs and patterns.

The incumbent will play a critical role in developing a comprehensive roadmap and vision for our business, studying industry-specific trends, and creating compelling narratives to drive monetization growth. This role requires a strategic thinker with strong analytical and communication skills, as well as the ability to navigate complex organizational dynamics.
  
  
**About The Team**
The PRS teams drive the brand philosophy and sales/revenue strategy for the channel to maximize revenue by optimizing inventory. This is achieved through effective forecasting, planning, pricing, and property integrations based on a deep understanding of customer needs and patterns.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities
* Creating revenue business plan across portfolio, defining the pricing strategy along with the Channel PRS Head for the channel/cluster basis organization objectives, budget for the year, market scenario, competition, etc. in order to ensure the sales organization achieves overall revenue target.
* Driving the channel pricing agenda - setting benchmarks, providing inputs and sign-offs on deals, and participating in deal negotiations as and when required
* Build client wise strategy/ deal structuring for the channel which includes creating and recommending client pricing options for individual client deals, building monthly client packages including decisions on what time bands to allocate to each client based on what works for their target segments and track deviations in delivery
* Build sponsor packages for impact shows and ensure maximum monetization for each property on the channel
* Build band wise revenue budget, show and property wise pricing including determination of sponsor packages
* Create and maintain strategies based on key genres to help understand the genre behavior, trends, movements etc. that may have impact on business.
* Building bottom-up revenue plans for the fiscal, quarter & month
* Tracking performance vs. annual plan, revising forecasts etc.

title: Content Production Specialist
description:
**Presidio, Where Teamwork and Innovation Shape the Future**
At Presidio, we're at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting-edge digital solutions and next-generation AI. We empower businesses - and their internal customers - to achieve more through innovation, automation, and intelligent insights.
  
  
**The Role**
Presidio is seeking a detail-oriented and productive
**Content Production Specialist**
to build, style, and maintain content pages and experiences within our Showpad enablement platform. This is a hands-on production role: the primary, day-to-day activity is the accurate and efficient creation of Showpad pages — laying out graphics, formatting copy, uploading and tagging assets, and assembling clean, on-brand, easy-to-navigate experiences for our sales and technical teams.
  
  
The ideal candidate is fast, reliable, and has a good eye for visual layout. Deep sales enablement strategy experience is not required — Showpad is learnable within a few days, and success in this role is measured by output quality, consistency, and speed. We are looking for someone personable, organized, and quick to get up to speed, who takes pride in producing polished pages at volume.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include**

* Page Creation & Layout (Primary Activity): Build and style Showpad pages — arranging graphics, images, text, and links into clean, consistent, on-brand layouts. This is the core, high-volume function of the role.
* Content Entry & Assembly: Upload, place, and organize content assets (PDFs, decks, videos, images) into pages and experiences accurately and at pace, including frequent copy-paste and formatting work.
* Graphics & Visual Formatting: Place, crop, resize, and align graphics and thumbnails; apply basic image edits so pages look professional and adhere to Presidio brand standards.
* Tagging & Organization: Apply the established tagging/metadata taxonomy so content is categorized correctly and easy to find; keep folder structures and page navigation tidy and logical.
* Navigation & Experience Structure: Assemble and update page navigation, sections, and experiences so sellers and technical staff can move through content quickly and intuitively.
* Quality & Consistency: Proofread and QA pages before publishing — checking links, formatting, spelling, image quality, and brand consistency — to ensure a polished end result.
* Content Maintenance: Keep pages current: swap outdated assets, fix broken links, archive retired material, and action update requests promptly.
* Turnaround & Volume: Manage a steady queue of production requests, prioritize effectively, and deliver a high volume of pages on schedule.
* Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with enablement, marketing, and content owners to understand requests, ask clarifying questions, and confirm final output meets expectations.

**Required Skills And Professional Experience**

* Demonstrable production efficiency: Proven ability to produce digital pages, layouts, or content at volume with speed and accuracy. A portfolio or work samples showing Showpad pages (or comparable web/CMS/DAM/slide layouts) is strongly valued.
* Strong visual and layout sense: A good eye for spacing, alignment, image placement, and clean, professional-looking pages.
* Comfort with content platforms and tools: Ease working in web-based content platforms, CMS, DAM, or presentation tools; quick to learn new software (Showpad proficiency is expected within days, not months).
* Attention to detail: Meticulous about formatting, brand consistency, spelling, and link accuracy.
* Comfort with repetitive, high-volume work: Able to stay accurate and efficient across frequent copy-paste, upload, and formatting tasks.
* Basic graphics ability: Comfortable cropping, resizing, and lightly editing images (e.g., Canva, Figma, or Adobe Creative Cloud basics).
* Organization and follow-through: Able to manage a request queue, prioritize, and meet deadlines with minimal supervision.
* Personable and collaborative: Clear communicator who works well with content owners and stakeholders and asks good questions.
* Fast learner: Gets up to speed quickly on new platforms and processes and applies feedback rapidly.

**Preferred Skills And Professional Experience**

* Hands-on Showpad experience (Content, Experiences, Pages) or experience with a comparable enablement platform such as Highspot or Seismic.
* Showpad Professional certification (Content Administrator) or willingness to earn it.
* Experience with digital asset management and content tagging/taxonomy.
* Familiarity with brand guideline application across templated content.
* Basic graphic design or production design background.
* Experience supporting sales, marketing, or enablement teams.
* A college degree is preferred but not required. We prioritize demonstrable efficiency and quality in producing Showpad (or comparable) pages over formal credentials. Relevant experience, a strong work sample portfolio, and speed-to-proficiency carry the most weight.

**Your future at Presidio**
Joining Presidio means stepping into a culture of trailblazers - thinkers, builders, and collaborators - who push the boundaries of what's possible. With our expertise AI-driven analytics, cloud solutions, cybersecurity, and next-gen infrastructure, we enable businesses to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital world.
  
  
Here, your impact is real. Whether you're harnessing the power of Generative AI, architecting resilient digital ecosystems, or driving data-driven transformation, you'll be part of a team that is shaping the future.
  
  
**Ready to innovate? Let's redefine what's next-together.**
**About Presidio**
Presidio is committed to hiring the most qualified candidates to join our amazing culture. We aim to attract and hire top talent from all backgrounds, including underrepresented and marginalized communities. We encourage women, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans to apply for open roles at Presidio. Diversity of skills and thought is a key component to our business success.
  
  
At Presidio, speed and quality meet technology and innovation. Presidio is a trusted ally for organizations across industries with a decades-long history of building traditional IT foundations and deep expertise in AI and automation, security, networking, digital transformation, and cloud computing. Presidio fills gaps, removes hurdles, optimizes costs, and reduces risk. Presidio's expert technical team develops custom applications, provides managed services, and enables actionable data insights and builds forward-thinking solutions that drive strategic outcomes for clients globally. For more information visit https://presidio.com
  
  
*Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis.*
*Presidio has a strong commitment to the community we serve and our employees. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we strive to have a workforce that includes the community we serve.*

Presidio does not accept unsolicited agency resumes/CVs. Do not forward resumes/CVs to our career's email address, Presidio employees or any other means. Presidio is not responsible for any feeds related to unsolicited resumes/CVs.*

title: Apprenticeship Placement Coordinator
description:
**Company Description**
Logistics Sector Skill Council (LSC) is a not-for-profit organization registered under Section 8 of the Indian Companies Act, 2013, established by the Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship (MSDE), National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC), and the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII). LSC focuses on developing skill-trained human resources at entry level and upskilling the existing logistics workforce across India. It collaborates with industry partners, government bodies, training providers, and academic institutions to identify skill gaps and design targeted training programs. LSC is an approved awarding body of NCVET and operates flagship e-learning portals, including Online Certificate Programmes and an Executive Development Center, to support continuous professional development in the logistics sector.
  
**Role Description**
The Apprenticeship Placement Coordinator is a full-time, on-site role based in Chennai, responsible for managing and supporting apprenticeship placements within the logistics sector. The role includes engaging with industry partners to identify apprenticeship opportunities, coordinating with training providers and academic institutions, and matching candidates to suitable placements. The coordinator will guide learners through the placement process, provide pre-placement orientation, and address queries or concerns from both candidates and employers. Daily activities involve maintaining placement records, monitoring apprenticeship progress, supporting compliance with relevant standards and guidelines, and preparing reports and updates for internal stakeholders. The role also requires building long-term relationships with employers to expand apprenticeship networks and promote LSC’s training and e-learning initiatives.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Interpersonal Skills to build and maintain relationships with learners, employers, and training partners.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills, including clear verbal and written communication for coordinating placements and preparing reports.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service skills to provide responsive support to apprentices and employer partners throughout the placement lifecycle.
* Candidates should possess Education-related skills or experience, such as working with training programs, academic institutions, or vocational education initiatives.
* Candidates should possess Recruiting skills, including candidate screening, matching profiles to roles, and coordinating interviews or selection processes.
* Relevant qualifications may include a bachelor’s degree in logistics, business, education, human resources, or a related field.
* Knowledge of the logistics sector and apprenticeship frameworks in India is highly beneficial.
* Ability to work with digital tools, learning management systems, and MS Office for documentation and reporting.
* Demonstrated organizational skills and attention to detail for managing multiple placements and stakeholder interactions.

title: Content Manager
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

**JOB PURPOSE**

  

We are looking for a highly driven **Digital Content & Influencer Marketing Manager** who can build brands through compelling content, creator partnerships, and social-first storytelling. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience managing influencer campaigns at scale, creating high-performing digital content, driving social media engagement, and collaborating with media teams to amplify content performance.

This role requires a blend of creativity, cultural awareness, analytical thinking, and strong execution skills to deliver measurable business impact across the marketing funnel.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

  

**Influencer Marketing**

* Lead end-to-end influencer marketing programs across Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and emerging platforms.
* Build and manage a diverse network of creators, influencers, celebrities, and domain experts.
* Identify, evaluate, and shortlist influencers based on audience fit, engagement, relevance, and campaign objectives.
* Execute large-scale influencer campaigns involving macro, micro, nano, and regional creators.
* Negotiate partnerships and manage agency relationships.
* Develop influencer briefs, content guidelines, and approval workflows.
Measure campaign effectiveness through reach, engagement, video views, sentiment, search lift, traffic, and conversions.  

**Content Strategy & Creation**

* Develop platform-first content strategies tailored to consumer behavior and business objectives.
* Create and manage content calendars across social and digital channels.
* Drive production of reels, short-form videos, static creatives, creator collaborations, and branded content.
* Translate consumer insights, trends, and cultural moments into engaging content ideas.
Ensure content aligns with brand voice, category regulations, and marketing priorities.  

  

**Social Media Management**

* Manage brand presence across social platforms.
* Monitor trends, conversations, and emerging content formats.
* Work closely with community management teams to drive engagement and advocacy.
Track social performance and continuously optimize content strategies.  

  

**Media & Content Amplification**

* Partner with media teams to drive content distribution and performance.
* Understand paid media fundamentals across Meta, YouTube, Google, and programmatic platforms.
* Recommend content amplification strategies including creator whitelisting, partnership ads, and paid social.
Leverage media insights to improve content effectiveness and audience targeting.  

  

**Analytics & Reporting**

* Establish clear KPIs for influencer and content campaigns.
* Analyze campaign performance and generate actionable insights.
* Monitor competitor activities, creator landscape, and industry trends.
Present performance reports and recommendations to key stakeholders.  

  

**Why you?**
============

  

**Basic Qualifications**

  

We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:

  

* 4-5 years of experience in Digital Marketing, Content Marketing, Social Media, or Influencer Marketing.
* Proven track record of executing influencer campaigns at scale.
* Strong understanding of the Indian creator ecosystem.
* Excellent knowledge of Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and emerging social platforms.
* Understanding of social media algorithms, content formats, and platform best practices.
* Familiarity with paid media and content amplification strategies.
* Experience with social listening and influencer discovery tools.
* Strong storytelling, copywriting, and communication skills.
* Proficiency in analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Meta Business Suite, YouTube Analytics, etc.
Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, agencies, and projects simultaneously.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:

  

* Experience in FMCG, Consumer Healthcare, Consumer Tech, Beauty, or Lifestyle categories.
* Experience working with influencer marketing platforms and measurement tools.
* Familiarity with AI-powered content creation tools.
* Exposure to performance marketing and commerce-led content.
Brand /Agency side experience  

  

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

  

A social-first marketer who understands that great content, the right creators, and smart media amplification work together to drive brand growth. Equally comfortable discussing a reel concept, influencer shortlist, KPI framework, or media optimization plan.

  

**Job Posting End Date**

2026-11-12  

**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  
  
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
----------------------------------------

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

**Note to candidates**
----------------------

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: Senior Omnichannel Experience Design & Channel Manager
description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Purpose of the Role**
Lead the design, execution, and optimization of omnichannel engagement strategies that enhance HCP experience, improve commercial effectiveness, and drive measurable business outcomes. The role will partner closely with Marketing, Sales, Medical, and Commercial Excellence teams to translate business priorities into impactful customer journeys and scalable omnichannel programs.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Omnichannel Strategy & Experience Design**

* Define and evolve omnichannel engagement frameworks aligned to business priorities.
* Design customer-centric journeys using HCP insights, channel preferences, and engagement data.
* Drive personalization, segmentation, and next-best-action initiatives.

**Campaign Planning & Orchestration**

* Translate brand objectives into integrated omnichannel campaigns.
* Ensure seamless orchestration across field, digital, events, remote engagement, and content channels.
* Drive campaign reviews and continuous optimization based on performance insights.

**Analytics & Performance Management**

* Generate actionable insights from customer behavior, channel performance, and campaign outcomes.
* Identify improvement opportunities and drive execution of optimization plans.

**Channel & Capability Excellence**

* Lead deployment of new engagement capabilities, tools, and ways of working.
* Partner with global and local stakeholders to bring best practices and innovation into the market.

**Stakeholder & Team Leadership**

* Act as a strategic partner to Brand, Sales, Medical, and Leadership teams.
* Manage cross-functional priorities and ensure delivery excellence.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 8-12 years in Omnichannel, Digital Marketing, Commercial Excellence, Customer Experience, CRM, or Analytics.
* Strong analytical, stakeholder management, and project leadership skills.
* Experience in Pharma, Healthcare, or other customer-centric industries preferred.

**Critical Competencies**

* Customer Centricity
* Strategic Thinking
* Data & Analytics Mindset
* Execution Excellence
* Cross-functional Influence
* Digital Innovation
* People Leadership
* Culture Ambassador

**Skills**
Business Acumen, Customer Experience (CX), Data to Insights, Digital Fluency, Digital Marketing, Product Lifecycle, Scientific Literacy
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

title: HR Recruiter
description:
HR Recruiter / HR Executive – Job Description & Responsibilities

For Facilities Management (IFM) and Pest Control Services – Acuity Groups LLP, Bengaluru

1. Job Title and Role Overview

Job Title: HR Recruiter / HR Executive Department: Human Resources Industry: Integrated Facilities Management (IFM), Housekeeping, Security, Technical Services and Pest Control Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka Reporting To: HR Manager / Management

Job Purpose: To manage end-to-end recruitment, manpower deployment, employee documentation, attendance, onboarding, and HR operations for facilities management and pest control services, ensuring timely deployment of suitable employees at client sites.

2. Key Jobs and ResponsibilitiesA. Recruitment and Manpower Planning

* Handle end-to-end recruitment for housekeeping staff, security guards, security supervisors, technicians, pest control technicians, helpers, field officers and other office staff.
* Source candidates through job portals, WhatsApp groups, referrals, walk-ins and field recruitment.
* Coordinate with operations managers and site supervisors to understand manpower requirements.
* Screen resumes, conduct initial interviews and arrange management or client interviews where required.
* Verify candidate experience, salary expectations, availability and joining dates.
* Maintain a daily recruitment tracker showing vacancies, candidates contacted, interviews, selections and joining status.
* Follow up with selected candidates to ensure they join on the committed date.
* Maintain a ready pool of candidates for urgent and replacement requirements.
* Meet weekly and monthly recruitment targets based on approved manpower requirements.

B. Facilities Management (IFM) Recruitment

* Recruit housekeeping staff, supervisors, security guards, technicians and multi-skilled technicians for client locations.
* Coordinate manpower deployment for apartments, commercial buildings, offices, warehouses, retail outlets and other client sites.
* Arrange replacement staff for absenteeism, resignations and client complaints.
* Coordinate with site supervisors to confirm attendance, shift requirements and vacancies.
* Ensure candidates understand their duties, working hours, salary, weekly offs and site location before joining.
* Monitor joining status and confirm successful deployment with the operations team.

C. Pest Control Recruitment and Coordination

* Recruit pest control technicians, helpers, field supervisors and business development staff.
* Ensure candidates understand pest control duties, fieldwork requirements and client-site responsibilities.
* Coordinate technician deployment according to daily service schedules and client requirements.
* Arrange replacement technicians when employees are absent or leave the organization.
* Coordinate with the operations team to ensure technicians receive the required uniforms and personal protective equipment (PPE), such as masks, gloves, goggles and safety shoes.
* Maintain records of technician training, safety induction and attendance.
* Follow up with operations regarding client complaints, technician conduct and service quality issues.

D. Employee Onboarding and Documentation

* Collect and verify employee documents, including Aadhaar, PAN, bank details, photographs, address proof and previous employment records where applicable.
* Prepare appointment letters, offer letters, joining forms, employee ID cards and employee files.
* Explain company policies, salary structure, attendance rules, leave policies and notice periods.
* Coordinate employee induction and site-specific training.
* Maintain an updated employee master database with contact details, job role, salary, joining date and deployment location.
* Track pending documents and follow up with employees for completion.

E. Attendance, Payroll and Employee Records

* Collect attendance and overtime details from site supervisors.
* Verify absenteeism, weekly offs, leave records, replacements and new joiners before payroll processing.
* Coordinate with accounts and management for salary inputs, deductions, advances and full-and-final settlements.
* Maintain records relating to PF, ESI, insurance and other applicable employee benefits.
* Track salary-related queries and coordinate timely resolution.
* Maintain proper records of resignations, absconding employees, notice periods and employee exits.

F. Statutory Compliance and HR Administration

* Coordinate applicable PF, ESI, professional tax, labour law and other statutory documentation with the concerned team.
* Maintain employee records and supporting documents for audits and inspections.
* Track employee insurance enrolment and renewal requirements.
* Ensure recruitment and employment documentation follows applicable company policies and legal requirements.
* Escalate compliance gaps or missing employee records to management.

G. Employee Relations and Retention

* Handle employee queries regarding salaries, attendance, leave, benefits and workplace concerns.
* Coordinate with supervisors to resolve manpower and employee discipline issues.
* Conduct follow-up calls with new joiners to improve retention.
* Monitor absenteeism, early attrition and employees who fail to report for duty.
* Coordinate exit formalities, company asset recovery and clearance processes.
* Maintain professional communication with employees, candidates and site management.

H. HR MIS and Reporting

Prepare and submit daily, weekly and monthly HR reports covering:

* Vacancy and manpower status.
* Candidates contacted, screened, interviewed and selected.
* Joining and deployment status.
* Recruitment source and hiring cost, where tracked.
* Employee attendance, absenteeism and attrition.
* Pending employee documentation.
* PF, ESI and insurance documentation status.
* Resignations, replacements and full-and-final settlements.
* Recruitment performance against assigned targets.

Established in 2010, NCAA is a 95-bed residential dementia care facility providing person-centred care to elders across all stages of dementia. Our multidisciplinary team strives to ensure that every resident receives care with dignity, empathy, respect and professional excellence.

We are looking for a dynamic leader who has a genuine passion for elder care and proven experience in managing residential care homes, preferably those catering to elders living with dementia.

**The Role**

The Centre Manager will be responsible for the overall clinical coordination, administration and operational management of the centre, ensuring high standards of resident care, effective team performance and a safe, supportive and dignified living environment.

Key Responsibilities

· **Clinical Care & Quality :** Oversee care delivery, individualised care plans, resident assessments and the implementation of person-centred dementia care practices.

· **Centre Operations:** Manage the day-to-day functioning of the facility, ensure efficient utilisation of resources and maintain appropriate occupancy levels.

· **Team Leadership:** Lead, supervise and motivate caregivers, clinical personnel and support staff, fostering a culture of accountability, teamwork and compassion.

· **Resident Engagement:** Ensure meaningful daily activities, psychosocial support and a stimulating, dementia-friendly environment for residents.

· **Medical Coordination:** Coordinate with doctors, psychologists and other healthcare professionals to ensure continuity and quality of care.

· **Family Engagement:** Build trusting relationships with residents’ families, address their concerns and provide guidance on dementia care.

· **Administration & Compliance:** Ensure accurate documentation, adherence to applicable regulations, effective systems and smooth administrative functioning.

· **Continuous Improvement:** Monitor service quality, address operational challenges and introduce improvements that enhance resident wellbeing and organisational effectiveness.

**Who Should Apply?**

We are looking for a professional who brings both competence and compassion to the role.

· A postgraduate qualification in Clinical Psychology or a related field.

· At least five years of relevant professional experience.

· Experience in managing residential care homes, preferably dementia care facilities, will be a strong advantage.

· Sound understanding of dementia, ageing, behavioural and psychological needs, and person-centred care. Proven leadership, staff management, communication and problem-solving skills.

· Ability to balance clinical priorities with administrative, operational and team-management responsibilities.

· A strong commitment to the dignity, rights, safety and wellbeing of older persons.

**Why Join Nightingales Medical Trust?**

· Be part of a well-established and reputed organisation with a longstanding commitment to elder care and dementia services.

· Lead a multidisciplinary team delivering meaningful, person-centred care.

· Make a tangible difference to the lives of elders and provide much-needed support to their families.

description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Role Overview**

The **L2 Application Support Engineer** (Technical Support Analyst) is a critical role within the Production Support and Operations team. This individual is responsible for providing high-quality technical support, troubleshooting, and incident resolution for complex enterprise applications and platforms. Acting as the bridge between L1 Helpdesk/Monitoring teams and L3 Development/Engineering groups, the L2 Engineer ensures system availability, stability, and adherence to strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs) in a fast-paced, enterprise technology environment.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Incident & Problem Management**

* **Escalation Handling:** Acknowledge and own incidents escalated by the L1 support team or monitoring alerts.
* **Troubleshooting & Diagnosis:** Perform in-depth technical analysis and root cause investigation of application, database, middleware, and infrastructure failures.
* **Workaround Implementation:** Apply approved temporary workarounds or permanent hotfixes to restore services quickly and minimize business impact.
* **Collaboration:** Partner with L3 developers, database administrators (DBAs), network engineers, and system administrators to resolve complex, multi-tiered issues.
* **Incident Lifecycle Management:** Track and document all incident progression within the ITSM platform (e.g., ServiceNow) from creation through to resolution.
  

  

**2. Monitoring, Observability & Preventive Maintenance**

* **System Monitoring:** Actively monitor application health, batch jobs, integration feeds, and system performance using enterprise observability suites.
* **Proactive Interventions:** Identify recurring patterns, error trends, or capacity bottlenecks and initiate preventative actions.
* **Health Checks:** Perform daily health checks, start-of-day (SOD) and end-of-day (EOD) verifications, and batch processing runs.

**3. Release, Deployment & Configuration Management**

* **Deployment Validation:** Support the verification of application deployments, system patches, and infrastructure upgrades during maintenance windows.
* **Configuration Controls:** Maintain and update application configuration files, environment variables, and parameter settings under strict change management processes.
* **Environment Management:** Assist in maintaining non-production (UAT/Staging) and production environments to ensure consistency.

**4. Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* **Status Updates:** Provide clear, timely, and precise communications to business stakeholders, product owners, and technology leadership during critical (Sev-1/Sev-2) incidents.
* **Bridges & War Rooms:** Participate in or lead technical incident bridges to coordinate restoration efforts.
* **Post-Incident Reviews:** Contribute technical inputs to Post-Incident Reviews (PIRs) and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documentation.

**5. Documentation & Knowledge Management**

* **Runbooks & SOPs:** Document and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), application architecture maps, and troubleshooting runbooks.
* **Knowledge Sharing:** Train L1 teams on common issue resolution paths to shift-left workloads and improve first-contact resolution rates.

**Qualifications & Experience**

  
  

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* **Experience:** 8+ years of experience in an application support, technical support, or systems engineering role (preferably in an enterprise or financial services environment).
* **Certifications (Desirable):**
  + ITIL v3 or v4 Foundation certification.
  + Professional certifications in AWS/Azure, Kubernetes (CKAD), Linux Administration, or Oracle/SQL.

**Required Technical Skills**

**Domain**

**Technology / Tooling**

**Operating Systems**

Strong hands-on experience with **Linux/Unix** environments (navigating file systems, checking logs, monitoring CPU/memory, cron jobs) and **Windows Server**.

**Scripting & Automation**

Proficiency in writing and debugging **Shell scripting** (Bash), **PowerShell**, or **Python** to automate daily tasks and analyze log files.

**Databases & Querying**

Strong **SQL** skills (Oracle, MS SQL, Sybase, or PostgreSQL). Ability to write complex select queries, joins, analyze execution plans, and run database scripts.

**Middleware & Web Servers**

Working knowledge of **Apache**, **Tomcat**, **Nginx**, **WebSphere,** and messaging queues like **IBM MQ**, **RabbitMQ**, or **Apache Kafka**.

**Cloud & Containerization**

Familiarity with **Docker**, **Kubernetes**, **OpenShift**, or cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure) concepts and container deployments.

**Monitoring & Logging**

Hands-on experience with tools such as **Splunk**, **ELK Stack**, **AppDynamics**, **Dynatrace**, **Grafana**, or **ITRS Geneos**.

**ITSM & Collaboration**

Experience with ticketing tools like **ServiceNow** or **Jira**, and version control systems like **Git** or Bitbucket.

  
  

**Required Professional & Soft Skills**

We are looking for a creative and execution-driven Video Editor & Graphic Designer to create engaging video and graphic content for our website, social media and digital marketing channels.

The ideal candidate should be skilled in Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe Photoshop, with a strong understanding of video editing, visual composition and social media content.

The role will involve editing Reels, YouTube videos, product videos and promotional content, along with creating engaging graphics for social media and marketing campaigns.

Knowledge of emerging AI tools for image generation, video creation, subtitling and content editing will be an added advantage.

Key Responsibilities

* Edit engaging Instagram Reels, YouTube videos, Shorts and other social media videos.
* Edit product videos for our e-commerce website and digital platforms.
* Create promotional videos for product launches, festivals, campaigns and advertisements.
* Create engaging graphics, posts, stories, banners and other social media creatives.
* Edit raw footage including cutting, transitions, text, subtitles, music and basic effects.
* Resize and adapt video and graphic content for different digital platforms and formats.
* Work closely with the Social Media Manager and Marketing Team to execute creative concepts.
* Maintain consistency in the brand's visual identity, fonts, colours and overall aesthetic.
* Organize and manage video footage, images and other creative assets.
* Use AI-powered creative tools where relevant to improve the quality and efficiency of content production.
* Deliver creative work within defined timelines while managing multiple requirements simultaneously.

Skills & Requirements

* Strong working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro.
* Strong working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop.
* A course or professional certification in Adobe Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Video Editing, Graphic Design or a related field is required.
* Good understanding of video editing, pacing, transitions, typography and visual storytelling.
* Good graphic design and visual composition skills.
* Understanding of social media formats, particularly Instagram Reels and YouTube.
* Ability to work with raw video footage and convert it into polished, engaging content.
* Good attention to detail and ability to follow creative briefs.
* Ability to manage multiple creative requirements and deadlines.

Preferred

* Knowledge of AI image-generation tools.
* Experience using AI video-generation or video-editing tools.
* Experience with AI-powered subtitling and transcription tools.
* Interest or experience in Spirituality, Wellness, Lifestyle, Jewellery, Ecommerce or Product Marketing will be an advantage.

Preferred Experience

1–3 years of relevant experience in Video Editing, Graphic Design or Digital Content Creation.

Candidates with experience creating content for a consumer, e-commerce or product-based brand will be preferred.

Portfolio / Showreel of previous video and design work is mandatory.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Associate Director – HR Business Partner (AD HRBP)
description:
**Associate Director – HR Business Partner (AD HRBP)**

**Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India

**Shift:**
UK Shift (2:00 PM IST – 11:00 PM IST)

**Experience:**
15+ Years

**Department:**
Human Resources Business Partnering

**About Prochant**

Prochant is a leading healthcare revenue cycle management organization delivering technology-enabled solutions and operational excellence to healthcare providers across the United States. We help healthcare organizations optimize revenue cycle performance through expertise in Intake Operations, Medical Billing, Accounts Receivable Management, Denial Management, Revenue Recovery, Quality Assurance, Analytics, and Process Excellence.

**Role Overview**

Prochant is looking for an experienced
**Associate Director – HR Business Partner (AD HRBP)**
to lead strategic HR initiatives and drive organizational effectiveness across its healthcare RCM operations.

This leadership role will partner closely with senior business leaders to align HR strategies with business objectives, improve employee engagement, strengthen leadership effectiveness, and drive talent management and organizational development initiatives.

A key priority for this role is
**proactively managing and reducing employee attrition, improving retention, and building a stable, engaged workforce**
across business operations. The successful candidate should be capable of identifying attrition drivers, developing effective retention strategies, and partnering with operations leaders to improve employee experience and workforce stability.

The ideal candidate will have extensive HR business partnering experience in ITES, BPO, or other large-scale service-oriented organizations. Experience in the US Healthcare or Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) industry is highly preferred. A strong track record of controlling attrition, improving retention metrics, managing employee relations, and driving people strategies in high-volume operational environments is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with senior business leaders to develop and execute HR strategies aligned with organizational goals and business priorities.
* **Drive attrition control and employee retention initiatives**
  by identifying key attrition drivers, analyzing exit trends, and implementing targeted retention strategies.
* Partner with operations leaders to monitor attrition trends across teams, functions, tenure groups, and employee segments, recommending corrective actions to improve workforce stability.
* Develop proactive retention plans for critical talent, high-performing employees, and key operational teams.
* Conduct exit interviews, stay interviews, employee feedback sessions, and attrition analysis to identify underlying concerns and recommend sustainable solutions.
* Work closely with people managers to strengthen leadership effectiveness, address employee concerns, and improve team engagement and retention.
* Act as a strategic HR advisor on workforce planning, organizational development, employee engagement, performance management, and people-related business challenges.
* Drive employee relations initiatives, grievance management, disciplinary processes, and conflict resolution in line with company policies and applicable employment regulations.
* Lead talent management, succession planning, leadership development, and performance management initiatives.
* Develop and implement employee engagement, recognition, career development, and culture-building initiatives to improve employee satisfaction and retention.
* Analyse HR metrics, including attrition rates, retention trends, absenteeism, employee engagement, and workforce productivity, to support data-driven decision-making.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition and business leaders to address workforce requirements, critical hiring needs, and workforce planning challenges.
* Drive change management, organizational restructuring, and people transformation initiatives.
* Ensure HR policies, processes, and practices comply with applicable labour laws, statutory requirements, and organizational standards.
* Collaborate with HR Centres of Excellence, including Talent Acquisition, Learning & Development, Compensation & Benefits, and HR Operations, to deliver effective HR solutions.
* Lead and mentor HR Business Partners and HR teams, fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Prepare and present HR dashboards, attrition reports, retention metrics, business reviews, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
* Support business expansion, employee productivity, and organizational effectiveness through proactive HR interventions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* MBA, MSW, or postgraduate qualification in Human Resources preferred.
* 15+ years of overall HR experience, with significant experience in strategic HR business partnering.
* Strong HRBP experience in ITES, BPO, or large-scale service-oriented organizations.
* **Demonstrated success in attrition management, employee retention, and workforce stabilization**
  , preferably in high-volume operational environments.
* Proven ability to analyse attrition trends, identify root causes, and implement measurable retention improvement initiatives.
* Experience partnering with senior leadership and managing complex employee relations matters.
* Demonstrated expertise in performance management, talent management, employee engagement, workforce planning, and organizational development.
* Experience leading HR teams and driving organization-wide people initiatives.
* Strong understanding of HR policies, labour law compliance, and people management practices in a dynamic operational environment.

**Preferred Industry Background**

* Prior experience in the
  **US Healthcare or Healthcare RCM industry is highly preferred**
  .
* Experience supporting large-scale ITES, BPO, shared services, or operations-driven organizations.
* Exposure to US healthcare operations, medical billing, or revenue cycle management environments will be an added advantage.
* Experience managing attrition and retention challenges in large employee populations, particularly in shift-based or customer-service-oriented operations.

**Domain Expertise**

Strategic HR Business Partnering

Attrition Control & Employee Retention

Workforce Stability & Retention Strategy

ITES / BPO / Shared Services HR

US Healthcare / Healthcare RCM

Employee Relations & Grievance Management

Employee Engagement & Experience

Performance Management

Talent Management & Succession Planning

Workforce Planning & Organizational Development

Exit Analysis & Root Cause Analysis

Change Management

HR Policies & Labour Law Compliance

HR Analytics & Workforce Reporting

Leadership Coaching & Stakeholder Management

Organizational Effectiveness

**Preferred Skills**

* Strong business acumen, strategic thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
* Proven ability to influence business leaders and people managers to improve retention outcomes.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret attrition data, identify trends, and develop actionable solutions.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills.
* Experience managing employee relations in a dynamic, fast-paced operational environment.
* Ability to design and implement effective employee engagement and retention programs.
* Proficiency in HRMS platforms, Excel, and HR dashboards.
* Strong leadership, team management, and decision-making capabilities.
* Ability to balance business priorities with employee experience and organizational culture.

**Why Join Prochant?**

Play a strategic role in shaping the people agenda of a growing US healthcare RCM organization.

Partner with senior leadership to influence business strategy and organizational effectiveness.

Drive impactful attrition reduction, employee retention, and engagement initiatives.

Contribute to building a stable, motivated, and high-performing workforce.

Lead people transformation initiatives and develop strong, business-aligned HR capabilities.

If you are a strategic HR leader with a strong track record in
**attrition control, employee retention, and HR business partnering**
, we invite you to join Prochant as Associate Director – HR Business Partner and play a key role in strengthening our workforce, improving employee experience, and driving business success.

description:

Manage HR administration, bookkeeping, invoicing, GST coordination, office operations, vendor management, and grant-related financial documentation.

Who we are?

**Job Description**
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a detail-oriented and organized HR & Accounts Executive to manage employee administration, office operations, invoicing, GST coordination, and day-to-day financial documentation. The candidate will play an important role in ensuring smooth internal operations, maintaining accurate records, supporting statutory compliance, and coordinating with employees, vendors, clients, and external accountants.
  
  
This role requires someone comfortable handling multiple responsibilities in a growing startup environment.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Human Resources & Employee Management
* Maintain employee records, personnel files, attendance, leave balances, and employment documentation.
* Coordinate recruitment activities, including job postings, interview scheduling, candidate communication, and onboarding.
* Prepare and coordinate offer letters, appointment letters, internship letters, experience certificates, and relieving letters.
* Track employee attendance, working hours, leave requests, and monthly payroll inputs.
* Coordinate monthly payroll processing, salary documentation, reimbursements, and employee-related deductions.
* Maintain HR policies, employee handbooks, holiday calendars, and internal procedures.
* Support employee engagement, performance review coordination, and internal communications.
* Track probation periods, contract renewals, internship durations, and employee exits.
* Accounting & Bookkeeping
* Maintain day-to-day records of income, expenses, purchases, payments, and receipts.
* Record and organize financial transactions, invoices, receipts, and supporting documents.
* Maintain accounts payable and receivable records and track outstanding payments.
* Prepare expense statements, reimbursement summaries, and monthly financial reports.
* Reconcile bank statements with accounting records and identify discrepancies.
* Maintain vendor records, purchase orders, payment schedules, and expense documentation.
* Coordinate with the company's Chartered Accountant (CA) for bookkeeping reviews, financial statements, and statutory filings.
* Assist in preparing cash flow statements, budgets, and financial summaries for management.
* GST, Invoicing & Statutory Compliance
* Prepare and issue customer invoices, pro forma invoices, quotations, and payment receipts.
* Verify GST details, HSN/SAC classifications where applicable, tax rates, and invoice particulars in coordination with the CA.
* Maintain GST-compliant sales and purchase invoice records.
* Track GST collected, input tax credit documentation, and applicable tax payment requirements.
* Coordinate with the CA for GST return preparation, reconciliation, and timely filing.
* Track TDS applicability, deduction records, certificates, and filing requirements with the CA.
* Maintain statutory records and support compliance with applicable company, tax, and employment requirements.
* Monitor invoice due dates and follow up with customers for pending payments.
* Office Administration & Procurement
* Manage office supplies, stationery, pantry essentials, housekeeping requirements, and other administrative purchases.
* Monitor inventory levels and ensure timely replenishment of office materials.
* Coordinate vendor quotations, procurement, deliveries, bills, and payments.
* Maintain office assets, equipment registers, maintenance schedules, and allocation records.
* Coordinate office facilities, repairs, utilities, internet connectivity, and other service providers.
* Maintain an organized office environment and support day-to-day operational requirements.
* Ensure administrative expenses are documented and tracked against budgets.
* Grant & Project Financial Documentation
* Maintain project-wise expense records and supporting bills for grants, pilots, and funded programmes.
* Organize invoices, payment proofs, bank statements, and expense documentation for financial reporting.
* Assist in preparing utilization statements, statements of expenditure, and milestone-wise expense reports.
* Track approved budgets, actual expenditure, and available balances for individual projects.
* Coordinate with project teams and the CA to ensure expenses are properly documented and classified.
* Support financial audits, grant reviews, and requests for supporting documents from funding agencies.
* General Operations & Management Support
* Maintain organized digital and physical filing systems for HR, accounts, administration, and compliance records.
* Prepare internal trackers, spreadsheets, and management reports.
* Coordinate employee reimbursements, travel bookings, and administrative arrangements.
* Track recurring payments, subscriptions, office rent, utility bills, and vendor contracts.
* Support management with documentation for incubators, grant applications, audits, and other business requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve internal processes and administrative efficiency.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related discipline.
* Basic knowledge of bookkeeping, invoicing, GST, and financial documentation.
* Familiarity with HR administration, employee records, payroll coordination, and attendance management.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and office productivity tools.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality when handling employee, salary, and financial information.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with accounting software such as Tally Prime, Zoho Books, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with GST invoicing, GST reconciliation, TDS, and statutory compliance coordination.
* Experience with payroll processing and HR management tools.
* Understanding of vendor management, procurement, and office administration.
* Experience maintaining project budgets, grant expenses, or audit documentation.
* Prior experience in a startup, small business, or growing organization.

Key Competencies
  
  

* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong coordination and time-management skills.
* Ownership of routine administrative and financial processes.
* Discretion and integrity in handling confidential information.
* Proactive problem-solving and follow-through.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate across teams.

What We Offer
  
  

* An opportunity to contribute to the growth of an emerging climate-tech startup.
* Exposure to HR, finance, accounting, and business operations.
* Opportunities to build and improve internal systems and processes.
* A collaborative working environment with exposure to startup operations and funded projects.

Performance Expectations
  
  
**Success In This Role Will Be Measured By**

* Accurate and up-to-date employee and financial records.
* Timely invoicing and systematic follow-up on outstanding payments.
* Timely coordination of payroll, GST, and other applicable compliance activities.
* Effective management of office supplies, vendors, and administrative expenses.
* Complete and audit-ready documentation for grant-funded projects.
* Reliable reporting and smooth day-to-day office operations.

FIZIX Innovation Labs is a technology-based R&D company in Chennai specializing in innovative software and electronics solutions across various industries. The Business Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing and optimizing the company's operational processes. **Operational Strategy:**

·      Identify opportunities for process improvements and cost savings.

2.
**Process Management:**

·      Oversee day-to-day operations to ensure that business functions are efficient and effective.

·      Streamline workflows to improve productivity and reduce operational costs.

·      Monitor and analyze operational metrics to ensure targets are met.

3.
**Resource Allocation:**

·      Manage resources, including personnel, equipment, and budgets, to maximize operational efficiency.

·      Coordinate with department heads to ensure optimal allocation of resources

**Team Leadership:**

·      Foster a culture of continuous improvement and accountability.

**Project Management:**

·      Plan, execute, and oversee projects aimed at improving business operations.

·      Ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and meet quality standards.

6.
**Cross-Functional Collaboration:**

·      Work closely with other members and associates in such areas as Finance, HR, Sales, and IT to ensure seamless operations.

·      Act as a liaison to resolve issues and improve communication.

7.
**Compliance and Risk Management:**

·      Ensure that all operations comply with company policies, regulations, and legal requirements.

·      Identify and mitigate operational risks.

8.
**Reporting and Analysis:**

·      Prepare and present regular reports on operational performance to management.

·      Use data-driven insights to recommend and implement improvements.

**Vendor and Supplier Management:**

·      Manage relationships with vendors and suppliers to ensure quality and cost-effectiveness.

·      Oversee customer service operations to ensure a high level of customer satisfaction.

title: Process Lead - Operations (R2P)
description:
**Job Summary**
The Process Lead - Accounts Payable is responsible for the accurate, timely, and compliant execution of end-to-end Requisition-to-Pay (R2P) processes across multiple entities and jurisdictions. The role supports invoice processing, vendor payments, employee expense reimbursements, account reconciliations, and financial controls while ensuring adherence to banking regulations, internal policies, audit requirements and Service Level Agreements (SLAs). The role also supports quality improvement, issue resolution, and acts as a point of guidance for junior analysts.
  
  
The individual will play a critical role in optimizing payment operations, mitigating risk, enhancing controls, supporting transformation initiatives, and ensuring consistent delivery against Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Manage end-to-end R2P activities including invoice processing, validation, payment runs, reconciliations, Travel & Expense, and MIS professionally & efficiently
* Ensure daily work allocation (indexing, assessing, processing) is completed consistently and efficiently.
* Review incomplete or incorrect invoices before moving them to the rework queue.
* Prioritize urgent and critical invoices as per instructions from the Manager or Team Coordinator.
* Ensure all assigned volumes are completed as per agreed productivity and quality targets.
* Maintain 100% accuracy in invoice processing, journals, and rework movements.
* Journals to be processed with 100% accuracy based on inputs received.
* Ensure strong financial and operational controls are in place and operating effectively.
* Monitoring to ensure that the standards of customer service provided, is consistently meet or exceed the requirements set under the Service Level Agreements agreed with the customers
* Support audit requirements and ensure compliance with internal policies and quality standards.
* Review processes regularly to identify opportunities for efficiency, quality, and automation improvements.
* Supervising the team, providing on-the-job and other process trainings
* Support new process transitions, migrations, and stabilization initiatives.
* To be responsive to the needs of the stakeholders at all times, ensuring clear and effective communication.
* Coordinate with other R2P team leads and Global Finance teams to ensure smooth operations.
* Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes.
* Apply accounting knowledge across the end-to-end P2P lifecycle, including upstream and downstream dependencies.
* Review and manage the book of work for the assigned process stream.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**

* HR Business
* P2P
* R2R

**Other Responsibilities**

* Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values. Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures.

**Skills And Experience**

* 3–5 years of experience in Accounts Payable, Procure-to-Pay (P2P), or Requisition-to-Pay (R2P) operations.
* Experience within Banking, Financial Services or Shared Services preferred.
* Exposure to multinational and high-volume transaction environments is an advantage
* Proven experience handling complex AP transactions, audits, controls, and stakeholder management.
* Proven experience in managing end-to-end operational processes.
* Strong understanding of operational risk, controls, and regulatory requirements.
* Experience in process improvement, automation, and transformation initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to engage with senior stakeholders and drive business outcomes

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. Stranger Soccer is expanding across key cities worldwide and is seeking a License Owner to launch and grow the Stranger Soccer operation in Chennai.**

To make playing football as easy as going for a jog.

A world where playing football is as popular and accessible as watching football.

title: Manager - Entertainment PRS, Tamil GEC
description:
* Job Summary This is a team management and revenue enablement role in the Product & Revenue Strategy Function. This position is required to work with the Sales team to support part of the business of the respective cluster/ language . The incumbent will act as a key link between Programming/Content team and Sales teams and drive the brand philosophy and sales/revenue strategy for the channel to maximize revenue. This will be done through effective forecasting, planning, pricing and property integrations based on deep understanding of customer needs and patterns.

The incumbent will play a critical role in developing a comprehensive roadmap and vision for our business, studying industry-specific trends, and creating compelling narratives to drive monetization growth. This role requires a strategic thinker with strong analytical and communication skills, as well as the ability to navigate complex organizational dynamics.
  
  
**About The Team**
The PRS teams drive the brand philosophy and sales/revenue strategy for the channel to maximize revenue by optimizing inventory. This is achieved through effective forecasting, planning, pricing, and property integrations based on a deep understanding of customer needs and patterns.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities
* Creating revenue business plan across portfolio, defining the pricing strategy along with the Channel PRS Head for the channel/cluster basis organization objectives, budget for the year, market scenario, competition, etc. in order to ensure the sales organization achieves overall revenue target.
* Driving the channel pricing agenda - setting benchmarks, providing inputs and sign-offs on deals, and participating in deal negotiations as and when required
* Build client wise strategy/ deal structuring for the channel which includes creating and recommending client pricing options for individual client deals, building monthly client packages including decisions on what time bands to allocate to each client based on what works for their target segments and track deviations in delivery
* Build sponsor packages for impact shows and ensure maximum monetization for each property on the channel
* Build band wise revenue budget, show and property wise pricing including determination of sponsor packages
* Create and maintain strategies based on key genres to help understand the genre behavior, trends, movements etc. that may have impact on business.
* Building bottom-up revenue plans for the fiscal, quarter & month
* Tracking performance vs. annual plan, revising forecasts etc.
* Developing insights into the genre & channel deliveries to develop customized pitches for clients
* Creating & implementing trade marketing agenda for the channel – Mailers, On Air promos, Trade events etc.
* Define a measurement process to ensure that client and agency are aligned on key performance metrics, establishing realistic business goals, and providing frontline support through reporting and analytics
* Impact landscape sizing of a particular genre – understand the kind of impact properties across channels, changes and evolutions compared to the previous year and deeper understanding of the advertisers who buy impact
* Engage with sales teams for ensuring revenue rationalization by forecasting projections/trends for a healthy business and designing attractive packages for the sales team to take to the market, conducting roadshows. Prepare the sales team so they can handle queries from clients and media planners/buyers with confidence.
* Supporting ad sales team with operational tasks on rate cards, internal deal approvals, client sales proposals etc.
* Liaise with the Programming teams and build a thorough understanding of the channel objectives and performance in order to identify monetization opportunities, as also provide market / sales feedback in relation to channel properties
* Work collaboratively across Sales and Ops to ensure seamless delivery on deals from a client perspective, as well as inventory optimization and revenue maximization from a business perspective
* Helps building client dockets to understand the advertising patterns for key advertisers versus competition genre wise, channel wise, brand wise, market wise and make recommendations basis the same to improve the efficiency of clients’ buys
* Skills & Attributes for success

Business Acumen
  
  

* Strategic planning
* Influencing Skills
* Result Orientation
* Negotiation Skills
* Analytical thinking
* Strategic planning
* Leadership
* Preferred Education & Experience

Minimum Qualification: MBA
  
  

* 5+ years of post-qualification experience
* Business consulting/ strategy background preferred
