title: Cluster Assistant Human Resource Manager_South Region
description:
Cluster Assistant Human Resource Manager
  
  
**Brand:**
Holiday Inn Express – IHG Hotels & Resorts
  
  
**Department:**
Human Resources
  
  
**Job Band:**
06
  
  
**Location:**
Cluster Role – Hyderabad, Bengaluru & Chennai, India
  
  
**Reports To:**
Portfolio HR Director
  
  
**Travel Requirement:**
Frequent inter-property travel across assigned hotels
  
  
**About Holiday Inn Express**
At Holiday Inn Express, we believe in making travel simple and smart. We focus on delivering a comfortable stay, friendly service and the essentials that matter most to our guests.
  
  
As part of IHG Hotels & Resorts, we are committed to creating True Hospitality for everyone. We are looking for a people-oriented HR professional who can support our hotel teams, strengthen employee engagement and drive consistent HR practices across our multi-property portfolio.
  
  
Role Overview – What Is the Job?
  
  
The Cluster Assistant HR Manager will support and drive the Human Resources function across assigned Holiday Inn Express hotels in Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Chennai. The role will be responsible for implementing HR policies and procedures, talent acquisition, employee engagement, learning and development, performance management, employee relations, payroll coordination and statutory compliance.
  
  
The position will work closely with General Managers, Hotel Managers, Department Heads and the Portfolio HR Director to build a positive workplace culture, ensure compliance with applicable employment laws and support business performance through effective people management.
  
  
This is a multi-property role requiring strong execution, stakeholder management, analytical skills and the ability to travel regularly across assigned hotel locations.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Human Resources Operations
* Manage and coordinate day-to-day HR operations across assigned hotel properties, ensuring consistency in HR processes and adherence to company policies.
* Maintain accurate employee records, personnel files, HR documentation, attendance and employee lifecycle data.
* Coordinate onboarding, induction, confirmation, transfers, promotions, employee separations and full-and-final settlement inputs.
* Support the implementation and effective utilisation of HRMS and recruitment systems.
* Ensure timely preparation of HR reports, manpower updates, organisational structures and other management reports.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of employee information and HR records.
* Talent Acquisition and Manpower Planning
* Coordinate end-to-end recruitment activities, including manpower requisitions, candidate sourcing, interview scheduling, selection coordination and offer management.
* Partner with General Managers and Department Heads to understand manpower requirements and ensure timely recruitment.
* Monitor vacancies, recruitment turnaround time, joining ratios and manpower availability across the assigned hotels.
* Ensure recruitment practices comply with IHG standards, company policies and applicable employment requirements.
* Support effective manpower planning, internal career progression and talent development initiatives.
* Payroll, Compensation & Benefits
* Coordinate monthly attendance, payroll inputs, employee master updates, leave data, incentives and other salary-related information with the respective stakeholders and payroll team.
* Review payroll inputs for completeness and accuracy and facilitate timely resolution of discrepancies.
* Coordinate employee benefits, salary revisions, reimbursements and other compensation-related processes as applicable.
* Monitor employee costs and manpower expenses against approved budgets.
* Support preparation and validation of payroll reports, employee cost analysis and related management information.
* Statutory Compliance and Employee Documentation
* Ensure timely coordination and monitoring of applicable statutory compliances, including EPF, ESIC, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, minimum wages, bonus, gratuity and other applicable employment requirements.
* Coordinate with payroll teams, external consultants, vendors and relevant stakeholders for statutory calculations, payments, returns, registers and documentation.
* Monitor applicable central and state employment laws, statutory deadlines, regulatory changes and establishment-specific requirements.
* Maintain compliance records, licences, registers, notices and other prescribed documentation as applicable.
* Conduct periodic HR compliance reviews and support internal and external audits.
* Track compliance gaps, facilitate corrective actions and escalate material risks to the Portfolio HR Director and relevant management.
* Employee Engagement, Relations & Retention
* Promote the IHG Winning Ways culture and create a positive, inclusive and engaging work environment.
* Plan and coordinate employee engagement activities, recognition programmes, celebrations and team-building initiatives.
* Support employee satisfaction surveys and develop action plans based on feedback.
* Address employee queries, grievances and workplace concerns promptly, fairly and confidentially.
* Conduct exit interviews, analyse attrition and absenteeism trends, and recommend appropriate retention initiatives.
* Build effective relationships with employees, Department Heads and hotel leadership teams.
* Learning, Development & Performance Management
* Coordinate new-joiner induction, HR orientation and employee awareness programmes.
* Support training needs identification and the implementation of learning and development initiatives.
* Guide managers on HR policies, performance management, employee development and people-related matters.
* Monitor performance appraisal cycles, probation reviews and confirmation processes.
* Support succession planning, talent development and internal career opportunities.
* Encourage continuous learning and reinforce the service culture expected at Holiday Inn Express.
* Employee Welfare, POSH & Workplace Standards
* Support implementation of employee welfare initiatives and workplace policies.
* Coordinate awareness programmes relating to the Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) and other applicable workplace requirements.
* Support the appropriate handling and escalation of workplace complaints in accordance with company policy and applicable law.
* Promote respectful workplace behaviour, equal opportunity and a culture of inclusion.
* Ensure employee-related departmental SOPs and HR standards are communicated and followed.
* Business Partnership & Guest Experience
* Partner with General Managers and Department Heads to align HR initiatives with hotel business objectives and guest service standards.
* Support service standards audits and communicate relevant people-related observations and improvement opportunities.
* Develop initiatives to motivate employees and improve service delivery, productivity and guest satisfaction.
* Monitor staffing levels, employee productivity and labour costs to support operational efficiency.
* Contribute to regional and portfolio-level HR initiatives, projects and special assignments as directed by the Portfolio HR Director.
* HR Reporting, Analytics & Continuous Improvement
* Prepare periodic HR dashboards and reports covering manpower, vacancies, attrition, absenteeism, employee movements, payroll costs and other key HR metrics.
* Analyse workforce trends and provide actionable insights to hotel leadership.
* Maintain accurate and timely HR data across all assigned properties.
* Identify opportunities to simplify HR processes, improve employee experience and strengthen operational controls.
* Ensure timely completion of assigned deliverables, management reports and compliance trackers.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Graduate degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Hotel Management or a related discipline.
* Approximately 3–4 years of relevant Human Resources experience, preferably in the hospitality industry or a multi-property environment.
* Working knowledge of recruitment, payroll coordination, employee relations, HR operations and statutory compliance.
* Understanding of applicable Indian labour laws and employment regulations.
* Experience working with HRMS, recruitment systems, Microsoft Excel and HR reporting tools.
* Strong communication, coordination, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and travel frequently across assigned hotel locations.

Key Skills & Competencies
  
  

* Multi-property HR operations and execution.
* Talent acquisition and manpower planning.
* Payroll coordination and statutory compliance.
* Employee engagement and grievance handling.
* HR analytics, reporting and Excel proficiency.
* Communication, collaboration and influencing skills.
* Confidentiality, integrity and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating with hotel leadership teams.
* A service-oriented mindset and commitment to continuous improvement.

How Will You Deliver Success?
  
  
At IHG, our commitment to True Hospitality is reflected in how we work and how we treat people.
  
  

* True Attitude: Demonstrate care, respect and a genuine desire to make a positive difference.
* True Confidence: Apply HR knowledge and professional judgement to support employees and business leaders.
* True Listening: Understand employee and stakeholder concerns and respond with empathy and professionalism.
* True Responsiveness: Resolve queries efficiently, meet deadlines and take ownership of commitments.

Success in this role will be reflected in consistent HR execution across assigned properties, timely recruitment and payroll coordination, strong employee engagement, reliable compliance management and effective partnership with hotel leadership.
  
  
What We Offer
  
  

* The opportunity to work with the globally recognised IHG Hotels & Resorts brand.
* Exposure to multi-property HR operations and business partnering.
* Opportunities for professional learning, development and career growth.
* A collaborative and inclusive working environment.
* Access to applicable IHG employee benefits, training and development programmes, subject to company policy.

Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
IHG Hotels & Resorts is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace where colleagues are respected, valued and encouraged to contribute their best.
  
  
**Join us and be part of a team that brings True Hospitality to life every day.**
Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

title: Head of Employee Relations for India and APAC, Vice President
description:
As
**Head of Employee Relations for India and APAC,**
you will provide strategic leadership and expert advice to business divisions and corporate functions across the region. You will be responsible for the effective management of complex employee relations matters and associated legal, financial, and reputational risks.
  
  
The Employee Relations function plays a critical role in supporting organisational performance by advising on workplace issues and addressing employee concerns. In this role, you will deliver pragmatic, commercially focused solutions while building manager capability and strengthening employee engagement.
  
  
This position is suited to a senior Employee Relations professional with deep regional expertise across India and APAC and a proven ability to operate in a complex, global environment at both an operational and strategic level.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The Head of Employee Relations - India & APAC is a senior leadership role responsible for providing strategic, operational, and people leadership across Employee Relations for India and the broader APAC region.
  
  
This role serves as the primary regional escalation point for complex and high-risk employee relations matters, ensures consistent application of ER standards across jurisdictions, and builds a scalable regional model aligned with global frameworks, local requirements, and evolving data- and technology-enabled ways of working.
  
  
Reporting into Head of Employee Relations – International, the role leads a team of ER professionals across APAC and India and partners closely with HR, Legal, Compliance, Conduct Standards, Ethics, Corporate Audit, Global Security, and business leadership to identify, manage, and mitigate employee-related risk.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Regional ER Leadership & Strategy
  
  

* Provide end-to-end leadership for Employee Relations across India and APAC, ensuring alignment with global ER strategy and standards.
* Partner with the Managing Director, Head of International Employee Relations, to shape and execute the regional ER operating model, including governance, escalation pathways, capability building, and technology-enabled process and service improvements.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior business and HR leaders on complex, sensitive, and high-risk employee relations matters.
* Provide leadership across diverse APAC jurisdictions with varying employment law frameworks, regulatory obligations, and cultural considerations, balancing global consistency with local requirements and business needs.

Case Oversight, Conduct & Risk Management
  
  

* Provide oversight and direction on complex investigations, grievances, employee misconduct matters, executive employee matters, and other high-risk employee relations issues.
* Oversee employee misconduct and conduct-related matters in partnership with Conduct Standards, Ethics, Legal, Compliance, and Global Security, ensuring consistent, fair, and risk-appropriate outcomes.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for significant employee conduct matters, sensitive investigations, and issues presenting legal, regulatory, reputational, operational, or cultural risk.
* Ensure matters are handled in a consistent, fair, and risk-aware manner, balancing legal, regulatory, cultural, and reputational considerations.
* Support regional governance and risk management activities, including audit reviews, regulatory inquiries, employee-related risk reporting, and senior leadership forums.

Leadership & Team Management
  
  

* Lead, develop, and coach a team of VP/AVP/Officer level Employee Relations consultants across India and APAC.
* Build a high-performing Employee Relations leadership team and succession pipeline through coaching, talent development, learning agility, knowledge sharing, and consistent decision-making.
* Set clear expectations, promote accountability, and foster a collaborative, inclusive team culture.
* Create a cohesive regional Employee Relations function that delivers consistent, high-quality support while effectively navigating local market and jurisdictional differences.
* Develop senior Employee Relations practitioners and sustainable regional capability by promoting continuous learning, adaptability, and readiness for emerging technologies and evolving workforce expectations.

Stakeholder Partnership
  
  

* Establish strong partnerships with HR Business Partners, COEs, and regional leadership teams.
* Provide guidance and challenge to stakeholders to drive appropriate outcomes while protecting the organisation and its employees.
* Support restructurings, integrations, transformation programs, and other organisational change, helping leaders adopt new ways of working effectively.
* Maintain strong relationships with internal and external counsel and relevant industry networks to anticipate legal, regulatory, and market developments across APAC.

Governance, Standards & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Ensure regional ER practices align with global policies, local labour laws, and regulatory expectations.
* Use Employee Relations metrics, case data, trend analysis, and thematic reporting to identify emerging risks, generate actionable insights, inform proactive interventions, and enable evidence-based senior leadership decisions.
* Report on Employee Relations activity, conduct-related concerns, organisational trends, and key risk indicators across the region.
* Contribute to the evolution of ER policies, frameworks, and manager capability initiatives.

**Experience**
**Required Experience & Capabilities**

* Significant senior-level experience in Employee Relations / Employment Law / HR Advisory, ideally within a complex, global organisation.
* Proven experience leading regional or multi-country ER teams.
* Strong track record managing high-risk, high-profile, and senior-level ER matters.
* Experience operating in regulated environments and partnering with Legal and Compliance.

Skills & Attributes
  
  

* Strong judgment and decision-making capability in complex and ambiguous situations.
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills at senior leadership level.
* Ability to balance global consistency with local nuance and cultural sensitivity.
* Proven people leader with experience developing senior professionals.
* Commercial, pragmatic approach with a strong risk and conduct mindset.
* Ability to use data, technology, and innovative approaches to improve Employee Relations outcomes and processes.

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

title: Global Head - Travel & Hospitality
description:
Job Title: Global Head - Travel & Hospitality

City: Bengaluru

State/Province: Karnataka

Posting Start Date: 10/13/26

Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.

The Global Head of Travel & Hospitality owns Wipro's end-to-end travel and hospitality value chain for ~250,000 employees across 65+ countries . The role is accountable for four integrated sub-functions: Travel Operations (delivered through WTSL, Wipro's in-house IATA-accredited 24×7 travel management company operating as a profit centre with its own P&L), Hospitality & Guest House reservations, Airlines & Hotel Contracting & RFP Management, and MICE bookings (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences & Events).

The mandate is to run Travel & Hospitality as a control-and-value lever: driving measurable cost optimisation through airline and hotel supplier leverage, GDS/PCC fare economics, PLB and segment-income retention, and the structural advantage of the in-house TMC model; enforcing global travel policy, duty-of-care governance and GST-compliant contracting at source; and continuously elevating the traveller experience through self-booking adoption, disruption management and AI-enabled tooling.

Lead the travel-side AI and agentic-AI transformation agenda across the full trip lifecycle, owns travel integration for acquired entities, Expected business impact includes double-digit annual travel cost savings, sustained travel SLAs of 92%+ and hospitality SLAs of 95%+, guest-house utilisation of 80%+, and crisis-response capability of under 30 minutes for Tier-1 travel-risk events.

**͏Roles & Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

**1. Functional Responsibilities**

* **WTSL & Travel Operations —** Own strategy, P&L and 24×7 operations of the in-house IATA-accredited TMC (WTSL): airline and hotel commercial negotiation, corporate fare-code and restricted-RBD deal structures, GDS/PCC fare filing and rate loading, PLB and segment-income optimisation, BSP settlement, and ADM/ACM recovery.
* **Hotel Contracting & RFP —** Own the global hotel RFP programme end-to-end — rate negotiation, Last Room Availability and value-add contracting, zero-markup net-rate delivery, GST-compliant invoicing at source, and contract continuity with no rate gap at renewal.
* **Hospitality & Guest Houses —** Run guest-house reservation management and hospitality SLA governance globally; own utilisation, cost-per-night and guest-experience metrics; manage the hospitality supplier ecosystem.
* **MICE —** Own MICE demand end-to-end — group bookings
* **Policy & Booking Compliance —** Enforce travel policy at the point of booking through the self-booking and pre-trip approval stack (SAP Concur and internal approval platforms); drive self-booking adoption and in-policy booking rates while protecting employee experience.
* **AI & Digital Transformation —** Lead the travel-lifecycle AI transformation — embedded AI in booking and servicing tools, agentic automation of traveller and approver actions (including disruption management), and predictive intelligence ahead of trip decisions — framed as behaviour, controls and automation, not a systems implementation.
* **Duty of Care & Travel Risk —** Co-own traveller risk management with Global Security Team.
* **M&A Travel Integration —** Own travel integration for acquired entities — booking-platform migration, policy harmonisation, traveller communication and go-live stabilisation — using a repeatable M&A integration playbook.
* **Sustainability & ESG —** Deliver carbon data coverage across bookings, Scope 3 emissions reporting readiness (CSRD), and sustainability clauses in all travel and hospitality vendor contracts.
* **Governance Cadence —** Publish the monthly Travel & Hospitality governance scorecard and quarterly programme reporting to senior leadership; maintain auditable SLA tracking through enterprise IT service management.

**͏**
-----

**2. Stakeholder Management**

* **Leadership reporting —** Report to the Head of Global Operations with a regular review cadence; represent the function to the CHRO organisation with impact-forward reporting on savings, SLAs, transformation and risk posture.
* **CFO & Finance partnership —** Own the WTSL P&L narrative with Finance — retained-income economics (PLB, segment income, hotel commissions), net operating cost, and the evidence base for the build-versus-buy case for the in-house TMC model, including independent fare audits.
* **Cross-functional partnership —** Partner with the Global Security Group on duty of care and crisis response; with CIO/BITS on booking-platform integrations; with the payables/FSS organisation on IATA and hotel settlement; and with HR on policy harmonisation and traveller communications.
* **External & supplier ecosystem —** Own senior relationships with airlines, hotel chains and consortia, the GDS provider, and travel-technology vendors; protect the function's ownership of travel partner management while collaborating constructively with central procurement on negotiations.
* **Traveller voice —** Champion the traveller experience at leadership level — CSAT/NPS accountability for travel and hospitality touchpoints, executive and VIP desk service standards, and change-management communication for every major rollout.

**͏**
-----

**3. Team Management**

* **Organisation leadership —** Lead a multi-layered global organisation across Travel Operations, Hospitality, MICE and special projects/analytics, operating 24×7 across time zones.
* **Succession & capability building —** Build succession depth in an operations-heavy team: develop strategic and analytical capability in operational leaders, manage planned retirements and leadership transitions without service disruption, and absorb talent from acquired entities into the operating structure.
* **Performance management —** Calibrate leadership style per leader — autonomy for strategically strong leads, structured cadence and oversight for execution-focused leads — while keeping accountability unambiguous.
* **Engagement & cadence —** Run rewards & recognition, leadership offsites and an engagement cadence that keeps a globally distributed, crisis-exposed 24×7 operation motivated and audit-ready.

**͏Requirements / Pre-requisites Required for the Role**
--------------------------------------------------------

**1. Educational Qualification Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Hospitality/Travel Management
* MBA or equivalent post-graduate qualification in Business/Operations (strongly preferred).
* Industry credentials valued: IATA-accredited agency operations exposure, GBTA/CCTE certification, ISO 31030 familiarity, GDS (Sabre/Amadeus) proficiency.

**2. Work Experience Required**

* 18 - 22 years of total experience in Airlines/Travel management Companies with a minimum of 8 years heading a global corporate travel and/or hospitality function for a large multinational (75,000+ employees or $75M+ managed travel spend).
* Demonstrated P&L ownership of a travel operation — ideally an in-house or hybrid TMC — including GDS economics (PCC, fare filing, corporate fare codes/RBDs, PLB, segment income), BSP settlement, and airline/hotel commercial negotiation at named-account level.
* Proven hotel programme leadership: global RFP cycles, LRA and value-add contracting, guest-house or serviced-accommodation operations, and hospitality SLA management.
* Hands-on leadership of enterprise booking-platform estates (SAP Concur or equivalent OBT, pre-trip approval workflows) and MICE/group-travel operations, including platform automation programmes.
* Proven delivery of duty-of-care/travel-risk frameworks with real-time traveller tracking, and of M&A travel integration onto common platforms.
* Track record of quantified outcomes — travel cost reduction of 15%+ on comparable portfolios, SLA performance sustained through geopolitical crisis events, and measurable adoption gains on self-booking.
* Experience in India-headquartered global environments with GST-compliant travel contracting knowledge is a strong advantage.

**3. Behavioural Competencies**

* **Strategic & commercial acumen —** Treats travel as a business with retained-income economics, not a cost centre — commercial instinct on fare structures, supplier incentives and the in-house TMC value stack.
* **Executive presence —** Communicates impact-forward at CEO/CHRO/CXO level; builds the evidence case for the operating model rather than asserting it; makes the team's work visible.
* **Data-driven decision-making —** Builds decisions on baselines, targets and audited evidence; insists on discovery and ground-truth input before design; resists anecdote-led decision-making.
* **Judgement under competing goals —** Balances policy enforcement with traveller experience deliberately — knows when soft controls with downstream governance beat hard stops.
* **Change & transformation leadership —** Leads AI adoption personally; converts operational leaders into AI-literate operators; distinguishes automation opportunity from platform replacement.
* **Organisational savvy —** Navigates organisational boundaries (procurement, security, finance, IT) with political sensitivity — protecting functional ownership of partner management while remaining collaborative.
* **Resilience & crisis command —** Calm, decisive crisis command — proven ability to run 24×7 travel operations through geopolitical disruption, system outages and mass rebooking events while holding SLAs.
* **Integrity & governance mindset —** High integrity in a supplier-facing, incentive-rich domain.

title: Sourcing Specialist
description:
**What's Ditto?**

Ditto’s mission is to help people make well-informed insurance decisions - from expert advisory and policy purchases to dedicated claim support. We pioneered the industry’s first “No-Spam” policy, challenging traditional insurance approaches and putting customer trust first. Over the past five years, we’ve helped 700,000+ people make personalized decisions on health and term insurance, earning a 4.9/5 rating from 32,000+ reviews on Google.

Ditto is part of the Finshots family (500K+ subscribers) and is backed by Zerodha, India’s largest stockbroker. We were also recognized as LinkedIn’s Top Startup in India in both 2022 and 2023.

**The Context**

Ditto is scaling fast. Our advisory team alone hires at high volume, and we're opening up roles across marketing, ops, tech, and specialised regional and multilingual hiring.

The bottleneck at this scale isn't screening candidates. It's finding them — reaching the right people in markets where the obvious channels don't work, and building pipelines that consistently deliver on tough briefs.

That's what this role owns.

**The Role**

You'll own sourcing across multiple positions — advisory bulk hiring at scale, non-advisory specialised hiring, regional and multilingual pipelines. You'll report into the HR team and work closely with hiring managers across departments.

Some examples of what you might own:

* **Bulk regional pipelines —** build the sourcing engine for Tamil-, Telugu-, or Kannada-speaking advisor hires — where LinkedIn and Naukri don't get you all the way, and you need to find channels that do.
* **Specialised non-advisory hiring —** source for niche roles in marketing, ops, or tech where the candidate pool is small and passive engagement matters more than volume.
* **Agency management —** onboard and manage recruitment agencies as an extension of the sourcing function — with real accountability on quality, not just volume.
* **Talent mapping —** build competitor and market maps for recurring and strategic hires, so we're not sourcing cold every time.

Whatever the role, you own the sourcing end-to-end — from strategy to first response.

**How This Role Evolves**

Excel at sourcing and other TA roles open up over time — TA Lead, specialised ownership of bulk-hiring or non-advisory hiring, lateral moves as the function grows. That's not the point of the role, it's what tends to happen when the craft is real. If your plan is to escape sourcing as fast as possible, this isn't the right role.

**What We're Looking For**

* 4–6 years of hands-on sourcing, with real ownership of bulk or high-volume mandates.
* Strong craft — Boolean, X-ray, LinkedIn advanced search, passive candidate outreach. The sourcing toolkit at working depth, not surface-familiar.
* Experience sourcing across channels beyond LinkedIn and Naukri — regional portals, communities, referrals, agencies. You know where different candidate profiles actually live.
* Comfort managing recruitment agencies as an extension of your own sourcing. You communicate the spec, hold partners to quality, and know when to push back.
* Enough analytical range to read funnel data and diagnose what's not converting.
* Bias toward finding talent where others can't. That's the muscle we're hiring for.

**A note on what this role is not**

This is not a coordination or scheduling role. If you want to run interview logistics and calendar management, this will frustrate you. It's not a role where you hand mandates to agencies and wait for callbacks — you're doing the sourcing yourself, at scale. And it's not for someone whose plan is to get out of sourcing as fast as possible. The craft is the job. If you do it well, other TA roles open up — but only because you were great at sourcing first.

**Why Join Ditto**

* Real ownership of a sourcing function at a company scaling hiring significantly.
* A TA team that's building forward, not maintaining what exists.
* Direct visibility into how a growing company gets built — you're the first conversation many joiners have with Ditto.
* Craft compounds. Great sourcing here sets you up for the TA roles that open up as we scale.
* A company where the mission is genuinely lived — a 4.9 Google rating from 30,000+ users tells its own story.

**Perks**

* Comprehensive health and term insurance.
* Compensation as per industry standards.
* Learning allowances and growth opportunities.

**Our Interview Process**

We want to respect your time. There are 4 rounds, and we aim to complete all of them within 3 weeks.

**The schedule:**

* 1. Introductory call with HR

* 2. Task / Assignment (3 business days from receipt)

* 3. Task presentation + Case discussion with the Hiring Manager

* 4. Founders round

**This is an in-office role. Our address is: Fortuna-1, No 680, 15th Cross, J.P Nagar 2nd Phase, J P Nagar, Bangalore South – 560078, Karnataka, India.**

*Please Note: Beware of recruitment scams. Ditto does not charge any fees at any stage of the hiring process. If you receive any suspicious message claiming to be from Ditto, please verify through our official channels.*

title: Track Lead - Data Loss Prevention,Palo Alto Firewalls
description:
Track Lead - Data Loss Prevention,Palo Alto Firewalls

Bangalore, Karnataka

**Job Summary**
---------------

**Job Summary :** We are seeking an experienced Insider Risk Specialist to join Marvell\'s Security Operations team. This is a high-impact, analytically driven role at the intersection of behavioral analysis, data protection, threat intelligence, and investigation. You will be a key operator in our Insider Risk Program — identifying, analyzing, and mitigating threats that originate from within the enterprise.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Job Responsibilities : Threat Signal Analysis & Data Monitoring · Continuously monitor and analyze threat signals from SIEM, DLP, endpoint detection, email security, cloud access, and HR/behavioral data sources to identify anomalous and high-risk activity. · Correlate multi-source data — including access logs, data movement telemetry, badge records, and productivity signals — to build a holistic risk picture for individuals and populations. · Develop, tune, and operationalize detection use cases, alerting thresholds, and behavioral baselines to reduce noise and improve signal fidelity. · Build and maintain dashboards, metrics, and trend reports that communicate program effectiveness to leadership. DLP Triage & Processing · Own the end-to-end triage lifecycle for DLP alerts across endpoints, cloud environments (M365, Google Workspace, AWS), and email — from initial alert review through disposition and escalation. · Classify and prioritize incidents by sensitivity, intent, and potential business impact; apply consistent triage frameworks to ensure efficient and defensible case handling. · Identify policy gaps, false-positive patterns, and emerging exfiltration vectors; recommend DLP policy refinements to reduce risk while minimizing friction for legitimate business activities. · Maintain accurate, timely case records in the case management system, ensuring chain-of-custody integrity for all evidence. Investigations · Lead and conduct end-to-end investigations of potential insider risk incidents — including IP theft, data exfiltration, policy violations, sabotage, and pre-departure data staging. · Collect, preserve, and analyze digital evidence from endpoint forensics, cloud storage, communication platforms, and HR systems in accordance with legal and evidentiary standards. · Produce comprehensive, well-structured investigation reports documenting findings, timelines, impact assessments, and recommended actions suitable for legal, HR, and executive audiences. · Manage multiple concurrent active investigations with rigor, discretion, and appropriate urgency. Subject Interviews · Plan and conduct structured subject interviews in coordination with Legal, HR, and business leadership — applying established interview methodologies tailored to insider risk contexts (e.g., cognitive interviewing, motivational interviewing). · Conduct witness interviews to gather corroborating information and context; document findings with accuracy and impartiality. · Maintain composure and objectivity in sensitive, adversarial, or emotionally charged interview settings; protect subject dignity while gathering actionable intelligence. Legal Collaboration & Case Adjudication · Partner closely with Legal and Employment Law to ensure investigations comply with applicable labor laws, privacy regulations, and evidentiary standards across all operating jurisdictions (U.S., India, Israel, EU, and Asia-Pacific). · Present investigation findings, evidence packages, and risk assessments to Legal and HR for case adjudication — including decisions on disciplinary action, civil litigation, criminal referral, or administrative closure. · Support the preparation of materials for regulatory inquiries, litigation holds, and law enforcement cooperation when required. · Track and document case dispositions and lessons learned to continuously improve program policy and legal defensibility. Threat Intelligence & Risk Program Development · Develop and maintain an insider threat intelligence capability — tracking threat actor TTPs relevant to the semiconductor industry, including economic espionage, nation-state recruitment, and supply chain manipulation. · Produce threat intelligence products (briefings, advisories, risk reports) for security leadership, HR, and business unit heads to inform enterprise risk decisions. · Monitor the external threat landscape, including geopolitical developments, export control changes, and industry-specific threat reporting from CISA, FBI, and

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

**Skill Requirement :** Required · 7+ years of progressive experience in insider threat, corporate investigations, counterintelligence, digital forensics, or a closely related security discipline. · Demonstrated expertise with DLP platforms (e.g., Microsoft Purview, Symantec DLP, Forcepoint, Zscaler) including policy tuning, triage workflows, and incident adjudication. · Proficiency with SIEM platforms (XSIAM, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, or equivalent) and UEBA/UAM tools for behavioral analysis and anomaly detection. · Hands-on experience conducting complex civil or corporate investigations — from initial tip through evidence collection, interviews, reporting, and legal referral. · Experience conducting structured subject interviews and witness interviews in a corporate or law enforcement context. · Proven ability to work cross-functionally with Legal, HR, IT, and senior leadership in a highly confidential environment. · Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to translate complex technical findings into clear, actionable narratives for non-technical audiences. · Demonstrated knowledge of applicable privacy and employment laws across multiple jurisdictions (particularly U.S., EU GDPR, and Asia-Pacific regimes). · Hands-on experience operating AI-powered insider risk or UEBA platforms — including use case configuration, cohort/module development, and risk score tuning — with a clear understanding of how AI-assisted detection outputs translate into investigation workflows. Preferred · Prior experience in the semiconductor, defense technology, or critical technology sectors with heightened awareness of IP protection. · Experience in or with federal law enforcement, intelligence community, or military counterintelligence. · Background in threat intelligence production (STIX/TAXII, indicator management, adversary TTP analysis). · Familiarity with digital forensic tools (EnCase, FTK, Cellebrite, or equivalent) and e-discovery platforms. · Experience with SOAR platforms and automation of investigation workflows. · Knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK; for Enterprise and Insider Threat frameworks. · Experience using generative AI / LLM tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude, or similar) to accelerate investigative analysis, summarize case evidence, draft reports, or build detection logic. · Familiarity with the ethical, legal, and governance considerations of deploying AI in a workforce monitoring context, including explainability requirements and bias mitigation. Education & Certifications · Bachelor\'s degree in Cybersecurity, Criminal Justice, Intelligence Studies, Computer Science, or a related field; advanced degree a plus. · Relevant professional certifications valued: CISSP, CISM, CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner), CFCE, EnCE, CCITP (CERT Insider Threat Professional), or equivalent.

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

**Other Requirement :** You think like an investigator AND a data analyst — equally comfortable in a boardroom briefing and deep in SIEM query language. You harness AI as a force multiplier — you know how to configure detection use cases, build meaningful cohorts, and tune behavioral modules without losing sight of the human judgment that makes investigations defensible. You operate with impeccable judgment and discretion — you understand that access to sensitive data and AI-assisted monitoring is a privilege with strict ethical obligations. You are proactive, not reactive — you identify and reduce risk before incidents occur. You build trust across organizational boundaries — Legal trusts your evidence, HR trusts your process, and business leaders trust your judgment. You thrive in ambiguity and complexity — insider risk rarely comes neatly packaged, and you know how to structure uncertainty into defensible conclusions.

description:

**Job Overview**

**Salesforce Lead – Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform**

**Experience:** 7–10 Years  
**Location:** Kochi / Bangalore / Hyderabad (Hybrid)

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced and highly capable **Salesforce Lead** to drive the technical delivery of our next-generation **Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform** powered by Salesforce, Agentforce, AI, Data Cloud, and MuleSoft.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role for professionals who can **lead development teams, guide solution design, mentor developers and senior developers, and closely partner with architects to deliver scalable enterprise solutions**. The ideal candidate combines deep Salesforce platform expertise with strong people leadership, delivery ownership, and architectural thinking.

As a Salesforce Lead, you will be responsible for translating business and platform strategy into high-quality technical solutions while ensuring adherence to architecture, governance, security, and engineering best practices. You will lead cross-functional teams building intelligent service management experiences across Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Agentforce, Enterprise Service Management (ESM), ITSM, CMDB, IT Asset Management, and enterprise integrations.

This role offers an opportunity to play a key leadership position in shaping the future of AI-powered service management and conversational enterprise platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Leadership & Delivery**

* Lead a team of Salesforce Developers and Senior Salesforce Developers across multiple workstreams.
* Provide technical leadership throughout the full software development lifecycle, from solution design to production deployment.
* Partner closely with Salesforce Architects to translate architectural vision into scalable and maintainable technical solutions.
* Own technical delivery, ensuring solutions meet business, security, scalability, and performance requirements.
* Drive estimation, sprint planning, technical task allocation, and delivery execution.
* Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and architecture compliance reviews.
* Establish and enforce Salesforce development standards, coding conventions, CI/CD processes, and governance frameworks.

**Solution Design & Development**

* Lead the design and development of Salesforce solutions supporting the organization's Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform.
* Design scalable solutions leveraging Salesforce Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Platform, and Agentforce capabilities.
* Build intelligent service experiences utilizing Agentforce, AI-driven workflows, conversational experiences, and autonomous service capabilities.
* Design and develop complex solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, Platform Events, Integration Patterns, and Salesforce APIs.
* Guide implementation of enterprise service management processes including:
  + Incident Management
  + Service Request Management
  + Change Management
  + Problem Management
  + Knowledge Management
  + Employee Support Services
  + CMDB Management
  + IT Asset Management
  + Service Catalog Management

**Integration & Enterprise Architecture**

* Lead enterprise integration initiatives using MuleSoft and API-led connectivity patterns.
* Design reusable integration frameworks connecting Salesforce with ITSM, ERP, HR, Monitoring, Collaboration, Identity, and Business Systems.
* Collaborate with enterprise architects and integration teams to ensure platform interoperability and data consistency.
* Drive API governance, performance optimization, security controls, and integration best practices.

**Team Leadership & Mentoring**

* Mentor Salesforce Developers and Senior Developers through coaching, design guidance, and hands-on technical support.
* Support career development and capability building within the Salesforce team.
* Identify skill gaps and define technical learning and certification roadmaps.
* Foster a culture of engineering excellence, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Act as the primary technical escalation point for complex solution and production challenges.

**AI & Platform Innovation**

* Champion adoption of Agentforce, Generative AI, Data Cloud, and emerging Salesforce innovations.
* Guide implementation of conversational AI, agentic workflows, intelligent automation, and self-service experiences.
* Evaluate new platform capabilities and recommend innovative solutions that improve service delivery and operational efficiency.
* Contribute to strategic platform roadmaps and technology decision-making.

**Required Qualifications**

**Must Have**

* 7 to 10 years of Salesforce platform experience with at least 2-3 years in a technical lead role.
* Strong hands-on expertise across:
  + Service Cloud
  + Sales Cloud
  + Experience Cloud
  + Salesforce Platform
* Deep technical expertise in:
  + Apex
  + Lightning Web Components (LWC)
  + Salesforce Flows
  + SOQL/SOSL
  + Platform Events
  + Integration Patterns
  + REST/SOAP APIs
  + Salesforce Security Model
* Strong experience with large-scale Salesforce implementations and enterprise delivery programs.
* Experience leading and mentoring development teams.
* Experience working alongside solution architects and enterprise architects.
* Proven ability to drive technical decision-making and delivery governance.
* Strong understanding of:
  + Data Architecture
  + Security & Sharing Models
  + DevOps & CI/CD
  + Release Management
  + Application Lifecycle Management
* Experience in Agile, Scrum, and DevOps-driven environments.
* Strong stakeholder communication and leadership skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing Enterprise Service Management (ESM) and IT Service Management (ITSM) solutions.
* Experience with:
  + CMDB
  + IT Asset Management (ITAM)
  + Service Catalog
  + Enterprise Operations Management
* Hands-on experience with MuleSoft and API Management.
* Experience working in global delivery models.
* Salesforce Platform Developer I & II Certifications.
* Salesforce Application Architect or System Architect Certification.
* Scrum Master, SAFe, or Agile certifications.

**Added Advantage**

* Hands-on experience with Salesforce Agentforce.
* Experience building Conversational AI and autonomous service experiences.
* Exposure to Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, Agentic AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts.
* Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud.
* Experience delivering Digital Transformation and Enterprise Automation initiatives.
* Knowledge of Service Operations, ITIL, or Enterprise Service Management frameworks.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are seeking professionals who:

* Think like technical leaders while remaining hands-on contributors.
* Can successfully lead teams while maintaining a strong engineering mindset.
* Are comfortable partnering with architects and influencing platform strategy.
* Enjoy solving complex enterprise-scale technology challenges.
* Can balance delivery excellence, innovation, governance, and stakeholder expectations.
* Are passionate about Agentforce, AI, Conversational Platforms, and Intelligent Automation.
* Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and strong decision-making capabilities.
* Thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

**Why Join Us?**

* Lead the technical delivery of a strategic Salesforce-powered Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform.
* Work with cutting-edge technologies including Agentforce, AI, Data Cloud, MuleSoft, and Enterprise Automation.
* Influence platform architecture and engineering direction.
* Lead and mentor a high-performing Salesforce engineering team.
* Collaborate with architects, integration specialists, AI engineers, and business leaders.

* Be part of a rapidly growing organization where innovation and impact are valued.

If you are a seasoned Salesforce professional with a passion for technical leadership, team mentoring, enterprise-scale solution delivery, and AI-driven innovation, we invite you to join us in building the future of **Conversational Agentic ITSM on Salesforce**. This role offers the opportunity to combine **technical excellence, people leadership, and architectural influence** while shaping a transformative platform that redefines enterprise service management.

Core Mission
  
  
The Enterprise Applied AI Solution Specialist is a hands-on engineer who builds and deploys practical AI solutions that improve internal workflows and employee productivity. The role focuses on implementing agentic and Generative AI features using established patterns, grounded in enterprise knowledge and data.
  
  
This individual partners closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into usable, reliable capabilities while operating within enterprise constraints such as security, governance, and user trust. The position is ideal for a builder who ships, iterates quickly, and continuously improves solution quality through feedback and measurement.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
This is a delivery-focused role combining hands-on implementation with light product ownership and operational discipline.
  
  
1. Applied Solution Delivery & Iteration (65% of time)
  
Build and enhance AI-powered features (e.g., copilots, summarization, classification, routing, Q&A) aligned to defined business workflows.
  
Partner with business users to clarify requirements, run demos, capture feedback, and iterate toward measurable outcomes.
  
Support pilot launches, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to smooth adoption through user training and clear documentation.
  
  
2. Knowledge-Based Agents & Conversational Design (25% of time)
  
Develop agents grounded in the company’s internal knowledge base, using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns and retrieval quality improvements.
  
Design conversational flows for internal functions (e.g., HR helpdesk), including intent handling, escalation paths, and handoff to human support when needed.
  
Implement simple agentic or predictive models for operational use cases (e.g., predicting customer support ticket volume) under guidance from senior engineers.
  
  
3. Product Execution, Quality & Documentation (10% of time)
  
Manage the feature backlog for an AI product area: write user stories, define acceptance criteria, and coordinate UAT.
  
Contribute to evaluation and regression testing using approved checklists; help monitor quality, latency, and cost for deployed features.
  
Create and maintain documentation (how-to guides, runbooks, and user enablement materials) to support long-term sustainability.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
3+ years of experience in software engineering or applied solutions development (or equivalent practical experience).
  
Proficiency in Python and API-based integration; working knowledge of SQL and data access patterns.
  
Working familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
  
Exposure to agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or similar) and the ability to implement tool/function calling patterns.
  
Basic understanding of enterprise security, privacy, and data governance requirements; ability to follow established guardrails and escalate risks early.
  
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
  
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  
Ideal Candidate Profile: Who Thrives in This Role
  
Builders Over Theorists: You enjoy shipping working software and iterating based on user feedback.
  
User-Centered Mindset: You like sitting with users, mapping workflows, and improving day-to-day productivity.
  
Pragmatic Technologist: You choose simple, reliable approaches and adopt new techniques when they clearly improve outcomes.
  
Quality-Driven: You care about correctness, safety, and operational reliability, and you follow established production standards.
  
Continuous Learner: You stay current on rapidly evolving GenAI capabilities and apply them responsibly.
  
Generous Collaborator: You document clearly, communicate proactively, and work well across teams.

title: Associate HRIS Analyst, Workday Operations
description:
Join our Global Workforce Systems team as an Associate HRIS Analyst, Workday Operations and quickly expand your Workday knowledge through hands-on experience. You will manage JIRA tickets, process routine Workday transactions, maintain accurate employee data, and support process documentation. We are looking for someone with one to two years of Workday experience who is curious, careful, and committed to delivering accurate results.  
  
This is a regular, full-time position based in Bangalore, India and requires a work schedule that provides coverage during core U.S. business hours.

**What You'll Do**

* Serve as the first level of review and support for HRIS and Workday requests submitted through JIRA, ensuring requests are acknowledged, assessed, and appropriately routed.
* Support the day-to-day management of the JIRA ticket queue by reviewing new tickets, prioritizing routine requests according to established guidelines, monitoring aging items, updating statuses, and following up as needed.
* Evaluate incoming tickets for completeness, urgency, business impact, dependencies, and appropriate next steps.
* Resolve routine Workday questions, requests, transactions, and data issues using established procedures and documented solutions.
* Proactively request missing information or clarification when a ticket does not contain sufficient details to investigate or complete the request accurately.
* Escalate complex, high-risk, time-sensitive, or unresolved issues to the appropriate HRIS team member with clear documentation of the issue, troubleshooting performed, supporting information, and recommended next steps.
* Maintain complete and timely JIRA documentation, including the original request, investigation performed, actions taken, stakeholder communication, decisions, and final resolution.
* Monitor open tickets and dependencies and proactively follow up when information, approvals, testing, or action is outstanding.
* Identify tickets at risk of missing established service expectations or deadlines and escalate appropriately.
* Complete assigned routine Workday transactions and employee data updates across the employee lifecycle, according to established procedures, approval requirements, and role-based access.
* Review source documentation and validate key information, including employee names, dates, organizations, positions, statuses, and other relevant data, before completing Workday transactions.
* Perform post-transaction quality checks and follow documented validation steps to confirm that changes were processed accurately, escalating unexpected results or potential downstream impacts.
* Research employee and HRIS data discrepancies, reconcile information between source documentation and Workday, resolve routine issues, and escalate exceptions when necessary.
* Support Workday testing for system updates, enhancements, fixes, and configuration changes, including executing test scripts, validating expected results, documenting defects, and tracking issues through resolution.
* Assist with documenting and maintaining HRIS workflows and process maps, including process steps, responsibilities, handoffs, and escalation paths.
* Develop and maintain SOPs, process guides, job aids, user instructions, FAQs, and HRIS knowledge articles to improve consistency and reduce repeat questions.
* Review existing workflows and documentation periodically to ensure they remain accurate and aligned with current Workday functionality and business processes.
* Identify recurring tickets, data issues, bottlenecks, or manual processes and share observations and potential improvement opportunities with the HRIS team.
* Support routine data audits, reconciliations, and validation activities to maintain HRIS data integrity.
* Prepare, send, track, and validate manual HR notifications, ensuring communications are accurate, timely, and sent to the appropriate recipients.
* Partner collaboratively with Talent & Culture (HR), Payroll, Benefits, Talent Acquisition, Compensation, IT, and other stakeholders as necessary to investigate and resolve HRIS requests.
* Handle employee and organizational data in accordance with established privacy, confidentiality, and information-security requirements.

**What You Bring**

* 1–2 years of experience supporting Workday within HR, HRIS, People Operations, Shared Services, or a similar environment.
* Hands-on experience reviewing or processing employee data and transactions in Workday.
* Experience using JIRA or a comparable ticket/case-management platform, including reviewing, assigning, prioritizing, documenting, tracking, escalating, and resolving support requests.
* Demonstrated ability to manage a ticket queue independently, balance competing priorities, and follow requests through to resolution.
* Experience creating or maintaining workflows, process documentation, SOPs, job aids, or knowledge articles.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify missing, inconsistent, or potentially inaccurate information.
* A proactive approach to work, including the ability to identify outstanding actions, anticipate potential issues, and follow up without waiting for direction.
* Strong problem-solving and investigative skills with the judgment to distinguish between issues that can be resolved independently and those requiring escalation.
* Ability to follow detailed procedures while recognizing opportunities to improve existing processes.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple tickets, recurring responsibilities, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical or process-related information in a way that is understandable to different audiences.
* Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues and stakeholders across teams, locations, and time zones.
* Ability to appropriately handle confidential employee and organizational information.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

**What Will Help You Succeed**

* Experience supporting Workday Core HCM and one or more related areas such as Recruiting, Benefits, Compensation, Talent, Absence, or other employee lifecycle functionality.
* Experience with JIRA-based HRIS support operations, including queue management, ticket prioritization, escalation, and reporting.
* Experience creating process maps and end-to-end workflow documentation.
* Experience conducting employee data audits, reconciliations, or validation activities.
* Familiarity with system-testing practices, including executing Workday test scripts, validating results, documenting defects, and supporting issue resolution.
* Ability to identify patterns across support tickets and recommend improvements through documentation, process changes, training, automation, or system enhancements.
* Demonstrated ownership and initiative: actively monitoring the queue, recognizing what needs attention, following up on stalled requests, surfacing risks, and communicating when escalation is required.

title: Assistant Manager – Finance & Administration
description:
About the Role

Anoud Technologies is looking for an experienced Assistant Manager – Finance & Administration to support the Finance Head in running day-to-day finance operations from our Chennai office. You will own the accuracy of payments, reconciliations, MIS, payroll and statutory filings (GST, TDS), support budgeting, audits and financial reporting, and coordinate procurement and office administration. The role suits a hands-on finance professional who combines strong technical accounting with sound controls, ownership and stakeholder management.

Key Responsibilities

**Finance Operations & Controls**

* Support the oversight of daily Finance Department operations, ensuring all activities follow approved policies, procedures and the Delegation of Authority (DoA) Matrix.
* Review utility, supplier and vendor payments for accuracy and completeness before they go for approval and processing.
* Monitor and verify bank reconciliations across all company accounts, and drive timely closure of outstanding reconciling items.
* Maintain fixed asset records and strengthen internal control processes.

**Accounting, Reporting & Analysis**

* Assist in managing accounting, financial reporting, budgeting and forecasting.
* Prepare monthly MIS reports and carry out financial analysis to support management decisions.
* Support quarterly and annual financial statement preparation, and coordinate internal and external audits.
* Track project costs, budget variances, cash flow and operational expenses.

**Payroll & Statutory Compliance**

* Oversee payroll processing, vendor payments and bank reconciliations.
* Ensure timely and accurate statutory compliance, including GST and TDS.

**Procurement & Administration**

* Coordinate procurement activities, vendor management and office administration functions.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 7 to 12 years of relevant experience in finance, accounts and compliance.
* Strong working knowledge of Indian accounting standards (Ind AS / Indian GAAP), GST, TDS, payroll processing and statutory compliance.
* Hands-on experience in budgeting, forecasting and financial reporting.
* Good understanding of financial analysis, MIS reporting, cash flow management and internal controls.
* Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
* Experience with ERP systems is an added advantage.

Behavioural Competencies

* Clear communication and strong stakeholder management skills.
* Analytical, problem-solving mindset with close attention to detail.
* Ability to prioritise, handle multiple assignments and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Self-motivated and proactive, with ownership and accountability for assigned work.
* Team player who coordinates smoothly with finance, operations, HR, procurement and external stakeholders.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to changing business needs.
* High integrity and confidentiality, with commitment to organisational objectives.

* Client Reporting: Prepare and review periodic and ad hoc client reports, maintaining consistency, clarity, and compliance with client requirements.

* Aladdin Accounting Experience: Utilise Aladdin or similar investment accounting platforms for data management, reconciliation, and reporting functions.

* Expertise in handling multiple asset classes.
* Proficiency with Aladdin or equivalent investment accounting systems.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines effectively.

title: SAP CPM-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Consulting – SAP – CPM Functional – Manager:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a skilled SAP Commercial Project Management (CPM) Consultant to support the design, implementation, enhancement, and maintenance of SAP CPM solutions. The role offers a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of large-scale SAP transformation programs while developing expertise at the intersection of finance, strategy, project delivery, and commercial management.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Commercial Project Governance**

* Act as the commercial lead for SAP implementation, support, migration, and transformation programs.
* Establish and maintain commercial governance frameworks across project portfolios.
* Support project leadership in ensuring projects are delivered within approved budgets, schedules, and contractual commitments.
* Drive project profitability while balancing customer satisfaction and delivery objectives.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, financial controls, and regulatory requirements.

**Financial Management & Project Controlling**

* Own project financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting activities.
* Monitor project revenue, costs, gross margins, and cash flow performance.
* Analyze project financial health and proactively identify variances against forecasts.
* Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reviews.
* Drive corrective actions to improve project profitability and financial performance.
* Ensure accurate revenue recognition and project accounting in line with corporate and statutory requirements.

**Contract & Commercial Management**

* Review customer contracts, Statements of Work (SOWs), Master Service Agreements (MSAs), and change requests.
* Ensure contractual obligations, commercial terms, and project assumptions are properly managed.
* Identify contractual risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Lead commercial negotiations related to scope changes, claims management, and contract amendments.
* Support bid reviews and project handovers from sales to delivery teams.

**Risk Management**

* Identify financial, contractual, operational, and compliance risks throughout the project lifecycle.
* Develop risk mitigation plans and track closure of identified risks.
* Monitor project performance indicators and escalate issues proactively.
* Support contingency planning and financial recovery strategies where applicable.

**Portfolio & Business Performance Management**

* Manage commercial oversight for multiple SAP projects and accounts.
* Track portfolio-level financial metrics including revenue, backlog, utilization, margin, and working capital.
* Provide insights and recommendations to improve overall business performance.
* Support leadership with dashboards, KPIs, and executive reporting.

**Change Request and Scope Management**

* Ensure all scope changes are formally assessed and approved.
* Quantify financial and commercial impacts of project changes.
* Collaborate with delivery and customer stakeholders to secure change order approvals.
* Maximize revenue realization through effective scope management.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with Project Managers, Program Managers, Delivery Leads, and Customer Executives.
* Serve as a trusted advisor on commercial and financial matters.
* Communicate project financial performance to senior leadership and stakeholders.
* Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support successful project execution.

**Compliance & Audit Support**

* Ensure compliance with organizational policies and governance requirements.
* Support internal and external audits.
* Maintain project documentation supporting financial and commercial decisions.
* Ensure adherence to revenue recognition, procurement, and financial reporting standards.

**Team Leadership & People Development**

* Mentor and coach junior CPM professionals and project controllers.
* Drive best practices in commercial management across SAP programs.
* Contribute to organizational capability development and process improvements.
* Participate in recruitment, performance management, and career development activities.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 8+ years of experience in project financial management, commercial management, project controlling, or program governance.
* Experience in SAP implementation, ERP transformation, managed services, or consulting environments.
* Strong understanding of project accounting, budgeting, forecasting, and revenue recognition.
* Knowledge of contract management and commercial risk management principles.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
