title: Senior Manager - HR
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**SENIOR MANAGER – HR**

**Reporting To:** Managing Director & Administrative Director  
**Department:** Human Resources  
**Position Level:** Senior Management  
**Industry:** Manufacturing / Water & Wastewater Treatment / O&M / Projects  
**Location:** Tiruppur

**1. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Strategic Recruitment & Talent Acquisition – Primary Responsibility**

· Work closely with the Managing Director, Administrative Director and concerned HODs to understand current and upcoming manpower requirements.

· Coordinate with concerned HODs regarding the required number of positions, designation, department, location and manpower timeline.

· Ensure that the concerned HOD obtains the necessary management approval for the approved number of manpower requirements.

· Work with management to finalize or modify experience requirements and salary/CTC ranges, wherever required.

· Develop the overall recruitment strategy for each requirement and determine how the required manpower can be delivered within the stipulated timeline.

· Plan recruitment approaches based on the urgency, skill level, location, manpower volume and availability of candidates.

· Delegate recruitment activities to HR executives/junior team members and ensure that the assigned activities are completed within the required timelines.

· Monitor recruitment progress and intervene at the appropriate level whenever there are delays, challenges or critical hiring requirements.

· Personally handle critical recruitment decisions, senior-level discussions and management coordination.

· Conduct discussions with shortlisted candidates on salary/CTC, expectations, employment terms and other critical aspects.

· Lead salary negotiation and contract/employment-term negotiation with selected candidates.

· Take appropriate decisions regarding candidate selection, compensation and offer closure within the approved framework.

· Ensure successful closure and joining of candidates within the committed timeline.

· Ensure manpower is made available for projects, O&M operations and other business requirements within the required deployment timeline.

· Build a structured and scalable recruitment process to support continuous business growth.

**B. Manufacturing, Assembly & Engineering Recruitment**

The Senior Manager – HR will be responsible for driving recruitment primarily for non-IT functions, particularly:

· Manufacturing

· Production

· Assembly

· Process functions

· Design and Engineering

· Project Engineering

· O&M Engineering

· Technical functions

· Other manufacturing and engineering-related positions

Recruitment responsibility will cover blue-collar, technical, supervisory, managerial and senior white-collar positions, depending on business requirements.

The role will support recruitment requirements across South India and North India, including project and O&M locations.

**2. HR OPERATIONS & PAYROLL**

· Oversee the overall **HR operations and payroll process**.

· Ensure payroll activities are carried out accurately and within the prescribed timelines.

· Ensure employee records, attendance, leave, payroll inputs and related HR processes are properly maintained.

· Monitor the HR team responsible for payroll and HR operations.

· Ensure HR operational processes are functioning effectively and consistently.

· Review and resolve critical HR operational issues in coordination with the concerned team members.

**3. STATUTORY COMPLIANCE**

· Ensure that all applicable **statutory and labour-law requirements** are complied with.

· Ensure payroll and statutory activities are carried out as per applicable statutory norms and organizational requirements.

· Review the overall compliance status periodically.

· Ensure required records, documentation, filings and payments are maintained appropriately.

· Guide and monitor the HR team/executives handling day-to-day statutory activities.

· Coordinate with consultants or external agencies wherever required.

· Escalate any major compliance risks or deviations to management.

**4. TRAINING & DEVELOPMENT**

· Identify **training and development requirements** across departments.

· Discuss training requirements with HODs and management.

· Prepare an annual/monthly **training calendar**.

· Prepare and manage the **training budget**.

· Coordinate with internal mentors, subject-matter experts and external trainers.

· Plan and coordinate **monthly training programs**.

· Ensure appropriate technical, functional, behavioural and managerial development programs are conducted.

· Monitor employee participation and training effectiveness.

· Identify development requirements for individual employees and teams.

· Support continuous learning and employee capability development.

**5. PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT**

· Work closely with management and HODs to establish **Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** for employees.

· Ensure KPIs are aligned with departmental and organizational objectives.

· Establish a structured performance measurement process.

· Review employee performance periodically with concerned HODs and management.

· Evaluate performance from both **technical and behavioural perspectives**.

· Identify performance gaps and development requirements.

· Support performance improvement plans wherever required.

· Coordinate the appraisal and performance review process.

· Ensure performance management is implemented consistently across the organization.

**6. HR POLICIES & EMPLOYEE ENGAGEMENT**

· Support management in developing and implementing effective **HR policies and procedures**.

· Review existing HR policies and recommend improvements wherever required.

· Ensure policies are communicated and implemented consistently.

· Develop employee engagement initiatives.

· Support employee motivation, recognition and retention initiatives.

· Maintain a positive and professional work environment.

· Act as an HR partner to HODs and management in resolving employee-related matters.

**7. TEAM MANAGEMENT & LEADERSHIP**

· Lead and manage the HR/recruitment team.

· Delegate recruitment and HR operational activities to appropriate team members.

· Set priorities and timelines for the HR team.

· Monitor the performance and productivity of HR executives and team members.

· Ensure recruitment activities are completed within agreed timelines.

· Mentor and develop junior HR team members.

· Provide guidance and support to the team in handling complex HR matters.

· Ensure clear accountability and ownership within the HR function.

**8. CANDIDATE PROFILE**

· Strong experience in Human Resources with significant exposure to recruitment.

· Proven experience in non-IT recruitment, preferably in manufacturing, engineering, assembly, industrial, EPC, infrastructure or similar sectors.

· Strong understanding of recruitment for technical, engineering, manufacturing and operational positions.

· Experience in handling recruitment from blue-collar to white-collar positions.

· Experience in handling recruitment requirements across multiple geographical locations.

· Strong experience in salary/CTC negotiation and employment/contract negotiation.

· Strong stakeholder management and management coordination skills.

· Experience in leading and managing an HR/recruitment team.

· Strong knowledge of HR operations, payroll and statutory compliance.

· Good experience in training & development and performance management.

description:

**Job Description**

At Prolifics, we are currently implementing multiple solutions, and we are looking to hire Change Management Lead for our development centre in India. This position would be based out of Hyderabad and is a permanent position.

If you are looking for a high growth company with rock-solid stability, if you thrive in the energetic atmosphere of high-profile projects, we want to talk to you today! Let’s connect and explore possibilities of having you onboard the Prolifics team!

Job Title: Change Management Lead

Primary Skill: Lead change management activities across technology, product, process, and organizational transformation initiatives.  
Secondary Skill: Assess the business and organizational impact of proposed changes across different user groups and functions.  
Location: Hyderabad
  
Educational Qualification: B.Tech/BE/M.Tech/MCA/M.Sc  
YOE: 5-10 yrs

**Job Description:**

We are looking for an experienced Change Management professional to lead organizational change initiatives associated with technology implementations, product launches, process transformations, and business change programs.

The role will be responsible for assessing the impact of change, preparing stakeholders and end users, developing communication and training strategies, managing adoption, and ensuring that changes are successfully embedded into day-to-day operations.

The ideal candidate will have strong stakeholder management, communication, training, and organizational change skills, with the ability to work across business, technology, product, and delivery teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead change management activities across technology, product, process, and organizational transformation initiatives.
* Assess the business and organizational impact of proposed changes across different user groups and functions.
* Develop and execute comprehensive Change Management and Adoption Plans.
* Identify impacted stakeholders, user groups, processes, systems, and business functions.
* Develop stakeholder maps and assess stakeholder readiness, influence, impact, and potential resistance.
* Partner with business leaders, Product Owners, Project Managers, Technology teams, HR, Training, and Communications teams.
* Develop effective communication strategies and messaging for different stakeholder groups.
* Create and manage communication materials including announcements, newsletters, FAQs, presentations, executive updates, and change notifications.
* Develop training and enablement strategies aligned with the change roadmap.
* Coordinate training, demonstrations, workshops, knowledge-transfer sessions, and user enablement activities.
* Work with Technical Writers and Product Trainers to ensure documentation and training materials are aligned with the new processes and product capabilities.
* Establish stakeholder engagement plans and conduct regular readiness and feedback sessions.
* Identify potential resistance to change and develop appropriate mitigation and engagement strategies.
* Monitor adoption, user readiness, training completion, and change effectiveness.
* Develop and track change readiness and adoption metrics.
* Gather feedback from users and stakeholders and use insights to improve adoption.
* Support UAT, pilot programs, rollout planning, go-live, and post-production stabilization.
* Develop transition and operational-readiness plans to ensure smooth movement from project delivery to business-as-usual operations.
* Coordinate change activities across multiple locations, business units, and geographically distributed teams.
* Maintain change management risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and action items.
* Provide regular status updates and executive-level reporting on change readiness, adoption, risks, and key actions.
* Establish reusable change management frameworks, templates, processes, and best practices.

**About us:**

**Prolifics Corporation Limited** is a Global Technology Solutions Provider with presence across North America (USA and Canada), Europe (UK and Germany), Middle East & Asia. In India, we have offshore development centers: 3 in Hyderabad & 1 in Pune.

For more than 40 years, Prolifics has transformed enterprises of all sizes including over 100 Fortune 1000 companies by solving their complex IT challenges. Our clients include Fortune 50 and Fortune 100 companies across a broad range of industries including Financial Services, Insurance, Government, Healthcare, Telecommunications, Manufacturing and Retail. We rank consistently in **Dream Companies to Work For**and**Dream Employer of the Year**ranking from World HRD Congress, ranked 7 in 2019.

We encourage you to visit us on **www.prolifics.com** or follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube and other social media to know more about us.

title: Delivery Director
description:
We are Two Circles. We are a Sports & Entertainment Marketing business. We grow audiences and revenues by knowing fans best.

We work with clients to help them understand and influence fan behaviour — how fans spend their money, the events they attend, the channels they respond to, and the content they engage with. We use this understanding to help our clients grow both direct-to-consumer and business-to-business revenues.

Our platforms and services are trusted by over 1,000 clients globally, including the English Premier League, Red Bull, UEFA, VISA, the NFL, Nike and Amazon. We are over 1,000 people, based across 15 offices worldwide, delivering work for sports and entertainment organisations of all shapes and sizes.

India is a long-term commitment for Two Circles. We're already trusted by the BCCI, one of the biggest and most important properties in world sport, and our Hyderabad office sits at the heart of that relationship. Being here, and succeeding here, is central to how we build a better future for the sports and entertainment industry globally.

Hyderabad is a Two Circles office, not a GCC. Today it's tech-centric, but our ambition is to diversify what we build here over time, growing into a broad Two Circles presence rather than staying confined to technology propositions.

We're looking for a Delivery Director to lead our Hyderabad delivery organisation: a team of around 50 engineers, QA and delivery specialists, and still growing. This is a hands-on leadership role, not a governance role sitting apart from the work. You'll take direct ownership of how delivery runs day to day, build a high-performing team, and set the tone for its spirit.

You'll report to our APAC Managing Director, with a dotted line to our Engineering Directors for Data and for Digital Products & CRM, who hold technical direction for their respective practices. As the most senior Two Circles leader in Hyderabad, you'll also play an important role in our work with BCCI, our most important partner in India.

We want Hyderabad to be known, by 2029, not just for delivering the work, but for shaping it, owning it, and making it better. That means more ownership of outcomes, greater exposure to our clients and their problems, more leaders and careers built from within Hyderabad, and a reputation for ideas, innovation and smart use of AI, all while protecting the spirit and connection that makes Two Circles what it is as we grow. You'll be the person most accountable for getting us there.

Leading the Team and Its Spirit

* Lead, grow and retain the India delivery team, including recruitment, onboarding and development of new team members.
* Co-own the spirit of our Hyderabad office with our HR Lead. You'll treat this as a core part of your job, not something handed off to the HR team. You will be the role model of Two Circles spirit in the office.
* Build an India leadership layer of Engineering Managers, QA leadership and delivery leadership. Embed progression frameworks, career pathways and regular, structured feedback.
* Be a visible, accessible leader in the office. Build strong relationships and encourage the face-to-face collaboration that builds trust and improves delivery.

Delivery and Engineering Excellence

* Own the software delivery lifecycle across India projects, with consistent processes that drive quality and predictability.
* Oversee QA and release management standards across India builds, aligned with our global standards.
* Stay close to the work: attend key governance forums, review delivery health weekly, and step in when projects need support.
* Partner with our Tech Leads and Engineering Directors to ensure technical standards and architectural approaches are followed and executed well.
* Embed the agentic engineering practices being rolled out across our global teams. Drive adoption in India and share what you learn.
* Help the India team take increasing ownership of outcomes end-to-end, including design, not just execution, and reduce reliance on other regions to unblock problems.

Performance, Metrics and Governance

* Create and run a monthly governance process and health report for the India team, covering hiring, onboarding, attrition, utilisation, quality, performance and progress on major initiatives.
* Own delivery, quality and team health metrics, including code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues. Track how project leaders elsewhere in the business rate the India team's work.
* Own utilisation and cost efficiency across India delivery. Propose the India hiring plan and work with Delivery Directors globally on resource planning and hotspots.
* Keep any scorecard or metrics simple and supportive, not a tool that creates pressure. Psychological safety and performance measurement need to be built together, not treated as separate things.

Client Leadership

* Act as Client Lead for BCCI: our most senior relationship owner in India, accountable for client governance and margin efficiency. We'd expect this to take up roughly 10% of your time.
* Represent our engineering and delivery capability in client meetings in India, drawing on the work we deliver globally.

Global Collaboration

* Give leadership upward visibility, and give teams clarity on priorities, outcomes and decisions.
* Work with Directors in Melbourne, London and Vancouver to develop operating models that let teams work smoothly across regions.
* Help Hyderabad become a knowledge hub, not just a delivery team: bring in what's working well from London, Melbourne and Vancouver, and feed Hyderabad's own innovations back out to the rest of the business.
* Work effectively across time zones and cultures, bringing structure and clarity to complex, global work.

What Success Looks Like in Your First Year

* A high-performing team, shown in hard metrics such as code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues, and in strong feedback from the project leaders the team works with across regions.
* A strong spirit in our Hyderabad office, measured against our regular pulse checks.
* Our agentic engineering practices widely adopted across the India team.
* A clear monthly view of the India team's health, shared with the wider business through a regular governance process.
* An India leadership layer in place that can support continued growth.

  
**Requirements**

Proven experience building, scaling and leading complex delivery organisations at scale (50+ people) spanning engineering, QA and delivery, including experience managing managers.

* A delivery and operator mindset first. Genuine fluency across data and digital product engineering, sufficient to work credibly with Tech Leads and architects on trade-offs, quality and risk, without requiring a hands-on engineering background yourself.
* Senior client-facing experience in a services, agency or consultancy business.
* Experience working within a multi-region or global delivery model.
* Hands-on ownership of the software delivery lifecycle, delivery processes, resourcing and talent management.
* A demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders without formal authority, across technical, commercial and client audiences.
* An interest in AI-enabled development practices and the drive to lead their adoption.
* Fluent in English, written and spoken.
* Eligible to work in India.

Nice to Have

* A formal delivery or PMO background, or certification (Scrum, PRINCE2 or equivalent).
* Familiarity with the platforms we build on (CMS, identity, video, CRM and e-commerce) and modern cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.

Location and Travel

Based in Hyderabad or willing to relocate to Hyderabad.

Able to travel to Vancouver, London, and Melbourne twice a year.

title: Manager IT Business Services
description:
**Who We Are**

Solera is a leading global technology and data solutions provider, specializing in the automotive industry that strives to transform every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. In addition, we provide products and services to protect life’s other most important assets: our homes and digital identities. Today, Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our 6,500 team members foster an uncommon, innovative culture and are dedicated to successfully bringing the future to bear today through cognitive answers, insights, algorithms and automation. For more information, please visit solera.com.

**The Role**

The Manager is responsible for leading global **Tier 1 and Tier 2 IT support operations**, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, efficient, and scalable support services for end users across the organization.

The role directly manages **4 Team Leads** and provides overall leadership for a team of approximately **24 IT Business Services professionals located in Hyderabad, India**. The Senior Manager oversees the Service Desk and Remote Services functions while partnering with HR, Security, Enterprise Applications, and other IT organizations to drive operational excellence, service automation, access management, employee lifecycle services, continuous improvement, and an exceptional end-user experience.

This leader is responsible for developing talent, driving accountability, improving service delivery performance, and ensuring the organization continues to mature its support operations while delivering reliable global IT services.

**What You’ll Do**

**Core Requirements**

**Leadership**  
Lead and develop a global team of Tier 1 and Tier 2 support professionals through multiple team leads, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and exceptional customer service.

**Global Service Delivery:**  
Ensure timely and effective resolution of incidents and service requests while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction and adherence to established SLAs, KPIs, and operational targets.

**Remote Operations:**  
Provide strategic oversight of Service Desk and Remote Services functions, ensuring consistent support experiences and efficient service delivery across multiple regions and time zones.

**Employee Lifecycle Management**

Lead global IT onboarding, offboarding, contingent worker provisioning, leave-of-absence support processes, and employee technology enablement activities to ensure a secure, seamless, and consistent employee experience.

**Access & Identity Services**

Oversee account provisioning, access management, role-based access models, access personas, entitlement reviews, and identity-related support processes while ensuring compliance with security and audit requirements.

**Incident, Request & Problem Management**

Drive operational excellence across incident, request, escalation, and problem management processes, ensuring recurring issues are identified, analyzed, and addressed through sustainable solutions and root cause analysis.

**Service Request Triage & Escalation Management**

Own support intake, ticket triage, escalation governance, and routing processes to ensure requests are assigned to the appropriate support teams and resolved efficiently while reducing unnecessary escalations and ticket transfers.

**Process Optimization & Service Automation**  
Identify opportunities to streamline and automate support processes, onboarding workflows, reporting activities, and employee lifecycle services to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance service quality.

**Knowledge Management & Training**  
Establish and maintain knowledge management programs, operational documentation, and training initiatives that improve first-contact resolution rates, accelerate team development, and ensure consistent support practices globally.

**Stakeholder Engagement**  
Partner closely with IT leadership, HR, Security, Finance, Enterprise Applications, and business stakeholders to align support services with organizational priorities and business objectives.

**Reporting & Service Analytics**  
Develop and maintain operational dashboards, KPIs, and management reporting to provide visibility into service performance, support trends, team productivity, and customer satisfaction while enabling data-driven decision making.

**Compliance, Audit & Governance**

Support SOX, ISO, security, and internal audit requirements through the implementation of appropriate operational controls, access governance processes, asset management standards, and policy compliance activities.

**Technology Enablement**

Leverage and support enterprise technologies including Microsoft 365, Intune, Entra ID (Azure AD), Teams, Zoom, Jira, endpoint management platforms, and automation tools to continuously improve end-user support capabilities and experiences.

**Timings**

Must be open to working in different shift timings to support USA/EMEA/APAC regions, as per business needs.

**What You’ll Bring**

**Required Qualifications**

8+ years of progressive experience in IT support, service management, or IT operations leadership.

5+ years of experience managing global support organizations, including geographically distributed teams.

Proven experience leading Tier 1 and Tier 2 support operations in a large enterprise environment.

title: Principal ServiceNow Architect – ITSM & Enterprise Workflow
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Principal ServiceNow Architect to lead the architecture, solution design, technical governance, and implementation of scalable ServiceNow solutions. The individual will be responsible for translating business and IT requirements into secure, maintainable, and upgrade-friendly platform capabilities aligned with ITIL best practices and enterprise architecture standards.

The role requires a strong combination of ServiceNow platform expertise, hands-on technical proficiency, ITSM process knowledge, integration architecture, and stakeholder management. The candidate must be capable of independently handling complex technical challenges, evaluating existing implementations, identifying architectural gaps, and driving solutions from design through deployment and operational support.

The architect will work closely with business stakeholders, ITSM process owners, platform administrators, developers, integration teams, infrastructure teams, security teams, and delivery leadership.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**1. Enterprise and Solution Architecture**

Define the ServiceNow platform architecture, technical standards, design principles, and implementation guidelines.

Translate business requirements and functional specifications into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions.

Lead architecture assessments, solution design reviews, technical feasibility assessments, and architectural decision-making.

Evaluate out-of-the-box capabilities against customization requirements and prioritize configuration over custom development wherever feasible.

Define reusable architectural patterns, application boundaries, data models, and integration approaches.

Maintain architecture documentation, solution design documents, technical specifications, and architecture decision records.

Assess existing implementations to identify technical debt, architectural inconsistencies, performance bottlenecks, and opportunities for simplification.

**2. ITSM and ITIL Process Architecture**

Design and govern ServiceNow ITSM capabilities, including Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Enablement, Request Management, Knowledge Management, and Service Catalog.

Align platform workflows with ITIL 4 principles and enterprise service management policies.

Review and optimize incident categorization, impact, urgency, priority, assignment rules, escalation, and SLA management.

Define appropriate priority calculation and escalation models, ensuring that business impact and urgency drive consistent prioritization.

Establish standards for incident lifecycle management, major incident handling, problem investigation, change risk assessment, approvals, and service restoration.

Ensure that process implementations are consistent, measurable, auditable, and aligned with operational objectives.

Challenge unnecessary customizations or process variations that increase complexity without delivering measurable business value.

**3. Technical Architecture and Advanced Development**

Provide technical leadership for complex ServiceNow implementations, custom applications, workflows, and platform enhancements.

Demonstrate strong hands-on knowledge of JavaScript, GlideRecord, GlideAggregate, GlideSystem, GlideAjax, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, and Flow Designer.

Design and troubleshoot advanced automation, event-driven processing, asynchronous operations, and complex workflow logic.

Define appropriate use of IntegrationHub, Flow Designer, scripting, scheduled jobs, events, and platform-native capabilities.

Review code for quality, security, scalability, performance, maintainability, and compliance with ServiceNow development standards.

Diagnose complex defects, production incidents, transaction failures, slow-running scripts, and unexpected platform behavior.

Establish development standards, code review practices, reusable components, and technical documentation.

**4. Integration and Data Architecture**

Design and govern integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise systems using REST APIs, SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, and other supported integration mechanisms.

Define authentication, authorization, API security, error handling, retry mechanisms, monitoring, and integration resiliency.

Lead integration design across identity management, monitoring tools, ERP, CRM, HR, cloud platforms, and other enterprise applications.

Establish data ownership, data mapping, transformation, reconciliation, and validation standards.

Govern CMDB data integrations, identification and reconciliation rules, and data quality where applicable.

Troubleshoot integration failures, authentication issues, data inconsistencies, API errors, and performance constraints.

**5. Platform Governance, Security, and Performance**

Establish platform governance, development lifecycle standards, application access controls, and technical quality gates.

Ensure appropriate use of roles, ACLs, authentication, authorization, encryption, and sensitive-data controls.

Define instance strategy, application scope, update-set or application deployment practices, and environment promotion controls.

Establish release, upgrade, regression-testing, and rollback strategies in collaboration with platform operations.

Assess customization impact on upgrades and minimize upgrade conflicts.

Monitor platform health, transaction performance, script efficiency, integration reliability, and technical debt.

Ensure compliance with enterprise security policies, audit requirements, and applicable governance standards.

**6. CMDB, Service Mapping, and ITOM**

Define CMDB architecture, configuration item classes, relationships, ownership, and data quality controls.

Establish configuration management standards and alignment between business services, technical services, and supporting infrastructure.

Provide architectural guidance for Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and operational visibility where these capabilities are in scope.

Define integration patterns for infrastructure monitoring and service health data.

Ensure that CMDB and operational data support incident impact analysis, change risk assessment, and service availability objectives.

**7. ServiceNow Product and Platform Strategy**

Evaluate and recommend appropriate ServiceNow capabilities across ITSM, ITOM, IT Asset Management, Strategic Portfolio Management, HR Service Delivery, Customer Service Management, Security Operations, and Integrated Risk Management, according to business needs.

Assess product fit, licensing implications, implementation complexity, dependencies, and business value.

Identify opportunities to consolidate fragmented workflows and reduce overlapping tools or custom-built solutions.

Define platform evolution roadmaps, capability maturity improvements, and modernization priorities.

Stay current with relevant ServiceNow releases, platform capabilities, architecture guidance, and recommended practices.

**8. Delivery Leadership and Stakeholder Management**

Partner with business stakeholders, process owners, product managers, project managers, and delivery teams to establish solution scope and technical priorities.

Lead architecture workshops, technical design discussions, proof-of-concept exercises, and solution demonstrations.

Provide technical direction and mentoring to developers, administrators, technical leads, and implementation partners.

Review estimates, technical dependencies, delivery risks, and implementation plans.

Support testing strategy, defect triage, deployment readiness, go-live, and post-production stabilization.

Communicate architectural decisions, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

12–15+ years of overall IT experience, with substantial hands-on ServiceNow experience.

Typically 8+ years of ServiceNow implementation and development experience, including significant ownership of complex technical solutions.

Demonstrated experience designing and delivering enterprise-grade ServiceNow architectures.

Strong knowledge of ITSM processes and ITIL principles; ITIL 4 certification is preferred.

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator certification; relevant implementation and architect-level certifications are strongly preferred.

Strong JavaScript and ServiceNow scripting expertise, including complex debugging and code reviews.

Proven experience with REST/SOAP integrations, authentication, data transformation, and integration troubleshooting.

Experience with platform security, access controls, performance optimization, release management, and upgrades.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, stakeholder management, and technical leadership skills.

Ability to work independently, make architecture decisions, explain technical trade-offs, and take ownership of complex issues.

**Preferred Qualifications**

ServiceNow Certified Application Developer certification.

Relevant ServiceNow CIS certifications, particularly ITSM and ITOM where applicable.

ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect or Certified Master Architect credentials, where held and relevant to the role.

Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks, service management governance, and technical debt reduction.

Experience leading multi-team implementations, platform modernization, and enterprise integration programs.

**Expected Outcomes**

A clearly defined, documented, and governed ServiceNow architecture.

Consistent implementation of ITSM processes aligned with business policies and ITIL principles.

Improved platform stability, integration reliability, maintainability, and upgrade readiness.

Reduced unnecessary customization, technical debt, recurring defects, and avoidable production incidents.

Stronger code quality, security controls, documentation, and deployment governance.

A prioritized platform improvement roadmap tied to measurable business and operational outcomes.

description:
**Position Purpose**

The Head HR will be responsible for developing and executing the people strategy that enables Companies India & Global growth ambitions while fostering a high-performance, employee-centric, safety-first culture.

The role will serve as a strategic advisor to the CEO and leadership team on organization design, talent acquisition, leadership development, employee engagement, industrial relations, performance management, rewards, succession planning, culture transformation, and workforce productivity across corporate, manufacturing, projects, service, and O&M operations.

The incumbent will play a pivotal role in positioning company as an employer of choice within the renewable energy industry while ensuring strong governance, compliance, and workforce capability to support long-term business success.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic HR Leadership**

* Develop and implement an HR strategy aligned with Companies business objectives and growth plans.
* Partner with the CEO and leadership team on organizational effectiveness and workforce planning.
* Drive culture initiatives focused on accountability, ownership, collaboration, innovation, and customer orientation.
* Lead organizational transformation and change management programs.

**Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning**

* Develop robust manpower plans to support manufacturing expansion, project execution, service growth, and new business initiatives.
* Build strong recruitment pipelines for leadership, engineering, manufacturing, project execution, sales, and service functions.
* Strengthen employer brand in the renewable energy sector.
* Reduce time-to-hire while improving quality of hires and retention.

**Leadership Development & Succession Planning**

* Establish leadership development frameworks for future business leaders.
* Build succession plans for all critical positions.
* Design career progression and talent acceleration programs.
* Drive coaching and mentoring initiatives across the organization.

**Performance & Productivity Management**

* Lead performance management processes across the organization.
* Ensure alignment between business objectives and individual KPIs.
* Introduce data-driven productivity and performance measurement systems.
* Drive continuous improvement and accountability culture.

**Employee Engagement & Culture**

* Enhance employee satisfaction, engagement, and retention.
* Lead employee listening forums, surveys, and engagement initiatives.
* Promote a culture where employees feel respected, valued, and empowered.
* Champion diversity, inclusion, and employee well-being initiatives.

**Compensation, Benefits & Rewards**

* Design and implement competitive compensation and rewards programs.
* Conduct benchmarking against leading renewable energy, engineering, and manufacturing companies.
* Develop retention and recognition programs for high-potential employees.
* Support merit reviews and incentive plans linked to business performance.

**Industrial Relations & Employee Relations**

* Maintain harmonious industrial relations across manufacturing operations.
* Ensure proactive engagement with employees and stakeholders.
* Drive grievance handling and conflict resolution mechanisms.
* Support business continuity through effective workforce relations.

**Learning & Capability Building**

* Establish technical and leadership competency frameworks.
* Drive capability development programs across manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, project execution, EHS, and O&M.
* Ensure training programs align with future business requirements.
* Create a learning culture focused on continuous development.

**Compliance & Governance**

* Ensure compliance with all applicable labour laws and statutory regulations.
* Lead POSH, ethics, disciplinary, and employee governance processes.
* Support internal and external audits.
* Maintain robust HR policies, procedures, and controls.

**HR Digitization & Analytics**

* Drive digital HR transformation initiatives.
* Develop leadership dashboards for workforce analytics.
* Establish data-driven decision-making through HR metrics and insights.
* Improve HR process effectiveness and employee experience through automation.

**Education**

* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources from a reputed institution.
* Additional qualifications in Labour Law, Organization Development, Coaching, Industrial Relations, or Compensation Management preferred.

**Experience**

• 18+ years of progressive Human Resources leadership experience, with a strong track record of driving organizational effectiveness and people strategy.

• Minimum 5 years in a senior HR leadership role with enterprise-wide responsibility for talent, culture, organizational development, employee relations, and workforce planning.

• Demonstrated success in leading organizational growth, transformation, change management, and culture-building initiatives.

• Proven experience managing large and geographically dispersed workforces across multiple business functions and locations.

• Strong expertise in leadership development, succession planning, talent management, performance management, and employee engagement.

• Exposure to complex, multi-site, project-driven, manufacturing, engineering, or service organizations is advantageous but not mandatory.

title: Recruitment Specialist
description:
We are hiring Recruitment Specialist in RPO setup. The candidate will be deployed at cliental site taking care of end-to-end recruitment. Below is the JD for your reference.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. 360-Degree End-to-End Recruitment**

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle, from understanding hiring requirements and sourcing candidates to screening, interview coordination, offer negotiation, and joining follow-ups.
* Conduct detailed requirement briefing discussions with hiring managers to understand job specifications, competencies, and business expectations.
* Source relevant profiles through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, internal databases, and other sourcing channels.
* Screen and assess candidates based on role requirements, experience, skills, compensation, and cultural fit.
* Maintain a healthy candidate pipeline and ensure timely submission of quality profiles.
* Drive interview scheduling, feedback collection, offer management, and candidate engagement throughout the hiring process.
* Follow up with selected candidates to ensure offer acceptance and successful joining.
* Manage multiple open positions simultaneously while meeting defined recruitment SLAs and turnaround times.

**2. Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned hiring stakeholders and maintain effective working relationships.
* Proactively communicate recruitment progress, challenges, pipeline status, and anticipated delays.
* Drive timely interview feedback and decision-making from hiring managers.
* Understand changing business priorities and realign recruitment efforts accordingly.
* Manage stakeholder expectations regarding candidate availability, compensation benchmarks, and market realities.
* Identify potential hiring bottlenecks and proactively recommend solutions.
* Ensure a professional and seamless experience for both clients and candidates.

**3. Recruitment MIS and Excel Management**

* Maintain recruitment trackers with
  **100% accuracy and real-time updates**
  on candidate and position status.
* Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly recruitment MIS reports and dashboards.
* Track key recruitment metrics, including open positions, profiles sourced, submissions, interviews, offers, closures, joining ratios, and position ageing.
* Monitor individual productivity, recruitment funnel movement, and progress against assigned targets.
* Use MS Excel to analyse recruitment data, identify gaps, and generate actionable insights.
* Ensure data integrity, timely reporting, and adherence to client-specific reporting formats and processes.

**4. Recruitment Delivery and Process Compliance**

* Ensure recruitment delivery is aligned with agreed SLAs, client expectations, and quality benchmarks.
* Regularly review open positions and prioritise requirements based on business criticality.
* Maintain accurate candidate records in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and recruitment trackers.
* Ensure compliance with recruitment processes, documentation requirements, and client-specific guidelines.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve sourcing effectiveness, turnaround time, and recruitment productivity.

**Required Skills and Competencies**

* Strong hands-on experience in 360-degree end-to-end recruitment.
* Excellent stakeholder management, client communication, and relationship-building skills.
* Good proficiency in MS Excel, including
  **VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, IF formulas, filters, sorting, and data management**
  .
* Experience in recruitment MIS, dashboards, and tracker management.
* Proficiency in sourcing through job portals, LinkedIn, Boolean search, referrals, and databases.
* Strong candidate assessment, negotiation, and follow-up skills.
* Ability to manage multiple requirements and changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail, time management, and problem-solving abilities.
* Familiarity with ATS and recruitment management systems.

**Educational Qualification and Experience**

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in Human Resources will be an added advantage.
* 3–6 years of relevant recruitment experience, preferably in an RPO or client-facing recruitment environment.
* Demonstrated experience in managing the complete recruitment lifecycle independently.
* Prior experience handling client stakeholders and recruitment MIS is essential.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Achievement of assigned hiring targets and recruitment SLAs.
* Quality and relevance of candidate submissions.
* Time-to-fill and position closure rate.
* Offer-to-join ratio and candidate engagement.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and timely feedback management.
* Accuracy and timeliness of recruitment trackers and MIS reports.
* Individual recruiter productivity and process compliance.

description:
**Assistant Manager – Talent Acquisition (Retail)**

**Location – Lower Parel, Mumbai**

**About Company:**

The Souled Store is a homegrown youth casual-wear brand founded in 2013. Today, we are one of India’s largest online merchandising platforms, with licensing partnerships including Disney, Warner Bros., WWE, IPL and Viacom18, among others.

We create products inspired by pop culture- superheroes, movies, TV shows and cartoons while staying deeply rooted in evolving youth fashion and lifestyle trends. Alongside our core men’s and women’s apparel categories, we are actively expanding into new product lines such as activewear, Supima products, personal care, footwear and backpacks.

While we began as a digital-first brand, we have steadily expanded into offline retail and currently operate 90+ stores across India, with further pan-India expansion underway.

The Souled Store was built on a simple belief: people do their best work when they love what they do. We believe work should be driven by ownership, curiosity and leadership at every level not just by titles. Over the years, we’ve built a team of like-minded individuals who work smart, take accountability and grow with the business.

If you resonate with our culture and want to be part of an aggressively scaling, consumer-first brand, we’d love to have you join us!

**Role Summary:**

Owns hiring for Store Managers, Area Managers and all corporate office roles within Retail Ops. Reports to Senior Manager – HR.

**Key responsibilities**

**1.Hiring delivery:**
Run full-cycle hiring across three mandates:

* Store Managers, including leadership for new store launches.
* Area Managers.
* Retail Ops corporate roles, such as retail MIS/analytics, training, audit and compliance, retail excellence, and ops leadership.

**2.Sourcing:**
Map talent at fashion and lifestyle retailers for field roles, source cross-industry for corporate roles (analytics, training, audit), headhunt through LinkedIn and referrals, and manage a small panel of search partners.

**3.Internal pipeline:**
Work with Retail HRBPs to identify promotion-ready ASMs for Store Manager roles and strong Store Managers for Area Manager roles and run internal job postings before going external.

**4.Assessment:**
Build role-specific selection:

* For field roles: store walk-throughs and P&L or KPI deep-dives.
* For corporate roles: functional assignments or case discussions.

**5.Offer management:**
Benchmark compensation, negotiate within approved bands and the approval matrix, and manage candidates through to joining.

**6.Stakeholder management:**
Partner with Retail Ops leadership and Area Managers on manpower plans and interview panels and run fortnightly hiring reviews.

**7.Reporting:**
Track TAT, offer-to-join ratio, source mix, cost per hire and 6-month retention by role category.

**Requirement**
:

* 5–8 years in talent acquisition, with at least 5+ years in retail or consumer hiring.
* Experience hiring both field leadership and corporate functional roles.
* Strong retail network; skilled in headhunting, assessment and negotiation; comfortable with multi-city travel.

title: Partnerships & Outreach Manager – Sustainability & Educational Workshops | LITER OF LIGHT - INDIA
description:
**Company:** Liter of Light – India Chapter  
**Location:** Mumbai, Maharashtra  
**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Work Mode:** Hybrid / Work from Home with field visits  
**Experience:** 2–5 years  
**Salary:** ₹25,000–₹38,000 per month, depending on experience

**About**

**Liter of Light**

Liter of Light is a global sustainability movement that brings people together through accessible solar lighting, hands-on learning and community participation.

The India Chapter combines renewable energy with traditional craftsmanship to create handcrafted solar lamps. We conduct educational workshops, corporate employee-engagement programmes and community initiatives that encourage people to learn about solar energy by building functional solar lamps themselves.

We are now looking for a proactive, relationship-driven professional to help us expand our partnerships and take these experiences to more schools, colleges, corporates, resorts and communities.

***About the Role***

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, pitching ideas and turning opportunities into real-world experiences.

You will be responsible for identifying potential partners, initiating conversations, developing proposals, securing workshops and coordinating their execution. You will work directly with the India Chapter leadership and have considerable ownership in shaping how our programmes grow.

We are looking for a **builder, not just a coordinator**—someone who can identify opportunities, take initiative, follow through and help grow a meaningful sustainability initiative.

***Key Responsibilities***

**1. Partnerships & Business Development**

* Identify and build relationships with schools, colleges, universities and educational institutions.
* Reach out to corporate HR, employee engagement, ESG and sustainability teams to develop employee-engagement workshops.
* Establish partnerships with sustainable resorts and hospitality groups for guest experiences involving solar-lamp building.
* Identify CSR opportunities for large-scale solar-lamp workshops, community programmes and public installations.
* Explore collaborations with art festivals, cultural events, sustainability events and other relevant platforms.
* Independently manage outreach, follow-ups, meetings, proposals and partnership discussions.

**2. Workshop Development & Execution**

* Pitch and develop engaging solar-energy workshops for students, corporate teams and other audiences.
* Help design interactive experiences that combine learning, teamwork, creativity and social impact.
* Coordinate workshop materials, logistics, facilitators, venues and schedules.
* Facilitate workshops and engage participants during on-ground events.
* Collect participant feedback, document outcomes and prepare post-event reports.
* Develop ideas for new workshop formats, institutional partnerships and repeat engagements.

**3. Pipeline Management & Reporting**

* Build and maintain a structured database of potential partners and decision-makers.
* Track outreach, meetings, proposals, follow-ups and confirmed bookings.
* Maintain a weekly progress report and work towards agreed targets.
* Identify opportunities for repeat workshops, referrals and long-term partnerships.
* Monitor budgets and coordinate with the leadership team to ensure successful delivery.

***Who We Are Looking For***

* 2–5 years of experience in partnerships, business development, education outreach, experiential learning, event management or sustainability programmes.
* Experience organising workshops, educational programmes, corporate engagement activities or institutional events.
* Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
* Comfortable approaching new organisations, making introductions, pitching ideas and following up persistently.
* Ability to independently take an opportunity from the first conversation to a confirmed event.
* Resourceful, organised and comfortable working with targets and deadlines.
* Genuine interest in sustainability, renewable energy, environmental education or social impact.
* Proficiency in English and Hindi. Marathi would be an advantage.
* Based in Mumbai, with flexibility to travel for partner meetings and workshops.

Experience working with schools, colleges, corporate HR teams, CSR departments or sustainability-focused organisations will be particularly valuable.

**Most importantly, we value initiative, ownership and the ability to turn ideas into action.** You do not need to come from the NGO sector if you have the right skills and attitude.

What We Offer

* An opportunity to build and grow a sustainability initiative with meaningful social impact.
* Direct access to leadership and the freedom to develop new partnerships and programme ideas.
* A hybrid working arrangement with flexibility, balanced with clear deliverables and accountability.
* Exposure to schools, corporates, sustainability programmes, public installations and community initiatives.
* The opportunity to shape new workshop formats and develop long-term institutional relationships.
* A fixed monthly salary of ₹35,000–₹45,000, depending on experience, with the possibility of performance-linked incentives.
* Reimbursement of approved work-related travel and event expenses.

***What Success Looks Like***

In this role, success means building a healthy pipeline of institutional and corporate partnerships, converting qualified opportunities into confirmed workshops, delivering excellent participant experiences and developing relationships that generate repeat engagements.

You will be evaluated on meaningful outcomes, ownership and execution—not simply the number of hours spent at a desk.

***How to Apply***

Please submit your CV along with a brief note describing:

* A workshop, event, partnership or outreach initiative you have personally helped organise or develop.
* How you would approach schools and corporates to introduce them to Liter of Light's solar-lamp workshops.
* Why this role interests you.

We welcome applicants who are enthusiastic about sustainability, education and building something from the ground up.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹38,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Mumbai, Maharashtra

title: Global Compensation Specialist
description:
Job Description

**Global HR Compensation Analyst | Pune, India | Full-time**

If you are passionate about compensation analytics, data accuracy, and improving HR processes through effective analysis and automation, this could be the ideal opportunity for you.

**Your Role:**

As a Global HR Compensation Analyst, you will play an important role in the operational delivery of Vanderlande's global compensation programmes across North America, EMEA, and APAC.

You will support market benchmarking, annual merit and incentive cycles, compensation reporting, Workday-related activities, and compensation data management. By preparing and validating data, coordinating stakeholder input, and translating compensation information into clear insights, you will contribute to accurate and timely compensation decision-making. This role combines analytical rigour with a practical continuous improvement mindset. You will identify opportunities to simplify, standardise, and automate recurring processes, calculations, reporting, and documentation, helping create compensation processes that are efficient, controlled, and scalable.You will work closely with Total Rewards, HR Technology, Finance Shared Services, and HR stakeholders across different regions to ensure accurate and timely execution of global compensation activities.

**What you will do/Key Responsibilities:**

Compensation Programme Delivery & Benchmarking (35%)

* Coordinate compensation survey participation and support global benchmarking by collecting, validating, and analysing internal and external compensation data.
* Support annual merit, Short Term Incentive (STI), and Long Term Incentive (LTI) processes.
* Prepare and validate data required for annual compensation cycles.
* Coordinate stakeholder inputs and follow up with managers and HR stakeholders on deadlines and data quality.
* Support employee letter preparation for compensation and incentive programmes.
* Support the end-to-end Sales Incentive Plan process, including template preparation, target-setting inputs, evaluation, payout calculations, and letter preparation.
* Support incentive accrual processes for Company Bonus, STI, Sales Incentive Plan, and Key Account Management incentive programmes in partnership with Finance Shared Services.

Data Analysis, Reporting & Workday Support (35%)

* Prepare compensation data, reports, and insights for Total Rewards and other HR stakeholders.
* Analyse compensation data to identify trends, inconsistencies, and data quality issues.
* Translate compensation findings into clear and practical information for stakeholders.
* Support the creation and maintenance of Workday reports in collaboration with HR Technology.
* Prepare and validate Workday upload templates for merit matrices, norm salaries, incentive targets, and other compensation data.
* Ensure compensation data is accurate, complete, and appropriately validated before submission or upload.
* Create and update compensation reports in partnership with HR Technology and relevant stakeholders.

Process Improvement & Automation (20%)

* Review compensation activities and identify opportunities to simplify, standardise, and automate recurring processes, calculations, reporting, and document preparation.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, data quality, and process controls.
* Support the design, testing, and implementation of improved compensation solutions.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives involving automation, AI, and digital solutions.
* Help establish scalable and consistent compensation processes across regions.

Knowledge Management & Stakeholder Support (10%)

* Create, update, and maintain compensation knowledge articles, process descriptions, and work instructions.

title: Solution Lead HR
description:
**Job Purpose**

* Acts as consultant and business partner to the HR across the Air Arabia Group, providing and implementing HR technology solutions across the HRMS landscape.
* Owns end-to-end delivery and functional governance for SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central (EC) as the system-of-record, while ensuring cross-platform readiness and outcomes across integrations, automation platforms, data/analytics dependencies, and IT security/compliance requirements.
* Ensures solutions are scalable across the Group tenant and deliver measurable operational improvement and user adoption.

Key Result Responsibilities
  
  

* Leads discovery and solution definition with HR stakeholders; translates business requirements into scalable system designs, recommending standardization and simplification where required to reduce operational complexity.
* Takes functional ownership of SuccessFactors Employee Central across the Group tenant, including configuration governance and design leadership for:

+ EC Core HR processes and foundation data model
+ EC Position Management
+ MDF objects and workflows
+ Business Rules (validations/derivations/routing controls)
+ Intelligent Services (event-based automation, triggers, notifications)

* Acts as functional owner for integration outcomes; works with middleware/technical teams to validate mapping/specifications, test end-to-end, and ensure correctness of inputs/outputs in production (reconciliation, exception handling, and controlled fixes).
* Coordinates solution dependencies beyond SuccessFactors to ensure end-to-end delivery to work on supporting upstream and downstream technologies.
* Co-owns HRMS governance in coordination with the Payroll Solution Lead, ensuring strong controls and audit readiness through:

+ Access discipline and Role-Based Permissions inputs
+ Data privacy-by-design practices and evidence readiness
+ Change governance, documentation standards, and release impact readiness

* Provides project-first delivery with L3 functional support ownership for complex HRMS issues related to Core HR processes, org changes, mass updates, workflow failures, permission-related issues, and recurring data-quality problems; ensures root-cause fixes rather than repeat workarounds.

* Uses ITSM and other spolutions for support and project tracking; contributes to SLA discipline, knowledge base creation, and operational reporting.
* Provides knowledge transfer and enablement to other HRMS team members to build bench strength and reduce single points of dependency.
* Expected to deliver measurable improvements such as:


+ Stabilization of top recurring EC incidents through permanent fixes and stronger validation controls
+ Delivery of prioritized EC enhancements/automation triggers that reduce manual HR effort
+ Improved governance maturity (documentation pack, test evidence, release readiness, access discipline)
+ Reliable integration outcomes with clear reconciliation approach for critical interfaces.

**Qualifications (Academic, Training, Languages)**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent; Master’s degree is preferred.
* SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central certification is required.
* Certifications in supplementary technologies relevant to HRMS delivery (e.g., SAP Integration Suite/CPI, Integration Center, APIs, Azure fundamentals, ITIL) are considered an advantage.
* PMP certification or other recognized Project/Program Management qualification is preferred.

Work Experience
  
  

* 10+ years of experience in HR technology/HRIS or enterprise application delivery, with strong functional ownership and hands-on delivery exposure in SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central (EC).
* Expert-level working knowledge of at least one additional SuccessFactors area such as Compensation/Variable Pay, Succession & Development, Onboarding 2.0, or similar talent/rewards modules (implementation or major enhancement experience preferred).
* Demonstrated ability to lead stakeholder workshops, challenge and clarify requirements, drive decisions, and deliver end-to-end outcomes across HR, IT, and shared services teams.
* Strong depth in EC configuration and governance, including MDF objects/workflows, business rules, data model discipline, and role-based permissions / controls.
* Proven experience partnering with integration teams to validate interfaces end-to-end; solid understanding of Integration Center, API concepts, mapping/validation, test cycles, and reconciliation practices.
* Experience supporting complex HR environments (multi-entity, shared services, multi-country) is preferred; aviation/airline exposure is an advantage.

OpenGov is seeking a Director, HR to lead our HR Business Partnering, HR Operations, and Talent Enablement functions in Pune, reporting to the global Chief Administrative Officer. This is a highly visible, locally-led role: you'll set the vision and operating rhythm for how OpenGov supports its India-based employees, while staying tightly aligned to global HR strategy and standards. * Lead and develop the Pune HR team across HR Business Partnering, HR Operations, and Talent Enablement, setting priorities and ensuring consistent, high-quality delivery across all three functions
* Act as a trusted strategic advisor to Pune business leadership, aligning local HR priorities with global business objectives while strengthening team performance, culture and retention
* Partner closely with US HR leadership and HR Centers of Excellence (Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, HR Tech, HR Ops, HRBPs, Talent Management) to adapt global programs for the India market without losing consistency
* Champion an AI-native culture within the Pune HR team and across the business, redesigning how teams work
* Own India-specific HR compliance, ensuring practices meet local labor law while reflecting OpenGov's global standards
