title: Global L&D Innovation Director
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

As the Global L&D Innovation Director, you will lead the innovation engine within BCG's Global Learning & Development Strategy & Transformation Office. Reporting to the Global L&D Strategy & Transformation Senior Director, you will run a ringfenced innovation team focused on identifying, prototyping, and PoC testing the next generation of online learning experiences for BCG.

BCG's L&D model is evolving to deliver faster, more personalized, data-informed, and AI-enabled upskilling in support of BCG's 2030 strategy. You will be a critical leader in making that roadmap real, helping stand up the innovation team and tech squad, pilot adaptive learning, develop agentic learning prototypes to scale new products and experiences over time.

You will lead work across three connected domains:

* Innovation portfolio management - shaping the intake, prioritization, sequencing, governance, and delivery discipline for a portfolio of high-priority L&D innovation initiatives
* Experimentation and product development - leading the development and validation of new audience-facing learning experiences, products, formats, and AI-enabled solutions
* Implementation and scaling - partnering across L&D, Talent, IT/Product, and business stakeholders to move successful pilots into durable products, programs, platforms, or operating routines

The work will include experimentation with AI tools, AI workflows and automation for L&D internal transformation, and prototyping and piloting of agentic and adaptive learning experiences aligned to the 2030 L&D strategy. You will help BCG shift from slower, programmatic learning cycles toward rapid upskilling in short cycles - weeks, not years - particularly for emerging business needs and technical skills.

What You'll Bring

* 10+ years of experience in innovation, product management, digital transformation, learning transformation, talent/capability building, strategy execution, or enterprise program leadership
* Experience leading teams in complex, global, matrixed environments, with a strong track record of coaching, developing, and mobilizing talent
* Demonstrated ability to move work from ideation through design, build, pilot and value proof.
* Experience in designing innovation with scale in mind, anticipating the technical, integration, and operating requirements needed to move successful pilots into production and enable a smooth handover to Product and IT
* Curiosity and the desire to change the status quo.
* Strong technology literacy, including comfort working with AI-enabled tools, digital products, workflow automation, learning platforms, or data-enabled solutions
* Experience managing a portfolio of initiatives with competing priorities, limited resources, and senior stakeholder visibility
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders, align cross-functional partners, and manage tradeoffs with sound judgment
* Experience working with agile, product-led, design-thinking, test-and-learn, or rapid prototyping approaches
* Strong problem-solving and structured thinking, with the ability to bring clarity to ambiguous or fast-changing topics
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to translate technical or conceptual ideas into clear business and learning implications
* Comfort operating at both strategic and executional levels - you can set direction and personally help get the work done
* Experience in L&D, talent, capability building, HR transformation, or professional services is preferred, but not required for candidates with strong innovation, product, or transformation experience
* Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred

Who You'll Work With

You will report to the Global L&D Strategy & Transformation Senior Director and lead the innovation team within the Global L&D Strategy & Transformation Office.

Your direct leadership scope will include the ringfenced innovation team responsible for developing and validating new learning experiences, products, formats, AI-enabled workflows, and agentic/adaptive prototypes. This team will act as a rapid experimentation and delivery capability for the L&D organization, helping relieve pressure from teams managing structured curricula and foundational programs while responding to accelerating demand for digital and AI upskilling.

You will work closely with:

* L&D Strategy Implementation & Transformation to align innovation priorities with the broader 2030 L&D roadmap, governance, investment choices, and transformation milestones
* Rapid AI Adoption teams to connect innovation efforts with urgent business-critical skill needs, AI upskilling priorities, and emerging technical capability requirements
* L&D Business Partners to understand demand from BCG's cohorts, businesses, regions, and functions and translate that demand into prioritized innovation opportunities
* Learning Architecture and Curriculum teams to ensure successful pilots can be embedded into learning journeys and sustained beyond the innovation team
* Learning Product and Operations teams to transition proven solutions into scalable delivery models, platforms, processes, and operating routines
* IT, Product, Data, and AI teams to ensure prototypes and pilots are technically feasible, well-integrated, secure, and aligned with BCG's broader technology ecosystem
* HR, Talent, and People Strategy teams to connect learning innovation to broader skill, performance, talent, and workforce priorities
* Vendors and external partners where third-party platforms, content, tools, or technical capabilities can accelerate delivery

Together, you will help BCG build a faster, more adaptive, more technology-enabled learning ecosystem - one that strengthens our world-class apprenticeship and faculty-led learning while creating scalable, personalized, data-informed learning experiences for the future.

Additional info

**YOU'RE GOOD AT-**

* Taking ideas from concept to implementation - You can start with an ambiguous business or learning need, shape the problem, define the opportunity, mobilize the right people, test a technical solution, and evaluate what is needed to drive adoption and scale.
* Running a high-quality innovation portfolio - You bring structure to fast-moving work. You can manage intake, prioritization, resourcing, stage gates, decision rights, dependencies, risks, and handoffs without slowing the team down.
* Leading agile, multidisciplinary teams - You know how to lead teams that may include a mix of learning designers, product owners, technologists, data and analytics colleagues, AI specialists, vendors, and business SMEs. You create clarity, energy, accountability, and momentum.
* Applying technology and AI pragmatically - You are tech literate and curious. You do not need to be an engineer, but you can engage credibly with technical teams, understand what AI and digital tools can and cannot do, and translate emerging capabilities into usable learning solutions.
* Building solutions that are learner-centered and business-backed - You can connect business goals to skill needs, translate those needs into learning experiences, and keep outcomes at the center of the work.
* Collaborating across a complex ecosystem - You can operate in a global, matrixed environment and build strong partnerships with L&D Business Partners, Learning Architecture, Product and Operations, Talent, HR, IT, Product, and senior business stakeholders.
* Managing stakeholders with confidence and judgment - You know how to shape demand, negotiate tradeoffs, communicate progress, surface decisions, and keep stakeholders aligned across seniority levels and functions.
* Experimenting with discipline - You are comfortable with rapid prototyping, piloting, feedback loops, and iteration, but you also know when to stop, pivot, scale, or hand off.
* Leading people through ambiguity and change - You build trust, coach teams, manage performance, and help people do excellent work in a space where priorities, tools, and expectations are evolving quickly.
* Translating innovation into adoption - You understand that a successful prototype is only valuable if it is used. You think ahead about change management, communications, enablement, measurement, and integration into existing workflows.

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: 1004-Staff Engineer-Full Stack (MVC)
description:
Engineering at Innovaccer

With every line of code, we accelerate our customers' success, turning complex challenges into innovative solutions. Collaboratively, we transform each data point we gather into valuable insights for our customers. Join us and be part of a team that's turning dreams of better healthcare into reality, one line of code at a time. Together, we're shaping the future and making a meaningful impact on the world.

About the Role

At Innovaccer, we’re looking for exceptional **Senior Staff Software Engineers** who are passionate about solving complex problems, building systems at scale, and redefining how software is engineered in the AI era.

As a Senior Staff Engineer, you’ll operate across multiple teams and technical domains, taking ownership of some of our most challenging engineering problems. You’ll combine deep hands-on coding with architecture, system thinking, and technical leadership to build scalable, reliable, and intelligent platforms that create meaningful impact in healthcare.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product, AI, and other technical leaders to turn ambiguous problems into simple, scalable, and durable solutions. You’ll influence architecture and engineering direction, raise the technical bar, and help teams move faster without compromising engineering quality.

We’re looking for exceptional builders and technical leaders who are energized by hard problems, challenge assumptions, thrive in ambiguity, and have a strong bias toward ownership and action.

AI-native engineering is central to how we build at Innovaccer. You’ll be expected to use AI coding agents and the AI Development Life Cycle (AIDLC) as an integral part of your engineering practice—and help other engineers adopt these practices effectively.

A Day in the Life

* + Own and drive large, cross-team technical initiatives from problem definition and architecture through implementation, deployment, and production.
  + Design and build highly scalable, resilient, secure, and maintainable full-stack and distributed systems.
  + Solve complex technical problems that cross service, product, platform, and organizational boundaries.
  + Remain deeply hands-on—designing, coding, debugging, reviewing, and improving production systems.
  + Use AI coding agents and AI-assisted development extensively across design, implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring, code review, and documentation.
  + Champion AIDLC / AI-native engineering practices and help teams evolve their development workflows to take advantage of AI.
  + Think beyond individual services and features, understanding system-wide dependencies, trade-offs, failure modes, and customer impact.
  + Identify opportunities to simplify architecture, eliminate systemic technical debt, and improve engineering velocity, reliability, and developer experience.
  + Lead architecture and design discussions across teams and influence technical direction through strong engineering judgment and technical credibility.
  + Partner with Product, AI, Design, and Engineering leaders to translate ambiguous business and customer problems into technical strategies and executable solutions.
  + Establish reusable architectural patterns, engineering practices, and technical standards across teams.
  + Mentor Senior Engineers and SDE3s and help develop the next generation of technical leaders.
  + Proactively identify important problems before they become incidents, customer issues, or organizational bottlenecks.

What You Need

* 8+ years of software engineering experience, with a demonstrated track record of building and operating complex production systems.
* Deep hands-on expertise in software engineering, system design, distributed systems, and cloud-native architectures.
* Strong coding skills with depth in one or more areas and the ability to work effectively across the full stack.
* Strong experience with Java, Python, Node.js, TypeScript, React, or equivalent modern technologies.
* Strong understanding of databases, APIs, messaging, caching, observability, security, reliability, scalability, and cloud infrastructure.
* Demonstrated experience driving architecture and technical initiatives across multiple teams.
* Proven ability to take ambiguous, high-impact problems and drive them from problem definition through production.
* Strong engineering judgment and ability to balance velocity, scalability, reliability, security, cost, and long-term maintainability.
* Strong hands-on proficiency with AI coding tools is required. Experience with tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent AI coding agents.
* Practical experience with AIDLC / AI-native development, including AI-assisted design, coding, testing, debugging, code review, evaluation, and iterative development.
* Strong system-thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to reason across multiple layers of a technology stack.
* Ability to influence technical decisions without relying on organizational authority.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, AI, and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ownership, curiosity, bias for action, and continuous learning.

**Good to Have**

* Hands-on experience building Agentic AI applications or production AI workflows.
* Experience with LLMs, RAG, tool calling, MCP, AI agents, agent orchestration, or multi-agent systems.
* Experience designing AI-native or agentic architectures.
* Experience with AI evaluation, guardrails, observability, and runtime monitoring.
* Experience helping organizations adopt AIDLC and AI-augmented engineering practices.
* Experience with AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Kafka, Temporal, or similar cloud-native technologies.
* Experience defining engineering standards, architectural patterns, or platform-wide technical strategies.

About Innovaccer

Innovaccer builds software that helps hospitals, clinics, and health insurance companies make sense of all the scattered data they deal with every day — patient records, appointments, insurance claims, lab results — and turns it into something useful and actionable.

Think of a typical hospital: patient information often lives in a dozen different systems that don't talk to each other well. This causes delays in scheduling, slows down doctors, and makes it harder to catch health problems early. Innovaccer's platform connects all of that data together, and increasingly, uses AI "agents" to actually do some of the manual work for healthcare teams — things like scheduling appointments, preparing insurance paperwork, or drafting clinical notes — so that staff can spend more time with patients and less time on admin work.

Some of the largest healthcare systems in the US — including CommonSpirit Health, Atlantic Health, and Banner Health — use Innovaccer's platform today.

The company is also investing heavily in this direction: in June 2026, Innovaccer signed a multi-year partnership with AWS to run its AI agents at a much larger scale, using AWS's cloud AI tools (Amazon Bedrock) and healthcare-specific data infrastructure (AWS HealthLake). This is a strong signal of where the platform — and this engineering team — is headed next. For more information, visit www.innovaccer.com and check us out on YouTube, Glassdoor, LinkedIn, Instagram, and the Web.

**Here’s What We Offer**

* Generous Leaves: Enjoy generous leave benefits of up to 40 days.
* Parental Leave: Leverage one of industry's best parental leave policies to spend time with your new addition.
* Sabbatical: Want to focus on skill development, pursue an academic career, or just take a break? We've got you covered.
* Health Insurance: We offer comprehensive health insurance to support you and your family, covering medical expenses related to illness, disease, or injury. Extending support to the family members who matter most.
* Care Program: Whether it’s a celebration or a time of need, we’ve got you covered with care vouchers to mark major life events. Through our Care Vouchers program, employees receive thoughtful gestures for significant personal milestones and moments of need.
* Financial Assistance: Life happens, and when it does, we’re here to help. Our financial assistance policy offers support through salary advances and personal loans for genuine personal needs, ensuring help is there when you need it most.

Innovaccer is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all employees, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, marital status, or veteran status, feel valued and empowered.

**Disclaimer:** Innovaccer does not charge fees or require payment from individuals or agencies for securing employment with us. We do not guarantee job spots or engage in any financial transactions related to employment. If you encounter any posts or requests asking for payment or personal information, we strongly advise you to report them immediately to our HR department at px@innovaccer.com. Additionally, please exercise caution and verify the authenticity of any requests before disclosing personal and confidential information, including bank account details.

For more information, please visit innovaccer.com. Check us out on YouTube, Glassdoor,LinkedIn and Web.

We’re looking for curious minds, passionate builders, problem-solvers and people who aren't afraid to challenge the ordinary.

If you love creating, moving fast and making a difference, there’s a place for you here.

**Come make the next drop.**

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a hands-on
**Manager – HR Operations**
to independently manage end-to-end HR operations, payroll, statutory compliance and employee lifecycle processes across our corporate office, kitchens and dark stores.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Payroll Management**

* Manage monthly attendance and leave cut-offs, payroll inputs, joiners, exits, increments, deductions and salary processing.
* Prepare salary registers and payslips and reconcile payroll data with the Finance team.
* Ensure payroll accuracy, confidentiality and timely salary disbursement.

**2. Statutory Compliance**

* Manage monthly and periodic compliance relating to PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund and other applicable statutory requirements.
* Maintain a compliance calendar and ensure timely filings, payments and documentation.
* Coordinate statutory audits, inspections and compliance-related queries.

**3. Registrations and Licences**

* Manage Shops & Establishments registrations, renewals and applicable registrations across the head office and dark-store locations.
* Handle contract labour compliance for employees deployed through third-party vendors, wherever applicable.
* Coordinate with external consultants, vendors and relevant authorities as required.

**4. Employee Onboarding and Documentation**

* Complete joining formalities from Day 1, including employee master creation, personal files, offer and appointment letters, ID cards and HRMS/attendance setup.
* Coordinate PF, ESI and group insurance enrolments, as applicable.
* Maintain accurate, complete and audit-ready employee records.

**5. Employee Lifecycle and Exit Management**

* Issue confirmation, increment, transfer, experience and relieving letters.
* Manage resignations, exit clearances, handovers and full and final settlements within agreed timelines.
* Ensure timely closure of employee documentation and settlement records.

**6. HRMS and Attendance Management**

* Administer HRMS, biometric systems, attendance and leave management across locations.
* Ensure data accuracy, timely updates and effective coordination with store and kitchen teams.
* Resolve routine system and employee data discrepancies.

**7. Benefits and Insurance Administration**

* Manage employee enrolments, additions, deletions and updates under group medical and personal accident insurance policies.
* Coordinate with insurers and employees for policy-related queries and claim support.

**8. HR Policy Administration**

* Ensure consistent implementation of leave, attendance, reimbursement and other HR policies.
* Identify exceptions, maintain records and escalate deviations for approval.
* Support the rollout and communication of HR policies and processes.

**9. Audits and Employee Relations Support**

* Coordinate labour inspections, statutory audits and internal HR audits.
* Maintain supporting records, registers and documentation.
* Support the Talent Acquisition & Business Partnering Manager with disciplinary documentation and employee relations processes.

**10. HR Reporting and MIS**

* Prepare monthly HR operations dashboards covering headcount, payroll costs, employee movements and statutory compliance status.
* Maintain accurate HR MIS and provide data-driven insights to management.
* Identify process gaps and implement improvements to strengthen operational efficiency.

**Candidate Profile**

* 5–8 years of experience in HR Operations, preferably in a multi-location & fast high growth organizations.
* Prior experience in payroll management, statutory compliance and end-to-end employee lifecycle management.
* Working knowledge of PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, Shops & Establishments requirements and contract labour compliance, as applicable.
* Experience managing HRMS, attendance systems, payroll records and HR MIS.
* Exposure to retail, QSR, food & beverage, bakery, FMCG, hospitality, cloud kitchens or other frontline-intensive businesses is good to have but not mandatory
* Strong Excel/MIS skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.
* Ability to independently manage HR operations across the corporate office, kitchens and multiple store locations.
* Strong coordination, documentation, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills.

**What We Are Looking For**

A hands-on HR professional who takes ownership, maintains high standards of accuracy and compliance, works well in a fast-paced environment and can build reliable HR processes as the business continues to expand.

**Candidates who can join immediately or within a short notice period will be preferred.**

Sector 67, Noida

6 days a week

title: Senior Analyst, Enterprise D&D Planning
description:
At Aristocrat, we believe in creating the world's greatest gaming and entertainment experiences through innovation, and meticulous investment. Our success is driven by our focus on delivering value to players, customers, and shareholders. We are looking for a highly organized and analytically strong finance professional to join our Development & Design Finance group as a Senior Analyst, Enterprise D&D Planning. This role is pivotal in bringing greater structure, consistency, and coordination to our annual planning, rolling forecasts, and headcount planning activities.
  
  
For individuals eager to improve processes, promote alignment across teams, and ease complex planning cycles, this position offers extensive interaction with Finance, People & Culture, Group Finance, RCOE, and D&D leadership.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As Senior Analyst, Enterprise D&D Planning, you will support the core planning and forecasting operating rhythm for D&D. You will assist in structuring timelines, templates, inputs, assumptions, and follow-ups so finance partners and business leaders can plan with greater accuracy, consistency, and accountability.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Support the planning and forecasting calendar across D&D, including annual plan, rolling forecast, monthly updates, and key submission achievements.
* Assemble and synchronize inputs across Finance, Studios, Product, Technology, People & Culture, Group Finance, and RCOE to support alignment and timely delivery of planning assumptions.
* Keep transparent trackers for forecast submissions, open items, risks, delayed inputs, approvals, and follow-up actions.
* Help prepare planning outputs that are consistent, comparable, and ready for D&D Finance and leadership review.
* Develop, sustain, and enhance headcount planning templates across D&D, incorporating role-level, location, cost center, hiring, attrition, and transfer inputs.
* Help establish a more structured operating rhythm for planning across D&D, reducing last-minute churn and improving transparency.
* Partner closely with People & Culture and Finance teams to align headcount assumptions, open roles, hiring timing, compensation inputs, and workforce changes.
* Create repeatable processes and controls that improve data quality, reduce rework, and make headcount planning easier to manage across cycles.
* Support clear variance explanations for headcount, compensation, and related cost movements across plan, forecast, and actuals.
* Find opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve planning and forecasting processes across D&D.
* Maintain planning documentation, process maps, templates, and operating guides to support consistency and knowledge transfer.
* Build trusted relationships by being responsive, organized, and clear on ownership and next steps.
* Support alignment across collaborators by bringing structure, clarity, and follow-through to complex, multi-participant planning cycles.

What We're Looking For
  
  
**Required Experience**

* 7+ years of experience in FP&A, planning, forecasting, business operations, finance transformation, project management, or related analytical roles.
* Working knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, headcount planning, and recurring finance operating rhythms.
* Strong organizational skills, including the ability to manage timelines, dependencies, collaborators, and follow-ups across multiple workstreams.
* Advanced skills in Excel and PowerPoint, paired with a focus on detail and the talent to generate clear, accurate, and logically arranged work products.

**You Will Thrive In This Role If You**

* Are very organized and enjoy simplifying complex planning processes to make them more predictable.
* Can balance detailed data work with project management, collaborator coordination, and executive-ready communication.
* Have strong communication skills and can make timelines, asks, risks, and decisions clear to different audiences.
* Build credibility through accuracy, responsiveness, ownership, and strong follow-through.
* Bring a continuous improvement outlook and look for ways to reduce rework, standardize inputs, and improve the planning experience for partners.

*Тази длъжностна характеристика може да е била прегледана и подобрена с помощта на инструменти с изкуствен интелект с цел повишаване на нейната яснота, последователност и приобщаващ характер. Цялото окончателно съдържание, изискванията за длъжността и решенията за наемане остават предмет на преглед и одобрение от Aristocrat.*
**Философия на възнаграждението**
Предлагаме цялостен пакет от възнаграждения и придобивки, създаден да остане конкурентен на пазара, да подкрепя вашето благосъстояние и да признава приноса ви към нашия успех. Нашият подход се основава на принципа за възнаграждение според представянето, като насърчава и възнаграждава индивидуалния принос. Конкретният ви пакет на възнаграждение ще бъде определен въз основа на фактори като умения, опит, квалификации и местоположение.

* Prepare recurring status, progress and exception reporting for the assigned functional area.

Required experience

* 8+ years of business analysis, data analysis or systems analysis experience, including involvement in a system transition or data migration.
* Strong practical data-handling capability — comfortable working at volume with spreadsheets, extracts, structured queries and reporting output.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently through detailed, high-volume analytical work with accuracy and consistency.
* Experience preparing documentation, trackers and templates to a standard suitable for a regulated environment.
* Clear written and verbal communication in English, and comfort operating with stakeholders in a different time zone.
* Willingness to work a dedicated shift pattern providing overlap with US Eastern business hours.
* Experience working within GxP-regulated environments.

title: Assistant Manager - Customer Support
description:
Send your CV to alka@propertyangel.in or hr@propertyangel.in. Please mention the position in the subject line.

  

### **Assistant Manager - Customer Support**

Experience 5-8 years

#### **Role Overview**

**Role Overview**
-----------------

The Customer Support Manager will be responsible for delivering a responsive, transparent and reliable experience to PropertyAngel’s property owners and tenants.

The role involves managing the customer-support team, monitoring service requests and escalations, coordinating with internal teams, and ensuring that every customer receives timely updates and effective resolution. The manager will also use support data and customer feedback to identify recurring problems and improve processes across the organisation.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. Customer Support Management**

* Manage the day-to-day functioning of the customer-support team.
  
* Ensure that customer queries received through calls, email, WhatsApp, Freshdesk and other channels are acknowledged and resolved within defined timelines.
  
* Monitor open, pending and overdue tickets.
  
* Ensure that every interaction is professional, empathetic and solution-oriented.
  
* Maintain clear ownership of each customer request until final closure.

### **2. Escalation Management**

* Take ownership of complex or sensitive owner and tenant escalations.
  
* Investigate complaints, understand the root cause and coordinate with the appropriate internal teams for resolution.
  
* Communicate difficult decisions clearly and respectfully.
  
* Ensure that customers receive regular updates even when an immediate solution is not available.
  
* Escalate high-risk matters to senior management when required.

### **3. Team Leadership**

* Lead, train and motivate customer-support executives.
  
* Allocate work and monitor individual workloads and performance.
  
* Conduct regular ticket reviews, coaching sessions and quality audits.
  
* Train the team in communication, conflict management, empathy, documentation and PropertyAngel’s service standards.
  
* Create a culture of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement.

### **4. Cross-functional Coordination**

* Coordinate with Operations, Accounts, Leasing, Maintenance, Inspections and Relationship Management teams.
  
* Follow up with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of customer requests.
  
* Identify gaps in interdepartmental handovers and recommend better workflows.
  
* Ensure that information provided to customers is accurate and consistent across teams.

### **5. Systems and Process Management**

* Ensure proper use of Freshdesk or other customer-support systems.
  
* Establish clear ticket categories, priorities, escalation levels and service-level timelines.
  
* Maintain accurate customer histories, notes and resolution records.
  
* Develop and update standard operating procedures, response templates and escalation matrices.
  
* Identify opportunities to automate routine queries without compromising the quality of customer service.

### **6. Reporting and Service Improvement**

* Prepare weekly and monthly reports covering:
  
* + Ticket volumes and categories
    
  + First-response and resolution times
    
  + Pending and ageing tickets
    
  + Reopened tickets
    
  + Escalations and recurring complaints
    
  + Customer satisfaction
    
  + Team productivity and quality scores
  
* Analyse support data to identify recurring issues and their root causes.
  
* Work with management to implement corrective and preventive actions.
  
* Track whether process improvements have reduced complaints and improved turnaround time.
  
* Represent the voice of the customer in internal discussions.

**Key Performance Indicators**
------------------------------

* First-response time
  
* Average resolution time
  
* Percentage of tickets resolved within SLA
  
* Number and ageing of pending tickets
  
* Reopened-ticket rate
  
* Customer satisfaction score
  
* Number of escalations
  
* Quality and completeness of ticket documentation
  
* Reduction in recurring complaints
  
* Team productivity and adherence to processes

**Required Qualifications and Experience**
------------------------------------------

* Graduate degree in any discipline.
  
* Approximately 5–8 years of experience in customer service, customer success, operations or relationship management.
  
* At least 2 years of experience leading a customer-support team.
  
* Experience using Freshdesk, Zoho Desk, Zendesk or a similar ticket-management platform.
  
* Experience in property management, real estate, hospitality, banking or another service-oriented industry would be an advantage.

**Skills and Competencies**
---------------------------

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  
* Excellent problem-solving and conflict-resolution ability.
  
* Empathy combined with firmness and sound judgement.
  
* Ability to remain calm while handling demanding or dissatisfied customers.
  
* Strong follow-up, coordination and organisational skills.
  
* Ability to interpret support data and convert it into practical improvements.
  
* Comfortable working with service-level targets and performance dashboards.
  
* High attention to detail and documentation.
  
* Ability to take ownership and work effectively across departments.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
---------------------------

We are looking for someone who understands that excellent customer service is not limited to responding politely. It requires ownership, accurate information, proactive communication and reliable follow-through.

The ideal candidate will be able to balance the interests of property owners, tenants and the company while ensuring that commitments are realistic and consistently fulfilled.

  

CTC: 5,00,000 - 7,00,000 /Year.

------------------------------------------

* Approximately 5–8 years of experience in customer service, customer success, operations or relationship management.

* Experience using Freshdesk, Zoho Desk, Zendesk or a similar ticket-management platform.

title: Product Director- MXDR
description:
**Director, MXDR Product**

**Level**

Director

  

**Function**

Product Engineering & Development — MXDR (Managed Extended Detection & Response)

  

**Experience**

15–20 years, including 5+ years leading a security or infrastructure product at scale

**Role Summary**
================

The Director, MXDR Product owns the MXDR product line end-to-end — strategy, roadmap, delivery, and outcomes. This person sits at the intersection of engineering, architecture, security operations, sales, and customer success, converting technical capability into a coherent product that customers trust and buy. They will partner closely with the Senior Architect (who continues to own technical architecture) while taking full ownership of product direction, delivery commitments, cross-functional alignment, and executive/customer communication.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Product Ownership & Strategy**
--------------------------------

* Own the MXDR product roadmap end-to-end — define priorities, sequence releases, and make explicit trade-off calls between customer asks, competitive pressure, and technical debt.
* Translate market and customer signal (win/loss reviews, analyst reports, competitive intelligence, compliance requirements like FedRAMP/SOC 2) into a defensible product strategy.
* Own the business case for major initiatives — cost, timeline, staffing, and expected outcome — before they go to engineering, closing the gap between "good architecture" and "fundable roadmap."

**Delivery Ownership**
----------------------

* Own delivery predictability: turn architecture and design work into resourced, sequenced, trackable delivery plans with realistic timelines.
* Run the cadence that keeps delivery visible — regular progress reviews, clear status reporting (RAG/roadmap-vs-actual), and early escalation of risk rather than late surprises.
* Partner with the Senior Architect and engineering leads to convert technical designs into shippable phases with clear acceptance criteria and success metrics.

**Stakeholder Management & Communication**
------------------------------------------

* Be the primary product point of contact for CTO, executive leadership, and key customers — comfortable presenting roadmap, risk, and trade-offs to non-technical and executive audiences.
* Manage the inevitable tension between sales commitments, customer requests, and engineering capacity — and be the one who says no, with a clear rationale, when needed.
* Build and maintain trust with cross-functional stakeholders (engineering, SOC/security operations, sales, marketing, customer success, compliance) so the product roadmap reflects real constraints from every side, not just engineering's.

**Ownership & Accountability**
------------------------------

* Take end-to-end accountability for product outcomes — not just what was designed or built, but what shipped, what customers adopted, and what moved the business forward.
* Proactively surface risk (technical, delivery, market, compliance) rather than waiting to be asked — and bring a recommended path forward, not just a problem.
* Own post-release outcomes: adoption, customer feedback, support burden, and whether the product delivered the value it was built for.

**Domain & Technical Fluency**
------------------------------

* Be fluent enough in MXDR/SOC concepts (detection engineering, threat hunting, SIEM/UEBA/ITDR, incident response workflows, MITRE ATT&CK) to have a credible technical conversation with architects, customers, and analysts — without needing to be the one designing the models.
* Understand the compliance and certification landscape relevant to security products (SOC 2, FedRAMP, ISO 27001, GDPR) well enough to factor it into roadmap decisions early, not as an afterthought.
* Expertise in building AI based SDLC using AI tools.

**AI/ML, LLM, and Innovation Strategy**

* **GenAI & LLM Integration:** Design the architectural blueprint for embedding Generative AI and LLMs (via commercial APIs like OpenAI/Anthropic or open-source models like Llama/Mistral) into our existing products to deliver next-generation customer value.
* **Machine Learning Pipelines:** Leverage the **Python** ecosystem to oversee the creation of scalable ML data pipelines, MLOps frameworks, and predictive modeling features that enhance our application's intelligent capabilities.
* **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG):** Architect advanced RAG systems combining **Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch as a vector database)** and SQL to enable high-performance, context-aware semantic search and enterprise knowledge retrieval.
* **AI Security & Governance:** Establish enterprise-wide compliance, data privacy (preventing PII leakage into LLMs), and ethical guardrails for AI usage, ensuring alignment with emerging global AI regulations.
* **Internal AI Automation:** Lead initiatives to leverage AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot) and automated testing tools to improve overall engineering team velocity and code quality.

**Executive Technology Strategy & Enterprise Architecture**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* **Long-Term Technical Vision**: Define and execute a 3-to-5-year technology roadmap that scales with the company’s business growth, shifting engineering from a reactive delivery unit to a proactive business driver.
* **Polyglot Stack Governance:** Establish modern architectural guardrails and engineering standards for our composite ecosystem—ensuring seamless, secure integration between enterprise Angular frontends, distributed Python services, and high-performance .NET Web APIs.
* **Enterprise Data & Search Strategy:** Architect the future state of our data layer; guide principal engineers in optimizing high-transaction SQL databases (replication, partitioning) alongside massive Elastic Stack (ELK) clusters utilized for real-time search, analytics, and observability.
* **R&D and Innovation Leadership**: Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and AI/ML capabilities to determine their business viability, running targeted Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs) to maintain market competitiveness.
* **Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity:** Own the design and regular testing of global Disaster Recovery (DR) and High Availability (HA) strategies to guarantee maximum business continuity and strict uptime SLA compliance.

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

**Required**
------------

* 15–20 years total experience, with a meaningful portion in product development or product leadership roles for security, infrastructure, or SaaS platforms.
* 5+ years operating at Director level or equivalent scope — owning a product line's roadmap, delivery, and business outcomes, not just a feature area.
* Demonstrated track record of taking a product from architecture/vision to shipped, adopted reality — able to speak to specific products they've owned end-to-end.
* **Technical Breadth:** Previous hands-on architecture experience in enterprise Microsoft environments (.NET/C#) blended with open-source ecosystems (Python, Angular).
* Strong delivery discipline: experience running structured delivery cadences (roadmaps, sprint/release tracking, RAG reporting) and holding cross-functional teams to commitments.
* Excellent communicator — comfortable presenting to CTO/executive leadership and to customers, and able to translate deep technical detail into business language and back.
* Experience working alongside (not replacing) a strong technical architect — clear sense of where product ownership ends and architecture ownership begins, and how to partner rather than compete.
* Working knowledge of security operations concepts: detection & response, threat intelligence, SIEM/XDR/UEBA, identity security, or adjacent domains.
* Compliance & Governance Alignment: Ensure all engineering processes, data handling pipelines, and architectural patterns adhere strictly to industry certifications relevant to a scaling mid-size company (**SOC2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA**, etc.).

**Preferred**
-------------

* Prior experience specifically in MXDR, MDR, SIEM, XDR, or broader security operations product lines.
* Experience navigating compliance-driven sales cycles (FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001) and their impact on roadmap and architecture decisions.
* Experience building or scaling a product function — hiring and mentoring product managers, delivery leads, or program managers.
* Familiarity with modern detection engineering concepts (behavioral analytics, ML-based detection, identity threat detection) sufficient to evaluate technical proposals critically.

Are you an experienced Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations (D365FO) developer with strong technical expertise in customizations, integrations, and solution development? Do you enjoy solving complex technical challenges and building scalable solutions that deliver value to customers? If so, we should talk!

Ellucian is seeking a D365FO Developer to join our Professional Services team. You will work closely with functional consultants, project managers, QA teams, and other developers to deliver high-quality technical solutions that support successful project delivery.

Our higher education customers are modernizing their business applications and adopting cloud-based solutions to improve operational efficiency and support institutional success. In this role, you will contribute to this transformation by developing and supporting D365FO customizations, integrations, reports, and extensions. You will also help troubleshoot technical issues, optimize application performance, and support deployment and upgrade activities while following Microsoft development best practices and Ellucian’s delivery standards.

* Hands-on experience developing and maintaining D365FO customizations using Microsoft’s extensibility framework and best practices.
* Experience developing and supporting data entities, SSRS reports, business logic, and integrations with external systems.
* Strong understanding of D365FO architecture, application models, packages, metadata, and development environments.

* Understanding of D365FO build and deployment processes, database synchronization, environment management, and release practices.
* Experience in code reviews, unit testing, performance optimization, and maintaining code quality.
* Ability to understand technical requirements, explain solutions clearly, and collaborate effectively with functional consultants, QA teams, project managers, and other developers.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

title: Manager II, Project Management
description:
Job Description:

* Mission :

  Field Services Subcontractors Manager is responsible for the service delivery/site execution performance delivered to customers by 3rd parties called subcontractors, on behalf or supporting Schneider Electric teams.

  Subcontractors Manager ensures that work orders are effectively resourced and executed in a safe (including cybersecurity) and efficient manner, satisfying customers, at required quality standards and budgeted costs.

  The Subcontractors Manager will implement the Service Delivery Strategy defined by the country, managing subcontractor’s end to end (consider, select, enable, monitor and evaluate) and building a strong collaboration and performance with them according to yearly Business Plan established by the Field Services VP.

  Subcontractors Manager is key point of contact between Schneider Electric and Subcontractors whether certified or not. She/he is also responsible for certifying and supporting Channel Partners during the service performance.

  For countries that couldn’t setup this Subcontractors Manager headcount, one of Field Services Leaders will manage Subcontractors.

  Areas of responsibility :

  qParticipate with Field Services VP and Operations Director to **Country Service Delivery Strategy definition**, based on Make or Buy policies from Lines of Business, which define service activities to be delivered by internal Field Services Representatives, external Subcontractors or Partners. It must be reviewed periodically, at least once per year.

  qContribute to **the selection and Request for Quotation of new Subcontractors** with Schneider Procurement leader, defining a win-win relationship with those selected ones, sharing the program guide.

  qContribute to **the selection of new Partners** who will perform services, with the Channel Marketing program leader.

  qGet **Service Agreement** signed between the subcontractors and Schneider Procurement leader in the country, according to local regulations.

  qAccountable for **subcontractors and Partners Safety and Cybersecurity compliance** with Schneider requirements throughout the life of agreement.

  qDefine clearly the **Service ordering and invoicing processes** between Schneider Electric and Subcontractors, as well as the Supply-Chain for products and spare parts.

  q**Assess competency gaps** and **manage training needs** of technicians employed by certified Subcontractors and Partners, updating FSR Competency Management tool accordingly.

  q**Ensure** efficient and effective **planning of the services** delivered by Subcontractors to customers, then their execution (safety first, customer satisfaction, quality and efficiency following Schneider procedures), managing escalation through Issue to Prevention process (I2P).

  q**Coordinate the communication** between Subcontractors and different Schneider teams when required.

  q**Measure and challenge Subcontractors services performances**, then drive continuous improvement with them defining appropriate actions. Ensure regular audits, like for safety compliance.

  qParticipate to the **yearly review** between Procurement and Subcontractors, providing **forecasted resource plan**.

  q**Accountable for additional revenue and margin** to country P&L thanks to subcontractors, as defined by yearly Business Plan

  q**Accountable for customer satisfaction** when service delivery thru subcontractor

  q**Encourage** detection of **Leads Generations** by subcontractors

  q**Ensure Install Base** tracking and accuracy by certified subcontractors.

  q**Support licenses renewal** for Subcontractors and Partners, based on valid Service Agreement.

  **Main Interactions :**

  Reports to Field Services Operations Director.

  **Internal:** FS VP, Procurement leader, Planners, Quality leader, Safety officer, GFS academy, Channel Marketing Program leader and Channel Services Sales leader

  **External:** Subcontractors, Channel Partners, Avetta, Customers.

  Key Success factors :

  + Planning resources capability, considering country services strategy and business evolution
  + Ability to build performance dashboard and improvement plan
  + Good interpersonal communication and relationship with others
  + Ability to understand P&L and financial stakes basics.
  + Technical knowledges on Schneider products.
  + Ability to build intercompany win-win relationship.
  + Certified Subcontractor and Partner proactive competency management
  + Customer focus
  + Support subcontractor rationalization and cost optimization with procurement team.

  KPIs :

  + 0 serious safety or cybersecurity accident where Subcontractors and Partners are engaged
  + 100% subcontractors and partners with Safety and Cybersecurity certifications
  + NSS “Get Failure support” for subcontracted jobs at country target
  + Yearly Savings for subcontracting in AOC and rationalization target at country level
  + Subcontracting Ratio at country target (%Work Orders subcontracted in bFS)
  + Subcontractors Leads Generations: Min 1 every 3 interventions (=33% success) for WO executed without SE FSR presence
  + IB Tracking: No WO closed with Installed Product created or updated

  Timely completion of assigned WO in bFS (No late WO).

  
(External) English Qualifications:

title: Lobby Ambassador
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Lobby Ambassador - Job Description
  
Position Overview
  
The Lobby Ambassador serves as the primary point of contact for all visitors, tenants, and guests entering the building. This role is responsible for creating exceptional first impressions, ensuring seamless visitor experiences, and maintaining security protocols while delivering outstanding customer service in a professional corporate environment.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Visitor and Guest Services
  
Greet all visitors with professionalism and warmth, creating a welcoming atmosphere. Verify visitor credentials, issue badges, and maintain accurate visitor logs in compliance with security protocols. Notify Business Units contacts of guest arrivals promptly and courteously. Manage visitor check-in and check-out procedures efficiently while ensuring all security requirements are met.
  
  
Reception and Administrative Support
  
Answer incoming calls professionally and direct inquiries to appropriate parties. Provide accurate information about building amenities, tenant locations, and local area services. Coordinate meeting room reservations and conference services as needed. Receive, log, and distribute packages and deliveries to tenants. Assist with mail distribution and courier services.
  
Security and Access Control
  
Monitor building access points and ensure only authorized individuals enter the premises. Enforce building security policies consistently and professionally. Report security concerns, suspicious activity, or safety hazards immediately to management and security teams. Maintain awareness of emergency procedures and assist during evacuations or critical incidents. Issue temporary access cards and track their return.
  
Workspace and Environment Management
  
Maintain the lobby's professional appearance throughout the day. Ensure reception area remains clean, organized, and presentable. Refresh reading materials, brochures, and informational displays regularly. Monitor and report maintenance needs including lighting, temperature control, and equipment malfunctions.
  
Required Qualifications
  
Education and Experience
  
Bachelor degree in any steam or equivalent associate degree or relevant coursework preferred. Minimum 1-2 years of experience in customer service, hospitality, reception, or front desk roles. Experience in corporate office environments or commercial real estate settings is advantageous.
  
  
Skills and Competencies
  
Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with diverse individuals at all organizational levels. Strong customer service orientation with a genuine desire to help others. Professional appearance and demeanor that reflects positively on the building. Basic computer proficiency including Microsoft Office Suite and visitor management systems. Ability to learn building-specific technology platforms quickly.
  
Personal Attributes
  
Reliable and punctual with strong work ethic. Friendly, approachable demeanor with positive attitude. Discretion and confidentiality when handling sensitive information. Cultural awareness and ability to work effectively with diverse populations. Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and situations. Team player who collaborates well with building staff and management.
  
Physical Requirements
  
Ability to stand for extended periods during shifts. Monitor lobby activities and communicate effectively. Mobility to move throughout the lobby area and assist visitors as needed.
  
Work Schedule
  
Full-time position with standard business hours, typically Monday through Friday. Flexibility for occasional extended hours during building events or special circumstances. Shift work may be required depending on building operations.
  
Reporting Structure
  
Reports directly to the Facilities Manager. Collaborates closely with corporate security teams.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Manager II, Science, Tech - Science
description:
**About the team**  
  
The Core Analytics & Science Team (CAS) is Uber's primary science organisation, covering both our main lines of business as well as the underlying platform technologies on which those businesses are built. We are a key part of Uber's cross-functional product development teams, helping to drive every stage of product development through data analytic, statistical, and algorithmic expertise. CAS owns the experience and algorithms powering Uber's global Mobility and Delivery products. We optimise and personalise the rider and driver experience, target incentives and introduce customizations for routing and matching for products and use cases that go beyond the core Uber capabilities.
  
  
Within CAS, the Mobility Science team focuses on improving the core rider and driver experience across Uber's Mobility business. Our work spans areas such as marketplace health, pricing and incentives, matching and dispatch, rider experience, and driver experience, with the goal of ensuring a reliable and efficient experience for millions of riders and drivers globally.
  
  
A key part of this mission is enabling high-quality experimentation and causal measurement across product features that influence marketplace dynamics. The team develops and applies advanced experimentation methodologies and quasi-causal inference techniques to evaluate product changes, understand marketplace interventions, and guide data-driven decision making in complex, networked environments where traditional experimentation may not always be feasible.
  
  
**About the Role**  
  
The Mobility and Delivery Science team is Uber's science organisation covering two of our core lines of business. We are a key part of Uber's cross-functional product development teams, helping to drive every stage of product development through data analytic, statistical, and algorithmic expertise. We own the experience and algorithms powering Uber's global Mobility and Delivery products. We optimise and personalise the rider experience, target incentives and introduce customizations for routing and matching for products and use cases that go beyond the core Uber capabilities.
  
  
What the Candidate Will Do

* Lead marketplace analytics, such as understanding rider and driver price sensitivity and the balance of supply and demand, to inform pricing, incentive and matching decisions.
* Develop and grow a team of data scientists
* Work with cross functional stakeholders and influence product roadmap for their respective area, including pricing and marketplace strategy
* Refine ambiguous questions and generate new hypotheses about the product through a deep understanding of the data, our customers, and our business
* Review the design of experiments and help interpret the results to draw detailed and impactful conclusions, across standard A/Bs as well as Switchback setup and quasi-experimental techniques like synthetic controls
* Define how our teams measure success, by developing Key Performance Indicators and other users/business metrics, in close partnership with Product and other subject areas such as engineering, operations and marketing
* Collaborate with data engineers to build and improve on the availability, integrity, accuracy, and reliability of data logging and data pipelines.
* Develop data-driven business insights and work with cross-functional partners to find opportunities and recommend prioritization of product, growth, and optimization initiatives.

Basic Qualifications

* Undergraduate and/or graduate degree in Math, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, or other quantitative fields.
* Educational background in Economics (preferred), or relevant experience in an equivalent domain (preferred), or a strong product science background in the tech industry.
* 9+ years experience in Data Science, Analytics or other types of data analysis-focused functions
* 2+ years experience in managing team of analytics and data science professionals with demonstrated ability to guide and mentor them
* Advanced Python expertise
* Excellent understanding of statistical principles backed by an academic foundation
* Experience with Excel and some dashboarding/data visualization (i.e. Tableau, Mixpanel, Looker, or similar)
* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Ability to mentor, coach and develop junior and senior team members
* Superb organization skills

Preferred Qualifications

* Proven track record to wrangle large datasets, extract insights from data, and summarize learnings/takeaways.
* Proven aptitude toward Data Storytelling and Root Cause Analysis using data
* Ability to learn and adapt to new methodologies for data collection and analysis
* Ability to deliver on tight timelines and prioritize multiple tasks while maintaining quality and detail
Ability to work in a self-guided manner  

  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

title: Software Development Engineer II
description:
**About the role**  

As part of the Stores Fulfilment, you will have the opportunity to work on software applications and services that are transforming the way Tesco manages its warehouse operations. Your work will enhance the experience of our colleagues in depots and drive greater efficiency across our extensive fulfilment network. When it comes to new ideas, we’re as ambitious as you are.

Our team is modernizing the mainframe technologies that power our store fulfilment operations, adopting industry-leading standards and leveraging data science and AI to achieve our goals in mainframe platform.

From a technical perspective, we develop COBOL-based solution using VSAM , CICS and JCL.

  
**You will be responsible for**  

Hybrid work

We always welcome conversations about flexible working, so feel free to talk to us during your application about how we can support you. We value connecting, collaborating, and innovating with our colleagues in person.

At Tesco Technology, we work in a hybrid model. This role requires you to be based in Banglore, as we currently meet in the office 3 days a week

Benefits

Tesco is a diverse and exciting employer, providing career-defining opportunities to all of our colleagues.

  
**You will need**  

We take responsibility for the software through its entire lifecycle. We practice continuous integration, delivery, and support of our code through to production and beyond. Whilst specific responsibilities will be dependent upon the changing needs of the Tesco business, the following provides an overview of the role’s key responsibilities and measures:

* Be a coder; review and contribute code.
* Proactively propose solutions.
* Work in the team – support and be supported in your team.
* Design: design, propose and review architecture design.
* Focus on performance, availability, reliability, and security.
* Contribute to the definition of features for services owned by your team.
* Effectively communicate your and your team’s progress to your team members, your manager, and wider Tesco colleagues.

**You will need**

Experience: 4-10 yrs.

Expertise in COBOL, VSAM, CICS and JCL & REXX coding

Developed libraries, object repositories and optimized configurations

Automate functional/regression test scenarios

Exposure in working on automation framework

Ability to convert manual functional and regression scripts to automated script

Should be able to work independently and self-driven

Expertise in Test Automation Framework Creation is an added advantage.

  
**Whats in it for you?**  

At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you.

As a result, our colleagues enjoy a unique, differentiated, market- competitive reward package, based on the current industry practices, for all the work they put into serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day.

Our Tesco Rewards framework consists of pillars - Fixed Pay, Incentives, and Benefits.

Total Rewards offered at Tesco is determined by four principles -simple, fair, competitive, and sustainable.

**Salary** - Your fixed pay is the guaranteed pay as per your contract of employment.

**Leave & Time-off** - Colleagues are entitled to 30 days of leave (18 days of Earned Leave, 12 days of Casual/Sick Leave) and 10 national and festival holidays, as per the company’s policy.

**Making Retirement Tension-FreeSalary** - In addition to Statutory retirement beneets, Tesco enables colleagues to participate in voluntary programmes like NPS and VPF.

**Health is Wealth** - Tesco promotes programmes that support a culture of health and wellness including insurance for colleagues and their family. Our medical insurance provides coverage for dependents including parents or in-laws.

**Mental Wellbeing** - We offer mental health support through self-help tools, community groups, ally networks, face-to-face counselling, and more for both colleagues and dependents.

**Financial Wellbeing** - Through our financial literacy partner, we offer one-to-one financial coaching at discounted rates, as well as salary advances on earned wages upon request.

**Save As You Earn (SAYE)** - Our SAYE programme allows colleagues to transition from being employees to Tesco shareholders through a structured 3-year savings plan.

**Physical Wellbeing** - Our green campus promotes physical wellbeing with facilities that include a cricket pitch, football field, badminton and volleyball courts, along with indoor games, encouraging a healthier lifestyle.

**About Us**  

At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion are deeply embedded in our values—we treat people how they want to be treated. Our goal is for all colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work, and we are committed to helping them thrive. Across the Tesco group, we are building an inclusive workplace that actively celebrates the cultures, personalities, and preferences of our colleagues, who in turn contribute to the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve.

At Tesco Bengaluru, we are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer, highlighting our commitment to creating a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities. We are dedicated to offering equal opportunities for all candidates and encourage applicants with disabilities to apply. Our recruitment process is fully accessible, and we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments during interviews. If you need any accommodations to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to ensure that everyone has the chance to succeed.

We also believe in fostering a work environment where you can excel both professionally and personally. Our hybrid model allows you to work flexibly—spend 60% of your week collaborating in person with colleagues at our office locations or local sites, and the rest of the time working remotely. We understand that everyone’s life journey is unique, whether you are starting your career, pursuing passions, or navigating life changes, and we are here to support you. Flexibility is a core part of our culture, and we encourage open conversations about how we can best accommodate your needs, so talk to us throughout your application process on the support required.

When you join Tesco Bengaluru in this role, you'll be employed by Tesco Bengaluru Private Limited, the Tesco legal entity responsible for your employment.

* Collaborate with developers to identify product defects and enhance serviceability.
