title: Test Chapter Lead - Platform and Technology
description:
Bengaluru North, Karnataka, India
  

**Job Summary**

The **Test Chapter Lead** serves as the technical authority for quality engineering and testing across the organization, combining deep expertise in test architecture, automation, and project leadership. The role is responsible for defining testing strategies, driving quality standards, establishing scalable automation frameworks, and leading end-to-end verification activities for software, firmware, and hardware products.

As a technical leader, the Test Chapter Lead will mentor test engineers, guide engineering teams on quality best practices, and ensure successful delivery of complex product development initiatives. The role focuses on technical excellence, project execution, innovation, and continuous improvement while fostering a culture of quality across multiple Agile value streams.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Test Strategy & Architecture**

* Define and own the overall test strategy, architecture, and roadmap for software, firmware, and hardware products.
* Design, implement, and maintain scalable automated test frameworks and testing infrastructure.
* Establish testing standards, procedures, checklists, and best practices to ensure consistent quality across development teams.
* Drive quality engineering initiatives, including shift-left testing, continuous testing, and risk-based testing approaches.
* Evaluate and implement emerging testing technologies, methodologies, and tools.

### **Technical Leadership**

* Act as the primary technical authority for testing and quality engineering.
* Provide technical mentorship and guidance to test engineers and cross-functional engineering teams.
* Review system architectures, requirements, and designs to identify potential quality risks and validation requirements.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective actions for complex product quality issues.
* Promote automation-first practices and continuous improvement throughout the development lifecycle.

### **Project & Delivery Leadership**

* Lead test planning, estimation, execution, and reporting activities for multiple projects and product releases.
* Coordinate testing efforts across teams, value streams, and geographical locations.
* Ensure timely delivery of testing milestones and adherence to release schedules.
* Drive defect management, risk assessment, and quality metrics reporting to stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, System Architects, and Engineering Managers to ensure successful product delivery.

### **Agile & Collaboration**

* Champion Agile testing principles and quality-focused development practices.
* Foster collaboration between software, firmware, hardware, systems, and product teams.
* Drive continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) testing practices.
* Promote knowledge sharing, technical excellence, and innovation across the Test Chapter.

**Key Requirements**
--------------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in software, firmware, and hardware testing.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in a Test Lead, Test Architect, Quality Engineering Lead, or similar technical leadership role.
* Strong experience in test automation frameworks, test strategy development, and quality engineering practices.
* Hands-on experience leading end-to-end testing efforts for complex products and systems.
* Experience with Agile methodologies and modern software development practices.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and release quality processes.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and technical leadership skills.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with embedded systems, IoT devices, industrial automation products, or hardware-software integrated solutions.
* Understanding of power utility, electrical monitoring, or industrial technology domains.
* Experience with performance, security, and scalability testing.
* Familiarity with DevOps, cloud-based testing environments, and modern automation toolsets.
* ISTQB, Agile, Scrum, or equivalent certifications.
* Proven success leading quality initiatives across multiple cross-functional product teams.

**Ralliant Corporation Overview**

Ralliant, originally part of Fortive, now stands as a bold, independent public company driving innovation at the forefront of precision technology. With a global footprint and a legacy of excellence, we empower engineers to bring next-generation breakthroughs to life — faster, smarter, and more reliably. Our high-performance instruments, sensors, and subsystems fuel mission-critical advancements across industries, enabling real-world impact where it matters most. At Ralliant we're building the future, together with those driven to push boundaries, solve complex problems, and leave a lasting mark on the world.

**About Qualitrol**

QUALITROL manufactures monitoring and protection devices for high value electrical assets and OEM manufacturing companies. Established in 1945, QUALITROL produces thousands of different types of products on demand and customized to meet our individual customers’ needs. We are the largest and most trusted global leader for partial discharge monitoring, asset protection equipment and information products across power generation, transmission, and distribution. At Qualitrol, we are redefining condition-based monitoring.

We Are an Equal Opportunity Employer. Ralliant Corporation and all Ralliant Companies are proud to be equal opportunity employers. We value and encourage diversity and solicit applications from all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or other characteristics protected by law. Ralliant and all Ralliant Companies are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. Individuals who need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment application process, please contact us at applyassistance@Ralliant.com.

**Bonus or Equity**
  
This position is also eligible for bonus as part of the total compensation package.

title: Senior Serviceability Engineer - Networking
description:
**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**

**The Opportunity**

Are you a hungry, humble, and honest individual with a passion for enhancing customer experiences through improved product serviceability? If so, joining our team as a Serviceability Engineer at Nutanix offers you the opportunity to collaborate across diverse functions, drive impactful serviceability improvements, and work closely with talented professionals dedicated to delivering exceptional support and usability for our innovative products.

**About the Team**

The Serviceability Engineer role is part of the Service Strategy & Enablement team at Nutanix, based in Bangalore. This team is made up of passionate engineers dedicated to improving product serviceability, diagnostics, and the overall customer experience.

Serving as a critical bridge between Support and Engineering, the Service Strategy & Enablement team ensures that serviceability and usability are embedded into every stage of product design and development. By analyzing support cases, monitoring field performance, and incorporating customer feedback, the team drives continuous improvements that enhance both product quality and the support experience.

You will report to the Manager, Service Strategy & Enablement, whose leadership style fosters empowerment, collaboration, and continuous learning. The team operates in a hybrid work environment, encouraging in-person collaboration a few days each week to promote teamwork, innovation, and shared success.

**Your Role**

The Senior Serviceability Network Engineer, will play a critical role in enhancing the serviceability, reliability, and diagnostic capabilities of Nutanix Network products. This role partners closely with Engineering, Product Management, and Support throughout the product lifecycle - from concept to release and post-deployment - to ensure products are designed, validated, and supported with serviceability at the forefront.

* Develop and maintain comprehensive Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) defining serviceability and diagnostic improvements.
* Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering to embed serviceability requirements early in the New Product Introduction (NPI) cycle and across existing hardware product lines.
* Review, track, and drive resolution for critical and deferred defects, ensuring timely closure and cross-functional visibility.
* Partner with DevEx, QA, and Engineering teams to prioritize field issues, provide feedback on test plans, and ensure known gaps are covered in test automation and validation.
* Lead serviceability validation testing for upcoming software and hardware releases — including defining test plans, tracking bugs, and monitoring bug fix rates.
* Coordinate with Release Management and Portal teams to ensure proper documentation, readiness, and smooth rollout of releases.
* Act as a bridge between Support, Engineering, and Product Management to align on serviceability improvements and customer-impacting issues.
* Participate in PRD reviews and collaborate on developing troubleshooting guides and support readiness materials.
* Analyze post-release field data and lessons learned to identify opportunities for design and diagnostic enhancements.
* Champion serviceability best practices and promote a culture of customer-centric design across hardware development teams.

**What Will You Bring**

* Minimum 5+ years of experience in the technology industry, with a strong background in customer support, product quality, or serviceability.
* Bachelor’s degree in, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent experience).

**Technical requirement**

**Virtualization & Hybrid Cloud**

* **Hypervisor Concepts:** Good knowledge of VMware / KVM / Nutanix based virtualization.
* **Public Cloud Networking:** Familiarity with AWS VPCs, AWS Direct Connect, Azure Virtual Networks, and Azure ExpressRoute

**Software-Defined Networking (SDN) & Network Virtualization**

* **Open vSwitch (OVS) & Open Virtual Network (OVN):** OVS bridge chaining, virtual switch management, and OVN logical routers/switches.
* **Overlay Networks:** Knowledge of network encapsulation protocols, specifically VXLAN and Geneve, used with Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs) and Layer 2 network extensions.
* **VMware NSX Architecture & Concepts:** Conceptually equivalent to Nutanix Flow features.

**Core Networking (L2/L3) & Routing**

* **Switching Fundamentals:** Strong understanding of VLANs, LACP, network bond modes, and MTU/Jumbo frames.
* **Advanced Routing:** Proficiency in dynamic routing protocols, especially BGP and OSPF, which are critical for configuring gateways and Layer 2 subnet extensions to external networks.
* **Network Address Translation (NAT):** Experience with SNAT and floating IPs within VPC environments.

**Network Security & Microsegmentation**

* **Distributed Firewalls:** Understanding how stateful, policy-based firewalls function in a virtualized environment to secure east-west traffic.
* **Policy Migration & Translation:** Experience with NSX Distributed Firewall (DFW). Understanding NSX's IP-based/group policy models and Nutanix Flow's category-based (identity-aware) policy model.
* **Traffic Management:** Familiarity with Access Control Lists (ACLs), Policy-Based Routing (PBR), and Service Chaining (redirecting traffic through third-party firewalls like Palo Alto Networks or load balancers).

**Linux Systems & Network Troubleshooting**

* **Linux Networking:** Proficiency in Linux network administration
* **Datapath Analysis:** Ability to trace traffic flows from the host, through overlay networks and edge gateways, to the physical network. Packet capture and analysis using tools like tcpdump

* Proven ability to translate Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) into actionable serviceability initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience in reviewing and prioritizing product defects and collaborating with engineering teams to drive resolution.
* Strong track record of leading cross-functional improvement initiatives that enhance product quality and support efficiency.
* Proficient with Salesforce, JIRA, and Confluence for issue tracking, project management, and documentation.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at all organizational levels — from individual contributors to executives.
* Skilled in negotiation, conflict management, and guiding teams toward resolution while achieving aggressive goals.
* Proven success working collaboratively with Engineering, Product Management, Support, and external partners.

**Work Arrangement** Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

title: Customer Relationship Executive (CRE)
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
**Position:** Community Executive
  
**Business:** Property and Asset Management, Bangalore
  
  
What this job involves
  
  
We are seeking a dynamic and customer-oriented Community Executive to join our team. As a Community Executive, you will play a crucial role in creating a positive first impression for our clients, visitors, and employees. Your primary responsibility will be to ensure smooth front office operations while providing exceptional customer service.
  
  

* High school diploma or equivalent qualification. Additional relevant certifications are a plus.
* Proven experience as a Front Desk Executive, Receptionist, or in a similar customer-facing role.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Proficient in using office equipment (e.g., phone systems, printers, etc.).
* Familiarity with MS Office applications (Word, Excel, Outlook).
* Polite, professional, and customer-focused demeanour.
* Ability to maintain composure under pressure and handle challenging situations with poise.
* Punctual and dependable with a strong sense of responsibility.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in handling data and documents.

**Reception and Welcoming:** Greet visitors, tenants, and employees with a friendly and professional demeanor. Provide a warm and welcoming environment, making tenants and visitors feel comfortable and valued.
  
  
**Visitor Management:** Greet visitors, assist them with registration/way finding as Notify relevant staff of visitor arrivals and handle security protocols.
  
  
**Information Dissemination:** Provide accurate and up-to-date information about the organization's services, products, and policies. Assist visitors with general queries and direct them to the relevant resources.
  
  
**Administrative Support:** Assist in various administrative tasks such as coordinating with the Hospitality team for upkeep of the asset and events, as required Handle incoming and outgoing mail and packages.
  
  
**Facilities Management:** Monitor and maintain the cleanliness and organization of the front desk area. Report any maintenance or security issues promptly.
  
  
**Communication:** Communicate effectively with colleagues and management regarding any relevant issues or updates.
  
  
**Problem-Solving:** Handle complaints or difficult situations with diplomacy and tact. Escalate issues to the appropriate department when necessary
  
  
**Reporting:**  
You will be reporting to the Property Manager.
  
  
**Sound like you? Here is what we’re looking for:**  
Being Analytical and Meticulous
  
You must pay attention to detail and have excellent accounting and financial management knowledge and skills. Possess the ability to collate information into the system and maintain it in the record books.
  
  
Qualifications
  
You will have a Degree / Diploma with relevant educational background in with min 2-3 years of work experience.
  
  
**What we can do for you:**  
At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.
  
Apply today!
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Director, Product Development
description:
Overview:

Planview has one mission: to close the gap between strategic intent and business outcome, providing the intelligence organizations need to act decisively.

As the global leader in Strategic Portfolio Management, Planview helps organizations of all sizes achieve their business goals, faster and smarter. Our comprehensive platform bring initiatives, investments, and resources into a continuous, connected model of the business: the actionable understanding leaders need to move decisively, keep teams and AI in lockstep, and know how their initiatives are performing.—now powered by Planview Anvi, our next-generation enterprise AI that delivers expert guidance, intelligent recommendations, and actionable insights, turning complex data into decisive action from strategy through execution.

Recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Strategic Portfolio Management for the fifth consecutive year, we proudly serve more than 3,000 customers globally, including 45% of the Fortune 100—and more than 3 million users worldwide.

**Why Join Planview?**

At Planview, our people’s connections drive our innovation and success. Our global team of 1,500+ employees work remotely and across offices in Austin, Vancouver, Hod HaSharon, Bangalore, Sydney, and Stockholm. We've built a world-class, connected culture rooted in shared values that empowers our teams to thrive and succeed from anywhere. When you join Planview, you're not just joining a company, you're joining a movement to transform how the world works.

Discover more about our portfolio at planview.com, and connect with us on LinkedIn, Instagram, and X.

Responsibilities:

**Lead Global Delivery and Customer Outcomes**

* Own delivery quality, customer satisfaction, financial performance, and execution confidence across the global Retain portfolio.
* Establish clear expectations for delivery, engineering execution, quality, collaboration, customer responsiveness, and risk management.
* Oversee portfolio planning, forecasting, staffing, utilization, margin performance, and continuous improvement, including effective collaboration with India-based teams.
* Serve as an executive escalation point for strategic customers, ensuring clear ownership, recovery plans, communication, and root-cause actions.

**Connect Product, Engineering, and Customer Value**

* Partner with Product and Engineering leaders to create viable, sequenced, and customer-focused roadmaps.
* Balance customer commitments, product strategy, capacity, technical feasibility, quality, technical debt, modernization, security, reliability, EOL remediation, and platform sustainability.
* Translate technical risks and engineering constraints into clear implications for customer outcomes, investment, margin, timing, and delivery confidence.
* Ensure roadmap decisions have clear priorities, owners, assumptions, dependencies, confidence levels, and trade-offs—and can be clearly communicated to customers and executives.

**Drive Business Growth and Development Services**

* Partner with Sales and customer-facing leaders to expand accounts, support new-logo growth, and increase bookings.
* Identify and shape repeatable opportunities in modernization, migration, integration, technical assessment, upgrades, adoption, and development services.
* Evaluate opportunities for customer value, commercial potential, delivery repeatability, capability requirements, capacity, margin, and operational risk.
* Convert validated opportunities into scalable offerings rather than one-off commitments that create unsustainable support obligations.

**Build Leadership Capacity and Organizational Resilience**

* Lead, coach, and develop distributed Delivery, Development, and Engineering leaders across products, customers, regions, and time zones.
* Build a strong leadership bench through delegation, succession planning, targeted development, and clear accountability.
* Strengthen operating clarity, leadership coverage, decision-making, technical judgment, stakeholder management, and customer orientation.
* Oversee hiring, career progression, performance management, and capability development for delivery and development talent.

**Establish Effective Operating Governance**

* Create a consistent operating rhythm for portfolio, roadmap, modernization, customer escalation, delivery-risk, and executive decision reviews.
* Ensure effective Sales-to-Delivery handoffs, including alignment on customer needs, scope, estimates, feasibility, roadmap implications, and staffing.
* Identify systemic product, process, quality, or capability issues and drive corrective action across the organization.
* Maintain alignment with Planview methodologies and promote disciplined, transparent, and scalable execution.

Qualifications:

* 15–18 years of experience in professional services, consulting, software development, engineering leadership, product engineering, or technology delivery.
* 8–12 years of leadership experience across complex programs, portfolios, products, engineering organizations, or enterprise delivery environments.
* 5+ years leading large, distributed teams and developing Delivery, Development, or Engineering managers across regions and time zones.
* Demonstrated success managing software development organizations and building effective leadership structures.
* Strong understanding of architecture dependencies, engineering practices, modernization, EOL management, technical debt, upgrades, reliability, security, and platform sustainability.
* Proven ability to partner with Product and Engineering leaders to shape feasible roadmaps and communicate value, risk, and trade-offs to customers and executives.
* Experience leading complex customer escalations and improving satisfaction, retention, adoption, and expansion.
* Track record of building leadership succession, coaching emerging leaders, and improving organizational resilience.
* Experience developing professional-services or development-services offerings with strong commercial, delivery, and margin outcomes.
* Broad understanding of enterprise AI delivery, including generative AI, LLMs, RAG, agentic AI, workflow automation, data readiness, cloud platforms, governance, and adoption.
* Strong financial, commercial, communication, and executive stakeholder-management skills.

Great Benefits and Fun Perks:

At Planview, you’ll join our global team and culture which reflects the vibrant communities in which our employees live and work. To support you at Planview, you will enjoy:

* Unplugged Days: 4 company-wide paid days off per year to recharge and relax.
* Generous PTO offerings (region dependent).
* Region specific competitive benefit plans to support you at any life stage including parental leave, retirement, medical plans, wellness support, and remote work support.
* Paid time to volunteer through Planview’s Force for Good Week.
* Employee Referral bonus program.
* Weekly office lunches for hybrid team members and social events.
* Flexible work hours/environment.

Now is a great time to join our team. If you are looking for a place to grow your career, innovate with best-in-class solutions, and build the future of connected work, Planview is the right place for you!

Location:

Bangalore,IND

The role requires expertise in sourcing strategies, market mapping, candidate engagement, and contractor-to-full-time conversion programs. * Experience managing contractor workforce programs and contractor-to-permanent employee conversions.

title: Security Consultant
description:
Location: Bengaluru

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: Oct 12, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1746236

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Senior Security Consultant**

**EY Technology:**

Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.

**EY Technology** supports our technology needs through three business units:

**Client Technology (CT) -** focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster, and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.

**Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) –** EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.

**Information Security (Info Sec) -** Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.

  

**The opportunity**

As a Security Consultant within EY’s internal Global Information Security team, the individual will be a trusted security advisor to the Client Technology Platforms Delivery organization within IT Services. The Client Technology Platforms delivery organization is responsible for end-to-end delivery of technology programs and projects supporting EY’s Client Techmology service lines including delivery of a global managed services platform, big data and analytics solutions as well as individual line of business solutions and services. This role will directly engage in supporting a team of architects, engineers, and product managers for delivery on programs and projects, defining security risks and control, providing security guidance, identifying and prioritizing security-related requirements, promoting secure-by-default designs and facilitating delivery of information security services throughout the system development life cycle (SDLC). The role will also develop and directly communicate appropriate risk treatment and mitigation options to address security vulnerabilities translated vulnerabilities into business risk terminology for communication to business stakeholders.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Support a technical team with a focus on the following responsibilities:
* Provide security architectures and provide pragmatic security guidance that balance business benefit and risks.
* Engage IT project teams throughout the SDLC to identify and prioritize applicable security controls and provide guidance on how to implement these controls
* Perform threat modeling and risk assessments of information systems, applications and infrastructure
* Maintain and enhance the Information Security risk assessment and certification methodologies
* Define security configuration standards for shared and multi-tenant platforms and technologies
* Develop appropriate risk treatment and mitigation options to address security risks identified during security review or audit
* Translate technical vulnerabilities into business risk terminology for business units and recommend corrective actions to customers and project stakeholders
* Provide knowledge sharing and technical assistance to other team members
* Act as Subject Matter Expert (SME) in responsible technologies and have deep technical understanding of responsible services and technology portfolios

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

Significant working security experience and knowledge in the design, implementation, and operation of security controls in one of the following areas:

* **Cloud Security** – Technical understanding of virtualization, cloud infrastructure, and public cloud offerings and experience designing security configuration and controls within cloud-based solutions e.g., Microsoft Azure and Azure PAAS services or another cloud platform (GCP, AWS, IBM, AliCloud, etc.)
* **Infrastructure Security** – Experience with the integration of cloud native infrastructure security technologies and solutions into business solution architectures including the integration of identity & access management, Web Application Firewalls (WAFs), Application and API Gateways, intrusion detection and prevention, security monitoring, and data encryption solutions.
* **Application Security** - Experience with the design and testing of security controls for multi-tier business solutions including the design of application-level access and entitlement management, data tenancy and isolation, encryption, and logging. Working familiarity with REST API and microservices architecture.
* **Identity and Access Management** – Experience with Azure Active Directory (AAD) based Identity and Access Management and Authorization design and integration with API, IDaaS, and Federation technologies.
* **Agile & DevSecOps Methodologies** – Experience promoting automated security features in pipelines and security testing as a central feature in Agile workflows as a contributing member within an Agile development or DevOps environment.

  

Although not required, it is preferred that candidates possess additional working security experience and knowledge in one or more of the following areas:

* **Operational Security** – Experience with defining operational security models and procedures for business solutions including the operation and maintenance of infrastructure and application security controls.
* **Information Security Standards** – Knowledge of common information security standards such as: ISO 27001/27002, CSA and CIS Controls, NIST CSF, PCI/DSS, FEDRAMP.
* **Product Management** – working with broader business and technology teams on aspects of security that affect all phases of PI Planning from concept to design to implementation and then operational support.

  

**To qualify for the role you must have:**

* Advanced degree in Computer Science or a related discipline; or equivalent work experience.
* Candidates are preferred to hold or be actively pursuing related professional certifications within the GIAC family of certifications or CISSP, CISM or CISA or similar cloud-security oriented certifications.
* Five or more years of experience in the management of a significant Information Security risk management function
* Experience in managing the communication of security findings and recommendations to IT project teams, business leadership and technology management executives

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Exceptional judgment, tact, and decision-making ability
* Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change
* Excellent , communication, organizational, and decision-making skills
* Strong English language skills are required

  

**What working at EY offers**

We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Analyst – Bid Management
description:
**Introduction**  

Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.

  
**Overview**

Gallagher Center of Excellence (GCoE) is seeking to hire a Bid Content Specialist – Knowledge and Document Manager. As a Proposal Response Specialist, you are responsible for ensuring Gallagher’s Bid Library is proactively maintained with fresh, relevant content. You will become an expert in using Gallagher’s ‘Responsive – formerly RFPIO’ technology to work with Sales Teams to capture and communicate our value proposition. You will use the Bid Library to provide Sales Teams with answer content across all Gallagher propositions.
  
You will be responsible for content strategy development, advanced writing and editing skills, and working closely with the Bid Managers on a day-to-day basis.  
This role requires a strategic thinker with excellent writing skills who can translate complex insurance concepts into clear, persuasive documents. You are required to collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather necessary information, ensuring that all proposals meet client specifications and industry standards. Success in this position involves producing compelling bid content that enhances the company's chances of winning new business and expanding its client base. Additionally, you will be responsible for fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer focus within the shared services team. You will be interacting with teams present in Bengaluru and Pune.

  
  
**How you'll make an impact**

**Responsibilities:**

* **Response Development:** Review assigned RFP questions and select the most appropriate responses from approved content libraries and knowledge repositories.
* **Content Customization:** Tailor responses to align with prospect requirements, industry considerations, and client-specific circumstances while maintaining approved messaging.
* **Content Analysis:** Evaluate requirements, identify content gaps, and determine when additional research or subject matter expertise is needed.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Incorporate reviewer feedback and lessons learned to improve future proposal responses and overall response quality.
* **Content Knowledge Management:** Maintain familiarity with approved content, response libraries, and became champion of knowledge sharing
* **Content Enhancement:** Identify outdated, duplicate, inaccurate, or missing content and contribute to ongoing content improvement initiatives.
* **Deadline Management:** Manage multiple proposals simultaneously, ensuring deliverables are completed accurately and on time.
* **AI Advocacy & Digital Enablement:** Act as a champion for AI and digital technologies by promoting adoption, sharing best practices, identifying use cases, and leveraging tools such as Microsoft Copilot to enhance proposal development, content management, and operational efficiency
* **Project Management:** Take ownership of the proposal and co-ordinate with Bid Managers till the proposal submission. Have regular connects with the Bid Mangers to ensure the smooth progress of the project.

  
**About you**

**Qualifications:**

**Education:**

* **Minimum Required Degree:** Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, English, or a related field.
* **Preferred Degree:** Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, English, or a related field.
* **Master's Degree** in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, English, or a related field is preferred.

**Certificate(s)/Special Training:**

* Knowledge Capture Certification or equivalent
* Certification in Insurance Bid writing is highly preferred.
* Advanced training in SEO (Search Engine Optimization) and SEM (Search Engine Marketing) is advantageous.
* Proficiency in content management systems (CMS) such as WordPress.
* Training in analytics tools such as Google Analytics is beneficial.

The Technology Strategy & Advisory Practice is a part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on our clients’ most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative R&D transformation, aimed at redefining business models.

We provide you with a great learning ground, where you will get an opportunity to advice and work with our key global clients, driving end-to-end transformative strategic value and business growth. * **Business problem assessment:** Engage with client stakeholders to assess ITSM pain points and current-state service management capabilities, define problem statements, scope engagements, and drive project workstreams to deliver measurable outcomes
* **Process Design & Analysis:** Analyze client ITSM processes across key functions (Incident, Problem, Change, Request, CMDB, Service Catalog, etc.) to identify maturity gaps, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities, and develop structured recommendations for process re-engineering and operating model enhancement

Contribute to defining KPIs/OKRs and tracking improvement in service quality, cost optimization, automation, and user experience
* **Understand and apply the key service management levers of a business**, how they impact the scope and approach of the engagement

* (5-8) years of relevant consulting experience in IT Service Management, with hands-on exposure to ITSM assessments, process design, and operating model development. Strong skills in structuring analysis, building client narratives, and crafting compelling deliverables in PowerPoint and other formats.
* Good understanding across multiple ITSM domains including Incident Management, Problem Management, Change & Release Management, Service Request Management, CMDB/Asset Management, Service Catalog, and Knowledge Management. Preferred experience in ITSM strategy and operating model design.

Familiarity with the ITSM tooling landscape (e.g., ServiceNow, JIRA Service Management, BMC Remedy/Helix, Ivanti) from a consulting advisory standpoint is a plus.

* 3+ years of experience developing ITSM maturity assessments, process design documents, and transformation business cases to support strategic IT service management initiatives
* Quickly understand the **key ITSM and service management levers of an organization**, how they impact the scope and approach of the engagement
* Advanced presentation, public speaking skills and ability to **drive C-suite/senior leadership level discussions**
* Ability to manage **ITSM engagement planning, scoping, and workstream management activities** and contribute to client proposals and project planning documentation
* Proficiency in ITSM maturity assessment frameworks, process mapping, and the ability to translate findings into executive-ready presentations and structured recommendations
* **Maximize capacity to develop high impact thought leadership** that articulates a forward-thinking view of the market and work creatively and analytically in a problem-solving environment.
* Promote a **culture of experimentation and innovation**.

**Read more about us.**

* Recent Blogs

  

**Your experience counts!**

* MBA from a tier 1 institute
* Working experience across:

* 10-14 years of experience in IT/technology consulting, with a strong focus on ITSM strategy, process design, and service management transformation
* 7+ years of relevant experience in ITSM process design and re-engineering, service management operating model design, and ITSM consulting delivery
* Solid knowledge of ITSM frameworks (ITIL 4, VeriSM, COBIT) and their practical application in enterprise service management environments
* Awareness of and interest in emerging ITSM trends including AI-driven service management, AIOps, intelligent automation, and next-generation service desk models
* Working knowledge of ITSM frameworks and standards—e.g., ITIL 4, VeriSM, SIAM, COBIT—and core ITSM process areas such as Incident, Problem, Change, CMDB, and Service Catalog management. General awareness of the ITSM tooling landscape is beneficial but not a requirement
* Practical industry expertise in Financial Services, Retail, Consumer Goods, Telecommunications, Life Sciences, Transportation, Hospitality, Automotive/Industrial, Mining and Resources is of interest but experience in equivalent domains is also welcome.

title: Senior Manager, Partner Solution Architect
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  
  
  

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

  
  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  
  
  

As Senior Manager, Partner Solution Architects, you will lead and grow a team of Partner Success Architects (PSAs) based in our India Delivery Center, setting the technical direction, delivery standards, and career development path for the team. Your team is the technical backbone of our partner ecosystem, providing hands-on solution design, activation support, and delivery escalation expertise for our global network of Systems Integrator (SI) and Independent Software Vendor (ISV) Global Delivery Center personnel as Docusign’s in-region APJ partners. You will work cross-functionally with Americas, EMEA and AP partner and sales leadership, engineering, and the global Partner Success organization to make sure the right technical resources are deployed against the right priorities, and that every technical engagement ties back to a tangible, customer-facing partner deliverable.

This position is a people manager role reporting to the Senior Director, Value Delivery Activation.

**Responsibility**

* Lead, hire, coach, and develop a team of Partner Solution Architects in the India Delivery Center, setting technical quality standards, career paths, and performance expectations
* Own technical solutioning and technical delivery support for Docusign's APJ in-region teams, ensuring PSAs deliver timely, high-quality solution design, activation workshops, and delivery escalation support for partner-led engagements
* Own technical solutioning and technical delivery support for GDC resources across our Systems Integrator (SI) and Independent Software Vendor (ISV) network.
* Partner closely with in-region Partner Success and Sales leaders to align on ISV and SI enablement and delivery-support priorities, and ensure PSA resources are deployed in alignment with in-region business strategies and demand
* Define, document, and continuously refine team activities, engagement models, and playbooks, ensuring technical solutioning and technical delivery support connect directly to customer-facing partner deliverables
* Establish and report on agreed upon team KPIs (e.g., GDC pre-delivery assessment completion, nearshore delivery volume, GDC-to-onshore handoff SLAs, ISV/Builder enablement and activation velocity) to global Customer Success and Partner Success leadership
* Serve as the primary escalation point for complex technical issues raised by partner personnel, engaging Docusign engineering and product teams as needed
* Represent the Partner Success Architect function to internal stakeholders and partner organizations, championing consistent, scalable technical enablement practices

  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  
  
  

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

  
  

**What you bring**
------------------

  
  
  

**Basic**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 12+ years of experience in technical solutioning, solutions architecture, or technical delivery roles, including experience supporting partner or channel ecosystems
* 2+ years of people management experience, ideally leading technical or partner-facing teams
* Demonstrated experience working with Systems Integrators (SI) and/or Independent Software Vendors (ISV)
* Experience supporting or collaborating with global and regional delivery teams across time zones, including APJ

  
  

**Preferred**

* Experience building, managing, or scaling a Global Delivery Center (GDC) or nearshore/offshore technical delivery model
* Hands-on experience with Docusign IAM, CLM, eSignature, or agentic/AI-native solutions
* Experience with Salesforce.com
* Experience defining enablement programs, technical playbooks, or delivery frameworks for partner ecosystems
* Track record of aligning cross-regional stakeholders (APJ, EMEA, Americas) on shared technical enablement and delivery priorities
* Strong understanding of e-signature, contract lifecycle management (CLM), or intelligent agreement management technologies
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to both technical and business audiences

  

**Life at Docusign**
--------------------

  
  
  

**Working here**

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

**Accommodation**

Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

title: Assistant Manager - Referral & Alternative Sourcing
description:
1. Role Objective

To drive business sourcing, qualified lead generation, site visits, and bookings through Customer Referrals, Loyalty Programs, Employee Referrals, Corporate Associations, Outstation and NRI initiatives, and other alternative sourcing channels. The role is responsible for developing sustainable sourcing programs, achieving assigned business targets, improving conversion efficiency, and ensuring cost-effective execution in alignment with the organization's business plan.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Business Planning & Sourcing Strategy

1. Develop and implement sourcing plans for new project launches and sustenance business through Referral, Loyalty, Employee, Corporate, Outstation, NRI, and Alternative Sourcing channels.

2. Plan and achieve a minimum of 50% of the overall business plan through designated non-marketing-led sourcing channels, with the balance 50% attributed to marketing-led sourcing, as per the approved business plan.

3. Work closely with the Brand & Marketing Head to establish monthly, quarterly, and annual sourcing targets for each channel.

4. Develop long-term sourcing strategies and scalable programs to ensure consistent business contribution across projects.

5. Identify new sourcing opportunities, assess their potential, and recommend initiatives to strengthen lead generation and business conversion.

B. Referral & Loyalty Program Management

1. Develop and execute customer referral and loyalty programs to generate qualified leads, site visits, and bookings.

2. Design structured referral initiatives to encourage existing customers to recommend the organization's projects to prospective buyers.

3. Coordinate with the Brand & Marketing Head to develop referral benefits, customer engagement initiatives, and loyalty program structures.

4. Monitor referral lead quality, customer engagement, conversion rates, and program effectiveness.

5. Identify opportunities to increase repeat business, customer advocacy, and referrals across existing projects.

C. Employee & Corporate Sourcing

1. Develop and implement employee referral programs to generate qualified prospects through the organization's internal network.

2. Establish and strengthen corporate sourcing initiatives through associations with IT companies, manufacturing companies, institutions, and other relevant organizations.

3. Plan and execute corporate engagement activities, employee outreach programs, and targeted property awareness initiatives.

4. Work with internal stakeholders to communicate project offerings and approved employee or corporate benefits.

5. Track lead generation, site visits, bookings, and business contribution from employee and corporate sourcing initiatives.

D. Outstation, NRI & Alternative Sourcing

1. Develop targeted sourcing strategies to generate business from outstation customers, NRIs, and other relevant customer segments.

2. Identify suitable markets, customer groups, and engagement opportunities to expand the organization's sourcing footprint.

3. Coordinate with the Marketing and Sales Teams to execute targeted outreach programs, customer engagement initiatives, and project presentation activities.

4. Develop alternative sourcing initiatives based on market opportunities and business requirements.

5. Monitor channel-wise performance and optimize sourcing strategies based on lead quality, site visits, bookings, and acquisition costs.

E. Site Visit Generation & Conversion Management

1. Work closely with the Brand & Marketing Head, Sales Team, and Telemarketing Team to convert sourced leads into qualified site visits and bookings.

2. Maintain a minimum 10% lead-to-walk-in ratio and 15% walk-in-to-booking ratio, as per organizational benchmarks.

3. Achieve an average booking conversion of 15% against the applicable assigned sourcing base, as defined in the approved business plan.

4. Track lead movement, follow-ups, site visit scheduling, actual walk-ins, bookings, and cancellations across all sourcing channels.

5. Identify conversion gaps and implement corrective action plans in coordination with the relevant teams.

6. Take proactive measures to minimize avoidable cancellations through timely follow-ups and customer coordination.

F. Budget & Cost Management

1. Ensure that referral benefits, loyalty incentives, employee and corporate benefits, activation expenses, and other sourcing-related costs remain within approved budgets.

2. Work closely with the Brand & Marketing Head, Finance, Vendor Management, and Strategy Teams to plan and monitor sourcing expenditure.

3. Track cost per lead, cost per site visit, cost per booking, and return on investment for each sourcing initiative.

4. Recommend measures to improve sourcing efficiency and maximize business contribution within approved cost parameters.

5. Ensure all benefits, incentives, and commercial commitments follow the organization's approval processes.

G. Payout Management & Operational Coordination

1. Coordinate with Finance and relevant internal teams to ensure accurate processing and timely settlement of approved referral benefits, loyalty rewards, and other eligible sourcing-related payouts.

2. Maintain proper documentation of referrals, lead registrations, eligibility, approvals, booking references, and payout status.

3. Resolve payout-related queries and discrepancies in coordination with the concerned teams.

4. Ensure compliance with approved payout policies, documentation requirements, and internal processes.

H. CRM, MIS & Performance Monitoring

1. Ensure disciplined usage of SFDC (Salesforce) for lead registration, source attribution, lead tracking, and booking updates.

2. Ensure accurate and timely recording of all sourcing activities and maintain reliable channel-wise data.

3. Prepare regular MIS reports covering lead generation, sourcing contribution, site visits, booking conversions, cancellations, expenditure, and program performance.

4. Review performance against monthly and quarterly targets and implement corrective measures wherever required.

5. Use data-driven insights to identify high-performing sourcing initiatives and improve overall business productivity.

I. Governance, Ethics & Compliance

1. Maintain high standards of ethics, integrity, transparency, and professional conduct across all sourcing activities.

2. Ensure adherence to organizational policies, approved benefits, documentation standards, and applicable compliance requirements.

3. Prevent unauthorized commitments, incorrect source attribution, payout irregularities, and conflicts of interest.

4. Maintain effective coordination with Marketing, Sales, Telemarketing, Finance, Vendor Management, and Strategy Teams.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Sourcing Contribution: Minimum 50% of the approved business plan through designated non-marketing-led sourcing channels.

- Lead-to-Walk-in Ratio: Minimum 10%.

- Walk-in-to-Booking Ratio: Minimum 15%.

- Booking Conversion: Average 15% against the defined sourcing base.

- Referral & Loyalty Programs: Achievement of assigned lead, walk-in, and booking targets.

- Employee & Corporate Sourcing: Achievement of approved sourcing targets.

- Outstation & NRI Sourcing: Achievement of assigned business contribution targets.

- Cost Efficiency: Sourcing expenditure maintained within approved budgets.

- Cancellation Management: Reduction in avoidable booking cancellations.

- CRM Compliance: Accurate and timely SFDC usage and source attribution.

- Payout Efficiency: Timely processing of eligible benefits and rewards.

- Reporting & Governance: Timely MIS submission and adherence to organizational policies.

4. Key Working Relationships

- Brand & Marketing Head

- Sales Team

- Telemarketing Team

- Finance Team

- Vendor Management Team

- Strategy and Business Planning Team

- Existing Customers and Referral Networks

- Corporate Organizations and Employee Networks

5. Role Expectations

The Assistant Manager is expected to demonstrate strong business ownership, relationship management, analytical capability, planning, and execution discipline. The role requires proactive identification of sourcing opportunities, close coordination with internal stakeholders, and regular engagement at project sites, including weekends when required.

Success in this role will be measured by sustainable alternative sourcing growth, achievement of assigned business targets, improved lead-to-site-visit and booking conversions, and cost-effective execution within approved budgets.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Lead Engineer - L3 Observability
description:
**Presidio, Where Teamwork and Innovation Shape the Future**  
At Presidio, we're at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting-edge digital solutions and next-generation AI. We empower businesses - and their internal customers - to achieve more through innovation, automation, and intelligent insights.

**The Role**

Level 3 Managed Service Engineer serves as the senior escalation point and technical authority for end-to-end observability across the environment. This role is responsible for resolving or driving resolution of highly complex incidents spanning application, infrastructure, network, and third-party dependencies, while owning observability strategy, Datadog architecture, monitoring standards, and continuous improvement. The engineer is expected to guide L1 and L2 engineers, lead root cause analysis and major incident reviews, and partner with cross-functional teams to improve detection, reduce noise, and strengthen operational resilience for both 3-tier and cloud-native applications.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the final escalation and technical authority for complex, cross-domain incidents involving application, infrastructure, network, and third-party dependencies.
* Own the end-to-end observability architecture and strategy in Datadog, including instrumentation standards, tagging strategy, dashboard governance, and monitor design principles.
* Lead root cause analysis for major/critical incidents and drive post-incident reviews, ensuring permanent fixes and preventive monitoring are implemented.
* Define and continuously improve monitoring coverage for new and existing services, including 3-tier applications, microservices, and cloud-native workloads.
* Design and govern SLOs/SLIs aligned to business-critical services, and advise application and platform teams on instrumentation best practices.
* Drive automation initiatives: Datadog-as-code (Terraform/API-based configuration management), auto-remediation workflows, and integration with CI/CD pipelines.
* Partner with application, infrastructure, network, and security teams to close monitoring gaps and reduce mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to resolve (MTTR).
* Own capacity planning and performance engineering insights derived from long-term observability data trends.
* Manage Datadog platform health: cost optimization, license/usage governance, data retention, and integration management.
* Mentor L1 and L2 engineers, review their RCA quality, and build enablement material (runbooks, training, best practices).
* Act as a key stakeholder in client governance calls, presenting trends, risks, and improvement roadmaps.
* Evaluate and pilot new Datadog features or complementary observability tools, and lead their rollout.
* Define escalation matrices and coordinate cross-team response during major outages.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 6+ years of experience in Managed Services, SRE, or platform engineering roles, with at least 3 years of hands-on ownership of a Datadog (or equivalent) observability platform at scale.
* Expert-level knowledge of Datadog, including:
* Platform architecture: organization/team structuring, RBAC, tagging strategy, and multi-environment setups.
* APM: distributed tracing at scale, service dependency mapping, and instrumentation strategy across polyglot environments.
* Synthetics and RUM: designing comprehensive digital experience monitoring strategies tied to business KPIs.
* Log Management: pipeline architecture, log-based metrics, and cost/volume governance.
* SLOs, error budgets, and anomaly/forecast-based alerting at an advanced level.
* Deep understanding of infrastructure and cloud architecture: compute, containers, orchestration (Kubernetes), auto-scaling, and multi-cloud/hybrid environments.
* Deep understanding of networking: routing, load balancing, CDN, DNS, and complex connectivity troubleshooting across hybrid environments.
* Strong incident and problem management leadership experience, including major incident command and post-incident review facilitation.
* Experience defining and governing observability standards across multiple teams or business units.

**Application & Architecture Understanding (technology-agnostic)**

* Expert-level understanding of 3-tier and N-tier application architectures, including how failures cascade across presentation, application, and data layers.
* Expert-level understanding of cloud-native and distributed architectures: microservices, event-driven systems, service meshes, API gateways, and asynchronous messaging.
* Ability to advise application teams on observability best practices (instrumentation, tracing context propagation, structured logging) without needing to write code in a specific language.
* Strong grasp of resiliency and failure patterns (retries, circuit breakers, backpressure, caching, graceful degradation) and how to detect their failure modes through observability data.

**Good to Have**

* Datadog advanced/expert certifications, or equivalent recognized observability certifications.
* Strong scripting/automation background (Python, Terraform, or similar) for Datadog-as-code and custom tooling.
* Experience with FinOps or cost governance for observability tooling at scale.
* Exposure to multiple observability ecosystems (New Relic, Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana/Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).
* Experience presenting to senior stakeholders or clients on observability maturity and roadmaps.

**Soft Skills**

* Strategic thinking with the ability to balance immediate incident needs against long-term platform health.
* Strong leadership and mentoring capability across L1/L2 engineers.
* Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Calm, decisive leadership during major incidents.
* Strong documentation and process-governance discipline.

**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

**Work Details**

* **Level:** L3 (Senior/Lead, Managed Services)
* **Shift:** Primarily general shift, with on-call responsibility for major incident escalations
* **Reporting To:** Observability Practice Lead / Delivery Manager

title: Manager Software Engineer
description:

Technology, Digital and Data

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

* Foster a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Drive Agile practices and ensure timely delivery of high-quality solutions.

**Technical Strategy & Architecture**

* Implement data quality frameworks, lineage tracking, and schema evolution strategies.

**Big Data & Data Warehousing**

* Build and maintain large-scale data lakes and data warehouses for structured and unstructured data.
* Design scalable data architectures to support manufacturing analytics, predictive maintenance, and supply chain optimization.

**Cloud & Platform Engineering**

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Partner with product managers, manufacturing SMEs, and business leaders to understand requirements and deliver impactful data solutions.
* Communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences and influence strategic decisions.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Proven experience in Big Data processing and Data Warehousing.
* Expertise in building end-to-end near real-time data pipelines for OLTP & OLAP.
* Strong architecture exposure for building robust, scalable Data Platforms.
* Deep expertise in Snowflake, SQL, NoSQL, and distributed data systems.
* Strong analytical skills and solid knowledge of computer science fundamentals.
* Deep exposure to AWS and Azure cloud platforms.
* Good understanding of AI concepts and latest developments (Gen AI, MCP, ATA, etc.).

**Nice-to-Have Skills**

* Knowledge of the NVIDIA ecosystem and its applications in data and AI.
* Experience building production-ready AI solutions and integrating with MLOps workflows.
* Familiarity with modern data visualization and BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker).

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 15+ years of experience in data engineering, with at least 5+ years in a leadership role.
* Demonstrated success in managing engineering teams and delivering complex data solutions.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

October 13, 2026 - October 22, 2026

title: Enterprise Account Manager
description:
**Overview**
**About Certara**
Certara accelerates the potential of bringing medicines to market and to patients using biosimulation software, technology, and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development. Our clients include more than 2,400 biopharmaceutical companies, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies across 70 countries.
  
  
Our goal is to enable the life sciences industry’s use of data, modeling, and analytics to make better decisions across the various phases of discovery and drug development. Our software and scientists incorporate modern advances in scientific understanding, drug development experience, data analysis, and AI resulting in significant opportunities to decrease the cost and increase the probability of success for new drug approval and commercialization.
  
  
As an Enterprise Account Manager you will be working with world class expert drug development consultants in client engagements and be supported during the Business Development process by required expert teams. As a precursor to consultant engagement with the client, our candidates will be responsible for identifying and pursuing strategic business with clients after qualifying them with a needs assessment including, understanding their business model and corporate objectives, understanding their development program focus, objectives and priorities, understanding their critical decisions and challenges and financial position. It is after this qualification process that the appropriate Certara consulting resources are identified for engagement and are introduced to the client as the Certara resource team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Identify and pursue strategic business with new clients
* Identify and pursue business growth opportunities within assigned clients
* Conduct proper discovery to understand and qualify client needs, including understanding of business model and corporate objectives, development program focus, and priorities
* Negotiate contract terms by understanding critical decision timelines, challenges, and financial position
* Lead and facilitate client meetings with consulting resources, ensure internal stakeholders are properly briefed on client meeting plan and management

title: Vice President, Operating Model, Product & Client Solutions
description: About Citco JOB DESCRIPTION Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services with staff across 50 office locations worldwide. With more than $1.8 trillion in assets under administration, we deliver end-to-end solutions and exceptional service to meet our clients’ needs.For more information about Citco, please visit www.citco.comAbout The Team & Business LineFund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.Strategic Operations is a dedicated function within Private Assets. It brings transformation delivery, project execution, business analysis, operational initiatives and implementation support into one team, reducing the delivery burden on BAU Operations and maintaining ownership from design through adoption.The group will be split across three distinct focus areas, aligned under two individual leaders:Operating Model, Product & Client Solutions: led by the Operating Model & Product leader, this area will define how services should run end to end, shape scalable products and solutions, support complex client implementations, and ensure client commitments are operationally deliverable.Data, Reporting & Platform Enablement: led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will define Operations requirements for data, reporting and platforms, strengthen data quality and lineage, and carry solutions through testing, deployment and adoption.Digital Workflow, Automation & AI: also led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will identify and deliver workflow, automation and AI opportunities, establish appropriate controls, and measure whether the expected benefits are realised.The group works in close partnership with Operations, the Transformation Office, IT, Tactical Operations and Marquee Client teams. Roles may be permanent or approximately 12-month rotational assignments anchored in strategic locations. Rotational colleagues will join from the business, help shape and deliver change, and return to the line with broader project experience.ResponsibilitiesYour RoleYou will deliver operating model and product change from the problem, through testing, to deployment and adoption. Document current state end to end, identify root causes, and design the target state process. Build the case for change — quantifying effort, risk and benefit in terms the business recognises. Write and agree business requirements with IT, the Transformation Office and the relevant focus areas, and support them through build and delivery. Design, plan and execute testing, including UAT, and manage defect resolution through to sign-off. Contribute operational input to client pitches, POCs and presentations, and translate client requirements into an operational design that can be built and run. Support implementation of fund structures, new client setups, complex client transitions and onboarding on our accounting platforms, alongside Client Integration. Work directly with Operations teams to make sure change is understood, trained out and genuinely adopted. Assess where a redesign or client solution delivered once can be applied more widely, and document the case. Produce project documentation, status reporting and ad hoc analysis as required. QualificationsAbout YouYou have 8+ years’ experience in private assets accounting or operations, at a fund administrator, fund manager or comparable environment. Hands-on experience of process improvement, system implementation or project delivery. Strong technical knowledge of private assets processes — general ledger, capital activity, fee and waterfall calculations, financial statements and investor reporting. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interrogate data and evidence a recommendation. Confident in front of a client, and comfortable explaining operational constraints clearly. Project management skills with attention to detail and a proven ability to multi-task. Confident engaging both operational teams and technology partners. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Advanced computer skills (Microsoft Excel); familiarity with reporting, workflow or automation tooling an advantage. Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance or Economics; professional accounting designation is preferred. What We Expect Of The Strategic Operations TeamRegardless of role or focus area, everyone in Strategic Operations is expected to demonstrate the following: Deep technical and operational knowledge — genuine depth in how our processes, data and platforms actually work — the detail that only comes from having run the work. Curiosity — the instinct to ask why a process looks the way it does, to challenge the answer, and to keep asking whether there is a better way. A transformational mindset — comfortable redesigning end to end rather than patching, and prepared to see change through past go-live to the point where it is genuinely adopted. Ownership through to adoption — accountability does not end at delivery; success is measured by whether the change sticks in the business. Commercial and client awareness — an understanding of what we can genuinely run, so that what we commit to a client is deliverable. Global mindset — working across regions, jurisdictions and time zones, and designing solutions that scale beyond a single desk, client or location. Ambition to shape Citco’s future — an appetite to help build the operating model we will run for years, and to be measured on whether it works. Our BenefitsYour well-being is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect.Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.
