title: Technical Account Engineer
description:
We are seeking a customer-focused Technical Account Engineer to serve as the bridge between our enterprise customers, products, and internal engineering teams. In this role, you will provide technical expertise, proactive onboarding, and high-touch support across the customer lifecycle. You will troubleshoot complex cloud environments, advocate for customer needs, write documentation, and automate routine operational tasks.

  

Because this role involves direct customer interaction across channels (tickets, chat, phone, video) and daily alignment with US engineering teams, strong written and spoken English communication skills are essential.

  

Location: Remote, India

  
  
Key Responsibilities
  

  
* Customer Support & Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve technical inquiries, infrastructure failures, and performance bottlenecks across client cloud systems via tickets, chats, calls, and video sessions.
  
* Onboarding & Pre-Sales Assistance: Assist with new customer onboarding, initial platform provisioning, customization requests, pre-sales technical configurations, and end-user enablement.
  
* Automation & Scripting: Write and maintain Bash and Ansible scripts to automate operational processes and deploy software updates.
  
* Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Create clear internal and external technical documentation, runbooks, and process guides using Markdown, Git, GitHub/Wiki, or Google Docs.
  
* Monitoring & Outage Ownership: Monitor customer-facing platforms, configure alerting tools, and maintain end-to-end ownership during outages or critical incidents until fully resolved.
  
* Product Advocacy: Partner closely with internal Engineering teams to surface customer feedback, bug reports, and feature requests to continuously improve product performance.
  

  
  
Required Qualifications & Skills
  

  
* Experience: 3+ years of experience in customer-facing technical support, system administration, networking, or cloud operations.
  
* Communication: Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills with experience creating customer-facing technical documentation.
  
* Linux Systems Administration: Advanced Linux administration skills, including experience managing clustered Linux environments and executing live root-level updates.
  
* Cloud & Containers: Hands-on experience or working knowledge of cloud platforms (OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes, Docker, or virtualization).
  
* Scripting & Automation: Intermediate experience with Ansible and Python scripting, alongside shell tools (Bash).
  
* Networking & Tools: Understanding of core networking concepts and tools (DNS, Load Balancers, VPNs, iptables, HAProxy, OpenVSwitch) and version control via Git.
  
* Hardware Management: Experience accessing and managing remote servers via IPMI/BMC interfaces.
  

  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  

  
* Experience using Terraform or Heat for infrastructure configuration management.
  
* Direct experience supporting public or private cloud hosting components (VMs, Databases, Network Storage).

title: Integration Support Analyst
description:
**The Vacancy**

We're looking for an Integration Support Analyst to join our IT team and become the first point of contact for customer integration support queries. This role is responsible for managing and resolving integration-related issues across our warehouse and logistics platforms, ensuring customers receive clear, accurate, and timely updates.

Working closely with internal engineering teams and customers, you'll investigate failed integrations, identify root causes, perform system checks, and provide practical next steps. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with application support, service desk, or integration support experience who enjoys problem-solving, analysing data, and delivering excellent customer service.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage and prioritise the integrations support queue throughout UK business hours.
* Investigate failed messages, warehouse transactions, and integration errors to identify root causes.
* Review API responses, file transfers, and system error logs to determine appropriate actions.
* Verify whether shipment orders, advance shipping notices, item records, and other documents have been successfully processed within warehouse systems.
* Communicate findings clearly to customers, providing concise explanations and recommended next steps.
* Maintain accurate ticket records, documenting investigations, checks performed, actions taken, and closure reasons.
* Escalate recurring incidents, defects, and integration issues to the engineering team with supporting evidence.
* Liaise with internal stakeholders to follow up on outstanding actions, corrected files, and missing data.
* Ensure support tickets are resolved efficiently while maintaining a high standard of customer service.
* Identify trends and recurring issues that could improve overall integration stability and operational performance.

**What We're Looking For**

**Essential:**

* At least 2 years' experience in Application Support, Service Desk, Technical Support, or Integration Support roles.
* Ability to interpret system, API, and file processing errors and determine appropriate troubleshooting steps.
* Experience working with JSON files, spreadsheets, and ticket management systems.
* Strong written communication skills with the ability to produce clear, professional, customer-focused responses.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and thrive in a live support environment.
* Comfortable supporting stakeholders and customers during UK business hours from Chennai.

**Desirable:**

* Experience within logistics, warehousing, supply chain, EDI, or transport environments.
* Familiarity with ITSM platforms such as Halo.
* Experience using Postman or similar tools to perform API investigations and checks.
* Basic SQL knowledge for data validation and record checking.
* Understanding of system integrations, data mapping, and file-based data exchanges.

**What You'll Bring:**

* A proactive and customer-focused approach.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* The ability to remain organised while managing a busy support queue.
* A collaborative mindset and willingness to share knowledge with colleagues.
* Professionalism, reliability, and a commitment to delivering excellent service.

If you're passionate about technology, enjoy solving complex problems, and want to play a key role in supporting business-critical integrations, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and become part of a team that keeps our systems and customers connected.

title: Systems Development Engineer II, FO Support
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon.com is seeking a Systems Development Engineer to join a Fulfillment Optimization team that helps promise, plan, and execute the delivery of millions of packages to customers worldwide — faster and cheaper each day — while providing an extraordinary customer experience from the website to doorstep delivery. Our systems handle millions of requests per second and make business recommendations that impact billions of dollars each year. With rapid expansion into new geographies, increasing complexity of the transportation network, and an expanding selection of products, the Fulfillment Optimization team builds solutions that scale and propel the business with best-in-class technology innovations.  
  
We are looking for passionate, hard-working, and talented engineers who have experience supporting innovative, mission-critical, high-volume applications — and who are excited to apply AI and agentic automation to how large-scale systems are supported and operated. You will have an enormous opportunity to work across multiple systems: researching and identifying common issues, building AI-powered tooling that diagnoses and prevents them, and driving teams toward resolution to have a positive impact on the customer experience. Your solutions will impact our customers directly. This role requires you to hit the ground running; your ability to learn quickly and work on disparate and overlapping tasks will define your success.  
  
The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, has superior verbal and written communication skills and strong organizational skills, can juggle multiple tasks at once, works independently, and maintains professionalism under pressure. You must be able to identify problems before they happen and implement solutions that detect and prevent outages. Your ability to accurately prioritize work, make sound technical trade-offs, improve the customer experience, and get the right things done will have a direct impact on Amazon's Supply Chain Optimization and fulfillment-network efficiency.  
  
As a SysDE II on this team, you will work autonomously on difficult, team- and component-level problems, build resilient and well-tested solutions, and increasingly act as a force multiplier — enabling other builders through the tools, automation, and AI capabilities you deliver.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Dive deeply into technical details to diagnose, reproduce, and root-cause issues across Amazon technology products (services, tools, data solutions, etc.), and drive them to resolution or escalation.
* Design, build, and operate AI-powered and agentic support capabilities — diagnostic agents, automated root-cause analysis, anomaly detection, and self-healing/auto-remediation — that detect and prevent issues before they impact customers.
* Apply AI across the software development lifecycle (spec-driven and AI-assisted development, agentic workflows) to raise engineering velocity and quality.
* Automate repetitive operational tasks to increase efficiency and reduce manual toil, and build tooling that enables other engineers.
* Manage trouble tickets through to resolution or escalation using existing documentation, procedures, and tools, and improve those mechanisms over time.
* Use technology to monitor security vulnerabilities and eliminate risk; identify and mitigate reliability risks at the team and component level.
* Improve service resilience, performance, and operational metrics; define and apply operational-excellence practices for the team.
* Participate in a team on-call rotation, providing operational support for the services the team owns.
* Collaborate with partner teams, Technical Program Managers, and Product Managers to deliver on shared goals.
* Work in an Agile environment using the Scrum methodology.

  
About the team  
The Fulfillment Optimization (FO) Support team plays a crucial role in Amazon's supply chain operations. We invent and deliver software solutions that facilitate Customer Promise Speed, Order Planning, and Fulfillment.  
  
The FO Support team leverages data, process improvement, and innovative technologies — including AI and agentic automation — to provide comprehensive engineering-excellence services and solutions across FO's product portfolios. The team is responsible for FO services as front-line support and plays a central role in the organization's success.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
* Knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals (networking, storage, operating systems)
* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience building services using AWS products
* Experience with distributed systems at scale
* Experience with Linux/Unix
* Experience leveraging AI (Artificial Intelligence) agents for security review automation, spec-driven development practices, or adversarial red teaming
* Experience building or integrating AI/GenAI-powered solutions (e.g., LLM-based tools, agentic frameworks, automated diagnostics or remediation)
* Ability to work independently and solve problems using knowledge of an object-oriented programming language

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**Senior Support Engineer**
Insurity’s next Senior Support Engineer will be a hands-on, customer-focused technical support professional who owns and coordinates the investigation and resolution of medium- to high-complexity production issues across assigned Insurity products.
  
  
This role combines advanced ticket ownership and escalation judgment with product configuration, component and integration knowledge, technical troubleshooting, and functional and technical root-cause analysis. The ideal candidate communicates clearly, documents work accurately, mentors other support engineers and performs effective handoffs to help customers and internal teams reach timely resolutions.
  
  
This role is expected to work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours and support customer-facing production issues across applicable time zones when required
  
  
**What Our Senior Support Engineer**
**Will Do**

* Lead triage of incoming tickets, determine priority and ownership, identify billable work, and act as an escalation point for higher-priority or complex support issues.
* Own medium- to high-complexity customer issues and requests through investigation, coordination, communication, resolution, and documented closure.
* Use SQL or similar query tools, application and platform logs, troubleshooting tools, debugging utilities, and other diagnostic methods to investigate reported issues and validate findings.
* Use Kubernetes and GitOps workflows to monitor deployments, review operational behavior, and support investigation of production issues.

* Perform functional and technical root-cause analysis for complex incidents and present findings, impact, contributing factors, and recommended actions clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Perform technical troubleshooting across connected systems and identify whether an issue is caused by a defect, configuration gap, integration behavior, data condition, or support process.
* Execute or coordinate approved data-maintenance scripts, quality audits, and other support-related technical work with the appropriate teams.
* Escalate issues through established procedures, provide complete technical context, and maintain follow-up through resolution or transition to the appropriate owner.
* Maintain accurate ticket information, workflow systems, customer-facing tools, case records, resolution notes, impact assessments, and knowledge-based content with limited oversight.
* Support customer-facing production issues through clear written and verbal communication, coordination across multiple time zones, and effective handoffs that protect business continuity.
* Support new customer go-lives by following established readiness processes, completing assigned tasks, and coordinating risks or dependencies with the appropriate teams.
* Communicate with Product Management, Software Engineering, Professional Services, other internal teams, and third-party software suppliers or partners as needed.
* Provide self-service tool support and ad hoc training for customers, internal users, new employees, and other support team members.
* Mentor Support Engineers and provide practical guidance on troubleshooting, ticket ownership, documentation, escalation judgment, and customer communication.
* Support continuous-improvement initiatives that reduce low-value support demand, improve service quality, strengthen knowledge transfer, and increase customer self-service.
* Contribute to and improve knowledge-base articles, troubleshooting guides, standard procedures, and other documentation used for training and operational consistency.
* Use AI tools, where appropriate and consistent with company requirements, to support troubleshooting, research, analysis, and documentation.
* Stay current on industry and job-related trends, support best practices, Insurity product changes, and new products offered.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Who We’re Looking For**

* 4 to 7 years of experience in a support, development, or consulting environment, including at least 3 years supporting or developing assigned products.
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent work experience.
* Experience owning complex customer issues, leading escalations, performing functional and technical root-cause analysis, and coordinating work across technical teams.
* Experience mentoring or providing technical guidance to less-experienced support engineers.
* Advanced analytical and critical-thinking skills, creative problem solving, and strong technical judgment.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to explain technical findings accurately, manage expectations, document work, and perform effective handoffs.
* Strong time-management, planning, prioritization, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and competing customer needs.
* Ability to collaborate effectively while also working independently and taking ownership of assigned work.
* Flexible and adaptable approach to customer and team support needs.
* Strong business and technical acumen, including software development acumen and programming logic.
* Advanced technical troubleshooting skills across applications, infrastructure, data, and integrations.
* Ability to configure the product and understand component and integration interactions.
* Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office or similar productivity tools, SQL or similar query tools, XML/JSON or similar data formats, databases, version-control systems, case-management or CRM systems, debug utilities, application logs, and troubleshooting tools.
* Working knowledge of Salesforce and Jira, Kubernetes, GitOps workflows, web-based troubleshooting tools, and PHP-based defect investigation is preferred.
* Working knowledge of insurance workflows, supported business scenarios, customer variations, and Insurity products is preferred.
* Within the first three months, complete required Insurity Academy courses and product-specific training covering company learning requirements, insurance and domain concepts, product functions, workflow and process training, transaction workflows, and technical processing.
* Ability to travel approximately 0–10% as needed.

Thank you for your interest in Insurity! Please understand that due to the volume of applicants we receive, only selected candidates will be contacted.

description:
Company : Dayal Fertilizers Private Limited
  
  
Job Title : Senior System & Network Administrator (IT Hardware & Network)
  
  
Qualification : Graduation in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
  
  
Experience : 7–10 years
  
  
Location : Partapur, Delhi Road, Meerut, Uttar Pradesh
  
  
Working Hours : 10:00 AM–6:00 PM
  
  
Certification : Cisco CCNA
  
  
Reporting To : General Manager – Platform Engineering
  
  
**Job Purpose**
We are seeking a highly experienced and capable Senior System & Network Administrator with at least 7 years of hands-on experience in managing enterprise IT infrastructure, network security, server administration, and IT facility management.
  
  
The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring the availability, security, performance, and reliability of the organization's IT infrastructure while minimizing operational downtime.
  
  
As a key member of the IT Infrastructure & Facility Management function, the candidate will oversee enterprise networks, Windows and Linux servers, security systems, virtualization, backup and disaster recovery, IT procurement, asset management, and end-user support. The role will also involve managing vendor relationships, software licenses, Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), and infrastructure performance reporting.
  
  
Experience in a manufacturing environment will be an added advantage, particularly in supporting plant operations, business-critical systems, and uninterrupted IT services.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, configure, maintain, and optimize enterprise networks, including Cisco routers, switches, VLANs, and network segmentation.
* Manage firewalls, Unified Threat Management (UTM) security features, NAT/PAT configurations, and secure VPN connectivity for site-to-site and remote access.
* Administer endpoint security solutions, including Sequrite Endpoint Protection, and maintain awareness of EDR, XDR, and MDR security technologies.
* Manage Windows Server and Linux systems, Active Directory, Group Policy Objects (GPOs), DNS, DHCP, proxy servers, and virtualization infrastructure.
* Plan and execute server upgrades, firmware and BIOS updates, operating system patching, and end-of-life hardware replacements.
* Maintain reliable backup and recovery processes, periodically verify backup integrity, and support infrastructure continuity and disaster recovery planning.
* Manage Microsoft 365/Office 365 or Google Workspace environments, including user accounts, access controls, and identity management.
* Monitor network and server performance using enterprise monitoring tools such as Zabbix or Nagios, proactively identifying and resolving infrastructure issues.
* Analyze system logs, network traffic, and security events to identify faults, investigate incidents, and implement corrective actions.
* Support the installation, configuration, and maintenance of Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL) and MySQL databases, including basic queries, database maintenance, and user access management.
* Manage IT assets, endpoint compliance, hardware and software inventories, device security policies, and asset lifecycle tracking.
* Oversee IT facility infrastructure, including IP-based CCTV surveillance, biometric attendance systems, and associated physical security technologies.
* Plan IT budgets, evaluate hardware and software requirements, assess vendors, negotiate commercial terms, and manage procurement activities.
* Oversee annual renewals of AMCs, software licenses, application subscriptions, and infrastructure support contracts.
* Manage IT helpdesk operations and ticketing workflows, ensuring timely resolution of user issues in accordance with defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Maintain up-to-date network diagrams, infrastructure documentation, technical inventories, troubleshooting guides, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Prepare and present monthly MIS reports covering network performance, server downtime, helpdesk tickets, user complaints, security incidents, and hardware ageing.
* Coordinate with internal teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure reliable IT services and continuous infrastructure improvement.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of enterprise networking, including TCP/IP, LAN, WAN, VLANs, routing, switching, and network troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience with Cisco routers and switches, firewall administration, UTM, NAT/PAT, and VPN configurations.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and Linux administration.
* Experience with virtualization technologies, server hardware, storage, system patching, and infrastructure lifecycle management.
* Knowledge of endpoint protection solutions, security policies, vulnerability management, and infrastructure hardening.
* Experience in implementing and monitoring backup, recovery, and disaster recovery processes.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365/Office 365 or Google Workspace administration and identity management.
* Working knowledge of network and infrastructure monitoring tools such as Zabbix or Nagios.
* Basic administration of MSSQL and MySQL databases, including queries, maintenance, and access controls.
* Experience in IT asset management, hardware and software procurement, vendor coordination, AMC management, and license renewals.
* Knowledge of helpdesk ticketing systems, SLA management, IT documentation, and MIS reporting.
* Familiarity with IP-based CCTV, biometric access control or attendance systems, and related IT facility infrastructure.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
* A high degree of ownership and accountability for infrastructure availability and service continuity.
* Ability to prioritize incidents and resolve issues under time-sensitive conditions.
* Good communication and coordination skills when working with users, vendors, and management.
* Strong planning, documentation, reporting, and IT asset management capabilities.
* Ability to independently manage multiple infrastructure activities and lead technical service delivery.
* A cost-conscious approach to procurement, vendor management, and infrastructure optimization.

**Must-Have Requirements**

* Experience in IT infrastructure management within a manufacturing or plant-based environment.
* Exposure to production-critical applications, ERP systems, and business operations.
* Experience with remote deployment and automation of firmware, BIOS, and operating system updates.
* Experience in IT budget planning, commercial negotiations, vendor evaluation, and annual contract management.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with high-availability infrastructure, production clustering, and server modernization.
* Familiarity with EDR, XDR, MDR, and advanced threat detection and response practices.
* Knowledge of IT Service Management (ITSM) practices, incident management, change management, and SLA governance.
* Exposure to infrastructure security audits, business continuity planning, and disaster recovery drills.

**Proximity to Delhi-NCR**

title: MQ Admin
description:
Job description:

Job Role – MQ Administrator

Position Title-MQ Administrator / Middleware Administrator

Location-As per project/business requirements

Salary: 50,000 to 70,000 Per Month

Experience-2-5

Employment Type-Full-Time

About the Company

We are a leading aviation IT solutions provider specializing in mission-critical airport systems integration, enterprise middleware, operational technology platforms, and digital transformation solutions for airports and aviation stakeholders. Our projects involve complex, high-availability environments requiring secure, scalable, and resilient system integrations across multiple airport operational systems.

We are seeking a highly skilled MQ Administrator to manage, optimize, and support enterprise messaging and middleware infrastructure in demanding, 24x7 operational environments.

Role Overview

The MQ Administrator will be responsible for the installation, configuration, administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, security, and performance optimization of enterprise messaging systems, primarily IBM MQ and related middleware technologies. The role requires strong expertise in high-availability messaging architecture, integration support, incident management, and coordination with application, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and operations teams.

The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical skills, operational discipline, proactive problem-solving capabilities, and the ability to work effectively in high-pressure, mission-critical aviation environments.

Key Responsibilities

Middleware & MQ Administration

* Install, configure, upgrade, patch, and maintain IBM MQ environments across development, testing, staging, and production systems.
* Create and manage Queue Managers, Queues, Channels, Listeners, Clusters, Topics, and security configurations.
* Configure and support distributed MQ environments across Linux, Windows, and cloud platforms.
* Manage MQ clustering, multi-instance queue managers, failover configurations, and high-availability setups.
* Perform routine health checks and preventive maintenance activities.
* Monitor queue depth, channel status, message flow, and overall middleware performance.
* Troubleshoot messaging failures, connectivity issues, latency problems, and application integration incidents.
* Support SSL/TLS configurations, certificate management, and secure messaging practices.
* Implement backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures for middleware environments.
* Maintain middleware standards, naming conventions, and operational procedures.



System Integration Support

* Coordinate with application teams, system integrators, OEM vendors, and infrastructure teams during deployments and integrations.
* Support airport operational systems integrations involving mission-critical applications.
* Assist in interface troubleshooting between enterprise systems, operational databases, APIs, and third-party applications.
* Analyze message flow logs and transaction traces for issue resolution.
* Support SIT, UAT, production rollout, and cutover activities.



Monitoring & Incident Management

* Provide L2/L3 support for production middleware incidents.
* Participate in 24x7 operational support and on-call rotations when required.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement corrective/preventive actions.
* Ensure compliance with SLA, availability, and operational KPIs.
* Maintain incident records, operational logs, and technical documentation.



Security & Compliance

* Ensure middleware infrastructure complies with organizational cybersecurity policies.
* Implement authentication, authorization, encryption, and audit logging mechanisms.
* Support vulnerability remediation, security audits, and compliance activities.
* Coordinate with cybersecurity teams for hardening and risk mitigation.



Automation & Optimization

* Develop and maintain automation scripts for monitoring, deployment, backup, and maintenance activities.
* Identify opportunities for performance tuning and operational improvements.
* Support infrastructure modernization and cloud migration initiatives where applicable.



Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* 2+ years of hands-on experience in IBM MQ Administration.
* Strong experience in enterprise middleware administration in production environments.
* Experience working on Linux and Windows server environments.
* Good understanding of TCP/IP, networking, firewall concepts, and secure communication protocols.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Experience with high-availability and disaster recovery configurations.
* Knowledge of shell scripting or automation scripting.
* Familiarity with ITIL-based incident and change management processes.



Preferred Skills

* Experience in aviation, airport systems, transportation, or mission-critical environments.
* Knowledge of IBM ACE/IIB, Kafka, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ, or other messaging platforms.
* Experience with containerized or cloud-based middleware deployments.
* Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, AppDynamics, Splunk, or similar.
* Understanding of APIs, REST/SOAP integrations, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience supporting large-scale system integration projects.
* Exposure to DevOps and CI/CD practices.

Desired Behavioral Competencies

* Strong ownership and accountability mindset.
* Ability to perform effectively under pressure in 24x7 operational environments.
* Excellent communication and coordination skills.
* High attention to detail and operational discipline.
* Proactive problem-solving approach.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional and multicultural teams.
* Strong documentation and reporting capabilities.
* Adaptability to evolving technologies and project requirements.

Working Conditions

* May require shift support and participation in on-call rotations.
* May involve support during production cutovers, migrations, and critical operational activities.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on large-scale international aviation and airport technology projects.
* Exposure to mission-critical enterprise systems and integrations.
* Collaborative and technology-driven work environment.
* Career growth opportunities in enterprise integration and middleware technologies.
* Competitive compensation and professional development opportunities.

Application Process

Interested candidates may share their updated resume along with relevant project experience, certifications, and current notice period details.

description:

As we scale our team across sales, delivery and operations, we're looking for people who want to build a specialist practice rather than join a generalist IT shop.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are building out our managed-support desk so that off-hours and weekend coverage for enterprise clients runs on a proper rota rather than informal goodwill. This role handles day-to-day monitoring, ticket resolution and tenant hygiene across our clients' SASE/SSE and endpoint security estates.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Monitoring & Ticket Handling**

•   Monitor client Netskope, Menlo Security and endpoint security tenants.

•   Triage, investigate and resolve L1/L2 support tickets within SLA.

**Off-Hours Coverage**

•   Participate in a rostered on-call rotation covering evenings, weekends and time zones outside standard IST business hours for clients who require it contractually.

**Tenant Hygiene & Escalation**

•   Perform routine health checks, policy reviews and configuration hygiene tasks across managed tenants; flag drift or misconfiguration to Professional Services.

•   Escalate complex issues to Professional Services Engineers or the Tech Lead with clear, well-documented findings.

•   Maintain accurate ticket and runbook documentation, and communicate status clearly to client technical contacts.

**REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

•   2–4 years in a SOC, NOC or security support role, ideally with cloud or SASE/SSE platform exposure.

•   Comfortable with shift and on-call work.

•   Clear written English for client-facing ticket updates.

•   Basic familiarity with networking fundamentals (DNS, proxy, VPN/tunnels) and at least one security platform.

**PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS**

•   Netskope or CrowdStrike associate-level certification — funded by Xploreteq after joining.

•   CompTIA Security+ or equivalent is a plus.

**COMPETENCIES & SOFT SKILLS**

•   Methodical and calm under ticket pressure.

•   Takes ownership of a problem through to resolution rather than just triage.

•   Reliable with rostered hours.

**WHAT WE VALUE**

At Xploreteq, we value people who take responsibility, communicate openly, solve problems practically, and contribute beyond the boundaries of a job description. For this role, we're particularly looking for someone dependable enough that off-hours coverage becomes a rota, not a favour.

Reports to the Tech Lead; works closely with Professional Services Engineers and the Customer Success Manager.

description:
**ABOUT XPLORETEQ**

Xploreteq is a Pune-based technology and cybersecurity company working with organisations across cybersecurity, AI governance, data protection and DPDP readiness — through advisory, implementation and managed services. We are ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified, serve 50+ enterprise customers across financial services, healthcare, technology, manufacturing and services, and partner with leading platforms including Netskope, CrowdStrike, Menlo Security, Proofpoint, Okta, Varonis and Forcepoint. As we scale our team across sales, delivery and operations, we're looking for people who want to build a specialist practice rather than join a generalist IT shop.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are seeking a client-facing Professional Services Engineer to lead the technical implementation, architecture and integration of edge security solutions for our enterprise clients. Working from a System Integrator perspective, you will assess client environments, design the deployment architecture, and execute migrations onto modern Zero-Trust platforms — bridging legacy infrastructure (on-prem proxies, MPLS) and cloud-native SASE/SSE.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Assessment & Design**

•   Lead technical discovery workshops to map legacy architecture, application portfolios and traffic flows.

•   Author High-Level and Low-Level Design documentation covering traffic steering, proxy chaining, SSL decryption policy and fallback mechanisms.

•   Help clients plan prerequisites — allowlists, firewall exceptions, certificate authority provisioning, IdP sync.

**SASE/SSE Implementation**

•   Build, configure and validate tenants covering Secure Web Gateway, CASB and ZTNA.

•   Implement DLP policies aligned to client regulatory requirements (PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, DPDP) with custom detection rules.

•   Configure traffic steering and client deployment via MDM/GPO, including bypass and smart-steering rules.

•   Deploy Remote Browser Isolation and content-sanitisation (CDR) controls where in scope.

**Integration & Go-Live**

•   Integrate platforms with client Identity Providers (Azure AD/Entra ID, Okta) for provisioning and group-based policy.

•   Configure log/event forwarding into the client's SIEM (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, etc.).

•   Design and execute UAT test matrices; provide post-go-live hypercare support; run technical training and handover sessions for the client's internal operations team.

**REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

•   3–6 years as a Cyber Security Engineer, Consultant or Professional Services engineer, ideally within a System Integrator or MSP.

•   Hands-on deployment experience with at least one SASE/SSE platform (Netskope preferred) or isolation platform (Menlo Security); familiarity with a second (Zscaler, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Forcepoint) is a strong plus.

•   Working knowledge of proxy configuration (PAC files, explicit vs. transparent), GRE/IPsec tunnelling, TLS/SSL inspection and routing fundamentals.

•   Experience deploying endpoint agents at scale via Intune, SCCM, JAMF or GPO.

**PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS**

•   Netskope Cloud Security Integrator (NCSI) or Cloud Security Administrator (NCSA).

•   Palo Alto PCNSE, CISSP or CCSP are a plus.

**COMPETENCIES & SOFT SKILLS**

•   Comfortable walking into varied, unpredictable client environments and deploying a modern security stack on top of messy legacy networks.

•   Strong documentation discipline for HLD/LLDs and runbooks.

•   Able to run more than one client engagement at different lifecycle stages at once.

**WHAT WE VALUE**

At Xploreteq, we value people who take responsibility, communicate openly, solve problems practically, and contribute beyond the boundaries of a job description. For this role, we're particularly looking for someone who can be dropped into a messy client environment and bring order to it.

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Computer Science, or a related discipline.

**Experience**

* 5+ years of relevant experience in SAP TRM / Treasury Management Systems / payment operations / implementation support.
* Experience supporting at least two end-to-end SAP TRM, treasury system, payment hub, or treasury transformation implementations is preferred.
* Experience coordinating with cross-functional teams and supporting small workstreams or junior team members is preferred.

**Preferred Skills**

* Knowledge of multiple TMS platforms and treasury modules.
* Exposure to SQL scripting, automation tools, and reporting scripts.
* Familiarity with Citrix environments and job scheduling tools.
* Understanding of electronic bank account management (eBAM) processes.
* Exposure to API-based integrations and secure file transfer protocols such as SFTP.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

* Foreign Exchange (FX): trade capture, settlement, and valuation support.
* Interest Rate Swaps: configuration and lifecycle support.
* Forwards and Futures: hedging and exposure management support.
* Money Market Funds: investment workflow and reporting support.
* Derivatives and Options: pricing, risk analysis, and compliance support.

* Enterprise Workflow (EWF): approval and operational workflow support.
* Crystal Reports / reporting tools: operational reporting and analytics support.

* Strong stakeholder management and written / verbal communication skills.

description:

**Global Managed Service – Privileged Identity and access Management – Senior**
The Senior CyberArk Operations Support Analyst is a key member of the CyberArk Privileged Access Management (PAM) team, responsible for the advanced support and management of the CyberArk infrastructure. This role requires a deep understanding of PAM principles, CyberArk architecture, and cybersecurity best practices. The Senior Analyst will lead initiatives to enhance security, streamline processes, and ensure the stability and integrity of privileged account management systems
  
  
**Key Requirements / Responsibilities:**

* Lead the administration and advanced support of the CyberArk PAM solution, including complex troubleshooting, policy management, and platform optimization.
* Design and implement enhancements to the CyberArk infrastructure to improve security, efficiency, and compliance with industry standards.

* Conduct regular system audits to identify potential vulnerabilities and recommend remediation strategies.
* Mentor junior analysts and provide guidance on best practices and technical challenges.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for system configurations, procedures, and service records.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to support enterprise-wide cybersecurity initiatives and projects.
* Manage the response to critical incidents involving privileged accounts, including root cause analysis and preventive measures.
* Stay abreast of emerging threats and technologies in the PAM space and evaluate their impact on the organization.
* Lead the planning and execution of system upgrades, patches, and maintenance activities, minimizing disruption to business operations.
* Support compliance and regulatory activities by providing expertise and documentation as needed.
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive disaster recovery and business continuity plan for the CyberArk infrastructure, ensuring minimal downtime and quick restoration of services in the event of an outage.
* Collaborate with the cybersecurity architecture team to design and implement a robust privileged access management strategy that aligns with the organization's overall security posture.
* Lead security incident investigations related to privileged accounts, including forensic analysis, and collaborate with the incident response team to develop a coordinated response plan.
* Proactively monitor the CyberArk environment for unusual activities and potential threats using advanced security tools and techniques.
* Serve as the subject matter expert for CyberArk within the organization, providing insights and recommendations to senior management on PAM-related matters.
* Participate in vendor management, including evaluating potential software solutions, negotiating contracts, and managing relationships with CyberArk and other security vendors.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by regularly reviewing and updating CyberArk policies and procedures to reflect the evolving threat landscape and business needs.
* Facilitate cross-training and knowledge sharing sessions within the team to ensure redundancy in critical skill sets and promote a culture of continuous learning.
* Engage with the broader cybersecurity community to stay informed about new vulnerabilities, attack vectors, and defense mechanisms related to privileged access management.

* Assist in budget planning and management for the CyberArk operations team, including forecasting future needs for resources, tools, and training.

* Advanced knowledge of CyberArk PAM solutions, with relevant certifications such as CyberArk Certified Delivery Engineer (CDE), Defender, or Sentry.
* Proven experience in managing complex CyberArk environments, including components such as EPV, CPM, PSM, and AIM.
* Strong understanding of network security, identity and access management (IAM), and related technologies (e.g., SIEM, firewalls, multi-factor authentication).
* Expertise in scripting and automation to streamline operations and incident response.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Leadership qualities and experience in mentoring or managing junior staff.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey technical information to non-technical stakeholders

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

* Willingness to work in shifts as required

The Senior CyberArk Operations Support Analyst is a key member of the CyberArk Privileged Access Management (PAM) team, responsible for the advanced support and management of the CyberArk infrastructure. This role requires a deep understanding of PAM principles, CyberArk architecture, and cybersecurity best practices. The Senior Analyst will lead initiatives to enhance security, streamline processes, and ensure the stability and integrity of privileged account management systems

* Mentor junior analysts and provide guidance on best practices and technical challenges.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for system configurations, procedures, and service records.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to support enterprise-wide cybersecurity initiatives and projects.

* Proactively monitor the CyberArk environment for unusual activities and potential threats using advanced security tools and techniques.

description:
**Urgent Hiring || Production Manager – Extrusion Tools, Tool Room & Tungsten || Bangalore**

Profile:- Production Manager – Extrusion Tools, Tool Room & Tungsten

Experience: 5 to 10 yrs

Ctc: upto 8lpa – 12lpa ,(Depend on the interview)

Location:- Chikkaballapur, Bangalore

Working Days:- 6 Days

Key Roles & Responsibilities

1. Production Planning & Control

* Plan and monitor daily, weekly and monthly production activities.
* Prepare production schedules based on customer requirements and delivery commitments.
* Ensure optimum utilization of manpower, machines, tools and raw materials.
* Monitor production targets, output and productivity.

2. Extrusion Tool Production

* Manage complete production activities related to extrusion tools, dies and associated components.
* Ensure tools are manufactured according to approved drawings, specifications and tolerances.
* Coordinate with Design/Engineering and Quality departments for drawing and specification clarification.
* Monitor critical dimensions and ensure first-time-right production.

3. Tool Room Management

* Manage day-to-day activities of the Tool Room, including machining, grinding, EDM/wire EDM, drilling, polishing and finishing operations.
* Allocate jobs to operators/machinists based on skill and machine availability.
* Monitor machine loading and minimize machine idle time.
* Ensure proper maintenance and upkeep of tool-room machines.

4. Tungsten / Tungsten Carbide Operations

* Manage production processes involving tungsten/tungsten carbide materials and components.
* Monitor machining, grinding, sizing, finishing and inspection processes.
* Ensure proper handling and storage of tungsten materials and finished components.
* Control material wastage and improve material recovery wherever possible.

5. Quality Control

* Ensure products are manufactured within specified dimensional and quality requirements.
* Coordinate with Quality/Inspection teams for in-process and final inspection.
* Analyze rejection, rework and customer complaints and implement corrective actions.
* Maintain process consistency and reduce rejection rates.

6. Manpower Management

* Lead and supervise Tool Room operators, technicians, setters and other production personnel.
* Prepare manpower allocation and shift plans.
* Identify skill gaps and arrange on-the-job training.
* Monitor discipline, attendance, productivity and performance of team members.

7. Productivity & Cost Control

* Improve production efficiency and reduce cycle time.
* Identify bottlenecks and implement process improvements.
* Control tool, material and consumable usage.
* Reduce scrap, rejection, rework and unnecessary machine downtime.

8. Machine & Process Coordination

* Coordinate with Maintenance for machine breakdowns and preventive maintenance.
* Ensure machines are available as per production requirements.
* Monitor tooling, fixtures, gauges and other production equipment.
* Suggest new machines, technology or process improvements where required.

9. Production Documentation

* Maintain production reports, job cards, rejection/rework records and productivity reports.
* Track production against planned quantities.
* Ensure proper traceability of jobs and materials.
* Submit daily/weekly/monthly production reports to management.

10. Safety & 5S

* Ensure compliance with factory safety procedures and PPE requirements.
* Maintain proper 5S and housekeeping in the Tool Room and production areas.
* Ensure safe handling of tungsten, carbide materials, grinding equipment and machinery.
* Conduct regular safety and housekeeping inspections.

11. Coordination with Other Departments

* Coordinate with Planning, Purchase, Stores, Quality, Maintenance, Design/Engineering and HR.
* Ensure timely availability of raw materials and production drawings.
* Coordinate urgent and priority jobs to meet customer delivery

Preferred Qualification & Experience

Diploma / BE / B.Tech – Mechanical / Production / Tool & Die Making

8–15 years of relevant experience, preferably in tool room, extrusion dies, tungsten carbide, precision machining or diamond-tool manufacturing.

FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
  
  
Our Company
  
  
FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. Our Philosophy
  
  
The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company.
  
  
Our Culture
  
  
Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

title: Lead Medical Device & Packing Operations
description:
**Position: Lead Medical Device & Packing Operations**

**Experience**

• 12–18 years of manufacturing operations experience within Medical Devices, Pharmaceuticals, Biologics, or regulated healthcare manufacturing.

• Significant experience leading assembly and packaging operations.

• Proven experience managing high-performing manufacturing teams in a cGMP-regulated environment.

• Demonstrated success in regulatory inspections and quality systems.

• Strong background in Lean Manufacturing, Operational Excellence, and Continuous Improvement.

**Education**

• Bachelor's degree in engineering.

• Master's degree preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Manufacturing Operations Leadership**

• Lead end-to-end assembly and packaging operations for medical devices, ensuring safe, compliant, and efficient manufacturing.

• Own daily manufacturing performance with complete accountability for delivery commitments, quality, productivity, and cost.

• Drive production planning and execution to ensure optimum utilization of manpower, equipment, materials, and manufacturing capacity.

• Ensure quarterly business deliverables and operational KPIs are consistently achieved.

**Delivery Excellence & Operational Ownership**

• Take complete ownership for manufacturing schedules and customer delivery commitments.

• Establish and monitor operational KPIs including:

o On-Time Delivery

o Schedule Adherence

o Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE)

o Productivity

o First Pass Yield

o Right First Time

o Packaging Efficiency

o Training Compliance

o Quality Metrics

• Proactively identify operational risks and implement mitigation plans to ensure uninterrupted supply.

**Quality, Compliance & GMP Leadership**

• Champion a strong quality culture through strict adherence to cGMP, GDP, SOPs, and regulatory requirements.

• Ensure all manufacturing documentation is accurate, complete, and inspection-ready.

• Maintain continuous audit preparedness for internal, customer, and global regulatory inspections.

• Ensure compliance with applicable medical device quality standards and regulatory expectations.

• Promote "Quality First" and "Right First Time" manufacturing practices across the organization.

**Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement**

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on:

o Defect reduction

o Cycle time improvement

o Cost optimization

o Productivity enhancement

o Waste elimination

o Process standardization

• Conduct process capability analysis for development and commercial products.

• Recommend and implement improvements in manufacturing processes, equipment, layouts, and workflows.

• Lead verification and validation activities for process changes where applicable.

**Cross Functional Collaboration**

• Work closely with:

o Engineering & Maintenance

o Quality Assurance

o Quality Control

o Supply Chain

o Warehouse

o Validation

o Regulatory Affairs

o Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT)

• Ensure timely closure of cross-functional actions impacting manufacturing performance.

• Support product transfers, process improvements, equipment qualification, and new product introductions.

title: POD Lead
description:
**Purpose:**
Own the day-to-day delivery, quality and people management of one POD, so the POD consistently meets its service, quality and customer-satisfaction targets.

**Common responsibilities**

- Lead a POD of team leaders and agents; own daily planning, huddles, floor management and shift handovers.

- Drive POD KPIs: CSAT, FCR, AHT, SLA/TAT adherence, quality scores and attrition.

- Coach agents and team leaders through call/chat/ticket audits, one-on-ones and performance improvement plans.

- Work with the RTA team on staffing, shrinkage and intraday adjustments.

- Work with Training & Quality on onboarding, refreshers and calibration sessions.

- Identify top contact drivers and repeat issues, and escalate product, logistics or process gaps to the relevant teams with data.

- Publish daily and weekly performance reports and review them with the AM/AD.

**POD-specific focus**

**Delight & Sales**
- Own conversion on pre-sales and post-sales sales-assist interactions; drive upsell and cross-sell, product-advisory quality and customer delight initiatives (welcome calls, post-delivery check-ins); track sales-assisted revenue, conversion and NPS/CSAT.

**Proactive Escalations**
-Run proactive outreach on at-risk orders (delivery delays, damages, installation issues) before customers escalate; maintain escalation trackers and closure TATs; handle social, legal and consumer-forum-sensitive cases with cross-functional teams; drive RCA on repeat escalations.

**Ticketing**
- Own ticket queue health across channels (email, marketplaces); drive first-response and resolution TAT; manage ticket tagging accuracy, backlog and reopen rate; partner with vendors and tools teams on routing and automation.

Skills: People leadership, data-driven decision making, Excel/BI reporting, familiarity with CRM and ticketing tools (Freshdesk, Zendesk or similar), strong communication.

title: Centre Manager - Nightingales Centre for Ageing and Alzheimer's
description:
**Centre Manager – Nightingales Centre for Ageing & Alzheimer’s**

Make a difference in the lives of elders living with dementia.

Location:
**Kasturinagar, Bengaluru**

Organisation:
**Nightingales Medical Trust**

Nightingales Medical Trust (NMT), a leading non-profit organisation dedicated to elder care and dementia services, invites applications from a passionate, experienced and committed professional to lead Nightingales Centre for Ageing & Alzheimer’s (NCAA).

Established in 2010, NCAA is a 95-bed residential dementia care facility providing person-centred care to elders across all stages of dementia. Our multidisciplinary team strives to ensure that every resident receives care with dignity, empathy, respect and professional excellence.

We are looking for a dynamic leader who has a genuine passion for elder care and proven experience in managing residential care homes, preferably those catering to elders living with dementia.

**The Role**

The Centre Manager will be responsible for the overall clinical coordination, administration and operational management of the centre, ensuring high standards of resident care, effective team performance and a safe, supportive and dignified living environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

·      
**Clinical Care & Quality:**
Oversee care delivery, individualised care plans, resident assessments and the implementation of person-centred dementia care practices.

·      
**Centre Operations:**
Manage the day-to-day functioning of the facility, ensure efficient utilisation of resources and maintain appropriate occupancy levels.

·      
**Team Leadership:**
Lead, supervise and motivate caregivers, clinical personnel and support staff, fostering a culture of accountability, teamwork and compassion.

·      
**Resident Engagement:**
Ensure meaningful daily activities, psychosocial support and a stimulating, dementia-friendly environment for residents.

·      
**Medical Coordination:**
Coordinate with doctors, psychologists and other healthcare professionals to ensure continuity and quality of care.

·      
**Family Engagement:**
Build trusting relationships with residents’ families, address their concerns and provide guidance on dementia care.

·      
**Administration & Compliance:**
Ensure accurate documentation, adherence to applicable regulations, effective systems and smooth administrative functioning.

·      
**Continuous Improvement:**
Monitor service quality, address operational challenges and introduce improvements that enhance resident wellbeing and organisational effectiveness.

**Who Should Apply?**

We are looking for a professional who brings both competence and compassion to the role.

·      A postgraduate qualification in clinical psychology or a related field.

·      At least five years of relevant professional experience.

·      Experience in managing residential care homes, preferably dementia care facilities, will be a strong advantage.

·      Sound understanding of dementia, ageing, behavioural and psychological needs, and person-centred care. Proven leadership, staff management, communication and problem-solving skills.

·      Ability to balance clinical priorities with administrative, operational and team-management responsibilities.

·      A strong commitment to the dignity, rights, safety and wellbeing of older persons.

**Why Join Nightingales Medical Trust?**

·      Be part of a well-established and reputed organisation with a longstanding commitment to elder care and dementia services.

·      Lead a multidisciplinary team delivering meaningful, person-centred care.

·      Make a tangible difference to the lives of elders and provide much-needed support to their families.

·      Contribute to strengthening professional standards and best practices in dementia care.

**Compensation**

₹55,000 onwards per month, commensurate with qualifications and experience.

**How to Apply**

If you have the experience, leadership skills, and passion to make a meaningful difference in dementia care, please apply.

Please email your updated CV, along with your current and expected salary, to:

**recruitment@nightingaleseldercare.com**

**Subject line: Application for Centre Manager – NCAA**

For enquiries: +91 92437 37217

Nightingales Medical Trust

8P6, 3rd A Cross, Kasturinagar, Banaswadi, Bengaluru – 560043

Partner with Technology and Product teams on platform enhancements, control automation, and basket process modernization

  

ETF Settlements Oversight

  

Lead oversight settlement breaks, fails, and risk exposure, driving root‑cause analysis and sustainable remediation.

  

Ensure settlement readiness for new launches, liquidations, index transitions, and corporate action events.

  
  

Risk, Controls & Governance

  

Own the operational risk framework for Basket Operations and Settlements, ensuring adherence to documented procedures, controls, and escalation standards.

  

Ensure strong audit, regulatory, including issue remediation and management action plans

  

People & Team Leadership

  

Lead and develop managers and senior staff across Basket Operations and Settlements, fostering a strong culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

  

Set clear performance expectations, support talent development, and build succession plans.

  

Promote cross‑training and resiliency across global locations to support business continuity.

  

Qualifications & Experience

  

A post graduate or graduate degree in Accounting, from a reputed institution with an overall experience of 15-16 yrs in the Settlements, Custody and Investment banking domain.

  

8+ years of experience in ETF Operations, Basket Operations, Settlements, or related asset servicing functions.

  

Deep understanding of ETF primary market mechanics, including baskets, PCFs, NSCC processes, and settlement flows.

  

Proven experience leading large operational teams and managing risk in a high‑volume, time‑sensitive environment.

  

Strong knowledge of corporate actions, income processing, cash‑in‑lieu, and supplemental processing impacts on ETFs.

  

Demonstrated ability to partner with Technology, Trading, Fund Accounting, and Transfer Agency teams.

  

Experience supporting audits, regulatory reviews, and management governance forums.

Background
  
  
The Chennai Regulatory Compliance team supports compliance activities for Corpay Cross-Border across regions. This role will provide day-to-day support to the Toronto and North America teams by maintaining Legal Entity Identifier registrations for customers located in North America. The position is focused on monitoring assigned cases, completing required LEI actions, following up for supporting documentation and ensuring records are accurate, complete and current.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
The Regulatory Compliance Analyst will work from Chennai and align to Toronto business hours. The analyst will monitor the LEI case queue, action new registration, renewal, transfer and update requests, and maintain clear evidence of work performed. The role requires regular communication with business stakeholders to clarify requirements, obtain documentation and escalate matters that require guidance from the Compliance Director or the North America regulatory compliance team.
  
  
Role Responsibilities
  
  

* Monitor the assigned LEI case queue daily and prioritize cases in line with agreed service levels, procedures and business urgency.
* Action LEI registration, renewal, transfer and record update cases for customers located in North America.
* Review customer records, system information and supporting documents to confirm required LEI details, including legal name, registered address, entity status and other registration data.
* Identify missing, outdated or unclear information and follow up with the business or relevant internal teams to obtain the documentation needed to progress the case.
* Communicate clearly with North America stakeholders on case status, information requirements, blockers and expected next steps.
* Maintain accurate trackers, working files and evidence of actions taken so that case history and audit trail requirements are met.
* Escalate exceptions, data discrepancies, overdue items or matters requiring interpretation to the Compliance Director or regional compliance team.
* Prepare routine reporting and metrics on queue volumes, ageing, completed actions, pending documentation and escalated matters.
* Support process improvements, procedure updates and additional regulatory support activities assigned to the Chennai team.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Law, Commerce, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics or a related discipline.
* 2 to 5 years of experience in regulatory compliance, operations, case management, AML compliance, internal audit, risk management or financial services.
* Experience in banking, fintech, payments, foreign exchange or other financial services roles would be helpful; prior exposure to LEI processes is preferred.
* Comfortable working North America shift hours from Chennai.
* Able to follow documented procedures, manage a queue of time-sensitive cases and ask for clarification where evidence or requirements are not clear.

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Strong attention to detail and ability to review legal entity information and documentation carefully.
* Practical understanding of compliance reviews, control checks, customer record maintenance or similar review-based processes.
* Basic understanding of Legal Entity Identifiers, including the purpose of an LEI and the general process for creating, renewing, updating and transferring LEIs.
* Good written and verbal communication skills, especially for stakeholder follow-ups, documentation requests and exception summaries.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including filters, lookups, reconciliations and basic reporting.

title: Store Assistant Manager cum Kitchen Operations – Hospital Canteen
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Store Assistant Manager cum Kitchen Operations – Hospital Canteen

Department: Canteen / Food & Beverage Services | Applicable to: Hospital Canteen Operations

1. Job Details

Job Title

Store Assistant Manager cum Kitchen Operations

Department

Administration / Canteen Services

Reports To

Administration Manager / Facility Manager

Supervises

Kitchen staff, cooks, helpers, store assistants, and canteen service personnel, as assigned

Qualification

Diploma or degree in Hotel Management, Catering Technology, Food Production, Hospitality Management, or a relevant field

Experience

3–5 years of experience in kitchen operations, stores, catering, or institutional food services; hospital canteen experience preferred

Employment Type

Full-time2. Job Purpose

To manage the hospital canteen's day-to-day store activities and kitchen operations efficiently, ensuring uninterrupted availability of raw materials, proper inventory control, hygienic food preparation, quality service, cost control, and compliance with applicable food safety requirements.

The role combines store management, kitchen supervision, food safety, staff coordination, and operational reporting to provide safe, nutritious, hygienic, and timely food services to hospital employees, consultants, visitors, and other authorized customers.

3. Key Roles and ResponsibilitiesA. Store Management and Inventory Control

* Maintain accurate stock records for groceries, vegetables, fruits, dairy products, meat, cooking oil, spices, beverages, cleaning materials, and other canteen supplies.
* Monitor daily stock consumption, minimum stock levels, reorder levels, and expiry dates to prevent shortages and wastage.
* Prepare purchase requisitions based on consumption patterns, menu requirements, and approved budgets.
* Receive incoming materials and verify quantity, quality, weight, specifications, expiry dates, and delivery documents against purchase orders.
* Ensure proper storage, labelling, segregation, and stock rotation using FIFO (First In, First Out) and FEFO (First Expiry, First Out), as applicable.
* Maintain separate and appropriate storage arrangements for dry goods, refrigerated products, frozen items, chemicals, and cleaning materials.
* Conduct daily checks of critical or perishable stock and periodic physical stock verification.
* Investigate stock discrepancies, shortages, damages, pilferage, and unusual consumption, and report them to the reporting manager.
* Coordinate with approved vendors and the purchase department for timely deliveries, quality issues, returns, and replacements.
* Maintain records of goods received, goods issued, stock transfers, wastage, returns, and closing balances.

B. Kitchen Operations Management

* Supervise daily kitchen activities, including preparation, cooking, portioning, plating, packing, and distribution of food.
* Coordinate with cooks and kitchen staff to ensure meals are prepared according to the approved menu and required service timings.
* Estimate daily food requirements based on expected demand from hospital employees, consultants, patients' attendants, and visitors.
* Ensure timely preparation of breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks, beverages, and special meal requirements, wherever applicable.
* Monitor food quality, taste, freshness, portion size, presentation, and consistency.
* Ensure appropriate segregation of raw and cooked food and prevent cross-contamination.
* Monitor food preparation practices, holding temperatures, refrigeration, reheating, and serving conditions in accordance with applicable food safety procedures.
* Ensure that kitchen equipment, cooking ranges, refrigerators, freezers, exhaust systems, utensils, and work surfaces are maintained in safe and hygienic condition.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance and report equipment breakdowns promptly.
* Monitor daily food wastage and implement corrective measures to improve yield, portion control, and cost efficiency.

C. Food Safety, Hygiene and Regulatory Compliance

* Ensure compliance with applicable Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) requirements, licence conditions, and hospital food safety policies.
* Enforce personal hygiene requirements, including clean uniforms, head coverings, hand hygiene, and appropriate protective equipment.
* Ensure routine cleaning and sanitization of kitchen areas, food-contact surfaces, storage areas, utensils, and equipment.
* Monitor pest-control measures, waste segregation, garbage disposal, and drainage cleanliness.
* Ensure safe potable water availability and appropriate food handling practices.
* Check the condition of incoming raw materials and reject or report spoiled, contaminated, damaged, or unsuitable supplies.
* Maintain food safety records, including temperature logs, cleaning checklists, stock inspection records, and other applicable monitoring documents.
* Support food safety inspections, internal audits, corrective actions, and regulatory inspections.
* Ensure staff understand procedures for reporting suspected food contamination, foodborne illness concerns, and kitchen accidents.
* Coordinate with the hospital's infection control, housekeeping, engineering, and administration teams on relevant hygiene and safety matters.

D. Staff Supervision and Coordination

* Allocate duties and responsibilities to kitchen, store, and service staff.
* Prepare or coordinate duty rosters in line with canteen operating hours and workload requirements.
* Monitor attendance, punctuality, grooming, discipline, productivity, and adherence to work instructions.
* Train employees on safe food handling, stock management, cleaning procedures, waste reduction, and equipment use.
* Identify staffing shortages and arrange replacements or escalation through the appropriate reporting channel.
* Coordinate with the HR department regarding staff attendance, training, competency, and performance-related matters.
* Promote teamwork, professional conduct, and responsive service to hospital staff and visitors.

E. Purchase Coordination and Cost Control

* Monitor daily and monthly expenditure on food materials, consumables, and kitchen supplies.
* Compare consumption against meal volumes, approved budgets, and standard recipes where available.
* Coordinate with the purchase and accounts departments regarding purchase orders, supplier invoices, delivery discrepancies, and payments.
* Monitor food cost per meal and identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary expenditure without compromising quality.
* Prevent over-purchasing, overproduction, avoidable spoilage, and unauthorized stock issues.
* Maintain records of vendor performance, material quality, price variations, and supply delays.
* Submit purchase requirements and stock reports within the prescribed timelines.
* Ensure that all purchases and stock issues follow the hospital's approved authorization procedures.

F. Hospital Canteen Service and Customer Satisfaction

* Ensure timely and uninterrupted canteen services during designated operating hours.
* Maintain cleanliness, orderly food display, and hygienic serving practices.
* Respond to complaints concerning food quality, portion size, availability, service delays, or cleanliness.
* Record complaints and coordinate corrective action with the appropriate staff or manager.
* Obtain feedback from hospital employees and other authorized users to improve service quality.
* Coordinate special catering requirements for hospital meetings, training programmes, events, and official gatherings.
* Ensure that special dietary requests are handled only in accordance with approved instructions and the hospital's applicable dietary procedures.

G. Documentation and Reporting

Maintain and submit the following records, as applicable:

* Daily opening and closing stock reports.
* Goods receipt and material issue registers.
* Purchase requisitions and vendor delivery records.
* Expiry, damage, wastage, and stock discrepancy reports.
* Daily meal production and consumption reports.
* Kitchen cleaning and sanitation checklists.
* Food storage and temperature monitoring logs.
* Staff attendance and duty rosters.
* Equipment maintenance and breakdown records.
* Food safety inspection and corrective action reports.
* Monthly inventory, food cost, and canteen performance reports.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The following indicators may be used for monthly performance evaluation. Targets should be finalized by management based on the canteen's size, meal volume, baseline performance, and approved policies.

KPI

Suggested performance measure

Stock accuracy

Physical stock compared with recorded stock

Stock availability

Frequency of avoidable stock-outs

Expiry and spoilage control

Value or quantity of expired and spoiled materials

Food wastage

Wastage as a percentage of food prepared or issued

Food cost control

Actual food cost versus approved budget

Timely meal service

Percentage of meals served within scheduled timings

Food safety compliance

Audit score and closure of corrective actions

Kitchen hygiene

Compliance with cleaning and sanitation checklists

Documentation

Completeness and timely submission of records

Customer satisfaction

Feedback ratings and complaint resolution

Staff management

Duty coverage, training completion, and adherence to procedures

Equipment maintenance

Completion of scheduled checks and timely reporting of breakdowns

5. Authority and Accountability

The position is authorized to:

* Monitor stock levels and initiate purchase requisitions within approved procedures.
* Allocate daily duties to assigned kitchen and store personnel.
* Inspect incoming materials and report or initiate rejection of non-conforming supplies in accordance with procurement policy.
* Recommend corrective actions for food quality, hygiene, stock discrepancies, and operational inefficiencies.

description:

The IT Service Manager – Network Operations is responsible for the effective delivery, reliability, and continual improvement of global network operations across all locations. This includes managing day-to-day operations, ensuring timely resolution of incidents and service requests, monitoring service health, and implementing enhancements to maintain security, compliance, and seamless connectivity experience.

Working closely with the accountable Service Owner, the IT Service Manager ensures network operations align with organizational goals and provides a consistent, secure, and high-performing infrastructure for all employees worldwide.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Oversee operational management of global network services (WAN, LAN/WLAN, SD-WAN, VPN, DNS/DHCP/IPAM, firewalls, load balancing).

* Manage Incident, Problem, Change, and Request processes for network operations.
* Monitor performance and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Coordinate across internal teams and external partners to resolve service issues promptly.

Stakeholders: Service Owners, Service Managers, Process Managers, Provider Managers, Regional Delivery Leads, and external partners.

* Oversee real-time monitoring tools for proactive detection of latency, jitter, and packet loss.
* Perform capacity planning for network infrastructure to support global scalability.
* Ensure integration with security platforms and compliance frameworks.

2. Vendor & Stakeholder Management
