title: Collateral Management - Manager
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
We are looking for a candidate with deep experience in Collateral Management to reduce credit risk by exchanging cash/securities with counterparties. Should have knowledge in the end to end functions including Onboarding activities ideally.
  
  
**Why This Role Is Important To Us**
Collateral management main focus is to reduce credit risk by exchanging eligible cash or securities between counterparties. The daily calculations are based on MTM of the underlying trades and results in sending Margin Calls, which in turn lead to agreeing transfers. Based on the agreements between our clients and the counterparties the Collateral team in India ensures that all the exposures are fully collateralized and the agreed collateral transactions settle as agreed. The critical onboarding process is particularly important.
  
  
**What you will be responsible for: As Officer you will:**

* End to End Margin call processing - Process daily margin calls daily for all agreed clients, who will include banks and fund clients and both cash and security margin calls.
* Reconcile collateral balances, investigate and solve discrepancies; be the main point of contact/ escalations
* Fails investigation - Checking the cash non-receipt reports and the custody settlement system (MCH) and initiating correspondence with the client
* Reporting - Generate a variety of reports, which includes client and internal reporting from an access database and Protocol.
* Portfolio reconciliations - Completing any daily or ad hoc manual portfolio reconciliations.
* Interest Processing - Month end interest statement generation, settling interest, updating interest agreements, and updating and validating interest rates.
* Ensure that the team meets accuracy and timeliness criteria.

* Execute on the risk framework changes and/or escalation chain changes. Ensure all Key controls are identified, implemented and adhered to
* Perform related duties as assigned (Projects - India and Global)
* Provide back and coverage as required across EMEA/NA shift

* Communicates effectively and accurately in English - experience in facing clients

* Ability to work on own initiative and proactive

title: Data Center Inventory & Asset Technician Manager
description:
**Overview**
As a Microsoft Data Center Inventory & Asset Technician Manager (DIAM), you will lead a team of Inventory & Asset Management technicians across "multiple Data Centers" responsible for inbound/outbound logistics tasks, inventory cycle audits, and Data Center regulatory compliance activities. You will guide your employees to effectively run warranty processes and data bearing device (DBD) destruction. This opportunity will allow you to model leadership principles, drive focus on accurately and efficiently completing Inventory and Asset Management (IAM) tasks, and work with stakeholders to manage escalations.
  
  
Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DIAM, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.
  
  
Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
  
  
With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* Graduate with 5+ year(s) experience warehouse/supply chain in an information technology (IT) environment, inventory management, retail, warehouse management, logistics, or a related field.

+ OR equivalent experience.

**Background Check Requirements**
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
  
  

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

While not required, we also look for the following
*Preferred Qualifications:*

* 5+ year(s) experience in warehouse/supply chain in an information technology (IT) environment, IT, and/or logistics, operating heavy-load movement equipment (e.g., forklift, pallet jacks, chassis lifts) for a large corporation

+ OR equivalent experience.

* 1+ year(s) project management experience.
* Certification in American Production and Inventory Control Society (APICS)/Association for Supply Chain Management (ASCM), International Association of Information Technology Asset Managers (IAITAM), Inventory Control, OR equivalent.

**Qualifications**
Responsibilities
  
  
Customer Service
  
  

* Ensures that all issues are documented, tracked, discussed, and resolved with internal and external stakeholders as well as suppliers with consistent and complete communication. Acts as a resource across Data Center teams (e.g., Site Services, Critical Environment, Facility Management, Security, Vendors, Safety, Supply Chain), and supports Microsoft and non-Microsoft gear deliveries. Drives focus on accurately and efficiently completing Inventory and Asset Management (IAM) tasks through a team up to headcount cap. Engages with internal and external stakeholders, maintaining relationships with vendors and providing oversight, to manage issues.

Data Bearing Device (DBD) Destruction
  
  

* Ensures all data bearing devices (DBDs) are destroyed within the allotted time, and all data bearing devices leaving premises do not contain customer information. Handles any escalations. Coordinates with and oversees any third-party vendors who perform DBD destruction as necessary, managing external vendor relationships. Maintains responsibility for any security investigations, partnering with security and senior leadership. Oversees data bearing devices (DBD) reconciliation and review of current documentation. Oversees decommissioning servers, ensuring proper documentation of actions taken against a decommissioning workflow and process standards are met.

Inbound and Outbound Logistics
  
  

* Leads a team of technicians responsible for preparing and executing incoming/outgoing deliveries and documenting inbound/outbound packages (e.g. purchase order [PO] receiving, Rack Movement Supervisor [RMS] activities) based on site-class designation. Responsible for overall day-to-day operations and ensures inbound and outbound measuring processes are running smoothly and effectively and inventory parts are properly stored. Ensures items logged within Intelligence Communication Manager (ICM) are resolved and deals with the escalated issues. Creates more efficient receiving routes, driving the movement of manual communication and information sharing to automated processes, managing the change.

IT Inventory Management
  
  

* Leads a team of technicians responsible for providing support guidance to third-party personnel, including material movement (e.g., inventory management/tracking, inventory staging), inventory cycle audits, and Data Center regulatory compliance or certification control audit activity. Enables strategies for space optimization, driving identification of opportunities to improve inventory to address space constraints, driving new build design and availability of inventory or storage rooms. Ensures escalations are resolved, and clears blocking issues to enable continued delivery of Inventory and Asset Management (IAM) activities.

Operational Excellence
  
  

* Serves as subject matter expert and models compliance to less experienced team members. Creates clarity and drives consistency in processes and services to align with defined policies and procedures in order to meet expectations for accuracy and timeliness of delivery. Drives improvement of delivered results against Service Level Agreements (SLAs), increasing efficiency of processes leading to Objective Key Results (OKRs). Collaborates with internal stakeholders to influence workstreams towards a more simplified and/or automated approach by evolving processes, services, and solutions to increase efficiency and manage costs. Drives environmental sustainability and zero waste initiatives. Ensures completion of required security and data management training and complies with security and data management procedures/policies. Oversees training for relevant site-specific procedures and tools (e.g., forklift, pallet jacks, technician on-hand processes, inventory maintenance software, RMA portals, Rack Movement).

People Management
  
  

* Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring. Model: Live our culture. Embody our values. Practice our leadership principles. Coach: Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn. Care: Attract and retain great people. Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.

Safety Practices
  
  

* Runs daily safety topic huddles and conducts inspections of equipment (e.g., vehicles, pallet jacks, dock levelers). Manages and coordinates any escalated task risks and reported issues, establishing safety standard operating procedures for new equipment (e.g., server rack tugs, electric pallet jacks, forklifts). Trains employees on safe and effective equipment and inventory moving. Ensures team and 3rd party vendors are in compliance with Microsoft Corporation safety standards Procures, audits, and reviews personal protective equipment (PPE), leading by example of all safety standards. Presents Identity and Access Management (IAM) metrics to senior leaders. Supervises rack movement, observing to ensure compliance with safety protocols and training others on devices and tools used in rack movement. Oversees handling and storage of hazardous materials and chemicals, developing plans to address unsafe materials out of containment and ensuring preparedness of others, and acting as a point of escalation.

Tactical Shift Management
  
  

* Supports the planning, management, and communication of end-to-end project plans with applicable stakeholders and teams. Assesses resource and workflow patterns to determine any needed changes in work assignments regarding long-term headcounts and project resources to ensure timelines are met and work is completed accurately and efficiently. Resolves escalated issues during high-volume work activity or escalation-based situations, participating in high severity meetings.

Warranty Process Management
  
  

* Drives the direction to make sure the expectations are met handling high-level escalations. Empowers less experienced employees to effectively process Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) and non-RMA warranties. Oversees manual return processes for non-RMA failed parts. Oversees and plans for large-scale replacement projects for upgrading or refreshing equipment. Works with internal stakeholders as needed related to finances around incorrectly handled RMA and non-RMA warranties.

title: Store Head
company: Krishna Jewellers Pearls and Gems Private Limited
description:
Job Summary

Krishna Jewellers Pearls & Gems Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced and business-oriented
**Store Manager**
to take complete ownership of the day-to-day operations and overall business performance of our jewellery showroom at Kokapet.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing the store end to end, including
**Profit & Loss (P&L), sales performance, operational efficiency, inventory management, financial controls, staff productivity, customer experience, and compliance**
. The candidate must be capable of analyzing business performance, controlling costs, improving profitability, and ensuring smooth showroom operations while maintaining high standards of service and security.

Key Responsibilities

1. End-to-End Store Operations

* Take complete ownership of the showroom's daily operations and overall functioning.
* Ensure smooth coordination across sales, billing, inventory, customer service, and support functions.
* Establish and monitor operational processes, SOPs, and company policies.
* Ensure proper opening and closing procedures, staff deployment, housekeeping, and showroom readiness.
* Identify operational gaps and implement improvements to enhance efficiency and productivity.

2. Profit & Loss (P&L) and Financial Management

* Take ownership of the store's overall P&L, revenue, profitability, and operating expenses.
* Monitor sales, gross margins, discounts, operating costs, and other key financial performance indicators.
* Prepare and review daily, weekly, and monthly business performance reports.
* Develop action plans to achieve revenue, profitability, and cost-control targets.
* Monitor controllable expenses and ensure optimal utilization of store resources.
* Ensure accurate cash management, billing, payment reconciliation, and financial documentation.
* Analyze business variances and present performance updates and improvement plans to management.

3. Sales Performance and Business Growth

* Drive overall store revenue and profitability through effective business planning and execution.
* Set sales targets and monitor individual and team performance against business goals.
* Identify opportunities to improve conversion rates, average transaction value, repeat business, and customer footfall.
* Implement upselling and cross-selling strategies to improve sales and margins.
* Analyze product category performance and customer buying patterns to support business decisions.
* Develop local business opportunities and execute promotional activities in coordination with management and marketing teams.

4. Inventory and Stock Management

* Oversee end-to-end inventory management, including stock availability, movement, transfers, and reconciliation.
* Ensure accurate stock records and conduct regular physical stock audits.
* Monitor stock discrepancies, ageing inventory, slow-moving items, and stock loss.
* Coordinate with merchandising, purchase, and inventory teams to maintain appropriate stock levels.
* Ensure strict controls over jewellery handling, custody, security, and documentation.
* Investigate stock variances and implement corrective measures to minimize losses.

5. Team Management and Productivity

* Lead and manage the complete showroom team, including sales staff, billing personnel, and support staff.
* Plan manpower requirements, duty rosters, attendance, and task allocation.
* Set performance expectations and monitor individual productivity.
* Train and coach employees on operational procedures, product knowledge, customer handling, and compliance.
* Conduct performance reviews and implement improvement plans where required.
* Maintain discipline, accountability, teamwork, and a performance-driven work culture.

6. Compliance, Controls, and Risk Management

* Ensure adherence to company policies, internal controls, and applicable statutory requirements.
* Maintain accurate operational, financial, inventory, and employee records.
* Ensure compliance with billing, cash handling, stock movement, and authorization procedures.
* Coordinate internal audits and implement corrective actions for audit observations.
* Enforce showroom security, loss-prevention measures, and risk-control procedures.
* Ensure proper documentation and timely closure of operational issues.

7. Customer Experience and Relationship Management

* Ensure a consistent, high-quality customer experience throughout the showroom.
* Handle customer escalations, complaints, and service recovery.
* Build relationships with high-value and repeat customers.
* Monitor customer feedback and implement measures to improve satisfaction and retention.
* Ensure the showroom maintains premium presentation, cleanliness, and visual merchandising standards.

8. Reporting and Coordination with Management

* Strong understanding of retail store operations, financial management, and business performance.

* Strong communication, coordination, and team management skills.
* High integrity, accountability, and attention to detail.

Education & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Retail Management, Finance, or a related field preferred.
* **Minimum 10 years of overall retail experience, including at least 5 years in a Store Manager or equivalent leadership role.**
* Experience managing the complete operations and P&L of a retail store is strongly preferred.
* Experience in jewellery, luxury retail, fashion, lifestyle, or other high-value retail businesses will be an advantage.
* Candidates with demonstrated experience in inventory control, financial management, operational audits, and profitability improvement will be preferred.

Working Conditions

* 6 days per week.
* 10 working hours per day.
* Availability to work on weekends, public holidays, and during festive seasons.
* Active involvement in showroom operations and business reviews.

Compensation & Benefits

* Competitive salary.
* Performance-based incentives.
* Health insurance and Provident Fund (PF).
* Paid leave.
* Daily snacks.
* Yearly bonus.
* Professional development and career growth opportunities.
* Supportive and professional work environment.

The Store Manager will act as the overall business owner of the showroom, ensuring complete accountability for store operations, P&L, profitability, inventory, team performance, compliance, and customer experience.

title: Battery Production Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Quantum Energy Limited is a leading electric vehicle firm in India focused on accelerating EV adoption and reducing the global carbon footprint. The company designs, develops, and manufactures high-quality electric scooters tailored to the diverse needs of customers. Backed by over five decades of automotive expertise, Quantum Energy operates a state-of-the-art R&D center and advanced manufacturing facility in Hyderabad to deliver innovative and sustainable mobility solutions. The organization is actively engaged with its community through multiple digital channels and provides support and information via support@quantumenergy.in.
  
**Role Description**
The Battery Production Manager is responsible for overseeing end-to-end battery production operations for electric scooters at Quantum Energy Limited. This full-time, on-site role based in Bengaluru involves planning and managing production schedules, ensuring adherence to quality standards, and optimizing manufacturing processes for efficiency and safety. The manager will coordinate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, quality, supply chain, and maintenance, to ensure timely availability of materials, resolve production issues, and support new product introductions. Daily responsibilities include monitoring production KPIs, leading and training production staff, implementing continuous improvement initiatives, and ensuring compliance with relevant regulatory and environmental norms. The role also requires active participation in root cause analysis, cost optimization efforts, and alignment of production activities with company goals and demand forecasts.

* Understanding of quality management systems, safety standards, and compliance requirements relevant to battery production and EV industry.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings, work instructions, and process documentation; familiarity with basic electrical and electrochemical concepts is beneficial.
* Proficiency in using production management tools, ERP systems, and standard office software for reporting and data analysis.
* Strong leadership, people management, and communication skills, with the ability to train, mentor, and motivate diverse production teams.
* Experience in troubleshooting production issues, conducting root cause analysis, and implementing corrective and preventive actions.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (mechanical, electrical, industrial, or related field) or equivalent practical experience in manufacturing management.
* Prior experience in the electric vehicle, automotive, or energy storage sector is an advantage.
* Ability to work on-site in Bengaluru and collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.

title: Catering & Events Associate
description:
Are you passionate about creating exceptional food experiences and unforgettable events? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, people-centric environment where no two days are the same? If you have a flair for hospitality, a sharp eye for detail, and a love for bringing people together — we want to hear from you!
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Catering & Events Associate at Swiss Re, you will be at the heart of our workplace experience, delivering world-class food & beverage services and orchestrating seamless corporate events. From strategic planning to hands-on execution, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the day-to-day hospitality experience for our employees and guests in Hyderabad. This is your opportunity to combine your passion for food, events, and people into a role that truly makes an impact.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design and execute food & beverage strategies that align with organizational standards and cater to the diverse needs of our internal customers
* Champion sustainable gastronomy practices, driving initiatives that align with our environmental and organizational objectives
* Plan and manage end-to-end corporate events, including developing event plans, timelines, and conducting venue inspections and evaluations
* Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors — including kitchen staff, caterers, decorators, and audiovisual providers — to ensure timely and flawless service delivery
* Ensure full compliance with ISO 22000 and all applicable food safety, health & safety regulations, licensing, tax obligations, and labour laws
* Organise FOSTAC training for all food handlers and manage Background Verification documentation
* Create and manage budgets, track financial performance, analyse trends, and prepare regular financial and dashboard reports
* Build and nurture strong vendor and partner relationships, negotiating contracts and establishing KPIs to ensure cost-effectiveness and service excellence
* Drive process improvement initiatives, including automation and streamlining operations to enhance efficiency and overall experience
* Gather and act on feedback from employees and guests to continuously elevate the hospitality and events experience
* Lead and develop contract staff, fostering a positive, collaborative, and high-performing team culture
* Stay current with industry trends and best practices in catering, sustainable gastronomy, and event management

**About The Team**
The Corporate Real Estate and Services (CRES) team is on a mission to create and sustain a world-class office environment that aligns with Swiss Re's strategic vision and goals. Our diverse team of experts spans real estate, security, facilities management, and hospitality operations — working collaboratively to deliver innovative, data-driven solutions that make a real difference.
  
  
We believe that a well-maintained, secure, and thoughtfully designed workspace — paired with exceptional service offerings — is a powerful driver of employee well-being and productivity. As trusted advisors and partners, we are committed to consistently exceeding service standards by leveraging our collective expertise, fostering open communication, and embracing continuous learning and improvement.
  
  
**About You**
You are a hospitality professional who leads with warmth, precision, and purpose. You bring a solution-focused mindset, a genuine passion for customer service, and the ability to manage multiple priorities with grace. You take full ownership and accountability for your work, demonstrating strong leadership in everything you do — whether managing a high-profile event or resolving a day-to-day operational challenge. You thrive in dynamic environments, build strong relationships effortlessly, and are always looking for smarter, better ways to deliver exceptional experiences.
  
  
**We Are Looking For Candidates Who Meet These Requirements**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in catering, food & beverage management or a related corporate role, with demonstrated experience managing large teams
* Strong knowledge of food safety regulations, including ISO 22000 standards, and experience implementing and enforcing safe food handling procedures
* Proven budget management and financial analysis skills, with the ability to create, oversee, and report on budgets and financial performance
* Experience in vendor and contract management, including negotiating contracts and managing relationships with external partners and suppliers
* Proficiency in event planning and execution, including developing event plans, timelines, and coordinating with multiple internal and external stakeholders
* Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and leadership skills — the ability to take responsibility for outcomes, lead by example, and drive results even in ambiguous or challenging situations

**What Would Make You Stand Out**

* Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Culinary Arts, or a related field
* Certifications such as ServSafe Food Handler or similar food safety credentials
* Certified Meeting Professional (CMP) or equivalent event management certification
* Experience working in diverse, multi-geography environments
* Familiarity with MSME vendor payment regulations and compliance requirements
* Knowledge of local occupational health and safety regulations in India
* Experience with automation and process improvement initiatives in a hospitality or facilities management context
* Proficiency in preparing dashboards and data reports for consumption and budget tracking
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in both English and the local language
* A collaborative, empathetic approach to teamwork across virtual and in-person environments

Nice to have: Exposure to Event Planning
  
  
**Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per wee**
**About Swiss Re**
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.
  
  
Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. title: Manager IT Business Services
description:
**Who We Are**
Solera is a leading global technology and data solutions provider, specializing in the automotive industry that strives to transform every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. In addition, we provide products and services to protect life’s other most important assets: our homes and digital identities. Today, Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our 6,500 team members foster an uncommon, innovative culture and are dedicated to successfully bringing the future to bear today through cognitive answers, insights, algorithms and automation. For more information, please visit solera.com.
  
  
**The Role**
The Manager is responsible for leading global
**Tier 1 and Tier 2 IT support operations**
, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, efficient, and scalable support services for end users across the organization.
  
  
The role directly manages
**4 Team Leads**
and provides overall leadership for a team of approximately
**24 IT Business Services professionals located in Hyderabad, India**
. The Senior Manager oversees the Service Desk and Remote Services functions while partnering with HR, Security, Enterprise Applications, and other IT organizations to drive operational excellence, service automation, access management, employee lifecycle services, continuous improvement, and an exceptional end-user experience.
  
  
This leader is responsible for developing talent, driving accountability, improving service delivery performance, and ensuring the organization continues to mature its support operations while delivering reliable global IT services.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Core Requirements**
**Leadership**
Lead and develop a global team of Tier 1 and Tier 2 support professionals through multiple team leads, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and exceptional customer service.
  
  
**Global Service Delivery:**
Ensure timely and effective resolution of incidents and service requests while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction and adherence to established SLAs, KPIs, and operational targets.
  
  
**Remote Operations:**
Provide strategic oversight of Service Desk and Remote Services functions, ensuring consistent support experiences and efficient service delivery across multiple regions and time zones.
  
  
**Employee Lifecycle Management**
Lead global IT onboarding, offboarding, contingent worker provisioning, leave-of-absence support processes, and employee technology enablement activities to ensure a secure, seamless, and consistent employee experience.
  
  
**Access & Identity Services**
Oversee account provisioning, access management, role-based access models, access personas, entitlement reviews, and identity-related support processes while ensuring compliance with security and audit requirements.
  
  
**Incident, Request & Problem Management**
Drive operational excellence across incident, request, escalation, and problem management processes, ensuring recurring issues are identified, analyzed, and addressed through sustainable solutions and root cause analysis.
  
  
**Service Request Triage & Escalation Management**
Own support intake, ticket triage, escalation governance, and routing processes to ensure requests are assigned to the appropriate support teams and resolved efficiently while reducing unnecessary escalations and ticket transfers.
  
  
**Process Optimization & Service Automation**
Identify opportunities to streamline and automate support processes, onboarding workflows, reporting activities, and employee lifecycle services to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance service quality.
  
  
**Knowledge Management & Training**
Establish and maintain knowledge management programs, operational documentation, and training initiatives that improve first-contact resolution rates, accelerate team development, and ensure consistent support practices globally.
  
  
**Stakeholder Engagement**
Partner closely with IT leadership, HR, Security, Finance, Enterprise Applications, and business stakeholders to align support services with organizational priorities and business objectives.
  
  
**Reporting & Service Analytics**
Develop and maintain operational dashboards, KPIs, and management reporting to provide visibility into service performance, support trends, team productivity, and customer satisfaction while enabling data-driven decision making.
  
  
**Compliance, Audit & Governance**
Support SOX, ISO, security, and internal audit requirements through the implementation of appropriate operational controls, access governance processes, asset management standards, and policy compliance activities.
  
  
**Technology Enablement**
Leverage and support enterprise technologies including Microsoft 365, Intune, Entra ID (Azure AD), Teams, Zoom, Jira, endpoint management platforms, and automation tools to continuously improve end-user support capabilities and experiences.
  
  
**Timings**
Must be open to working in different shift timings to support USA/EMEA/APAC regions, as per business needs.
  
  
**What You’ll Bring**
**Required Qualifications**
8+ years of progressive experience in IT support, service management, or IT operations leadership.
  
  
5+ years of experience managing global support organizations, including geographically distributed teams.
  
  
Proven experience leading Tier 1 and Tier 2 support operations in a large enterprise environment.
  
  
Strong leadership, coaching, and people management skills with experience leading leaders.
  
  
Deep understanding of ITIL-based service management principles and operational best practices.
  
  
Experience managing incident, request, problem, change, and knowledge management processes.
  
  
Strong analytical and reporting skills with experience using service metrics to drive operational improvements.
  
  
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and organizational skills.
  
  
Experience working cross-functionally with HR, Security, Infrastructure, and business teams.
  
  
Ability to balance strategic initiatives with day-to-day operational responsibilities.
  
  
**Technical & Professional Expertise**
**Identity & Access Management**
Strong experience administering Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Active Directory, and identity governance solutions.
  
  
Experience managing user provisioning, deprovisioning, group management, entitlement reviews, and access control processes.
  
  
Proficiency with identity and access management tools such as ADManager and similar administration platforms.
  
  
**Microsoft 365 Administration**
Strong working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and related administration functions.
  
  
Ability to troubleshoot and support complex user, collaboration, and productivity-related issues within Microsoft 365.
  
  
**IT Support Operations**
Advanced understanding of Tier 1 and Tier 2 support processes, service operations, incident management, request fulfillment, escalation management, and troubleshooting methodologies.
  
  
Experience supporting Windows, macOS, Microsoft Office, collaboration platforms, printers, remote access technologies, and end-user productivity tools.
  
  
**Service Management Platforms**
Strong experience with Jira Service Management, including workflow creation, queue management, SLA administration, service request design, reporting, and operational process optimization.
  
  
Reporting & Analytics
  
  
Experience building, maintaining, and enhancing Power BI dashboards, operational reports, and executive reporting solutions.
  
  
Ability to analyze support trends, service metrics, workforce data, and operational KPIs to drive decision-making and continuous improvement initiatives.
  
  
**Automation & Workflow Solutions**
Experience implementing and managing workflow automation solutions to improve operational efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance service delivery.
  
  
Understanding of automation concepts, business process improvement, and service orchestration.
  
  
**Artificial Intelligence & Modern Technologies**
Demonstrated understanding of Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies and their practical application within IT support and service management functions.
  
  
Experience leveraging AI-powered tools to improve productivity, knowledge management, reporting, automation, and user experience.
  
  
**Operational Excellence**
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and process-improvement skills.
  
  
Ability to identify operational inefficiencies and implement scalable solutions across global support teams.
  
  
**Communication & Leadership Skills**
**Communication**
Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills.
  
  
Ability to communicate effectively with executives, technical teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and end users across global regions.
  
  
Strong presentation, documentation, and stakeholder engagement capabilities.
  
  
**Leadership**
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop managers, team leads, and support professionals within a global organization.
  
  
Proven ability to drive accountability, collaboration, customer service excellence, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Strategic Thinking**
Ability to balance operational responsibilities with strategic initiatives.
  
  
Experience leading organizational change, service transformation, and process improvement programs.
  
  
**Timings**
Must be open to working in different shift timings to support USA/EMEA/APAC regions, as per business needs.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
ITIL Foundation Certification or higher.
  
  
Microsoft 365, Entra ID, or Power Platform certifications.
  
  
Experience building and maintaining Power BI reporting solutions.
  
  
Experience with workflow automation platforms, including Power Automate or similar solutions.
  
  
Experience supporting global onboarding, offboarding, and identity management processes.
  
  
Experience leading globally distributed support teams across multiple regions and time zones.
  
  
Experience working within SOX, ISO, audit, or compliance-driven environments.
  
  
Experience leveraging AI-driven tools and automation within enterprise support organizations.

description:

We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. title: Study Grant Analyst II
description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose – moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Study Grant Analyst II to join our team. As a Study Grant Analyst II, you will play a critical role in developing accurate, competitive clinical study budgets that support our clients' research objectives and advance new treatments for patients. This position is essential to study execution, financial planning, regulatory compliance, and successful project delivery.
  
  
You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams including Site Contracts Leaders, Study Project Leaders, and Project Directors to create strategic budget analysis that drives business growth and client satisfaction. Following industry-standard processes and Parexel's rigorous compliance standards, you'll contribute to study operations from pre-sales proposal development through post-award financial management.
  
  
You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment where your analytical expertise and attention to detail directly impact study success and client relationships. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, this role offers pathways to expand your skills in clinical research operations, financial strategy, and healthcare compliance.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and deliver timely, accurate, and competitive clinical study budgets across all trial phases and indications using industry-standard pricing tools such as Grant Plan, ensuring compliance with client requirements and Parexel internal policies
* Serve as a subject matter expert on clinical study grant creation, revision, and approval processes, collaborating with Site Contracts Leaders, Study Project Leaders, and Project Directors to ensure financial accuracy and strategic alignment
* Prepare competitive budget concepts for pre-sales business proposals and conduct post-award clinical study grant analyses to support ongoing project financial management
* Participate in strategy sessions and budget reviews to develop win themes, benchmark competitor offerings, and align budgets with client needs and market standards
* Ensure all clinical study budget information complies with Fair Market Value (FMV) principles, the Physician Payments Sunshine Act, and relevant healthcare compliance requirements including HIPAA, FCPA, and Safe Harbor regulations
* Share knowledge and best practices with team members, document lessons learned, and contribute to departmental training development and delivery
* Deliver client-focused grant analysis and performance metrics to proactively identify issues and drive continuous improvement in budget accuracy and delivery
* Maintain working knowledge of ICH Guidelines, Good Clinical Practices, regulatory agency requirements, and Parexel SOPs to ensure full compliance across all budget development activities
* Participate in departmental and organizational system improvement activities, task forces, and change management initiatives to enhance processes and quality standards
* Maintain agreed productivity and billability levels while completing routine administrative tasks in a timely manner, including timesheets, training, and travel expense management

**Candidate Profile**
**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**

* Strategic thinking skills that enable you to create urgency, take a proactive approach, and develop solutions-based strategies
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities to define and resolve complex issues across multiple projects and situations
* Strong communication skills that enable you to convey information across functional boundaries and build trust with clients and internal stakeholders
* A client-focused mindset with the ability to create and maintain trust through project interactions and serve as a trusted advisor
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with enthusiasm and prioritization
* Outstanding negotiation and influencing skills with demonstrated stakeholder and relationship management experience
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word, and the ability to quickly master Parexel systems and eClinical tools
* Ability to work effectively in virtual and cross-functional team environments with a collaborative and results-oriented approach

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in biological science, pharmacy, health-related discipline, nursing, or equivalent clinical experience
* 3-5 years of work experience in clinical site budget development, clinical research operations, or a similar role within the managed care, pharmaceutical, or biotechnology industries
* Experience with clinical study pricing tools such as Grant Plan or Grant Manager
* Knowledge of ICH-GCP, regulatory requirements, and clinical trial processes
* Experience with industry benchmarking databases and tools used to ensure fair market value in investigator grant development
* Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently and escalate issues appropriately

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced proficiency with Grant Plan or other clinical study pricing platforms
* Experience in specific therapeutic areas or clinical trial phases
* Familiarity with Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS), eTMF, or Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems
* Demonstrated experience with Fair Market Value analysis and healthcare compliance requirements

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.
  
  
If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

The Prime Services Operations Vice President is a leadership role responsible for overseeing the operational support of Prime Services borrowing and lending activities, including settlement processes, collateral management, recon, billing, and corporate action event processing. title: Technical Operations Manager, Post Services - India
description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

**About the Role:**
-------------------

As part of Netflix's in-house Post Services team, the Technical Operations Manager (India) owns technical operations for the India market — spanning Netflix Dailies, MPS (Media Production Suite) Footage Ingest, screening operations — and is accountable for service quality across all Post Services technical offerings in India. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Post Services – APAC, this is a people manager role: you'll lead and grow a team of contractor operators, applying systems thinking, risk management, and operations design to build scalable, reliable workflows across India's production hubs.

You'll partner closely with India's Project Operations counterpart to ensure end-to-end clarity across every workstream — dailies, ingest, screenings, and editorial — and align with APAC and Global Post Services colleagues to keep standards and practices consistent.

**What You'll Do:**
-------------------

* Own technical operations for India, including Netflix Dailies, MPS Footage Ingest, screening operations, and be accountable for service quality across all Post Services technical offerings in India.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of contractor operators (including Dailies Operators and Dailies Lab Supervisor), building a high-performance, service-first culture.
* Lead the execution of Post Services’ Global Follow-the-Sun Operations of MPS Dailies in India. Collaborating closely with global colleagues on continuous development of operational excellence and efficiencies.
* Responsible for representing Post Services as local leadership. Build and strengthen partnerships with internal stakeholders such as Title Management and Production Solutions
* Serve as the technical operator lead for Netflix screening spaces in India — Screening Room, Screening Lounge, and Technical Review Room — and oversee local/remote operational support for sessions conducted at partner facilities such as Dark and Talkies.
* Own MPS Footage Ingest operations across India's Model A ingest hubs (Mumbai, Delhi, and Hyderabad), including onboarding, training, and coordination of contractors, kiosk resource allocation, and fulfillment of ad-hoc and high-volume ingest requests.
* Oversee end-to-end MPS Dailies technical workflows and deliverables across multiple concurrent productions, acting as the primary Dailies technical point of contact for internal stakeholders and external partners.
* Collaborate closely with the Senior Manager of Post Services APAC to develop the MPS and Live Editorial strategy for India.
* Apply systems thinking, risk management, and operations design to build workflows that scale reliably as India's volume and complexity grow.
* Partner closely with India's Project Operations Coordinator so that technical and project workstreams move together, aligning on escalation paths and partner-facing commitments.
* Act as the India escalation point for technical risk, workflow gaps, and tooling issues surfaced by Specialists and contractor teams.
* Represent Technical Operations for India, acting as the named decision-maker for technical questions that are local in scope, and looping in Global when a decision would set a de facto standard or trade off against the 90% Global standard/ 10% Local nuance line.
* Partner with Global Engineering and Product teams to pilot and roll out new tools, ensuring compatibility with the nuance of India-specific production workflows.
* Surface risk, workflow gaps, and improvement opportunities to Regional Leadership (Senior Manager, Post Services – APAC).

**Experience:**
---------------

* 10+ years of post-production technical operations experience, with prior people management or team lead experience.
* Deep knowledge of post-production tools and workflows relevant to the India market (e.g., dailies, ingest, editorial, screenings, QC, sound, finishing).
* Proven ability to build and scale technical operations across multiple production hubs, applying systems thinking and operations design.
* Track record of managing and mentoring technical teams, including contractor operators, in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. A mature and collaborative mindset, and ability to align partners and stakeholders across regions and functions on complex initiatives.
* Familiarity with the India production ecosystem.
* Comfortable operating with ambiguity, applying judgment, and prioritizing across shifting, concurrent demands.
* Enthusiastic team player with a commitment to high performance and a service-first mindset.
  

  

**Additional Qualifications:**
------------------------------

  

* Fluent in English (Hindi or other regional languages a plus).
* Willingness to travel within India, and globally as needed.
* Ability to respond to urgent or after-hours needs when required.
* Comfortable working across time zones in a global team, including alignment with APAC and global partners.
* Deep alignment with Netflix's culture of curiosity, ownership, and continuous improvement.

**About Post Services in India:**
---------------------------------

This is a regional role within a globally aligned Post Services organization. As part of Regional Leadership for APAC, you'll own technical operations for India and work closely with Project Operations and global partners to deliver scalable, reliable, and impactful post-production support that helps Netflix entertain the world.

title: Assistant Vice President – Facility and Construction (F&C) Operations Team Lead
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

At Citi, we get to connect millions of people across hundreds of cities and countries every day. And we've been doing it for more than 200 years. We do this through our unparalleled global network. We provide a broad range of financial services and products to our clients – whether they are consumers, corporations, governments, or institutions – to help them meet their biggest opportunities and face the world's toughest challenges.

Citi’s Enterprise Services and Public Affairs (ESPA) aims to enhance how our stakeholders perceive and experience Citi. We manage our reputation by engaging with our stakeholders and delivering great spaces and services to colleagues and clients.

We’re currently looking for a high caliber professional to join our team as Assistant Vice President (AVP) – Facility and Construction (F&C) Operations Team Lead - Hybrid based in Mumbai, India. Being part of our team means that we’ll provide you with the resources to meet your unique needs, empower you to make healthy decisions and manage your financial well-being to help plan for your future. For instance:

* Citi provides programs and services for your physical and mental well-being including access to telehealth options, health advocates, confidential counseling and more. Coverage varies by country.

* We believe all parents deserve time to adjust to parenthood and bond with the newest members of their families. That’s why in early 2020 we began rolling out our expanded Paid Parental Leave Policy to include Citi employees around the world.

* We empower our employees to manage their financial well-being and help them plan.

**About the Team:**

Real Estate services (RES) provides services and premises that are cost effective, safe, and productive to Citi Businesses, through a network of regional offices and a team of international realty advisors. RES manages approximately 2,500 properties (36 MM Sf) and supports businesses through the development and maintenance of office buildings, data centers and branches. The products and services include premises acquisition and disposal, construction (including fit outs, moves and changes), maintenance, facilities management, and utilities supply.

In this role, you’re expected to:

The Assistant Vice President (AVP), F&C Operations Team Lead is responsible for leading a team that supports Real Estate Services (RES) project compliance activities across the project lifecycle. The role ensures adherence to Citi policies, procedures, standards, and governance requirements while maintaining high-quality project documentation, financial controls, and operational excellence.

The AVP serves as a key partner to Project Managers, Facilities Managers, Finance, Procurement, and Vendor Management teams by overseeing project initiation, compliance reviews, quality assurance, purchase-to-pay processes, and project closure activities within REALM and P2P systems.

The AVP needs to demonstrate strong leadership, operational discipline, and deep understanding of compliance and governance requirements. Needs to effectively balance people leadership, risk management, process efficiency, and stakeholder support to ensure projects are executed in a compliant, controlled, and efficient manner while delivering exceptional service to the business.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Team Leadership & People Management**

Lead, coach, and develop the team to achieve operational excellence and service delivery goals. Manage team capacity, workload distribution, and resource planning to optimize productivity and performance. Conduct regular performance reviews, provide constructive feedback, and support employee development initiatives. Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and operational excellence. Exceptional problem-solving skills and the ability to make quick, effective decisions. Strong analytical skills and a data-driven mindset to track and measure performance

**Compliance & Governance**

Ensure compliance with Citi policies, procedures, standards, and regulatory requirements across all project activities. Monitor project documentation and records to ensure completeness, accuracy, and audit readiness. Review contracts, permits, certificates of insurance, scope documentation, and supporting approvals to ensure adherence to governance requirements. Identify compliance risks and implement corrective actions to mitigate potential issues.

**REALM Project Lifecycle Management**

Oversee project initiation activities, including project setup and validation within REALM. Review and approve Scope Agreements and pre-funding documentation to ensure accuracy and completeness. Partner with project teams to ensure compliance requirements are met throughout the project lifecycle. Support project closure activities and ensure all required documentation is completed and archived appropriately.

**P2P and Financial Operations**

Oversee creation and validation of Purchase Requisitions and Purchase Orders within P2P systems. Ensure accurate invoice receipting and supporting documentation review prior to approval. Monitor financial controls associated with project expenditure and procurement processes. Resolve procurement and payment-related issues in collaboration with Finance and Procurement teams.

**Quality Assurance & Operational Excellence**

Conduct quality reviews and sample-based audits of team outputs. Develop and maintain operational controls to improve accuracy and reduce processing errors. Analyze operational metrics and identify opportunities for process enhancement. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to streamline workflows, eliminate inefficiencies, and enhance user experience.

**Stakeholder Management**

Serve as a trusted advisor to Project Managers and operational stakeholders on compliance and process requirements. Provide interpretation and guidance on Citi operational policies, governance frameworks, and compliance procedures. Collaborate with regional and global teams to support consistent execution of compliance standards. Escalate risks, control gaps, and operational issues to senior management as required.

**Required Qualifications**

  
  

Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Operations Management, Real Estate, or related discipline.

Minimum 5 years of experience in operations, compliance, project administration, procurement, or related functions.

Minimum 2 years of people management experience leading operational teams.

Experience working within global and matrix organizations.

Strong understanding of governance, controls, risk management, and operational compliance practices.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience within Corporate Real Estate, Facilities Management, Construction, or Project Delivery environments.

Knowledge of REALM, P2P, procurement, and project lifecycle management processes.

Proficient in the use of office applications (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.)

Accounting or finance background preferred.

Experience managing projects and implementing process improvement initiatives.

Familiarity with audit, regulatory, and control frameworks.

title: Manager, Water Treatment Operations (EAII Advisors)
description:
This position is with EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India.
  
  
**About EAII**
EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence-based public health programs, including safe drinking water initiatives and school and Anganwadi-based National Deworming Day and iron and folic acid supplementation. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long-term wellbeing of children and families.
  
  
For more information, read about our work here: About Evidence Action and EAII
  
  
**About Evidence Action**
At Evidence Action, we deliver data-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations.
  
  
Our model operationalizes leading academic research (including from Nobel-winning economists). We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we're making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 11 countries, our team of 900+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions.
  
  

* Our Deworm the World program has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains.
* Through Safe Water Now, we've saved the lives of over 15,000 children.
* Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives.

At Evidence Action, your colleagues are your greatest asset. You'll partner with high-caliber colleagues in an environment blending innovation, autonomy, and teamwork. Our team excels in disruptive thinking and believes in rolling up our sleeves to get things done. If you're looking to work flexibly and with purpose, join a team that delivers measurable change for millions.
  
  
**The Role**
We are seeking a technically strong, operationally rigorous Manager to own the ILC intervention through its full lifecycle — first establishing and validating the pilot, then driving its scale-up across new and existing geographies. This is a sequential mandate: the Manager sets up the pilot, proves the model on the ground, and subsequently leads the transition into full-scale, multi-site operations. Throughout, the role carries direct ownership of regional teams and ground operations.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings deep operational and technical experience — someone who has run field operations hands-on, solved device- and system-level problems directly, and later scaled those operations into a repeatable, standardised model. 5-8 years relevant experience required.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Operations Delivery (35%) —**

* Own day-to-day ground operations end-to-end: site setup, installation quality, O&M adherence, supply and logistics, and water-quality benchmarks.
* Establish the pilot's operational backbone —SOPs, workflows, escalation paths — then progressively harden and standardize these systems for scale.
* Run root-cause analysis on operational bottlenecks and drive continuous improvement across sites
* Manage vendor performance, field logistics, and resource allocation in low-infrastructure settings.

**Technical Ownership (30%)**

* Serve as the technical lead for the ILC intervention — dosing calibration, chlorine residual management, device configuration, and troubleshooting across varied field infrastructure
* Own operational performance across intervention sites, including installation quality, O&M adherence, water-quality benchmarks, and real-time data validation through dashboards and raw-data review
* Diagnose recurring technical and operational failures, design scalable solutions, and embed corrective protocols across teams and geographies
* Collaborate with academic and technical partners, vendors, and the product team to strengthen device performance and field protocols

**Team Building & Management (20%)**

* Hire, structure, and lead new field and coordination teams - defining roles, KPIs, and reporting lines aligned to program priorities
* Provide direct leadership, mentorship, and structured performance management to team members, driving accountability and a culture of transparency and learning
* Run structured performance management via trackers, dashboards, and review cadences

**Stakeholder Collaboration (15%)**

* Contribute to the development of tools, frameworks, training materials, and methodologies for effective knowledge transfer and capacity building
* Represent the LMT with government departments (e.g., JJM, PHED / RWSS), academic partners, and community stakeholders, championing technical and programmatic excellence
* Communicate insights, risks, and recommendations to ISW leadership in a timely and structured manner

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Chemical, or Environmental) or a closely related technical discipline
* Minimum of 5-8 years of experience in technically complex program delivery, with demonstrable, including hands-on field operations and a subsequent scale-up
* Proven experience hiring, structuring, and leading teams, ideally across dispersed geographies in rural or resource-limited settings
* Strong ability to use data for decision-making, protocol design, and continuous improvement
* Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to synthesise information and produce high-quality documents to tight deadlines
* Willingness to travel up to 40% of the time domestically

**Desirable**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Management, or a related discipline
* Experience running large, multi-site field operations, ideally having taken an operation from pilot through to scale-up
* Exceptional ability to work with minimal supervision while proactively surfacing progress and bottlenecks to leadership

**Benefits**
EAII provides a comprehensive benefits package for employees which include:
  
  

* Comprehensive health insurance with IPD and OPD provisions,
* Life and Accidental insurance
* PF, ESIC and Gratuity as per statutory requirements
* Mental and physical well-being benefits
* Learning and Development benefit
* Generous leave
* Avenues for engagement and recognition

**Compensation**
Competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience, and previous pay scale
  
  
All contracting arrangements will be made through EAII Advisors Private Limited. EAII is an equal opportunity employer. Employment at EAII is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. EAII does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, caste, creed, colour, religion, gender, origin, disability, marital status, or any other basis protected by law.
  
  
**Note:**
This role will be open for applications until May 31st, 2026. Please apply at your earliest convenience. We may close this search earlier than the specified date if we find the right fit. Due to the volume of applications received, we will only be able to contact shortlisted candidates.

title: Head of Operations
description:
Head of Operations

**We build the product. You make everything behind it work.**

Every order matters. Every detail matters. And great operations should work so seamlessly that nobody has to think twice about them.

We’re looking for a Head of Operations to own the entire backend at Monvue — from inventory and packaging to dispatch, delivery and marketplace operations.

You’ll lead the packaging team, manage our fulfilment systems and make sure every order moves from checkout to doorstep, accurately and on time.

What you’ll own

* **Order Management:**
  Oversee every order across our website and marketplaces, from processing to final dispatch.
* **Packaging & Fulfilment:**
  Lead the packaging team, maintain quality standards and ensure orders are packed accurately and shipped on time.
* **Inventory:**
  Own stock tracking, SKU management, stock audits, inward and outward movement, and inventory reconciliation.
* **Shipping & Logistics:**
  Manage Shiprocket, courier pickups, tracking, delayed shipments, returns, RTOs and delivery exceptions.
* **Marketplace Operations:**
  Handle end-to-end fulfilment across Amazon and other online marketplaces.
* **Systems & Processes:**
  Build SOPs, improve workflows and create systems that make our operations faster, more accurate and scalable.
* **Reporting & Accountability:**
  Track daily orders, dispatches, inventory, returns and team performance.

Who you are

You don’t wait to be told what needs fixing. You see a problem, take ownership and solve it.

You know how e-commerce operations work. You can manage a team, stay on top of inventory, navigate shipping platforms and keep multiple moving parts under control.

You care about the details. You think in systems. And you believe that good operations aren't about firefighting — they're about making sure the fire never starts.

**What we’re looking for:**

* 3–6 years of experience in e-commerce operations or fulfilment.
* Hands-on experience with Shiprocket, inventory management and order processing.
* Experience managing packaging, warehouse or dispatch teams.
* Familiarity with Shopify and marketplaces such as Amazon.
* A strong sense of ownership, urgency and execution.

The goal is simple.

Build an operation that runs efficiently, scales with the business and doesn't depend on the founder to keep it moving.

If that sounds like the kind of challenge you enjoy, let's talk.

**Location:**
Ghitorini, New Delhi

**Role:**
Full-time | On-site

**Apply with your CV and a short note about the operations you've owned end to end.**

title: Head of Commercialization and Operations, New Approach Methodologies (NAMs)
description:
**Head of Commercialization and Operations, New Approach Methodologies (NAMs)**

**Location:**

New Delhi, India

**Employment Type:**

Full time

**Reports to:**

Founders and Board

**About NITS Engineering**

NITS Engineering is a biomedical technology company building the next generation of biomedical devices, in vitro disease models, and engineering systems for drug discovery, regenerative medicine, and diagnostics. We combine precision hardware engineering with biomedical research to build the tools that take science from the lab bench to real world application.

**Role Overview**

Regulators worldwide are reducing reliance on animal testing, and drug developers need human relevant models they trust. We are building high throughput bioprinted human tissue platforms, starting with engineered cardiac tissue, for safety assessment, disease modeling, and drug discovery.

We are seeking a commercial and operational leader who has taken NAMs to market. You will own the path from validated science to revenue: defining products and pricing, winning pilots and first contracts with pharma, biotech, and CROs, shaping the validation evidence customers require, and building the operations that deliver reliably at scale. This work is carried out in collaboration with CenFab, the Center for Biofabrication at Vellore Institute of Technology, Vellore.

**What You Will Do**

**Go to Market and Revenue**

* Define product offerings, target customer segments, and the business model (assay services, kits, or platform licensing).
* Set pricing for pilot studies, service contracts, and platform access.
* Build and manage the pipeline: lead pilot evaluations, convert them into paid contracts, and establish recurring revenue.
* Secure partnerships with pharma, biotech, CROs, distributors, and academic centers in India, the US, and Europe.
* Deliver the first commercial milestones: paid pilots in year one and recurring contracts by year two.

**Validation That Drives Adoption**

* Work with the R&D team to design validation studies that answer the questions buyers and regulators ask, including reference compound sets, sensitivity, specificity, and reproducibility.
* Benchmark our models against human clinical data, animal data, and incumbent in vitro assays to build a clear value case.
* Align the evidence package with FDA, EMA, CDSCO, and OECD expectations, and decide when to pursue formal qualification routes.
* Translate customer feedback into product requirements and specifications.

**Operations and Quality**

* Build the quality management system for commercial model production, including SOPs, batch release criteria, and documentation suitable for customer audits.
* Establish supply chain and vendor management for cells, reagents, and consumables, including import planning.
* Set up service delivery workflows, timelines, and data reporting standards for customer projects.
* Scale capacity in step with demand while maintaining batch to batch consistency.

**Leadership and External Engagement**

* Lead business development, project management, and operations staff, working closely with scientific teams.
* Represent NITS Engineering at industry conferences, NAM consortia, and investor meetings.
* Prepare commercial proposals, study designs, white papers, and pitch materials.
* Support fundraising and nondilutive grant applications with market and commercial strategy.

**What We Are Looking For**

* At least 8 years of professional experience, with at least 4 years commercializing NAMs, in vitro models, or preclinical services in industry.
* A proven record of selling NAM products or services to pharma, biotech, or CROs, with demonstrable contract values and customer relationships.
* Experience setting pricing, running pilot to contract conversion, and negotiating commercial agreements.
* Hands-on experience building operations or quality systems (ISO 9001, ISO 13485, or GLP) for an assay, model, or product.
* Working knowledge of at least one NAM domain: microphysiological systems, organoids, 3D tissue models, iPSC derived assays, or in silico safety tools.
* A scientific degree in a relevant discipline. A PhD, MBA, or both is valued but not required.
* Strong network across pharma safety and discovery teams, CROs, and the NAM community.

**Nice to Have**

* Contributions to regulatory or validation initiatives with FDA, EMA, NIH/NICEATM, EURL ECVAM, OECD, or CDSCO.
* Experience commercializing 3D bioprinted or cardiac models.
* Experience managing multilab reproducibility studies or technology transfer to customer sites.
* Experience at a startup or early stage company through first revenue or fundraising.

**Why Join**

* Lead the commercial launch of human relevant NAM platforms from first customer to scale.
* Shape a company at an early stage, with direct influence on strategy, products, and growth.
* Work alongside biomedical engineers and cell biologists in a multidisciplinary environment, with access to the CenFab biofabrication hub.
* Help modernize preclinical testing and reduce reliance on animal studies.
