**Senior Manager / Deputy General Manager – Warehouse & Logistics Operations (Domestic Market)**

**Reporting To:**
Head – Global Logistics & Distribution

**Location**
: Ahmedabad, Mumbai

**Purpose of the Role:**

To lead and manage end-to-end warehousing, distribution, transportation, and inventory operations across the domestic market, ensuring optimum product availability, superior customer service levels, cost-effective logistics, efficient order fulfilment, inventory optimization, vendor performance management, and continuous process improvement in pharmaceutical Industry.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Warehouse & Distribution Management**

* Lead end-to-end warehousing and distribution operations across domestic market
* Ensure timely dispatch and delivery of Finished Goods (FG) to CFA locations and distribution points.
* Monitor logistics performance through key metrics such as OTIF (On-Time In-Full), fill rate, dispatch adherence, and delivery turnaround time.
* Ensure product availability across all stocking locations to support uninterrupted market servicing.
* Select and manage transportation partners for primary and secondary distribution.
* Negotiate freight rates, transportation contracts, and service-level agreements.
* Monitor transporter performance, vehicle availability, transit lead times, and delivery compliance.
* Optimize route planning, vehicle utilization, freight costs, and transportation efficiency.

**2. Vendor Management & Commercial Excellence**

* Identify, evaluate, onboard, and manage logistics service providers, warehouse operators, and transport partners.
* Lead commercial negotiations to achieve cost optimization and improved service performance.
* Conduct periodic vendor performance reviews and implement corrective and improvement actions.
* Ensure compliance with contractual commitments and agreed service standards.
* Monitor inventory health and ensure optimum stock levels across warehouses, hubs, and CFA locations.
* Manage inventory replenishment through effective DRP (Distribution Requirement Planning) and deployment planning.
* Coordinate with Production, Demand, Planning, Sales, and Commercial teams to achieve targeted service levels.
* Coordinate dispatch planning based on sales forecasts and market demand.
* Maintain high inventory accuracy through adherence to FIFO/FEFO practices and inventory controls.
* Monitor KPIs related to inventory accuracy, damage control, dispatch turnaround time, and warehouse efficiency.

**3. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Finance, Commercial, and Quality teams.
* Align distribution plans with business demand and market requirements.
* Support new product launches, promotional campaigns, and distribution initiatives.

**4. MIS, Compliance & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop logistics dashboards, management reports, and performance scorecards.
* Analyze logistics costs, warehouse productivity, inventory ageing, and service performance.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, SOPs, statutory requirements, and quality standards.
* Lead internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Drive digitization, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives across logistics operations.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Logistics Cost as % of Sales
* Transportation Cost Reduction
* Freight Cost Savings
* OTIF (On-Time In-Full) Performance
* DRP & RSP Planning Effectiveness
* Inventory Accuracy and Cycle Count Compliance
* Warehouse Productivity & Space Utilization
* Vendor Performance Compliance
* SOP Compliance & Implementation
* Internal & External Audit Compliance

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Commerce, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or related discipline.
* MBA / PGDM in Operations, Supply Chain Management, or Logistics preferred.

**Experience**

* 15–25 years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical Warehousing, Logistics, Distribution, and Supply Chain Management.

**Conga**
lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line.
  
  
**Job Title**
: Senior Manager, PS
  
  
**Locations**
: Ahmedabad

: Regional Vice President, Professional Services
  
  
**A career that’s the whole package!**
At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate, support for growth through individual and team development, and an environment where all voices can be heard.
  
  
**Conga**
crushes complexity within an increasingly complex world. With our revenue lifecycle management solution, we transform your unique complexities for order configuration, execution, fulfillment, and contract renewal processes with a single critical insights data model that adapts to ever-changing business requirements and aligns the understanding and efforts of every team.
  
  
**Our mission**
: Empower customers to deliver transformational revenue growth by aligning teams, processes, and technology to maximize customer lifetime value.
  
  
Our approach is grounded in the Conga Way, a framework for what we stand for and everything we do as an organization — from hiring to decision making and product development. Developed with direct input from our colleagues, the Conga Way is the foundation for our culture.
  
  
**A quick snapshot**
**…**
A Senior Manager will build and manage an effective team from offshore centre. It includes hiring, training, coaching, retaining, and measuring the effectiveness of a high-performing PS delivery team. Be a problem solver and a guide, coach, mentor, and a strong communicator.
  
  
**Why it’s a big deal…**
The Senior Manager will play a key role in building a strong and effective team who will deal with different situations while working on the projects.
  
  
**Are you the person we’re looking for?**
**Related experience.**
Must have 15+ years of experience in the IT industry, with strong experience in building and managing high-performing teams. Should have solid experience coordinating with global and offshore teams, along with full lifecycle enterprise software implementation experience. Experience working with Conga products such as CPQ and CLM, or with any CRM or SaaS platform, will be a strong added advantage.
  
  
**Strong communication and interpersonal skills.**
You’re not just comfortable engaging in collaborative discussions, but initiating them, too. You are skilled at reading and adapting to different communication styles, and when you speak you are clear and concise. Your strong listening skills foster connection with our customers and stakeholders and allow you to accurately gather the right information so you can resolve issues in the most effective way.
  
  
**Natural collaborator.**
You work effectively across functions — with Delivery Teams, Practice Directors, Regional Heads and customer stakeholders — to drive successful project outcomes. You are proficient with Agile and have a collaborative, cross-functional approach to delivering great solutions. You are comfortable working across multiple teams and championing best practices. You constantly seek opinions and solicit feedback to create the best work possible. You don’t know any other way, It’s a team effort and you completely appreciate that.
  
  
**People leadership and development.**
You take genuine ownership of your team — hiring, coaching, mentoring, and retaining top talent. You invest in each individual’s career growth and skill expansion, building clear development paths and a culture where people do their best work and want to stay.
  
  
**Driving initiatives and an AI-first mindset.**
You lead organizational initiatives that raise the bar for delivery, and you champion AI-driven ways of working to improve efficiency, quality, and customer outcomes. You proactively identify opportunities to innovate and bring your team along with you.
  
  
**Subject matter expertise.**
You serve as a trusted subject matter expert for Conga’s enterprise customers, understanding their business challenges and how our solutions solve them. You bring credibility to customer conversations and help your team navigate complex enterprise implementations.
  
  
**Education.**
A bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical field is highly preferred.

. We know it when we see it. Passion is not about saying how much you love what you do in your most excited voice. Passion is revealed in your truest self. It’s about what you’ve accomplished; how you want to grow; the ideas you have; your philosophies. It’s demonstrating through your words and your actions that you truly believe in what you do -- and where you work. That it matters to you. And that’s pretty cool.

*own it*
. And that also goes back to having an entrepreneurial spirt

title: Credit Team Leader – Australian Mortgages
description:
**Gandhinagar, Gujarat · Full time, work from office · CTC ₹15 LPA+ (base, premium and bonus)**

Own client delivery for an Australian finance broking firm. You lead the team that carries every loan file from first application to settlement, and you carry the complex files yourself. For a senior loan processor or credit lead with five or more years in lending, ideally on Australian mortgages, and real experience leading people.

Applications close Sunday 1st November 2026.

**WHO YOU WOULD BE JOINING**

Prevail Finance is a boutique Australian finance broking firm, founded in Melbourne in 2017 and working Australia-wide under Australian Credit Licence 509527. A finance broker arranges loans for clients from a panel of lenders; ours has more than 65. We arrange complex residential, business acquisition, commercial property, SMSF commercial, development and construction, and debt restructure lending. Four people today. You would lead the part of the firm that delivers every loan we write.

Established in 2017, Melbourne. Transaction range $400k–$10M+ AUD. 65+ lenders on panel. 50+ five-star Google reviews.

Priyank Thakkar, Founder — he assessed and approved business loans as a bank Lending Manager and Commercial Credit Analyst before he started arranging them. Master of Commerce (Professional Accounting), twelve years in lending, and still developing property himself. What you learn here is current practice, not textbook theory.

Member — Finance Brokers Association of Australia, Australian Institute of Business Brokers, SMSF Association.

Where and when — Gandhinagar, Gujarat, alongside our existing Gandhinagar team. Ahmedabad and areas within about 30 km are within commuting distance; you do not need to relocate. Monday to Saturday, on Australian business hours: an early-morning start and an afternoon finish, IST.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

Client delivery, end to end. Every active file has a clear status, an owner and a next action, and every loan settles on time, to standard. You report directly to the founder. As the firm grows, a General Manager will be appointed and this role will report to them. Advice to clients is given by the licence holder, not by this role.

You lead — a senior loan processor with almost five years on our files, a client experience coordinator who handles onboarding, document collection and client updates, a junior processor you will help choose, and whoever joins the team next.

Your week — about 60% your own files and 40% leading, until the junior processor is productive. Then 40% files and 60% leading. The split is written into your role agreement.

**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES**

Own the pipeline. Allocate every file by priority, capacity and capability, with a named owner, a next action and a due date. Run the weekly pipeline review and raise settlement risk early.

Carry the complex files. Personally manage complex applications from handover to settlement: self-employed, company and trust borrowers, and business and commercial lending as you learn it.

Hold the quality line. Review documents, servicing inputs and application readiness before anything reaches a lender, and confirm every file passes its required checks: customer identity (VOI), anti-money-laundering (AML/CTF) and Australian credit rules (NCCP, Best Interests Duty).

Work the lenders. Research policy, resolve lender queries, and work with relationship managers on pricing requests, policy exceptions, conditions and valuations.

Lead the people. Set clear standards for quality, communication and turnaround. Coach, review work, and hold the accountability conversation yourself when a standard slips.

Grow the team. Own your team’s training and development, sit on the panel for every hire into your team, and build the training that makes a new processor independent.

Fix what repeats. When the same problem comes back twice, find the cause and change the workflow so it stops.

Escalate well. Decide within your agreed authority. Bring material risks to the founder early, with the facts, the action already taken and your recommended next step.

**WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU**

Five or more years in mortgage or credit processing, in any market, owning complex files end to end.

Real experience leading people: allocating work, coaching, and holding colleagues to a standard, with or without the title.

Australian residential mortgage processing, end-to-end, is preferred. US or UK mortgage experience, or other credit processing, is also welcome; we will train you on Australian lending.

Australian business, commercial, SMSF or construction lending, ApplyOnline and Australian lender portals are an advantage. We use SalesTrekker as our CRM and will train you on it.

A degree in accounting, finance, commerce or banking.

Clear written and spoken English: you will write file notes and speak with Australian lenders every day.

Experience gets your CV read. Judgement gets you the job. We hire people who check carefully and then move, make the call within their authority, and can hold a colleague to a standard both kindly and directly.

**WHO THRIVES HERE**

You are accurate by habit, and quick to move once the checks are done. You are comfortable making the call within your authority. You are patient when teaching, direct when a standard slips, and calm when two settlements are at risk on the same morning.

You are not waiting to be told what comes next, redoing work yourself instead of teaching someone to do it right, letting a missed standard slide to keep the peace, or sending routine decisions up to the founder.

**WHAT YOU GET FROM US**

Real authority, in writing. What you decide alone, what you consult on and what you escalate: a starter version in your role agreement before your first day, finalised with the founder by day 30.

A structured 90-day onboarding. Our check-ins step back as you take ownership.

Training on whatever you have not done yet: Australian lending, business and commercial files, and our systems. Paid for by the firm.

Direct access to the founder, who assessed these loans inside the banks before he ever arranged one.

A team to build. You help choose your first hire.

What we cannot train is the wanting to. That part you bring.

**HOW WE WORK**

You will not be chased. You are given a result to achieve, the authority to achieve it, and the resources you need. Nobody checks whether you have started. You are expected to start.

The checklist is the minimum, not the maximum. Following the process is the basic requirement of the role. We need people who notice what the checklist missed and fix it before anyone asks.

Your work is measured. Turnaround time, compliance completeness, on-time settlements and client experience are reviewed every week, openly, in front of the whole team. For this role, so is how your team performs.

**PAY**

CTC ₹15 LPA+, including base, premium and bonus: a top-of-market package for the right person.

Base — for holding the role and meeting its standard.

Premium — as you develop and deliver at a higher level.

Bonus — for clearing a specific, difficult, time-bound project.

Most of it is fixed base salary, by design, because compliance work must never be influenced by a bonus. The final figure is benchmarked and agreed individually, and we discuss it openly at the first conversation.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Apply on LinkedIn, then email your CV, your current location, your notice period and your answers to the three questions below to priyank@prevailfinance.com.au. A paragraph each is enough. Write them yourself, in your own words.

Subject line: Credit Team Leader – your name

One. Tell us about a loan file that was stuck or at risk of missing settlement, and that you personally turned around. What was wrong, what did you do, and what happened?

Two. Tell us about a time you held a colleague to a standard they were not meeting. What did you say, what did you do next, and what happened?

Three. Tell us one thing in this advertisement you disagree with, or would do differently. Tell us why.

Question three is not a trick. It is the answer we read first.

Both steps count. Applications without the emailed answers are not assessed.

**WHAT HAPPENS NEXT**

Applications are read in the order they arrive, so earlier is better.

Every applicant receives a reply, including those not selected.

Shortlisted applicants are contacted within a week of the closing date for a 15-minute call, then an interview with the founder that includes a short practical exercise. If we receive many strong applications, we may first ask for a two-minute audio recording.

On appointment, a written role agreement covering title, responsibilities, authority and pay structure is provided before you start.

The first three months are a window to show the role is working, for both sides. If it is not, we part ways positively and without drama.

**YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS**

What success looks like, so you can judge us against it too.

By day 30: you know every live file and its next step, the weekly pipeline review is yours, and your decision rights are signed off in writing.

By day 60: you hold standards conversations without the founder in the room, and you have helped choose the junior processor.

By day 90: the founder no longer chases files or allocates work, check-ins have moved to exceptions only, and your first workflow fix is live.

**BEFORE YOU APPLY**

Background check — this role leads the team that handles client credit files, so appointment requires a police check and clearance against ASIC’s banned and disqualified persons register. Standard for the industry, arranged by the firm.

Fair assessment — every application is assessed against the same standard. We do not discriminate on age, gender, background, family responsibilities, or anything else with no bearing on the work.

If this reads like a description of how you already work, we would like to hear from you.

title: Assistant General Manager - CRM
description:
**Job Description:**

**Department:**
Ortho

**Job Title:**
Assistant General Manager - CRM

**Job Location:**
Corporate Office, Ahmedabad

**Experience Required:**
15 to 20 Years

**Role Objective:**

* To lead and govern the international distribution business and customer relationship management function for the
  **Ortho vertical.**
  The role is accountable for
  **export sales invoicing**
  ,
  **customer acquisition and upgrades**
  ,
  **premium-product revenue mix**
  ,
  **DSO and collections, forecasting, order-to-cash governance, customer service, distributor management, process compliance, digital transformation**
  through SAP and Salesforce, and the development of a robust CRM organization. The role must provide clear commercial direction, review performance at defined intervals, remove execution bottlenecks and ensure that business commitments are delivered through disciplined cross-functional coordination.

**Role and Responsibilities:**

**International Business Strategy and Revenue Delivery**

* Translate the approved annual international distribution strategy into market-wise, quarter-wise and customer-wise execution plans.
* Own the achievement of the approved export distribution sales invoicing target and review progress against quarterly milestones.
* Drive year-on-year growth through existing-customer expansion, new customer acquisition, customer upgrades and improved premium-product penetration.
* Review the performance of assigned regions, distribution partners, direct offices and customer segments, and implement corrective actions for target gaps.
* Lead preparation for the annual business plan and budget process and ensure that the operating plan is supported by realistic forecasts, customer actions and collection plans.

**Business Development and Customer Growth**

* Engage existing and potential international customers for business development and relationship expansion.
* Establish customer-segmentation priorities and ensure structured engagement with A and B customers, along with periodic follow-up for C and D customers.
* Drive business from new and upgraded customers in line with the approved annual and quarterly contribution targets.
* Review regional opportunities, market constraints, forecast-versus-actual gaps and customer-specific actions with regional stakeholders.

**CRM and Customer-Service Governance**

* Ensure a high and consistent level of service to existing and potential customers throughout the enquiry-to-order, order-to-shipment and post-shipment lifecycle.
* Lead CRM governance across assigned markets, including customer master data, follow-up trackers, customer health reports, customer feedback, open-point closure and service escalations.
* Ensure timely customer communication on order status, documentation, payments, shipment schedules, complaints, returns and regulatory requirements.
* Review customer follow-up presentations, customer-focused inputs, collected 4Q feedback and customer action plans before management reviews.
* Ensure that the CRM team maintains complete, accurate and current records in Salesforce, SAP and approved trackers.

**Sales Forecasting, Invoice Planning and Performance Reviews**

* Govern the 12-week rolling forecast process and ensure that forecast inputs are collected, validated, consolidated and reviewed at the prescribed frequency.
* Review the monthly invoice plan, expected sales and collection position, order pipeline, dispatch readiness and forecast-versus-actual challenges.
* Review sales, order, invoice and collection dashboards and ensure that data is available for global sales and collection performance meetings.
* Ensure periodic review of order-to-shipment reports, customer health reports, pending sales orders and key operational trackers.

**Order-to-Cash, DSO and Collection Control**

* Own DSO performance for the assigned international distribution business and drive progressive achievement of the approved quarterly DSO milestones.
* Review customer ledgers, overdue and due receivables, collection plans, credit risks and shipment holds with the CRM team.
* Ensure that monthly collection plans are prepared, communicated and actively followed up with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure that proforma invoices, sales contracts and orders are processed within the approved turnaround time, subject to receipt of advance payment where applicable.
* Ensure that orders are correctly created, verified, approved and released in SAP and that OBD, invoicing and shipment activities are completed within defined service levels.
* Escalate material payment, credit, documentation or shipment risks early and ensure closure through cross-functional coordination.

**Distributor Agreements and Commercial Documentation**

* Oversee preparation, validation, issuance and execution of distributor agreements for assigned markets.
* Ensure that agreement data is correctly uploaded and maintained in SAP and Salesforce.
* Oversee preparation and customer acceptance of sales contracts, pro forma invoices and related commercial documents for each order.
* Drive implementation and adoption of the Agreement Module in Salesforce in accordance with the approved project plan and go-live milestone.
* Ensure document completeness, version control, approval compliance and accessibility for audit and operational use.

**Logistics, Shipment and Inventory Coordination**

* Review order and logistics efficiency, pending dispatches, shipment risks and order-to-shipment performance with CRM and logistics stakeholders.
* Support the transition and review of FOB-to-CIF processes and ensure that nominated-agent details are made available for FOB shipments where required.
* Review non-moving stock and ensure that market, customer and shipment actions are defined and tracked to reduce inventory risk.
* Ensure timely resolution of documentation, payment, regulatory and logistics issues that may delay shipment.
* Govern implementation of the Salesforce Freight Portal and ensure process adoption after go-live.

**Regulatory, Quality, PMS and Returns Coordination**

* Ensure that product registration information and certificates received from customers or regional teams are shared with the Regulatory function in a timely manner.
* Ensure follow-up on product registration trackers with the Regulatory team for assigned markets.
* Ensure collection and tracking of customer-wise and product-wise post-market-surveillance feedback in line with defined requirements.
* Ensure that customer complaints are supported by complete complaint forms and routed through the approved quality-management process, including Track Wise/DMS activities.
* Ensure that goods-return details are correctly processed in SAP after confirmation from the relevant stores or operations team.
* Support applicable MDR and compliance audits and ensure timely closure of assigned observations.

**Systems, Digital Transformation and Process Improvement**

* Drive SAP-Salesforce automation, Salesforce master-data quality, process controls and management dashboards, including Power BI or other approved tools.
* Lead the Agreement Module and Freight Portal projects in Salesforce from project initiation through go-live and stabilization.
* Support development and adoption of online PMS feedback tools and other approved CRM/process solutions.
* Review process performance, identify control gaps, standardize workflows and sponsor continuous-improvement initiatives through the Menlo Park/Kaizen mechanism.

**Management Reporting, Meetings and Compliance**

* Prepare and present accurate information for management reviews, global sales and collection performance meetings, customer-focused meetings and business-plan discussions.
* Ensure that dashboards, trackers and review packs clearly show target achievement, DSO, collections, forecasts, customer actions, premium-product mix, new/upgrade business and project status.

**Functional Skills Required:**

* International distribution sales strategy and business development
* CRM governance, customer lifecycle management and service escalation
* Sales forecasting, gap analysis, pipeline and performance dashboards
* DSO, receivables, collection planning and credit-risk management
* Order-to-cash process, SAP order release, OBD, invoicing and shipment coordination
* Distributor agreements, sales contracts and proforma-invoice governance
* SAP and Salesforce implementation, automation and master-data control
* Management reporting, Power BI/analytics and executive presentations
* Regulatory registration, PMS feedback, complaint and returns coordination
* Process improvement, SOP governance, audits, budgeting and project management
* Team structure design, performance management, coaching and capability building

**Behavioural Skills Required:**

* Customer orientation and service ownership
* Commercial drive, aggressiveness and will to win
* Innovation, adaptability and change leadership
* Entrepreneurial thinking and opportunity orientation
* Passion, commitment and personal accountability
* Analytical thinking and evidence-based decision-making
* Clear communication, influencing and cross-cultural stakeholder management
* Respectful people leadership, coaching, collaboration, high process discipline, integrity, effective prioritization and timely action closure

**Team Size to be Handled:**

* Role involves managing a team of 2 members.

**Specific Professional Competencies:**

* Business Acumen, Customer Focus, Drive for results, Problem-solving, Peer relationship, Negotiation skills, Functional/ technical skills, Presentation skills, Adherence to Ethics and Values, Integrity.

* Website: https://biotechhealthcare.com/
* LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/biotechhealthcare/
* Instagram: Biotech Vision Care

+ Standby Letters of Credit (SBLCs)
+ Buyers' and Suppliers' Credit

title: Senior Account Manager
description:
**Company Description**
SHAH PANCHAL & ASSOCIATES is a consulting firm that supports businesses across accounts, tax, finance, legal, and international business affairs. The firm has a strong focus on helping clients navigate complex regulatory and compliance requirements while optimizing their financial and operational performance. It is recognized for its specialized expertise in real estate matters and cross-border transactions, providing tailored advisory services for domestic and international clients. Team members work closely with diverse businesses, offering strategic guidance and practical solutions to support growth and risk management.

**Role Description**
The Senior Account Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Ahmedabad. This role is responsible for overseeing key client accounts, managing day-to-day communication, and ensuring timely delivery of services in accounts, tax, finance, legal, and international business domains. The Senior Account Manager will review financial statements, coordinate tax filings, monitor compliance deadlines, and support real estate and cross-border transaction advisory work. The role includes supervising junior team members, allocating workloads, and maintaining high-quality documentation and reporting standards. The Senior Account Manager will also identify opportunities to expand client relationships, prepare proposals, and collaborate with internal specialists to address complex client requirements.

**Qualifications**

* Strong expertise in accounting, taxation, and financial reporting, with the ability to manage multiple client accounts and complex portfolios.
* Experience in legal and regulatory compliance relevant to business operations, including documentation review and coordination with legal advisors.
* Knowledge of international business affairs, including cross-border transactions, foreign exchange regulations, and global business practices.
* Exposure to real estate matters, such as transaction structuring, due diligence support, and financial evaluation of property-related deals.
* Proficiency in standard accounting and office software (e.g., ERP/accounting systems, spreadsheets, and presentation tools).

Maintain planning parameters in the ERP — reorder levels, safety stock, lead times, and material master data. Material availability and riskEnsure availability of all production inputs — textiles, printing media, inks, hardware, packaging, and consumables. Coordination and reportingWork closely with Sales, Production Planning, Procurement, Stores and Operations to ensure seamless material flow. Participate in the S&OP cycle and support demand planning. Publish daily, weekly, and monthly planning reports and KPIs. Improve planning processes through data analysis and better use of the ERP. A daily, published view of which materials are at risk and what is being done about them. Planning parameters in the ERP accurate, complete, and actively maintained. At least one measurable inventory improvement delivered and evidenced. Key Performance IndicatorsMaterial availability for production (%) Production stoppages attributable to material shortage Inventory turns and inventory days of cover. Inventory record accuracy. Excess, slow-moving and obsolete inventory as a percentage of total. Planning accuracy — requirement plan against actual consumption Purchase requisitions raised on or before the planned date Inventory carrying cost. Experience6 to 10 years in material planning, production planning, supply chain, or inventory management. Manufacturing background preferred — signage, printing, textiles, packaging or similar. Experience in a high-SKU or made-to-order environment is a strong advantage. Experience planning across multiple brands or business lines is an advantage. Advanced Microsoft Excel — pivot tables, lookup functions, dashboards, and modelling. Comfortable analysing consumption patterns and demand data to reach a recommendation. title: Operations Analyst, Credit Bureau Reporting- Operations
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We're looking for a detail-oriented Operations Analyst to join our Credit Bureau Reporting Operations team, where you'll play a critical role in ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant credit bureau reporting.  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for preparing and delivering credit bureau reports by extracting data from data warehouses and ensuring full compliance with all applicable reporting guidelines and regulatory standards. You will manage the end-to-end dispute resolution process for disputes received from Credit Information Companies (CICs) — investigating each case thoroughly and responding with accurate, well-documented, and detailed responses within defined turnaround times (TAT).  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Extract, validate, and reconcile data from data warehouses to prepare accurate and timely credit bureau reports in compliance with all regulatory and organizational reporting guidelines  
Manage the end-to-end dispute resolution process for disputes received from Credit Information Companies (CICs), ensuring each dispute is thoroughly investigated and resolved within defined turnaround times (TAT)  
Draft and deliver clear, detailed, and well-documented dispute responses through email and designated dispute management portals  
Monitor and track dispute aging, TAT adherence, and resolution metrics to ensure consistent compliance with service-level agreements (SLAs)  
Handle client communications professionally, including responding to queries, providing status updates, and managing interactions across email and specified portals  
Manage and resolve escalations promptly, coordinating with internal stakeholders to ensure timely and satisfactory outcomes  
Maintain accurate records and documentation for all reporting activities, dispute cases, and client interactions for audit and compliance purposes  
Identify gaps, trends, and patterns in dispute data to recommend process improvements and enhance reporting accuracy  
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on reporting standards, dispute handling procedures, and regulatory updates  
  
A day in the life  
Your day begins with reviewing overnight dispute queues from Credit Information Companies (CICs) and prioritizing cases based on TAT deadlines. You'll extract and validate data from data warehouses to prepare credit bureau reports, ensuring every submission meets regulatory guidelines. Mid-day, you'll draft detailed dispute responses and update case statuses on designated portals. You'll handle client emails, address escalations, and coordinate with internal teams to resolve complex cases. Before wrapping up, you'll track TAT metrics, flag aging disputes, and ensure nothing slips through the cracks — keeping reporting accurate and clients informed every step of the way.  
  
About the team  
The Credit Bureau Reporting Operations team at Amazon is dedicated to ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant credit reporting across all regulatory frameworks. We work at the intersection of data, compliance, and customer trust — managing everything from report generation to end-to-end dispute resolution with Credit Information Companies (CICs). Our team thrives on precision, accountability, and continuous improvement. We collaborate closely with internal stakeholders to uphold the highest standards of data integrity and regulatory compliance. If you're someone who takes ownership, sweats the details, and wants to make a real impact — you'll fit right in.

------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in any field of study
* Experience in written and oral communication, including the ability to communicate with all levels in the organization (technical, business, executive)

* Any data analyis courses

title: Risk Analyst II, Account Integrity
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon's Account Integrity Team (AIT) within Buyer Risk Prevention (BRP) protects hundreds of millions of customers by identifying and stopping fraudulent activity before it causes harm. The Risk Mining function is where human ingenuity meets machine learning - our team detects emerging modus operandi (MOs) that automated systems alone can't catch, and feeds those signals back into scalable upstream defenses. Nowhere is that fight sharper than in Anti-Automation, where we go head-to-head with bots, scripted attacks, and automated abuse that evolves by the hour. If you want to do investigative work that directly translates into customer trust at global scale, this is the role.  
  
The Risk Analyst II (Risk Mining) is a senior individual-contributor role that sits at the intersection of three disciplines - analyst, strategist, and ML partner. You will join the Anti-Automation Risk Mining team in India - a team of analysts, investigators, and builders who hunt down automated abuse before it scales. As the analyst, you run deep dives on bot and scripted-attack behavior and turn raw signal into high-quality MO documentation. As the strategist, you shape where the vertical invests its detection effort and anticipate how the adversary will evolve. As the ML partner, you work hand-in-hand with Machine Learning and Engineering to convert your findings into scalable, automated upstream defenses and close the feedback loop into models and rules.  
  
This is a hands-on, high-ownership role with broad cross-team influence, reporting to Risk Mining leadership. You are accountable for the quality, speed, and impact of your investigations - detecting automated MOs, driving measurable gains in detection speed and precision, mitigating risk, and clearing the blockers that stand between the team and impact. As a senior IC, you are expected to raise the bar for investigation quality across the vertical and influence detection strategy well beyond your own caseload.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
- Lead complex investigations into emerging automated abuse - running deep dives on bots, scripted attacks, and automated MOs before they scale, and setting the quality bar others follow.  
- Own detection and mitigation strategy for the Anti-Automation vertical - prioritizing the highest-risk automated MOs and anticipating how bots and scripted attacks will evolve.  

* Partner deeply with Machine Learning and Engineering teams to turn your findings into scalable, automated upstream defenses, and own the feedback loop back into models and rules.

- Translate investigative signal into ML features, detection logic, and rule improvements - acting as the bridge between front-line investigation and automated defense.  

* Produce high-quality deep dives, MO write-ups, and analyses, and own vertical-level metrics for detection volume, speed, and precision.
* Collaborate with the other Risk Mining verticals and partner teams (Payment Risk, Abuse Risk Mining) on joint investigations and shared signals.
* Serve as a subject-matter expert on high-severity incidents and escalations.
* Champion automation and GenAI opportunities to amplify throughput and quality, and measure the realized ROI from those investments.

  
A day in the life  
No two days look the same when the automated-abuse landscape shifts in real time - your week balances hands-on investigation, strategy, and close ML partnership to keep Anti-Automation ahead of emerging threats:  
  
Analyst (Investigation & Analysis)  

* Running deep dives on the highest-risk automated MOs and following the signal in the noise and take mitigation action.
* Pulling and analyzing large datasets to size impact, confirm hypotheses, and sharpen detection.
* Documenting findings and MO write-ups so they can be turned into durable, scalable defenses.

  
Strategy (Building What's Next)  
- Shaping the detection and mitigation strategy for your slice of Risk Mining - anticipating how automated abuse will evolve and positioning the team to stay ahead.  

* Championing GenAI and automation opportunities as a core part of the vertical's strategy.

  
ML Partnership (Scaling the Defense)  

* Partnering with ML and Engineering to turn your findings into automated defenses that scale.
* Translating investigative signal into features, detection logic, and rule improvements.
* Owning the feedback loop so model and rule performance keeps improving on the MOs you surface.

  
Tactical (Keeping the Engine Running)  

* Reporting detection metrics and progress on key goals.
* Responding to live escalations when a new automated attack surfaces.

  
About the team  
The Risk Mining team within Account Integrity spans India, US, and Costa Rica, and works for Amazon's worldwide marketplace to detect and disrupt bad-actor behavior.  
  
Our mission is simple: find the signal in the noise before bad actors cause harm. We operate across three risk verticals - Anti-Automation, Account Takeover, and Bad Actor Account - and partner closely with Machine Learning, Engineering, and Product teams to turn our investigative findings into scalable upstream defenses. The Anti-Automation vertical sits at the front line of that fight, taking on bots and scripted abuse at the scale.  
  
If you want to do work where your findings directly translate into customer trust at global scale - and where the adversary never stops evolving - this is the team.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience with advanced use of SQL for data mining and business intelligence, or experience with data analytics platforms (Power BI, Python, SQL, Tableau)
* Experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects
* 5+ years of experience in an analytics or data-driven role (e.g. business analyst, risk analyst, data analyst, operations analyst, or research analyst) or similar quantitative/analytical roles across any domain

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of program requirements definition and data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements experience
* Experience handling confidential information
* Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
* Master's degree in Math, Statistics, Computer Science, or related Science field, or experience in data

title: FP&A Manager
description:
Ayr designs and manufactures critical power grid equipment including power transformers, distribution transformers, special-purpose transformers, high-voltage circuit breakers, and medium-voltage switchgear. We serve markets such as renewables, data centers, utilities, oil & gas, and industrial sectors.
  
  
Website: https://ayr.energy
  
  
**Role Summary**
This is a business-first finance role. We are looking for someone who understands how the business makes money, not just how the numbers are reported. You will partner with sales, project and supply chain teams to understand what is driving orders, margins and cash. You will then turn that understanding into budgets, forecasts and recommendations that leadership can act on.
  
  
You should be curious about the business: how a bid becomes an order, how an order becomes a delivery, and how a delivery becomes cash. If you understand that cycle, you will see problems in the numbers before they show up in the P&L.
  
  
****Business Understanding We Expect****

* How the business earns and keeps its margin. This covers sourcing, pricing, freight, duties, FX, warranty and commissioning, and how each affects project profitability.
* The order-to-cash cycle. This runs from tender and bid to contract terms, milestone billing, delivery, retention and collection. You should understand where cash gets stuck and why.
* The market and customers. Utilities, discoms, IPPs and EPC contractors differ in payment behavior, contract structure and risk.
* Cross-border operations. This means the flow between AEI and AEIPL, import and export implications, and currency exposure.
* Commercial risk. This includes guarantees, LDs (liquidated damages), warranties, insurance and counterparty risk, and how they show up in financial outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**
****Budgeting and forecasting****

* Prepare the annual budget and rolling forecasts for AEI and AEIPL.
* Build driver-based models grounded in real business drivers: order book, delivery schedules, vendor lead times, pricing and cost inputs.
* Challenge assumptions with business teams and update forecasts when the ground reality changes.

****Reporting and insight****

* Prepare monthly management reports with variance analysis that explains the business reason behind each variance, not just the number.
* Analyze margins by project, product and customer, including freight, duties, FX and logistics.
* Build MIS dashboards and board and investor reporting packs. Slides should be brief and precise.

****Cash and working capital****

* Prepare 13-week cash flow forecasts and track receivables, payables and inventory.
* Monitor bank guarantee and SBLC utilization, and facility headroom.
* Link cash movement to project milestones and business events.

****Process improvement****

* Automate and standardize recurring reports and models.
* Improve data quality and reporting timelines.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* MBA (Finance), CA (Inter), CA qualified
* 2–3 years in FP&A, business finance or financial planning, with demonstrated partnering with non-finance teams.
* Experience in manufacturing, EPC, power, renewables or other project-based, order-driven businesses is strongly preferred.

**Skills**
****Business and analytical****

* Strong business and commercial acumen. You can explain what is happening in the business and why.
* Sound judgment on what matters. You can separate signal from noise and focus on the few drivers that move margin and cash.
* Ability to read contracts and commercial terms and translate them into financial impact.
* Structured problem solving and a habit of asking “why” behind the numbers.

****Technical****

* Advanced Excel: financial modelling, lookups, pivots, scenario and sensitivity analysis.
* Solid grasp of P&L, balance sheet and cash flow, and how they connect.
* Familiarity with an accounting system (Zoho Books, QuickBooks or similar).
* Working knowledge of cost and margin analysis, working capital and basic FX exposure.
* Exposure to Power BI or similar tools is a plus.

****Behavioral****

* Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain numbers in plain language to non-finance colleagues.
* Confidence to challenge assumptions and hold a view, while staying collaborative.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail and respect for deadlines.
* Comfortable working with US and India teams across time zones.

**What We Offer**

* Direct exposure to leadership and cross-border finance.
* A growing company in the energy infrastructure sector.
* A clear path to Senior FP&A / Business Finance Manager.
* Compensation as per experience and industry standards.

title: SAP CPM-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Consulting – SAP – CPM Functional – Manager:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a skilled SAP Commercial Project Management (CPM) Consultant to support the design, implementation, enhancement, and maintenance of SAP CPM solutions. The role offers a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of large-scale SAP transformation programs while developing expertise at the intersection of finance, strategy, project delivery, and commercial management.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Commercial Project Governance**

* Act as the commercial lead for SAP implementation, support, migration, and transformation programs.
* Establish and maintain commercial governance frameworks across project portfolios.
* Support project leadership in ensuring projects are delivered within approved budgets, schedules, and contractual commitments.
* Drive project profitability while balancing customer satisfaction and delivery objectives.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, financial controls, and regulatory requirements.

**Financial Management & Project Controlling**

* Own project financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting activities.
* Monitor project revenue, costs, gross margins, and cash flow performance.
* Analyze project financial health and proactively identify variances against forecasts.
* Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reviews.
* Drive corrective actions to improve project profitability and financial performance.
* Ensure accurate revenue recognition and project accounting in line with corporate and statutory requirements.

**Contract & Commercial Management**

* Review customer contracts, Statements of Work (SOWs), Master Service Agreements (MSAs), and change requests.
* Ensure contractual obligations, commercial terms, and project assumptions are properly managed.
* Identify contractual risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Lead commercial negotiations related to scope changes, claims management, and contract amendments.
* Support bid reviews and project handovers from sales to delivery teams.

**Risk Management**

* Identify financial, contractual, operational, and compliance risks throughout the project lifecycle.
* Develop risk mitigation plans and track closure of identified risks.
* Monitor project performance indicators and escalate issues proactively.
* Support contingency planning and financial recovery strategies where applicable.

**Portfolio & Business Performance Management**

* Manage commercial oversight for multiple SAP projects and accounts.
* Track portfolio-level financial metrics including revenue, backlog, utilization, margin, and working capital.
* Provide insights and recommendations to improve overall business performance.
* Support leadership with dashboards, KPIs, and executive reporting.

**Change Request and Scope Management**

* Ensure all scope changes are formally assessed and approved.
* Quantify financial and commercial impacts of project changes.
* Collaborate with delivery and customer stakeholders to secure change order approvals.
* Maximize revenue realization through effective scope management.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with Project Managers, Program Managers, Delivery Leads, and Customer Executives.
* Serve as a trusted advisor on commercial and financial matters.
* Communicate project financial performance to senior leadership and stakeholders.
* Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support successful project execution.

**Compliance & Audit Support**

* Ensure compliance with organizational policies and governance requirements.
* Support internal and external audits.
* Maintain project documentation supporting financial and commercial decisions.
* Ensure adherence to revenue recognition, procurement, and financial reporting standards.

**Team Leadership & People Development**

* Mentor and coach junior CPM professionals and project controllers.
* Drive best practices in commercial management across SAP programs.
* Contribute to organizational capability development and process improvements.
* Participate in recruitment, performance management, and career development activities.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 8+ years of experience in project financial management, commercial management, project controlling, or program governance.
* Experience in SAP implementation, ERP transformation, managed services, or consulting environments.
* Strong understanding of project accounting, budgeting, forecasting, and revenue recognition.
* Knowledge of contract management and commercial risk management principles.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. **Role Overview**

We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Tax Associate to join our Hyderabad team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience preparing US federal and state corporate income tax returns, strong analytical skills and a desire to learn. This role will support both US and US/international tax compliance, as well as tax provision analyses, including FIN48 support. Experience with ASC740 tax provision is a strong plus.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare and review US federal and state corporate income tax return workpapers, including analyses, reconciliations and documentation.
* Prepare interim and year-end workbooks (e.g., M-1s, Sec.174, R&D Credit, FA tax depreciation, etc.).

* Collaborate with business partners to gather supporting documentation and respond to inquiries.
* Conduct flux analysis and present findings to stakeholders.

* Monitor legislative updates and regulatory guidance for enacted or pending changes impacting tax compliance.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
* 4+ years of experience in US corporate and state tax return preparation and compliance.
* Strong understanding of US federal and state tax concepts, including book/tax differences, state apportionment, and US/International tax including GILTI, FDII, FTC; able to analyze fluxes and reconcile differences.
* Experience with ASC740 tax provision calculations and reporting is highly desirable.
* Proficiency in tax software (OTP), Excel, and data management tools (PBI, MS List).
* Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

**Why Join Us?**

* Be part of a dynamic global tax team with opportunities for professional growth.
* Work on complex tax compliance and provision projects for a leading multinational organization.
* Collaborate with experienced tax professionals and cross-functional teams.

title: Financial Planning and Analysis Manager
description:
**About the role**

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented
**Manager**
to manage the company's day-to-day finance and accounting operations. The role will be responsible for ensuring accurate financial reporting, timely compliance, effective cash-flow management, strong financial controls, and providing meaningful financial insights to support business decisions.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of accounting principles, taxation, statutory compliance, financial reporting, and preferably experience in managing finance operations in a growing organisation.

**1. Accounting & Financial Reporting**

* Oversee day-to-day accounting operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger and reconciliations.
* Ensure accurate and timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing.
* Prepare and review Profit & Loss statements, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow statements and other financial reports.
* Ensure accounting records are accurate, complete, and maintained in accordance with applicable accounting standards.
* Review and reconcile bank, vendor, customer and other balance sheet accounts.

**2. Financial Planning & Analysis**

* Prepare budgets, forecasts and periodic financial projections.
* Track actual performance against budgets and provide variance analysis.
* Prepare management reports and dashboards highlighting key financial trends and business performance.
* Provide financial insights to management to support business and operational decisions.
* Identify areas for cost optimisation and improved financial efficiency.

**3. Cash Flow & Working Capital Management**

* Monitor daily/weekly cash flow and ensure adequate liquidity.
* Manage receivables and payables to optimise working capital.
* Track outstanding customer receivables and coordinate with relevant teams for timely collections.
* Review payment schedules and ensure timely vendor payments.
* Support management in cash-flow planning and forecasting.

**4. Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure timely compliance with applicable GST, TDS, income tax and other statutory requirements.
* Coordinate with external consultants, auditors and tax advisors wherever required.
* Review statutory filings and ensure accuracy of supporting documentation.
* Stay updated on relevant changes in accounting, taxation and regulatory requirements.

**5. Audit & Internal Controls**

* Coordinate internal and statutory audits and ensure timely closure of audit requirements.
* Prepare schedules, reconciliations and supporting documents required for audits.
* Establish and maintain appropriate financial controls and approval processes.
* Identify financial and operational risks and recommend corrective measures.
* Ensure adherence to company finance policies and procedures.

**6. Business Finance Support**

* Work closely with HR, Sales, Operations and other business teams on finance-related matters.
* Review commercial proposals, contracts and business transactions from a financial perspective.
* Support management in evaluating costs, profitability and financial implications of business decisions.
* Provide timely financial information and analysis to senior management.

**7. Team Management**

* Manage and mentor the finance and accounts team.
* Allocate responsibilities and ensure timely completion of finance activities.
* Review the team's work for accuracy and compliance.
* Build efficient processes and improve finance operations through automation and standardisation.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting or a related field.
* CA / CMA / MBA Finance qualification will be an added advantage.
* 6–10 years of relevant experience in Finance & Accounts.
* Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial reporting.
* Good understanding of GST, TDS, income tax and statutory compliance.
* Experience with accounting/ERP systems such as Tally, SAP, Oracle, Zoho, Keka or similar platforms.
* Strong proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets.
* Experience in budgeting, forecasting, cash-flow management and MIS reporting.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and ability to work with deadlines.
* Good communication and stakeholder-management skills.

title: Lead Analyst
description:
**Role Purpose**

Plan the right workforce, at the right place and time, at the right cost. The role owns end-to-end resource planning and analytics for operational workforce, turning data into clear, decision-ready insights for leadership. As an individual contributor, the role combines deep planning expertise with hands-on use of Python, SQL and Power BI to build models, automate reporting and solve business problems.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Advanced Excel, SQL, Python and Power BI.
* Forecasting, statistics and scenario modelling.
* Strong analytical thinking and practical problem solving.
* Create SOPs for planning processes and BRDs for automation and system requirements
* Independent ownership, stakeholder management and clear communication.

**Qualification & Experience**

* Graduate in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, Operations Research or Data Science; post-graduation/MBA preferred.
* 3-8 years of experience, including 1-2 years in resource planning, workforce management(preferred) or capacity planning.
* Airline, aviation, logistics or other 24x7 operations experience preferred.

Key Responsibilities

1. Resource Planning, Forecasting & Analytics

* Own and validate planning assumptions, including productivity, attrition, leave, training, and fleet plan.
* Deliver short-, medium- and long-term workforce requirements aligned to the fleet and network plan.
* Monitor capacity and highlight gaps early and recommend workforce actions.
* Review plan versus actuals, explain variances and refine assumptions.
* Build analytical and simulation models to evaluate operational scenarios, cost-benefit trade-offs and improvement opportunities.
* Define and validate data requirements, analyse operational trends and recommend the best operational and financial outcome.
* Document assumptions, methodology and changes to maintain transparency and governance.

2. Technology & Automation

* Use Excel, SQL, Python and Power BI to analyse data, build dashboards and automate recurring processes.
* Improve data quality, planning accuracy and reporting turnaround time.

3. Stakeholder & Decision Support

* Partners with Operations, HR, Finance and other teams to align assumptions and planning requirements.
* Present complex analysis as simple, leadership-ready recommendations and support implementation.

title: Analyst/Senior Analyst - P&L Reporting
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
The D. E. Shaw group uses a combination of quantitative and qualitative tools to uncover self-governing, hard-to-find sources of return across global public and private markets. We are seeking an analyst/Senior Analyst to join our P&L Reporting team at the firm’s office based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram, India which is responsible for producing firm-wide reports that provide insights and analyses into key performance indicators— including profit and loss (P&L), expenses, capital, returns, and fees— for the offices of the Chief Operating Officer (COO), Chief Financial Officer (CFO), business unit (BU) heads, and portfolio managers. The group handles ad hoc requests related to P&L and capital from portfolio managers and senior stakeholders, facilitating effective decision making through clear reporting, analyses, and recommendations. Another key responsibility is driving technology initiatives—leveraging a combination of proprietary and third-party tools to prepare and present reports, streamline workflows, improve process controls, and enhance user experience.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
You will take end-to-end ownership of the team’s recurring P&L reporting suite — across daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and year-end cycles — ensuring every report on P&L, expenses, capital, returns & fees is accurate, timely and complete. You will also coordinate with various teams including Front Office, Risk, Pricing, and other teams in FinOp to ensure accuracy of data while managing recurring workflows to sync, reconcile and allocate P&L, expenses and capital. Additionally, you will act as the domain expert and “human in the loop” for automated recurring workflows — running, validating and troubleshooting outputs (including those produced with GenAI) and owning the controls that keep reporting accurate. You will also respond to P&L and capital-related ad-hoc requests from portfolio managers and senior stakeholders. Finally, you will understand changes in the firm’s businesses, like new products and fund launches, and incorporate these changes into the recurring reports independently.
  
  
**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**
Basic Qualifications:
  
  

* Finance domain knowledge, robust analytical and problem-solving skills, someone who is a quick learner and can excel while working under tight deadlines
* The ability to be self-motivated, exhibit keen attention to detail, and have a high sense of ownership with an attitude to take initiative in driving process enhancements
* 1 to 3 years of relevant experience in P&L / management reporting, fund accounting, financial planning & analysis (FP&A), or a related finance function
* Working knowledge of how hedge funds operate and their revenue model (fees and expenses), along with core financial concepts — instruments, ratios, accounting terms and statements
* Robust data and analytical skills — advanced MS Excel
* Comfort working alongside automation and GenAI tools — able to run, validate and critically evaluate their output as the domain expert, with a solid controls and process-improvement mindset
* Learning agility and adaptability to evolving workflows, tools, and business changes
* Excellent written and oral communication skills along with deft interpersonal skills are essential for managing interactions with senior stakeholders and ability to collaborate with multiple groups

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* A CA / MBA degree from a reputed college with 1 to 3 years of work experience in the Financial Services industry
* A Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) / Financial Risk Manager (FRM) Qualification
* Exposure to SQL, Python, or BI / analytics tools

title: Senior Manager Corporate Finance
description:
Senior Manager – Business Finance

Team: Corporate Finance

Location: Noida

Experience: 2–4 years

Education: B.Tech / B.E. or quantitative degree from a Tier-1 institute (preferred)

About the role

You will sit where finance meets data: you'll turn large operational datasets into P&L decisions on cost (cost per kg, fleet mix, vendor share), revenue (account and segment profitability) and reporting. You will build the analysis, then automate it so it runs without you.

What you'll do

• Cost and margin analytics: Break down unit economics (cost/kg, cost/shipment, load factor, vehicle utilisation) by facility, lane and vendor type, and separate the levers you can act on from mix effects and noise.

• Revenue and profitability: Support account-level gross margin actioning, segment P&L, and pricing and revenue-leakage reviews.

• SQL at scale: Write and optimise Trino/Presto queries on high-volume shipment, billing and fleet tables, and reconcile the outputs against finance books.

• Python automation: Turn recurring analyses into scripts (pandas, openpyxl) that produce stakeholder-ready Excel and Word outputs, including files too large for Excel.

• Dashboards and mailers: Build QuickSight dashboards and Google Sheets/Apps Script automations, such as scheduled flash mailers to regional and ops teams.

• Variance and scenarios: Build MoM/WoW variance bridges and split movements into volume, rate and mix. Model scenarios such as EV adoption and fleet right-sizing.

• Storytelling: Turn the numbers into crisp, deck-ready commentary for leadership: lead with the "so what" and back it with the number.

• Execution: Coordinate inputs across Ops, Product, BD and Finance, track initiatives to closure, and own data quality end to end.

Must-haves

• Strong academic pedigree: B.Tech/B.E. or a quantitative degree from a Tier-1 institute (IITs, NITs, BITS, IIITs, DCE/NSUT, ISI, SRCC/St. Stephen's Economics or equivalent). An MBA from IIM/ISB/XLRI/FMS is a plus.

• 2–4 years in analytics, strategy, consulting, FP&A or a data role. Experience at a top analytics firm or high-growth consumer/logistics tech company is preferred.

• Strong SQL (joins, window functions, CTEs, performance on large tables). This is non-negotiable.

• Working Python (pandas): you have automated something real, not just done coursework.

• Advanced Excel: financial modelling, pivots, lookups and clean model structure.

• Sharp business logic: you can explain why a metric moved, not just that it moved.

• You reconcile numbers obsessively and catch data errors before they reach a stakeholder.

Good to have

• QuickSight, Tableau or Power BI; Google Apps Script

• Exposure to logistics, supply chain or other unit-economics-driven businesses

• Finance basics: P&L structure, gross margin, revenue recognition (IndAS 115 a plus)

• Comfort using AI tools (Claude, Copilot) to speed up coding and analysis
