At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future - we're creating it.
  
  
**To be successful in this role, you should have below skills:**

* Data & Record Governance Framework : Strong command of records and information governance frameworks, including ISO 15489 and ARMA's Generally Accepted Record Keeping Principles (GARP), with experience designing and operating an Information Governance Reference Model.
* Regulatory Knowledge spanning UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act, FCA/PRA record-keeping Requirements(Including SYSC), MIFID II Retention Rules, AML and BASEL- related retention obligations and/or SOX.
* Proficiency in building and maintaining enterprise retention schedules.
* Working knowledge of Enterprise Records Management platforms such as OpenText, Iron Mountain and SharePoint/Microsoft 365 records management, at a leadership or hands-on level.
* Experience designing and executing eDiscovery and litigation hold process.
* Demonstrated capability leading paper-to-digital migration, cloud records repository implementation, and automated disposition or legal hold workflow design.
* Sound understanding of risk and controls methodology, including Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) practices, audit remediation, and first/second-line-of-defense operating models.
* Familiarity with how records management intersects with data management and data privacy.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include Below**

* 12+ years of progressive experience in records management, information governance, or a related risk/compliance discipline, including a minimum 5 years in a senior leadership role.
* A demonstrated track record of building and running an enterprise-wide records management function within a regulated financial institution - bank, insurer, or comparable organization.
* Experience leading large, geographically distributed or matrixed teams, including onshore/offshore delivery models typical of banking operations.
* Direct Experience managing regulatory examinations and audits related to records management with a credible history of remediation delivery.
* Accountability for budget ownership and vendor management, including physical storage contacts and ECM licensing arrangements.
* A strong background in change management, experience engaging and infulencing senior stakeholders, up to and including Executive Committee and Board Risk Committee Level.
* A Strategic Mindset, with experience owning and delivering a multi-year target operating roadmap for a governance or compliance function.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based in Pune office.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To develop, implement, and maintain effective governance frameworks for all data and records across the bank's global operations.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and maintenance of a comprehensive data and records governance framework aligned with regulatory requirements and industry standards.
* Monitoring data quality and records metrics and compliance with standards across the organization.
* Identification and addressing of data and records management risks and gaps.
* Development and implementation of a records management programme that ensures the proper identification, classification, storage, retention, retrieval and disposal of records.
* Development and implementation of a data governance strategy that aligns with the bank's overall data management strategy and business objectives.
* Provision of Group wide guidance and training on Data and Records Management standard requirements.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: AVP Risk & Assurance
company: Intellectual Capital HR Consulting Pvt. Ltd.
description:
Associate Vice President – Assurance

**Location:**
Pune

**Function:**
Assurance & Risk

**Experience:**
12+ years post-qualification

**Qualification:**
Chartered Accountant (CA)

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced
**Associate Vice President – Assurance**
to strengthen the effectiveness of Internal Audit and Assurance functions across business entities. The role will focus on enhancing internal controls, governance, risk management and regulatory compliance while providing independent advisory inputs to senior management.

The position will work closely with Internal Audit leadership and senior stakeholders to assess audit effectiveness, identify emerging risks, strengthen audit methodologies and drive implementation of best practices.

Key Responsibilities

Internal Audit & Assurance

* Provide independent advisory and assessment support on Internal Audit and Assurance matters.
* Review Internal Audit reports at various stages and discuss significant findings with relevant stakeholders.
* Follow up on resolution of critical audit observations and assess whether appropriate root-cause remediation has been undertaken.
* Evaluate the effectiveness and maturity of Internal Audit functions and recommend improvements.
* Review Internal Audit scope and coverage to ensure adequate focus on high-risk, material and emerging risk areas.
* Assess audit methodologies, audit frequency and overall effectiveness of audit execution.
* Review audit reports to ensure they clearly articulate issues, root causes, potential impact, risks and actionable recommendations.
* Ensure Internal Audits are conducted in accordance with applicable standards, recognized audit methodologies and sound professional judgment.
* Provide guidance on thematic and horizontal audits covering key focus areas and emerging risks.
* Support continuous enhancement of Internal Audit methodologies, frameworks, tools and templates.

Risk, Governance & Compliance

* Advise on appropriate implementation of Accounting Standards and compliance with applicable laws and regulations.
* Support strengthening of internal controls, governance and compliance frameworks.
* Stay updated on regulatory developments, industry trends and significant risks relevant from an audit and assurance perspective.
* Identify areas requiring greater management attention across business entities.
* Promote a strong governance, risk and control culture through audit insights, thematic observations and knowledge sharing.

Strategic Projects & Advisory

* Support senior Assurance & Risk leadership on strategic projects, including:
* Valuation-related assignments
* Business restructuring strategies
* Evaluation of business proposals
* Policy reviews and inputs
* Other risk and assurance-related initiatives
* Lead initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and business functions.
* Develop a strong understanding of business challenges, opportunities and emerging threats.
* Provide independent advisory inputs to improve the quality, consistency and effectiveness of assurance practices.
* Prepare clear, concise and impactful reports and presentations for senior management and governance forums.

Stakeholder Management

* Work closely with Internal Audit Heads and senior stakeholders across business entities.
* Coordinate with multiple functions depending on emerging risk themes and horizontal audit requirements.
* Manage ambiguity and independently determine appropriate approaches for audit and assurance assignments.
* Build effective relationships with stakeholders across functions and businesses.
* Engage with professionals from Assurance, Internal Audit, Risk, Accounting and related disciplines.

Key Decision-Making Responsibilities

* Identify appropriate methodologies and approaches for executing assurance assignments.
* Determine areas requiring greater focus across business entities.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and resolve ambiguity during assignments.
* Escalate significant findings, risks, challenges and delays to senior leadership along with recommendations.

Key Challenges

* Working across multiple business entities, functions and stakeholder groups.
* Operating within a fast-paced environment requiring a short learning curve.
* Managing a diverse and evolving scope of assignments.
* Seamlessly transitioning between strategic, assurance, risk and advisory projects.
* Managing multiple priorities while maintaining quality and professional judgment.

Qualifications & Experience

* **Chartered Accountant (CA) – Mandatory.**
* **12+ years of post-qualification experience.**
* Strong experience in
  **Internal Audit, Risk, Assurance or related functions**
  .
* Experience within the
  **BFSI / Financial Services sector**
  is mandatory.
* Strong understanding of Internal Audit, Risk Management and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Certification in Internal Audit would be an added advantage.

Functional & Behavioural Competencies

* Strong knowledge of Internal Audit and Assurance frameworks.
* Understanding of risk management and regulatory requirements.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder and relationship management skills.
* Strong people management and project management capabilities.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple assignments.
* Strong communication, report writing and presentation skills.
* Ability to operate effectively in a complex, multi-stakeholder environment.
* Strong professional judgment and ability to challenge constructively.

Role Scope

* **Location:**
  Pune
* **Financial Responsibility:**
  No direct financial targets.
* **Nature of Role:**
  Strategic Assurance, Internal Audit, Risk, Governance & Advisory.

title: Tax Senior -Tax - LBS - Legal Entity Management (LEM)- Hyderabad/Pune
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Tax Senior,**
**Legal Entity Management (LEM) Legal Business Services**
Multinational organizations need professionals who can support legal business services across the full lifecycle of process, compliance, and regulatory matters. Deloitte Legal Business Services (LBS) helps clients manage business-as-usual requirements as well as event-driven and regulatory changes. Join Deloitte to support complex legal entity management work for large, multinational organizations while delivering high-quality service in a collaborative, global environment.
  
  
Deloitte Tax in India and its affiliates in the United States and India do not practice law or provide legal advice.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior - Legal Entity Management on the Legal Business Services team, you will be responsible for supporting legal entity management and corporate secretarial services for large and complex organizations.
  
  

* Support the formation, maintenance, dissolution, and ongoing compliance of legal entities, including annual meetings, appointment of directors and officers, powers of attorney, written consents, annual reports, and document preparation.
* Review governance structures, corporate changes, legal entity simplification activities, and event-driven changes across the lifecycle of legal entities.
* Maintain legal entity data and compliance workflows using platforms such as HighQ, Diligent Entities, and Athennian, including entity profiles, ownership structures, compliance calendars, and stakeholder reporting.
* Support Board of Directors’ and stockholders’ meeting planning and documentation, including corporate records, minute books, board resolutions, and public notary coordination.
* Assist with engagement delivery activities, including document collection, data entry, tracking, document review, proposal support, research, and identification of process improvement opportunities within Legal Entity Management engagements.

**The team**
Legal Business Services is a service line within Deloitte Tax in India that works closely with other Deloitte businesses, including Deloitte Advisory and Deloitte Consulting. The team supports multinational organizations with day-to-day and event-driven legal business services needs across a multidisciplinary environment. Deloitte brings global perspective, market knowledge, and experience helping clients navigate complex cross-border issues.
  
  
**Location: Hyderabad or Pune**
**Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM IST**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Company Secretary qualification
* 5-8 years of experience in legal entity management, corporate secretarial services, or alternative legal services
* Experience supporting legal entity formation, maintenance, dissolution, and annual compliance activities
* Experience reviewing governance structures, corporate changes, and legal entity lifecycle events
* Experience using legal entity management platforms such as HighQ, Diligent Entities, or Athennian
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, Power BI, and Tableau
* Familiarity with commercial agreements such as non-disclosure agreements, statements of work, and master service agreements

Preferred:
  
  

* Bachelor of Laws (LLB)
* Experience supporting United States legal entity management services
* Experience preparing materials for Board of Directors’ and stockholders’ meetings
* Experience with corporate records management, including minute books and board resolutions
* Experience supporting process improvement or technology-enabled service delivery
* Project Management Professional (PMP), Lean Six Sigma, or similar accreditation

**Senior Consultant – Tax Technology Consulting – Contract Lifecycle Management**
The role of technology in legal functions is growing exponentially and allowing legal departments to transform how they improve their processes, increase efficiencies and transform the future of legal services delivery. If you are someone who thrives in navigating the growing legal transformation through a technology lens and partnering with passionate professionals to help companies achieve their objectives; then we would like to get to know you.
  
  
If the answer to all of the above is “Yes,” come join Tax Management Consulting group in Deloitte India (Offices of the U.S), a service line of Deloitte Tax LLP!
  
  
Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all of the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn U.S. taxation, a much sought-after career option.

We offer a broad range of fully integrated services and add greater impact to clients by combining technology and contract management technical resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.

As a professional in Deloitte’s Tax Management Consulting (TMC) team, you will be a part of a team that provides an integrated approach to technology implementations, automation, , data wrangling and document extraction and data management and analytics that help legal departments maximize the strategic value to the organization. You will deliver services for companies that streamline their process and increase efficiency; leveraging numerous applications.

Configure contract management technologies based on requirements documented by the TMC client facing team.
  
  
Conduct user acceptance testing to compile comprehensive test scenarios and identify flaws as well as improvements to newly built systems and processes
  
  
Gather and document contract management requirements for business and performing system fit and gap analysis

3+ to 15+ years of total experience.
  
  
3+ - 10 years of Implementation experience in Sirion and/or Icertis CLM applications and other related or similar technologies.
  
  

* Expert in CLM configuration with template rationalization and harmonization, guide or playbook creation and the design of the contracting processes and related functionality

Multiple successful project implementation experience in, Sirion or Icertis or other CLM applications.
  
  
Strong in project management, leadership abilities, and has tendency to independently execute project cycles and deliverables.
  
  
Relentless focus on quality of work products while adhering to completing deliverables on time
  
  
Effective communications and strong presentation and team building skills. Proactive, participates in firm-based activities, and owns his/her career.

Team Management experience (For Senior Professionals)
  
  
**Preferred Skills:**

* Certifications with any of the tools mentioned, as well as PMP or PMI-ACP, and/or Scrum Master
* Experience with document extraction tools, data wrangling tools such as Alteryx, and visualization/BI tools such as PowerBI, Tableau or QlikView and others

title: Vendor Management Lead, VP
description:
**Position Overview**
**Job Title- Vendor Management Lead, Vice President**
**Location- Pune, India**
**Role Description**

* Within IVMO, the Vendor Management Lead acts as the single point of accountability, ensuring that contractual, commercial, and risk outcomes are effectively managed so that vendor relationships deliver sustained value, compliant service performance, and robust risk mitigation across the contract lifecycle.
* The Vendor Management Lead is the subject matter expert for the management of DB’s most strategic vendors and contracts post-signature, leading cross functional stakeholder engagement, managing business demand and proactively identifying and resolving contractual, vendor performance, and risk issues.
* The role may manage a portfolio of contracts and vendors relating to specific business programmes within a larger divisional portfolio and may have people management responsibilities.

**Global Procurement And Vendor Management (GPVM) Overview**
The Global Procurement and Vendor Management function enables Deutsche Bank (DB) to optimize supplier relationships to meet its strategic objectives by:
  
  

* Partnering across DB to develop commercial strategies and create value from supplier relationships.
* Enabling the bank to manage Third-Party risks and purchase efficiently and compliantly.
* Managing sourcing demands and vendor performance on a divisional level.
* Implementing and upholding sustainable procurement practices.
* Driving transformation and ensuring future-proof procurement technology, data and processes.
* Within GPVM, the Infrastructure Vendor Management Office (IVMO) is responsible for the end-to-end management of vendors across all Infrastructure and TDI divisions to improve performance, mitigate risk, optimise costs and maximise commercial value.

**What We’ll Offer You**
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy
  
  

* Best in class leave policy
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
* Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Business Partnering**

* Lead contact for business engagement related to portfolio of contracts/vendors under management and act as interface to GPVM for queries from the business.
* Work with business to understand strategy and engage relevant stakeholder functions such as Strategic Procurement to support the build of required vendor eco-system.
* Build divisional third-party strategy and where applicable, supplier strategies, to support delivery of the business strategy.
* Manage and process sourcing requests in line with policy and the divisional third-party strategy.
* Provide reporting and insights across the vendor engagements and across the elements of vendor management.

**Vendor Governance & Performance**

* Act as the primary point of accountability for vendor governance, coordinating structured engagements with vendors and internal stakeholders to ensure alignment, transparency, and timely decision making.
* Maintain end-to-end visibility of all contracts in scope, ensuring a holistic overview of vendor performance and delivery and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement/innovation.
* Lead regular vendor governance and performance reviews, leveraging defined KPIs, SLAs, and ESG scoring to assess delivery quality, risk exposure, and value realization.

**Commercial Contract Management**

* Own and oversee contractual compliance by DB and third-party vendors, ensuring obligations are continuously monitored, documented, and enforced throughout the contract lifecycle.
* Draft, negotiate and manage contractual changes and terminations for in-scope agreements in a structured and timely manner, ensuring continuity of service and protection of DB’s commercial and legal interests.
* Manage contractual issues and contractual disputes, leading negotiations with counterparties and engaging with the relevant DB functions such as Legal and Strategic Procurement to resolve, minimizing financial, operational, and reputational risk for DB.
* Conduct periodic contract and commercial reviews to confirm that vendor delivery remains aligned with agreed commercial terms, business demand, and the approved sourcing strategy.

**Risk Management & Compliance**

* Lead the remediation of in-scope supplier related audit findings and resolution of in-scope third-party risk issues where applicable.
* Ensure that applicable third-party risk, compliance, and ESG requirements are embedded into contractual documentation and reflected in ongoing governance and monitoring activities.
* Drive proactive remediation, corrective action plans, and consequence management in response to contractual, performance, risk, or ESG noncompliance, ensuring issues are addressed at root cause level.
* Provide visibility and reporting of risk management activity.

**Your Skills And Experience**

* Experience in Financial Services or a large corporate environment with an in-depth understanding of vendor management across the entire vendor lifecycle
* 8+ years of experience in vendor management with strong demonstrable skills and understanding across contract and commercial management, issue and dispute management, risk management, service performance management, supplier governance, vendor strategy
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills with the ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments
* Strong commercial awareness and understanding of different types of commercial models and how to implement and manage against them
* Strong financial acumen and understanding of business cases
* Ability to negotiate and draft commercial and contract terms and changes to those terms on Statements of Work essential
* Knowledge and exposure of sourcing process, RFI, RFP and contract lifecycle
* Strong analytical skills to analyse trends, data, spend and measure and drive improved vendor performance (SLAs, KPIs, KRIs) and internal business discipline
* Strategic overview/mindset and ability to shape business thinking
* Ability to deliver strategy
* Demonstrable experience of ability to leverage data to deliver reporting and insights to inform business decisions
* Experience in driving continuous improvement /innovation
* Legal understanding preferred
* Project management understanding preferred
* Supplier Relationship Management skills and experience or understanding an advantage
* People management experience an advantage
* Business Fluency in English required
* Capacity to effectively operate in ambiguous situations.
* Demonstrates initiative and works effectively with minimal supervision
* Experience of using Digital Procurement tools such as SAP Ariba, Coupa and digital contract workplaces
* Significant experience working with technology vendors and technology contracts is essential

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**
**How We’ll Support You**

* Training and development to help you excel in your career
* Coaching and support from experts in your team
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

Please visit our company website for further information:
  
  
https://www.db.com/company/company.html

title: Senior Legal Manager
description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager with 12–15 years of post-qualification experience (PQE) and a strong background in the Freight Forwarding / Shipping industry. The role will provide comprehensive legal support across commercial contracts, claims, litigation, compliance, risk management, and business operations, while partnering with regional business teams to provide practical and commercially sound legal solutions.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Draft, review, negotiate, and provide legal support for customer agreements, supplier agreements, commercial contracts, and other business documents.
* Partner with business teams and regional stakeholders to negotiate contractual terms in line with company and group policies.
* Identify, assess, and proactively manage legal and commercial risks, providing practical mitigation advice.
* Drive legal and risk awareness across business units and senior management.
* Provide legal support to Compliance, Data Protection, Internal Controls, Finance, Operations, IT, and other functions.
* Support development, implementation, and monitoring of internal governance policies and compliance requirements.
* Manage claims, contentious disputes, litigation, arbitration, and insurance-related matters.
* Coordinate with external advocates, legal counsel, insurance companies, and other external stakeholders.
* Monitor changes in laws and regulations and assess their impact on business operations.
* Provide advice on labour, operations, licensing, IT, finance, international trade, and other legal matters.
* Support new business models, projects, strategic initiatives, and business growth from a legal and risk perspective.
* Support other Legal Counsel and regional legal activities as required.

**Mandatory Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Law.
* Experience: 12–15 years
* Mandatory experience in Freight Forwarding / Shipping; international trade, supply chain, or related logistics legal experience preferred.
* Strong background in commercial contracts, claims, litigation, arbitration, insurance, and international trade law.
* Experience independently conducting contract reviews and negotiating directly with customers/business stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of legal risk management, compliance, and corporate governance.
* Excellent spoken and written English.
* Strong negotiation, litigation, communication, and relationship-management capabilities.
* Proficient in MS Office – Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision as well as effectively within a regional/multicultural team.

title: Nodal Officer - Law Enforcement Agency (LEA)
description: JOB REQUISITION: NODAL OFFICER - LAW ENFORCEMENT AGENCY (LEA)The Nodal Officer (LEA) will serve as the primary liaison between the company and Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs), including I4C, NPCI, and MHA. title: Responsible AI & Governance
description:
Role Overview

The Office of Responsible AI within Digital Foundation Services is looking for a practitioner who can hold both halves of the job at once: the engineering depth to take an agentic AI system apart and see how it actually behaves, and the governance fluency to judge whether it should be allowed to run. This is not a policy-only role, and it is not a pure engineering role. The person we are looking for reviews architectures, reads evaluation results, challenges design choices, and then turns those findings into control decisions that clients, delivery teams and regulators can rely on.

The role works across delivery teams shipping agentic and generative AI into production for enterprise customers. Day to day the work spans risk assessment of new AI use cases, hands-on review of model and retrieval pipelines, definition of guardrails and evaluation criteria, and enablement of engineering teams so that responsible AI practice is built in rather than inspected in at the end.

Key Responsibilities

Governance and assurance

* Run intake and risk classification for new AI and agentic use cases, applying an agreed risk-tiering method and recording the rationale, so decisions remain auditable.
* Own the responsible AI control framework — policies, standards, checklists and approval gates — and keep it aligned to EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001 expectations.
* Chair or support the AI review board: prepare evidence packs, present findings, and track conditions of approval through closure.
* Maintain the AI inventory and model registry, covering ownership, data lineage, intended use and residual risk for every deployed system.
* Produce audit-ready documentation: model cards, system cards, data sheets, impact assessments, and evaluation reports.

Technical assurance of AI systems

* Review agentic architectures end to end: tool and function calling, planning loops, memory, autonomy boundaries, human-in-the-loop checkpoints and failure containment.
* Assess retrieval-augmented generation pipelines for grounding quality, chunking and embedding choices, retrieval relevance, citation fidelity and leakage of restricted content.
* Evaluate fine-tuned and adapted models for fitness of purpose, drift, catastrophic forgetting, and the provenance and licensing of training data.
* Design and oversee evaluation of harnesses covering accuracy, robustness, bias, toxicity, prompt injection, jailbreak resistance and data exfiltration.
* Define guardrail patterns — input and output filtering, policy engines, tool sandboxing, scope and rate limits — and validate that they hold under adversarial testing.

Enablement and advisory

* Advise solution architects and delivery lead at design time, so controls are chosen early rather than retrofitted late.
* Build and run enablement material: playbooks, reference patterns, training and office hours for the engineering and delivery communities.
* Act as escalation point for AI incidents, running root-cause analysis and feeding lessons back into the control framework.
* Support client conversations and bid responses where responsible AI posture is a differentiator or a contractual requirement.

Technical Skills Required

Agentic AI frameworks and tooling

* Working knowledge of at least two agentic frameworks — LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel or the OpenAI Agents SDK — including their orchestration and state models.
* Familiarity with agent interoperability and tool-integration standards, including Model Context Protocol and comparable function-calling interfaces.
* Practical experience with multi-agent patterns such as planner-executor, supervisor-worker and reflection loops, and with the failure modes each introduces.
* Ability to read production agent code and execution traces, and to instrument systems with observability tooling such as LangSmith, Langfuse or OpenTelemetry.

Models, fine-tuning and RAG

* Solid grounding in transformer architectures, tokenization, context windows, decoding parameters and the practical limits of current frontier and open-weight models.
* Hands-on understanding of adaptation techniques — prompt engineering, instruction tuning, LoRA and QLoRA, full fine-tuning, RLHF and preference optimization — and when each is appropriate.
* Experience building or reviewing RAG systems: embedding models, vector stores such as FAISS, Azure AI Search, Pinecone or pgvector, hybrid and re-ranked retrieval, and evaluation of grounding quality.
* Comfort with evaluation tooling and benchmarks, including LLM-as-judge techniques and a clear view of their known weaknesses.
* Awareness of cost, latency and sustainability trade-offs across hosted and self-hosted deployment options.

Engineering foundations

* Python at a level sufficient to prototype, read production code and build evaluation scripts.
* Familiarity with at least one major cloud AI platform — Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI — and its native governance and content-safety controls.
* Understanding of MLOps and LLMOps practice: CI/CD, versioning, monitoring, rollback and change control for models and prompts.
* Working knowledge of security and privacy fundamentals as they apply to AI: identity, secrets, data classification, anonymization and residency.

AI Governance and Responsible AI Expertise

* Practical command of the EU AI Act, including risk tiering, general-purpose AI obligations and conformity expectations, with the ability to translate them into engineering controls.
* Familiarity with NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 and ISO/IEC 23894, and experience operationalizing at least one of them.
* Understanding of sector regulation relevant to financial services and other regulated industries, including model risk management expectations such as SR 11-7.
* Knowledge of data protection regimes such as GDPR and the DPDP Act, and how they interact with training data, inference logs and cross-border transfer.
* Fluency in fairness, explainability, transparency and accountability techniques, with the judgement to select the right one rather than defaulting to a favorite.
* Experience running AI impact assessments and third-party or vendor AI risk reviews.
* Awareness of emerging assurance practice: red teaming, model evaluation standards, content provenance and watermarking.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies

This role only works if the person can carry a technical argument into a business room and be believed in both. The behaviours below carry as much weight in selection as the technical depth above.

* Influence without authority. Much of the job is persuading teams that do not report to you to change a design, which takes credibility, patience and a workable alternative rather than a veto.
* Clear communication across levels. The same finding must be expressed as an engineering ticket, a client-facing paragraph and a board-level risk statement without losing accuracy at any step.
* Constructive challenge. Comfortable saying no to a senior stakeholder, and equally comfortable saying yes quickly when the risk is genuinely low; proportionality matters more than caution.
* Judgement under ambiguity. Regulation, tooling and model behaviour are all moving. Strong candidates make defensible decisions on incomplete information and revisit them as evidence changes.
* Intellectual honesty. Willing to state the limits of an evaluation, flag their own uncertainty, and correct a published position when new evidence arrives.
* Cross-functional collaboration. Works naturally with legal, privacy, security, procurement, HR and delivery, and can translate between their vocabularies.
* Ethical grounding and empathy. Genuinely considers the people affected by an AI system, including those who are not the paying customer.
* Pragmatism and delivery focus. Understands commercial pressure and designs controls teams can actually adopt, rather than an ideal framework nobody follows.
* Facilitation and coaching. Runs review boards, workshops and enablement sessions that leave people clearer than they arrived.
* Continuous learning. Keeps current with research, incidents and regulatory movement, and shares that knowledge rather than hoarding it.

Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, data science, engineering or a related quantitative discipline; a law, policy or ethics background combined with demonstrable technical depth will also be considered.
* Eight to twelve years of overall technology experience, including at least three years working directly on machine learning or generative AI systems.
* At least two years in an AI governance, model risk, AI assurance or responsible AI capacity, or equivalent evidence of leading such work from inside an engineering team.
* Demonstrable experience taking at least one generative or agentic AI system from design through to governed production deployment.
* Client-facing or consulting experience is an advantage, given the role's exposure to customer, audit and regulator conversations.

Preferred Certifications and Credentials

* IAPP AI Governance Professional (AIGP).
* ISO/IEC 42001 lead implementer or lead auditor.
* A cloud AI engineering certification such as Azure AI Engineer Associate, AWS Machine Learning Specialty or Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer.
* Security or privacy credentials such as CISSP, CIPP/E or CIPM.
* Published work, open-source contributions or conference talks on responsible AI, model evaluation or agent safety.

What Success Looks Like in the First Year

* Every in-flight AI and agentic use case is classified, inventoried and mapped to a control set with a named owner.
* A documented, repeatable review gate exists and is used by delivery teams without escalation in the majority of cases.
* Evaluation and red-teaming harnesses run automatically against production agent workloads, with results visible to engineering leadership.
* Delivery teams arrive at the review board with evidence already prepared, because the enablement material made the expectations obvious.

title: Manager - TDD & Documentation
description:
Job Description

**Job Description: Manager, Title Due Diligence**

**Company:** Arvind SmartSpaces Ltd (Real Estate, Lalbhai Group)
  
**Function:** Legal
  
**Location:** Ahmedabad
  
**Reports to:** AGM, Title Due Diligence / Head Legal
  
**Experience:** 8-12 years

**Role Purpose**

To manage title due diligence for land and project acquisitions, ensuring that each parcel has a clean, marketable and developable title. The role provides practical risk assessments and mitigation plans to Business Development, Projects, Liaison and Finance, and supports the closure of acquisition transactions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Title Due Diligence**

* Conduct and manage legal due diligence on land parcels and project acquisitions, covering the chain of title, revenue and property records (7/12, 8A, property cards, mutation entries), encumbrances, ownership, and possession.
* Review land use, zoning, NA/conversion status, land ceiling, tenancy, agricultural land and farmer-status issues, and other statutory restrictions, as applicable to each state.
* Review litigation search outcomes and assess their impact on title and deal viability, in coordination with the litigation team.
* Prepare due diligence reports with risk ratings, mitigation steps, and conditions precedent, and present findings to senior management.
* Escalate critical title risks and give recommendations on proceeding, price adjustment or deal conditions.

**2. Transaction Support & Documentation**

* Draft, review and negotiate title-related provisions in MoUs, agreements to sell, sale deeds, JDAs and conveyance deeds, including covenants, indemnities, warranties and conditions precedent.
* Support deal structuring for land acquisitions, joint development, joint ventures and redevelopment from a title perspective.
* Manage closing checklists, stamp duty, registration and post-closing title perfection, including mutation and record updates.

**3. External Counsel & Vendor Management**

* Coordinate with external law firms, title search agencies and local counsel, and review their reports and opinions.
* Ensure quality, consistency and timely delivery of external work, and track fees against budgets.

**4. Compliance, Process & Reporting**

* Ensure compliance with RERA, the Transfer of Property Act, the Registration Act, stamp laws, and state land and revenue laws.
* Support lender, investor and audit requirements relating to title.
* Maintain the title status tracker, MIS and document repository for the land bank.
* Contribute to due diligence checklists, templates, SOPs and the title risk matrix.

**5. Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with Business Development, Liaison, Projects and Finance to provide timely and practical legal inputs.
* Build working relationships with revenue and registration authorities and local counsel.
* Mentor junior team members, where applicable.

**Candidate Profile**

**Qualifications**

* LL.B. (mandatory); LL.M. preferred.
* Enrolled advocate or an in-house/law firm real estate background is an advantage.

**Experience**

* 8-12 years of relevant experience in real estate legal work, with a developer, a law firm, or a bank/NBFC legal team.
* Hands-on experience in title due diligence and land acquisition, with Gujarat exposure strongly preferred and exposure to other markets such as Maharashtra or Karnataka an advantage.
* Exposure to JDA/JV, redevelopment and land aggregation transactions is desirable.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of property law, land revenue laws, RERA, and stamp and registration laws.
* Good drafting, reviewing and negotiation skills.
* Ability to identify risks and give practical, business-oriented advice.
* Attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple deals under tight timelines.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office and document management tools.

**Success Measures (Indicative)**

* Quality and turnaround time of due diligence reports.
* Clean closure of acquisitions with minimal post-closing title issues.
* Effective coordination and cost control of external counsel.
* Accuracy and timeliness of trackers and MIS.
